teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organization that presents products, works, or other items at an exhibition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在展览中展示产品、作品或其他物品的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li turi prodotti, xogħlijiet jew oġġetti oħra f'wirja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参展者；在展览中展示物品或作品的个人或机构。

formal.mt: Kull espożitur għandu jipprepara lista tal-prodotti li se juri fil-fiera.
formal.en: Each exhibitor must prepare a list of the products they will display at the fair.
formal.zh: 每位参展商都须准备一份将在展销会上展示的产品清单。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dak ir-raġel huwa espożitur? Rita: Iva, qed juri kotba għat-tfal.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is that man an exhibitor? Rita: Yes, he's displaying children's books.
colloquial.zh: 马克：那位男士是参展商吗？丽塔：是的，他在展示儿童图书。

messages.speaker: Mark (参观者)
messages.zh: 那位男士是参展商吗？
messages.en: Is that man an exhibitor?

messages.speaker: Rita (展会工作人员)
messages.zh: 是的，他在展示儿童图书。
messages.en: Yes, he's displaying children's books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 espożitur 和展台后介绍商品的人联系起来：记住它指参展者，而不是展览活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized explanation of a subject, or a public display of works or objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某一主题有条理的阐述，或向公众展示作品、物品的展览。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spjegazzjoni organizzata ta' suġġett, jew wirja pubblika ta' xogħlijiet jew oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阐述；对主题、观点或论证作有条理的说明。
展览；向公众展示作品或物品的活动。

collocations.en: a clear exposition of the argument

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jinkludi espożizzjoni ċara tal-ideat ewlenin tal-artisti li qed jieħdu sehem fl-espożizzjoni.
formal.en: The catalogue includes a clear exposition of the main ideas of the artists taking part in the exhibition.
formal.zh: 目录清晰阐述了参加此次展览的艺术家们的主要理念。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi miegħi għall-espożizzjoni tal-arti? Pawlu: Iva! Fejn se ssir? Maja: Fil-mużew ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come to the art exhibition with me? Pawlu: Yes! Where will it be held? Maja: At the museum next to the square.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想和我一起去看艺术展吗？保罗：想！在哪里举办？玛雅：在广场旁边的博物馆。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想和我一起去看艺术展吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come to the art exhibition with me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 想！在哪里举办？
messages.en: Yes! Where will it be held?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 在广场旁边的博物馆。
messages.en: At the museum next to the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 espożizzjoni：文章把观点讲清楚，展厅把作品摆出来，分别对应阐述与展览。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In an explicit and clearly stated way, or specifically for a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以明确说出的方式；或专门为了某一特定目的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod espliċitu u ċar, jew apposta għal għan partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明确地，明文地；特意地，专门地。

formal.mt: Ir-regolament jipprojbixxi espressament l-użu tat-telefowns waqt l-eżami.
formal.en: The regulation expressly prohibits the use of phones during the examination.
formal.zh: 该规定明确禁止在考试期间使用手机。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nieħu ritratt hawn? Mark: Le, qalulna espressament li ma nistgħux nieħdu ritratti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I take a photo here? Mark: No, they expressly told us that we can't take photos.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以在这里拍照吗？马克：不行，他们明确告诉过我们不能拍照。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 我可以在这里拍照吗？
messages.en: Can I take a photo here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qalulna espressament li ma nistgħux nieħdu ritratti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qalulna espressament li ma nistgħux nieħdu ritratti.
messages.zh: 不行，他们明确告诉过我们不能拍照。
messages.en: No, they expressly told us that we can't take photos.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 espressament，想象规定中被画线强调的话：意思已经明确说出；用于目的时则记作专门为此。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that vividly communicates feelings or ideas through voice, movement, or artistic performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过声音、动作或艺术表演，生动传达情感或思想地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jwassal sentimenti jew ideat b'ħajja permezz tal-vuċi, tal-moviment jew tal-arti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 富有表现力地；生动传神地表达情感或思想。

formal.mt: L-istudenta qrat il-poeżija espressivament u wasslet id-dwejjaq tal-poeta permezz tal-vuċi tagħha.
formal.en: The student read the poem expressively and conveyed the poet's sadness through her voice.
formal.zh: 这名学生富有感情地朗读了诗歌，通过声音传达出诗人的悲伤。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif għandi naqra din il-poeżija? Pawlu: Aqraha espressivament, u ħalli l-vuċi tiegħek turi dak li qed tħoss.
colloquial.en: Rita: How should I read this poem? Pawlu: Read it expressively, and let your voice show what you're feeling.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这首诗应该怎么读？保罗：读得有感情一些，让你的声音表现出你的感受。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 这首诗应该怎么读？
messages.en: How should I read this poem?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朗诵老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqraha espressivament, u ħalli l-vuċi tiegħek turi dak li qed tħoss.
messages.mt_standard: Aqraha espressivament, u ħalli l-vuċi tiegħek turi dak li qed tħoss.
messages.zh: 读得有感情一些，让你的声音表现出你的感受。
messages.en: Read it expressively, and let your voice show what you're feeling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 espressivament 配上演员有起伏的声音和丰富的表情：重点是表达得传神、有感染力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An artistic approach that emphasizes subjective feelings and inner experience over realistic representation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强调主观情感与内在体验，而非逼真再现外部事物的艺术取向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stil artistiku li jagħti prijorità lis-sentimenti u lill-esperjenza ġewwiena aktar milli lir-rappreżentazzjoni realistika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现主义；着重表现主观情感和内在体验的艺术取向。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tagħha, l-istudenta tispjega kif il-kuluri qawwija u l-forom mgħawġa juru l-influwenza tal-espressjoniżmu.
formal.en: In her analysis, the student explains how the strong colours and distorted forms show the influence of expressionism.
formal.zh: 这名学生在分析中解释了强烈的色彩和扭曲的形态如何体现表现主义的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-wiċċ f'din il-pittura jidher daqshekk mgħawweġ? Mark: Hawnhekk l-espressjoniżmu jenfasizza l-biża' tal-persuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the face in this painting look so distorted? Mark: Here, expressionism emphasizes the person's fear.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这幅画里的人脸为什么看起来这么扭曲？马克：这里用表现主义手法强调人物的恐惧。

messages.speaker: Maja (美术学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-wiċċ f'din il-pittura jidher daqshekk mgħawweġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-wiċċ f'din il-pittura jidher daqshekk mgħawweġ?
messages.zh: 这幅画里的人脸为什么看起来这么扭曲？
messages.en: Why does the face in this painting look so distorted?

messages.speaker: Mark (美术老师)
messages.zh: 这里用表现主义手法强调人物的恐惧。
messages.en: Here, expressionism emphasizes the person's fear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 espressjoniżmu 时，想象画家用夸张色彩画出内心情绪；用这幅学习画面抓住表现主义的重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling or showing extremely intense happiness and excitement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到或表现出极其强烈的喜悦与兴奋的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss jew juri ferħ u eċċitament kbar ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欣喜若狂的；极度喜悦和兴奋的。

formal.mt: Wara li tħabbar ir-riżultat, ir-rebbieħ kien estatiku u rringrazzja lil kull min għenu.
formal.en: After the result was announced, the winner was ecstatic and thanked everyone who had helped him.
formal.zh: 结果公布后，获胜者欣喜若狂，并向所有帮助过他的人表示感谢。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Sibt il-post fil-kors li ridt! Jien estatiku! Lara: Prosit! Naf kemm ħdimt għalih.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: I got a place on the course I wanted! I'm ecstatic! Lara: Congratulations! I know how hard you worked for it.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：我被想读的课程录取了！我高兴坏了！拉拉：恭喜！我知道你为此付出了多少努力。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt il-post fil-kors li ridt! Jien estatiku!
messages.mt_standard: Sibt il-post fil-kors li ridt! Jien estatiku!
messages.zh: 我被想读的课程录取了！我高兴坏了！
messages.en: I got a place on the course I wanted! I'm ecstatic!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 恭喜！我知道你为此付出了多少努力。
messages.en: Congratulations! I know how hard you worked for it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 estatiku 放在收到录取通知后欢呼的画面里，记住它比普通的高兴更强烈，接近欣喜若狂。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove something completely, especially by pulling it out by the roots.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 彻底除去某物，尤其指将植物连根拔除。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi xi ħaġa għal kollox, speċjalment billi jaqla' pjanta bl-għeruq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 根除；彻底清除，尤指连根拔除植物。

formal.mt: It-tim estirpa l-pjanti invażivi miż-żona u neħħa l-għeruq li kienu għadhom fil-ħamrija.
formal.en: The team extirpated the invasive plants from the area and removed the roots that were still in the soil.
formal.zh: 团队彻底清除了该区域的入侵植物，并移除了仍留在土壤中的根。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'għamel il-ġardinar b'dak il-ħaxix ħażin? Mark: Estirpa kollox bl-għeruq, għax kien qed jerġa' jikber.
colloquial.en: Rita: What did the gardener do about those weeds? Mark: He pulled everything out by the roots because it kept growing back.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：园丁怎么处理那些杂草的？马克：他把它们全都连根拔除了，因为它们总是重新长出来。

messages.speaker: Rita (住户)
messages.zh: 园丁怎么处理那些杂草的？
messages.en: What did the gardener do about those weeds?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Estirpa kollox bl-għeruq, għax kien qed jerġa' jikber.
messages.mt_standard: Estirpa kollox bl-għeruq, għax kien qed jerġa' jikber.
messages.zh: 他把它们全都连根拔除了，因为它们总是重新长出来。
messages.en: He pulled everything out by the roots because it kept growing back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用拔草时连根带土一起拔出的动作记 estirpa，重点是彻底除去，而不只是剪掉露出的部分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of removing something completely, especially a plant together with its roots.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 彻底除去某物的行为或过程，尤其指连根清除植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa titneħħa għal kollox, speċjalment pjanta bl-għeruq tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 根除；彻底清除的行为或过程，尤指将植物连根除去。

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' manutenzjoni jinkludi l-estirpazzjoni tal-pjanti invażivi u kontroll regolari taż-żona.
formal.en: The maintenance plan includes the extirpation of invasive plants and regular inspection of the area.
formal.zh: 维护计划包括彻底清除入侵植物，并定期检查该区域。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex trid tneħħi l-għeruq ukoll? Pawlu: Għax l-estirpazzjoni tfisser li nneħħu l-pjanta kollha, mhux biss naqtgħu l-weraq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you need to remove the roots too? Pawlu: Because extirpation means removing the whole plant, not just cutting off the leaves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么还要把根也除掉？保罗：因为根除就是把整株植物清除掉，不只是剪掉叶子。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 为什么还要把根也除掉？
messages.en: Why do you need to remove the roots too?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-estirpazzjoni tfisser li nneħħu l-pjanta kollha, mhux biss naqtgħu l-weraq.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-estirpazzjoni tfisser li nneħħu l-pjanta kollha, mhux biss naqtgħu l-weraq.
messages.zh: 因为根除就是把整株植物清除掉，不只是剪掉叶子。
messages.en: Because extirpation means removing the whole plant, not just cutting off the leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 estirpazzjoni 写在一项完整的除草工作旁边：它是名词，指连根清除这件事或这一过程。

gloss_zh: 爱沙尼亚的；爱沙尼亚人；爱沙尼亚语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Estonia, its people, or its language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与爱沙尼亚、爱沙尼亚人或爱沙尼亚语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Estonja, mal-poplu tagħha jew mal-lingwa tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱沙尼亚的；爱沙尼亚人的；爱沙尼亚语的。
爱沙尼亚人。
爱沙尼亚语。

collocations.zh: 一位住在马耳他的爱沙尼亚人

formal.mt: Il-programm kulturali jinkludi diskors minn kittieb Estonjan u qari ta' poeżiji bl-Estonjan.
formal.en: The cultural programme includes a talk by an Estonian writer and a reading of poems in Estonian.
formal.zh: 文化活动安排包括一位爱沙尼亚作家的演讲，以及爱沙尼亚语诗歌朗诵。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-ħabib il-ġdid tiegħek Estonjan? Mark: Iva, u jitkellem bl-Estonjan mal-familja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is your new friend Estonian? Mark: Yes, and he speaks Estonian with his family.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你的新朋友是爱沙尼亚人吗？马克：是的，他和家人说爱沙尼亚语。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的新朋友是爱沙尼亚人吗？
messages.en: Is your new friend Estonian?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jitkellem bl-Estonjan mal-familja tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jitkellem bl-Estonjan mal-familja tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，他和家人说爱沙尼亚语。
messages.en: Yes, and he speaks Estonian with his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把同一个词放进三个画面：爱沙尼亚作家、爱沙尼亚朋友、说爱沙尼亚语；靠句中位置区分形容词、人物名词和语言名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally hand a person over to another country for prosecution or punishment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人正式移交给另一个国家，以便接受刑事追诉或服刑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadda persuna uffiċjalment lil pajjiż ieħor biex titressaq il-qorti jew tiskonta piena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引渡；把某人正式移交给另一个国家接受刑事追诉或服刑。

collocations.en: extradited the suspect to another country
collocations.zh: 把嫌疑人引渡到了另一个国家

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-pajjiż estrada lill-akkużat wara li tlestew il-proċeduri meħtieġa.
formal.en: According to the report, the country extradited the accused after the required procedures were completed.
formal.zh: 报告称，该国在完成必要程序后引渡了被告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jgħid ir-rapport dwar is-suspettat? Pawlu: Jgħid li l-pajjiż estrada lis-suspettat ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the report say about the suspect? Paul: It says the country extradited the suspect yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：报告里怎么说那名嫌疑人的情况？保罗：报告说，该国昨天引渡了那名嫌疑人。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 报告里怎么说那名嫌疑人的情况？
messages.en: What does the report say about the suspect?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħid li l-pajjiż estrada lis-suspettat ilbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħid li l-pajjiż estrada lis-suspettat ilbieraħ.
messages.zh: 报告说，该国昨天引渡了那名嫌疑人。
messages.en: It says the country extradited the suspect yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两国之间正式移交嫌疑人的画面记住 estrada，重点联想法律程序中的“引渡”动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A passage taken from a longer text, or a substance obtained by extracting it from another material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从较长文本中选出的片段，或从某种材料中提取出的物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Silta meħuda minn test itwal, jew sustanza miksuba billi tiġi estratta minn materjal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摘录，指从较长文本中选出的片段；也指从材料中取得的提取物。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jaqraw l-estratt mir-rumanz u jiddeskrivu l-karattru prinċipali.
formal.en: The students should read the extract from the novel and describe the main character.
formal.zh: 学生应阅读这段小说摘录，并描述主人公。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'għandi nżid mat-taħlita tal-kejk? Toni: Żid kuċċarina estratt tal-vanilla.
colloquial.en: Maria: What should I add to the cake mixture? Tony: Add a teaspoon of vanilla extract.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：蛋糕糊里该加什么？托尼：加一茶匙香草提取物。

messages.speaker: Marija (烘焙学员)
messages.zh: 蛋糕糊里该加什么？
messages.en: What should I add to the cake mixture?

messages.speaker: Toni (烘焙老师)
messages.zh: 加一茶匙香草提取物。
messages.en: Add a teaspoon of vanilla extract.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 estratt 想成“取出来的那一部分”：从书里取出的是摘录，从原料里取出的是提取物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove or obtain a substance, item, or information from something containing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从包含某种物质、物件或信息的材料中将其取出或获取。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħareġ jew kiseb sustanza, oġġett jew informazzjoni minn xi ħaġa li jkun fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提取；抽取；从某种材料或整体中取出所需的物质、物件或信息。

collocations.en: extracted the oil from the seeds
extracted the information from the text

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur estratta ż-żejt miż-żrieragħ u kejjel il-kwantità miksuba.
formal.en: The researcher extracted the oil from the seeds and measured the quantity obtained.
formal.zh: 研究人员从种子中提取了油，并测量了所得的量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sibt id-dati kollha hekk malajr? Mark: Il-programm estratta d-dati mit-test għalija.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you find all the dates so quickly? Mark: The program extracted the dates from the text for me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么这么快就找到了所有日期？马克：程序帮我从文本中提取了日期。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sibt id-dati kollha hekk malajr?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sibt id-dati kollha hekk malajr?
messages.zh: 你怎么这么快就找到了所有日期？
messages.en: How did you find all the dates so quickly?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 程序帮我从文本中提取了日期。
messages.en: The program extracted the dates from the text for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“谁从哪里提取了什么”造句记 estratta：研究员从种子提取油，程序从文本提取日期，抓住动作本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or act of removing or obtaining something from a material, place, or larger whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从材料、某个位置或较大的整体中取出或获取某物的过程或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-att li bih xi ħaġa tinħareġ jew tinkiseb minn materjal, post jew ħaġa akbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提取、抽取或取出的过程；用于牙科语境时可指拔牙。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-estrazzjoni taż-żejt miż-żrieragħ u l-kejl tal-kwantità miksuba.
formal.en: The report describes the extraction of oil from seeds and the measurement of the quantity obtained.
formal.zh: 报告描述了从种子中提取油的过程，以及对所得量的测量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex sejjer għand id-dentist għada? Pawlu: Għandi appuntament għall-estrazzjoni ta' sinna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you going to the dentist tomorrow? Paul: I have an appointment for a tooth extraction.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你明天为什么要去看牙医？保罗：我约了拔牙。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天为什么要去看牙医？
messages.en: Why are you going to the dentist tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我约了拔牙。
messages.en: I have an appointment for a tooth extraction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 estrazzjoni 记成“取出这件事”：取油叫提取，取数据叫抽取，取出牙齿叫拔牙，具体译法看对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose romantic or sexual attraction is toward people of a different sex from their own.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在浪漫情感或性方面受到异性吸引的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħoss attrazzjoni romantika jew sesswali lejn persuni ta' sess differenti minn tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 异性恋者；在浪漫情感或性方面受到异性吸引的人。
异性恋的；描述对异性产生浪漫情感或性吸引的性取向。

formal.mt: Fil-glossarju, eterosesswali huwa definit bħala persuna li tħoss attrazzjoni romantika jew sesswali lejn persuni ta' sess differenti minn tagħha.
formal.en: In the glossary, a heterosexual is defined as a person whose romantic or sexual attraction is toward people of a different sex from their own.
formal.zh: 词汇表把异性恋者定义为在浪漫情感或性方面受到异性吸引的人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi tfisser il-kelma eterosesswali hawn? Marija: Tfisser persuna li tħoss attrazzjoni romantika jew sesswali lejn persuni ta' sess differenti minn tagħha.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does the word heterosexual mean here? Maria: It means a person whose romantic or sexual attraction is toward people of a different sex from their own.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这里的 eterosesswali 是什么意思？玛丽亚：指在浪漫情感或性方面受到异性吸引的人。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 eterosesswali 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word heterosexual mean here?

messages.speaker: Marija (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser persuna li tħoss attrazzjoni romantika jew sesswali lejn persuni ta' sess differenti minn tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser persuna li tħoss attrazzjoni romantika jew sesswali lejn persuni ta' sess differenti minn tagħha.
messages.zh: 指在浪漫情感或性方面受到异性吸引的人。
messages.en: It means a person whose romantic or sexual attraction is toward people of a different sex from their own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“人”和“人的取向”两张词卡记忆：单独指人时译为异性恋者，修饰 persuna 或 orjentazzjoni 时译为异性恋的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sexual orientation involving romantic or sexual attraction toward people of a different sex from one's own.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对异性产生浪漫情感或性吸引的性取向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Orjentazzjoni sesswali li tinvolvi attrazzjoni romantika jew sesswali lejn persuni ta' sess differenti minn dak tal-persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 异性恋；对异性产生浪漫情感或性吸引的性取向。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jispjega l-eterosesswalità bħala orjentazzjoni sesswali li tinvolvi attrazzjoni romantika jew sesswali lejn persuni ta' sess differenti.
formal.en: The chapter explains heterosexuality as a sexual orientation involving romantic or sexual attraction toward people of a different sex.
formal.zh: 本章将异性恋解释为一种对异性产生浪漫情感或性吸引的性取向。

colloquial.mt: Mark: L-eterosesswalità tfisser persuna jew orjentazzjoni? Sara: Orjentazzjoni. Biex tirreferi għal persuna, tista' tgħid eterosesswali.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does heterosexuality mean a person or an orientation? Sara: An orientation. To refer to a person, you can say heterosexual.
colloquial.zh: 马克：eterosesswalità 指人还是一种取向？萨拉：一种取向。要指一个人，可以用 eterosesswali。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: eterosesswalità 指人还是一种取向？
messages.en: Does heterosexuality mean a person or an orientation?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Orjentazzjoni. Biex tirreferi għal persuna, tista' tgħid eterosesswali.
messages.mt_standard: Orjentazzjoni. Biex tirreferi għal persuna, tista' tgħid eterosesswali.
messages.zh: 一种取向。要指一个人，可以用 eterosesswali。
messages.en: An orientation. To refer to a person, you can say heterosexual.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eterosesswalità 放在“性取向”这一栏，把 eterosesswali 放在“人或形容词”这一栏，用词卡分类记住两者的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A specialist who studies the origins of words and how their forms and meanings have developed over time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究词语起源以及词形、词义如何随时间演变的学者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Studjuż li jistudja l-oriġini tal-kliem u kif il-forom u t-tifsiriet tiegħu żviluppaw matul iż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词源学家；研究词语起源和历史演变的学者。

formal.mt: L-etimologu qabbel forom antiki tal-kelma biex jistudja l-iżvilupp tagħha.
formal.en: The etymologist compared old forms of the word to study its development.
formal.zh: 这位词源学家比较了该词的古老形式，以研究它的演变。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar l-oriġini ta' din il-kelma? Pawlu: Tista' tistaqsi lil etimologu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who can I ask about the origin of this word? Pawlu: You can ask an etymologist.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：关于这个词的起源，我可以问谁？保罗：你可以请教词源学家。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar l-oriġini ta' din il-kelma?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar l-oriġini ta' din il-kelma?
messages.zh: 关于这个词的起源，我可以问谁？
messages.en: Who can I ask about the origin of this word?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 你可以请教词源学家。
messages.en: You can ask an etymologist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位翻查古老词典的学者，给他贴上 etimologu 标签；这个词指研究词源的人。

gloss_zh: 从词源上说；在词源方面

teaching_sense.en_definition: With regard to the origin and historical development of a word.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一个词的来源及其历史发展这一角度来说。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mill-aspett tal-oriġini ta' kelma u tal-iżvilupp storiku tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从词源上说；就词的来源和历史发展而言。

collocations.zh: 从词源角度分析一个词
从词源角度解释一个术语

formal.mt: Biex janalizza kelma etimoloġikament, ir-riċerkatur jeżamina l-oriġini tagħha u l-forom dokumentati tagħha matul iż-żmien.
formal.en: To analyse a word etymologically, the researcher examines its origin and its documented forms over time.
formal.zh: 为了从词源角度分析一个词，研究人员考察其来源，以及不同时期有文献记录的形式。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser li tispjega kelma etimoloġikament? Toni: Tfisser li tispjega minn fejn ġiet u kif żviluppat matul iż-żmien.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does it mean to explain a word etymologically? Tony: It means explaining where it came from and how it developed over time.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：从词源角度解释一个词是什么意思？托尼：就是解释它从哪里来，以及它随着时间怎样发展。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser li tispjega kelma etimoloġikament?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser li tispjega kelma etimoloġikament?
messages.zh: 从词源角度解释一个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean to explain a word etymologically?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li tispjega minn fejn ġiet u kif żviluppat matul iż-żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li tispjega minn fejn ġiet u kif żviluppat matul iż-żmien.
messages.zh: 就是解释它从哪里来，以及它随着时间怎样发展。
messages.en: It means explaining where it came from and how it developed over time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给一个词画时间线，从最早记录一路看到后来的变化；etimoloġikament 提醒你切换到“从词源上说”的观察角度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the origins of words and the historical development of their forms and meanings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与词语的起源以及词形、词义的历史发展有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-oriġini tal-kliem u mal-iżvilupp tal-forom u t-tifsiriet tiegħu matul iż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词源的；研究词语起源及其历史演变的。

formal.mt: L-istudju etimoloġiku jeżamina kif il-forma u t-tifsira ta' kelma nbidlu matul iż-żmien.
formal.en: The etymological study examines how the form and meaning of a word have changed over time.
formal.zh: 这项词源研究考察一个词的形式和意义如何随时间发生变化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan id-dizzjunarju jgħid minn fejn ġej il-kliem? Mark: Iva, huwa dizzjunarju etimoloġiku.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this dictionary tell you where words come from? Mark: Yes, it is an etymological dictionary.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这本词典会告诉你词语从哪里来吗？马克：会，这是一本词源词典。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-dizzjunarju jgħid minn fejn ġej il-kliem?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-dizzjunarju jgħid minn fejn ġej il-kliem?
messages.zh: 这本词典会告诉你词语从哪里来吗？
messages.en: Does this dictionary tell you where words come from?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 会，这是一本词源词典。
messages.en: Yes, it is an etymological dictionary.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 etimoloġiku 和“词源词典”一起记：它描述研究或词典的性质，表示“与词源有关的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An earlier word or word form from which another word has developed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 另一个词在历史上由之发展而来的较早词语或词形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma jew forma eqdem ta' kelma li minnha tkun żviluppat kelma oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 语源词；某个词在历史上所源自的较早词语或词形。

formal.mt: L-awtur jipproponi etimu għall-kelma u jippreżenta evidenza biex isostni l-analiżi tiegħu.
formal.en: The author proposes an etymon for the word and presents evidence to support his analysis.
formal.zh: 作者为该词提出一个语源词，并提供证据支持自己的分析。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu etimu? David: Huwa kelma jew forma eqdem li minnha żviluppat kelma oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is an etymon? David: It is an earlier word or form from which another word developed.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：什么是语源词？戴维：就是另一个词由之发展而来的较早词语或词形。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是语源词？
messages.en: What is an etymon?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa kelma jew forma eqdem li minnha żviluppat kelma oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa kelma jew forma eqdem li minnha żviluppat kelma oħra.
messages.zh: 就是另一个词由之发展而来的较早词语或词形。
messages.en: It is an earlier word or form from which another word developed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上画“较早词形→后来词语”，把 etimu 写在箭头起点，记住它表示后来词语的来源形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a country in East Africa, officially the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 东非国家埃塞俄比亚的名称，正式国名为埃塞俄比亚联邦民主共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Lvant, uffiċjalment ir-Repubblika Demokratika Federali tal-Etjopja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Ethiopia (a country in East Africa; official name: Repubblika Demokratika Federali tal-Etjopja)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 埃塞俄比亚，东非国家；正式国名为埃塞俄比亚联邦民主共和国。

collocations.zh: 前往埃塞俄比亚的旅行

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi taqsima dwar l-Etjopja, pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Lvant.
formal.en: The report includes a section on Ethiopia, a country in East Africa.
formal.zh: 报告包含一个介绍埃塞俄比亚的章节，该国位于东非。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tinsab l-Etjopja? Daniel: Fl-Afrika tal-Lvant. Ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Ethiopia? Daniel: In East Africa. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：埃塞俄比亚在哪里？丹尼尔：在东非。我们在地图上找找吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 埃塞俄比亚在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Ethiopia?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-Afrika tal-Lvant. Ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-Afrika tal-Lvant. Ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在东非。我们在地图上找找吧。
messages.en: In East Africa. Let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Etjopja 写在东非地图旁，与“埃塞俄比亚”配对记忆；作为国家名称，实际书写时首字母大写。

gloss_zh: 民族志的；民族志研究的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the detailed study and description of a community's culture and everyday life, often through direct observation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与细致研究和描述某个社群的文化及日常生活有关的，通常涉及直接观察。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-istudju u d-deskrizzjoni dettaljata tal-kultura u l-ħajja ta' kuljum ta' komunità, spiss permezz ta' osservazzjoni diretta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 民族志的；与观察、研究和描述社群文化及日常生活有关的。

formal.mt: L-istudju etnografiku jiddeskrivi l-ħajja ta' kuljum tal-komunità permezz ta' osservazzjonijiet u intervisti.
formal.en: The ethnographic study describes the community's everyday life through observations and interviews.
formal.zh: 这项民族志研究通过观察和访谈描述该社群的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex tqatta' daqshekk ħin mal-komunità? Mark: Qed nagħmel studju etnografiku biex nifhem il-ħajja tagħhom ta' kuljum.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you spend so much time with the community? Mark: I am doing an ethnographic study to understand their everyday life.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么花这么多时间和这个社群的人相处？马克：我在做民族志研究，想了解他们的日常生活。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么花这么多时间和这个社群的人相处？
messages.en: Why do you spend so much time with the community?

messages.speaker: Mark (研究者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel studju etnografiku biex nifhem il-ħajja tagħhom ta' kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel studju etnografiku biex nifhem il-ħajja tagħhom ta' kuljum.
messages.zh: 我在做民族志研究，想了解他们的日常生活。
messages.en: I am doing an ethnographic study to understand their everyday life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 etnografiku 配上“走进社群、观察生活、记录访谈”三个画面，联想民族志研究的具体工作。

gloss_zh: 民族中心主义的；以本族文化为中心的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Judging other cultures mainly by the standards of one's own culture, often treating those standards as superior.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主要以自身文化的标准评判其他文化，并常将自身文化的标准视为更优越的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġġudika kulturi oħra skont il-kriterji tal-kultura tiegħu stess, spiss billi jqis dawk il-kriterji bħala superjuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 民族中心主义的；以自身民族或文化的标准衡量其他文化的。

collocations.zh: 以本族文化为中心的研究或处理方式

formal.mt: Approċċ etnoċentriku jista' jwassal għal interpretazzjoni żbaljata tad-drawwiet ta' komunità oħra.
formal.en: An ethnocentric approach can lead to a mistaken interpretation of another community's customs.
formal.zh: 以自身文化为中心的理解方式可能导致对其他社群习俗的误读。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din id-drawwa hija ħażina għax aħna nagħmlu mod ieħor. Samwel: Dan hu ħsieb etnoċentriku; ejja nifhmu għaliex jagħmlu hekk.
colloquial.en: Lara: This custom is wrong because we do things differently. Samwel: That is ethnocentric thinking; let's understand why they do it that way.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这种习俗不对，因为我们的做法不同。塞缪尔：这是以自身文化为中心的想法；我们先了解他们为什么这样做吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din id-drawwa hija ħażina għax aħna nagħmlu mod ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Din id-drawwa hija ħażina għax aħna nagħmlu mod ieħor.
messages.zh: 这种习俗不对，因为我们的做法不同。
messages.en: This custom is wrong because we do things differently.

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu ħsieb etnoċentriku; ejja nifhmu għaliex jagħmlu hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu ħsieb etnoċentriku; ejja nifhmu għaliex jagħmlu hekk.
messages.zh: 这是以自身文化为中心的想法；我们先了解他们为什么这样做吧。
messages.en: That is ethnocentric thinking; let's understand why they do it that way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象只拿“我们文化的尺子”衡量所有人，把这个画面配给 etnoċentriku，记住其中以自身文化为评判中心的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of assessing the quality, value, effectiveness, or results of something using relevant criteria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依据相关标准判断某事物的质量、价值、成效或结果的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jiġu vvalutati l-kwalità, il-valur, l-effettività jew ir-riżultati ta' xi ħaġa skont kriterji rilevanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 评估；依据一定标准对质量、价值、成效或结果作出的评价。

formal.mt: L-evalwazzjoni tal-proġett se tqis jekk l-għanijiet intlaħqux u kif intużaw ir-riżorsi.
formal.en: The project evaluation will consider whether the objectives were achieved and how the resources were used.
formal.zh: 项目评估将考察目标是否达成，以及资源的使用情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se nkunu nafu jekk l-attività rnexxietx? Pawlu: Nagħmlu evalwazzjoni u nistaqsu lill-parteċipanti x'jaħsbu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How will we know whether the activity was successful? Pawlu: We will carry out an evaluation and ask the participants what they think.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们怎么知道活动是否成功？保罗：我们做一次评估，再问问参与者的看法。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nkunu nafu jekk l-attività rnexxietx?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nkunu nafu jekk l-attività rnexxietx?
messages.zh: 我们怎么知道活动是否成功？
messages.en: How will we know whether the activity was successful?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmlu evalwazzjoni u nistaqsu lill-parteċipanti x'jaħsbu.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmlu evalwazzjoni u nistaqsu lill-parteċipanti x'jaħsbu.
messages.zh: 我们做一次评估，再问问参与者的看法。
messages.en: We will carry out an evaluation and ask the participants what they think.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 evalwazzjoni 与英语 evaluation 配对，再想象“列标准、看结果、作评价”的流程，记住它表示评估。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called europium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素铕的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bħala ewropju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铕，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tal-kimika tinkludi eżerċizzju dwar kif issib l-ewropju fit-tabella perjodika.
formal.en: The chemistry lesson includes an exercise on finding europium in the periodic table.
formal.zh: 这节化学课包含一道在元素周期表中查找铕的练习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-ewropju? Daniel: Huwa element kimiku. Ejja nfittxuh fit-tabella perjodika.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is europium? Daniel: It is a chemical element. Let's look for it in the periodic table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：铕是什么？丹尼尔：它是一种化学元素。我们在元素周期表里找找吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 铕是什么？
messages.en: What is europium?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku. Ejja nfittxuh fit-tabella perjodika.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku. Ejja nfittxuh fit-tabella perjodika.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素。我们在元素周期表里找找吧。
messages.en: It is a chemical element. Let's look for it in the periodic table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张三语元素卡，把 ewropju、europium 和“铕”写在同一格，再联想在元素周期表中查找它的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming before all others in a sequence, order, or series.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在顺序、次序或系列中排在所有其他项之前的，即第一的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi qabel l-oħrajn kollha f'sensiela jew f'ordni.

sense_translations.en_definition: first (of a series or order, before second and third)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 第一的；在系列或顺序中位于第二、第三等之前的。

formal.mt: Fl-ewwel jum tal-kors, l-għalliema spjegat l-għanijiet tat-tagħlim.
formal.en: On the first day of the course, the teacher explained the learning objectives.
formal.zh: 课程第一天，老师说明了学习目标。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema eżerċizzju se nagħmlu? Mark: L-ewwel wieħed, fil-paġna ta' quddiem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which exercise are we going to do? Mark: The first one, on the front page.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们要做哪一道练习？马克：第一道，在最前面那一页。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我们要做哪一道练习？
messages.en: Which exercise are we going to do?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 第一道，在最前面那一页。
messages.en: The first one, on the front page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ewwel 放在数字队列最前面，想象“第一天、第一位、第一道题”；连同常见形式 l-ewwel 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat geometric shape with six sides and six angles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有六条边和六个角的平面几何图形；不一定各边相等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Figura ġeometrika ċatta li għandha sitt naħat u sitt angoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 六边形；具有六条边和六个角的平面图形。

formal.mt: L-istudent pinġa eżagonu regolari u kejjel it-tul ta' kull naħa.
formal.en: The student drew a regular hexagon and measured the length of each side.
formal.zh: 学生画了一个正六边形，并测量了每条边的长度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-figura għandha sitt naħat. X'jisimha? Pawlu: Eżagonu. Ejja ngħoddu n-naħat flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: This shape has six sides. What is it called? Pawlu: A hexagon. Let's count the sides together.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个图形有六条边，叫什么？保罗：六边形。我们一起数数它的边吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-figura għandha sitt naħat. X'jisimha?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-figura għandha sitt naħat. X'jisimha?
messages.zh: 这个图形有六条边，叫什么？
messages.en: This shape has six sides. What is it called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 六边形。我们一起数数它的边吧。
messages.en: A hexagon. Let's count the sides together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 eżagonu 旁边画六边形，每读一次就沿轮廓数六条边；先记“六条边”，不要把所有六边形都想成正六边形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being correct or of closely matching the true value or facts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信息、测量或结果正确，或与真实数值、事实相符合的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' informazzjoni, kejl jew riżultat li jkun korrett u jaqbel mal-fatti jew mal-valur veru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准确性；信息、测量或结果与事实或真实数值相符的程度。

formal.mt: Qabel il-pubblikazzjoni tar-rapport, ir-riċerkaturi vverifikaw l-eżattezza tad-data.
formal.en: Before publishing the report, the researchers verified the accuracy of the data.
formal.zh: 在发布报告之前，研究人员核实了数据的准确性。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nikteb numru approssimattiv hawn? David: Aħjar tiċċekkjah; l-eżattezza hija importanti għal dan il-kalkolu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I write an approximate number here? David: You'd better check it; accuracy is important for this calculation.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里可以写一个大概的数字吗？戴维：最好核对一下；这个计算很讲究准确性。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 这里可以写一个大概的数字吗？
messages.en: Can I write an approximate number here?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar tiċċekkjah; l-eżattezza hija importanti għal dan il-kalkolu.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar tiċċekkjah; l-eżattezza hija importanti għal dan il-kalkolu.
messages.zh: 最好核对一下；这个计算很讲究准确性。
messages.en: You'd better check it; accuracy is important for this calculation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eżattezza 和“核对数字是否准确”的动作绑定：读词时想象逐位检查小数，记住它表示准确性这一性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An activity done to practise a skill or to improve physical fitness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为练习某项技能而进行的活动或题目，也可指增强体能的锻炼活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività jew biċċa xogħol li ssir biex titħarreġ ħila jew biex titjieb il-kundizzjoni fiżika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 练习；练习题；也可指身体锻炼或某项锻炼动作。

formal.mt: Dan l-eżerċizzju jgħin lill-istudenti jużaw il-verbi fil-passat.
formal.en: This exercise helps students use verbs in the past tense.
formal.zh: 这项练习帮助学生使用动词的过去时。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Spiċċajt l-eżerċizzju tal-grammatika? Ben: Għadni le. Tista' tgħinni bl-aħħar mistoqsija?
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you finished the grammar exercise? Ben: Not yet. Can you help me with the last question?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你做完语法练习了吗？本：还没有。你能帮我看看最后一题吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你做完语法练习了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished the grammar exercise?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Tista' tgħinni bl-aħħar mistoqsija?
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Tista' tgħinni bl-aħħar mistoqsija?
messages.zh: 还没有。你能帮我看看最后一题吗？
messages.en: Not yet. Can you help me with the last question?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 eżerċizzju 配两幅图：书上的练习题和操场上的锻炼动作；两种场景都通过反复练习来提高能力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized military force, especially one trained to fight on land; a large body of troops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有组织的军事力量，尤其指接受陆地作战训练的军队，也可指大批军人组成的大军。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forza militari organizzata, speċjalment għat-taqbid fuq l-art, jew għadd kbir ta' suldati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 军队；陆军；大军。这里的 host 指成群的军队。

formal.mt: Wara l-għargħar, l-eżerċtu għen fit-tqassim tal-ikel lill-familji milquta.
formal.en: After the flooding, the army helped distribute food to the affected families.
formal.zh: 洪水过后，军队协助向受灾家庭分发食物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħuk jaħdem mal-eżerċtu? Mark: Iva, huwa suldat u llum qiegħed bit-taħriġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does your brother work for the army? Mark: Yes, he's a soldier and he's training today.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你哥哥在军队工作吗？马克：是的，他是军人，今天在训练。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥在军队工作吗？
messages.en: Does your brother work for the army?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa suldat u llum qiegħed bit-taħriġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa suldat u llum qiegħed bit-taħriġ.
messages.zh: 是的，他是军人，今天在训练。
messages.en: Yes, he's a soldier and he's training today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eżerċtu 写在一整支军队的图下，把 suldat 写在单个士兵旁；通过“集体军队—个体士兵”帮助区分。

gloss_zh: 存在的；关乎人生存在与意义的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to existence, especially human existence and questions about life's meaning, freedom, and choices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与存在有关的，尤其用于涉及人的存在、人生意义、自由及选择等问题。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-eżistenza, speċjalment mal-eżistenza tal-bniedem, it-tifsira tal-ħajja, il-libertà u l-għażliet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存在的；关乎人的存在、人生意义等根本问题的。

collocations.zh: 关于存在或人生意义的问题
存在危机；对人生意义的深刻困惑

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz iqajjem mistoqsija eżistenzjali dwar it-tifsira tal-ħajja u r-responsabbiltà personali.
formal.en: The novel raises an existential question about the meaning of life and personal responsibility.
formal.zh: 这部小说提出了一个关于人生意义与个人责任的存在性问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi drabi nistaqsi għaliex qiegħda nagħmel dan kollu. Nina: Dik mistoqsija eżistenzjali. Trid nitkellmu ftit dwarha?
colloquial.en: Maja: Sometimes I wonder why I'm doing all this. Nina: That's an existential question. Would you like to talk about it for a bit?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：有时我会想，我做这一切到底是为了什么。妮娜：这是个关于人生意义的问题。想聊一会儿吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi drabi nistaqsi għaliex qiegħda nagħmel dan kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Xi drabi nistaqsi għaliex qiegħda nagħmel dan kollu.
messages.zh: 有时我会想，我做这一切到底是为了什么。
messages.en: Sometimes I wonder why I'm doing all this.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik mistoqsija eżistenzjali. Trid nitkellmu ftit dwarha?
messages.mt_standard: Dik mistoqsija eżistenzjali. Trid nitkellmu ftit dwarha?
messages.zh: 这是个关于人生意义的问题。想聊一会儿吗？
messages.en: That's an existential question. Would you like to talk about it for a bit?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“我为何存在、人生有什么意义”这两问记住 eżistenzjali；它是形容词，用来修饰这类问题或危机。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who follows or advocates existentialism, emphasizing individual existence, freedom, choice, and responsibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认同或倡导存在主义的人，重视个体存在、自由、选择与责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħaddan jew tippromwovi l-eżistenzjaliżmu u tagħti importanza lill-eżistenza individwali, il-libertà, l-għażla u r-responsabbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存在主义者；认同或倡导存在主义思想的人。

collocations.zh: 一位知名的存在主义者
一位存在主义者的思想

formal.mt: Fl-esej tagħha, l-istudenta tispjega kif eżistenzjalista jifhem ir-rabta bejn il-libertà u r-responsabbiltà.
formal.en: In her essay, the student explains how an existentialist understands the relationship between freedom and responsibility.
formal.zh: 这名学生在论文中解释了一位存在主义者如何理解自由与责任的关系。

colloquial.mt: Ben: X'inhu eżistenzjalista? Sara: Persuna li tħaddan l-eżistenzjaliżmu. L-għażliet u r-responsabbiltà personali huma importanti f'dan il-ħsieb.
colloquial.en: Ben: What is an existentialist? Sara: A person who follows existentialism. Choices and personal responsibility are important in this way of thinking.
colloquial.zh: 本：什么是存在主义者？萨拉：就是认同存在主义的人。这种思想重视选择和个人责任。

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 什么是存在主义者？
messages.en: What is an existentialist?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna li tħaddan l-eżistenzjaliżmu. L-għażliet u r-responsabbiltà personali huma importanti f'dan il-ħsieb.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna li tħaddan l-eżistenzjaliżmu. L-għażliet u r-responsabbiltà personali huma importanti f'dan il-ħsieb.
messages.zh: 就是认同存在主义的人。这种思想重视选择和个人责任。
messages.en: A person who follows existentialism. Choices and personal responsibility are important in this way of thinking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 eżistenzjalista 配一张人物卡，卡上写“存在主义者”；与表示思想体系的 eżistenzjaliżmu 对照，先判断说的是人还是思想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A philosophical approach that focuses on individual existence, freedom, choice, responsibility, and the search for meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 关注个体存在、自由、选择、责任以及意义追寻的一种哲学思想。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsieb filosofiku li jiffoka fuq l-eżistenza individwali, il-libertà, l-għażla, ir-responsabbiltà u t-tfittxija għal tifsira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存在主义；着重探讨个体存在、自由选择、责任与人生意义的哲学思想。

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jintroduċi l-eżistenzjaliżmu permezz ta' diskussjoni dwar il-libertà tal-individwu u r-responsabbiltà għall-għażliet tiegħu.
formal.en: This chapter introduces existentialism through a discussion of individual freedom and responsibility for one's choices.
formal.zh: 本章通过讨论个体自由以及个人对自身选择所负的责任，介绍存在主义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dwar xiex inhi l-lezzjoni tal-lum? Pawlu: Dwar l-eżistenzjaliżmu. Se nitkellmu dwar kif nagħżlu u kif nagħtu tifsira lil ħajjitna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is today's lesson about? Pawlu: Existentialism. We'll talk about how we make choices and give meaning to our lives.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天的课讲什么？保罗：存在主义。我们会谈谈如何作出选择，以及如何赋予生活意义。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 今天的课讲什么？
messages.en: What is today's lesson about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar l-eżistenzjaliżmu. Se nitkellmu dwar kif nagħżlu u kif nagħtu tifsira lil ħajjitna.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar l-eżistenzjaliżmu. Se nitkellmu dwar kif nagħżlu u kif nagħtu tifsira lil ħajjitna.
messages.zh: 存在主义。我们会谈谈如何作出选择，以及如何赋予生活意义。
messages.en: Existentialism. We'll talk about how we make choices and give meaning to our lives.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eżistenzjaliżmu 写在一本哲学书的封面上，旁注“存在主义：存在、选择、责任、意义”；用书代表思想，用人物卡代表存在主义者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form of the preposition meaning in, used before certain following words to express location or time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“在”的介词形式，用在某些后接词前，说明所在地点或所处时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tal-prepożizzjoni fi, li tintuża qabel ċertu kliem biex tindika post jew żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……里；在……地方；在……期间

formal.mt: Il-kors se jsir f'Malta f'April.
formal.en: The course will take place in Malta in April.
formal.zh: 课程将于四月在马耳他举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se tkun f'April? Mark: Se nkun f'Malta mal-familja tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where will you be in April? Mark: I'll be in Malta with my family.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：四月你会在哪里？马克：我会和家人在马耳他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 四月你会在哪里？
messages.en: Where will you be in April?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我会和家人在马耳他。
messages.en: I'll be in Malta with my family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 f'Malta 和 f'April 成对记忆：前者把人放进地点，后者把事情放进月份；撇号也是拼写的一部分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The objects placed on a stage to help create the setting of a performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摆放在舞台上、用于构成演出场景的各种物件，即舞台道具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-oġġetti li jitqiegħdu fuq il-palk biex jgħinu joħolqu x-xena ta' rappreżentazzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: props (items placed on a stage to create a scene)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 舞台道具，即摆放在舞台上以构成场景的物件

formal.mt: Qabel il-prova, it-tim ħejja l-fabbiżonju tax-xena u poġġa l-mejda u s-siġġijiet fuq il-palk.
formal.en: Before the rehearsal, the team prepared the props for the scene and placed the table and chairs on the stage.
formal.zh: 排练前，团队准备好了该场景的道具，并把桌椅摆上舞台。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-fabbiżonju lest għall-prova? Pawlu: Kważi; għad irrid inġib it-telefon il-qadim għax-xena.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are the props ready for rehearsal? Pawlu: Almost; I still need to bring the old telephone for the scene.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：排练用的道具准备好了吗？保罗：差不多了；我还得把场景要用的旧电话拿来。

messages.speaker: Lara (导演)
messages.zh: 排练用的道具准备好了吗？
messages.en: Are the props ready for rehearsal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (舞台助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; għad irrid inġib it-telefon il-qadim għax-xena.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; għad irrid inġib it-telefon il-qadim għax-xena.
messages.zh: 差不多了；我还得把场景要用的旧电话拿来。
messages.en: Almost; I still need to bring the old telephone for the scene.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象开演前逐件检查桌子、椅子和旧电话，把这一整组帮助布置场景的物件记作 fabbiżonju。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be made through a manufacturing process using suitable materials and equipment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够利用合适的材料和设备，通过制造过程生产出来的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġi magħmul permezz ta' proċess ta' manifattura b'materjali u tagħmir adattati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可制造的；具备生产可行性的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkonferma li l-prodott huwa fabbrikabbli bit-tagħmir disponibbli fil-fabbrika.
formal.en: The report confirms that the product is manufacturable with the equipment available at the factory.
formal.zh: 报告确认，利用工厂现有设备可以制造该产品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-mudell huwa fabbrikabbli bil-magni tagħna? David: Iva, iżda rridu nbiddlu parti żgħira mid-disinn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can this model be manufactured using our machines? David: Yes, but we need to change a small part of the design.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个型号能用我们的机器制造吗？戴维：能，但我们得修改设计中的一小部分。

messages.speaker: Sara (产品设计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-mudell huwa fabbrikabbli bil-magni tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-mudell huwa fabbrikabbli bil-magni tagħna?
messages.zh: 这个型号能用我们的机器制造吗？
messages.en: Can this model be manufactured using our machines?

messages.speaker: David (生产工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda rridu nbiddlu parti żgħira mid-disinn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda rridu nbiddlu parti żgħira mid-disinn.
messages.zh: 能，但我们得修改设计中的一小部分。
messages.en: Yes, but we need to change a small part of the design.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 fabbrikabbli 就想象工程师拿着图纸检查机器能否做出实物，重点记住“能够制造”这个性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company that makes goods, especially through an organized production process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制造商品的个人或企业，尤其指通过有组织的生产过程制造产品的厂家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tagħmel prodotti, speċjalment permezz ta' proċess ta' produzzjoni organizzat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制造商；生产商品的个人或企业

collocations.zh: 制造商提供的使用说明

formal.mt: Qabel tuża l-apparat, aqra bir-reqqa l-istruzzjonijiet tal-fabbrikant.
formal.en: Before using the appliance, read the manufacturer's instructions carefully.
formal.zh: 使用该电器前，请仔细阅读制造商提供的说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-fabbrikant ta' din il-mejda? Mark: Kumpanija lokali; nista' nagħtik isimha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the manufacturer of this table? Mark: A local company; I can give you its name.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张桌子是哪家制造商生产的？马克：一家本地公司；我可以把公司名称给你。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-fabbrikant ta' din il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-fabbrikant ta' din il-mejda?
messages.zh: 这张桌子是哪家制造商生产的？
messages.en: Who is the manufacturer of this table?

messages.speaker: Mark (家具店店员)
messages.zh: 一家本地公司；我可以把公司名称给你。
messages.en: A local company; I can give you its name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象产品标签上的“制造商”一栏，fabbrikant 回答的是“谁生产了它”，把词与厂家名称联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making goods from materials using tools, machinery, or organized production methods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用工具、机器或有组织的生产方法，将材料制成商品的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-materjali jinbidlu fi prodotti bl-użu ta' għodod, magni jew metodi ta' produzzjoni organizzati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制造；将材料加工成产品的生产过程

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tejbet il-proċess tal-fabbrikazzjoni biex tnaqqas l-iskart tal-materjali.
formal.en: The company improved the manufacturing process to reduce material waste.
formal.zh: 公司改进了制造过程，以减少材料浪费。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-fabbrikazzjoni ta' dawn is-siġġijiet issir hawn? Pawlu: Iva, nagħmluhom fil-ħanut tax-xogħol ta' wara.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does the manufacturing of these chairs take place here? Pawlu: Yes, we make them in the workshop at the back.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些椅子是在这里制造的吗？保罗：是的，我们在后面的工坊里制作。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fabbrikazzjoni ta' dawn is-siġġijiet issir hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Il-fabbrikazzjoni ta' dawn is-siġġijiet issir hawn?
messages.zh: 这些椅子是在这里制造的吗？
messages.en: Does the manufacturing of these chairs take place here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家具工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nagħmluhom fil-ħanut tax-xogħol ta' wara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nagħmluhom fil-ħanut tax-xogħol ta' wara.
messages.zh: 是的，我们在后面的工坊里制作。
messages.en: Yes, we make them in the workshop at the back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中播放木料经过切割、组装成为椅子的连续画面，用 fabbrikazzjoni 标记整个“制造过程”。

gloss_zh: 储蓄；收集；储蓄者；吝啬鬼

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put money aside for later use, or to gather objects into a collection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把钱存起来供以后使用，或把物品收集起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żamm il-flus għal aktar tard, jew ġabar oġġetti f'kollezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储蓄；把钱留存起来供以后使用。
收集物品；把物品逐渐积聚起来。
储蓄者；把钱存起来的人。
吝啬鬼；过分舍不得花钱的人，带贬义。

formal.mt: Matul is-sena, Pawlu faddal biżżejjed flus biex iħallas għal kors ta' taħriġ.
formal.en: During the year, Pawlu saved enough money to pay for a training course.
formal.zh: 这一年里，Pawlu存下了足够支付培训课程费用的钱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħallas Toni għar-rota l-ġdida? Lara: Faddal ftit flus kull ġimgħa sakemm kellu biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Toni pay for the new bicycle? Lara: He saved a little money every week until he had enough.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Toni怎么买得起那辆新自行车的？Lara：他每周存一点钱，直到存够。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Toni怎么买得起那辆新自行车的？
messages.en: How did Toni pay for the new bicycle?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Faddal ftit flus kull ġimgħa sakemm kellu biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Faddal ftit flus kull ġimgħa sakemm kellu biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 他每周存一点钱，直到存够。
messages.en: He saved a little money every week until he had enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用存钱罐和集邮册记两个动词义；作名词时，再区分普通储蓄者与贬义吝啬鬼。

gloss_zh: 有助于节省的；可省钱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Making it possible to save money or reduce spending.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够帮助省钱或减少开支的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jippermetti li wieħed jiffranka l-flus jew inaqqas l-ispejjeż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人能够节省开支、存下钱的。

collocations.zh: 有助于节省开支的计划

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ippropona metodu faddali li jnaqqas l-ispejjeż tat-trasport.
formal.en: The committee proposed a money-saving method that reduces transport costs.
formal.zh: 委员会提出了一种能够降低运输成本的省钱方法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-pjan hu faddali? Mark: Iva, jekk nixtru flimkien, kull wieħed iħallas inqas.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this plan help us save money? Mark: Yes, if we buy together, each person pays less.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个计划能帮我们省钱吗？Mark：能，如果一起买，每个人付的钱就更少。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个计划能帮我们省钱吗？
messages.en: Does this plan help us save money?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk nixtru flimkien, kull wieħed iħallas inqas.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk nixtru flimkien, kull wieħed iħallas inqas.
messages.zh: 能，如果一起买，每个人付的钱就更少。
messages.en: Yes, if we buy together, each person pays less.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它贴在团购计划旁边，记成形容方案能省钱，而不是直接表示存钱的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fougasse, an old-fashioned type of land mine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为富加斯的旧式地雷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip antik ta' mina tal-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 富加斯地雷，一种旧式地雷。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jiddeskrivi l-fagozz bħala tip antik ta' mina tal-art.
formal.en: The museum catalogue describes the fougasse as an old-fashioned type of land mine.
formal.zh: 博物馆目录将富加斯地雷描述为一种旧式地雷。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-mudell fil-vetrina? Toni: Huwa mudell ta' fagozz, tip antik ta' mina tal-art.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that model in the display case? Toni: It is a model of a fougasse, an old-fashioned type of land mine.
colloquial.zh: Lara：展柜里的那个模型是什么？Toni：那是富加斯地雷模型，属于一种旧式地雷。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 展柜里的那个模型是什么？
messages.en: What is that model in the display case?

messages.speaker: Toni (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa mudell ta' fagozz, tip antik ta' mina tal-art.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa mudell ta' fagozz, tip antik ta' mina tal-art.
messages.zh: 那是富加斯地雷模型，属于一种旧式地雷。
messages.en: It is a model of a fougasse, an old-fashioned type of land mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象博物馆展柜里标着fagozz的旧式地雷模型，用展品画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bringing financial gain or providing practical benefit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够带来经济收益的，或能提供实际帮助与益处的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib qligħ finanzjarju jew li jkun ta' għajnuna prattika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有利可图的；能带来可观收益的。
有用的；能提供实际帮助的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proġett bħala negozju fajdi li jista' jġib qligħ tajjeb.
formal.en: The report describes the project as a lucrative business that can bring a good profit.
formal.zh: 报告将该项目描述为一项有利可图、能够带来良好收益的生意。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kien fajdi l-parir ta' Pawlu? Maja: Iva, għenni nsolvi l-problema malajr.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was Pawlu's advice useful? Maja: Yes, it helped me solve the problem quickly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗的建议有用吗？玛雅：有用，它帮我很快解决了问题。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗的建议有用吗？
messages.en: Was Pawlu's advice useful?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 有用，它帮我很快解决了问题。
messages.en: Yes, it helped me solve the problem quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fajdi 放在两个画面里记：生意带来钱是“有利可图”，建议带来帮助是“有用”，共同点都是带来益处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fill a container so much that its contents overflow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把容器装得过满，使其中的东西溢出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mela reċipjent tant li l-kontenut tiegħu beda jfawwar minn barra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to fill a receptacle to overflowing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把容器灌满或装满到溢出的程度。

collocations.en: filled the bucket with water until it overflowed
collocations.zh: 把水桶灌得水都溢了出来

collocations.en: filled the cup with milk until it overflowed
collocations.zh: 往杯子里倒牛奶，倒得溢了出来

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, l-istudent fajjad il-barmil bl-ilma, u l-ilma niżel fuq l-art.
formal.en: During the experiment, the student filled the bucket with water until it overflowed, and the water spilled onto the floor.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，学生把水桶灌得溢了出来，水流到了地板上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm il-ħalib fuq il-mejda? Pawlu: Għax fajjad it-tazza bil-ħalib. Se nimsaħ il-mejda issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is there milk on the table? Pawlu: Because I filled the cup with milk until it overflowed. I'll wipe the table now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：桌上怎么有牛奶？保罗：因为我把杯子里的牛奶倒得溢出来了。我现在就擦桌子。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 桌上怎么有牛奶？
messages.en: Why is there milk on the table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fajjad it-tazza bil-ħalib. Se nimsaħ il-mejda issa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fajjad it-tazza bil-ħalib. Se nimsaħ il-mejda issa.
messages.zh: 因为我把杯子里的牛奶倒得溢出来了。我现在就擦桌子。
messages.en: Because I filled the cup with milk until it overflowed. I'll wipe the table now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住水越过杯口流到桌面的画面：fajjad 强调装得过满而溢出，学习时要把“溢出来”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sling used to throw stones.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于将石块投掷出去的投石索。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex twaddab il-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投石索；用于投掷石块的器具。

collocations.en: throws a stone with a sling

formal.mt: L-illustrazzjoni fil-ktieb turi persuna tuża fajjara biex twaddab ġebla.
formal.en: The illustration in the book shows a person using a sling to throw a stone.
formal.zh: 书中的插图展示了一个人用投石索投掷石块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik fl-istampa? Mark: Dik fajjara. Tintuża biex twaddab il-ġebel.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that in the picture? Mark: That's a sling. It's used to throw stones.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：图片里的那个是什么？马克：那是投石索，用来投掷石块。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里的那个是什么？
messages.en: What's that in the picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik fajjara. Tintuża biex twaddab il-ġebel.
messages.mt_standard: Dik fajjara. Tintuża biex twaddab il-ġebel.
messages.zh: 那是投石索，用来投掷石块。
messages.en: That's a sling. It's used to throw stones.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fajjara 和书中“用投石索把石块投出去”的插图配对记忆，用器具的用途帮助固定词义。

gloss_zh: 起提醒作用的；使人想起某事的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Serving to bring something back to mind or to remind someone of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够使人想起某事，或起到提醒作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib xi ħaġa fil-moħħ jew jgħin lil xi ħadd jiftakar fiha.

sense_translations.en_definition: that acts to bring sth. to mind
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能使人想起某事的；起提醒作用的。

collocations.en: a sign that serves as a reminder
a photograph that brings something to mind

formal.mt: L-għalliem poġġa sinjal fakkari ħdejn il-bieb biex l-istudenti jiftakru jagħlquh.
formal.en: The teacher placed a reminder sign beside the door so that the students would remember to close it.
formal.zh: 老师在门边放了一个起提醒作用的标记，让学生们记得关门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek dak ir-ritratt fuq l-iskrivanija? Nina: Għax huwa fakkari; kull darba li narah niftakar fil-vjaġġ tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you have that photograph on your desk? Nina: Because it brings back memories; whenever I see it, I remember our trip.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把那张照片放在书桌上？妮娜：因为它能唤起回忆；我每次看到它，都会想起我们的旅行。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek dak ir-ritratt fuq l-iskrivanija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek dak ir-ritratt fuq l-iskrivanija?
messages.zh: 你为什么把那张照片放在书桌上？
messages.en: Why do you have that photograph on your desk?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa fakkari; kull darba li narah niftakar fil-vjaġġ tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa fakkari; kull darba li narah niftakar fil-vjaġġ tagħna.
messages.zh: 因为它能唤起回忆；我每次看到它，都会想起我们的旅行。
messages.en: Because it brings back memories; whenever I see it, I remember our trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上一张照片让你立刻想起旅行：fakkari 描述的是“能提醒、能唤起记忆”的性质，记得它是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sells fruit and vegetables, or a porter who carries luggage or other loads.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 售卖水果和蔬菜的人；也指搬运行李或其他货物的搬运工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tbigħ il-frott u l-ħaxix, jew persuna li ġġorr il-bagalji jew tagħbijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蔬果商；售卖水果和蔬菜的人。
搬运工；替人搬运行李或货物的人。

formal.mt: Il-fakkin ġarr il-bagalji tal-vjaġġaturi mill-entratura sal-karozza.
formal.en: The porter carried the travelers' luggage from the entrance to the car.
formal.zh: 搬运工把旅客的行李从入口搬到了汽车旁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn xtrajt dan it-tadam? Pawlu: Mingħand il-fakkin fis-suq; għandu wkoll ħaxix frisk ieħor.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did you buy these tomatoes? Pawlu: From the greengrocer at the market; he also has other fresh vegetables.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些番茄你是在哪里买的？保罗：在市场的蔬果商那里买的；他还有其他新鲜蔬菜。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些番茄你是在哪里买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy these tomatoes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mingħand il-fakkin fis-suq; għandu wkoll ħaxix frisk ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Mingħand il-fakkin fis-suq; għandu wkoll ħaxix frisk ieħor.
messages.zh: 在市场的蔬果商那里买的；他还有其他新鲜蔬菜。
messages.en: From the greengrocer at the market; he also has other fresh vegetables.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fakkin 配两张职业图片：蔬果摊前卖菜的人，以及替旅客搬行李的人；遇到买菜或行李语境时分别选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The remembrance of someone or something, or something that serves as a reminder or memory aid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事的回忆、怀念；也指提醒人记起事情的物品或备忘记录。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tifkira ta' persuna jew ta' xi ħaġa, jew xi ħaġa li sservi biex tgħin lil xi ħadd jiftakar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 回忆；对某人或某事的怀念。
提醒；使人记起某事的事物。
备忘记录；帮助记忆或提示要点的简要笔记。

collocations.en: as a reminder of the trip
a memory aid containing the main points
collocations.zh: 列有主要要点的备忘记录

formal.mt: Qabel il-laqgħa, is-segretarju ħejja fakra bil-punti ewlenin li kellhom jiġu diskussi.
formal.en: Before the meeting, the secretary prepared an aide-memoir containing the main points to be discussed.
formal.zh: 会议前，秘书准备了一份备忘记录，列出将要讨论的主要要点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex żammejt dak il-biljett? Mark: Żammejtu bħala fakra tal-vjaġġ tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you keep that ticket? Mark: I kept it as a reminder of our trip.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么留着那张票？马克：我把它留作我们那次旅行的纪念。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么留着那张票？
messages.en: Why did you keep that ticket?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我把它留作我们那次旅行的纪念。
messages.en: I kept it as a reminder of our trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个记忆画面串联 fakra：心里回想往事、票根提醒旅行、纸条记录要点，分别对应回忆、提醒物和备忘记录。

gloss_zh: 多面手；包办多种事务的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who handles many different kinds of work or practical tasks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够承担多种工作或处理各种实际事务的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel ħafna tipi differenti ta' xogħol u tieħu ħsieb diversi ħidmiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多面手；能处理各种工作和杂务的人。

collocations.zh: 办公室里包办各种事务的人

collocations.en: to work as a general helper handling many different tasks
collocations.zh: 担任处理多种事务的综合帮手

formal.mt: Il-faktotum tal-iskola jieħu ħsieb it-tiswijiet żgħar, iħejji s-swali u jgħin fl-organizzazzjoni tal-attivitajiet.
formal.en: The school's factotum handles minor repairs, prepares the halls and helps organize activities.
formal.zh: 学校的多面手负责小修小补、布置礼堂，并协助组织活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jista' jirranġa l-bieb u jgħinna nċaqalqu l-imwejjed? Toni: Staqsi lil Pawlu. Hu l-faktotum tagħna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can fix the door and help us move the tables? Toni: Ask Pawlu. He's our jack of all trades!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁能修门，再帮我们搬桌子？托尼：问保罗吧。他是我们这里的多面手！

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jirranġa l-bieb u jgħinna nċaqalqu l-imwejjed?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jirranġa l-bieb u jgħinna nċaqalqu l-imwejjed?
messages.zh: 谁能修门，再帮我们搬桌子？
messages.en: Who can fix the door and help us move the tables?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Pawlu. Hu l-faktotum tagħna!
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Pawlu. Hu l-faktotum tagħna!
messages.zh: 问保罗吧。他是我们这里的多面手！
messages.en: Ask Pawlu. He's our jack of all trades!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个人修门、搬桌、布置会场，用这一连串不同任务记住 faktotum 是多面手。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Eurasian hobby, a species of small falcon with the scientific name Falco subbuteo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燕隼，一种小型隼，学名为 Falco subbuteo。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża żgħir, tal-ispeċi Falco subbuteo.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燕隼（学名 Falco subbuteo）。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, il-grupp ra falkett itir fuq l-għelieqi.
formal.en: During the birdwatching session, the group saw a Eurasian hobby flying over the fields.
formal.zh: 观鸟期间，小组看到一只燕隼从田野上空飞过。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak l-għasfur hemm fuq? Mark: Dak falkett. Ħares lejh bit-tromba.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's that bird up there? Mark: That's a Eurasian hobby. Look at it through the binoculars.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：上面那是什么鸟？马克：那是燕隼。用望远镜看看它。

messages.speaker: Sara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 上面那是什么鸟？
messages.en: What's that bird up there?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟伙伴)
messages.zh: 那是燕隼。用望远镜看看它。
messages.en: That's a Eurasian hobby. Look at it through the binoculars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 falkett 写在燕隼图片旁，再想象举起望远镜观察它，建立鸟名与形象的直接联系。

gloss_zh: 会犯错的；判断可能出错的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of making mistakes or reaching an incorrect judgement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可能犯错误或作出错误判断的，并非总是正确的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiżbalja jew jagħmel ġudizzju ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会犯错的；并非绝对正确的。

sense_translations.en_definition: liable to make mistakes or errors of judgement
sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能犯错误或出现判断失误的。

formal.mt: Anki espert huwa fallibbli; għalhekk, il-konklużjonijiet tiegħu għandhom jiġu vverifikati.
formal.en: Even an expert is fallible; therefore, their conclusions should be checked.
formal.zh: 即使专家也可能犯错，因此其结论应当经过核实。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kont ċerta li t-tweġiba tiegħi kienet tajba! Ben: Ilkoll kemm aħna fallibbli. Ejja niċċekkjawha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: I was sure my answer was right! Ben: We're all fallible. Let's check it together.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我本来确信自己的答案是对的！本：我们都会犯错。一起检查一下吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont ċerta li t-tweġiba tiegħi kienet tajba!
messages.mt_standard: Kont ċerta li t-tweġiba tiegħi kienet tajba!
messages.zh: 我本来确信自己的答案是对的！
messages.en: I was sure my answer was right!

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilkoll kemm aħna fallibbli. Ejja niċċekkjawha flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Ilkoll kemm aħna fallibbli. Ejja niċċekkjawha flimkien.
messages.zh: 我们都会犯错。一起检查一下吧。
messages.en: We're all fallible. Let's check it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到老师也会算错一道题，就用 fallibbli 提醒自己：这个词表示可能犯错，并不表示一定出错。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A failure to achieve an intended result; also, bankruptcy when a person or business cannot pay its debts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未能达到预期结果的失败；也指个人或企业无力偿还债务的破产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas li jintlaħaq riżultat mixtieq; ukoll, il-qagħda ta' persuna jew negozju li ma jistax iħallas id-djun tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失败；未能实现预期目标或取得预期结果。
破产；个人或企业无力偿还债务的状态。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddistingwi bejn il-falliment tal-proġett u l-falliment tal-kumpanija minħabba djun li ma setgħetx tħallas.
formal.en: The report distinguishes between the failure of the project and the company's bankruptcy due to debts it could not pay.
formal.zh: 报告区分了项目的失败与公司因无力偿还债务而发生的破产。

colloquial.mt: Nina: L-attività ma marritx tajjeb. Kienet falliment? Ġużi: Ma ksibniex ir-riżultat li ridna, imma nistgħu nitgħallmu minnha.
colloquial.en: Nina: The event didn't go well. Was it a failure? Ġużi: We didn't get the result we wanted, but we can learn from it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这次活动办得不顺利。算是失败了吗？朱齐：我们没有取得想要的结果，但可以从中学习。

messages.speaker: Nina (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: L-attività ma marritx tajjeb. Kienet falliment?
messages.mt_standard: L-attività ma marritx tajjeb. Kienet falliment?
messages.zh: 这次活动办得不顺利。算是失败了吗？
messages.en: The event didn't go well. Was it a failure?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (合作伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma ksibniex ir-riżultat li ridna, imma nistgħu nitgħallmu minnha.
messages.mt_standard: Ma ksibniex ir-riżultat li ridna, imma nistgħu nitgħallmu minnha.
messages.zh: 我们没有取得想要的结果，但可以从中学习。
messages.en: We didn't get the result we wanted, but we can learn from it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 falliment 配两幅画：项目没有成功、企业还不起债；分别记住失败与破产两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person regarded as unsuccessful, or a person who is bankrupt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被认为没有取得成功的人；也指已经破产的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna meqjusa li ma rnexxietx, jew persuna li falliet għax ma setgħetx tħallas id-djun tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失败者；被认为未能取得成功的人。
破产者；无力偿还债务而破产的人。

collocations.en: to be regarded as a failure

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi d-djun tal-fallut u l-assi li baqgħu f'ismu.
formal.en: The report describes the bankrupt person's debts and the assets remaining in his name.
formal.zh: 报告说明了这名破产者的债务及其名下剩余的资产。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Ma għaddejtx mill-eżami. Inħossni fallut. Rita: Eżami wieħed ma jagħmlekx fallut. Tista' terġa' tipprova.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: I didn't pass the exam. I feel like a failure. Rita: One exam doesn't make you a failure. You can try again.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：我考试没通过，感觉自己是个失败者。丽塔：一次考试不能决定你就是失败者。你可以再试。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.zh: 我考试没通过，感觉自己是个失败者。
messages.en: I didn't pass the exam. I feel like a failure.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Eżami wieħed ma jagħmlekx fallut. Tista' terġa' tipprova.
messages.mt_standard: Eżami wieħed ma jagħmlekx fallut. Tista' terġa' tipprova.
messages.zh: 一次考试不能决定你就是失败者。你可以再试。
messages.en: One exam doesn't make you a failure. You can try again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fallut 放在人像旁，记住本条名词指失败者或破产者；再与表示失败或破产这件事的 falliment 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of dishonestly altering information or making something false appear genuine; also, a forged item.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为欺骗而篡改信息或制作假冒真品的行为；也可指伪造出来的物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tinbidel informazzjoni jew issir xi ħaġa falza biex tidher vera; ukoll, ħaġa ffalsifikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 篡改；弄虚作假；为误导他人而改变或捏造信息。
伪造文件、签名等的行为；也指伪造品。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat eżamina l-allegazzjonijiet ta' falsifikazzjoni tad-data u qabbel ir-riżultati mar-rekords oriġinali.
formal.en: The committee examined the allegations of data falsification and compared the results with the original records.
formal.zh: 委员会审查了有关数据造假的指控，并将结果与原始记录进行了比较。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din il-firma ma tidhirx bħal dik oriġinali. Leo: Jista' jkun każ ta' falsifikazzjoni. Ejja niċċekkjaw id-dokument.
colloquial.en: Marta: This signature doesn't look like the original one. Leo: It could be a case of forgery. Let's check the document.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这个签名看起来与原来的不同。利奥：可能涉及伪造。我们核查一下这份文件吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (办公室职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-firma ma tidhirx bħal dik oriġinali.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-firma ma tidhirx bħal dik oriġinali.
messages.zh: 这个签名看起来与原来的不同。
messages.en: This signature doesn't look like the original one.

messages.speaker: Leo (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun każ ta' falsifikazzjoni. Ejja niċċekkjaw id-dokument.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun każ ta' falsifikazzjoni. Ejja niċċekkjaw id-dokument.
messages.zh: 可能涉及伪造。我们核查一下这份文件吧。
messages.en: It could be a case of forgery. Let's check the document.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人改动数据、仿写签名，再用 falsifikazzjoni 给这些造假行为命名，重点记住行为本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes fake documents, signatures or other items, or falsifies information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伪造文件、签名或其他物品，或篡改信息以欺骗他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiffalsifika dokumenti, firem, oġġetti jew informazzjoni biex tqarraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伪造者；制作假文件、假签名等，或篡改信息的人。

formal.mt: L-espert qabbel il-firma oriġinali ma' dik li kien għamel il-falzarju.
formal.en: The expert compared the original signature with the one the forger had made.
formal.zh: 专家将原始签名与伪造者仿写的签名进行了比较。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Min għamel dawn il-biljetti foloz? David: Falzarju. Għamel kopji biex ibigħhom bħallikieku kienu veri.
colloquial.en: Elena: Who made these fake tickets? David: A forger. He made copies to sell as though they were genuine.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这些假票是谁做的？戴维：一个伪造者。他制作了复制品，想当成真票出售。

messages.speaker: Elena (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些假票是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made these fake tickets?

messages.speaker: David (售票员)
messages.mt_spoken: Falzarju. Għamel kopji biex ibigħhom bħallikieku kienu veri.
messages.mt_standard: Falzarju. Għamel kopji biex ibigħhom bħallikieku kienu veri.
messages.zh: 一个伪造者。他制作了复制品，想当成真票出售。
messages.en: A forger. He made copies to sell as though they were genuine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 falzarju 贴在制作假票的人身上，记住它回答的是谁在造假；可与同义的 falzatur 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who creates false documents or objects, or alters information to deceive others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作假文件、假物品，或通过篡改信息来欺骗他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel dokumenti jew oġġetti foloz, jew tbiddel informazzjoni biex tqarraq b'ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伪造者；制作假文件、假物品或篡改信息的人。

formal.mt: L-investigazzjoni sabet li l-falzatur kien biddel l-ismijiet u d-dati fuq diversi ċertifikati.
formal.en: The investigation found that the forger had changed the names and dates on several certificates.
formal.zh: 调查发现，伪造者更改了多份证书上的姓名和日期。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan iċ-ċertifikat jidher veru. Kif indunajtu li kien falz? Ruben: Ikkuntattjajna l-iskola. Il-falzatur kien ikkopja l-logo tagħha.
colloquial.en: Anna: This certificate looks genuine. How did you realize it was fake? Ruben: We contacted the school. The forger had copied its logo.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这张证书看着像真的。你们怎么发现它是假的？鲁本：我们联系了学校。伪造者抄用了学校的标志。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan iċ-ċertifikat jidher veru. Kif indunajtu li kien falz?
messages.mt_standard: Dan iċ-ċertifikat jidher veru. Kif indunajtu li kien falz?
messages.zh: 这张证书看着像真的。你们怎么发现它是假的？
messages.en: This certificate looks genuine. How did you realize it was fake?

messages.speaker: Ruben (审核员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikkuntattjajna l-iskola. Il-falzatur kien ikkopja l-logo tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ikkuntattjajna l-iskola. Il-falzatur kien ikkopja l-logo tagħha.
messages.zh: 我们联系了学校。伪造者抄用了学校的标志。
messages.en: We contacted the school. The forger had copied its logo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见假证书时，想象旁边站着制作它的人，用 falzatur 指这个造假者，并与表示造假行为的 falsifikazzjoni 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something false or altering it to deceive, especially a document or information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作虚假事物或为欺骗而改动内容的行为，尤其指伪造文件或篡改信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jinħoloq xi ħaġa falza jew li jinbidel dokument jew tagħrif biex jingħata bħala veru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伪造；为欺骗而进行的篡改。

formal.mt: Il-falzifikazzjoni tad-data tagħmel ir-riżultati tar-riċerka mhux affidabbli.
formal.en: Falsification of data makes research results unreliable.
formal.zh: 篡改数据会使研究结果不可靠。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din hi kopja jew falzifikazzjoni? Mark: Hija kopja; fuqha hemm miktub ċar li mhijiex l-oriġinal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this a copy or a falsification? Mark: It's a copy; it clearly says on it that it isn't the original.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是副本还是伪造品？马克：是副本，上面清楚写着它不是原件。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这是副本还是伪造品？
messages.en: Is this a copy or a falsification?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija kopja; fuqha hemm miktub ċar li mhijiex l-oriġinal.
messages.mt_standard: Hija kopja; fuqha hemm miktub ċar li mhijiex l-oriġinal.
messages.zh: 是副本，上面清楚写着它不是原件。
messages.en: It's a copy; it clearly says on it that it isn't the original.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人偷偷改动文件上的数字，再把假文件当真文件交出，用这个场景记住“伪造、篡改”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who follows or supports familism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信奉或支持家庭主义的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħaddan jew tappoġġja l-familiżmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家庭主义者；信奉家庭主义的人。

collocations.zh: 一位家庭主义者的观点

formal.mt: Fid-diskussjoni, il-familista spjega għaliex iħaddan il-familiżmu.
formal.en: In the discussion, the familist explained why he follows familism.
formal.zh: 在讨论中，这位家庭主义者解释了自己为何信奉家庭主义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser familista? Pawlu: Persuna li tħaddan il-familiżmu; ejja naqraw kif jispjegah it-test.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does familist mean? Pawlu: A person who follows familism; let's read how the text explains it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：家庭主义者是什么意思？保罗：就是信奉家庭主义的人；我们看看课文是怎么解释的。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 家庭主义者是什么意思？
messages.en: What does familist mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna li tħaddan il-familiżmu; ejja naqraw kif jispjegah it-test.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna li tħaddan il-familiżmu; ejja naqraw kif jispjegah it-test.
messages.zh: 就是信奉家庭主义的人；我们看看课文是怎么解释的。
messages.en: A person who follows familism; let's read how the text explains it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词记在“某种主义的信奉者”这一人物栏中，看到它就联想“信奉家庭主义的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of knowing someone or something well, or the ease that comes from that knowledge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事熟悉的状态，也指由此产生的亲近、自在感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li tkun taf lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa sew, jew il-kunfidenza li tiġi minn dan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 熟悉；熟悉程度；相处时的亲熟感。

collocations.zh: 对这门语言的熟悉程度
对这一主题的熟悉程度

formal.mt: Il-familjarità mas-suġġett tgħin lill-istudent jifhem testi aktar kumplessi.
formal.en: Familiarity with the subject helps the student understand more complex texts.
formal.zh: 熟悉这一主题有助于学生理解更复杂的文本。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek familjarità ma' dan il-programm? David: Iva, nużah kuljum u nista' nurik kif jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you familiar with this program? David: Yes, I use it every day and can show you how it works.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你熟悉这个程序吗？戴维：熟悉，我每天都用，可以教你怎么操作。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你熟悉这个程序吗？
messages.en: Are you familiar with this program?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nużah kuljum u nista' nurik kif jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nużah kuljum u nista' nurik kif jaħdem.
messages.zh: 熟悉，我每天都用，可以教你怎么操作。
messages.en: Yes, I use it every day and can show you how it works.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每天使用同一个程序，按钮的位置都很熟悉；把这种“已经熟悉的状态”与本词联系起来。
