gloss_zh: 熟悉过程；使熟悉；熟悉培训

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming familiar with something or helping someone learn about it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐步熟悉某事物，或帮助他人了解并熟悉某事物的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih wieħed isir jaf xi ħaġa aħjar jew jgħin lil ħaddieħor isir jafha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 熟悉化；使人熟悉某事物的过程或培训。

formal.mt: Qabel l-użu tat-tagħmir, il-parteċipanti jattendu sessjoni ta' familjarizzazzjoni.
formal.en: Before using the equipment, participants attend a familiarization session.
formal.zh: 使用设备之前，参与者先参加一节熟悉培训课。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'se nagħmlu fl-ewwel siegħa? Mark: Se jkollna sessjoni ta' familjarizzazzjoni mat-tagħmir, imbagħad nippruvawh.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are we doing in the first hour? Mark: We'll have a session to get familiar with the equipment, then try it out.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：第一个小时我们做什么？马克：先上一节熟悉设备的课，然后实际试用。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.zh: 第一个小时我们做什么？
messages.en: What are we doing in the first hour?

messages.speaker: Mark (培训师)
messages.mt_spoken: Se jkollna sessjoni ta' familjarizzazzjoni mat-tagħmir, imbagħad nippruvawh.
messages.mt_standard: Se jkollna sessjoni ta' familjarizzazzjoni mat-tagħmir, imbagħad nippruvawh.
messages.zh: 先上一节熟悉设备的课，然后实际试用。
messages.en: We'll have a session to get familiar with the equipment, then try it out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“第一次接触设备，经过介绍再动手试用”的连续画面记忆，重点是从陌生走向熟悉的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a friendly, informal way that suggests knowing someone well.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以熟人之间亲切、随意的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod ta' ħbiberija u bla formalità, bħalma wieħed iġib ruħu ma' nies li jaf sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 熟络地；以亲切而不拘礼节的方式。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jitkellem familjarment mal-ġar tiegħu biex juri kemm jafu sew.
formal.en: In the story, the character speaks familiarly with his neighbour to show how well he knows him.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物与邻居熟络地交谈，表现出两人十分熟悉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tkellimt familjarment miegħu? Pawlu: Għax ilna ħbieb minn meta konna żgħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you speak so familiarly with him? Pawlu: Because we've been friends since we were children.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么跟他说话这么熟络？保罗：因为我们从小就是朋友。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么跟他说话这么熟络？
messages.en: Why did you speak so familiarly with him?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ilna ħbieb minn meta konna żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ilna ħbieb minn meta konna żgħar.
messages.zh: 因为我们从小就是朋友。
messages.en: Because we've been friends since we were children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象遇见老朋友时自然随意的说话语气；本词修饰“怎么说、怎么打招呼”，记作“熟络地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dig out earth or other material to make a hole or clear a space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过挖掘移走泥土等材料，以形成坑洞或清出空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaffer u neħħa l-ħamrija jew materjal ieħor biex jagħmel ħofra jew ibattal spazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挖出；通过挖掘清除泥土等材料。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem fandaq trinka biex jitqiegħed il-pajp tal-ilma.
formal.en: The worker dug out a trench so that the water pipe could be laid.
formal.zh: 工人挖出了一条沟，以便铺设水管。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min fandaq din il-ħofra fil-ġnien? Toni: Il-ġardinar; se jħawwel siġra hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who dug out this hole in the garden? Toni: The gardener; he's going to plant a tree here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：花园里的这个坑是谁挖的？托尼：园丁，他要在这里种一棵树。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.zh: 花园里的这个坑是谁挖的？
messages.en: Who dug out this hole in the garden?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.zh: 园丁，他要在这里种一棵树。
messages.en: The gardener; he's going to plant a tree here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象园丁一铲一铲把泥土挖出来，地上留下种树的坑；用“挖出坑洞”的动作记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who boasts about their abilities, achievements or importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜欢夸耀自己能力、成就或地位的人，常含贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiftaħar ħafna bil-ħila, bil-kisbiet jew bl-importanza tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吹牛者；喜欢自吹自擂、夸耀自己的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-fanfarun jgħid li kapaċi jagħmel kollox, iżda ma jagħti ebda prova.
formal.en: In the story, the boaster says he can do everything but provides no proof.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个吹牛者声称自己无所不能，却拿不出任何证明。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tgħid li hu fanfarun? David: Għax dejjem jgħid li hu l-aħjar f'kollox.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you say he's a boaster? David: Because he always says he's the best at everything.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么说他爱吹牛？戴维：因为他总说自己什么都是最厉害的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他爱吹牛？
messages.en: Why do you say he's a boaster?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem jgħid li hu l-aħjar f'kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem jgħid li hu l-aħjar f'kollox.
messages.zh: 因为他总说自己什么都是最厉害的。
messages.en: Because he always says he's the best at everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人不停拍胸口说“我最厉害”，把画面中的这个人标为 fanfarun，重点记住它指人。

gloss_zh: 吹牛；夸口；自吹自擂的言行

teaching_sense.en_definition: A boast or a show of exaggerated confidence intended to impress others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了给别人留下深刻印象而说的大话，或夸张地展示自信的言行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem jew imġiba ta' tifħir żejjed għalih innifsu biex wieħed jimpressjona lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夸口；吹牛；趾高气扬、自吹自擂的言行。

formal.mt: L-istqarrija li seta' jsolvi kull problema waħdu kienet fanfarunata vojta.
formal.en: The claim that he could solve every problem on his own was an empty boast.
formal.zh: 他声称自己能独力解决所有问题，这不过是空洞的夸口。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qal li jista' jirbaħ kull tellieqa mingħajr taħriġ. Mark: Dik fanfarunata; ħa naraw kif imur fit-tellieqa.
colloquial.en: Nina: He said he can win every race without training. Mark: That's a boast; let's see how he does in the race.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他说不训练也能赢每一场比赛。马克：那是在吹牛，看看他比赛时表现如何吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li jista' jirbaħ kull tellieqa mingħajr taħriġ.
messages.mt_standard: Qal li jista' jirbaħ kull tellieqa mingħajr taħriġ.
messages.zh: 他说不训练也能赢每一场比赛。
messages.en: He said he can win every race without training.

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik fanfarunata; ħa naraw kif imur fit-tellieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Dik fanfarunata; ħa naraw kif imur fit-tellieqa.
messages.zh: 那是在吹牛，看看他比赛时表现如何吧。
messages.en: That's a boast; let's see how he does in the race.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“我不用训练也能全赢”写进一个夸张的对话气泡，用气泡里的大话记住 fanfarunata；它指夸口的言行。

gloss_zh: 黑鱼（Centrolophus niger，特指该物种）；lampuka tat-Torok 的同义名称

teaching_sense.en_definition: A name for the blackfish Centrolophus niger, also called lampuka tat-Torok.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鱼类 Centrolophus niger 的名称，与 lampuka tat-Torok 同义；学习时应结合学名辨认，避免与中文俗称“黑鱼”的其他鱼类混淆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta tal-ispeċi Centrolophus niger, magħrufa wkoll bħala lampuka tat-Torok.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of lampuka tat-Torok: blackfish (Centrolophus niger)
sense_translations.zh_definition: lampuka tat-Torok 的同义名称：黑鱼，特指 Centrolophus niger。

collocations.zh: 一种称为 fanfru barrani 的鱼
一张 Centrolophus niger 的照片

formal.mt: F'dan il-katalgu, l-isem fanfru barrani jirreferi għall-ispeċi Centrolophus niger.
formal.en: In this catalogue, the name fanfru barrani refers to the species Centrolophus niger.
formal.zh: 本目录中的 fanfru barrani 一名指的是 Centrolophus niger 这一物种。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-ħuta fir-ritratt? Mark: Fanfru barrani; fil-ktieb jisimha wkoll lampuka tat-Torok.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this fish in the photograph called? Mark: A blackfish; the book also calls it lampuka tat-Torok.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这条鱼叫什么？马克：叫 fanfru barrani；书上也称它为 lampuka tat-Torok。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这条鱼叫什么？
messages.en: What is this fish in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fanfru barrani; fil-ktieb jisimha wkoll lampuka tat-Torok.
messages.mt_standard: Fanfru barrani; fil-ktieb jisimha wkoll lampuka tat-Torok.
messages.zh: 叫 fanfru barrani；书上也称它为 lampuka tat-Torok。
messages.en: A blackfish; the book also calls it lampuka tat-Torok.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组 fanfru barrani 写在鱼类图卡上，并配上学名 Centrolophus niger；用“一种鱼、两个名称”联记 lampuka tat-Torok。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Filthy material or wet, dirty mud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肮脏的污物或湿黏的污泥，可用于描述地上、鞋上等处令人嫌脏的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħmieġ jew tajn maħmuġ u mxarrab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污秽、脏污；污泥、泥淖。

collocations.en: to remove the filth or mire

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, il-ħaddiema neħħew il-fangazz li kien inġabar fid-daħla tal-bini.
formal.en: After the rain, the workers removed the mire that had collected at the building entrance.
formal.zh: 雨后，工人清除了积在大楼入口处的污泥。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara kemm għandek fangazz maż-żraben! Pawlu: Għaddejt minn qalb it-tajn; innaddafhom qabel nidħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look how much muck you have on your shoes! Pawlu: I walked through the mud; I'll clean them before I come in.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：瞧你鞋上沾了多少污泥！保罗：我刚从泥地里走过；进屋前我会把鞋擦干净。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 瞧你鞋上沾了多少污泥！
messages.en: Look how much muck you have on your shoes!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddejt minn qalb it-tajn; innaddafhom qabel nidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddejt minn qalb it-tajn; innaddafhom qabel nidħol.
messages.zh: 我刚从泥地里走过；进屋前我会把鞋擦干净。
messages.en: I walked through the mud; I'll clean them before I come in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雨后鞋底沾满又湿又脏的泥，进门前必须清掉；把这个“脏兮兮的污泥”画面与 fangazz 绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mud associated with volcanic activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与火山活动有关的泥，教学时应保留“火山泥”这一特定含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tajn marbut ma' attività vulkanika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火山泥。

formal.mt: Il-ġeologu ġabar kampjun ta' fangu għall-analiżi fil-laboratorju.
formal.en: The geologist collected a sample of volcanic mud for laboratory analysis.
formal.zh: 地质学家采集了一份火山泥样本，供实验室分析。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'hemm f'dan il-vażett? Toni: Fangu, jiġifieri tajn vulkaniku; dan huwa kampjun għall-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's in this jar? Toni: Volcanic mud; this is a sample for the lesson.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个小罐子里装的是什么？托尼：Fangu，也就是火山泥；这是上课用的样本。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个小罐子里装的是什么？
messages.en: What's in this jar?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fangu, jiġifieri tajn vulkaniku; dan huwa kampjun għall-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Fangu, jiġifieri tajn vulkaniku; dan huwa kampjun għall-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: Fangu，也就是火山泥；这是上课用的样本。
messages.en: Volcanic mud; this is a sample for the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fangu 配一张“火山旁采泥样本”的图，记成“火山＋泥”；每次回忆都带上火山这个限定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To let oneself dwell on imagined situations or possibilities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让自己沉浸在想象的情境或可能性中，进行幻想。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla lilu nnifsu jintilef fi ħsibijiet dwar sitwazzjonijiet jew possibbiltajiet immaġinati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沉浸于幻想；任由自己想入非非。

formal.mt: Waqt li kien jikteb ir-rumanz, l-awtur fantas dwar dinja fejn kulħadd seta' jtir.
formal.en: While writing the novel, the author indulged in fantasies about a world where everyone could fly.
formal.zh: 写小说时，作者沉浸于一个人人都能飞翔的世界的幻想中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jitbissem Pawlu? Sara: Għax fantas dwar x'jagħmel kieku jirbaħ il-lotterija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu smiling? Sara: Because he was fantasizing about what he would do if he won the lottery.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么在笑？萨拉：因为他刚才在幻想，假如中了彩票会做些什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么在笑？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu smiling?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fantas dwar x'jagħmel kieku jirbaħ il-lotterija.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fantas dwar x'jagħmel kieku jirbaħ il-lotterija.
messages.zh: 因为他刚才在幻想，假如中了彩票会做些什么。
messages.en: Because he was fantasizing about what he would do if he won the lottery.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fantas 联想到英语 fantasy 的拼写来帮助认形，再用“人坐着不动，脑中已环游世界”记住动作义；这只是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ghost or phantom, or an apparition that seems to appear before someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鬼魂、幽灵，或仿佛出现在眼前的幻影。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spirtu jew dehra li tidher quddiem xi ħadd bħallikieku kienet preżenza reali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鬼魂；幽灵；显现的幻影。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, fantażma tidher fil-kuritur tal-kastell kull lejl.
formal.en: In the story, a ghost appears in the castle corridor every night.
formal.zh: 故事中，每晚都有一个幽灵出现在城堡的走廊里。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt fantażma ħdejn it-tieqa! Mark: Dik kienet il-purtiera tiċċaqlaq mar-riħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: I saw a ghost by the window! Mark: That was the curtain moving in the wind.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我看见窗边有个幽灵！马克：那是窗帘被风吹动了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看见窗边有个幽灵！
messages.en: I saw a ghost by the window!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是窗帘被风吹动了。
messages.en: That was the curtain moving in the wind.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗边一团白影被误认成鬼，把 fantażma 贴在那团白影上；先记“一只幽灵”，再扩展到“幻影”。

gloss_zh: 变幻的幻影景象；一连串梦幻般的影像

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shifting succession of strange, dreamlike images or apparitions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由奇异、梦境般的影像或幻影接连变换而构成的景象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' xbihat jew dehriet strambi, bħal dawk tal-ħolm, li jinbidlu waħda wara l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接连变幻的幻影景象；一连串奇异而梦幻的影像。

collocations.en: a phantasmagoria of light and shadow

collocations.zh: 一连串变幻的梦幻影像

formal.mt: L-ispettaklu ppreżenta fantażmagorija ta' dawl, dell u xbihat li nbidlu kontinwament.
formal.en: The performance presented a phantasmagoria of light, shadow and continually changing images.
formal.zh: 演出呈现了由光、影和不断变化的影像构成的梦幻奇景。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kienet il-ħolma tiegħek? Toni: Fantażmagorija sħiħa: toroq li jtiru, bibien jitkellmu u kuluri jinbidlu!
colloquial.en: Lara: What was your dream like? Toni: A complete phantasmagoria: flying streets, talking doors and changing colours!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你做了个什么样的梦？托尼：简直是一连串变幻的奇景：会飞的街道、会说话的门，还有不断变换的颜色！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你做了个什么样的梦？
messages.en: What was your dream like?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fantażmagorija sħiħa: toroq li jtiru, bibien jitkellmu u kuluri jinbidlu!
messages.mt_standard: Fantażmagorija sħiħa: toroq li jtiru, bibien jitkellmu u kuluri jinbidlu!
messages.zh: 简直是一连串变幻的奇景：会飞的街道、会说话的门，还有不断变换的颜色！
messages.en: A complete phantasmagoria: flying streets, talking doors and changing colours!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fantażmagorija 想成梦境放映机：一幅奇景接着一幅奇景，不停切换；用“整串变幻景象”记住这个名词。

gloss_zh: 幻景般的；奇异而变幻的；梦幻迷离的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the strange, shifting, dreamlike quality of a phantasmagoria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有奇异、变幻、梦境般特点的，用来形容仿佛由接连变化的幻影构成的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra stramba u dejjem tinbidel, bħax-xbihat f'ħolma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幻景般的；如梦境影像般奇异而变幻的。

formal.mt: Id-dawl u x-xbihat li kienu jinbidlu taw lill-palk aspett fantażmagoriku.
formal.en: The changing light and images gave the stage a phantasmagoric appearance.
formal.zh: 不断变换的灯光和影像使舞台呈现出梦幻迷离的样貌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok l-ispettaklu? Pawlu: Iva, kien fantażmagoriku; kull mument deher qisu ħolma differenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like the show? Pawlu: Yes, it was phantasmagoric; every moment seemed like a different dream.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢这场演出吗？保罗：喜欢，真是梦幻迷离；每一刻都像进入了不同的梦。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这场演出吗？
messages.en: Did you like the show?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien fantażmagoriku; kull mument deher qisu ħolma differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien fantażmagoriku; kull mument deher qisu ħolma differenti.
messages.zh: 喜欢，真是梦幻迷离；每一刻都像进入了不同的梦。
messages.en: Yes, it was phantasmagoric; every moment seemed like a different dream.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fantażmagoriku 放在“景观、表演”旁边，练习说“这个景观很梦幻迷离”；靠修饰事物的用法记住它是形容词。

gloss_zh: 仔细查看；把某物暂放在某处

teaching_sense.en_definition: To examine something closely; in a separate sense, to place something somewhere temporarily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一义为仔细查看、细察某物；另一义为把某物暂时放在某个地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħares lejn xi ħaġa bir-reqqa; f'tifsira oħra, qiegħed xi ħaġa f'post għal żmien qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仔细查看；细察。

sense_translations.en_definition: to put sth. temporarily in a location
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物暂时放在某个地方；暂放。

collocations.en: put the bag in the corner temporarily

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal faqad il-lista bir-reqqa. Wara, faqad il-basket ħdejn il-bieb għal ftit minuti.
formal.en: The officer examined the list closely. Afterwards, he placed the bag by the door for a few minutes.
formal.zh: 工作人员仔细查看了清单。随后，他把袋子在门边暂放了几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu faqad il-lista bir-reqqa? Mark: Iva, u mbagħad faqad il-basket fil-kantuniera għal ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Pawlu examine the list closely? Mark: Yes, and then he put the bag in the corner for a little while.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗仔细查看清单了吗？马克：看了，然后他把袋子在角落里暂放了一会儿。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗仔细查看清单了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu examine the list closely?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u mbagħad faqad il-basket fil-kantuniera għal ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u mbagħad faqad il-basket fil-kantuniera għal ftit.
messages.zh: 看了，然后他把袋子在角落里暂放了一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, and then he put the bag in the corner for a little while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 faqad 画两格独立图：第一格拿清单逐项细看，第二格把袋子暂放角落；用“细看／暂放”分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A protrusion of the lower jaw beyond its usual position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 下颌向前突出的位置或形态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ 'il quddiem tax-xedaq ta' taħt mill-pożizzjoni tas-soltu tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下颌前突；下颌向前突出的形态。

collocations.en: a slight protrusion of the lower jaw
a noticeable protrusion of the lower jaw

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-profil tal-karattru ssemmi faqam ħafif, bix-xedaq ta' taħt ftit 'il quddiem.
formal.en: The description of the character's profile mentions a slight protrusion of the lower jaw, with the jaw extending a little forward.
formal.zh: 人物侧面轮廓的说明提到轻微的下颌前突，下颌略微向前伸出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għandi nbiddel fil-profil tat-tpinġija? Leo: Naqqas ftit il-faqam; ix-xedaq ta' taħt ħareġ wisq 'il quddiem.
colloquial.en: Maja: What should I change in the profile drawing? Leo: Reduce the jaw protrusion a little; the lower jaw sticks out too far.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这幅侧面像该改哪里？Leo：把下颌前突的程度减小一点，下颌伸得太靠前了。

messages.speaker: Maja (绘画学生)
messages.zh: 这幅侧面像该改哪里？
messages.en: What should I change in the profile drawing?

messages.speaker: Leo (绘画老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqqas ftit il-faqam; ix-xedaq ta' taħt ħareġ wisq 'il quddiem.
messages.mt_standard: Naqqas ftit il-faqam; ix-xedaq ta' taħt ħareġ wisq 'il quddiem.
messages.zh: 把下颌前突的程度减小一点，下颌伸得太靠前了。
messages.en: Reduce the jaw protrusion a little; the lower jaw sticks out too far.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张侧脸，把下颌前伸的部分圈出来，再标上 faqam；用具体形态记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unexpected misfortune that brings trouble, loss, or distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然发生、带来困难、损失或痛苦的不幸事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja ħażina li tiġi bla mistenni u ġġib diffikultà, telf jew niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意外的不幸；突如其来的厄运。
酷的；很棒的。

collocations.en: an unexpected misfortune for the family
collocations.zh: 降临在家庭头上的意外不幸

formal.mt: It-telf mhux mistenni tal-impjieg kien faqgħa għall-familja u ġiegħelha tnaqqas l-ispejjeż.
formal.en: The unexpected loss of employment was a misfortune for the family and forced it to reduce its expenses.
formal.zh: 意外失业给这个家庭带来了不幸，迫使他们削减开支。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-karozza waqfet proprju llum, meta għandi l-intervista. Mark: X'faqgħa! Tinkwetax, nieħdok jien.
colloquial.en: Sara: The car broke down today of all days, when I have my interview. Mark: What bad luck! Don't worry, I'll drive you.
colloquial.zh: Sara：偏偏今天车坏了，我还要去面试呢。Mark：真倒霉！别担心，我开车送你。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-karozza waqfet proprju llum, meta għandi l-intervista.
messages.mt_standard: Il-karozza waqfet proprju llum, meta għandi l-intervista.
messages.zh: 偏偏今天车坏了，我还要去面试呢。
messages.en: The car broke down today of all days, when I have my interview.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 真倒霉！别担心，我开车送你。
messages.en: What bad luck! Don't worry, I'll drive you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 faqgħa 分成两张词义卡：名词配“突遭不幸”的情景，形容词配“很酷”的评价，按词性分别记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a lower jaw that protrudes forward.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 下颌向前突出的，用来描述人或人物的外貌特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x-xedaq ta' taħt ħiereġ 'il quddiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下颌前突的；下颌向前突出的。

collocations.en: a man with a protruding lower jaw
a character with a protruding lower jaw

formal.mt: Fl-illustrazzjoni, ir-raġel huwa faqmi: ix-xedaq ta' taħt jidher ħiereġ 'il quddiem.
formal.en: In the illustration, the man has a protruding lower jaw: his lower jaw can be seen extending forward.
formal.zh: 插图中的男子下颌前突，可以看出他的下颌向前伸出。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex dan il-karattru jidher differenti fil-profil? Pawlu: Għax hu faqmi; ara kemm ix-xedaq ta' taħt joħroġ 'il quddiem.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does this character look different in profile? Pawlu: Because he has a protruding lower jaw; look how far his lower jaw sticks out.
colloquial.zh: Nina：为什么这个人物从侧面看起来不一样？Pawlu：因为他下颌前突，你看他的下颌向前伸出了多少。

messages.speaker: Nina (绘画学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-karattru jidher differenti fil-profil?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-karattru jidher differenti fil-profil?
messages.zh: 为什么这个人物从侧面看起来不一样？
messages.en: Why does this character look different in profile?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (绘画老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu faqmi; ara kemm ix-xedaq ta' taħt joħroġ 'il quddiem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu faqmi; ara kemm ix-xedaq ta' taħt joħroġ 'il quddiem.
messages.zh: 因为他下颌前突，你看他的下颌向前伸出了多少。
messages.en: Because he has a protruding lower jaw; look how far his lower jaw sticks out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看侧脸图完成描述句“这个人是下颌前突的”，把 faqmi 放在描述特征的位置，记住它是形容词。

gloss_zh: 弄破；使爆炸；啪地折断；闪电击中；消息突然传出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something burst or explode; also to snap, for lightning to strike, or for news or a rumour to emerge suddenly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体破裂或爆炸；也可指啪地折断、闪电击中，或消息和传闻突然传出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel xi ħaġa tinfaqa' jew tisplodi; jista' jfisser ukoll jaqsam b'ħoss qasir, jolqot meta jingħad għal sajjetta, jew joħroġ f'daqqa meta jingħad għal aħbar jew għajdut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄破；使某物破裂。
引爆；使某物爆炸。
啪地折断或断开。
击中；劈下，用于闪电。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be revealed suddenly (used of a piece of news or a rumour)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然传出；突然被披露，用于消息或传闻。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, l-għalliem faqqa' bużżieqa b'labra biex l-istudenti jisimgħu l-ħoss.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the teacher burst a balloon with a needle so that the students could hear the sound.
formal.zh: 演示时，老师用针扎破了一个气球，让学生听到破裂的声音。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Ben: Ħija faqqa' bużżieqa bi żball waqt li kien qed iżejjen il-kamra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that noise? Ben: My brother accidentally burst a balloon while he was decorating the room.
colloquial.zh: Lara：刚才是什么声音？Ben：我哥哥布置房间时不小心弄破了一个气球。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija faqqa' bużżieqa bi żball waqt li kien qed iżejjen il-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija faqqa' bużżieqa bi żball waqt li kien qed iżejjen il-kamra.
messages.zh: 我哥哥布置房间时不小心弄破了一个气球。
messages.en: My brother accidentally burst a balloon while he was decorating the room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用气球“啪”地破裂记住 faqqa'，再分别配上爆炸、折断、闪电击中和消息突传的画面；这是情景联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To look over or inspect something closely, paying attention to its details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仔细查看或检查某物，留意其中的细节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeżamina xi ħaġa bir-reqqa u jagħti kas tad-dettalji tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仔细查看；细致检查。

formal.mt: Qabel iffirma r-rapport, l-ispettur faqqad il-magna u nnota l-partijiet li kellhom bżonn tiswija.
formal.en: Before signing the report, the inspector examined the machine closely and noted the parts that needed repair.
formal.zh: 检查员在签署报告前仔细检查了机器，并记下需要维修的部件。

colloquial.mt: Anna: It-tekniku sab għaliex il-magna tieqaf? David: Iva, faqqad il-magna u sab wajer maħlul.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did the technician find out why the machine stops? David: Yes, he inspected the machine closely and found a loose wire.
colloquial.zh: Anna：技术员查出机器为什么会停了吗？David：查出了，他仔细检查了机器，发现一根电线松了。

messages.speaker: Anna (店主)
messages.zh: 技术员查出机器为什么会停了吗？
messages.en: Did the technician find out why the machine stops?

messages.speaker: David (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, faqqad il-magna u sab wajer maħlul.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, faqqad il-magna u sab wajer maħlul.
messages.zh: 查出了，他仔细检查了机器，发现一根电线松了。
messages.en: Yes, he inspected the machine closely and found a loose wire.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着放大镜逐处查看机器的动作，把 faqqad 和“仔细检查每个细节”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause the lower jaw to project forward.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使下颌向前突出，可用于描述摆出的表情或人物形态的调整。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel ix-xedaq ta' taħt joħroġ 'il quddiem.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause the lower jaw to protrude
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使下颌前突；使下颌向前伸出。

collocations.en: made the character's lower jaw protrude

formal.mt: L-attur faqqam ix-xedaq ta' taħt biex jagħti lill-karattru espressjoni ta' rabja.
formal.en: The actor pushed his lower jaw forward to give the character an angry expression.
formal.zh: 演员把下颌向前伸出，使人物呈现愤怒的表情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-attur faqqam ix-xedaq hekk? Leo: Ried jidher irrabjat f'dik ix-xena.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the actor push his lower jaw forward like that? Leo: He wanted to look angry in that scene.
colloquial.zh: Maja：演员为什么那样把下颌向前伸？Leo：他想在那个场景里显得很生气。

messages.speaker: Maja (戏剧学生)
messages.zh: 演员为什么那样把下颌向前伸？
messages.en: Why did the actor push his lower jaw forward like that?

messages.speaker: Leo (戏剧老师)
messages.zh: 他想在那个场景里显得很生气。
messages.en: He wanted to look angry in that scene.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用演员把下颌往前伸的动作记 faqqam，重点记“使它突出”这个动作，而不是静态的外貌描述。

gloss_zh: 使贫困；使内容贫乏；使人贫困者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone poorer, or to reduce the quality or substance of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人变得贫困，或使某物的质量下降、实质内容变得贫乏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd ifqar, jew inaqqas il-kwalità jew il-kontenut sostanzjali ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使贫困；使穷困。

sense_translations.en_definition: to reduce the quality or substance of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 降低某物的质量；削弱其实质内容，使之贫乏。
使他人贫困的人。

formal.mt: It-tnaqqis fl-eżempji u fl-ispjegazzjonijiet faqqar il-kontenut tal-ktieb u naqqas il-valur edukattiv tiegħu.
formal.en: The reduction in examples and explanations impoverished the book's content and reduced its educational value.
formal.zh: 例子和解释的删减使这本书的内容变得贫乏，降低了它的教育价值。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex din il-verżjoni tal-artiklu tidher daqshekk vojta? Mark: L-editur neħħa l-eżempji kollha u faqqar il-kontenut.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does this version of the article seem so empty? Mark: The editor removed all the examples and impoverished the content.
colloquial.zh: Sara：为什么这个版本的文章显得这么空洞？Mark：编辑删掉了所有例子，让内容变得贫乏了。

messages.speaker: Sara (作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din il-verżjoni tal-artiklu tidher daqshekk vojta?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din il-verżjoni tal-artiklu tidher daqshekk vojta?
messages.zh: 为什么这个版本的文章显得这么空洞？
messages.en: Why does this version of the article seem so empty?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-editur neħħa l-eżempji kollha u faqqar il-kontenut.
messages.mt_standard: L-editur neħħa l-eżempji kollha u faqqar il-kontenut.
messages.zh: 编辑删掉了所有例子，让内容变得贫乏了。
messages.en: The editor removed all the examples and impoverished the content.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排画一个钱逐渐减少的钱包和一本例子被删空的书，分别记经济贫困与内容贫乏；名词义另记为造成贫困的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to make people poorer or to cause impoverishment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使人变得更贫困或陷入贫困倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jagħmel lin-nies ifqar jew iwassal għall-faqar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有使人贫困倾向的；容易导致贫困的。

collocations.en: an economic model that tends to impoverish people
collocations.zh: 有使人贫困倾向的经济模式

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi s-sistema bħala mudell ekonomiku faqqari, għax għandha t-tendenza tnaqqas id-dħul tal-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The report describes the system as an economic model that tends to impoverish people because it tends to reduce workers' incomes.
formal.zh: 报告将这一制度描述为有使人贫困倾向的经济模式，因为它倾向于压低劳动者的收入。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed tgħid li dan il-mudell hu faqqari? Pawlu: Għax għandu t-tendenza jħalli lill-ħaddiema b'inqas flus għall-bżonnijiet tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you saying that this model tends to impoverish people? Pawlu: Because it tends to leave workers with less money for their needs.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么说这种模式有使人贫困的倾向？Pawlu：因为它往往让劳动者能用来满足生活需要的钱变少。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħid li dan il-mudell hu faqqari?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħid li dan il-mudell hu faqqari?
messages.zh: 你为什么说这种模式有使人贫困的倾向？
messages.en: Why are you saying that this model tends to impoverish people?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu t-tendenza jħalli lill-ħaddiema b'inqas flus għall-bżonnijiet tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu t-tendenza jħalli lill-ħaddiema b'inqas flus għall-bżonnijiet tagħhom.
messages.zh: 因为它往往让劳动者能用来满足生活需要的钱变少。
messages.en: Because it tends to leave workers with less money for their needs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给一种经济模式贴上“容易使人变穷”的标签来记 faqqari；注意它描述造成贫困的倾向，而不是已经贫穷的状态。

gloss_zh: 促使孵化的；有助于孵化的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing eggs to hatch or providing conditions that bring about hatching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 促使卵孵化，或提供能够引发孵化的条件的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jikkawża t-tfaqqis tal-bajd jew jipprovdi l-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 促使卵孵化的。

formal.mt: L-apparat faqqasi jżomm it-temperatura u l-umdità fil-livelli meħtieġa għat-tfaqqis tal-bajd.
formal.en: The hatching equipment keeps temperature and humidity at the levels required for the eggs to hatch.
formal.zh: 孵化设备将温度和湿度维持在卵孵化所需的水平。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-apparat faqqasi għal xiex jintuża? Pawlu: Biex iżomm il-bajd fil-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa sakemm ifaqqas.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this hatching equipment used for? Pawlu: To keep the eggs in the conditions they need until they hatch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个孵化设备是做什么用的？保罗：用来让卵一直处于所需的环境中，直到孵化。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-apparat faqqasi għal xiex jintuża?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-apparat faqqasi għal xiex jintuża?
messages.zh: 这个孵化设备是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this hatching equipment used for?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex iżomm il-bajd fil-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa sakemm ifaqqas.
messages.mt_standard: Biex iżomm il-bajd fil-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa sakemm ifaqqas.
messages.zh: 用来让卵一直处于所需的环境中，直到孵化。
messages.en: To keep the eggs in the conditions they need until they hatch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词和恒温孵化箱联系起来：看到 faqqasi，就想“促使蛋孵化的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small watermelon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个头较小的西瓜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dulliegħa żgħira fid-daqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小西瓜；个头较小的西瓜。

formal.mt: Il-faqqus tqiegħed fuq il-mejda u nqata' f'biċċiet żgħar biex jitqassam lill-mistednin.
formal.en: The small watermelon was placed on the table and cut into small pieces to share among the guests.
formal.zh: 小西瓜被放在桌上，切成小块，分给来宾。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-faqqus misjur? Rita: Iva, tista' taqtgħu u tieklu llum.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this small watermelon ripe? Rita: Yes, you can cut it and eat it today.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个小西瓜熟了吗？丽塔：熟了，你今天就可以切开吃。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个小西瓜熟了吗？
messages.en: Is this small watermelon ripe?

messages.speaker: Rita (水果摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' taqtgħu u tieklu llum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' taqtgħu u tieklu llum.
messages.zh: 熟了，你今天就可以切开吃。
messages.en: Yes, you can cut it and eat it today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水果摊上一个双手就能捧住的小西瓜，用这个具体画面记住 faqqus。

gloss_zh: 未长到正常大小的甜瓜

teaching_sense.en_definition: Melons that have not reached their normal size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未达到正常大小的甜瓜，重点在果实的个头不足。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bettieħ li għadu ma laħaqx id-daqs normali tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: melons that haven't reached the normal size
sense_translations.zh_definition: 尚未长到正常大小的甜瓜。

collocations.zh: 一批未长到正常大小的甜瓜
田里未长到正常大小的甜瓜

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-faqqus il-bettieħ bħala frott li għadu ma laħaqx id-daqs normali tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the undersized melons as fruit that has not yet reached its normal size.
formal.zh: 报告将这些甜瓜描述为尚未达到正常大小的果实。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan issejjaħlu faqqus il-bettieħ? Ġużeppi: Għax il-bettieħ għadu ma laħaqx id-daqs normali tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you call this faqqus il-bettieħ? Ġużeppi: Because the melons have not yet reached their normal size.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么把这些叫作 faqqus il-bettieħ？朱塞佩：因为这些甜瓜还没长到正常大小。

messages.speaker: Sara (农业学生)
messages.zh: 你为什么把这些叫作 faqqus il-bettieħ？
messages.en: Why do you call this faqqus il-bettieħ?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-bettieħ għadu ma laħaqx id-daqs normali tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-bettieħ għadu ma laħaqx id-daqs normali tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为这些甜瓜还没长到正常大小。
messages.en: Because the melons have not yet reached their normal size.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把甜瓜放到正常大小的轮廓旁比较：还填不满轮廓，就联想到这个词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The squirting cucumber, Ecballium elaterium, a plant whose ripe fruit ejects seeds with liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喷瓜，学名 Ecballium elaterium，是成熟果实能将种子连同液体喷出的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta Ecballium elaterium, li l-frott misjur tagħha jwaddab iż-żrieragħ flimkien ma' likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喷瓜（Ecballium elaterium），成熟果实会喷出种子的植物。

collocations.en: the fruit of the squirting cucumber
the seeds of the squirting cucumber

formal.mt: Il-faqqus il-ħmir, magħruf xjentifikament bħala Ecballium elaterium, ixerred iż-żrieragħ billi jwaddabhom 'il barra mill-frott misjur.
formal.en: The squirting cucumber, known scientifically as Ecballium elaterium, disperses its seeds by ejecting them from its ripe fruit.
formal.zh: 喷瓜的学名是 Ecballium elaterium，它通过将种子从成熟果实中喷出的方式传播种子。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dik il-pjanta hija faqqus il-ħmir? David: Iva, ara r-ritratt: il-frott tagħha jitfa' ż-żrieragħ 'il barra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is that plant a squirting cucumber? David: Yes, look at the photograph: its fruit ejects the seeds.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那株植物是喷瓜吗？戴维：是的，看这张照片：它的果实会把种子喷出来。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 那株植物是喷瓜吗？
messages.en: Is that plant a squirting cucumber?

messages.speaker: David (自然教育教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara r-ritratt: il-frott tagħha jitfa' ż-żrieragħ 'il barra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara r-ritratt: il-frott tagħha jitfa' ż-żrieragħ 'il barra.
messages.zh: 是的，看这张照片：它的果实会把种子喷出来。
messages.en: Yes, look at the photograph: its fruit ejects the seeds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组当作植物名称记忆，配上果实像小喷泉一样喷出种子的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small watermelon; in another sense, a cucumber plant whose fruit bursts open and ejects its seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指小西瓜；另一个义项指果实会裂开并喷出种子的喷瓜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dulliegħa żgħira; f'tifsira oħra, pjanta li l-frott tagħha jinfetaħ u jwaddab iż-żrieragħ 'il barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个小西瓜。
喷瓜；果实成熟时会裂开并喷出种子的植物。

collocations.en: the seeds of the squirting cucumber

formal.mt: Il-kelma faqqusa għandha żewġ tifsiriet: dulliegħa żgħira u pjanta li l-frott tagħha jwaddab iż-żrieragħ 'il barra.
formal.en: The word faqqusa has two meanings: a small watermelon and a plant whose fruit ejects its seeds.
formal.zh: faqqusa 有两个义项：小西瓜，以及果实会喷出种子的喷瓜植物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta tgħid faqqusa, qed tfisser dulliegħa żgħira? Toni: Hawnhekk le; qed nitkellem fuq il-pjanta li l-frott tagħha jwaddab iż-żrieragħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: When you say faqqusa, do you mean a small watermelon? Toni: Not here; I am talking about the plant whose fruit ejects its seeds.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你说 faqqusa，是指小西瓜吗？托尼：这里不是；我说的是果实会喷出种子的那种植物。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid faqqusa, qed tfisser dulliegħa żgħira?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid faqqusa, qed tfisser dulliegħa żgħira?
messages.zh: 你说 faqqusa，是指小西瓜吗？
messages.en: When you say faqqusa, do you mean a small watermelon?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk le; qed nitkellem fuq il-pjanta li l-frott tagħha jwaddab iż-żrieragħ.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk le; qed nitkellem fuq il-pjanta li l-frott tagħha jwaddab iż-żrieragħ.
messages.zh: 这里不是；我说的是果实会喷出种子的那种植物。
messages.en: Not here; I am talking about the plant whose fruit ejects its seeds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 faqqusa 画两张记忆卡：一张是小西瓜，一张是喷出种子的瓜，靠上下文选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of being poor and lacking sufficient money or material resources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于贫穷之中，缺少足够金钱或物质资源的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' min hu fqir u m'għandux biżżejjed flus jew riżorsi materjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贫穷的状态；贫困。

formal.mt: Il-programm joffri taħriġ u għajnuna lil min jgħix fil-faqra sabiex ikun jista' jtejjeb il-qagħda tiegħu.
formal.en: The programme offers training and assistance to people living in poverty so that they can improve their circumstances.
formal.zh: 该项目为生活在贫困中的人提供培训与援助，帮助他们改善处境。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta tgħid li familja tgħix fil-faqra, xi tfisser? Samwel: Li m'għandhiex biżżejjed flus għall-ħtiġijiet ta' kuljum.
colloquial.en: Marija: When you say a family lives in poverty, what do you mean? Samwel: That it does not have enough money for everyday needs.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你说一个家庭生活在贫困中，是什么意思？萨姆韦尔：就是这个家庭没有足够的钱满足日常需要。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid li familja tgħix fil-faqra, xi tfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid li familja tgħix fil-faqra, xi tfisser?
messages.zh: 你说一个家庭生活在贫困中，是什么意思？
messages.en: When you say a family lives in poverty, what do you mean?

messages.speaker: Samwel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Li m'għandhiex biżżejjed flus għall-ħtiġijiet ta' kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Li m'għandhiex biżżejjed flus għall-ħtiġijiet ta' kuljum.
messages.zh: 就是这个家庭没有足够的钱满足日常需要。
messages.en: That it does not have enough money for everyday needs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 faqra 和“日常所需的钱不够”这个生活情境相连，记住这里表示贫困这种状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instance of hatching, when a young animal emerges from its egg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 幼小动物从卵中破壳而出的一次孵化过程或事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' ferħ minn bajda meta din tfaqqas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次孵化；幼体从卵中破壳而出的事件。

formal.mt: L-ewwel faqsa ġiet irreġistrata filgħodu, meta ferħ ħareġ mill-bajda taħt l-osservazzjoni tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The first hatching was recorded in the morning, when a chick emerged from its egg under the students' observation.
formal.zh: 首次孵化记录于上午，当时一只雏鸟在学生们的观察下破壳而出。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Rajt l-ewwel faqsa dalgħodu? Luqa: Iva, kont hemm meta l-ferħ ħareġ mill-bajda.
colloquial.en: Emma: Did you see the first hatching this morning? Luqa: Yes, I was there when the chick came out of the egg.
colloquial.zh: 埃玛：你看到今天早上的首次孵化了吗？卢卡：看到了，雏鸟从蛋里出来时我就在旁边。

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.zh: 你看到今天早上的首次孵化了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the first hatching this morning?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kont hemm meta l-ferħ ħareġ mill-bajda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kont hemm meta l-ferħ ħareġ mill-bajda.
messages.zh: 看到了，雏鸟从蛋里出来时我就在旁边。
messages.en: Yes, I was there when the chick came out of the egg.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象观察日志上记录“小鸟破壳的那一刻”，把 faqsa 记成一次具体的孵化事件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Abundant in quantity, or productive in yielding plentiful results.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量丰富的；或能够产出丰富成果、产量较高的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu kotran fil-kwantità, jew li jagħti ħafna frott jew riżultati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丰富的；数量充足的。
多产的；能产生丰富成果的。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ddeskriva l-istaġun bħala faqsi, billi l-għelieqi taw ħsad akbar minn dak tas-sena ta' qabel.
formal.en: The farmer described the season as productive because the fields yielded a larger harvest than in the previous year.
formal.zh: 农民将这一季描述为高产的一季，因为田里的收成超过了上一年。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif kien il-ħsad din is-sena? Pietru: Kien faqsi; ġbarna ħafna aktar mis-soltu.
colloquial.en: Anna: How was the harvest this year? Pietru: It was abundant; we gathered much more than usual.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今年收成怎么样？彼得：很丰盛；我们收获的比平时多得多。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 今年收成怎么样？
messages.en: How was the harvest this year?

messages.speaker: Pietru (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien faqsi; ġbarna ħafna aktar mis-soltu.
messages.mt_standard: Kien faqsi; ġbarna ħafna aktar mis-soltu.
messages.zh: 很丰盛；我们收获的比平时多得多。
messages.en: It was abundant; we gathered much more than usual.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收获篮子装得满满的：形容收成时是“丰盛”，形容产出能力时是“多产”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To smash or break something; also, to make someone exhausted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西砸碎或弄断；也可表示使某人筋疲力尽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kisser xi ħaġa, jew għajja ħafna lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 砸碎；打得粉碎。
弄断；弄破；使破碎。
使某人精疲力竭。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem farak il-ġebla bil-martell.
formal.en: The worker smashed the stone with a hammer.
formal.zh: 工人用锤子砸碎了石头。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan ix-xogħol farakni llum. Lara: Strieħ ftit u ixrob ftit ilma.
colloquial.en: Mark: This work exhausted me today. Lara: Rest a little and drink some water.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天这活儿把我累坏了。拉拉：休息一下，喝点水。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天这活儿把我累坏了。
messages.en: This work exhausted me today.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Strieħ ftit u ixrob ftit ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Strieħ ftit u ixrob ftit ilma.
messages.zh: 休息一下，喝点水。
messages.en: Rest a little and drink some water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“砸碎东西”和“累得像散了架”连起来记：farak既能说物体破碎，也能说人累坏了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A guinea fowl, a type of bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 珍珠鸡，一种鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' għasfur li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ guinea fowl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珍珠鸡。

formal.mt: L-istudenta osservat farawna u kitbet deskrizzjoni qasira tagħha.
formal.en: The student observed a guinea fowl and wrote a short description of it.
formal.zh: 女学生观察了一只珍珠鸡，并写下了简短的描述。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'għasfur hu dak fil-bitħa? Pawlu: Dik farawna; se nagħtiha ftit ilma.
colloquial.en: Marta: What bird is that in the yard? Pawlu: That's a guinea fowl; I'm going to give it some water.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：院子里那是什么鸟？保罗：那是一只珍珠鸡；我去给它一点水。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 院子里那是什么鸟？
messages.en: What bird is that in the yard?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik farawna; se nagħtiha ftit ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Dik farawna; se nagħtiha ftit ilma.
messages.zh: 那是一只珍珠鸡；我去给它一点水。
messages.en: That's a guinea fowl; I'm going to give it some water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己指着院子里的一只珍珠鸡说“Dik farawna”，用指认动物的画面记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cloth placed beneath a saddle on an animal's back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 垫在动物背部与鞍之间的布，即鞍垫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp li jitqiegħed fuq dahar annimal taħt is-sarġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鞍垫；铺在鞍下面的垫布。

formal.mt: Ir-rikkieb poġġa farda nadifa fuq dahar iż-żiemel qabel waħħal is-sarġ.
formal.en: The rider placed a clean saddle-cloth on the horse's back before securing the saddle.
formal.zh: 骑手先在马背上铺了一块干净的鞍垫，然后固定好马鞍。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hi l-farda? Toni: Hawn hi; poġġiha taħt is-sarġ.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the saddle-cloth? Toni: Here it is; put it beneath the saddle.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：鞍垫在哪里？托尼：在这里；把它放在马鞍下面。

messages.speaker: Anna (骑手)
messages.zh: 鞍垫在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the saddle-cloth?

messages.speaker: Toni (骑术教练)
messages.zh: 在这里；把它放在马鞍下面。
messages.en: Here it is; put it beneath the saddle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“马背—farda垫布—马鞍”的上下顺序想象，记住farda是夹在马背与鞍之间的垫布。

gloss_zh: 一年只收获一次的田地

teaching_sense.en_definition: A field that yields only one harvest each year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 每年只产出一季收成的田地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għalqa li tagħti ħsad wieħed biss fis-sena.

sense_translations.en_definition: field which yields a single annual harvest
sense_translations.zh_definition: 每年只有一次收成的田地。

collocations.en: a small field yielding one harvest a year
the harvest of a field yielding once a year

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi din il-fardgħalla bħala għalqa li tagħti ħsad wieħed biss fis-sena.
formal.en: The report describes this field as yielding only one harvest a year.
formal.zh: 报告将这块田描述为每年只收获一次的田地。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Din għaliex tissejjaħ fardgħalla? Ġużeppi: Għax tagħti ħsad wieħed biss fis-sena.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is this called a fardgħalla? Ġużeppi: Because it yields only one harvest a year.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：为什么这块田叫fardgħalla？朱塞佩：因为它每年只有一次收成。

messages.speaker: Marija (农业学生)
messages.zh: 为什么这块田叫fardgħalla？
messages.en: Why is this called a fardgħalla?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tagħti ħsad wieħed biss fis-sena.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tagħti ħsad wieħed biss fis-sena.
messages.zh: 因为它每年只有一次收成。
messages.en: Because it yields only one harvest a year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一块田，再在全年日历上只标一次收获；把整幅“一田一年一收”的画面对应到fardgħalla。

gloss_zh: 同父异母或同母异父的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used almost exclusively in aħwa fardsieq for siblings who share only one parent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 几乎只用于aħwa fardsieq，表示兄弟姐妹之间只有一位共同的亲生父母，即同父异母或同母异父。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Użat kważi biss fl-espressjoni aħwa fardsieq għal aħwa li għandhom ġenitur wieħed biss komuni.

sense_translations.en_definition: used almost exclusively in the phrase aħwa fardsieq to mean half siblings.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 几乎只用于短语aħwa fardsieq，表示同父异母或同母异父的兄弟姐妹。

collocations.en: half siblings who share a father
half siblings who share a mother

formal.mt: Lara u Toni huma aħwa fardsieq: għandhom l-istess missier, iżda ommijiet differenti.
formal.en: Lara and Toni are half siblings: they have the same father but different mothers.
formal.zh: 拉拉和托尼是同父异母的兄妹：他们的父亲相同，母亲不同。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int u Lara għandkom l-istess ġenituri? Toni: Aħna aħwa fardsieq: għandna l-istess omm, iżda missirijiet differenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you and Lara have the same parents? Toni: We're half siblings: we have the same mother but different fathers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你和拉拉的父母都一样吗？托尼：我们是同母异父的兄妹：母亲相同，父亲不同。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int u Lara għandkom l-istess ġenituri?
messages.mt_standard: Int u Lara għandkom l-istess ġenituri?
messages.zh: 你和拉拉的父母都一样吗？
messages.en: Do you and Lara have the same parents?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħna aħwa fardsieq: għandna l-istess omm, iżda missirijiet differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Aħna aħwa fardsieq: għandna l-istess omm, iżda missirijiet differenti.
messages.zh: 我们是同母异父的兄妹：母亲相同，父亲不同。
messages.en: We're half siblings: we have the same mother but different fathers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把aħwa fardsieq整组记忆：画两名孩子，连向同一位父亲或母亲，另一位家长各自不同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the pharynx; in phonetics, describing a sound articulated in the pharyngeal region.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与咽部有关的；在语音学中，形容在咽部发出的语音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mal-farinġi; fil-fonetika, jiddeskrivi ħoss li jiġi artikolat fil-farinġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咽的；咽部的；语音学中指咽部发音的。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-fonetika, l-għalliem spjega kif jiġi prodott ħoss farinġali.
formal.en: In the phonetics lesson, the teacher explained how a pharyngeal sound is produced.
formal.zh: 在语音学课上，老师解释了咽音是如何发出的。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser ħoss farinġali? Mark: Ħoss li jiġi artikolat fil-farinġi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does a pharyngeal sound mean? Mark: A sound articulated in the pharynx.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：“咽音”是什么意思？马克：就是在咽部发出的语音。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: “咽音”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a pharyngeal sound mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (语音教师)
messages.zh: 就是在咽部发出的语音。
messages.en: A sound articulated in the pharynx.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在发音部位图上圈出咽部，再给它贴上farinġali；把这个形容词与“咽部”位置一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A member of the Jewish religious group known as the Pharisees.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 犹太宗教群体法利赛派的成员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Membru tal-grupp reliġjuż Lhudi magħruf bħala l-Fariżej.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法利赛人；法利赛派的成员。

collocations.en: a Pharisee mentioned in the text
collocations.zh: 文中提到的一名法利赛人

formal.mt: L-istudent identifika l-Fariżew imsemmi fit-test u kiteb deskrizzjoni qasira tiegħu.
formal.en: The student identified the Pharisee mentioned in the text and wrote a short description of him.
formal.zh: 学生找出了文中提到的法利赛人，并为他写了一段简短的介绍。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dan il-Fariżew fit-test? David: Hu membru tal-grupp reliġjuż Lhudi magħruf bħala l-Fariżej.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is this Pharisee in the text? David: He is a member of the Jewish religious group known as the Pharisees.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：文中这位法利赛人是什么身份？戴维：他是犹太宗教群体法利赛派的成员。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 文中这位法利赛人是什么身份？
messages.en: Who is this Pharisee in the text?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu membru tal-grupp reliġjuż Lhudi magħruf bħala l-Fariżej.
messages.mt_standard: Hu membru tal-grupp reliġjuż Lhudi magħruf bħala l-Fariżej.
messages.zh: 他是犹太宗教群体法利赛派的成员。
messages.en: He is a member of the Jewish religious group known as the Pharisees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作人物身份卡，把Fariżew、Pharisee和“法利赛人”并排写，作为同一宗教群体成员的三语名称记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the ability to separate the two members of a pair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有把一对中的两个成员分开的能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jifred iż-żewġ membri ta' par.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to break up a pair
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有拆开一对、使成对双方分离的能力的。

collocations.en: a factor capable of breaking up a pair
an effect capable of separating a pair
collocations.zh: 能够使一对分离的作用

formal.mt: L-aġġettiv farradi jiddeskrivi dak li għandu l-ħila jifred iż-żewġ membri ta' par.
formal.en: The adjective farradi describes something that has the ability to separate the two members of a pair.
formal.zh: 形容词farradi描述具有将一对中的两个成员分开的能力的事物。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Xi jfisser fattur farradi? Pawlu: Fattur li jista' jifred iż-żewġ membri ta' par.
colloquial.en: Elena: What does fattur farradi mean? Pawlu: A factor that can separate the two members of a pair.
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：fattur farradi是什么意思？保罗：就是能把一对中的两个成员分开的因素。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.zh: fattur farradi是什么意思？
messages.en: What does fattur farradi mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fattur li jista' jifred iż-żewġ membri ta' par.
messages.mt_standard: Fattur li jista' jifred iż-żewġ membri ta' par.
messages.zh: 就是能把一对中的两个成员分开的因素。
messages.en: A factor that can separate the two members of a pair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个配成一对的物件被分开，用这幅画面记住farradi强调的是“能够拆开一对”的能力。

gloss_zh: 动不动就打坏或砸坏东西的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to break or smash things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人有打坏、摔坏或砸坏东西的倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jkisser jew ifarrak l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to break or smash
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有打坏或砸碎东西的倾向的。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to break things
a man who tends to smash things
collocations.zh: 动不动就砸东西的男人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel farraki jkisser diversi ġugarelli qabel jitgħallem jieħu ħsiebhom.
formal.en: In the story, the boy who tends to break things breaks several toys before learning to take care of them.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个经常弄坏东西的男孩打坏了好几个玩具，后来才学会爱护它们。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex ħbejt il-vażun meta ġie Pawlu? Maja: Għax hu farraki; diġà kisser żewġ tazzi hawn.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why did you put the vase away when Pawlu came? Maja: Because he tends to break things; he's already broken two cups here.
colloquial.zh: Lina：Pawlu 来的时候，你为什么把花瓶收起来了？Maja：因为他老是弄坏东西，已经在这里打破两个杯子了。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħbejt il-vażun meta ġie Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħbejt il-vażun meta ġie Pawlu?
messages.zh: Pawlu 来的时候，你为什么把花瓶收起来了？
messages.en: Why did you put the vase away when Pawlu came?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu farraki; diġà kisser żewġ tazzi hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu farraki; diġà kisser żewġ tazzi hawn.
messages.zh: 因为他老是弄坏东西，已经在这里打破两个杯子了。
messages.en: Because he tends to break things; he's already broken two cups here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 farraki 时想象一个总把玩具弄坏的人；重点记住“有破坏东西的倾向”，并用人物搭配反复练习。

gloss_zh: 抚慰人心的；给予慰藉和帮助的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving comfort, reassurance, or support to someone who is distressed or in need.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够安抚情绪、给予慰藉，或为处于困境中的人提供支持的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti faraġ, serħan jew għajnuna lil min ikun imnikket jew fil-bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有安抚作用的；令人感到平静和宽慰的。
给予援助和慰藉的；帮助处于困境中的人的。

formal.mt: L-għalliem tkellem b'ton farraġi biex jgħin lill-istudent jegħleb il-biża' tiegħu.
formal.en: The teacher spoke in a soothing tone to help the student overcome his fear.
formal.zh: 老师用令人安心的语气说话，帮助那名学生克服恐惧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadni inkwetata dwar l-eżami. Mark: Isma' dan il-messaġġ mingħand oħtok; għandu ton farraġi.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm still worried about the exam. Mark: Listen to this message from your sister; it has a comforting tone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我还在担心考试。Mark：听听你姐姐发来的这条信息，语气很让人安心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我还在担心考试。
messages.en: I'm still worried about the exam.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Isma' dan il-messaġġ mingħand oħtok; għandu ton farraġi.
messages.mt_standard: Isma' dan il-messaġġ mingħand oħtok; għandu ton farraġi.
messages.zh: 听听你姐姐发来的这条信息，语气很让人安心。
messages.en: Listen to this message from your sister; it has a comforting tone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 farraġi 放进“令人安心的声音”这个场景：听到温柔的话，紧张的心慢慢放松，也获得支持。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，用作人的家族姓；书写时首字母大写为 Farrugia。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Farrugia。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Farrugia se jippreżenta r-rapport fil-laqgħa ta' għada.
formal.en: Mr Farrugia will present the report at tomorrow's meeting.
formal.zh: Farrugia 先生将在明天的会议上介绍这份报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-prenotazzjoni fuq liema kunjom hi? Mark: Fuq Farrugia, għal żewġ persuni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What surname is the reservation under? Mark: Farrugia, for two people.
colloquial.zh: Maja：预订登记的姓氏是什么？Mark：Farrugia，两位。

messages.speaker: Maja (餐厅接待员)
messages.zh: 预订登记的姓氏是什么？
messages.en: What surname is the reservation under?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: Farrugia，两位。
messages.en: Farrugia, for two people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Farrugia 写在订位名单的“姓氏”栏里，再搭配“先生”和“一家”练习；作为姓名使用时记住大写 F。

gloss_zh: 鸡；小鸡；另指蓝胸佛法僧

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chicken or chick; in a separate sense, the European roller, Coracias garrulus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指鸡或小鸡；另一个独立义项指蓝胸佛法僧，学名 Coracias garrulus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġieġa jew fellus; f'tifsira oħra, l-għasfur magħruf bħala Coracias garrulus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸡；小鸡。
蓝胸佛法僧，一种学名为 Coracias garrulus 的鸟。

collocations.en: to feed the chicken or chick

formal.mt: It-tifel poġġa ftit ilma qrib il-farruġ biex ikun jista' jixrob.
formal.en: The boy placed some water near the chick so that it could drink.
formal.zh: 男孩在小鸡旁边放了一些水，让它能够喝水。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn mar il-farruġ? Pawlu: Qiegħed ħdejn ommu; ħallilu ftit spazju.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where did the chick go? Pawlu: It's beside its mother; give it a little space.
colloquial.zh: Lina：小鸡跑到哪里去了？Pawlu：它在妈妈旁边，给它留一点空间吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 小鸡跑到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the chick go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed ħdejn ommu; ħallilu ftit spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed ħdejn ommu; ħallilu ftit spazju.
messages.zh: 它在妈妈旁边，给它留一点空间吧。
messages.en: It's beside its mother; give it a little space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 farruġ 做两张图卡：一张画鸡和小鸡，一张写蓝胸佛法僧及其学名；分开记忆这两个名词义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To blow strongly, said of a strong wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指强风猛烈地吹刮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex jingħad li r-riħ jonfoħ bil-qawwa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to blow (used of a strong wind)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （用于强风）猛烈地吹；强劲地吹刮。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, ir-riħ beda jfartan u ċaqlaq is-siġġijiet li kienu fil-bitħa.
formal.en: During the night, the wind began to blow strongly and moved the chairs in the courtyard.
formal.zh: 夜间，风开始猛烈地吹，把院子里的椅子都吹移了位置。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Isma' r-riħ kif qed jfartan! Pawlu: Iva, se ndaħħal is-siġġijiet ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Lina: Listen to how strongly the wind is blowing! Pawlu: Yes, I'll bring the chairs inside.
colloquial.zh: Lina：听，风刮得多猛啊！Pawlu：是啊，我去把椅子搬进来。

messages.speaker: Lina (室友)
messages.zh: 听，风刮得多猛啊！
messages.en: Listen to how strongly the wind is blowing!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我去把椅子搬进来。
messages.en: Yes, I'll bring the chairs inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 fartan 时想象院子里的椅子被大风吹动，把这个动词和“强风猛烈吹刮”的画面一起记住。

gloss_zh: 变秃；修剪树冠或灌木顶部；秃头的人；秃顶的

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become bald; in another sense, to trim the upper part of a tree or bush.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指头发逐渐脱落而变秃；另一个动词义项指修剪树木或灌木的顶部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef xagħru u jsir bla xagħar fuq rasu; f'tifsira oħra, jaqta' l-parti ta' fuq ta' siġra jew arbuxxell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变秃；头发逐渐脱落而成为秃头。

sense_translations.en_definition: to trim the upper part of a tree or bush
sense_translations.zh_definition: 修剪树木或灌木的顶部。
秃头的人；秃顶的人。
秃头的；秃顶的。

collocations.en: to trim the top of the tree

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar beda jfartas is-siġra biex iżommha fl-għoli mixtieq.
formal.en: The gardener began trimming the top of the tree to keep it at the desired height.
formal.zh: 园丁开始修剪树木的顶部，使它保持在所需的高度。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qed nara inqas xagħar fuq rasi. Pawlu: Forsi qed tibda tfartas, bħali.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm noticing less hair on my head. Pawlu: Maybe you're starting to go bald, like me.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我发现自己头上的头发变少了。Pawlu：也许你开始像我一样秃顶了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nara inqas xagħar fuq rasi.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nara inqas xagħar fuq rasi.
messages.zh: 我发现自己头上的头发变少了。
messages.en: I'm noticing less hair on my head.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 也许你开始像我一样秃顶了。
messages.en: Maybe you're starting to go bald, like me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fartas 分四格记忆：动词“变秃”、动词“剪树顶”、名词“秃头的人”、形容词“秃顶的”；分别配句，避免混淆词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small flakes of dead skin that come off the scalp and may appear in the hair or on clothing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从头皮脱落的小片死皮，常见于头发中或衣服上，即头皮屑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qxur żgħar ta' ġilda mejta li jinqalgħu mill-qorriegħa u jidhru fix-xagħar jew fuq il-ħwejjeġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头皮屑；从头皮脱落的细小皮屑。

formal.mt: Fuq il-flixkun hemm miktub li dan ix-xampù huwa kontra l-fartsa.
formal.en: The bottle states that this shampoo is for dandruff.
formal.zh: 瓶身上写着，这款洗发水用于去除头皮屑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi ftit fartsa fuq l-ispallejn? Lina: Iva, fuq il-ġakketta sewda tidher sew; ħa nneħħihielek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do I have some dandruff on my shoulders? Lina: Yes, it shows clearly on the black jacket; let me brush it off for you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我肩膀上是不是有些头皮屑？Lina：是的，在黑色外套上很显眼，我帮你掸掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我肩膀上是不是有些头皮屑？
messages.en: Do I have some dandruff on my shoulders?

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fuq il-ġakketta sewda tidher sew; ħa nneħħihielek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fuq il-ġakketta sewda tidher sew; ħa nneħħihielek.
messages.zh: 是的，在黑色外套上很显眼，我帮你掸掉。
messages.en: Yes, it shows clearly on the black jacket; let me brush it off for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fartsa 和黑外套肩上的白色小屑联系起来，再记住 xampù kontra l-fartsa 这个“去屑洗发水”搭配。

gloss_zh: 搁板；传统上用来存放面包的木搁板

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shelf, especially a wooden shelf traditionally used for storing bread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种搁板，尤指传统上用于存放面包的木制搁板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xkaffa, speċjalment waħda tal-injam li tradizzjonalment kienet tintuża biex jinżamm il-ħobż fuqha.

sense_translations.en_definition: wooden shelf (traditionally used for storing bread)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 木制搁板，传统上用于存放面包。

sense_translations.en_definition: a shelf (traditionally used for keeping bread)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 搁板，传统上用来放置和保存面包。

formal.mt: Fil-kċina tad-dar il-qadima kien hemm farxa tal-injam li fuqha kien jinżamm il-ħobż.
formal.en: In the kitchen of the old house, there was a wooden shelf on which bread was kept.
formal.zh: 那座老房子的厨房里有一块木搁板，用来存放面包。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn inpoġġi l-ħobż? Pawlu: Fuq il-farxa tal-injam, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where shall I put the bread? Pawlu: On the wooden shelf, beside the door.
colloquial.zh: Lina：我把面包放在哪里？Pawlu：放在门旁边的木搁板上。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我把面包放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put the bread?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 放在门旁边的木搁板上。
messages.en: On the wooden shelf, beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老厨房里一块放着面包的木搁板，把 farxa 与“木板托着面包”的画面绑定，帮助记住它的传统用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The shape of something, or the design that determines its appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物的外形，或决定其外观的设计。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma ta' xi ħaġa, jew id-disinn li jagħtiha d-dehra tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形状；物体呈现出来的外形。
设计；对物体外观或形式的安排。

formal.mt: Il-vażun għandu fasla tonda u disinn sempliċi li jaqbel mal-bqija tal-kamra.
formal.en: The vase has a round shape and a simple design that suits the rest of the room.
formal.zh: 这个花瓶外形圆润，设计简洁，与房间的其他部分相配。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema vażun jogħġbok? Mark: Dak it-tond. Il-fasla tiegħu togħġobni aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which vase do you like? Mark: The round one. I like its shape better.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢哪个花瓶？马克：圆的那个。我更喜欢它的形状。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢哪个花瓶？
messages.en: Which vase do you like?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak it-tond. Il-fasla tiegħu togħġobni aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Dak it-tond. Il-fasla tiegħu togħġobni aktar.
messages.zh: 圆的那个。我更喜欢它的形状。
messages.en: The round one. I like its shape better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fasla 联想成纸上画出的花瓶轮廓：轮廓说明“形状”，安排这个轮廓就是“设计”。用同一张图记住两个名词义。

gloss_zh: 反复出血；引起出血的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bleed repeatedly or on more than one occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复出血，或不止一次地流血。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ id-demm ripetutament jew għal aktar minn darba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复出血；为 fasad 的反复动作形式。
引起出血的东西；使血液流出的事物。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, is-saba' midrub fassad kemm-il darba matul il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: In the story, the injured finger bled repeatedly during the journey.
formal.zh: 故事中，那根受伤的手指在旅途中多次出血。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Is-saba' tiegħek reġa' ħareġ id-demm? Pawlu: Iva, fassad mill-ġdid dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did your finger bleed again? Pawlu: Yes, it bled again this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的手指又出血了吗？保罗：是的，今天早上又出血了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手指又出血了吗？
messages.en: Did your finger bleed again?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，今天早上又出血了。
messages.en: Yes, it bled again this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用连续出现的几个红色血滴记动词 fassad 的“反复出血”；再画一支指向血滴的箭头，区分名词义“引起出血的东西”。

gloss_zh: 容易出血的；有出血倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to bleed easily or repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易出血，或具有反复出血倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza joħroġ id-demm faċilment jew ripetutament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有出血倾向的；容易出血的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tessut bħala fassadi, jiġifieri li għandu tendenza joħroġ id-demm.
formal.en: The report describes the tissue as prone to bleeding, meaning that it has a tendency to bleed.
formal.zh: 报告将该组织描述为容易出血，即具有出血倾向。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser 'tessut fassadi' hawn? David: Tessut li għandu tendenza joħroġ id-demm.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'tessut fassadi' mean here? David: Tissue that has a tendency to bleed.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里的 tessut fassadi 是什么意思？戴维：指有出血倾向的组织。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 tessut fassadi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tessut fassadi' mean here?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tessut li għandu tendenza joħroġ id-demm.
messages.mt_standard: Tessut li għandu tendenza joħroġ id-demm.
messages.zh: 指有出血倾向的组织。
messages.en: Tissue that has a tendency to bleed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给人物或组织贴一张“容易出血”的描述标签来记 fassadi。重点记“具有这种倾向”，不能仅凭这个形容词判断此刻正在出血。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Determining the design or shape of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某物的设计或形状起决定作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddetermina d-disinn jew il-forma ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: determining the design or shape of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 决定某物的设计或形状的；对其形式起决定作用的。

collocations.en: a factor determining the design or shape
collocations.zh: 决定设计或形状的因素

collocations.en: a role in determining the design or shape
collocations.zh: 决定设计或形状的作用

formal.mt: Il-wisa' tal-kamra huwa fattur fassali għad-disinn tal-mejda.
formal.en: The width of the room is a factor determining the table's design.
formal.zh: 房间的宽度是决定桌子设计的一个因素。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għamilt il-mejda daqshekk dejqa? Toni: Il-wisa' tal-kamra kien fattur fassali. Mejda usa' ma tidħolx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you make the table so narrow? Toni: The room's width determined the design. A wider table won't fit.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么把桌子做得这么窄？托尼：房间的宽度决定了设计。更宽的桌子放不下。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 你为什么把桌子做得这么窄？
messages.en: Why did you make the table so narrow?

messages.speaker: Toni (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-wisa' tal-kamra kien fattur fassali. Mejda usa' ma tidħolx.
messages.mt_standard: Il-wisa' tal-kamra kien fattur fassali. Mejda usa' ma tidħolx.
messages.zh: 房间的宽度决定了设计。更宽的桌子放不下。
messages.en: The room's width determined the design. A wider table won't fit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象房间宽度像一道边框，决定桌子能设计成什么形状。把 fassali 记作边框旁的标签：“决定设计或形状的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To help a baby or young animal stop feeding on milk and move to other food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使婴儿或幼小动物停止以奶为食，转向其他食物，即使其断奶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħin lil tarbija jew annimal żgħir jieqaf jitma' bil-ħalib u jgħaddi għal ikel ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使断奶；使婴儿或幼小动物逐渐停止吃奶。
帮助婴儿或幼小动物断奶的人。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi fattam lill-ħaruf gradwalment u niżżel id-data fir-reġistru.
formal.en: The farmer weaned the lamb gradually and entered the date in the register.
formal.zh: 农民逐步给小羊断了奶，并在记录簿中记下日期。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-ħaruf għadu jixrob il-ħalib? Ġużeppi: Le, missieri fattam lill-ħaruf ix-xahar li għadda.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the lamb still drinking milk? Ġużeppi: No, my father weaned the lamb last month.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：小羊还在喝奶吗？朱塞佩：没有了，我父亲上个月给它断了奶。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 小羊还在喝奶吗？
messages.en: Is the lamb still drinking milk?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民的儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, missieri fattam lill-ħaruf ix-xahar li għadda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, missieri fattam lill-ħaruf ix-xahar li għadda.
messages.zh: 没有了，我父亲上个月给它断了奶。
messages.en: No, my father weaned the lamb last month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出“奶瓶→其他食物”的过渡箭头来记 fattam：动词指帮助断奶这个动作，名词则指在旁边帮助完成这个过程的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something flat; also, to carry out an action very clumsily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变平；也可指十分笨拙地完成某个动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa ċatta; jista' jfisser ukoll li jagħmel azzjoni b'mod goff ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压平；弄平；使某物变得平坦。

sense_translations.en_definition: to perform an action very clumsily
sense_translations.zh_definition: 十分笨拙地做某事；动作很不灵巧地完成一件事。
用于压平或能使某物变平的东西。

collocations.zh: 笨手笨脚地做这项工作

formal.mt: Il-furnar fattar l-għaġina bir-romblu qabel qatagħha f'biċċiet indaqs.
formal.en: The baker flattened the dough with a rolling pin before cutting it into equal pieces.
formal.zh: 面包师先用擀面杖把面团压平，再将其切成大小相等的块。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex l-għaġina saret daqshekk ċatta? Mark: Pawlu fattar l-għaġina bir-romblu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why has the dough become so flat? Mark: Pawlu flattened it with the rolling pin.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：面团怎么变得这么平了？马克：保罗用擀面杖把它压平了。

messages.speaker: Anna (同住的朋友)
messages.zh: 面团怎么变得这么平了？
messages.en: Why has the dough become so flat?

messages.speaker: Mark (同住的朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗用擀面杖把它压平了。
messages.en: Pawlu flattened it with the rolling pin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三格图记 fattar：第一格把面团压平，第二格笨手笨脚做事，第三格单独画出压平工具。三格分别对应两个动词义和一个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that makes something flat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使某物变平的效果或作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-effett li jagħmel xi ħaġa ċatta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有压平效果的；能起到使某物变平的作用的。

collocations.en: a roller with a flattening effect

formal.mt: L-esperiment juri l-effett fattari tar-romblu fuq saff ta' tafal.
formal.en: The experiment demonstrates the roller's flattening effect on a layer of clay.
formal.zh: 该实验展示了滚筒对一层黏土的压平效果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex it-tafal sar ċatt? Leo: Ir-romblu għandu effett fattari; meta tgħaddih fuqu, iċattah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the clay become flat? Leo: The roller has a flattening effect; when you roll it over the clay, it flattens it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：黏土为什么变平了？利奥：滚筒有压平作用；你把它滚过黏土，黏土就会被压平。

messages.speaker: Maja (手工课学生)
messages.zh: 黏土为什么变平了？
messages.en: Why did the clay become flat?

messages.speaker: Leo (手工课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-romblu għandu effett fattari; meta tgħaddih fuqu, iċattah.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-romblu għandu effett fattari; meta tgħaddih fuqu, iċattah.
messages.zh: 滚筒有压平作用；你把它滚过黏土，黏土就会被压平。
messages.en: The roller has a flattening effect; when you roll it over the clay, it flattens it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象滚筒经过后，凸起的黏土变成平面。把 fattari 写在滚筒旁，记住它描述“具有压平作用”，重点在产生的效果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chickling vetch, the plant with the scientific name Lathyrus sativus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 山黧豆，学名为 Lathyrus sativus 的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Lathyrus sativus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 山黧豆（Lathyrus sativus），一种植物。

collocations.zh: 一块种植山黧豆的田地

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jidentifika l-favella bl-isem xjentifiku Lathyrus sativus u jinkludi ritratt tal-pjanta.
formal.en: The catalogue identifies chickling vetch by the scientific name Lathyrus sativus and includes a photograph of the plant.
formal.zh: 目录以学名 Lathyrus sativus 标示山黧豆，并附有该植物的照片。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'hemm miżrugħ f'din l-għalqa? Pawlu: Favella. Fuq it-tabella hemm ukoll l-isem Lathyrus sativus.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's planted in this field? Pawlu: Chickling vetch. The sign also gives the name Lathyrus sativus.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块田里种的是什么？保罗：山黧豆。牌子上还写着 Lathyrus sativus 这个名字。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: 这块田里种的是什么？
messages.en: What's planted in this field?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Favella. Fuq it-tabella hemm ukoll l-isem Lathyrus sativus.
messages.mt_standard: Favella. Fuq it-tabella hemm ukoll l-isem Lathyrus sativus.
messages.zh: 山黧豆。牌子上还写着 Lathyrus sativus 这个名字。
messages.en: Chickling vetch. The sign also gives the name Lathyrus sativus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张植物名牌，把 favella、山黧豆和 Lathyrus sativus 并排写在同一张卡片上，再配一幅田地小图，建立三个名称之间的对应。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The overflowing of liquid beyond the edge or capacity of a container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体超过容器容量或边缘而向外溢出的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' likwidu minn reċipjent meta jimtela aktar milli jiflaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 溢出；液体过满而向外流出的现象。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-fawran tal-ilma mit-tank u l-ħsara li kkawża.
formal.en: The report describes the overflowing of water from the tank and the damage it caused.
formal.zh: 报告描述了水从水箱溢出的情况及其造成的损坏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm l-ilma mal-art? Mark: Minħabba l-fawran mit-tank; insejt nagħlaq il-vit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there water on the floor? Mark: Because of the overflow from the tank; I forgot to turn off the tap.
colloquial.zh: Maja：地上怎么有水？Mark：是水箱里的水溢出来了；我忘了关水龙头。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 地上怎么有水？
messages.en: Why is there water on the floor?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-fawran mit-tank; insejt nagħlaq il-vit.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-fawran mit-tank; insejt nagħlaq il-vit.
messages.zh: 是水箱里的水溢出来了；我忘了关水龙头。
messages.en: Because of the overflow from the tank; I forgot to turn off the tap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水箱装得太满，水越过边缘流到地上；把 fawran 和“满到溢出”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Faroe Islands, their people, or their language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与法罗群岛、法罗人或法罗语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Gżejjer Faroe, man-nies tagħhom jew mal-lingwa tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法罗的；与法罗群岛、其居民或语言有关的。
法罗人；来自法罗群岛的人。
法罗语；法罗群岛居民使用的语言。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina r-rwol tal-Fawriż fil-ħajja ta' kuljum tal-poplu Fawriż.
formal.en: The study examines the role of Faroese in the everyday life of the Faroese people.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察法罗语在法罗人民日常生活中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak ir-raġel huwa Fawriż? Mark: Iva, u jitkellem bil-Fawriż ma' familtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that man Faroese? Mark: Yes, and he speaks Faroese with his family.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个男人是法罗人吗？Mark：是的，而且他和家人说法罗语。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男人是法罗人吗？
messages.en: Is that man Faroese?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jitkellem bil-Fawriż ma' familtu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jitkellem bil-Fawriż ma' familtu.
messages.zh: 是的，而且他和家人说法罗语。
messages.en: Yes, and he speaks Faroese with his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“法罗的人、法罗的事、法罗的语言”三个格子记 Fawriż；结合句中位置区分形容词、人物名词和语言名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of wrapping an injured part of the body with a bandage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用绷带缠裹身体受伤部位的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tgeżwer parti midruba tal-ġisem b'faxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包扎；用绷带缠裹受伤部位的过程。

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-għalliem wera l-faxxatura ta' id midruba permezz ta' mudell.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher demonstrated the bandaging of an injured hand using a model.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师用模型演示了受伤手部的包扎过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tgħallimtu fil-kors illum? Mark: Il-faxxatura tal-id; ipprattikajna fuq mudell.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you learn on the course today? Mark: Hand bandaging; we practised on a model.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们今天在课程里学了什么？Mark：手部包扎；我们用模型练习了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们今天在课程里学了什么？
messages.en: What did you learn on the course today?

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.zh: 手部包扎；我们用模型练习了。
messages.en: Hand bandaging; we practised on a model.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象绷带一圈圈绕过受伤的手，把整个“包扎过程”标成 faxxatura，重点记动作过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A practical task or errand that needs to be done, often as part of everyday responsibilities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要处理的一项日常事务或跑腿差事，常属于日常生活中的责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa xogħol jew qadi li jkun jeħtieġ isir, spiss bħala parti mir-responsabbiltajiet ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂务；需要处理的小事；跑腿差事
家务；打扫、整理等家庭日常劳动
排便；排出粪便

formal.mt: Qabel il-laqgħa, l-assistent ħareġ biex jaqdi faċenda fl-uffiċċju tal-posta.
formal.en: Before the meeting, the assistant went out to run an errand at the post office.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，助理外出去邮局办了一件事。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Se toħroġ issa? Sara: Iva, għandi faċenda x'naqdi fil-posta; niġi lura dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Are you going out now? Sara: Yes, I've got an errand to run at the post office; I'll be back soon.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你现在要出去吗？萨拉：是的，我得去邮局办点事；很快就回来。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 你现在要出去吗？
messages.en: Are you going out now?

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi faċenda x'naqdi fil-posta; niġi lura dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi faċenda x'naqdi fil-posta; niġi lura dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 是的，我得去邮局办点事；很快就回来。
messages.en: Yes, I've got an errand to run at the post office; I'll be back soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按场景分开记忆 faċenda：去邮局是办差事，在家打扫是家务，谈身体排泄时则指排便；依靠上下文选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of helping an activity, discussion, or procedure proceed more easily and effectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过协助或引导，使活动、讨论或程序更顺利、更有效地进行的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' għajnuna jew gwida biex attività, diskussjoni jew proċedura timxi b'inqas diffikultà u b'mod aktar effettiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 促进；通过协助或引导使某项活动顺利进行。

formal.mt: Il-faċilitazzjoni tad-diskussjoni għenet lill-parteċipanti jilħqu ftehim.
formal.en: The facilitation of the discussion helped the participants reach an agreement.
formal.zh: 对讨论的引导帮助参与者达成了协议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-faċilitazzjoni tal-laqgħa? Mark: Jien, u se nagħti ċans lil kulħadd jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will take care of facilitating the meeting? Mark: I will, and I will give everyone a chance to speak.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁来负责引导会议？Mark：我来，我会让每个人都有机会发言。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-faċilitazzjoni tal-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-faċilitazzjoni tal-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 谁来负责引导会议？
messages.en: Who will take care of facilitating the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (会议主持人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, u se nagħti ċans lil kulħadd jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, u se nagħti ċans lil kulħadd jitkellem.
messages.zh: 我来，我会让每个人都有机会发言。
messages.en: I will, and I will give everyone a chance to speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主持人帮助大家轮流发言、推动讨论，记住这个名词表示促进的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place, building, or piece of equipment provided for a particular activity or service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某种活动或服务提供的场所、建筑或设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post, bini jew tagħmir maħsub għal attività jew servizz partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供某种活动或服务使用的设施或场所。

formal.mt: Il-faċilità sportiva l-ġdida se tkun miftuħa għall-pubbliku minn nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The new sports facility will be open to the public from Monday.
formal.zh: 新的体育设施将从星期一起向公众开放。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm faċilità sportiva qrib id-dar tiegħek? Toni: Iva, hemm waħda ħdejn l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there a sports facility near your home? Toni: Yes, there is one next to the school.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你家附近有体育设施吗？Toni：有，学校旁边就有一处。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm faċilità sportiva qrib id-dar tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm faċilità sportiva qrib id-dar tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你家附近有体育设施吗？
messages.en: Is there a sports facility near your home?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，学校旁边就有一处。
messages.en: Yes, there is one next to the school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和体育馆、诊所的画面相连，记住它指提供活动或服务的设施。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An institution where people are held in custody as part of a criminal sentence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据刑事判决关押服刑人员的机构，即监狱或惩教设施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Istituzzjoni fejn jinżammu persuni biex jiskontaw sentenza ta' priġunerija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 监狱；关押服刑人员的惩教设施。

collocations.en: a visit to a correctional facility
the staff of the correctional facility
