formal.mt: Il-faċilità korrettiva toffri korsijiet edukattivi lill-priġunieri.
formal.en: The correctional facility offers educational courses to prisoners.
formal.zh: 该惩教设施为囚犯提供教育课程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn taħdem issa? Pawlu: Naħdem bħala għalliem f'faċilità korrettiva.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where do you work now? Pawlu: I work as a teacher in a correctional facility.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你现在在哪里工作？Pawlu：我在一所惩教设施里当老师。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你现在在哪里工作？
messages.en: Where do you work now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 我在一所惩教设施里当老师。
messages.en: I work as a teacher in a correctional facility.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词记成有围墙、看守和教育课程的机构，整体对应监狱或惩教设施。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing people who act friendly or loyal in front of someone but behave differently behind that person's back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容在人前表现友好或忠诚、背后却采取另一套态度或行为的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi nies li quddiem persuna juru ħbiberija jew lealtà, iżda minn wara daharha jġibu ruħhom mod ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 两面派的；当面一套、背后一套的；表里不一的

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-protagonista tiskopri li sħabha huma faċċati: ifaħħruha quddiemha iżda jikkritikawha minn wara daharha.
formal.en: In the story, the protagonist discovers that her companions are two-faced: they praise her to her face but criticize her behind her back.
formal.zh: 故事中，主人公发现同伴们表里不一：他们当面赞扬她，背后却批评她。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex m'għadekx tafdahom? David: Għax huma faċċati; quddiemi jaqblu miegħi, imma minn wara dahri jgħidu l-kontra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why don't you trust them anymore? David: Because they're two-faced; they agree with me to my face, but behind my back they say the opposite.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么不再信任他们了？戴维：因为他们当面一套、背后一套；当着我的面赞同我，背后却说相反的话。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不再信任他们了？
messages.en: Why don't you trust them anymore?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huma faċċati; quddiemi jaqblu miegħi, imma minn wara dahri jgħidu l-kontra.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huma faċċati; quddiemi jaqblu miegħi, imma minn wara dahri jgħidu l-kontra.
messages.zh: 因为他们当面一套、背后一套；当着我的面赞同我，背后却说相反的话。
messages.en: Because they're two-faced; they agree with me to my face, but behind my back they say the opposite.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅连续漫画记忆：一群人当面微笑赞同，转身却说反话；把 faċċati 与这种表里不一的表现相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One distinct side or aspect of something, such as a surface of a cut gem or an aspect of a complex subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物的一个独立面，例如经过切割的宝石表面，或复杂问题的某一方面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wiċċ jew aspett wieħed ta' xi ħaġa, bħal wiċċ ta' ġawhra maqtugħa jew aspett ta' suġġett kumpless.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 切面，尤指宝石的切割面；事物或问题的某一方面

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina faċċetta importanti tal-problema: l-effett tagħha fuq il-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The study examines an important facet of the problem: its effect on everyday life.
formal.zh: 该研究考察了问题的一个重要方面：它对日常生活的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma kontx naf li Mark ipinġi! Lara: Din faċċetta oħra tal-personalità tiegħu; għandu ħafna talent.
colloquial.en: Maja: I didn't know Mark paints! Lara: That's another facet of his personality; he's very talented.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我以前不知道马克还画画！拉拉：这是他性格的另一面；他很有才华。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma kontx naf li Mark ipinġi!
messages.mt_standard: Ma kontx naf li Mark ipinġi!
messages.zh: 我以前不知道马克还画画！
messages.en: I didn't know Mark paints!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din faċċetta oħra tal-personalità tiegħu; għandu ħafna talent.
messages.mt_standard: Din faċċetta oħra tal-personalità tiegħu; għandu ħafna talent.
messages.zh: 这是他性格的另一面；他很有才华。
messages.en: That's another facet of his personality; he's very talented.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象转动一颗宝石，每转一下就看见一个新切面；再把同一画面用于理解问题或性格的一个方面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An occurrence of bleeding, when blood flows out of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 血液流出身体的情况；一次出血。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ ta' demm mill-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出血；一次出血。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi faġra li seħħet wara l-inċident.
formal.en: The report describes an episode of bleeding that occurred after the accident.
formal.zh: 报告描述了事故后发生的一次出血。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu telaq kmieni? Mark: Kellu faġra minn imnieħru u mar id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu leave early? Mark: His nose was bleeding, and he went home.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu为什么提前走了？Mark：他鼻子出血，就回家了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么提前走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave early?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellu faġra minn imnieħru u mar id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Kellu faġra minn imnieħru u mar id-dar.
messages.zh: 他鼻子出血，就回家了。
messages.en: His nose was bleeding, and he went home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把faġra和纸巾上出现血迹的画面配对，记住它表示一次出血。

gloss_zh: 使人流鼻血；使人流鼻血者；玷污他人者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to bleed from the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人的鼻子出血。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd joħroġlu d-demm minn imnieħru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人流鼻血。

sense_translations.en_definition: one who gives sb. a nosebleed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使他人流鼻血的人。
玷污或污辱他人的人。

collocations.en: gave his opponent a nosebleed with a blow

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-plejer faġġar lill-avversarju b'daqqa waqt il-logħba.
formal.en: According to the report, the player gave his opponent a nosebleed with a blow during the match.
formal.zh: 据报告，该球员在比赛中一击使对手流了鼻血。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqqfu l-logħba? Toni: Plejer faġġar lill-avversarju b'daqqa aċċidentali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did they stop the match? Toni: A player accidentally struck his opponent and gave him a nosebleed.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他们为什么暂停比赛？Toni：一名球员意外打中了对手，使他流了鼻血。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 他们为什么暂停比赛？
messages.en: Why did they stop the match?

messages.speaker: Toni (观众)
messages.zh: 一名球员意外打中了对手，使他流了鼻血。
messages.en: A player accidentally struck his opponent and gave him a nosebleed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记使别人鼻子出血的动作；作名词时指施事者，另把玷污他人者单独记忆。

gloss_zh: 使人流鼻血的；造成玷污的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing someone to bleed from the nose, or causing defilement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会使人流鼻血的，或会造成玷污的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd joħroġlu d-demm minn imnieħru, jew li jniġġes.

sense_translations.en_definition: that makes s.o. bleed at the nose
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人鼻子出血的。
造成玷污或污辱的。

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kittieb jiddeskrivi l-profanazzjoni bħala att faġġari.
formal.en: In the text, the writer describes the desecration as a defiling act.
formal.zh: 在文中，作者把这种亵渎描述为造成玷污的行为。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser kuntatt faġġari f'dan ir-rapport? Pawlu: Kuntatt li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd joħroġlu d-demm minn imnieħru.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does contact described as faġġari mean in this report? Pawlu: Contact that causes someone to bleed from the nose.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这份报告里用faġġari形容碰撞，是什么意思？Pawlu：就是会使人流鼻血的碰撞。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser kuntatt faġġari f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser kuntatt faġġari f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.zh: 这份报告里用faġġari形容碰撞，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does contact described as faġġari mean in this report?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Kuntatt li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd joħroġlu d-demm minn imnieħru.
messages.mt_standard: Kuntatt li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd joħroġlu d-demm minn imnieħru.
messages.zh: 就是会使人流鼻血的碰撞。
messages.en: Contact that causes someone to bleed from the nose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给碰撞贴上使人流鼻血的标签，给行为贴上造成玷污的标签，记住两义都作形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dress in fashionable clothes and present a stylish appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿上时髦的衣服，把自己打扮得入时。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Libes ħwejjeġ tal-moda u deher eleganti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿着入时；把自己打扮得时髦。

collocations.zh: 为庆祝活动作时髦打扮
穿上流行服饰，打扮得很时髦

formal.mt: Għall-ftuħ tal-wirja, Mark faġġaġ bi ħwejjeġ tal-moda.
formal.en: For the opening of the exhibition, Mark dressed stylishly in fashionable clothes.
formal.zh: 为了参加展览开幕式，Mark穿上流行服饰，打扮得很时髦。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt kif faġġaġ Toni għall-festa? Maja: Iva, il-ġakketta l-ġdida tixraqlu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see how stylishly Toni dressed for the party? Maja: Yes, his new jacket suits him very well.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你看到Toni参加聚会时打扮得多时髦了吗？Maja：看到了，他的新夹克很适合他。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到Toni参加聚会时打扮得多时髦了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how stylishly Toni dressed for the party?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，他的新夹克很适合他。
messages.en: Yes, his new jacket suits him very well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象赴宴前挑选时髦夹克的动作，把整个词与穿着入时的画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 未阉割的成年公马；体格魁梧的男人；体重超重的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adult male horse that has not been castrated; also a very big man or an overweight person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未阉割的成年公马；也可指体格非常魁梧的男人或体重超重的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żiemel raġel adult mhux ikkastrat; ukoll raġel kbir ħafna jew persuna b'piż żejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未阉割的成年公马。
体格非常魁梧的男人；大块头男人。
体重超重的人；用于称呼他人时可能显得冒犯。

collocations.zh: 马厩里的一匹成年公马

formal.mt: Il-faħal jinżamm fi stalla spazjuża u jirċievi kura regolari.
formal.en: The stallion is kept in a spacious stable and receives regular care.
formal.zh: 这匹成年公马养在宽敞的马厩里，并定期得到照料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak iż-żiemel huwa faħal? Pawlu: Iva, huwa żiemel raġel adult mhux ikkastrat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that horse a stallion? Pawlu: Yes, it is an adult male horse that has not been castrated.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那匹马是未阉割的成年公马吗？Pawlu：是的，它是成年公马，没有阉割。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场访客)
messages.zh: 那匹马是未阉割的成年公马吗？
messages.en: Is that horse a stallion?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养马人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa żiemel raġel adult mhux ikkastrat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa żiemel raġel adult mhux ikkastrat.
messages.zh: 是的，它是成年公马，没有阉割。
messages.en: Yes, it is an adult male horse that has not been castrated.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用强壮成年公马记住faħal，再分别记住大块头男人和超重者两个人物义，称人时注意语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express approval or admiration for someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事表达认可、赞赏或钦佩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tesprimi approvazzjoni jew ammirazzjoni għal xi ħadd jew għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞扬；称赞；表达赞赏。

formal.mt: Id-direttur faħar lill-ħaddiema għall-kwalità tax-xogħol tagħhom.
formal.en: The director praised the employees for the quality of their work.
formal.zh: 主管赞扬了员工们的工作质量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qal l-għalliem dwar il-proġett tiegħek? Mark: Faħar ix-xogħol tiegħi u qal li kien ċar ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did the teacher say about your project? Mark: He praised my work and said it was very clear.
colloquial.zh: Sara：老师怎么评价你的项目？Mark：他称赞了我的作品，说内容非常清楚。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 老师怎么评价你的项目？
messages.en: What did the teacher say about your project?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Faħar ix-xogħol tiegħi u qal li kien ċar ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Faħar ix-xogħol tiegħi u qal li kien ċar ħafna.
messages.zh: 他称赞了我的作品，说内容非常清楚。
messages.en: He praised my work and said it was very clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师看完作业后竖起拇指，把faħar和开口称赞的动作一起记。

gloss_zh: 饲养马匹；把动物养肥；养马人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rear a horse or to feed an animal so that it becomes fat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 饲养马匹，或通过喂养使动物长肥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trabbi żiemel jew titma' annimal biex jissemmen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 饲养马匹；把马养大。
把动物养肥；使动物增膘。
养马人；从事马匹繁育的人。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi faħħal iż-żiemel b'għalf tajjeb u b'kura regolari.
formal.en: The farmer reared the horse with good feed and regular care.
formal.zh: 农场主用优质饲料和定期照料养育了这匹马。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min faħħal dan iż-żiemel? Toni: Missieri; ħa ħsiebu minn meta kien żgħir.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who reared this horse? Toni: My father; he has looked after it since it was young.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这匹马是谁养大的？Toni：我父亲；他从它小时候就一直照料它。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场访客)
messages.zh: 这匹马是谁养大的？
messages.en: Who reared this horse?

messages.speaker: Toni (农场主的儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri; ħa ħsiebu minn meta kien żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri; ħa ħsiebu minn meta kien żgħir.
messages.zh: 我父亲；他从它小时候就一直照料它。
messages.en: My father; he has looked after it since it was young.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用给马添饲料的画面记faħħal：作动词是养马或养肥动物，作名词则指养马的人。

gloss_zh: 使碳化；灼烧；烧焦；煤炭商

teaching_sense.en_definition: To carbonise a material, sear its surface, or burn it until it is charred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使材料碳化，灼烧其表面，或将其烧焦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tbiddel materjal f'materjal rikk fil-karbonju, taħarqu minn barra jew taħarqu sakemm jiswied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使碳化；使材料转变为富含碳的物质。
灼烧；用高温烧灼表面。
烧焦；使表面焦黑。
煤炭商；卖煤的人。

collocations.en: seared the surface of the meat
collocations.zh: 用高温灼烧了肉的表面

formal.mt: In-nar faħħam l-injam u ħalla saff iswed fuq il-wiċċ tiegħu.
formal.en: The fire charred the wood and left a black layer on its surface.
formal.zh: 火把木材烧焦，在其表面留下了一层黑色物质。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan l-injam huwa iswed? Mark: In-nar faħħam il-wiċċ tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this wood black? Mark: The fire charred its surface.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这块木头为什么是黑色的？Mark：火把它的表面烧焦了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这块木头为什么是黑色的？
messages.en: Why is this wood black?

messages.speaker: Mark (科学教师)
messages.zh: 火把它的表面烧焦了。
messages.en: The fire charred its surface.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用木头受热变黑记faħħam的动词义；另设一个卖煤摊位画面，单独记名词义煤炭商。

gloss_zh: 对食物的强烈渴望；馋劲

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong desire to eat food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想吃东西的强烈欲望；一阵馋劲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa qawwija li tiekol xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对食物的强烈渴望；很想吃东西的感觉。

formal.mt: Fid-djarju tagħha, l-istudenta ddeskriviet faħħama għall-ħelu li ħasset filgħaxija.
formal.en: In her diary, the student described a craving for sweets that she felt in the evening.
formal.zh: 这名学生在日记中描述了自己晚上很想吃甜食的感觉。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex xtrajt dawn il-gallettini? Lara: Kelli faħħama għall-ħelu u ridt niekol xi ħaġa ħelwa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you buy these biscuits? Lara: I had a craving for sweets and wanted to eat something sweet.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么买了这些饼干？Lara：我特别馋甜食，想吃点甜的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么买了这些饼干？
messages.en: Why did you buy these biscuits?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli faħħama għall-ħelu u ridt niekol xi ħaġa ħelwa.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli faħħama għall-ħelu u ridt niekol xi ħaġa ħelwa.
messages.zh: 我特别馋甜食，想吃点甜的。
messages.en: I had a craving for sweets and wanted to eat something sweet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看到饼干后满脑子都想吃的感觉，把faħħama记成突然涌起的一阵馋劲。

gloss_zh: 能使材料碳化的；具有碳化能力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the capacity to turn a material into carbon or a carbon-rich substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使材料碳化、转变为碳或富含碳的物质的能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-kapaċità li jbiddel materjal f'karbonju jew f'materjal rikk fil-karbonju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使材料碳化的能力的；能使材料转变为富含碳的物质的。

collocations.en: a process capable of carbonising material
an agent capable of carbonising material
collocations.zh: 具有碳化作用的试剂或介质

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi proċess faħħami li jbiddel l-injam f'materjal rikk fil-karbonju.
formal.en: The report describes a carbonising process that turns wood into a carbon-rich material.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一种能使木材转变为富碳材料的碳化过程。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Xi jfisser 'faħħami' f'din is-sentenza? Maja: Ifisser li l-proċess jista' jbiddel il-materjal f'materjal rikk fil-karbonju.
colloquial.en: Toni: What does 'faħħami' mean in this sentence? Maja: It means that the process can turn the material into a carbon-rich substance.
colloquial.zh: Toni：这句话里的faħħami是什么意思？Maja：意思是这个过程能把材料转变为富含碳的物质。

messages.speaker: Toni (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的faħħami是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'faħħami' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Maja (科学教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-proċess jista' jbiddel il-materjal f'materjal rikk fil-karbonju.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-proċess jista' jbiddel il-materjal f'materjal rikk fil-karbonju.
messages.zh: 意思是这个过程能把材料转变为富含碳的物质。
messages.en: It means that the process can turn the material into a carbon-rich substance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给某个过程贴上能使材料碳化的标签来记faħħami，重点记住它描述能力，是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Given to boasting about oneself, one's abilities, or one's achievements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 惯于夸耀自己、自己的能力或成就的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jiftaħar bih innifsu, bil-ħila tiegħu jew b'dak li għamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱自夸的；喜欢吹嘘的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru prinċipali huwa faħħari u jitkellem il-ħin kollu dwar is-suċċessi tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the main character is boastful and talks constantly about his achievements.
formal.zh: 故事中的主角爱自夸，总是不停地谈论自己的成就。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħid li Karl huwa faħħari? Nina: Għax kull darba li niltaqgħu jitkellem biss dwar kemm hu bravu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you say Karl is boastful? Nina: Because whenever we meet, he talks only about how good he is.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说卡尔爱自夸？妮娜：因为我们每次见面，他都只说自己有多厉害。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li Karl huwa faħħari?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li Karl huwa faħħari?
messages.zh: 你为什么说卡尔爱自夸？
messages.en: Why do you say Karl is boastful?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba li niltaqgħu jitkellem biss dwar kemm hu bravu.
messages.zh: 因为我们每次见面，他都只说自己有多厉害。
messages.en: Because whenever we meet, he talks only about how good he is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人举着自己的奖杯不停夸自己，把 faħħari 和“爱自夸的”这一人物形象一起记住。

gloss_zh: 使变得猥亵或不雅；造成猥亵或不雅的事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something obscene or indecent, for example by introducing offensive sexual language or content.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物变得猥亵或不雅，例如加入下流的性用语或内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel xi ħaġa oxxena jew indiċenti, pereżempju billi żied kliem jew kontenut sesswali offensiv.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sth. obscene or indecent
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某事物变得猥亵、下流或不雅。

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. which causes obscenity or indecency
sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成猥亵或不雅的事物。

formal.mt: L-editur osserva li l-awtur faħħax it-test billi żied espressjonijiet indiċenti.
formal.en: The editor observed that the author had made the text indecent by adding indecent expressions.
formal.zh: 编辑指出，作者加入了不雅措辞，使文本变得低俗。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ma tridx taqra dan it-test lit-tfal? Lara: Għax min biddlu faħħax it-test bi kliem indiċenti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why don't you want to read this text to the children? Lara: Because whoever changed it made it indecent with indecent language.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么不想把这篇文章读给孩子们听？拉拉：因为修改它的人加了不雅用语，把文章弄得很低俗。

messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx taqra dan it-test lit-tfal?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想把这篇文章读给孩子们听？
messages.en: Why don't you want to read this text to the children?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax min biddlu faħħax it-test bi kliem indiċenti.
messages.mt_standard: Għax min biddlu faħħax it-test bi kliem indiċenti.
messages.zh: 因为修改它的人加了不雅用语，把文章弄得很低俗。
messages.en: Because whoever changed it made it indecent with indecent language.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“原本正常的文本被加上不雅内容”来记动词义；名词义则指造成这种猥亵或不雅的东西，注意分别记忆词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut a small notch into something, or to make an edge fray into loose threads.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体上刻出小缺口，或使织物等的边缘散成松开的线头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel talja żgħira f'xi ħaġa, jew tħoll il-ħjut fit-tarf ta' drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在物体上刻出或切出小缺口、凹口。
使织物等的边缘磨散、起毛或散出线头。

collocations.en: notched the edge of the wood
collocations.zh: 在木头边缘刻出了缺口

collocations.en: frayed the edge of the fabric
collocations.zh: 使布料边缘散出了线头

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa fażżar it-tarf tal-biċċa injam biex joħloq punt ta' referenza.
formal.en: The carpenter notched the edge of the piece of wood to create a reference point.
formal.zh: 木匠在那块木头的边缘刻出了一个缺口，作为参照点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm ħjut maħlula fit-tarf ta' dan id-drapp? Mark: It-tifel fażżar it-tarf waqt li kien jiġbed il-ħjut.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there loose threads at the edge of this fabric? Mark: The boy frayed the edge while pulling at the threads.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这块布边缘怎么有松散的线头？Mark：那个男孩拉扯线头时，把布边弄散了。

messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm ħjut maħlula fit-tarf ta' dan id-drapp?
messages.zh: 这块布边缘怎么有松散的线头？

teaching_sense.en_definition: Regarded as reliable and worthy of confidence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被认为可靠、值得信赖的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitqies affidabbli u li wieħed jista' jafda fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受信任的；被认为可靠、可以信赖的。

formal.mt: Id-direttur talab lil konsulent fdat biex jeżamina l-proposta qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The director asked a trusted adviser to examine the proposal before the meeting.
formal.zh: 主管请一位受信任的顾问在会议前审阅提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma' min nista' nitkellem dwar din il-problema? Mark: Tkellem ma' Pawlu; huwa ħabib fdat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can I talk to about this problem? Mark: Talk to Pawlu; he is a trusted friend.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这件烦心事我可以找谁聊聊？Mark：找 Pawlu 吧；他是个值得信赖的朋友。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' min nista' nitkellem dwar din il-problema?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' min nista' nitkellem dwar din il-problema?
messages.zh: 这件烦心事我可以找谁聊聊？
messages.en: Who can I talk to about this problem?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Tkellem ma' Pawlu; huwa ħabib fdat.
messages.zh: 找 Pawlu 吧；他是个值得信赖的朋友。
messages.en: Talk to Pawlu; he is a trusted friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把重要事情交给一位可靠朋友，在他名字旁写上 fdat，记住这是“受信任的”这一评价。

gloss_zh: 一种类似意式宽扁面的马耳他面食

teaching_sense.en_definition: A type of Maltese pasta similar to tagliatelle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种马耳他面食，形态类似意式宽扁面 tagliatelle。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' għaġin Malti li jixbah it-tagliatelle.

sense_translations.en_definition: a type of Maltese pasta similar to tagliatelle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种类似意式宽扁面 tagliatelle 的马耳他面食。

collocations.zh: 加有 fdewxa 面食的汤

formal.mt: Il-ktieb jippreżenta riċetta għal soppa bil-fdewxa, tip ta' għaġin Malti li jixbah it-tagliatelle.
formal.en: The book presents a recipe for soup with fdewxa, a type of Maltese pasta similar to tagliatelle.
formal.zh: 书中介绍了一道加入 fdewxa 的汤的食谱；fdewxa 是一种类似意式宽扁面的马耳他面食。

colloquial.en: Maja: What's for lunch today? Mark: Soup with fdewxa pasta. Would you like a bowl?
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天午饭吃什么？Mark：加了 fdewxa 面食的汤。你要来一碗吗？

messages.en: Soup with fdewxa pasta. Would you like a bowl?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fdewxa 写在一张画着宽扁面条的餐盘卡片上，再配“马耳他面食”标签，借形状记住食物类别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who saves others from danger, suffering, or serious difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把他人从危险、痛苦或严重困境中解救出来的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssalva lil ħaddieħor minn periklu, tbatija jew diffikultà kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拯救者；救星；把他人从危险或困境中解救出来的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-protagonist jitqies bħala l-feddej tar-raħal wara li jsalva lill-abitanti minn periklu kbir.
formal.en: In the story, the protagonist is regarded as the saviour of the village after saving its inhabitants from great danger.
formal.zh: 故事中，主人公把村民从重大危险中救出，因此被视为村庄的救星。

colloquial.en: Maja: Did you find the file you lost? Mark: Yes, Pawlu had a copy. He was my saviour today!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你找到丢失的文件了吗？Mark：找到了，Pawlu 有个副本。他今天可真是我的救星！

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你找到丢失的文件了吗？
messages.en: Did you find the file you lost?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)

messages.mt_standard: Iva, Pawlu kellu kopja. Għalija kien il-feddej tal-ġurnata!
messages.zh: 找到了，Pawlu 有个副本。他今天可真是我的救星！
messages.en: Yes, Pawlu had a copy. He was my saviour today!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象陷入困境时有人及时伸手相救，你喊“救星来了”；把这个人物角色与 feddej 连在一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a wild or unruly animal become calmer and manageable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使野生或难以控制的动物逐渐温顺、能够接受人的管理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel annimal selvaġġ jew diffiċli biex tikkontrollah aktar mans u ubbidjenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驯服；使野性或难以控制的动物变得温顺。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel feddel iż-żiemel bil-paċenzja, u l-annimal beda jaċċetta l-preżenza tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the man patiently tamed the horse, and the animal began to accept his presence.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个男人耐心地驯服了那匹马，马也开始接受他在身边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min feddel dan iż-żiemel? Mark: In-nannu tiegħi; ħadem miegħu bil-paċenzja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who tamed this horse? Mark: My grandfather; he worked patiently with it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这匹马是谁驯服的？Mark：我爷爷；他一直很耐心地训练它。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 这匹马是谁驯服的？

messages.speaker: Mark (马主)
messages.zh: 我爷爷；他一直很耐心地训练它。
messages.en: My grandfather; he worked patiently with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用前后两幅图记 feddel：开始时马难以接近，后来能够平静接受人；中间的变化就是“驯服”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a loyal manner, or in a way that accurately preserves an original meaning or account.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 忠诚地履行职责或支持某人；也指忠实地保留原意或如实叙述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'lealtà lejn persuna jew dmir, jew b'mod li jżomm eżatt it-tifsira jew il-kontenut oriġinali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忠诚地；尽忠地。
忠实地；如实地；准确保留原意地。

collocations.en: to carry out his duty loyally

formal.mt: It-traduzzjoni tirriproduċi fedelment it-tifsira tat-test oriġinali.
formal.en: The translation faithfully reproduces the meaning of the original text.
formal.zh: 这份译文忠实地再现了原文的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din it-traduzzjoni żżomm it-tifsira tal-ittra? Mark: Iva, tittraduċi fedelment dak li kitbet Anna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this translation preserve the meaning of the letter? Mark: Yes, it faithfully translates what Anna wrote.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份译文保留了信的原意吗？马克：是的，它忠实地翻译了安娜写的内容。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这份译文保留了信的原意吗？
messages.en: Does this translation preserve the meaning of the letter?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tittraduċi fedelment dak li kitbet Anna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tittraduċi fedelment dak li kitbet Anna.
messages.zh: 是的，它忠实地翻译了安娜写的内容。
messages.en: Yes, it faithfully translates what Anna wrote.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个画面连起来记：对职责忠诚，对原文忠实；fedelment 都在说明动作做得怎样。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of remaining loyal and committed to a person, group, or principle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人、团体或原则保持忠诚与坚定承诺的品质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li wieħed jibqa' leali u jżomm l-impenn tiegħu lejn persuna, grupp jew prinċipju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忠诚；忠贞；对人、团体或原则的坚定支持。

formal.mt: Il-fedeltà lejn il-prinċipji tal-għaqda għandha tidher fl-għemil tal-membri tagħha.
formal.en: Loyalty to the association's principles should be evident in the actions of its members.
formal.zh: 对协会原则的忠诚，应当体现在会员的行动中。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għadek tappoġġja lil dan it-tim? Pawlu: Għax il-fedeltà lejn it-tim tiegħi ma tiddependix mir-riżultati.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you still support this team? Pawlu: Because my loyalty to my team does not depend on the results.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么还支持这支球队？保罗：因为我对球队的忠诚不取决于比赛成绩。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadek tappoġġja lil dan it-tim?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadek tappoġġja lil dan it-tim?
messages.zh: 你为什么还支持这支球队？
messages.en: Why do you still support this team?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-fedeltà lejn it-tim tiegħi ma tiddependix mir-riżultati.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-fedeltà lejn it-tim tiegħi ma tiddependix mir-riżultati.
messages.zh: 因为我对球队的忠诚不取决于比赛成绩。
messages.en: Because my loyalty to my team does not depend on the results.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象球队输了仍有人支持：这种持续支持的品质就是 fedeltà；记作名词“忠诚”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a system of government in which power is divided between a central government and constituent states or regions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与联邦体制有关的，即中央政府与组成联邦的州或地区分配权力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut ma' sistema ta' gvern li fiha s-setgħat jinqasmu bejn gvern ċentrali u l-istati jew ir-reġjuni li jiffurmaw il-federazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 联邦的；联邦制的；与联邦政府有关的。

formal.mt: F'sistema federali, il-kostituzzjoni tistabbilixxi kif jinqasmu s-setgħat bejn il-gvern ċentrali u l-istati.
formal.en: In a federal system, the constitution establishes how powers are divided between the central government and the states.
formal.zh: 在联邦体制下，宪法规定中央政府与各州之间如何分配权力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġifieri gvern federali? David: Huwa l-gvern ċentrali ta' federazzjoni, fejn l-istati għandhom ukoll setgħat tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does federal government mean? David: It is the central government of a federation, where the states also have powers of their own.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：联邦政府是什么意思？戴维：就是一个联邦的中央政府，其中各州也有自己的权限。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 联邦政府是什么意思？
messages.en: What does federal government mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-gvern ċentrali ta' federazzjoni, fejn l-istati għandhom ukoll setgħat tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-gvern ċentrali ta' federazzjoni, fejn l-istati għandhom ukoll setgħat tagħhom.
messages.zh: 就是一个联邦的中央政府，其中各州也有自己的权限。
messages.en: It is the central government of a federation, where the states also have powers of their own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画中央与各州分配权限的图，再把 federali 贴在“政府、体制”旁，记住它是形容词。

gloss_zh: 联邦主义者；联邦制支持者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supports a federal system of government.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持采用联邦政府体制的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappoġġja sistema federali ta' gvern.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 联邦主义者；支持联邦体制的人。

formal.mt: Bħala federalist, il-kelliem appoġġja t-tqassim tas-setgħat bejn il-gvern ċentrali u r-reġjuni.
formal.en: As a federalist, the speaker supported the division of powers between the central government and the regions.
formal.zh: 作为联邦主义者，发言人支持在中央政府与各地区之间分配权力。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Int federalist? Mark: Iva, nappoġġja sistema li tqassam is-setgħat bejn il-gvern ċentrali u r-reġjuni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you a federalist? Mark: Yes, I support a system that divides powers between the central government and the regions.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你是联邦主义者吗？马克：是的，我支持在中央政府与各地区之间分配权力的体制。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你是联邦主义者吗？
messages.en: Are you a federalist?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nappoġġja sistema li tqassam is-setgħat bejn il-gvern ċentrali u r-reġjuni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nappoġġja sistema li tqassam is-setgħat bejn il-gvern ċentrali u r-reġjuni.
messages.zh: 是的，我支持在中央政府与各地区之间分配权力的体制。
messages.en: Yes, I support a system that divides powers between the central government and the regions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 federalist 想成举着“支持联邦制”牌子的人；本条用作名词，记忆重点是支持这种体制的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Russian Federation, also called Russia, a country extending across Eastern Europe and North Asia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 俄罗斯联邦，也称俄罗斯，是横跨东欧和北亚的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Federazzjoni Russa, magħrufa wkoll bħala r-Russja, pajjiż li jestendi fl-Ewropa tal-Lvant u fl-Asja tat-Tramuntana.

sense_translations.en_definition: Russian Federation (synonym of Russia: a transcontinental country in Eastern Europe and North Asia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 俄罗斯联邦，俄罗斯的同义名称；横跨东欧和北亚的国家。

collocations.en: the map of the Russian Federation
the territory of the Russian Federation

formal.mt: Il-Federazzjoni Russa hija pajjiż li jestendi fl-Ewropa tal-Lvant u fl-Asja tat-Tramuntana.
formal.en: The Russian Federation is a country extending across Eastern Europe and North Asia.
formal.zh: 俄罗斯联邦是横跨东欧和北亚的国家。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hi l-Federazzjoni Russa fuq din il-mappa? Ben: Hawn, testendi mill-Ewropa tal-Lvant sal-Asja tat-Tramuntana.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the Russian Federation on this map? Ben: Here, it extends from Eastern Europe to North Asia.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这张地图上俄罗斯联邦在哪里？本：在这里，从东欧延伸到北亚。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-Federazzjoni Russa fuq din il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-Federazzjoni Russa fuq din il-mappa?
messages.zh: 这张地图上俄罗斯联邦在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the Russian Federation on this map?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn, testendi mill-Ewropa tal-Lvant sal-Asja tat-Tramuntana.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn, testendi mill-Ewropa tal-Lvant sal-Asja tat-Tramuntana.
messages.zh: 在这里，从东欧延伸到北亚。
messages.en: Here, it extends from Eastern Europe to North Asia.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Federazzjoni Russa 整体对应“俄罗斯联邦”，再用横跨东欧与北亚的地图轮廓帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something clear or understandable to someone by giving information or an explanation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过说明或讲解，使某人明白某件事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa ċara lil xi ħadd billi jagħti tagħrif jew spjegazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解释；讲解；向某人说明，使其理解。

collocations.en: he explained the rule to the students
collocations.zh: 他向学生解释了这条规则
他把一切都解释清楚了

formal.mt: L-għalliem fehhem il-proċedura lill-istudenti u ta eżempju għal kull pass.
formal.en: The teacher explained the procedure to the students and gave an example for each step.
formal.zh: 老师向学生讲解了操作流程，并为每个步骤举了例子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min fehhem din ir-regola lilek? Ben: L-għalliem fehhem kollox b'eżempju sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who explained this rule to you? Ben: The teacher explained everything with a simple example.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁给你讲解了这条规则？本：老师用一个简单的例子把一切都解释清楚了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 谁给你讲解了这条规则？
messages.en: Who explained this rule to you?

messages.speaker: Ben (学生)
messages.zh: 老师用一个简单的例子把一切都解释清楚了。
messages.en: The teacher explained everything with a simple example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师画图举例，学生终于明白：fehhem 就记成“把事情讲明白”，并一起记住向谁解释、解释什么。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who explains something so that others can understand it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过讲解帮助别人理解某件事的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tispjega xi ħaġa biex ħaddieħor jifhimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讲解者；负责解释某事的人。

formal.mt: Bħala fehiem paċenzjuż, Mark spjega kull pass lill-istudenti.
formal.en: As a patient explainer, Mark explained every step to the students.
formal.zh: 作为一名耐心的讲解者，马克向学生解释了每一个步骤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jista' jispjegali din ir-regola? Mark: Staqsi lil Pawlu; hu fehiem tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can explain this rule to me? Mark: Ask Pawlu; he's a good explainer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁能给我解释一下这条规则？马克：问保罗吧，他很会讲解。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 谁能给我解释一下这条规则？
messages.en: Who can explain this rule to me?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Pawlu; hu fehiem tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Pawlu; hu fehiem tajjeb.
messages.zh: 问保罗吧，他很会讲解。
messages.en: Ask Pawlu; he's a good explainer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位耐心讲解题目的同学，把 fehiem 记成负责解释的那个人。

gloss_zh: 解释性的；起说明作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Serving to explain something or make its meaning easier to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 起解释或说明作用，使某事的意思更容易理解的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jispjega xi ħaġa jew jagħmel it-tifsira tagħha aktar ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起解释、说明作用的。

formal.mt: It-test fehiemi taħt l-istampa jgħin lill-qarrej jifhem id-dettalji.
formal.en: The explanatory text below the picture helps the reader understand the details.
formal.zh: 图片下方的说明性文字帮助读者理解细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan it-test taħt l-istampa? Mark: Hu test fehiemi; jispjega x'qed jiġri.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this text below the picture? Mark: It's explanatory text; it explains what's happening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图片下面这段文字是什么？马克：是说明性文字，解释正在发生什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 图片下面这段文字是什么？
messages.en: What's this text below the picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu test fehiemi; jispjega x'qed jiġri.
messages.mt_standard: Hu test fehiemi; jispjega x'qed jiġri.
messages.zh: 是说明性文字，解释正在发生什么。
messages.en: It's explanatory text; it explains what's happening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到图下帮助理解的说明文字，就联想 fehiemi；它描述事物具有解释作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Understanding of something, or a person's particular way of viewing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事的理解，也可指一个人看待某事的观点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għarfien tat-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa, jew il-mod kif persuna taraha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理解；领会某事的意思或内容。
个人的观点；某人对事情的看法。

formal.mt: Fil-fehim tiegħi, l-eżempji jagħtu lill-istudenti fehim aktar ċar tar-regola.
formal.en: In my view, examples give students a clearer understanding of the rule.
formal.zh: 在我看来，例子能让学生更清楚地理解这条规则。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Issa għandek fehim ċar tar-regola? Mark: Iva. Fil-fehim tiegħi, l-aħħar eżempju kien l-aktar utli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a clear understanding of the rule now? Mark: Yes. In my view, the last example was the most useful.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你现在清楚理解这条规则了吗？马克：是的。在我看来，最后一个例子最有用。

messages.speaker: Maja (教师)
messages.zh: 你现在清楚理解这条规则了吗？
messages.en: Do you have a clear understanding of the rule now?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Fil-fehim tiegħi, l-aħħar eżempju kien l-aktar utli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Fil-fehim tiegħi, l-aħħar eżempju kien l-aktar utli.
messages.zh: 是的。在我看来，最后一个例子最有用。
messages.en: Yes. In my view, the last example was the most useful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fehim 连到中文的理解：既能表示已经弄懂，也能表示我个人怎样理解这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act dishonestly in order to gain an unfair advantage or deceive someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了获得不公平的优势或蒙骗别人而采取不诚实的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaġixxi b'mod diżonest biex jikseb vantaġġ mhux ġust jew iqarraq b'xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作弊；以不诚实的方式谋取好处或欺骗别人。

formal.mt: L-istudent ammetta li fejjet fl-eżami billi kkopja t-tweġibiet.
formal.en: The student admitted that he had cheated in the exam by copying the answers.
formal.zh: 这名学生承认，他在考试中抄答案作弊。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaft tilgħab ma' Pawlu? Mark: Għax fejjet fil-logħba; ħares lejn il-karti tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you stop playing with Pawlu? Mark: Because he cheated in the game; he looked at my cards.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不和保罗继续玩了？马克：因为他在游戏中作弊，偷看了我的牌。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不和保罗继续玩了？
messages.en: Why did you stop playing with Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fejjet fil-logħba; ħares lejn il-karti tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fejjet fil-logħba; ħares lejn il-karti tiegħi.
messages.zh: 因为他在游戏中作弊，偷看了我的牌。
messages.en: Because he cheated in the game; he looked at my cards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人偷看对手的牌，被指出 fejjet；把这个词和违反公平规则的作弊行为相连。

gloss_zh: 有用者；有益者；帮得上忙者

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone or something that is useful, beneficial, or helpful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有用、能带来益处或提供帮助的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li tkun utli, ġġib ġid jew tagħti għajnuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有用者；具有实际用处的人或事物。
有益者；能带来好处的人或事物。
帮得上忙者；能提供帮助的人或事物。

collocations.en: a helpful person in the group

collocations.zh: 能为社区带来益处的人

formal.mt: Bħala fejjied għall-komunità, Pawlu jagħti l-ħin tiegħu biex jgħin lill-ġirien.
formal.en: As someone who benefits the community, Pawlu gives his time to help his neighbours.
formal.zh: 作为一名能为社区带来益处的人，保罗抽出时间帮助邻居。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jista' jgħinna norganizzaw il-laqgħa? Mark: Staqsi lil Pawlu; hu fejjied fil-grupp u jaf jorganizza tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can help us organise the meeting? Mark: Ask Pawlu; he's a helpful person in the group and knows how to organise things well.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁能帮我们组织这次会议？马克：问保罗吧，他在小组里帮得上忙，也很会组织事情。

messages.speaker: Maja (小组成员)
messages.zh: 谁能帮我们组织这次会议？
messages.en: Who can help us organise the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Pawlu; hu fejjied fil-grupp u jaf jorganizza tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Pawlu; hu fejjied fil-grupp u jaf jorganizza tajjeb.
messages.zh: 问保罗吧，他在小组里帮得上忙，也很会组织事情。
messages.en: Ask Pawlu; he's a helpful person in the group and knows how to organise things well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用有用、带来益处、帮得上忙三个角度记 fejjied，想象小组里总能贡献帮助的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who treats illness or injury or helps someone regain health.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为他人治疗疾病、处理伤痛或帮助其恢复健康的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tittratta l-mard jew il-ġrieħi u tgħin lil ħaddieħor jerġa' jikseb saħħtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 治疗疾病或帮助他人恢复健康的人；治疗者。

collocations.en: to seek help from a healer

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi fejjieq tradizzjonali li kien jilqa' għandu lin-nies tar-raħal.
formal.en: The story describes a traditional healer who used to receive the people of the village.
formal.zh: 这篇故事描写了一位接待村民的传统治疗者。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min hu dak ir-raġel fl-istorja? Pawlu: Huwa fejjieq; in-nies imorru għandu biex jgħinhom ifiqu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who is that man in the story? Pawlu: He is a healer; people go to him for help getting better.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：故事里的那个男人是谁？保罗：他是一位治疗者，人们找他帮助自己恢复健康。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man in the story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa fejjieq; in-nies imorru għandu biex jgħinhom ifiqu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa fejjieq; in-nies imorru għandu biex jgħinhom ifiqu.
messages.zh: 他是一位治疗者，人们找他帮助自己恢复健康。
messages.en: He is a healer; people go to him for help getting better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fejjieq 放进人物卡片：画一个帮助病人康复的人，记住它指治疗者这个人。

gloss_zh: 有疗效的；具有疗愈作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having properties that help wounds heal or help health improve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有帮助伤口愈合或促进健康恢复的作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu proprjetajiet li jgħinu l-ġrieħi jfiqu jew is-saħħa titjieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有治疗、促进愈合或帮助康复的作用的。

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jiddeskrivi l-prodott bħala żejt fejjieqi għall-ġilda.
formal.en: The leaflet describes the product as an oil with healing properties for the skin.
formal.zh: 说明单将该产品描述为一种对皮肤具有疗愈作用的油。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jgħid il-fuljett dwar dan iż-żejt? Mark: Jgħid li huwa żejt fejjieqi għall-ġilda.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the leaflet say about this oil? Mark: It says it is an oil with healing properties for the skin.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：说明单怎么介绍这种油？马克：上面说它是一种对皮肤具有疗愈作用的油。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 说明单怎么介绍这种油？
messages.en: What does the leaflet say about this oil?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħid li huwa żejt fejjieqi għall-ġilda.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħid li huwa żejt fejjieqi għall-ġilda.
messages.zh: 上面说它是一种对皮肤具有疗愈作用的油。
messages.en: It says it is an oil with healing properties for the skin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fejjieqi 写在药油瓶旁，记成有疗愈作用的；与指人的 fejjieq 配对区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who acts dishonestly or breaks rules to gain an unfair advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过不诚实的行为或违反规则来获得不公平优势的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqarraq jew tikser ir-regoli biex tikseb vantaġġ inġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作弊、耍诈以取得不公平优势的人。

formal.mt: L-organizzatur neħħa lill-fejjiet mill-kompetizzjoni wara li nstab li kien kiser ir-regoli apposta.
formal.en: The organizer removed the cheater from the competition after it was found that he had deliberately broken the rules.
formal.zh: 查明该作弊者故意违反规则后，组织者取消了他的参赛资格。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma tridx tilgħab miegħu? Toni: Għax huwa fejjiet; dejjem iħares lejn il-karti tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why don't you want to play with him? Toni: Because he is a cheater; he always looks at my cards.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么不想和他玩？托尼：因为他是个作弊者，总是偷看我的牌。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不想和他玩？
messages.en: Why don't you want to play with him?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa fejjiet; dejjem iħares lejn il-karti tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa fejjiet; dejjem iħares lejn il-karti tiegħi.
messages.zh: 因为他是个作弊者，总是偷看我的牌。
messages.en: Because he is a cheater; he always looks at my cards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象牌桌旁有人偷看别人的牌，给这个人贴上 fejjiet 标签，记住它指作弊的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involving dishonest conduct intended to gain an unfair advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及为取得不公平优势而采取的不诚实行为的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi qerq biex jinkiseb vantaġġ inġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有作弊或耍诈性质的；通过不诚实手段谋取优势的。

formal.mt: Ir-regolament jipprojbixxi kull aġir fejjieti waqt il-kompetizzjoni.
formal.en: The regulations prohibit all cheating behavior during the competition.
formal.zh: 规则禁止比赛期间的一切作弊行为。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nħares lejn il-karti tiegħek qabel nagħżel? Ben: Le, dak ikun aġir fejjieti!
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I look at your cards before I choose? Ben: No, that would be cheating behavior!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我能先看看你的牌再选吗？本：不能，那样就是作弊了！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nħares lejn il-karti tiegħek qabel nagħżel?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nħares lejn il-karti tiegħek qabel nagħżel?
messages.zh: 我能先看看你的牌再选吗？
messages.en: Can I look at your cards before I choose?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 不能，那样就是作弊了！
messages.en: No, that would be cheating behavior!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 aġir fejjieti 整块记忆为作弊行为；fejjieti 在这里负责描述行为的性质。

gloss_zh: 康复；康复期的休养；治愈

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or result of becoming healthy again after illness or injury, including the period of convalescence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 患病或受伤后重新恢复健康的过程或结果，也可指康复期间的休养。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ir-riżultat ta' meta persuna terġa' tikseb saħħitha wara marda jew korriment, inkluż iż-żmien ta' mistrieħ meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 患病或受伤后健康状况的恢复；康复。
病后或伤后逐渐恢复体力与健康的休养过程；康复期的休养。
疾病或伤患得到治愈；恢复健康的结果。

formal.mt: Wara l-operazzjoni, il-pazjent kellu bżonn perjodu ta' fejqan qabel ma seta' jerġa' lura għax-xogħol.
formal.en: After the operation, the patient needed a period of convalescence before he could return to work.
formal.zh: 手术后，这位患者需要休养一段时间才能重返工作岗位。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif sejjer ħuk wara l-operazzjoni? Luqa: Il-fejqan miexi tajjeb, imma għadu jeħtieġ jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is your brother doing after the operation? Luqa: His recovery is going well, but he still needs to rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你哥哥手术后怎么样？卢卡：康复进展很好，不过他还需要休息。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥手术后怎么样？
messages.en: How is your brother doing after the operation?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fejqan miexi tajjeb, imma għadu jeħtieġ jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Il-fejqan miexi tajjeb, imma għadu jeħtieġ jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 康复进展很好，不过他还需要休息。
messages.en: His recovery is going well, but he still needs to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条从生病、休养到恢复健康的时间线，把 fejqan 写在整条线上，串起康复、休养和治愈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dishonest conduct or rule-breaking used to obtain an unfair advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了获得不公平优势而进行的欺骗或违反规则的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qerq jew ksur tar-regoli biex jinkiseb vantaġġ inġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作弊或耍诈的行为，即以不诚实手段取得不公平优势。

formal.mt: L-iskola tqis il-fejt fl-eżami bħala ksur serju tar-regoli.
formal.en: The school regards cheating in an examination as a serious breach of the rules.
formal.zh: 学校将考试作弊视为严重违反规则的行为。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex waqqaft il-logħba? David: Għax kien hemm il-fejt; xi ħadd biddel il-karti bil-moħbi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did you stop the game? David: Because there was cheating; someone secretly switched the cards.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么把游戏停了？戴维：因为有人作弊，偷偷换了牌。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把游戏停了？
messages.en: Why did you stop the game?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien hemm il-fejt; xi ħadd biddel il-karti bil-moħbi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien hemm il-fejt; xi ħadd biddel il-karti bil-moħbi.
messages.zh: 因为有人作弊，偷偷换了牌。
messages.en: Because there was cheating; someone secretly switched the cards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张卡片区分：fejjiet 是作弊者，fejjieti 描述作弊性质，fejt 指作弊这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant known as rue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为芸香的一种植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bl-isem Ingliż rue.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芸香，植物名称。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw pjanta tal-fejġel u pinġew il-weraq tagħha.
formal.en: The students observed a rue plant and drew its leaves.
formal.zh: 学生观察了一株芸香，并画下它的叶子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Mark: Din pjanta tal-fejġel. Ejja nħarsu lejn il-weraq tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this plant called? Mark: This is a rue plant. Let's look at its leaves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种植物叫什么？马克：这是一株芸香。我们看看它的叶子吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's this plant called?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din pjanta tal-fejġel. Ejja nħarsu lejn il-weraq tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Din pjanta tal-fejġel. Ejja nħarsu lejn il-weraq tagħha.
messages.zh: 这是一株芸香。我们看看它的叶子吧。
messages.en: This is a rue plant. Let's look at its leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在想象中的植物标签上并排写下 fejġel、rue、芸香，用同一株植物串起三种语言。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small radish; the diminutive form of fiġel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小萝卜；fiġel 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fiġel żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' fiġel.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small radish (the diminutive form of 'fiġel')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小萝卜；是 fiġel 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small radish in the salad

formal.mt: Għall-insalata, aħsel fejġla friska u qattagħha f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: For the salad, wash a fresh small radish and cut it into small pieces.
formal.zh: 制作沙拉时，洗净一颗新鲜的小萝卜，再把它切成小块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid fejġla fl-insalata? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Qattagħha f'biċċiet żgħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a small radish in the salad? Mark: Yes, please. Cut it into small pieces.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：沙拉里要加一颗小萝卜吗？马克：要，谢谢。把它切成小块吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 沙拉里要加一颗小萝卜吗？
messages.en: Would you like a small radish in the salad?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Qattagħha f'biċċiet żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Qattagħha f'biċċiet żgħar.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。把它切成小块吧。
messages.en: Yes, please. Cut it into small pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fiġel 旁边画一颗更小的萝卜并标上 fejġla，用大小对照记住这里的指小意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To injure a limb by twisting a joint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因关节受到扭转而使肢体受伤；扭伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iweġġa' parti minn driegħ jew riġel billi jdawwar ġog b'mod ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扭伤手臂、腿等肢体的关节部位。
关节受到扭转而造成的损伤；扭伤。

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, l-atleta fekk l-għaksa tal-lemin u waqaf jiġri.
formal.en: During training, the athlete sprained his right ankle and stopped running.
formal.zh: 训练时，这名运动员扭伤了右脚踝，随即停止跑步。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex Mark ma ġiex jilgħab? Samwel: Fekk l-għaksa lbieraħ, u llum qed jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why didn't Mark come to play? Samwel: He sprained his ankle yesterday, and he is resting today.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克为什么没来玩？萨姆韦尔：他昨天扭伤了脚踝，今天正在休息。

messages.speaker: Rita (队友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么没来玩？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark come to play?

messages.speaker: Samwel (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fekk l-għaksa lbieraħ, u llum qed jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Fekk l-għaksa lbieraħ, u llum qed jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 他昨天扭伤了脚踝，今天正在休息。
messages.en: He sprained his ankle yesterday, and he is resting today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚踝突然扭了一下：fekk 可记动作扭伤，也可记名词扭伤；用句中位置判断词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause a sprain in a limb by twisting a joint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因关节扭转而使手臂、腿等肢体发生扭伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iweġġa' ġog f'driegħ jew f'riġel billi jdawru b'mod ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扭伤手臂、腿等肢体的关节部位。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żelaq fuq l-art imxarrba u fekkek il-polz meta waqa'.
formal.en: The worker slipped on the wet floor and sprained his wrist when he fell.
formal.zh: 这名工人在湿滑的地面上滑倒，摔倒时扭伤了手腕。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'ġara lil ħuk waqt il-logħba? Ġorġ: Fekkek l-għaksa meta niżel wara qabża.
colloquial.en: Elena: What happened to your brother during the game? Ġorġ: He sprained his ankle when he landed after a jump.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你哥哥比赛时怎么了？乔治：他跳起落地时扭伤了脚踝。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥比赛时怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your brother during the game?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fekkek l-għaksa meta niżel wara qabża.
messages.mt_standard: Fekkek l-għaksa meta niżel wara qabża.
messages.zh: 他跳起落地时扭伤了脚踝。
messages.en: He sprained his ankle when he landed after a jump.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fekkek l-għaksa 与 fekkek il-polz 配成两幅动作图，分别记住扭伤脚踝和扭伤手腕。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who causes a sprain, an injury to a joint such as a wrist or ankle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使关节扭伤的人，例如造成别人手腕或脚踝扭伤的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jofloq ġog, bħall-polz jew l-għaksa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人扭伤的人；造成扭伤者。

collocations.en: someone who causes a wrist sprain
someone who causes a sprain during play
collocations.zh: 在玩耍中使人扭伤的人

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'fekkiek' tirreferi għall-persuna li kkawżat it-tifliq tal-polz.
formal.en: In the exercise, the word 'fekkiek' refers to the person who caused the wrist sprain.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，fekkiek 指造成手腕扭伤的那个人。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi jfisser 'fekkiek' hawn? Pawlu: Il-persuna li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jofloq ġog, pereżempju l-polz.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does 'fekkiek' mean here? Pawlu: The person who causes someone to sprain a joint, such as the wrist.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这里的 fekkiek 是什么意思？保罗：指使别人关节扭伤的人，例如使别人手腕扭伤的人。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 fekkiek 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'fekkiek' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-persuna li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jofloq ġog, pereżempju l-polz.
messages.mt_standard: Il-persuna li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jofloq ġog, pereżempju l-polz.
messages.zh: 指使别人关节扭伤的人，例如使别人手腕扭伤的人。
messages.en: The person who causes someone to sprain a joint, such as the wrist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fekkiek 配上“有人把别人手腕扭伤”的人物画面，重点记住它指造成扭伤的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of causing a sprain in a limb or joint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使肢体或关节扭伤的作用或力量的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-qawwa jikkawża tifliq f'xi ġog jew parti minn driegħ jew riġel.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the power to sprain (limbs etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够使肢体等部位扭伤的；具有造成扭伤的力量的。

collocations.en: a movement capable of causing a sprain
pulling capable of causing a sprain

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju, il-ġbid huwa deskritt bħala fekkieki għax jista' jikkawża tifliq fil-polz.
formal.en: In the example, the pulling is described as capable of causing a sprain because it can sprain the wrist.
formal.zh: 在例句中，拉扯被形容为 fekkieki，因为它可能使手腕扭伤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ktieb isejjaħ dan il-moviment 'fekkieki'? Mark: Għax jista' jġiegħlek tofloq ġog.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the book call this movement 'fekkieki'? Mark: Because it can make you sprain a joint.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：书里为什么把这个动作称为 fekkieki？马克：因为它可能使你的关节扭伤。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 书里为什么把这个动作称为 fekkieki？
messages.en: Why does the book call this movement 'fekkieki'?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 因为它可能使你的关节扭伤。
messages.en: Because it can make you sprain a joint.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给危险的拉扯动作贴上 fekkieki 标签，记成“这个动作具有使人扭伤的力量”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tortoise: a reptile with a hard shell that lives on land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 陆龟，一种主要在陆地生活、身体有坚硬甲壳的爬行动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rettili li jgħix fuq l-art u għandu qoxra iebsa li tipproteġi ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陆龟；生活在陆地上的龟。
无赖；品行卑劣的人，用作贬斥人的称呼。

formal.mt: Il-fekrun jgħix fuq l-art, u l-qoxra iebsa tiegħu tgħinu jipproteġi ġismu.
formal.en: The tortoise lives on land, and its hard shell helps protect its body.
formal.zh: 陆龟生活在陆地上，坚硬的甲壳有助于保护它的身体。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara, hemm fekrun ħdejn il-borma! David: Rajtu! Ejja nħalluh jgħaddi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look, there's a tortoise next to the plant pot! David: I see it! Let's let it pass.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看，花盆旁边有一只陆龟！戴维：看到了！让它过去吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，花盆旁边有一只陆龟！
messages.en: Look, there's a tortoise next to the plant pot!

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了！让它过去吧。
messages.en: I see it! Let's let it pass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 fekrun 和“花园里背着硬壳的陆龟”配图记忆；另设人物卡记“无赖”义，靠上下文区分。

gloss_zh: 使卷曲；种植红椒；红椒、红辣椒；辣椒属植物

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something curl, especially hair; in another verb sense, to grow red peppers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物卷曲，尤其指使头发卷曲；另一个动词义是种植红椒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa, speċjalment ix-xagħar, innukklata; f'tifsira oħra, ikabbar il-bżar aħmar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使卷曲；使形成卷状。
种植红椒。
红椒；红色的椒类果实。
红辣椒。
辣椒属植物，或其椒类果实。

collocations.zh: 他把自己的头发弄卷了

collocations.en: red pepper growing in the garden

formal.mt: Fis-sentenza 'Hu felfel xagħru', 'felfel' huwa verb li jfisser li għamel xagħru nnukklat; fil-frażi 'felfel frisk', huwa nom li jirreferi għall-bżar aħmar.
formal.en: In the sentence 'He curled his hair', 'felfel' is a verb meaning that he made his hair curly; in the phrase 'fresh red pepper', it is a noun referring to red pepper.
formal.zh: 在“他把自己的头发弄卷了”这句话中，felfel 是表示使头发卷曲的动词；在“新鲜红椒”这个短语中，它是指红椒的名词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna felfel għas-soppa? Toni: Iva, hemm ftit fil-friġġ. Trid inqattgħu?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have red pepper for the soup? Toni: Yes, there's some in the fridge. Shall I chop it?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们有做汤用的红椒吗？托尼：有，冰箱里有一些。要我把它切碎吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我们有做汤用的红椒吗？
messages.en: Do we have red pepper for the soup?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ftit fil-friġġ. Trid inqattgħu?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ftit fil-friġġ. Trid inqattgħu?
messages.zh: 有，冰箱里有一些。要我把它切碎吗？
messages.en: Yes, there's some in the fridge. Shall I chop it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 felfel 建两幅学习图：镜子前卷头发，菜园里种红椒；再把红椒图片标为名词，分别记住词性和词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strand or small lock of hair that curls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一根或一小绺呈卷曲形状的头发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Troffa żgħira jew ftit xagħar li jieħu forma nnukklata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一根卷曲的头发；一绺卷发。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher felful ta' xagħar ħdejn il-widna tat-tifel.
formal.en: The photograph shows a curly strand of hair beside the boy's ear.
formal.zh: 照片中可以看到男孩耳边的一绺卷发。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi felful ħdejn widinti li dejjem joħroġ. Marija: Ħallih hekk, jidher sabiħ!
colloquial.en: Sara: I have a curl beside my ear that always sticks out. Marija: Leave it like that, it looks nice!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我耳边有一绺卷发，总是翘出来。玛丽亚：就让它这样吧，挺好看的！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi felful ħdejn widinti li dejjem joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi felful ħdejn widinti li dejjem joħroġ.
messages.zh: 我耳边有一绺卷发，总是翘出来。
messages.en: I have a curl beside my ear that always sticks out.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 就让它这样吧，挺好看的！
messages.en: Leave it like that, it looks nice!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从整头头发中挑出一绺小卷，把这一绺标作 felful，记住它是可以单独指出的卷发。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A curl of hair worn or hanging over the forehead.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 垂在额头上或梳在额前的一绺卷发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nokkla jew troffa żgħira ta' xagħar fuq il-ġbin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 额前的一绺卷发，英语中也称作 kiss-me-quick。

formal.mt: Fil-pittura, it-tifla għandha felfula fuq il-ġbin u żigarella f'xagħarha.
formal.en: In the painting, the girl has a curl on her forehead and a ribbon in her hair.
formal.zh: 画中的女孩额前留着一绺卷发，头发上系着一条丝带。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Il-felfula tiegħi qiegħda sew? Rita: Iva, eżatt fuq il-ġbin. Tmisshiex aktar!
colloquial.en: Elena: Is my forehead curl sitting properly? Rita: Yes, right on your forehead. Don't touch it again!
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我额前的这绺卷发弄好了吗？丽塔：好了，正好在额头上。别再碰它啦！

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 我额前的这绺卷发弄好了吗？
messages.en: Is my forehead curl sitting properly?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, eżatt fuq il-ġbin. Tmisshiex aktar!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, eżatt fuq il-ġbin. Tmisshiex aktar!
messages.zh: 好了，正好在额头上。别再碰它啦！
messages.en: Yes, right on your forehead. Don't touch it again!

cognitive_memory_aid: 在人物额头上画一绺弯弯的小卷，旁边写 felfula；用“额前位置”帮助区别一般的一绺卷发。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Curly, describing hair that forms curls rather than lying straight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容头发呈卷曲状的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xagħar li jkun innukklat u mhux lixx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷曲的，指人的头发。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-karattru ssemmi għajnejn kannella u xagħar iswed u felfuli.
formal.en: The character description mentions brown eyes and black, curly hair.
formal.zh: 人物描写提到了棕色的眼睛和黑色的卷发。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xagħrek felfuli ħafna llum! Ben: Iva, ħallejtu jinxef waħdu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Your hair is really curly today! Ben: Yes, I let it dry on its own.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你今天的头发好卷啊！本：是啊，我让它自然干的。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天的头发好卷啊！
messages.en: Your hair is really curly today!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我让它自然干的。
messages.en: Yes, I let it dry on its own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xagħar felfuli 整组读成“卷曲的头发”，看见一头小卷时就用 felfuli 描述它的样子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go back on an agreement; in another sense, to make a mistake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不履行已经达成的约定；另一个义项是犯错或判断失误。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jżommx ma' ftehim li jkun għamel; f'tifsira oħra, jiżbalja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 违背已达成的协议；不履行约定。
犯错；出差错；判断失误。

collocations.en: he went back on his agreement after giving his word
collocations.zh: 他作出承诺后又反悔了

collocations.en: he made an error in the calculation

formal.mt: Kien hemm ftehim bil-miktub, iżda wieħed mill-parteċipanti fellaq u ma wettaqx dak li kien wiegħed.
formal.en: There was a written agreement, but one of the participants reneged and did not carry out what he had promised.
formal.zh: 双方已有书面约定，但其中一名参与者违约，没有履行自己的承诺。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Pawlu kien wiegħed li jgħinna, hux? Luqa: Iva, imma fellaq. Issa rridu nagħmlu kollox aħna.
colloquial.en: Marta: Pawlu had promised to help us, hadn't he? Luqa: Yes, but he went back on it. Now we have to do everything ourselves.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗原先答应过要帮我们，对吧？卢卡：是啊，可他反悔了。现在所有事情都得我们自己做。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu kien wiegħed li jgħinna, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu kien wiegħed li jgħinna, hux?
messages.zh: 保罗原先答应过要帮我们，对吧？
messages.en: Pawlu had promised to help us, hadn't he?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma fellaq. Issa rridu nagħmlu kollox aħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma fellaq. Issa rridu nagħmlu kollox aħna.
messages.zh: 是啊，可他反悔了。现在所有事情都得我们自己做。
messages.en: Yes, but he went back on it. Now we have to do everything ourselves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fellaq 配两张情境卡：答应后反悔是“违约”，算题算错是“出错”；用约定或计算的上下文选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who examines something carefully to check its condition or detect problems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仔细查看某物，以检查其状况或发现问题的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li teżamina xi ħaġa bir-reqqa biex tiċċekkja l-kundizzjoni tagħha jew issib problemi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 检查、查看某物的人；检查者。
执行检查的；担任检查者的。
除虱的；从人或动物身上清除虱子的。

formal.mt: Il-fellej eżamina l-merkanzija qabel ma ġiet aċċettata fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The inspector examined the goods before they were accepted into the warehouse.
formal.zh: 检查者在货物获准入库之前检查了货物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jiċċekkja dawn il-kaxxi? Mark: Il-fellej ġej dalgħodu biex jeżaminahom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will check these boxes? Mark: The inspector is coming this morning to examine them.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁来检查这些箱子？Mark：检查者今天上午会过来查看。

messages.speaker: Maja (仓库员工)
messages.zh: 谁来检查这些箱子？
messages.en: Who will check these boxes?

messages.speaker: Mark (仓库主管)
messages.zh: 检查者今天上午会过来查看。
messages.en: The inspector is coming this morning to examine them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fellej 配上拿放大镜仔细查看的人的画面，先记名词“检查者”；形容词另记“检查的”和“除虱的”，不要混成一个词性。

gloss_zh: 失言出丑；处理不当；驾驶不稳；自慰

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an embarrassing mistake in what one says or does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在言语或行为中犯下令人尴尬的错误，因而失言或出丑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel żball imbarazzanti f'dak li jgħid jew jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失言；做出失礼或令人尴尬的举动。
把某事处理得不好；管理不善。

sense_translations.en_definition: to steer a plough or a boat unsteadily
sense_translations.zh_definition: 操纵犁或驾驶船只时方向不稳，摇摆偏斜。
自慰；刺激自己的生殖器以获得性快感。

collocations.en: made a gaffe during a speech

formal.mt: Il-kelliem fellek meta ħabbar l-isem ħażin waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The speaker made a gaffe when he announced the wrong name during the ceremony.
formal.zh: 发言人在典礼上报错了名字，闹出了尴尬。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Pawlu fellek waqt il-laqgħa? Sara: Iva, sejjaħ lid-direttur bl-isem ħażin.
colloquial.en: Lina: Did Pawlu make a gaffe during the meeting? Sara: Yes, he called the director by the wrong name.
colloquial.zh: Lina：Pawlu 在会上失言了吗？Sara：是啊，他把主任的名字叫错了。

messages.speaker: Lina (同事)
messages.zh: Pawlu 在会上失言了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu make a gaffe during the meeting?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 是啊，他把主任的名字叫错了。
messages.en: Yes, he called the director by the wrong name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“会上叫错名字，船上方向摇摆”两个画面记住 fellek 的不同义项；“处理不当”和“自慰”各设独立词义卡，不强行串成同一种意思。

gloss_zh: 掌舵不稳的人；操纵方向不稳的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who steers unsteadily and does not maintain a consistent course.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 操纵方向时不稳定、不能保持平稳路线的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi b'mod mhux sod u ma żżommx direzzjoni stabbli.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who is an unsteady steerer
sense_translations.zh_definition: 掌舵或操纵方向不稳的人。

collocations.en: an unsteady steerer on a boat

collocations.zh: 缺乏经验、操纵方向不稳的人

formal.mt: L-għalliem baqa' ħdejn il-felliek biex jgħinu jżomm id-dgħajsa fuq rotta dritta.
formal.en: The instructor stayed beside the unsteady steerer to help him keep the boat on a straight course.
formal.zh: 教练留在这位掌舵不稳的人身边，帮助他让船保持直线航行。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex sejjaħtlu felliek? Nina: Għax meta jmexxi d-dgħajsa, imur darba lejn ix-xellug u darba lejn il-lemin.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you call him an unsteady steerer? Nina: Because when he steers the boat, he goes left one moment and right the next.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你为什么说他是个掌舵不稳的人？Nina：因为他开船时一会儿往左，一会儿往右。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个掌舵不稳的人？
messages.en: Why did you call him an unsteady steerer?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax meta jmexxi d-dgħajsa, imur darba lejn ix-xellug u darba lejn il-lemin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax meta jmexxi d-dgħajsa, imur darba lejn ix-xellug u darba lejn il-lemin.
messages.zh: 因为他开船时一会儿往左，一会儿往右。
messages.en: Because when he steers the boat, he goes left one moment and right the next.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把船开成左右摇摆的曲线，把 felliek 贴在这个人身上：这是指人的名词，记作“掌舵不稳者”。

gloss_zh: 掌舵不稳的；操纵方向不稳的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who steers unsteadily rather than maintaining a consistent course.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人掌舵或操纵方向不稳定，不能保持平稳路线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jmexxi b'mod mhux sod u ma jżommx direzzjoni stabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容掌舵或操纵方向不稳的人；掌舵不稳的。

formal.mt: It-tmunier fellieki kellu bżonn aktar taħriġ biex iżomm id-dgħajsa fuq rotta dritta.
formal.en: The unsteady helmsman needed more training to keep the boat on a straight course.
formal.zh: 这位掌舵不稳的舵手需要更多训练，才能让船保持直线航行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tmunier il-ġdid hu fellieki? Toni: Iva, għadu jdur wisq lejn ix-xellug u lejn il-lemin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the new helmsman steer unsteadily? Toni: Yes, he still turns too far to the left and right.
colloquial.zh: Maja：新来的舵手掌舵不稳吗？Toni：是啊，他还是会往左往右转得太多。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 新来的舵手掌舵不稳吗？
messages.en: Does the new helmsman steer unsteadily?

messages.speaker: Toni (水手)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu jdur wisq lejn ix-xellug u lejn il-lemin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu jdur wisq lejn ix-xellug u lejn il-lemin.
messages.zh: 是啊，他还是会往左往右转得太多。
messages.en: Yes, he still turns too far to the left and right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记 felliek“掌舵不稳的人”和 fellieki“掌舵不稳的”；给后者配上 tmunier，让词组直接呈现形容词修饰人的用法。

gloss_zh: 打楔者；铸币者；产出一窝小鸡

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who inserts wedges to hold objects in position or force them apart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把楔子插入物体之间，使其固定或分开的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ddaħħal feles bejn oġġetti biex iżżommhom f'posthom jew tifridhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 插入楔子的人；打楔者。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who mints or coins money
sense_translations.zh_definition: 制造或铸造钱币的人；铸币者。
产出或繁育出一窝小鸡；产雏。

collocations.en: a skilled person who inserts wedges

formal.mt: Il-fellies daħħal feles tal-injam taħt il-bieb biex iżommu miftuħ.
formal.en: The person inserting the wedge placed a wooden wedge under the door to hold it open.
formal.zh: 打楔者在门下塞入一块木楔，使门保持敞开。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'jagħmel fellies tal-muniti? Pawlu: Jagħmel il-muniti; hawnhekk il-kelma tfisser persuna li taħdem fil-produzzjoni tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does a coin minter do? Pawlu: He makes coins; here the word means a person who works in their production.
colloquial.zh: Lina：铸币者做什么工作？Pawlu：制造钱币；这里这个词指从事钱币生产的人。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 铸币者做什么工作？
messages.en: What does a coin minter do?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jagħmel il-muniti; hawnhekk il-kelma tfisser persuna li taħdem fil-produzzjoni tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Jagħmel il-muniti; hawnhekk il-kelma tfisser persuna li taħdem fil-produzzjoni tagħhom.
messages.zh: 制造钱币；这里这个词指从事钱币生产的人。
messages.en: He makes coins; here the word means a person who works in their production.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fellies 画三张独立小卡：手里拿楔子的人、制造钱币的人、一窝小鸡；用场景区分词义，不把这些画面当作词源解释。

gloss_zh: 插楔的；繁殖力强的；即将孵化的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person or action that inserts wedges.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或动作正在插入楔子、进行打楔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna jew azzjoni li ddaħħal il-feles.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 插入楔子的；进行打楔的。
繁殖力强的；多产的。
即将孵化的；快要出壳的。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem felliesi daħħal il-feles b'attenzjoni biex iżomm l-oġġett f'postu.
formal.en: The worker inserting wedges placed them carefully to hold the object in position.
formal.zh: 打楔的工人小心地插入楔子，使物体固定在原位。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-bajd felliesi? Toni: Iva, il-flieles dalwaqt joħorġu minnu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are these eggs about to hatch? Toni: Yes, the chicks will soon come out of them.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这些蛋快要孵化了吗？Toni：是啊，小鸡很快就会从里面出来。

messages.speaker: Sara (养鸡学徒)
messages.zh: 这些蛋快要孵化了吗？
messages.en: Are these eggs about to hatch?

messages.speaker: Toni (养鸡人)
messages.zh: 是啊，小鸡很快就会从里面出来。
messages.en: Yes, the chicks will soon come out of them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 felliesi 放进三个词组记忆：工人正在打楔、动物繁殖力强、蛋快要出壳；每次先看被描述的对象，再选择对应的中文义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fetters or shackles used to restrain a person's movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 限制人行动的镣铐，尤其指束缚肢体的用具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mezzi ta' rbit li jżommu l-idejn jew is-saqajn marbuta u jillimitaw il-moviment ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镣铐；脚镣等限制肢体活动的束缚用具。

formal.mt: Fil-vetrina tal-mużew hemm felq tal-ħadid flimkien ma' deskrizzjoni tal-użu tiegħu.
formal.en: The museum display case contains iron shackles together with a description of their use.
formal.zh: 博物馆的展柜里陈列着铁镣铐，并附有用途说明。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu dak fil-vetrina? Maja: Dak hu felq tal-ħadid, biex jorbot l-idejn jew is-saqajn.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is that in the display case? Maja: Those are iron shackles, for binding hands or feet.
colloquial.zh: Mark：展柜里的那是什么？Maja：那是铁镣铐，用来束缚手或脚。

messages.speaker: Mark (参观者)
messages.zh: 展柜里的那是什么？
messages.en: What is that in the display case?

messages.speaker: Maja (讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu felq tal-ħadid, biex jorbot l-idejn jew is-saqajn.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu felq tal-ħadid, biex jorbot l-idejn jew is-saqajn.
messages.zh: 那是铁镣铐，用来束缚手或脚。
messages.en: Those are iron shackles, for binding hands or feet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 felq 写在镣铐示意图旁，再配上 bil-felq“被镣铐锁住”的场景；用限制行动的具体画面记住它。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wart or verruca: a small raised growth on the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疣，即皮肤表面出现的小型隆起赘生物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkabbir żgħir u mqabbeż fuq il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疣；皮肤上的疣状赘生物，也可指跖疣。

formal.mt: Waqt il-konsultazzjoni, il-pazjent staqsa lit-tabib dwar il-felul fuq idu.
formal.en: During the consultation, the patient asked the doctor about the warts on his hand.
formal.zh: 就诊时，患者向医生询问了自己手上疣的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għandi felul fuq idi u rrid nistaqsi dwaru. Sara: Tista' turih lit-tabib waqt l-appuntament.
colloquial.en: Lina: I have warts on my hand and want to ask about them. Sara: You can show them to the doctor during your appointment.
colloquial.zh: Lina：我手上长了疣，想问问是怎么回事。Sara：你就诊时可以给医生看看。

messages.speaker: Lina (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi felul fuq idi u rrid nistaqsi dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi felul fuq idi u rrid nistaqsi dwaru.
messages.zh: 我手上长了疣，想问问是怎么回事。
messages.en: I have warts on my hand and want to ask about them.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你就诊时可以给医生看看。
messages.en: You can show them to the doctor during your appointment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 felul 与“手上或脚上的小疣”画面绑定，再读 felul fuq l-id；注意它指皮肤上的疣，与 felq“镣铐”分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Qualities or ways of expressing oneself associated with being feminine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与女性化形象或表达方式相关的气质和特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwalitajiet jew modi ta' espressjoni marbuta ma' dak li jitqies femminili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女性气质；女性特质。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddiskuti kif persuni differenti jesprimu l-femminilità tagħhom permezz tal-ilbies u tal-arti.
formal.en: The article discusses how different people express their femininity through clothing and art.
formal.zh: 这篇文章探讨不同的人如何通过服饰与艺术表达自己的女性气质。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'taħseb dwar din il-libsa? Lara: Togħġobni. Jekk tħoss li tesprimi l-femminilità tiegħek, ilbisha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you think of this dress? Lara: I like it. If you feel it expresses your femininity, wear it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得这条裙子怎么样？拉拉：我喜欢。如果你觉得它能表达你的女性气质，就穿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得这条裙子怎么样？
messages.en: What do you think of this dress?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Togħġobni. Jekk tħoss li tesprimi l-femminilità tiegħek, ilbisha.
messages.mt_standard: Togħġobni. Jekk tħoss li tesprimi l-femminilità tiegħek, ilbisha.
messages.zh: 我喜欢。如果你觉得它能表达你的女性气质，就穿吧。
messages.en: I like it. If you feel it expresses your femininity, wear it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“用服饰表达女性气质”的画面里，记住它说的是气质与表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A set of ideas and a movement supporting women's rights and equality between genders.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持女性权利、主张不同性别之间平等的思想与运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' ideat u moviment favur id-drittijiet tan-nisa u l-ugwaljanza bejn il-ġeneri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女性主义；争取女性权利与性别平等的思想和运动。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni teżamina r-rabta bejn il-femminiżmu u t-talba għal opportunitajiet indaqs fl-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The lesson examines the connection between feminism and the demand for equal opportunities in education.
formal.zh: 这节课考察女性主义与争取平等教育机会之间的联系。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fuq xiex inhu l-ktieb li qed taqra? Nina: Fuq il-femminiżmu u d-drittijiet tan-nisa.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is the book you are reading about? Nina: Feminism and women's rights.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你正在读的书讲什么？妮娜：讲女性主义和女性权利。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex inhu l-ktieb li qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex inhu l-ktieb li qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你正在读的书讲什么？
messages.en: What is the book you are reading about?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 讲女性主义和女性权利。
messages.en: Feminism and women's rights.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想一本讨论女性平等权利的书，把本词与“女性主义思想和运动”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 传统游戏中把物体滚向标记的玩家

teaching_sense.en_definition: A player in a traditional game who rolls an object towards a target mark.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在一种传统游戏中负责把物体滚向目标标记的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parteċipant f'logħba tradizzjonali li jgerbeb oġġett lejn marka.

sense_translations.en_definition: a person who rolls sth. towards a mark (used in the context of a traditional game)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物滚向标记的人，指传统游戏中的相应玩家。

collocations.en: an experienced player who rolls towards the mark
collocations.zh: 经验丰富的滚物瞄标玩家

collocations.en: the role of the player who rolls towards the mark

formal.mt: F'din il-logħba tradizzjonali, il-fenditur jgerbeb l-oġġett lejn il-marka.
formal.en: In this traditional game, the designated player rolls the object towards the mark.
formal.zh: 在这项传统游戏中，滚物瞄标的玩家把物体滚向标记。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min se jkun il-fenditur din id-darba? Pawlu: Jien. Se ngerbeb l-oġġett lejn dik il-marka.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who will roll towards the mark this time? Pawlu: I will. I will roll the object towards that mark.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这次谁来当滚物瞄标的玩家？保罗：我来。我会把物体滚向那个标记。

messages.speaker: Mark (游戏同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun il-fenditur din id-darba?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun il-fenditur din id-darba?
messages.zh: 这次谁来当滚物瞄标的玩家？
messages.en: Who will roll towards the mark this time?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (游戏同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Se ngerbeb l-oġġett lejn dik il-marka.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Se ngerbeb l-oġġett lejn dik il-marka.
messages.zh: 我来。我会把物体滚向那个标记。
messages.en: I will. I will roll the object towards that mark.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象传统游戏中一人瞄准地面标记滚动物体，记住本词指那位玩家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stew made with rabbit meat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以兔肉为主要食材炖制的菜肴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stuffat magħmul bil-laħam tal-fenek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 炖兔肉；兔肉炖菜。

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' filgħaxija tħejjiet fenkata, li ġiet servuta mal-ħobż.
formal.en: Rabbit stew was prepared for the evening meal and served with bread.
formal.zh: 晚餐准备了炖兔肉，并配面包上桌。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'se nieklu llejla? Marija: Se nsajjar fenkata. Trid tgħinni?
colloquial.en: Anna: What are we having tonight? Marija: I am going to cook rabbit stew. Do you want to help me?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今晚我们吃什么？玛丽亚：我准备做炖兔肉。你想帮我吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (女儿)
messages.zh: 今晚我们吃什么？
messages.en: What are we having tonight?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 我准备做炖兔肉。你想帮我吗？
messages.en: I am going to cook rabbit stew. Do you want to help me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词卡配上一盘热腾腾的兔肉炖菜，看到本词就回想餐桌上的炖兔肉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who hunts rabbits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以兔子为狩猎对象的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikkaċċja l-fniek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猎兔者；捕猎兔子的人。

formal.mt: L-awtur intervista fenkunier b'esperjenza biex jiddeskrivi l-attività tal-kaċċa għall-fniek.
formal.en: The author interviewed an experienced rabbit hunter to describe rabbit hunting.
formal.zh: 作者采访了一位经验丰富的猎兔者，以介绍猎兔活动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak ir-raġel huwa sajjied? Toni: Le, huwa fenkunier; jikkaċċja l-fniek.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is that man a fisherman? Toni: No, he is a rabbit hunter; he hunts rabbits.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个人是渔夫吗？托尼：不是，他是猎兔者，捕猎兔子。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个人是渔夫吗？
messages.en: Is that man a fisherman?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，他是猎兔者，捕猎兔子。
messages.en: No, he is a rabbit hunter; he hunts rabbits.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人物卡上写着“猎兔者”，用人物与兔子的画面记住本词指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A barrier around an area, or an area enclosed by such a barrier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围住某一区域的栏障，也可指由栏障围起的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilqugħ li jdawwar post, jew il-post magħluq b'dan l-ilqugħ.
