sense_translations.zh_definition: 围栏；围障；围起的场地或区域。

formal.mt: Tqiegħed fens madwar il-ġnien biex it-tfal ma joħorġux fit-triq.
formal.en: A fence was installed around the garden to keep the children from going out into the road.
formal.zh: 花园周围安装了围栏，防止孩子们跑到马路上。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-qsari? Rita: Ħdejn il-fens, imma ħalli l-bieb ħieles.
colloquial.en: Ben: Where should I put these plant pots? Rita: Next to the fence, but keep the gate clear.
colloquial.zh: 本：这些花盆放在哪里？丽塔：放在围栏旁边，但别挡住门。

messages.speaker: Ben (邻居)
messages.zh: 这些花盆放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these plant pots?

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-fens, imma ħalli l-bieb ħieles.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-fens, imma ħalli l-bieb ħieles.
messages.zh: 放在围栏旁边，但别挡住门。
messages.en: Next to the fence, but keep the gate clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借助英语 fence 的相似拼写来记忆，再想象围栏把花园围成一个区域。

gloss_zh: 飘动；焦急不安；心悸；勉强维持生命

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flutter; also to be anxious, to palpitate when referring to the heart, or to cling on to life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指轻快地飘动或扑动；也可表示焦急不安、心脏急跳，或勉强维持生命。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiċċaqlaq b'movimenti ħfief u mgħaġġla; ukoll li jkun anzjuż, li l-qalb tħabbat malajr, jew li jibqa' jitħabat biex jgħix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 飘动；轻快地扑动
焦急；感到不安
心悸；心脏急促跳动
勉强维持生命；挣扎着活下去

collocations.en: a flag fluttering in the wind

formal.mt: Il-bandiera bdiet tferfer fir-riħ hekk kif id-delegazzjoni waslet quddiem il-bini.
formal.en: The flag began to flutter in the wind as the delegation arrived in front of the building.
formal.zh: 代表团抵达大楼前时，旗帜开始在风中飘动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qalbi bdiet tferfer qabel l-intervista. Samwel: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda ftit waqt li nistennew.
colloquial.en: Nina: My heart started racing before the interview. Samwel: Let's sit down for a bit while we wait.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：面试前我的心开始怦怦直跳。萨姆韦尔：我们等的时候先坐一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (求职者)
messages.zh: 面试前我的心开始怦怦直跳。
messages.en: My heart started racing before the interview.

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda ftit waqt li nistennew.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda ftit waqt li nistennew.
messages.zh: 我们等的时候先坐一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let's sit down for a bit while we wait.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四格图记 ferfer：旗帜飘动、人物焦急、心脏急跳、生命挣扎。四格分别对应四义，不把记忆画面当作词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To do something in a hurry or act rashly without enough consideration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 匆匆忙忙地做某事，或未经充分考虑就轻率行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel xi ħaġa bl-għaġla jew mingħajr ma jaħseb biżżejjed qabel jaġixxi.

sense_translations.en_definition: to do sth. hurriedly or rashly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 匆忙或轻率地做某事

formal.mt: L-impjegat ferfex fit-tħejjija tar-rapport u bagħtu qabel ma ċċekkja ċ-ċifri.
formal.en: The employee rushed the preparation of the report and sent it before checking the figures.
formal.zh: 这名员工匆忙准备报告，未核对数字就将其发出。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex hemm daqshekk żbalji fir-rapport? David: Bdejt inferfex biex inlestih malajr, u ma ċċekkjajtx kollox.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are there so many mistakes in the report? David: I started rushing to finish it quickly, and I didn't check everything.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：报告里为什么有这么多错误？戴维：我急着把它做完，开始赶工，没有把所有内容都检查一遍。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 报告里为什么有这么多错误？
messages.en: Why are there so many mistakes in the report?

messages.speaker: David (报告撰写者)
messages.mt_spoken: Bdejt inferfex biex inlestih malajr, u ma ċċekkjajtx kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Bdejt inferfex biex inlestih malajr, u ma ċċekkjajtx kollox.
messages.zh: 我急着把它做完，开始赶工，没有把所有内容都检查一遍。
messages.en: I started rushing to finish it quickly, and I didn't check everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ferfex 时想象“报告还没核对就按发送”：重点是匆忙或轻率地做事，把这个词贴在动作旁记忆。

gloss_zh: 引起躁动或不安的事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that causes agitation, restlessness, or unease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人躁动、坐立不安或心绪不宁的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tqanqal aġitazzjoni jew nuqqas ta' kwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起躁动、不安或激动的事物

collocations.en: a source of agitation for the students
collocations.zh: 使学生们躁动不安的事物

formal.mt: L-istorbju kontinwu mill-kuritur kien ferfier għall-istudenti waqt il-qari fis-skiet.
formal.en: The constant noise from the corridor was a source of agitation for the students during silent reading.
formal.zh: 默读期间，走廊里持续的噪声使学生们心绪不宁。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dak il-ħoss huwa ferfier għalija; ma nistax nikkonċentra. Toni: Nagħlaq il-bieb biex ikun hawn aktar kwiet.
colloquial.en: Rita: That noise is a source of agitation for me; I can't concentrate. Toni: I'll close the door so it's quieter in here.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那个声音弄得我心烦，没法集中注意力。托尼：我把门关上，让这里安静一些。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-ħoss huwa ferfier għalija; ma nistax nikkonċentra.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-ħoss huwa ferfier għalija; ma nistax nikkonċentra.
messages.zh: 那个声音弄得我心烦，没法集中注意力。
messages.en: That noise is a source of agitation for me; I can't concentrate.

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħlaq il-bieb biex ikun hawn aktar kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħlaq il-bieb biex ikun hawn aktar kwiet.
messages.zh: 我把门关上，让这里安静一些。
messages.en: I'll close the door so it's quieter in here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferfier 写在令人心烦的噪声图标下面：记住它是造成躁动的“事物”，而不是躁动这个状态本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A type of wind vane made from reeds, used to show the direction of the wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种用芦苇制作、用来显示风向的风向标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' indikatur tad-direzzjoni tar-riħ magħmul mill-qasab.

sense_translations.en_definition: type of wind-vane made of reeds
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种用芦苇制作的风向标

collocations.en: a wind vane on the roof

formal.mt: L-istudenti poġġew ferfiera tal-qasab fuq il-bejt biex josservaw id-direzzjoni tar-riħ.
formal.en: The students placed a reed wind vane on the roof to observe the direction of the wind.
formal.zh: 学生们把一个芦苇制风向标放在屋顶上，以观察风向。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhi dik fuq il-bejt? Ġorġ: Dik ferfiera tal-qasab; turi minn fejn ġej ir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Lina: What's that on the roof? Ġorġ: That's a reed wind vane; it shows where the wind is coming from.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：屋顶上那个是什么？乔治：那是芦苇制风向标，能显示风从哪个方向吹来。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 屋顶上那个是什么？
messages.en: What's that on the roof?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ferfiera tal-qasab; turi minn fejn ġej ir-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Dik ferfiera tal-qasab; turi minn fejn ġej ir-riħ.
messages.zh: 那是芦苇制风向标，能显示风从哪个方向吹来。
messages.en: That's a reed wind vane; it shows where the wind is coming from.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“屋顶、芦苇、风向箭头”三幅小图记 ferfiera：既记住它是风向标，也记住材料是芦苇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing the heart to beat quickly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某种事物或情境会使人的心跳加快。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lill-qalb tħabbat malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使心脏快速跳动的；令人心跳加快的

collocations.en: a moment that makes the heart race
a sound that makes the heart race

formal.mt: L-aħħar minuta tal-partita kienet mument ferfieri għall-partitarji, li stennew ir-riżultat b'tensjoni kbira.
formal.en: The final minute of the match was a heart-racing moment for the supporters, who awaited the result with great tension.
formal.zh: 比赛的最后一分钟令球迷们心跳加快，他们十分紧张地等待结果。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dak kien mument ferfieri; qalbi għadha tħabbat malajr! Ben: Tiegħi wkoll, speċjalment meta l-ballun laqat il-lasta.
colloquial.en: Anna: That was a heart-racing moment; my heart is still beating fast! Ben: Mine too, especially when the ball hit the post.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：刚才那一刻真让人心跳加快，我的心现在还跳得很快！本：我也是，尤其是球撞到门柱的时候。

messages.speaker: Anna (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kien mument ferfieri; qalbi għadha tħabbat malajr!
messages.mt_standard: Dak kien mument ferfieri; qalbi għadha tħabbat malajr!
messages.zh: 刚才那一刻真让人心跳加快，我的心现在还跳得很快！
messages.en: That was a heart-racing moment; my heart is still beating fast!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiegħi wkoll, speċjalment meta l-ballun laqat il-lasta.
messages.mt_standard: Tiegħi wkoll, speċjalment meta l-ballun laqat il-lasta.
messages.zh: 我也是，尤其是球撞到门柱的时候。
messages.en: Mine too, especially when the ball hit the post.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferfieri 写在比赛最后一秒的画面旁，配上快速心跳的图标：它形容“使心跳加快的”时刻或事物。

gloss_zh: 轻率的人；做事急躁的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who acts rashly or hastily, often without enough thought.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指行动轻率或做事急躁、往往没有充分考虑的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taġixxi bl-għaġla jew bla ma taħseb biżżejjed.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who is rash or hasty
sense_translations.zh_definition: 行事轻率或急躁的人

collocations.en: someone who is rash in making decisions
to act like a rash or hasty person
collocations.zh: 像个冒失的人那样行事

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kap tat-tim huwa ferfiex li jieħu deċiżjonijiet qabel ma jisma' l-pariri tal-oħrajn.
formal.en: In the story, the team leader is a rash person who makes decisions before listening to other people's advice.
formal.zh: 故事中的队长是个轻率的人，尚未听取别人的建议就作出决定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark diġà ordna l-mejda mingħajr ma kejjel il-kamra. Luqa: Kemm hu ferfiex! Issa jrid jara jekk tidħolx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Mark has already ordered the table without measuring the room. Luqa: What a rash person! Now he has to see whether it will fit.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克还没量房间就已经订了桌子。卢卡：他可真冒失！现在还得看看桌子能不能放进去。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark diġà ordna l-mejda mingħajr ma kejjel il-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Mark diġà ordna l-mejda mingħajr ma kejjel il-kamra.
messages.zh: 马克还没量房间就已经订了桌子。
messages.en: Mark has already ordered the table without measuring the room.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu ferfiex! Issa jrid jara jekk tidħolx.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu ferfiex! Issa jrid jara jekk tidħolx.
messages.zh: 他可真冒失！现在还得看看桌子能不能放进去。
messages.en: What a rash person! Now he has to see whether it will fit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“没量房间就买桌子的人”记 ferfiex：把词贴在人物身上，记住这是指轻率、急躁之人的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hasty, disorderly, or rash in the way someone acts or does things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人做事仓促、缺乏条理，或未经充分考虑就冒然行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaġixxi bl-għaġla, mingħajr ordni jew mingħajr ma jaħseb biżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仓促的；急急忙忙而未充分斟酌的
杂乱的；做事缺乏条理的
冒失的；未考虑后果便行动的

collocations.en: to work hastily and without order
collocations.zh: 仓促而缺乏条理地工作

formal.mt: L-assistent kien ferfiexi fit-tħejjija tar-rapport u bagħtu qabel ma ċċekkja ċ-ċifri.
formal.en: The assistant was hasty in preparing the report and sent it before checking the figures.
formal.zh: 助理准备报告时过于仓促，还没核对数字就发了出去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex bgħatt il-formola mingħajr ma qrajtha? Mark: Kont ferfiexi; issa nerġa' niċċekkjaha bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you send the form without reading it? Mark: I was hasty; now I'll check it again calmly.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：你怎么没看就把表格发出去了？马克：我太仓促了；现在我会静下心来重新检查。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex bgħatt il-formola mingħajr ma qrajtha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex bgħatt il-formola mingħajr ma qrajtha?
messages.zh: 你怎么没看就把表格发出去了？
messages.en: Why did you send the form without reading it?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont ferfiexi; issa nerġa' niċċekkjaha bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Kont ferfiexi; issa nerġa' niċċekkjaha bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 我太仓促了；现在我会静下心来重新检查。
messages.en: I was hasty; now I'll check it again calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人急着交作业，桌面杂乱，还没检查就交卷；用这一画面串起“仓促、杂乱、冒失”三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rapid, light movement such as fluttering or flapping, or the fast beating of the heart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指轻而快速的飘动或扑动，也可指心脏快速跳动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċaqliq ħafif u mgħaġġel, bħal dak ta' drapp jew ġwienaħ, jew taħbit mgħaġġel tal-qalb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻快的飘动；颤动
翅膀等的扑动；拍动
心脏快速跳动；心跳加速

collocations.en: the fast beating of the heart
the fluttering of the curtain in the wind

formal.mt: L-osservatur innota l-ferfir tal-ġwienaħ qabel ma l-għasfur telaq mill-fergħa.
formal.en: The observer noted the flapping of the wings before the bird left the branch.
formal.zh: 观察者注意到，鸟儿离开树枝前先扑动了翅膀。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss ħdejn it-tieqa? Pawlu: Huwa l-ferfir tal-ġwienaħ ta' għasfur.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's that sound near the window? Pawlu: It's the flapping of a bird's wings.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：窗边是什么声音？保罗：是鸟儿扑动翅膀的声音。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 窗边是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound near the window?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 是鸟儿扑动翅膀的声音。
messages.en: It's the flapping of a bird's wings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把飘动的窗帘、扑动的鸟翅和紧张时急跳的心放在一起记：这个名词说的是快速反复的动静。

gloss_zh: 紧张不安的人；随风飘动的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: A nervous or anxious person; also, something that flutters in the wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指容易紧张、焦虑不安的人；也可指在风中飘动的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna nervuża jew anzjuża; ukoll, xi ħaġa li tferfer fir-riħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧张不安的人；焦虑的人
在风中飘动的东西

collocations.en: a nervous person before an exam

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-protagonist huwa ferfur li jinkwieta dwar kull bidla fil-pjan.
formal.en: In the story, the protagonist is an anxious person who worries about every change in the plan.
formal.zh: 故事中的主人公是个焦虑不安的人，计划稍有变化就会担心。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tistaqsi l-istess ħaġa daqshekk drabi? Ninu: Illum jien ferfur; qed ninkwieta dwar l-intervista.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you asking the same thing so many times? Ninu: I'm a bundle of nerves today; I'm worried about the interview.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么把同一件事问了这么多遍？尼努：我今天紧张得很，正担心面试呢。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tistaqsi l-istess ħaġa daqshekk drabi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tistaqsi l-istess ħaġa daqshekk drabi?
messages.zh: 你怎么把同一件事问了这么多遍？
messages.en: Why are you asking the same thing so many times?

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum jien ferfur; qed ninkwieta dwar l-intervista.
messages.mt_standard: Illum jien ferfur; qed ninkwieta dwar l-intervista.
messages.zh: 我今天紧张得很，正担心面试呢。
messages.en: I'm a bundle of nerves today; I'm worried about the interview.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记名词：一个人紧张得坐立不安，一条丝带在风里不停飘动；分别对应人物义和物件义。

gloss_zh: 被贬称为性行为放纵的女人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A derogatory term for a woman judged to be sexually promiscuous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对被认为性行为放纵的女性的贬称，带有道德评判和侮辱意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma dispreġġjattiva għal mara meqjusa li għandha ħafna sħab sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被认为性行为放纵的女人；带贬义的称呼

collocations.en: to call her a loose woman
collocations.zh: 贬称她为性行为放纵的女人

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tal-ġrajja, il-kelma 'ferfura' turi l-ġudizzju dispreġġjattiv tal-kelliem dwar il-ħajja sesswali tal-mara.
formal.en: In the analysis of the story, the word 'ferfura' reveals the speaker's disparaging judgment of the woman's sexual life.
formal.zh: 在对故事的分析中，ferfura 一词体现了说话者对该女性性生活的贬损性评判。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fil-ġrajja, għaliex isejħulha ferfura? Rita: Għax qed jiġġudikaw il-ħajja sesswali tagħha; hija tikketta offensiva.
colloquial.en: Maja: In the story, why do they call her a loose woman? Rita: Because they're judging her sexual life; it's an offensive label.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：故事里，他们为什么叫她“放荡女人”？丽塔：因为他们在评判她的性生活；这是一个冒犯性的标签。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 故事里，他们为什么叫她“放荡女人”？
messages.en: In the story, why do they call her a loose woman?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed jiġġudikaw il-ħajja sesswali tagħha; hija tikketta offensiva.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed jiġġudikaw il-ħajja sesswali tagħha; hija tikketta offensiva.
messages.zh: 因为他们在评判她的性生活；这是一个冒犯性的标签。
messages.en: Because they're judging her sexual life; it's an offensive label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词记在“故事人物使用的贬义标签”一栏：涉及对女性性行为的评判，不能当成中性的人物描述。

gloss_zh: 焦虑不安的；容易慌乱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Anxious or easily made flustered and ill at ease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人焦虑不安，或稍受影响便容易慌乱、感到不自在。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun anzjuż jew li jitħawwad u jħossu skomdu malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 焦虑的；忐忑不安的
容易慌乱的；容易感到窘迫或不自在的

collocations.zh: 焦虑而容易慌乱的学生

collocations.en: to remain anxious or ill at ease

formal.mt: L-istudent kien ferfuri waqt il-preżentazzjoni u tħawwad meta sema' l-ewwel mistoqsija.
formal.en: The student was anxious during the presentation and became flustered when he heard the first question.
formal.zh: 这名学生做展示时焦虑不安，听到第一个问题便慌了神。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għadek ferfuri dwar il-laqgħa? Mark: Iva, nitħawwad malajr meta jkolli nitkellem quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you still anxious about the meeting? Mark: Yes, I get flustered easily when I have to speak in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你还在为会议感到不安吗？马克：是的，一要在大家面前讲话，我就很容易慌。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 你还在为会议感到不安吗？
messages.en: Are you still anxious about the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nitħawwad malajr meta jkolli nitkellem quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nitħawwad malajr meta jkolli nitkellem quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 是的，一要在大家面前讲话，我就很容易慌。
messages.en: Yes, I get flustered easily when I have to speak in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象上台前反复捏讲稿、被提问就慌神的学生；这个形容词把“内心焦虑”和“容易失措”连起来。

gloss_zh: 冒失的人；急性子；做事无条理的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who acts rashly or hastily, or does things in a disorderly way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指行事冒失、急于行动，或做事杂乱无章的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taġixxi bla ħsieb jew bl-għaġla, jew li tagħmel l-affarijiet mingħajr ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒失的人；不考虑后果就行动的人
急性子；行事仓促的人
做事杂乱无章的人；缺乏条理的人

collocations.en: to behave like a rash or hasty person
collocations.zh: 表现得像个冒失鬼或急性子

collocations.en: a hasty person who checks nothing
collocations.zh: 什么都不检查的冒失鬼

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-ferfux jibda x-xogħol mingħajr pjan u jħalli l-għodod imxerrda mal-kamra.
formal.en: In the story, the disorderly person starts work without a plan and leaves the tools scattered around the room.
formal.zh: 故事里，这个做事无条理的人毫无计划地开工，还把工具散落得满屋都是。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tmurx taqsam it-triq mingħajr ma tħares! Pawlu: Għandek raġun, illum qed inġib ruħi ta' ferfux.
colloquial.en: Rita: Don't cross the road without looking! Pawlu: You're right, I'm behaving like a rash fool today.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：别不看路就过马路！保罗：你说得对，我今天做事像个冒失鬼。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmurx taqsam it-triq mingħajr ma tħares!
messages.mt_standard: Tmurx taqsam it-triq mingħajr ma tħares!
messages.zh: 别不看路就过马路！
messages.en: Don't cross the road without looking!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, illum qed inġib ruħi ta' ferfux.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, illum qed inġib ruħi ta' ferfux.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我今天做事像个冒失鬼。
messages.en: You're right, I'm behaving like a rash fool today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给“还没想好就冲出去、东西也收不齐”的人物贴一张学习标签：ferfux 是指这种人的名词。

gloss_zh: 冒失的；仓促的；缺乏条理的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rash or hasty in action, or disorganised in the way things are done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容行动冒失或仓促，或处理事情缺乏组织和条理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaġixxi bla ħsieb jew bl-għaġla, jew li ma jkunx organizzat f'dak li jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒失的；行动前欠缺考虑的
仓促的；急于行动的
缺乏组织的；做事没有条理的

collocations.en: to work in a hasty or disorganised way

formal.mt: L-impjegat kien ferfuxi fit-tqassim tal-fajls, u diversi dokumenti spiċċaw fil-post ħażin.
formal.en: The employee was disorganised when sorting the files, and several documents ended up in the wrong place.
formal.zh: 这名员工整理文件时缺乏条理，结果好几份文件都放错了位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġejt il-biljetti? Mark: Ma nafx; kont ferfuxi meta ppakkjajt u issa rrid infittex fil-basktijiet kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you put the tickets? Mark: I don't know; I was disorganised when I packed, and now I have to search all the bags.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：你把票放哪儿了？马克：不知道；我收拾行李时乱七八糟，现在得把所有包都翻一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (旅伴)
messages.zh: 你把票放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the tickets?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; kont ferfuxi meta ppakkjajt u issa rrid infittex fil-basktijiet kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; kont ferfuxi meta ppakkjajt u issa rrid infittex fil-basktijiet kollha.
messages.zh: 不知道；我收拾行李时乱七八糟，现在得把所有包都翻一遍。
messages.en: I don't know; I was disorganised when I packed, and now I have to search all the bags.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想赶车时胡乱装包、把车票塞得找不到的状态；用 ferfuxi 形容人的仓促、冒失和无条理。

gloss_zh: 树枝；伸缩钓竿细软的末端

teaching_sense.en_definition: A branch of a tree, or the thin, flexible end of a telescopic fishing rod.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指树的枝条；也指伸缩式钓竿最末端细而有弹性的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti ta' siġra li toħroġ miz-zokk jew minn parti oħra; ukoll, it-tarf irqiq u flessibbli ta' qasba tas-sajd teleskopika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 树枝；枝条

sense_translations.en_definition: the thin, flexible end of a telescopic fishing rod
sense_translations.zh_definition: 伸缩式钓竿细而柔韧的末端；竿梢

collocations.en: the thin, flexible tip of the fishing rod

formal.mt: Qabel l-użu, għandu jiġi ċċekkjat il-fergħ tal-qasba tas-sajd teleskopika biex jiġi żgurat li ma jkunx maqsum.
formal.en: Before use, the thin, flexible tip of the telescopic fishing rod should be checked to ensure that it is not split.
formal.zh: 使用前应检查伸缩式钓竿细软的竿梢，确保其没有开裂。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu l-fergħ tal-qasba? Toni: Huwa t-tarf irqiq u flessibbli tagħha; ara kif jitgħawweġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's the 'fergħ' of the rod? Toni: It's its thin, flexible tip; look how it bends.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：钓竿的 fergħ 是什么？托尼：就是细而柔韧的竿梢；看，它能这样弯曲。

messages.speaker: Lara (钓鱼初学者)
messages.zh: 钓竿的 fergħ 是什么？
messages.en: What's the 'fergħ' of the rod?

messages.speaker: Toni (钓鱼伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa t-tarf irqiq u flessibbli tagħha; ara kif jitgħawweġ.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa t-tarf irqiq u flessibbli tagħha; ara kif jitgħawweġ.
messages.zh: 就是细而柔韧的竿梢；看，它能这样弯曲。
messages.en: It's its thin, flexible tip; look how it bends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象细长的树枝和能弯曲的钓竿梢，帮助记住两个具体义项；钓竿义专指伸缩竿细软的末端。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of hurting, wounding, or injuring someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伤害他人、使人出现伤口或受到损伤的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tweġġa' lil xi ħadd jew tikkawżalu ġerħa jew ħsara f'ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伤害；使人疼痛或受到损害的行为。
致伤；使人身上出现伤口的行为。
使人受伤；造成身体损伤的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' feriment waqt ġlieda bejn żewġ persuni.
formal.en: The report describes a case of injury being inflicted during a fight between two people.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起两人打斗过程中发生的伤人事件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waslet il-pulizija? Mark: Qed jinvestigaw każ ta' feriment; raġel weġġa' waqt ġlieda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why have the police arrived? Mark: They're investigating a case of injury being inflicted; a man was hurt during a fight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：警察为什么来了？马克：他们正在调查一起伤人事件，有个男人在打斗中受了伤。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 警察为什么来了？
messages.en: Why have the police arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jinvestigaw każ ta' feriment; raġel weġġa' waqt ġlieda.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jinvestigaw każ ta' feriment; raġel weġġa' waqt ġlieda.
messages.zh: 他们正在调查一起伤人事件，有个男人在打斗中受了伤。
messages.en: They're investigating a case of injury being inflicted; a man was hurt during a fight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 feriment 时把注意力放在造成伤害这件事上；与表示具体伤口的 ferita 对照学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wound in the body, or an emotional hurt caused by something such as an insult.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体上的伤口，也可指侮辱等造成的情感伤害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġerħa fil-ġisem, jew weġgħa fis-sentimenti kkawżata, pereżempju, minn insult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伤口；身体组织受到损伤后形成的创口。

sense_translations.en_definition: a hurt (also emotional, as in an insult)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 伤痛；也指情感上的创伤，例如受到侮辱后产生的痛苦。

formal.mt: Fil-kitba tagħha, l-awtriċi tiddeskrivi l-insult bħala ferita li damet ħafna biex tfiq.
formal.en: In her writing, the author describes the insult as a wound that took a long time to heal.
formal.zh: 作者在文中把那次侮辱描述为一道很久才愈合的心灵伤口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi ferita żgħira f'idi. Mark: Kif ġrat? Maja: Qtajt idi waqt li kont inqatta' l-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Maja: I have a small wound on my hand. Mark: How did it happen? Maja: I cut my hand while slicing bread.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我手上有个小伤口。马克：怎么弄的？玛雅：切面包的时候割到手了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我手上有个小伤口。
messages.en: I have a small wound on my hand.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么弄的？
messages.en: How did it happen?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qtajt idi waqt li kont inqatta' l-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Qtajt idi waqt li kont inqatta' l-ħobż.
messages.zh: 切面包的时候割到手了。
messages.en: I cut my hand while slicing bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferita 想成一道需要愈合的伤口：它既能在手上，也能比喻留在心里的伤痛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stir or move coal or other fuel with a poker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用拨火棍翻动或拨动煤炭等燃料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħawwad jew iċċaqlaq il-faħam jew fjuwil ieħor b'ħadida biex tqalleb in-nar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to stir coal or other fuel using a poker
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用拨火棍拨动煤炭或其他燃料。

collocations.en: stirred the coal with a poker
stirred the fuel in the fireplace with a poker
collocations.zh: 用拨火棍拨动了壁炉里的燃料

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ferken il-faħam fil-forn b'ħadida twila sabiex l-arja tgħaddi aħjar bejn il-biċċiet.
formal.en: The worker stirred the coal in the furnace with a long poker so that air could pass more easily between the pieces.
formal.zh: 工人用长拨火棍翻动炉中的煤炭，使空气更容易从煤块之间通过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex in-nar qabad aħjar issa? Mark: Pawlu ferken il-faħam b'dik il-ħadida twila.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the fire burning better now? Mark: Pawlu stirred the coal with that long poker.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：火现在怎么烧得更旺了？马克：保罗用那根长拨火棍拨了拨煤炭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 火现在怎么烧得更旺了？
messages.en: Why is the fire burning better now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ferken il-faħam b'dik il-ħadida twila.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ferken il-faħam b'dik il-ħadida twila.
messages.zh: 保罗用那根长拨火棍拨了拨煤炭。
messages.en: Pawlu stirred the coal with that long poker.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ferken 时想象长拨火棍伸进炉中拨动煤块，抓住工具、燃料和拨动三个画面要素。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scrape the ground, or to carry out work in a disorderly way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刮动、刨动地面；也指做事杂乱无章。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tobrox wiċċ l-art, jew tagħmel ix-xogħol bla ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮地；刨动地面。

sense_translations.en_definition: to perform one's work in a disorderly fashion
sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂乱无章地工作；做事缺乏条理。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, is-serduk ferkex l-art b'saqajh u kixef xi żrieragħ.
formal.en: During the observation, the rooster scraped the ground with its feet and uncovered some seeds.
formal.zh: 观察过程中，公鸡用脚刨动地面，翻出了一些种子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-mejda kollha karti u għodod? Mark: Pawlu ferkex fix-xogħol u ħalla kollox imħawwad.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the table covered in papers and tools? Mark: Pawlu worked in a disorderly way and left everything in a mess.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桌上怎么全是纸和工具？马克：保罗干活没条理，把东西都弄乱了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-mejda kollha karti u għodod?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-mejda kollha karti u għodod?
messages.zh: 桌上怎么全是纸和工具？
messages.en: Why is the table covered in papers and tools?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ferkex fix-xogħol u ħalla kollox imħawwad.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ferkex fix-xogħol u ħalla kollox imħawwad.
messages.zh: 保罗干活没条理，把东西都弄乱了。
messages.en: Pawlu worked in a disorderly way and left everything in a mess.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记 ferkex：公鸡刨地，工人乱做事；分别对应地面动作和工作方式。

gloss_zh: 杂乱无章的；混乱的；慌乱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Disorderly, confused, or flustered and unable to act calmly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏条理、思绪混乱，或慌乱得无法从容做事的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla ordni, konfuż, jew aġitat u ma jafx minn fejn se jibda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂乱无章的；做事或表现缺乏秩序的。
混乱的；思路不清、弄不清情况的。
慌乱的；焦躁得手忙脚乱的。

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, il-koordinatur deher ferkiexi u ħallat id-dati ta' żewġ attivitajiet.
formal.en: During the meeting, the coordinator appeared confused and mixed up the dates of two activities.
formal.zh: 会议期间，协调员显得思绪混乱，把两项活动的日期弄混了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tidher ferkiexi, Mark. X'ġara? Mark: Ma nistax insib iċ-ċwievet u diġà wasal il-ħin biex nitlaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: You look flustered, Mark. What happened? Mark: I can't find my keys, and it's already time to leave.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克，你看起来慌慌张张的，怎么了？马克：我找不到钥匙，而且已经到出门的时间了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 马克，你看起来慌慌张张的，怎么了？
messages.en: You look flustered, Mark. What happened?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax insib iċ-ċwievet u diġà wasal il-ħin biex nitlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax insib iċ-ċwievet u diġà wasal il-ħin biex nitlaq.
messages.zh: 我找不到钥匙，而且已经到出门的时间了。
messages.en: I can't find my keys, and it's already time to leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前找不到钥匙的人：东西乱、脑子乱、动作慌，用这幅画面串起 ferkiexi 的三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who does their work in a disorderly way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 工作缺乏条理、干活时把事情或物品弄得杂乱的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel ix-xogħol tagħha bla ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做事杂乱无章的工人；干活缺乏条理的人。

collocations.en: a disorderly worker on the job
collocations.zh: 工作时做事没条理的人

collocations.en: to work like a disorderly worker

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-mastrudaxxa huwa deskritt bħala ferkux li jħalli l-għodod imxerrdin mal-ħanut tax-xogħol.
formal.en: In the story, the carpenter is described as a disorderly worker who leaves tools scattered around the workshop.
formal.zh: 故事把这位木匠描写成一个干活没条理的人，他把工具散放在整个工坊里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark ħalla l-għodod kollha mal-art. Pawlu: Veru ferkux! Ngħidlu jiġborhom qabel jitlaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark left all the tools on the floor. Pawlu: He really is a disorderly worker! I'll tell him to put them away before he leaves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克把所有工具都留在地上了。保罗：他干活真没条理！我会叫他走之前收好。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克把所有工具都留在地上了。
messages.en: Mark left all the tools on the floor.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru ferkux! Ngħidlu jiġborhom qabel jitlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Veru ferkux! Ngħidlu jiġborhom qabel jitlaq.
messages.zh: 他干活真没条理！我会叫他走之前收好。
messages.en: He really is a disorderly worker! I'll tell him to put them away before he leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给工具散落一地的工人贴上 ferkux 这张人物标签，记住它是指人的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Acting without enough thought, order, or care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做事欠考虑、缺乏条理或不够仔细的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaġixxi bla ħsieb biżżejjed, bla ordni jew b'nuqqas ta' attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒失的；未充分考虑就贸然行动的。
杂乱无章的；缺乏秩序或条理的。
粗心的；做事不够仔细、疏于留意的。

collocations.zh: 粗心而缺乏条理的工人

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-aġir tal-ħaddiem bħala ferkuxi, għax beda x-xogħol mingħajr ma qara l-istruzzjonijiet u ħalla l-materjal imxerred.
formal.en: The report describes the worker's behaviour as rash and disorderly because he began work without reading the instructions and left the materials scattered around.
formal.zh: 报告称这名工人的行为冒失且缺乏条理，因为他没读说明就开工，还把材料散放得到处都是。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark, illum qed tkun ferkuxi; din it-tazza se taqa' mit-tarf tal-mejda. Mark: Għandek raġun. Inressaqha 'l ġewwa u niġbor dawn l-affarijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark, you're being careless today; this cup is going to fall off the edge of the table. Mark: You're right. I'll move it away from the edge and tidy these things up.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克，你今天做事有点粗心，这个杯子都快从桌边掉下去了。马克：你说得对。我把它往里挪，再收拾一下这些东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark, illum qed tkun ferkuxi; din it-tazza se taqa' mit-tarf tal-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Mark, illum qed tkun ferkuxi; din it-tazza se taqa' mit-tarf tal-mejda.
messages.zh: 马克，你今天做事有点粗心，这个杯子都快从桌边掉下去了。
messages.en: Mark, you're being careless today; this cup is going to fall off the edge of the table.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Inressaqha 'l ġewwa u niġbor dawn l-affarijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Inressaqha 'l ġewwa u niġbor dawn l-affarijiet.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我把它往里挪，再收拾一下这些东西。
messages.en: You're right. I'll move it away from the edge and tidy these things up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用不看说明就动手、东西随手乱放的场景记 ferkuxi，把冒失、杂乱、粗心三个意思连在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chemical element called fermium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种名为“镄”的化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku magħruf bl-isem fermju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镄，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fit-test tal-kimika, l-istudent identifika l-fermju bħala element kimiku.
formal.en: In the chemistry test, the student identified fermium as a chemical element.
formal.zh: 在化学测验中，学生指出镄是一种化学元素。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser fermju? Pawlu: Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does fermju mean? Pawlu: It is the name of a chemical element.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：fermju 是什么意思？保罗：它是一种化学元素的名称。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: fermju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does fermju mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素的名称。
messages.en: It is the name of a chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fermju 写在一张元素词汇卡上，正面配“化学元素”，背面写“镄”，用类别与名称一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Raging or frenzied; also describing movement or activity that is very fast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容狂怒或狂乱的状态，也可形容动作或活动进行得飞快。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun mimli rabja jew aġitazzjoni kbira, jew li jsir b'ħeffa kbira ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狂怒的，怒气极盛的。
飞快的，速度极快的。
狂乱的，处于极度激动状态的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-ritmu fernetiku tax-xogħol matul l-aħħar siegħa qabel il-ftuħ.
formal.en: The report describes the frantic pace of work during the final hour before opening.
formal.zh: 报告描述了开门前最后一小时里紧张而飞快的工作节奏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed taħdem b'dan ir-ritmu fernetiku? Mark: Għandi nispiċċa kollox qabel nofsinhar!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you working at this frantic pace? Mark: I have to finish everything before noon!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么干活这么急？马克：我得在中午前把所有事情做完！

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed taħdem b'dan ir-ritmu fernetiku?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed taħdem b'dan ir-ritmu fernetiku?
messages.zh: 你为什么干活这么急？
messages.en: Why are you working at this frantic pace?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我得在中午前把所有事情做完！
messages.en: I have to finish everything before noon!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人怒气冲冲、动作飞快又手忙脚乱，用这一幅画面串联 fernetiku 的狂怒、飞快和狂乱三个义项。

gloss_zh: 使狂怒；使某人陷入疯狂

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone extremely angry or drive them into a frenzy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人极度愤怒，或使其陷入狂乱、激动的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħdab ħafna jew jidħol fi stat ta' aġitazzjoni kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使大怒，使极度愤怒。

sense_translations.en_definition: to drive sb. to a frenzy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人陷入疯狂或极度激动的状态。

collocations.en: drove the crowd into a frenzy

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, id-dewmien twil ferneż lill-klijent, li talab spjegazzjoni immedjata.
formal.en: According to the report, the long delay enraged the customer, who demanded an immediate explanation.
formal.zh: 根据报告，长时间的延误使顾客大怒，要求立即得到解释。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lil Mark? Pawlu: Dak il-kumment ferneż lil Mark; issa rridu nitkellmu miegħu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to Mark? Pawlu: That comment enraged Mark; now we need to speak to him calmly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么了？保罗：那句话把马克惹得大怒；现在我们得心平气和地跟他谈谈。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Mark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kumment ferneż lil Mark; issa rridu nitkellmu miegħu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kumment ferneż lil Mark; issa rridu nitkellmu miegħu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 那句话把马克惹得大怒；现在我们得心平气和地跟他谈谈。
messages.en: That comment enraged Mark; now we need to speak to him calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“某句话 → 某人大怒”的箭头图记 ferneż，重点记住它表示使别人进入狂怒或狂乱状态。

gloss_zh: 狂乱；狂怒；极度焦虑；恐慌

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of frenzy, rage, great anxiety, or panic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 狂乱、狂怒、极度焦虑或恐慌的状态，具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' aġitazzjoni qawwija, rabja kbira, ansjetà kbira jew paniku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狂乱，极度激动而难以自控的状态。
狂怒，极其强烈的愤怒。
极度焦虑，强烈的不安。
恐慌，突然而强烈的惊惧。

formal.mt: L-avviż mhux ċar qajjem ferneżija fost il-passiġġieri, li bdew jitolbu aktar informazzjoni.
formal.en: The unclear announcement caused panic among the passengers, who began asking for more information.
formal.zh: 含糊不清的通知引起了乘客的恐慌，他们开始要求提供更多信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm din il-ferneżija kollha? Mark: Ħsibt li tlift il-biljetti, imma sibthom fil-but!
colloquial.en: Maja: What is all this panic about? Mark: I thought I had lost the tickets, but I found them in my pocket!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么慌成这样？马克：我以为把票弄丢了，结果在口袋里找到了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么慌成这样？
messages.en: What is all this panic about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħsibt li tlift il-biljetti, imma sibthom fil-but!
messages.mt_standard: Ħsibt li tlift il-biljetti, imma sibthom fil-but!
messages.zh: 我以为把票弄丢了，结果在口袋里找到了！
messages.en: I thought I had lost the tickets, but I found them in my pocket!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ferneżija 画一只情绪温度计：狂乱、狂怒、焦虑、恐慌都升到高位，再靠上下文判断是哪一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A parting in the hair or hair arranged with a parting; also a cleft or split.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头发分开形成的发缝，也可指分缝的头发；另指物体上的裂隙或裂口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-linja fejn jinfired ix-xagħar, jew ix-xagħar mifrud hekk; ukoll qasma f'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头发分开后形成的发缝。
一道裂隙或裂口。
裂隙，物体裂开或分开形成的缝隙。
发缝，头发分向两边的分界线。
梳出分缝、向两边分开的头发。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, ix-xagħar huwa mimxut b'ferq ċar fin-nofs.
formal.en: In the photograph, the hair is combed with a clear middle parting.
formal.zh: 照片中的头发梳成中分，发缝清晰可见。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid il-ferq fin-nofs jew fil-ġenb? Maja: Fil-ġenb, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like the parting in the middle or at the side? Maja: At the side, please.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想要中分还是侧分？玛雅：请给我侧分。

messages.speaker: Lara (理发师)
messages.zh: 你想要中分还是侧分？
messages.en: Would you like the parting in the middle or at the side?

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我侧分。
messages.en: At the side, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象梳子分开发丝留下的一道缝，再联想到岩石上的裂缝，用“分开形成的缝”连接 ferq 的常见含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sprout, grow branches, or bring forth new growth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 萌发、长出枝条，或生出新的生长部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ rimjiet jew friegħi ġodda, jew jagħti tkabbir ġdid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 萌发，抽出新芽。
长出枝条，生枝。
生出，产生或长出。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, l-arbuxxell ferra' friegħi ġodda u kompla jikber.
formal.en: After the rain, the shrub put out new branches and continued to grow.
formal.zh: 雨后，灌木长出了新枝，并继续生长。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm ferra' l-arbuxxell! Mark: Iva, issa għandu ħafna friegħi ġodda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how much the shrub has branched out! Mark: Yes, it has lots of new branches now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看这棵灌木长出了多少枝条！马克：是啊，现在有好多新枝了。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 看这棵灌木长出了多少枝条！
messages.en: Look how much the shrub has branched out!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandu ħafna friegħi ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandu ħafna friegħi ġodda.
messages.zh: 是啊，现在有好多新枝了。
messages.en: Yes, it has lots of new branches now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一棵灌木从芽点抽出新枝，把 ferra' 和“萌发、长枝、生出”三个动作连起来；拼写时保留末尾撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone or something that causes separation or division between people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 导致人与人分离、关系破裂或产生分裂的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li ġġib il-firda bejn in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成分离或分裂的某个人或某种事物。

collocations.en: a cause of division among friends
collocations.zh: 造成朋友之间分裂的人或事物

collocations.en: someone or something that divides the family
collocations.zh: 导致家庭分裂的人或事物

formal.mt: Il-kittieb jippreżenta l-għira bħala ferried bejn iż-żewġ aħwa.
formal.en: The writer presents jealousy as a cause of division between the two siblings.
formal.zh: 作者把嫉妒描写为导致两兄妹关系破裂的因素。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-għajdut sar ferried bejn il-ħbieb. Mark: Mela ejja nitkellmu flimkien u niċċaraw kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: This gossip has become a cause of division among our friends. Mark: Then let's talk together and clear everything up.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些流言已经成了朋友之间分裂的祸因。马克：那我们就一起谈谈，把事情都说清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-għajdut sar ferried bejn il-ħbieb.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-għajdut sar ferried bejn il-ħbieb.
messages.zh: 这些流言已经成了朋友之间分裂的祸因。
messages.en: This gossip has become a cause of division among our friends.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja nitkellmu flimkien u niċċaraw kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja nitkellmu flimkien u niċċaraw kollox.
messages.zh: 那我们就一起谈谈，把事情都说清楚。
messages.en: Then let's talk together and clear everything up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferried 放在两个人之间，想象它是一块把双方隔开的挡板；它是名词，指造成分离的那个人或事物。

gloss_zh: 造成分离的；引起分裂的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing separation or division between people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容会使人与人分离、关系破裂或产生分裂的事物或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib il-firda bejn in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成分离的，引起分裂的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat wissa li kliem ferriedi jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-kooperazzjoni bejn il-membri.
formal.en: The committee warned that divisive words could damage cooperation among the members.
formal.zh: 委员会警告说，引起分裂的话语可能损害成员之间的合作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-kliem ferriedi qed joħloq problemi bejnietna. Mark: Għandek raġun; irridu nisimgħu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Those divisive words are creating problems between us. Mark: You're right; we need to listen to each other.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那些引起分裂的话正在给我们的关系制造问题。马克：你说得对，我们得听听彼此的想法。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kliem ferriedi qed joħloq problemi bejnietna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kliem ferriedi qed joħloq problemi bejnietna.
messages.zh: 那些引起分裂的话正在给我们的关系制造问题。
messages.en: Those divisive words are creating problems between us.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; irridu nisimgħu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; irridu nisimgħu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我们得听听彼此的想法。
messages.en: You're right; we need to listen to each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“引起分裂的言语”记 kliem ferriedi；把 ferriedi 当作贴在言语或行为上的形容词标签，记住它描述造成分离的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that branches out or sprouts, such as a branching or newly growing part of a plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指会分枝或萌发生长的事物，例如植物上分出的枝条或新生部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li toħroġ fi friegħi jew li tinbet, bħal parti ġdida ta' pjanta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会分枝、向外长出分支的事物。
会萌芽或萌发生长的事物。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-pjanta, l-istudent identifika ferriegħ ġdid ħdejn il-bażi taz-zokk.
formal.en: While observing the plant, the student identified a new sprouting growth near the base of the stem.
formal.zh: 观察植物时，学生在茎的基部附近辨认出一处新萌生的部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dan il-ferriegħ żgħir ħdejn iz-zokk! Pawlu: Iva, ħallih jikber u naraw kif jiżviluppa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at this little sprouting growth beside the stem! Pawlu: Yes, let it grow and we'll see how it develops.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，茎旁边有这么一个小小的新生部分！保罗：是啊，让它长着，看看会怎样发育。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dan il-ferriegħ żgħir ħdejn iz-zokk!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dan il-ferriegħ żgħir ħdejn iz-zokk!
messages.zh: 看，茎旁边有这么一个小小的新生部分！
messages.en: Look at this little sprouting growth beside the stem!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħallih jikber u naraw kif jiżviluppa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħallih jikber u naraw kif jiżviluppa.
messages.zh: 是啊，让它长着，看看会怎样发育。
messages.en: Yes, let it grow and we'll see how it develops.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在植物向外分枝、向上萌芽的部分，用“分枝或萌生之物”记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having branches; used to describe something with branching parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有枝条或分支的，用来描述某物呈现出分枝的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu friegħi; jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa b'partijiet li joħorġu minnha bħal fergħat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有枝条的；具有分支的。

formal.mt: L-arbuxxell ferriegħi jeħtieġ spazju biżżejjed biex il-friegħi tiegħu jikbru mingħajr xkiel.
formal.en: The branching shrub needs enough space for its branches to grow without obstruction.
formal.zh: 这株有分枝的灌木需要足够的空间，让枝条能够不受阻碍地生长。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-arbuxxell ferriegħi joqgħod ħdejn il-bieb? Pawlu: Aħjar inpoġġuh aktar 'il bogħod, biex il-friegħi ma jagħlqux il-passaġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would this branching shrub fit beside the door? Pawlu: We'd better put it farther away so its branches don't block the passage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这株有分枝的灌木放在门旁合适吗？保罗：最好放远一点，免得枝条挡住通道。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-arbuxxell ferriegħi joqgħod ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-arbuxxell ferriegħi joqgħod ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 这株有分枝的灌木放在门旁合适吗？
messages.en: Would this branching shrub fit beside the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar inpoġġuh aktar 'il bogħod, biex il-friegħi ma jagħlqux il-passaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar inpoġġuh aktar 'il bogħod, biex il-friegħi ma jagħlqux il-passaġġ.
messages.zh: 最好放远一点，免得枝条挡住通道。
messages.en: We'd better put it farther away so its branches don't block the passage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主茎两旁伸出枝条，把这个词作为“有分枝的”贴在植物图旁，并与表示事物的名词 ferriegħ 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who distributes things, giving them out to different people or places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品分给不同的人或送往不同地点的人，例如分发食物或传单的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqassam affarijiet lil nies differenti jew f'postijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责分发或分配物品的人。

formal.mt: Il-ferrieq tal-ikel ta porzjon lil kull persuna li kienet qed tistenna fil-kju.
formal.en: The food distributor gave a portion to each person waiting in the queue.
formal.zh: 食物分发者给每位排队等候的人发了一份食物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-ferrieq tal-fuljetti llum? Mark: Jien. Trid fuljett dwar l-attivitajiet ta' din il-ġimgħa?
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is handing out the leaflets today? Mark: I am. Would you like a leaflet about this week's activities?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天谁负责发传单？马克：我负责。你要一张介绍本周活动的传单吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (活动参加者)
messages.zh: 今天谁负责发传单？
messages.en: Who is handing out the leaflets today?

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Trid fuljett dwar l-attivitajiet ta' din il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Trid fuljett dwar l-attivitajiet ta' din il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 我负责。你要一张介绍本周活动的传单吗？
messages.en: I am. Would you like a leaflet about this week's activities?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人沿着队伍逐一发食物或传单，用“把东西分给大家的人”记忆 ferrieq。

gloss_zh: 负责分发的；能把双方隔开的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Assigned to distribute things, or able to keep people or things apart, including people involved in a scuffle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容负有分发任务的人，或有能力把人或物隔开的人，包括能够拉开扭打双方的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-inkarigu li jqassam affarijiet, jew li kapaċi jżomm nies jew affarijiet mifrudin, anki waqt ġlieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 承担分发或分配任务的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to hold apart (incl. people in a scuffle)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有能力把双方或不同事物隔开的，包括能把扭打的人拉开并保持分离的。

collocations.en: a worker assigned to distribute things
collocations.zh: 承担分发任务的工作人员

collocations.en: a guard able to keep people apart

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ferrieqi kellu jqassam il-pakketti lill-familji skont il-lista mogħtija lilu.
formal.en: The worker assigned to distribution had to hand out the parcels to families according to the list he had been given.
formal.zh: 承担分发任务的工作人员须按照交给他的名单，把包裹发给各户家庭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif waqfet il-ġlieda? Mark: Daħal gwardjan ferrieqi u żamm liż-żewġ irġiel 'il bogħod minn xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the fight stop? Mark: A guard who could keep them apart stepped in and kept the two men away from each other.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那场打斗是怎么停下来的？马克：一位能拉开双方的保安上前，把那两个男人隔开了。

messages.speaker: Maja (路人)
messages.zh: 那场打斗是怎么停下来的？
messages.en: How did the fight stop?

messages.speaker: Mark (目击者)
messages.mt_spoken: Daħal gwardjan ferrieqi u żamm liż-żewġ irġiel 'il bogħod minn xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Daħal gwardjan ferrieqi u żamm liż-żewġ irġiel 'il bogħod minn xulxin.
messages.zh: 一位能拉开双方的保安上前，把那两个男人隔开了。
messages.en: A guard who could keep them apart stepped in and kept the two men away from each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画分别记义项：工作人员负责分发包裹，保安有能力隔开双方；这是形容职责或能力的词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who spreads or disperses something over an area, such as seed or salt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某种东西撒开或散布到一片区域的人，例如撒种子或撒盐的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xxerred xi ħaġa fuq medda ta' art jew f'xi post, bħal żerriegħa jew melħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西撒开、铺散或散布出去的人。

formal.mt: Il-ferriex taż-żerriegħa mexa bil-mod tul l-għalqa u xerred iż-żerriegħa b'mod uniformi.
formal.en: The seed scatterer walked slowly along the field and spread the seed evenly.
formal.zh: 撒种者沿着田地缓慢行走，把种子均匀地撒开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm is-silġ fit-triq. Min se jxerred il-melħ? Mark: Il-ferriex tal-melħ se jiġi dalwaqt biex jagħmel dan.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's ice on the road. Who is going to spread the salt? Mark: The salt spreader will come soon to do that.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：路上结冰了。谁来撒盐？马克：撒盐的工作人员很快就会来处理。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm is-silġ fit-triq. Min se jxerred il-melħ?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm is-silġ fit-triq. Min se jxerred il-melħ?
messages.zh: 路上结冰了。谁来撒盐？
messages.en: There's ice on the road. Who is going to spread the salt?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ferriex tal-melħ se jiġi dalwaqt biex jagħmel dan.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ferriex tal-melħ se jiġi dalwaqt biex jagħmel dan.
messages.zh: 撒盐的工作人员很快就会来处理。
messages.en: The salt spreader will come soon to do that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住撒种时种子向一片地面散开的画面：ferriex 指执行撒布的人，可与逐人分发东西的 ferrieq 对照学习。

gloss_zh: 容易散开的；有散开倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to disperse or spread out instead of remaining together in one place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有散开、分散或向周围扩散倾向的，不容易一直聚在同一处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jinfirex jew jitferrex u ma jibqax miġbur f'post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有散开、分散或扩散倾向的。

collocations.en: a group whose members tend to disperse
collocations.zh: 成员容易各自散开的群体

formal.mt: Id-duħħan ferriexi nfirex malajr fl-arja miftuħa u ma baqax miġbur ħdejn is-sors tiegħu.
formal.en: The readily dispersing smoke spread quickly in the open air and did not remain concentrated near its source.
formal.zh: 这种容易扩散的烟在露天迅速散开，没有一直聚集在烟源附近。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-grupp tagħna hu ferriexi; kulħadd imur għal rasu. Mark: Mela ejja nagħżlu post fejn nerġgħu niltaqgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Our group tends to scatter; everyone goes their own way. Mark: Then let's choose a place to meet up again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们这群人很容易散开，大家都各走各的。马克：那就选个地方，之后再集合吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (旅行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-grupp tagħna hu ferriexi; kulħadd imur għal rasu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-grupp tagħna hu ferriexi; kulħadd imur għal rasu.
messages.zh: 我们这群人很容易散开，大家都各走各的。
messages.en: Our group tends to scatter; everyone goes their own way.

messages.speaker: Mark (旅行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja nagħżlu post fejn nerġgħu niltaqgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja nagħżlu post fejn nerġgħu niltaqgħu.
messages.zh: 那就选个地方，之后再集合吧。
messages.en: Then let's choose a place to meet up again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象烟向四周散去，或同伴逛街时各走各的，用“容易散开的”记忆；注意这里描述倾向，不指撒布的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A railway worker: a person whose job involves working on the railway or its services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在铁路系统或相关运输服务中工作的人员；这一称呼不限于列车司机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem fil-qasam tal-ferroviji jew fis-servizzi tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铁路工人；铁路工作人员。

collocations.en: a railway worker at the station
collocations.zh: 车站里的铁路工作人员
经验丰富的铁路工作人员

formal.mt: Il-ferrovjier iċċekkja l-vaguni qabel it-tluq tal-ferrovija mill-istazzjon.
formal.en: The railway worker checked the carriages before the train departed from the station.
formal.zh: 列车驶离车站之前，铁路工作人员检查了车厢。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar il-ferrovija li jmiss? Luca: Staqsi lill-ferrovjier ħdejn il-bieb; jista' jgħinek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can I ask about the next train? Luca: Ask the railway worker by the door; he can help you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以找谁问下一班火车的情况？卢卡：问问门旁的铁路工作人员吧，他能帮你。

messages.speaker: Maja (旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar il-ferrovija li jmiss?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar il-ferrovija li jmiss?
messages.zh: 我可以找谁问下一班火车的情况？
messages.en: Who can I ask about the next train?

messages.speaker: Luca (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lill-ferrovjier ħdejn il-bieb; jista' jgħinek.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lill-ferrovjier ħdejn il-bieb; jista' jgħinek.
messages.zh: 问问门旁的铁路工作人员吧，他能帮你。
messages.en: Ask the railway worker by the door; he can help you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把车站、车厢和穿工作服的工作人员放进同一幅画面，记住 ferrovjier 指铁路工作人员，不必限定具体岗位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wave one's hands, or to move about quickly with short, hurried movements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挥动自己的双手；也可指以急促的小步或动作来回跑动、窜动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ixejjer idejh, jew jiġri minn naħa għal oħra b'passi qosra u mgħaġġla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挥动双手。
急促地四处跑动；匆忙来回窜动。

collocations.en: he scurried from one side to the other
collocations.zh: 他从一边匆忙跑到另一边

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, il-ġurdien fertel minn naħa għal oħra tal-kaxxa qabel daħal fil-kenn tiegħu.
formal.en: During the observation, the mouse scurried from one side of the box to the other before entering its shelter.
formal.zh: 观察期间，老鼠在箱子里从一边急促地跑到另一边，随后钻进了藏身处。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu fertel b'idejh meta rana? Mark: Ried jiġbdilna l-attenzjoni biex naraw fejn kien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu wave his hands when he saw us? Mark: He wanted to get our attention so we could see where he was.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗看到我们时，为什么挥动双手？马克：他想引起我们的注意，让我们看到他在哪里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu fertel b'idejh meta rana?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu fertel b'idejh meta rana?
messages.zh: 保罗看到我们时，为什么挥动双手？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu wave his hands when he saw us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jiġbdilna l-attenzjoni biex naraw fejn kien.
messages.mt_standard: Ried jiġbdilna l-attenzjoni biex naraw fejn kien.
messages.zh: 他想引起我们的注意，让我们看到他在哪里。
messages.en: He wanted to get our attention so we could see where he was.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动态镜头记忆：一个人挥动双手招呼朋友，一只小鼠急促来回跑动；分别对应本词的两个动词义项。

gloss_zh: 拖着脚走；使人拖着脚走

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move along with shuffling steps, or to cause someone to move in that way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拖着脚、以细碎步子向前走；也指使某人这样行走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mexa b'passi żgħar waqt li jkaxkar saqajh, jew ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jimxi hekk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖着脚缓慢地走；以细碎拖曳的步子前行。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause sb. to shuffle along
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人拖着脚走；使某人以细碎拖曳的步子前行。

formal.mt: Meta qam mis-siġġu, ir-raġel ferċaħ bil-mod lejn il-bieb.
formal.en: When he rose from the chair, the man shuffled slowly towards the door.
formal.zh: 那名男子从椅子上起身后，慢慢地拖着脚走向门口。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Mark dam daqshekk biex wasal sal-bieb? Rita: Kien għadu bin-ngħas u ferċaħ bil-mod tul il-kuritur.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did Mark take so long to reach the door? Rita: He was still sleepy and shuffled slowly along the corridor.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克怎么花了那么久才走到门口？丽塔：他还困着，沿着走廊慢慢地拖着脚走。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark dam daqshekk biex wasal sal-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark dam daqshekk biex wasal sal-bieb?
messages.zh: 马克怎么花了那么久才走到门口？
messages.en: Why did Mark take so long to reach the door?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien għadu bin-ngħas u ferċaħ bil-mod tul il-kuritur.
messages.mt_standard: Kien għadu bin-ngħas u ferċaħ bil-mod tul il-kuritur.
messages.zh: 他还困着，沿着走廊慢慢地拖着脚走。
messages.en: He was still sleepy and shuffled slowly along the corridor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚睡醒的人拖着拖鞋缓慢前行，再把“自己这样走”和“使人这样走”配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose legs curve outwards at the knees.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 双腿在膝部向外弯曲、呈罗圈腿形态的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna b'saqajn mgħawġa 'l barra fl-irkopptejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罗圈腿的人；双腿向外弯曲的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ferċieħ kien raġel twil li kien jaħdem fil-ħanut tar-raħal.
formal.en: In the story, the bandy-legged person was a tall man who worked in the village shop.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，那个罗圈腿的人是一名高个子男子，在村里的商店工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma ferċieħ f'dan ir-rakkont? Lara: Tfisser persuna b'saqajn mgħawġa 'l barra fl-irkopptejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word ferċieħ mean in this story? Lara: It means a person whose legs curve outwards at the knees.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事里的 ferċieħ 是什么意思？拉拉：指双腿在膝部向外弯曲的人，也就是罗圈腿的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma ferċieħ f'dan ir-rakkont?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma ferċieħ f'dan ir-rakkont?
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 ferċieħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word ferċieħ mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser persuna b'saqajn mgħawġa 'l barra fl-irkopptejn.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser persuna b'saqajn mgħawġa 'l barra fl-irkopptejn.
messages.zh: 指双腿在膝部向外弯曲的人，也就是罗圈腿的人。
messages.en: It means a person whose legs curve outwards at the knees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在词卡上画一个双腿呈括号形的人物，记住本词指具有这种腿形的人。

gloss_zh: 走路笨拙的；走路呈罗圈腿姿态的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who tends to walk awkwardly or with bandy legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人走路往往笨拙，或双腿向外弯曲、呈罗圈腿姿态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jimxi b'mod goff jew b'riġlejh mgħawġin 'il barra.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to walk clumsily or with bandy legs
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有走路笨拙或呈罗圈腿姿态的倾向

collocations.en: a man who walks awkwardly or with bandy legs
collocations.zh: 走路笨拙或呈罗圈腿姿态的男子

collocations.en: a character who tends to walk awkwardly
collocations.zh: 一个走路往往笨拙的角色

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru ewlieni huwa ferċieħi, u l-awtur jiddeskrivi bir-reqqa l-mod kif jimxi.
formal.en: In the story, the main character tends to walk awkwardly, and the author carefully describes his gait.
formal.zh: 故事中的主人公走路往往笨拙，作者仔细描写了他的步态。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser li l-karattru huwa ferċieħi? Pawlu: Li għandu tendenza jimxi b'mod goff jew b'riġlejh mgħawġin 'il barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does it mean that the character is ferċieħi? Pawlu: That he tends to walk awkwardly or with bandy legs.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：说这个角色 ferċieħi 是什么意思？保罗：就是说他往往走路笨拙，或走路呈罗圈腿姿态。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li l-karattru huwa ferċieħi?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li l-karattru huwa ferċieħi?
messages.zh: 说这个角色 ferċieħi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that the character is ferċieħi?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Li għandu tendenza jimxi b'mod goff jew b'riġlejh mgħawġin 'il barra.
messages.mt_standard: Li għandu tendenza jimxi b'mod goff jew b'riġlejh mgħawġin 'il barra.
messages.zh: 就是说他往往走路笨拙，或走路呈罗圈腿姿态。
messages.en: That he tends to walk awkwardly or with bandy legs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferċieħi 放在人物速写旁记忆：画出笨拙或双腿外弯的步态，提醒自己这是描述人的形容词。

gloss_zh: 拖着脚走路的人；罗圈腿的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who shuffles when walking or has bandy legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指走路时拖着脚步，或双腿呈罗圈腿形态的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li timxi tkaxkar saqajha jew li għandha riġlejha mgħawġin 'il barra.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who shuffles or is bandy-legged
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖着脚走路的人，或罗圈腿的人

collocations.en: a shuffling person who drags his feet
described as a person who shuffles or has bandy legs
collocations.zh: 被描写为拖脚走路或有罗圈腿的人

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-karattru bħala ferċuħ għax jimxi jkaxkar saqajh mat-triq.
formal.en: The author describes the character as a shuffler because he drags his feet along the road.
formal.zh: 作者把这个角色描写为拖脚走路的人，因为他沿路行走时拖着双脚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex l-awtur isejjaħlu ferċuħ? Mark: Għax jimxi jkaxkar saqajh; hawnhekk il-kelma tirreferi għal persuna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the author call him a ferċuħ? Mark: Because he shuffles when he walks; here the word refers to a person.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：作者为什么称他为 ferċuħ？马克：因为他拖着脚走路；这里这个词指的是人。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 作者为什么称他为 ferċuħ？
messages.en: Why does the author call him a ferċuħ?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会主持人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jimxi jkaxkar saqajh; hawnhekk il-kelma tirreferi għal persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jimxi jkaxkar saqajh; hawnhekk il-kelma tirreferi għal persuna.
messages.zh: 因为他拖着脚走路；这里这个词指的是人。
messages.en: Because he shuffles when he walks; here the word refers to a person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物卡片记 ferċuħ：卡片上画一个拖脚走路的人，并标注“名词，指人”，与描述步态的形容词分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of happiness or an expression of rejoicing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内心感到高兴的情绪，或表现出来的欢乐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' hena jew espressjoni ta' kuntentizza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜悦，欢乐；欢欣庆贺时的高兴之情。

formal.mt: L-aħbar tar-riżultati tajbin ġabet ferħa kbira fost l-istudenti u l-għalliema.
formal.en: The news of the good results brought great joy to the students and teachers.
formal.zh: 取得好成绩的消息给学生和老师带来了巨大的喜悦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaddejt mill-eżami! Mark: X'ferħa! Ejja niċċelebraw flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: I passed the exam! Mark: What wonderful news! Let's celebrate together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我通过考试了！马克：太让人高兴了！我们一起庆祝吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我通过考试了！
messages.en: I passed the exam!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 太让人高兴了！我们一起庆祝吧。
messages.en: What wonderful news! Let's celebrate together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferħa 联想到收到好消息后笑着跳起来的画面，记住它表示喜悦与欢乐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone frantic or extremely agitated, or to leave someone confused.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人陷入狂乱或极度激动的状态，也可指使人迷惑、理不清头绪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jidħol fi stat ta' aġitazzjoni kbira, jew iħawdu u jħallih ma jifhimx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使陷入狂乱；使激动得失去控制
使困惑；使混乱

collocations.en: drove everyone frantic with the noise
collocations.zh: 用噪声把所有人都闹得快发狂

collocations.en: confused the students with a muddled explanation
collocations.zh: 用混乱的讲解把学生弄糊涂了

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ferżen lill-qarrejja għax ta żewġ spjegazzjonijiet li jikkontradixxu lil xulxin.
formal.en: The report confused readers because it gave two explanations that contradicted each other.
formal.zh: 这份报告给出了两种相互矛盾的解释，让读者感到困惑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħriġt mill-kamra? Pawlu: Dak l-istorbju ferżen lil kulħadd; kelli bżonn ftit kwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you leave the room? Pawlu: That noise drove everyone frantic; I needed some quiet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么离开房间？保罗：那噪声把大家都闹得快发狂了，我需要安静一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么离开房间？
messages.en: Why did you leave the room?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak l-istorbju ferżen lil kulħadd; kelli bżonn ftit kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Dak l-istorbju ferżen lil kulħadd; kelli bżonn ftit kwiet.
messages.zh: 那噪声把大家都闹得快发狂了，我需要安静一会儿。
messages.en: That noise drove everyone frantic; I needed some quiet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferżen 配上两个画面记忆：噪声让人抓狂，混乱的解释让人迷糊；两个义项都突出对人的影响。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of uncontrolled excitement or agitation, or a burst of intense anger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 失去控制的激动或狂乱状态，也可指强烈的愤怒或暴怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' eċċitament jew aġitazzjoni bla kontroll, jew rabja qawwija ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狂乱；失去控制的激动状态
暴怒；强烈的愤怒

formal.mt: Ix-xhud iddeskriva kif ir-raġel daħal f'ferżna ta' rabja u beda jkisser l-għamara.
formal.en: The witness described how the man flew into a rage and began smashing the furniture.
formal.zh: 证人描述了那名男子如何勃然大怒，开始砸坏家具。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara meta tilef il-logħba? Mark: Daħal f'ferżna u beda jgħajjat, imma mbagħad ikkalma.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened when he lost the game? Mark: He went into a frenzy and started shouting, but then he calmed down.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他输掉比赛后怎么样了？马克：他一时失控，大喊大叫，不过后来平静下来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他输掉比赛后怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened when he lost the game?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Daħal f'ferżna u beda jgħajjat, imma mbagħad ikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Daħal f'ferżna u beda jgħajjat, imma mbagħad ikkalma.
messages.zh: 他一时失控，大喊大叫，不过后来平静下来了。
messages.en: He went into a frenzy and started shouting, but then he calmed down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferżna 记成一种状态：想象人激动或愤怒到失控；与表示使人抓狂的动词 ferżen 对照学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass wind without making a sound, or to speak without proper discretion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不发出声音地放屁；也指说话欠谨慎，讲出不该讲的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ gass minn ġismu bla ħoss, jew jitkellem bla diskrezzjoni u jgħid dak li ma kellux jgħid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无声地放屁
说话不谨慎；失言

collocations.en: spoke indiscreetly and revealed a secret

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ir-rappreżentant fesa u kixef informazzjoni li kellha tibqa' kunfidenzjali.
formal.en: During the meeting, the representative spoke indiscreetly and revealed information that should have remained confidential.
formal.zh: 会议期间，那名代表说话不慎，泄露了本应保密的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tidħak? Toni: Għax Pawlu fesa bla ħoss u ħaseb li ħadd ma nduna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you laughing? Toni: Because Pawlu passed wind silently and thought nobody noticed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么笑？托尼：因为保罗无声地放了个屁，还以为没人发现。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么笑？
messages.en: Why are you laughing?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Pawlu fesa bla ħoss u ħaseb li ħadd ma nduna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Pawlu fesa bla ħoss u ħaseb li ħadd ma nduna.
messages.zh: 因为保罗无声地放了个屁，还以为没人发现。
messages.en: Because Pawlu passed wind silently and thought nobody noticed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张情境卡记 fesa：一张是无声放屁，一张是失言泄密；这是义项对照记忆，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove a shell, husk, or pod, or to break a shell such as that of an egg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 除去外壳、外皮或豆荚，也可指打破蛋等物体的壳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi l-qoxra jew il-miżwed, jew jikser qoxra bħal dik ta' bajda.

sense_translations.en_definition: to remove a shell or pod
sense_translations.zh_definition: 去掉外壳或豆荚
剥去外壳、外皮或荚壳

sense_translations.en_definition: to break the shell (e.g. of an egg)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 打破壳，例如打破蛋壳

formal.mt: Il-kok fesaq il-bajda fuq skutella nadifa qabel żiedha mat-taħlita.
formal.en: The cook cracked the egg over a clean bowl before adding it to the mixture.
formal.zh: 厨师在干净的碗上方打破鸡蛋壳，然后把蛋液加入混合物中。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-ful għadu fil-miżwed? Toni: Le, missieri fesaq il-ful dalgħodu; issa lest għat-tisjir.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are the broad beans still in their pods? Toni: No, my father shelled the broad beans this morning; they are ready to cook now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：蚕豆还在豆荚里吗？托尼：没有，我爸爸今天早上已经剥好了，现在可以下锅了。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 蚕豆还在豆荚里吗？
messages.en: Are the broad beans still in their pods?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, missieri fesaq il-ful dalgħodu; issa lest għat-tisjir.
messages.mt_standard: Le, missieri fesaq il-ful dalgħodu; issa lest għat-tisjir.
messages.zh: 没有，我爸爸今天早上已经剥好了，现在可以下锅了。
messages.en: No, my father shelled the broad beans this morning; they are ready to cook now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 fesaq 时想象厨房里的两只手：一只剥豆荚，一只敲蛋壳；共同线索是处理包在外面的壳。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who whispers or speaks in a very low voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以很低的声音说话、进行耳语的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem bil-ħ whispered?

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低声耳语的人；悄声说话者

collocations.en: a person whispering during the meeting

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-fesfies jgħaddi l-aħbar lil sieħbu mingħajr ma jiġbed l-attenzjoni tal-oħrajn.
formal.en: In the story, the whisperer passes the news to his companion without attracting the others' attention.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个低声耳语的人把消息告诉同伴，没有引起其他人的注意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed jgħid dak il-fesfies hemm wara? Pawlu: Ma smajtx sew; qed jitkellem bil-mod ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that whisperer at the back saying? Pawlu: I didn't hear clearly; he is speaking very quietly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：后面那个低声说话的人在讲什么？保罗：我没听清，他声音太轻了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed jgħid dak il-fesfies hemm wara?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed jgħid dak il-fesfies hemm wara?
messages.zh: 后面那个低声说话的人在讲什么？
messages.en: What is that whisperer at the back saying?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma smajtx sew; qed jitkellem bil-mod ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Ma smajtx sew; qed jitkellem bil-mod ħafna.
messages.zh: 我没听清，他声音太轻了。
messages.en: I didn't hear clearly; he is speaking very quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fesfies 贴在一个凑近同伴耳边讲话的人物上，记住它指说话的人，而不是耳语这个动作。

gloss_zh: 爱低声耳语的；行事神秘的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to whisper and to keep matters secret.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于低声耳语、对事情守口如瓶或表现得神神秘秘的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jitkellem bil-ħ whispered?

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to whispering and secrecy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有低声耳语和保密倾向的；爱悄悄说话、行事神秘的

collocations.en: a man inclined to whisper and be secretive
collocations.zh: 爱低声说话、行事神秘的男子
爱耳语、守口如瓶的人物

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta lil Pawlu bħala karattru fesfiesi li jaqsam il-pjanijiet tiegħu ma' ftit nies biss.
formal.en: The author presents Pawlu as a whispering, secretive character who shares his plans with only a few people.
formal.zh: 作者把保罗塑造成一个爱低声耳语、行事神秘的人物，只向少数人透露自己的计划。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Toni dejjem ikellmek bil-moħbi? Maja: Hu fesfiesi; anki affarijiet żgħar jgħidhomli bil-ħ whispered?
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does Toni always speak to you in secret? Maja: He is secretive and likes whispering; he even whispers trivial things to me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：托尼为什么总是偷偷跟你说话？玛雅：他就是爱耳语、神神秘秘的，连小事也要悄声告诉我。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼为什么总是偷偷跟你说话？
messages.en: Why does Toni always speak to you in secret?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu fesfiesi; anki affarijiet żgħar jgħidhomli b'leħen baxx ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Hu fesfiesi; anki affarijiet żgħar jgħidhomli b'leħen baxx ħafna.
messages.zh: 他就是爱耳语、神神秘秘的，连小事也要悄声告诉我。
messages.en: He is secretive and likes whispering; he even whispers trivial things to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fesfiesi 当成人物性格标签来记：说话压低声音，事情藏在心里；它是形容词，描述人的倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who whispers, speaking quietly rather than at an ordinary volume.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 低声说话、以耳语方式与人交谈的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħadd li jitkellem b'leħen baxx ħafna, qrib widnet persuna oħra jew biex ma jisimgħuhx l-oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低声耳语的人；悄声说话者

collocations.en: a whisperer at the back of the room
collocations.zh: 房间后面低声耳语的人

collocations.en: a person whispering by the door

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tax-xena, il-fesfus joqrob lejn widnet sieħbu biex iwassallu messaġġ qasir.
formal.en: In the description of the scene, the whisperer moves close to his companion's ear to deliver a short message.
formal.zh: 场景描写中，那个低声耳语的人凑近同伴的耳朵，传达了一条简短的消息。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min hu dak il-fesfus ħdejn il-bieb? Rita: Ħija; qed jgħid xi ħaġa lil sieħbu mingħajr ma jqajjem lit-tarbija.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is that whisperer by the door? Rita: My brother; he is telling his friend something without waking the baby.
colloquial.zh: 马克：门边那个悄声说话的人是谁？丽塔：我哥哥，他正在跟朋友说点事，免得吵醒宝宝。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak il-fesfus ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak il-fesfus ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门边那个悄声说话的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that whisperer by the door?

messages.speaker: Rita (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija; qed jgħid xi ħaġa lil sieħbu mingħajr ma jqajjem lit-tarbija.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija; qed jgħid xi ħaġa lil sieħbu mingħajr ma jqajjem lit-tarbija.
messages.zh: 我哥哥，他正在跟朋友说点事，免得吵醒宝宝。
messages.en: My brother; he is telling his friend something without waking the baby.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门边有人怕吵醒宝宝而贴耳讲话，把 fesfus 记作这个耳语者；与 fesfies 并列复习相同的所给释义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wrap a baby snugly in cloth or a blanket as a swaddle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用布或毯子将婴儿包裹成襁褓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Igeżwer tarbija fi drapp jew f'kutra biex iżommha mgeżwra sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用襁褓包裹婴儿

collocations.en: swaddled the baby in a soft blanket
collocations.zh: 用柔软的毯子把婴儿包成襁褓

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-missier fessaq lit-tarbija f'biċċa drapp nadifa u mbagħad ħadha f'dirgħajh.
formal.en: In the story, the father swaddled the baby in a clean cloth and then took the baby into his arms.
formal.zh: 故事中，父亲用一块干净的布把婴儿包成襁褓，然后抱进怀里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min fessaq lit-tarbija? Pawlu: Jien, b'din il-kutra ratba. Issa qed torqod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who swaddled the baby? Pawlu: I did, with this soft blanket. The baby is sleeping now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁给宝宝包的襁褓？保罗：我，用的这条软毯子。宝宝现在睡着了。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 谁给宝宝包的襁褓？
messages.en: Who swaddled the baby?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, b'din il-kutra ratba. Issa qed torqod.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, b'din il-kutra ratba. Issa qed torqod.
messages.zh: 我，用的这条软毯子。宝宝现在睡着了。
messages.en: I did, with this soft blanket. The baby is sleeping now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面对比记拼写：fesaq 是去壳，fessaq 是给宝宝包襁褓；看到双写 s 就调出包裹婴儿的画面，仅作学习提示。

gloss_zh: 放屁的人；守不住秘密的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who breaks wind, or a person who cannot be trusted to keep something private.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指放屁的人；也可指嘴不严、不能信任其保守秘密的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li toħroġ il-gass minn żaqqha, jew persuna li ma tafx iżżomm sigriet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放屁的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who can't be trusted to be discreet
sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘴不严、不能信任其保守秘密的人。
形容放屁的或爱放屁的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who can't be trusted to be discreet
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容嘴不严、守不住秘密的人。

collocations.mt: fessej li ma jafx iżomm sigriet
collocations.en: a loose-tongued person who cannot keep a secret
collocations.zh: 一个守不住秘密的大嘴巴

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-fessej jikxef sigriet li kien wiegħed li jżomm għalih.
formal.en: In the story, the loose-tongued person reveals a secret he had promised to keep to himself.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个嘴不严的人泄露了自己曾答应保守的秘密。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tgħidx lil Mark fejn ħbejt ir-rigal; huwa fessej. Anna: Mela ngħidlu biss wara l-festa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Don't tell Mark where you hid the present; he can't keep a secret. Anna: Then I'll only tell him after the party.
colloquial.zh: Maja：别告诉Mark你把礼物藏在哪里了，他嘴不严。Anna：那我等聚会结束后再告诉他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħidx lil Mark fejn ħbejt ir-rigal; huwa fessej.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħidx lil Mark fejn ħbejt ir-rigal; huwa fessej.
messages.zh: 别告诉Mark你把礼物藏在哪里了，他嘴不严。
messages.en: Don't tell Mark where you hid the present; he can't keep a secret.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我等聚会结束后再告诉他。
messages.en: Then I'll only tell him after the party.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记忆：一个人放屁，另一个人把秘密说漏嘴；见到此词先看语境，再判断是哪一种人。

gloss_zh: 被宠坏的人；经常受到宠爱的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spoiled person, or someone whom another person regularly pampers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被宠坏的人，也可指某人平日总是宠爱、娇惯的对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mħassra biżżejjed li tidra ssib kollox lest, jew persuna li xi ħadd iħobb ifissed ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被宠坏、惯坏的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. whom one habitually spoils or pampers
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某人经常宠爱或娇惯的对象。

collocations.en: the pampered member of the family
a spoiled person who wants everything for himself
collocations.zh: 什么都想独占的被宠坏的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-fessud tal-familja jidra li kulħadd jagħmel dak li jrid hu.
formal.en: In the story, the pampered member of the family becomes used to everyone doing whatever he wants.
formal.zh: 故事中，家里那个受宠的人逐渐习惯了人人都顺着他的意思做事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu dejjem irid l-akbar biċċa kejk. Anna: Veru fessud! Din id-darba naqsmuh indaqs.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu always wants the biggest piece of cake. Anna: He's really spoiled! This time we'll divide it equally.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu总想要最大的一块蛋糕。Anna：真是被宠坏了！这次我们平均分。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu dejjem irid l-akbar biċċa kejk.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu dejjem irid l-akbar biċċa kejk.
messages.zh: Pawlu总想要最大的一块蛋糕。
messages.en: Pawlu always wants the biggest piece of cake.

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru fessud! Din id-darba naqsmuh indaqs.
messages.mt_standard: Veru fessud! Din id-darba naqsmuh indaqs.
messages.zh: 真是被宠坏了！这次我们平均分。
messages.en: He's really spoiled! This time we'll divide it equally.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象全家总把最大的一块蛋糕留给同一个人：他是受宠对象，若因此凡事都要占先，就成了被宠坏的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who stammers or stutters when speaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指说话时有口吃现象的人，例如声音或音节出现不自主的重复或停顿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem b'tlaqliq, pereżempju billi tirrepeti ħsejjes jew tieqaf waqt il-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话结巴、有口吃现象的人。
口吃者。

collocations.en: to listen to a person who stutters
to give a person who stutters time to speak
collocations.zh: 给一位口吃者充分的说话时间

formal.mt: Il-fetfiet fil-ġrajja jingħata biżżejjed ħin biex itemm kliemu.
formal.en: The person who stutters in the story is given enough time to finish speaking.
formal.zh: 故事中的口吃者获得了足够的时间，可以把话说完。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu huwa fetfiet; kultant jeħtieġ aktar ħin biex jitkellem. Anna: Mela nistennieh itemm kliemu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu stutters; sometimes he needs more time to speak. Anna: Then I'll wait for him to finish.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu有口吃，有时说话需要多一点时间。Anna：那我会等他把话说完。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu huwa fetfiet; kultant jeħtieġ aktar ħin biex jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu huwa fetfiet; kultant jeħtieġ aktar ħin biex jitkellem.
messages.zh: Pawlu有口吃，有时说话需要多一点时间。
messages.en: Pawlu stutters; sometimes he needs more time to speak.

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 那我会等他把话说完。
messages.en: Then I'll wait for him to finish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词放在“耐心听他说完”的场景里记：它指有口吃现象的人，记忆重点是“人”，不是话语本身。

gloss_zh: 结结巴巴说出的；带有口吃的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing speech or words uttered with a stammer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容话语说出来时带有口吃，出现结巴或不流畅的停顿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi diskors jew kliem li jingħad b'tlaqliq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带着口吃说出的；结结巴巴说出的。

formal.mt: L-awtur juża diskors fetfieti biex juri kif jitkellem il-karattru.
formal.en: The author uses speech delivered with a stammer to show how the character speaks.
formal.zh: 作者通过结结巴巴的话语来表现这个角色的说话方式。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser 'diskors fetfieti' f'dan ir-rakkont? Anna: Ifisser diskors li jingħad b'tlaqliq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'diskors fetfieti' mean in this story? Anna: It means speech delivered with a stammer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇故事里的“diskors fetfieti”是什么意思？Anna：就是带着口吃、结结巴巴说出的话。
