messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇故事里的“diskors fetfieti”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'diskors fetfieti' mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Anna (老师)
messages.zh: 就是带着口吃、结结巴巴说出的话。
messages.en: It means speech delivered with a stammer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 与fetfiet配对记忆：fetfiet指口吃的人，fetfieti形容结结巴巴说出的内容；用“人”和“话”两个标签区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An opening where a seam has come apart or fabric has ripped; also a hernia, or a misfortune.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指衣物等开线或撕裂形成的口子；也可指疝气，或不幸、祸事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fetħa fejn infetħet ħjata jew tqatta' drapp; tista' tfisser ukoll ernja jew diżgrazzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开线处；布料等的裂口、撕裂处。
疝；疝气。
不幸；祸事；厄运。

collocations.en: a great misfortune for the family
collocations.zh: 这个家庭的一场重大不幸

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat eżamina l-fetqa fil-ġakketta qabel beda jsewwiha.
formal.en: The tailor examined the rip in the jacket before beginning to repair it.
formal.zh: 裁缝在开始修补夹克之前，先检查了上面的裂口。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi fetqa fil-qalziet, ħdejn il-but. Rita: Ġibu hawn; nara jekk nistax insewwiha.
colloquial.en: Mark: I've got a rip in my trousers, near the pocket. Rita: Bring them here; I'll see whether I can mend it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我的裤子在口袋旁边裂了一个口子。Rita：拿过来，我看看能不能补好。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 我的裤子在口袋旁边裂了一个口子。
messages.en: I've got a rip in my trousers, near the pocket.

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġibu hawn; nara jekk nistax insewwiha.
messages.mt_standard: Ġibu hawn; nara jekk nistax insewwiha.
messages.zh: 拿过来，我看看能不能补好。
messages.en: Bring them here; I'll see whether I can mend it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 准备三张语境卡：裤子裂口、疝气手术、家庭不幸；同一个词分别放进去练习，靠上下文区分三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat piece cut from food such as bread or ham.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从面包、火腿等食物上切下的一片，通常较薄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ċatta, ġeneralment rqiqa, maqtugħa minn ikel bħal ħobż jew perżut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一片，指面包、火腿等食物切下的薄片。

formal.mt: Għal kull persuna, poġġi fetta ħobż u fetta perżut fuq platt.
formal.en: For each person, place a slice of bread and a slice of ham on a plate.
formal.zh: 给每个人准备一个盘子，放上一片面包和一片火腿。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tagħtini fetta ħobż oħra? Rita: Żgur. Trid ftit ġobon magħha?
colloquial.en: Mark: Could you give me another slice of bread? Rita: Of course. Would you like some cheese with it?
colloquial.zh: Mark：能再给我一片面包吗？Rita：当然。要配一点奶酪吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 能再给我一片面包吗？
messages.en: Could you give me another slice of bread?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 当然。要配一点奶酪吗？
messages.en: Of course. Would you like some cheese with it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象切面包时切下一片，把这一片标上fetta；再换成火腿片练习，就能记住它表示食物的“一片”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who twirls something between their fingers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物放在手指之间捻动、转动的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ddawwar xi ħaġa bejn subgħajha.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who twirls sth. between their fingers
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在手指之间捻转某物的人。

collocations.en: a person who twirls thread between their fingers
a person who twirls wool between their fingers

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, il-fettiel idawwar biċċa ħajt bejn subgħajh biex juri l-moviment.
formal.en: In the exercise, the person twirling the thread turns a piece of it between his fingers to demonstrate the movement.
formal.zh: 练习中，捻线者在手指之间转动一段线，以展示这个动作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed iddawwar dak il-ħajt bejn subgħajk? Mark: Qed nipprova nkun fettiel tajjeb; ara kif idur!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you twirling that thread between your fingers? Mark: I'm trying to be good at twirling it; look how it turns!
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么在手指间捻那根线？Mark：我在练习做个熟练的捻线者，你看它怎么转！

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iddawwar dak il-ħajt bejn subgħajk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iddawwar dak il-ħajt bejn subgħajk?
messages.zh: 你为什么在手指间捻那根线？
messages.en: Why are you twirling that thread between your fingers?

messages.speaker: Mark (手工课学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nipprova nkun fettiel tajjeb; ara kif idur!
messages.mt_standard: Qed nipprova nkun fettiel tajjeb; ara kif idur!
messages.zh: 我在练习做个熟练的捻线者，你看它怎么转！
messages.en: I'm trying to be good at twirling it; look how it turns!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记fettiel时看见“人”的画面：两根手指夹住线来回捻转，词义落在做动作的人身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A staff with a cleft that holds wool in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有裂口或槽口、用于夹持羊毛的杆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastun b'xaqq li jservi biex iżomm is-suf f'postu.

sense_translations.en_definition: a staff with a cleft for holding wool
sense_translations.zh_definition: 带有裂口、用于夹持羊毛的杆。

collocations.en: a wooden staff with a cleft for holding wool
collocations.zh: 夹持羊毛的木制开槽杆

collocations.en: to place wool in the cleft staff

formal.mt: Is-suf jitqiegħed fix-xaqq tal-fettiela biex jinżamm f'postu.
formal.en: The wool is placed in the cleft of the staff to hold it in position.
formal.zh: 羊毛被放进杆的槽口中，以固定在原位。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn inqiegħed dan is-suf? Rita: Fil-fettiela, hawn fix-xaqq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where should I put this wool? Rita: In the wool-holding staff, here in the cleft.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这些羊毛放在哪里？Rita：放进夹毛杆里，就在这个槽口中。

messages.speaker: Nina (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 这些羊毛放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this wool?

messages.speaker: Rita (手工课老师)
messages.zh: 放进夹毛杆里，就在这个槽口中。
messages.en: In the wool-holding staff, here in the cleft.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把fettiela画成一根有槽口的杆，槽里夹着羊毛；用“杆、槽、羊毛”三个画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to twist or twine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有容易扭转、盘绕或缠绕的倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jitbrim jew jitkebbeb.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to twist or twine
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易扭转或缠绕的；有扭转、缠绕倾向的。

collocations.en: thread that tends to twist or twine
string that tends to twist or twine

formal.mt: Dan il-ħajt huwa fettieli: għandu tendenza jitbrim meta jinħall.
formal.en: This thread tends to twist: it is inclined to twist when loosened.
formal.zh: 这种线容易扭转：松开时，它往往会自行扭起来。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex dan l-ispag dejjem jitkebbeb? Ġorġ: Għax huwa fettieli; ipprova żommu dritt.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why does this string keep coiling up? Ġorġ: Because it tends to twist and twine; try holding it straight.
colloquial.zh: Lina：这根细绳怎么老是卷起来？Ġorġ：因为它容易扭转缠绕，试着把它拉直。

messages.speaker: Lina (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 这根细绳怎么老是卷起来？
messages.en: Why does this string keep coiling up?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa fettieli; ipprova żommu dritt.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa fettieli; ipprova żommu dritt.
messages.zh: 因为它容易扭转缠绕，试着把它拉直。
messages.en: Because it tends to twist and twine; try holding it straight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记fettieli时想象一松手就扭成圈的细绳：这个形容词强调“容易扭、容易缠”的倾向。

gloss_zh: 撕裂东西或拆开缝线的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who causes material to rip or stitching to come undone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使材料撕裂，或使缝线拆开的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqatta' materjal jew tiftaħ il-ħjatat.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who causes ripping or unstitching
sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成撕裂或拆开缝线的人。

collocations.en: a person who takes seams apart

formal.mt: Fil-ħanut tal-ħjata, il-fettieq fetaħ il-ħjatat tal-kisja biex id-drapp seta' jerġa' jintuża.
formal.en: In the sewing shop, the person taking the seams apart unstitched the coat so that the fabric could be reused.
formal.zh: 在裁缝店里，拆线者拆开了外套的缝线，以便重新利用布料。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Int se tkun il-fettieq tal-ħjatat illum? Pawlu: Iva, se niftaħ il-ħjatat ta' din il-kisja.
colloquial.en: Rita: Will you be the one taking the seams apart today? Pawlu: Yes, I'll unpick the seams of this coat.
colloquial.zh: Rita：今天由你来当拆线的人吗？Pawlu：对，我会拆开这件外套的缝线。

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Int se tkun il-fettieq tal-ħjatat illum?
messages.mt_standard: Int se tkun il-fettieq tal-ħjatat illum?
messages.zh: 今天由你来当拆线的人吗？
messages.en: Will you be the one taking the seams apart today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (裁缝学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se niftaħ il-ħjatat ta' din il-kisja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se niftaħ il-ħjatat ta' din il-kisja.
messages.zh: 对，我会拆开这件外套的缝线。
messages.en: Yes, I'll unpick the seams of this coat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把fettieq与“正在拆缝线的人”一起记：注意词义指做出撕裂或拆线动作的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to cause material to rip or stitching to come undone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够使材料撕裂，或使缝线松脱、拆开的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jqatta' materjal jew jiftaħ il-ħjatat.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to cause ripping or unstitching
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有造成撕裂或使缝线拆开这一能力的。

collocations.en: an edge capable of causing tearing
a hook capable of causing tearing or unstitching
collocations.zh: 能撕裂材料或扯开缝线的钩子

formal.mt: It-tarf fettieqi tal-metall jista' jqatta' d-drapp meta jmiss miegħu.
formal.en: The metal's tearing edge can rip fabric when it comes into contact with it.
formal.zh: 金属上这个能造成撕裂的边缘接触布料时，可能会将其撕破。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tgħatti dan il-ganċ? Toni: Għax huwa fettieqi; jista' jqatta' d-drapp.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you covering this hook? Toni: Because it can cause tearing; it could rip the fabric.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么把这个钩子盖起来？Toni：因为它会造成撕裂，可能把布料扯破。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么把这个钩子盖起来？
messages.en: Why are you covering this hook?

messages.speaker: Toni (布料店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa fettieqi; jista' jqatta' d-drapp.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa fettieqi; jista' jqatta' d-drapp.
messages.zh: 因为它会造成撕裂，可能把布料扯破。
messages.en: Because it can cause tearing; it could rip the fabric.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把fettieqi贴在一个会勾破布料的钩子旁：记住它描述“具有撕裂或扯开缝线的能力”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who cuts bread into slices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把面包切成片的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqta' l-ħobż fi flieli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把面包切片的人。

formal.mt: Il-fettiet qata' l-ħobż fi flieli ndaqs u poġġiehom fuq il-platt.
formal.en: The person slicing the bread cut it into even slices and placed them on the plate.
formal.zh: 切面包的人把面包切成均匀的薄片，并放在盘子上。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jaqta' l-ħobż illum? Mark: Jien se nkun il-fettiet! Tridu flieli rqaq jew ħoxnin?
colloquial.en: Anna: Who's going to slice the bread today? Mark: I'll be the bread slicer! Would you like thin or thick slices?
colloquial.zh: Anna：今天谁来切面包？Mark：我来当切面包的人！你们要薄片还是厚片？

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天谁来切面包？
messages.en: Who's going to slice the bread today?

messages.speaker: Mark (聚餐主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien se nkun il-fettiet! Tridu flieli rqaq jew ħoxnin?
messages.mt_standard: Jien se nkun il-fettiet! Tridu flieli rqaq jew ħoxnin?
messages.zh: 我来当切面包的人！你们要薄片还是厚片？
messages.en: I'll be the bread slicer! Would you like thin or thick slices?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记fettiet时想象餐桌旁切面包的人：面包一片片落下，词义重点是负责切片的人。

gloss_zh: 爱把面包浸泡或蘸着吃的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to soak bread in a liquid or dip it before eating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人习惯把面包浸在液体中，或蘸一下再吃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu d-drawwa jxarrab jew ibill il-ħobż f'xi likwidu qabel jieklu.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the tendency to soak or dunk bread
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有把面包浸泡或蘸入液体再吃的习惯的

collocations.en: a man who likes soaking or dunking bread
collocations.zh: 喜欢把面包浸泡或蘸着吃的男人

collocations.en: a boy who likes soaking or dunking bread
collocations.zh: 喜欢把面包浸泡或蘸着吃的男孩

formal.mt: Pawlu huwa fettieti: waqt il-kolazzjon, iħobb ibill il-ħobż fil-ħalib.
formal.en: Pawlu likes dunking bread: at breakfast, he enjoys dipping his bread in milk.
formal.zh: 保罗喜欢蘸面包吃：早餐时，他爱把面包蘸进牛奶里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tbill il-ħobż fit-te? Mark: Jien fettieti; hekk jogħġobni aktar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you dipping your bread in the tea? Mark: I like dunking bread; I prefer it that way.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把面包蘸进茶里？马克：我就爱蘸面包吃；这样更合我口味。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把面包蘸进茶里？
messages.en: Why are you dipping your bread in the tea?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我就爱蘸面包吃；这样更合我口味。
messages.en: I like dunking bread; I prefer it that way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象早餐时总要把面包蘸进牛奶的人，用这个固定画面记住 fettieti 描述的是吃面包的习惯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who opens something, such as a door.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指执行打开动作的人，例如为别人开门的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiftaħ xi ħaġa, pereżempju bieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打开某物的人；执行开启动作的人。

collocations.en: the person who opens the door
the person who opens the shop
collocations.zh: 负责给商店开门营业的人

formal.mt: F'din l-istorja, il-fettieħ tal-bieb huwa l-qaddej li jilqa' lill-mistednin.
formal.en: In this story, the person who opens the door is the servant who welcomes the guests.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，开门的人是负责迎接宾客的仆人。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fid-dramm, min hu l-fettieħ tal-bieb? Pawlu: Jien. Niftaħ il-bieb meta jaslu l-mistednin.
colloquial.en: Mark: In the play, who is the person who opens the door? Pawlu: I am. I open the door when the guests arrive.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这出戏里谁负责开门？Pawlu：我。宾客到来时，我就开门。

messages.speaker: Mark (演员)
messages.zh: 这出戏里谁负责开门？
messages.en: In the play, who is the person who opens the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Niftaħ il-bieb meta jaslu l-mistednin.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Niftaħ il-bieb meta jaslu l-mistednin.
messages.zh: 我。宾客到来时，我就开门。
messages.en: I am. I open the door when the guests arrive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象舞台上专门负责开门的演员，在他胸前贴上fettieħ；这个词条记的是“执行打开动作的人”。

gloss_zh: 撑杆；用于撑住物体使其保持打开的杆

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rod used to hold something open, such as a child's cradle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于支撑某物、使其保持打开状态的杆，例如撑住婴儿摇篮的杆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Virga li tintuża biex iżżomm xi ħaġa miftuħa, bħal benniena tat-tfal.

sense_translations.en_definition: a rod used to keep sth. open (e.g. a child's cradle)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物保持打开状态的撑杆，例如用于撑住婴儿摇篮的杆。

collocations.en: a wooden rod for holding something open
to hold the cradle open with a supporting rod
collocations.zh: 用撑杆使摇篮保持打开

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-benniena ssemmi fettieħa tal-injam li żżommha miftuħa.
formal.en: The description of the cradle mentions a wooden supporting rod that holds it open.
formal.zh: 摇篮的说明中提到一根使其保持打开的木撑杆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-virga? Pawlu: Dik fettieħa; iżżomm il-benniena miftuħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that rod? Pawlu: It's a supporting rod; it holds the cradle open.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那根杆是什么？Pawlu：那是撑杆，用来撑住摇篮，让它保持打开。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 那根杆是什么？
messages.en: What is that rod?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (讲解员)
messages.zh: 那是撑杆，用来撑住摇篮，让它保持打开。
messages.en: It's a supporting rod; it holds the cradle open.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住fettieħa时，想象一根撑住摇篮的杆：关键词是“撑着保持打开”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Abundant in quantity or generous in what it provides.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量充足、丰富，或能够提供丰盛产出的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun kotran jew li jagħti ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丰富的；数量充足的。
丰饶的；给予或产出丰盛的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ħsad fettieħi, bi kwantità kbira ta' frott u ħaxix.
formal.en: The report describes an abundant harvest, with a large quantity of fruit and vegetables.
formal.zh: 报告描述了丰盛的收成，水果和蔬菜的产量很大。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien il-ħsad din is-sena? Toni: Fettieħi! Ġbarna ħafna aktar frott mis-soltu.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was the harvest this year? Toni: Abundant! We picked much more fruit than usual.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今年收成怎么样？Toni：很丰盛！我们采到的水果比平常多得多。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今年收成怎么样？
messages.en: How was the harvest this year?

messages.speaker: Toni (种植者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fettieħi! Ġbarna ħafna aktar frott mis-soltu.
messages.mt_standard: Fettieħi! Ġbarna ħafna aktar frott mis-soltu.
messages.zh: 很丰盛！我们采到的水果比平常多得多。
messages.en: Abundant! We picked much more fruit than usual.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把fettieħi与装满水果的篮子联系起来：既可以记“数量丰富”，也可以记“产出丰饶”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long, narrow piece of material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一条长而窄的材料，如布条或纸条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa twila u dejqa ta' xi materjal, bħal drapp jew karta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一条狭长的材料；细长条

formal.mt: Għal din l-attività, aqta' fettul ta' karta u ikteb ismek fuqu.
formal.en: For this activity, cut a strip of paper and write your name on it.
formal.zh: 进行这项活动时，剪一张细长纸条，并在上面写下你的名字。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek fettul ta' drapp? Lara: Iva, hawn wieħed twil biżżejjed biex torbot il-pakkett.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a strip of fabric? Lara: Yes, here is one long enough to tie the parcel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有布条吗？拉拉：有，这条够长，可以用来捆包裹。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有布条吗？
messages.en: Do you have a strip of fabric?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn wieħed twil biżżejjed biex torbot il-pakkett.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn wieħed twil biżżejjed biex torbot il-pakkett.
messages.zh: 有，这条够长，可以用来捆包裹。
messages.en: Yes, here is one long enough to tie the parcel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从整张纸边缘剪下一条又长又窄的纸，拿起这一条时说 fettul，把词和长条实物连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fringe or hanging decoration made of strips or threads attached at one end, often on curtains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由一端固定、另一端垂下的细条或线组成的穗饰，常见于窗帘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiżjin magħmul minn strixxi jew ħjut marbutin minn tarf wieħed, spiss imdendel mal-purtieri.

sense_translations.en_definition: strips or threads fastened at one end, often hung from curtains
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一端固定的条带或线穗，常悬挂于窗帘上作装饰

formal.mt: Il-fettula tal-purtiera tikkonsisti f'ħjut imwaħħlin minn tarf wieħed u mdendlin liberament mit-tarf l-ieħor.
formal.en: The curtain fringe consists of threads attached at one end and hanging freely at the other.
formal.zh: 窗帘的穗饰由一端固定、另一端自由垂落的线组成。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu dak it-tiżjin mal-purtiera? Maja: Dik fettula; ara kif il-ħjut jiddendlu minnha.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is that decoration on the curtain? Maja: That is a fringe; look at the threads hanging from it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：窗帘上那是什么装饰？玛雅：那是穗饰；你看那些垂下来的线。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 窗帘上那是什么装饰？
messages.en: What is that decoration on the curtain?

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik fettula; ara kif il-ħjut jiddendlu minnha.
messages.mt_standard: Dik fettula; ara kif il-ħjut jiddendlu minnha.
messages.zh: 那是穗饰；你看那些垂下来的线。
messages.en: That is a fringe; look at the threads hanging from it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fettula 配上一幅窗帘流苏图：许多细线一端固定、另一端垂下，重点记住成束悬垂的装饰。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Long and narrow in shape, resembling a strip or thread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状细长，像条带或线一样的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma twila u dejqa, bħal strixxa jew ħajta.

sense_translations.en_definition: having an elongated form, like a strip or a thread
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有细长形态的，像条带或线一样的

collocations.en: material with a strip-like or thread-like form

formal.mt: L-oġġett muri fl-istampa huwa fettuli: għandu forma twila u dejqa, bħal ħajta.
formal.en: The object shown in the picture is thread-like: it has a long, narrow shape resembling a thread.
formal.zh: 图中物体呈线状：它的形状又长又细，像一根线。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif niddeskrivi dan l-oġġett twil u dejjaq? Pawlu: Tista' tgħid li huwa fettuli, bħal strixxa.
colloquial.en: Lara: How can I describe this long, narrow object? Pawlu: You can say it is strip-like, like a strip.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个又长又窄的物体可以怎么形容？保罗：可以说它呈细长条状，像一根条带。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif niddeskrivi dan l-oġġett twil u dejjaq?
messages.mt_standard: Kif niddeskrivi dan l-oġġett twil u dejjaq?
messages.zh: 这个又长又窄的物体可以怎么形容？
messages.en: How can I describe this long, narrow object?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħid li huwa fettuli, bħal strixxa.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħid li huwa fettuli, bħal strixxa.
messages.zh: 可以说它呈细长条状，像一根条带。
messages.en: You can say it is strip-like, like a strip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中把一个圆点拉成细长线，再用 fettuli 描述它；记住这个词说的是形状又长又窄。

gloss_zh: 严守细节者；完美主义者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who insists on exact standards or details, or strives to make everything perfect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坚持严格标准、认真计较细节的人，或力求凡事完美的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tinsisti fuq standards preċiżi u dettalji korretti, jew li tistinka biex kollox ikun perfett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对规则、标准或细节坚持严格要求的人
力求事事完美的人；完美主义者

formal.mt: L-editur huwa fettuq dwar id-dettalji u jiċċekkja kull referenza qabel il-pubblikazzjoni.
formal.en: The editor is a stickler for detail and checks every reference before publication.
formal.zh: 这位编辑对细节要求严格，出版前会核查每一条参考文献。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek tirranġa l-istess paġna? Mark: Iva, jien fettuq; irrid li kollox ikun perfett.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still adjusting the same page? Mark: Yes, I am a perfectionist; I want everything to be perfect.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还在调整同一页吗？马克：是啊，我是个完美主义者；我想让一切都尽善尽美。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你还在调整同一页吗？
messages.en: Are you still adjusting the same page?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien fettuq; irrid li kollox ikun perfett.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien fettuq; irrid li kollox ikun perfett.
messages.zh: 是啊，我是个完美主义者；我想让一切都尽善尽美。
messages.en: Yes, I am a perfectionist; I want everything to be perfect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位拿放大镜检查每个标点的人：守标准时是严谨较真，追求零瑕疵时是完美主义，两种意思都用 fettuq 记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dysentery, an intestinal illness involving severe diarrhoea that may contain blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 痢疾，一种肠道疾病，可引起严重腹泻，并可能出现血便。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-diżinterija, marda tal-imsaren li tikkawża dijarea qawwija li jista' jkun fiha d-demm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 痢疾。

formal.mt: It-tabib irreġistra każ ta' fetħa tad-demm fir-rapport.
formal.en: The doctor recorded a case of dysentery in the report.
formal.zh: 医生在报告中记录了一例痢疾病例。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'fetħa tad-demm' f'dan it-test? Anna: Tfisser id-diżinterija, marda tal-imsaren.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'fetħa tad-demm' mean in this text? Anna: It means dysentery, an intestinal illness.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇文章里的“fetħa tad-demm”是什么意思？Anna：意思是痢疾，一种肠道疾病。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“fetħa tad-demm”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'fetħa tad-demm' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Anna (老师)
messages.zh: 意思是痢疾，一种肠道疾病。
messages.en: It means dysentery, an intestinal illness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语作为疾病名称记忆，配上一张写着“痢疾”的词卡；练习时整组认读，避免逐词猜测病名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who burps, releasing gas from the stomach through the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过嘴排出胃中气体的人，即打嗝或嗳气的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li toħroġ gass mill-istonku minn ħalqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打嗝的人；从嘴里排出胃中气体的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-fewwieq storbjuż ġiegħel lill-mistednin iduru lejh.
formal.en: In the story, the noisy burper made the guests turn towards him.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个打嗝声音很大的人使宾客们都转头看他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-fewwieq fl-istorja? Pawlu: Ir-raġel li xorob malajr u mbagħad ħareġ gass minn ħalqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the burper in the story? Pawlu: The man who drank quickly and then burped.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里打嗝的人是谁？保罗：就是那个喝得很快，随后打了个嗝的男人。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里打嗝的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the burper in the story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-raġel li xorob malajr u mbagħad ħareġ gass minn ħalqu.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-raġel li xorob malajr u mbagħad ħareġ gass minn ħalqu.
messages.zh: 就是那个喝得很快，随后打了个嗝的男人。
messages.en: The man who drank quickly and then burped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 fewwieq 时想象饭后有人“嗝”了一声；这个名词指发出嗝声的人。

gloss_zh: 能引起打嗝的；能使人嗳气的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the ability to make someone burp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使人打嗝或嗳气作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jġiegħel lil xi ħadd joħroġ gass mill-istonku minn ħalqu.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to cause belching
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能引起嗳气的；具有使人打嗝作用的。

collocations.en: a drink that can cause belching

formal.mt: Fit-test, ix-xorb huwa deskritt bħala fewwieqi għax jista' jġiegħel lil min jixorbu joħroġ gass minn ħalqu.
formal.en: In the text, the drink is described as belching-inducing because it can make the person drinking it burp.
formal.zh: 文中把这种饮料描述为能引起嗳气，因为饮用者喝后可能会打嗝。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ix-xorb fewwieqi? Pawlu: Għalija iva; kull darba li nixorbu noħroġ gass minn ħalqi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this drink make you burp? Pawlu: It does for me; every time I drink it, I burp.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种饮料会让人打嗝吗？保罗：对我来说会；我每次喝它都会打嗝。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这种饮料会让人打嗝吗？
messages.en: Does this drink make you burp?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalija iva; kull darba li nixorbu noħroġ gass minn ħalqi.
messages.mt_standard: Għalija iva; kull darba li nixorbu noħroġ gass minn ħalqi.
messages.zh: 对我来说会；我每次喝它都会打嗝。
messages.en: It does for me; every time I drink it, I burp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 对照记忆：fewwieq 是打嗝的人，fewwieqi 则形容能让人打嗝的东西。

gloss_zh: 扇风器具；使空气流动的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object or device that moves the air and produces a breeze.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使空气流动、产生微风的物件或器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett jew apparat li jċaqlaq l-arja u joħloq żiffa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使空气流动、起扇风作用的东西

formal.mt: F'dan l-esperiment, biċċa kartun tintuża bħala fewwieġ biex iċċaqlaq l-arja lejn wiċċ l-ilma.
formal.en: In this experiment, a piece of cardboard is used as a fan to move air towards the surface of the water.
formal.zh: 在这个实验中，一块硬纸板被用作扇风器具，使空气朝水面流动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi s-sħana; tista' tagħtini dak il-fewwieġ tal-karta? Pawlu: Żgur, ħudu u agħmel ftit arja.
colloquial.en: Lara: I feel hot; can you pass me that paper fan? Pawlu: Of course, take it and fan yourself a little.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我觉得热；你能把那个纸扇递给我吗？保罗：当然，拿去扇扇风吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi s-sħana; tista' tagħtini dak il-fewwieġ tal-karta?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi s-sħana; tista' tagħtini dak il-fewwieġ tal-karta?
messages.zh: 我觉得热；你能把那个纸扇递给我吗？
messages.en: I feel hot; can you pass me that paper fan?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, ħudu u agħmel ftit arja.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, ħudu u agħmel ftit arja.
messages.zh: 当然，拿去扇扇风吧。
messages.en: Of course, take it and fan yourself a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手中的纸板扇一下，感受空气被推动，再把 fewwieġ 和这件扇风工具对应起来，记住它指东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a pleasant movement of air, or allowing air to circulate freely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有微风吹拂的，或空气能够自由流通的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fejn tinħass żiffa jew fejn l-arja tista' tiċċirkola liberament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有微风吹拂的
通风良好的；空气流通的

formal.mt: Is-sala għandha twieqi fuq żewġ naħat, li joħolqu ambjent fewwieġi għall-qari.
formal.en: The hall has windows on two sides, creating an airy environment for reading.
formal.zh: 大厅两侧都有窗户，营造了适合阅读的通风环境。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn noqogħdu bilqiegħda? Maja: Hawn taħt is-siġra; dan post fewwieġi u frisk.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where shall we sit? Maja: Here under the tree; this spot is breezy and cool.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们坐在哪里？玛雅：就坐这棵树下吧；这里有微风，很凉快。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we sit?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn taħt is-siġra; dan post fewwieġi u frisk.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn taħt is-siġra; dan post fewwieġi u frisk.
messages.zh: 就坐这棵树下吧；这里有微风，很凉快。
messages.en: Here under the tree; this spot is breezy and cool.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fewwieġi 放进两个画面：树下微风吹脸，室内开窗通风；共同点都是空气在舒适地流动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small box used to hold fragrant material and give off a pleasant scent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盛放芳香材料、散发香气的小盒子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kaxxa żgħira li żżomm materjal ifuħ u minnha toħroġ riħa pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装有芳香材料、用来散发香气的小盒子；香盒

formal.mt: Il-fewwieħa tal-fidda murija fil-vetrina hija kaxxa żgħira maħsuba biex iżżomm materjal ifuħ.
formal.en: The silver scent-box displayed in the case is a small box intended to hold fragrant material.
formal.zh: 陈列柜中展示的银制香盒，是一种用于盛放芳香材料的小盒子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'hemm f'din il-kaxxa żgħira? Mark: Din fewwieħa; fiha l-lavanda, u minnha ġejja dik ir-riħa ħelwa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is in this little box? Mark: This is a scent-box; it contains lavender, which gives off that lovely scent.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个小盒子里有什么？马克：这是香盒；里面装着薰衣草，那股好闻的香气就是从这里散出来的。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个小盒子里有什么？
messages.en: What is in this little box?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din fewwieħa; fiha l-lavanda, u minnha ġejja dik ir-riħa ħelwa.
messages.mt_standard: Din fewwieħa; fiha l-lavanda, u minnha ġejja dik ir-riħa ħelwa.
messages.zh: 这是香盒；里面装着薰衣草，那股好闻的香气就是从这里散出来的。
messages.en: This is a scent-box; it contains lavender, which gives off that lovely scent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开一个装着薰衣草的小香盒，先看见盒子，再闻到香气；用这组视觉和嗅觉画面记住 fewwieħa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a pleasant, sweet smell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散发令人愉快的香气的；芳香的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu riħa tajba u pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芳香的；散发香气的。
气味香甜宜人的；闻起来很香的。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut ibigħ sapun fewwieħi magħmul bl-idejn.
formal.en: The shop sells fragrant handmade soap.
formal.zh: 这家商店出售芳香的手工肥皂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-te kemm hu fewwieħi! Pawlu: Iva, ir-riħa tiegħu togħġobni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: This tea smells so lovely! Pawlu: Yes, I really like its scent.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这茶真香啊！保罗：是啊，我很喜欢它的香气。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这茶真香啊！
messages.en: This tea smells so lovely!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我很喜欢它的香气。
messages.en: Yes, I really like its scent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fewwieħi 和热茶升起的香气一起记：鼻子闻着舒服，就是“芳香的”。

gloss_zh: 发出嘶嘶声；滋滋作响；慌乱行事；冒失者；容易惊慌的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a fizzling or sizzling sound, or to act in a confused manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出嘶嘶或滋滋的声音；也可指行事慌乱、没有条理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss bħal żejt jaħraq fit-taġen, jew jaġixxi b'mod konfuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出嘶嘶声。
滋滋作响，尤指食物或油受热时发出的声音。

sense_translations.en_definition: to act in a confused manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 慌乱地行事；做事没有条理。
做事冒失、容易出错的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: someone who is prone to panic
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易惊慌失措的人。

collocations.en: he acted in confusion because of panic

formal.mt: Iż-żejt fexfex fit-taġen hekk kif il-kok żied il-patata.
formal.en: The oil sizzled in the pan as the cook added the potatoes.
formal.zh: 厨师把土豆放入锅中时，油滋滋作响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu fexfex meta ma sabx iċ-ċwievet. Rita: Iva, beda jfittex kullimkien bla ma waqaf jaħseb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu got flustered when he couldn't find the keys. Rita: Yes, he started searching everywhere without stopping to think.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗找不到钥匙时，慌得乱了手脚。丽塔：是啊，他开始到处乱找，也不停下来想一想。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu fexfex meta ma sabx iċ-ċwievet.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu fexfex meta ma sabx iċ-ċwievet.
messages.zh: 保罗找不到钥匙时，慌得乱了手脚。
messages.en: Pawlu got flustered when he couldn't find the keys.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, beda jfittex kullimkien bla ma waqaf jaħseb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, beda jfittex kullimkien bla ma waqaf jaħseb.
messages.zh: 是啊，他开始到处乱找，也不停下来想一想。
messages.en: Yes, he started searching everywhere without stopping to think.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 fexfex：锅里滋滋响，人急得团团转；另把指人的名词义单独记牢。

gloss_zh: 用油煎炸食物的人；做事冒失的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who fries food in oil; in a separate sense, a person who blunders.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用油煎炸食物的人；另一义为做事冒失、容易出错的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqli l-ikel fiż-żejt; f'sens ieħor, persuna li tagħmel żbalji bl-addoċċ.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who fries food in oil
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用油煎炸食物的人。
做事冒失、常犯错误的人。

formal.mt: Il-fexfiex tal-ħut ħejja ż-żejt u beda jaqli l-ewwel porzjon.
formal.en: The fish fryer prepared the oil and began frying the first portion.
formal.zh: 负责炸鱼的人备好油，开始炸第一份鱼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħt lil dak il-karattru fexfiex? Pawlu: Għax dejjem jgħaġġel u jagħmel żball wara ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you call that character a blunderer? Pawlu: Because he always rushes and makes one mistake after another.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把那个角色叫作冒失鬼？保罗：因为他总是急急忙忙，接连犯错。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex sejjaħt lil dak il-karattru fexfiex?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex sejjaħt lil dak il-karattru fexfiex?
messages.zh: 你为什么把那个角色叫作冒失鬼？
messages.en: Why did you call that character a blunderer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem jgħaġġel u jagħmel żball wara ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem jgħaġġel u jagħmel żball wara ieħor.
messages.zh: 因为他总是急急忙忙，接连犯错。
messages.en: Because he always rushes and makes one mistake after another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fexfiex 画两张人物卡：一位在油锅前煎鱼，一位匆忙出错；靠语境选对应人物。

gloss_zh: 发出嘶嘶声的；嘶嘶作响的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Making a fizzling or hissing sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出嘶嘶声的，用于描述物体的发声状态或声音特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel ħoss bħal ta' gass jew fwar ħiereġ minn fetħa żgħira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出细碎嘶嘶声的。
发出嘶嘶声的，如气体或蒸汽逸出时的声音。

formal.mt: Mit-toqba ż-żgħira fil-pajp beda ħiereġ ħoss fexfiexi.
formal.en: A hissing sound began coming from the small hole in the pipe.
formal.zh: 管道上的小孔开始发出嘶嘶声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss fexfiexi? Pawlu: Iva, ġej mill-kitla; l-ilma qed jagħli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear that hissing sound? Pawlu: Yes, it's coming from the kettle; the water is boiling.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见那个嘶嘶声了吗？保罗：听见了，是水壶发出的；水开了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见那个嘶嘶声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that hissing sound?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mill-kitla; l-ilma qed jagħli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mill-kitla; l-ilma qed jagħli.
messages.zh: 听见了，是水壶发出的；水开了。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the kettle; the water is boiling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fexfiexi 贴在水壶旁的“嘶嘶声”标签上，记住它是描述声音状态的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small stick with a tip that can be ignited by striking it, used to light a fire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一端带有可通过摩擦点燃的药头、用来引火的小棒，即火柴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stikka żgħira b'ras li tieħu n-nar meta togħrokha ma' wiċċ adattat, użata biex tqabbad in-nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火柴；通过摩擦点燃、用于引火的小棒。

formal.mt: Ir-raġel qabbad fexfix u użah biex jixgħel ix-xemgħa.
formal.en: The man lit a match and used it to light the candle.
formal.zh: 那名男子划燃一根火柴，用它点亮蜡烛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek fexfix biex nixgħel ix-xemgħa? Pawlu: Iva, hawn wieħed ħdejn il-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a match so I can light the candle? Pawlu: Yes, there's one here beside the box.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有火柴吗？我想点蜡烛。保罗：有，盒子旁边这里有一根。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你有火柴吗？我想点蜡烛。
messages.en: Do you have a match so I can light the candle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 有，盒子旁边这里有一根。
messages.en: Yes, there's one here beside the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fexfix 与“划一下、点蜡烛”的动作连起来记，脑中固定一根火柴的画面。

gloss_zh: 小型烟花；小型手持火花棒

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small sparkler or firework that gives off sparks when lit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 点燃后放出火花的小型烟花或火花棒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir tan-nar li joħroġ xrar meta jinxtegħel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小型火花棒或小型烟花。

collocations.zh: 一支小型火花棒或一枚小烟花

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċelebrazzjoni, fexfux żgħir xegħel u ħareġ xrar qawwi għal ftit sekondi.
formal.en: During the celebration, a small firework lit up and gave off bright sparks for a few seconds.
formal.zh: 庆祝活动中，一枚小烟花亮了起来，迸出数秒钟的明亮火花。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-fexfux fil-ġnien? Pawlu: Iva, kien żgħir, imma x-xrar tiegħu kien sabiħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the little firework in the garden? Pawlu: Yes, it was small, but its sparks were beautiful.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见花园里的小烟花了吗？保罗：看见了，虽然小，火花却很漂亮。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见花园里的小烟花了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the little firework in the garden?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien żgħir, imma x-xrar tiegħu kien sabiħ ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien żgħir, imma x-xrar tiegħu kien sabiħ ħafna.
messages.zh: 看见了，虽然小，火花却很漂亮。
messages.en: Yes, it was small, but its sparks were beautiful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排画图区分：fexfix 是点火用的火柴，fexfux 是放出漂亮火花的小烟花。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden wish or idea that arises without careful thought.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经仔细考虑而突然产生的愿望或念头，常指一时兴起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa jew idea li tiġi f'daqqa, mingħajr ħafna ħsieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一时兴起的念头；突发的愿望

formal.mt: Id-deċiżjoni kienet ibbażata fuq ħtieġa reali, u ma kinitx sempliċi fexxa.
formal.en: The decision was based on a real need and was not a mere whim.
formal.zh: 这项决定基于实际需要，并非仅仅出于一时兴起。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex trid tixtri kitarra llum? Mark: Ma nafx, ġietni fexxa li nitgħallem indoqq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you want to buy a guitar today? Mark: I don't know; I suddenly felt like learning to play.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么今天想买吉他？马克：我也不知道，就是突然想学着弹了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么今天想买吉他？
messages.en: Why do you want to buy a guitar today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx, ġietni fexxa li nitgħallem indoqq.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx, ġietni fexxa li nitgħallem indoqq.
messages.zh: 我也不知道，就是突然想学着弹了。
messages.en: I don't know; I suddenly felt like learning to play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象路过乐器店突然想学吉他：把 fexxa 与这种一时兴起的念头联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden appearance or manifestation; also a shooting star or an impetus for doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物的突然出现或显现；也可指流星，或促使做某事的动力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dehra jew manifestazzjoni għal għarrieda; tista' tfisser ukoll kewkba li taqa' jew ħeġġa biex wieħed jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然的显现；骤然出现。
流星。
做某事的动力；促使某事发生的激励。

collocations.en: to see a shooting star in the sky
collocations.zh: 看见天空中的一颗流星

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi feġġa ta' dawl qawwi li damet biss ftit sekondi.
formal.en: The report describes a sudden appearance of bright light that lasted only a few seconds.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一次强光的突然显现，持续时间仅有几秒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt dik il-feġġa fis-sema? Luqa: Iva, kienet sabiħa, imma għaddiet malajr!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see that shooting star in the sky? Luqa: Yes, it was beautiful, but it went by quickly!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到天空中那颗流星了吗？卢卡：看到了，很漂亮，不过一下就过去了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到天空中那颗流星了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that shooting star in the sky?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet sabiħa, imma għaddiet malajr!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet sabiħa, imma għaddiet malajr!
messages.zh: 看到了，很漂亮，不过一下就过去了！
messages.en: Yes, it was beautiful, but it went by quickly!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个学习画面分别记义：光突然出现、流星划过、心中有了行动动力；这是联想记忆，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 正在显现；开始出现的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ongoing process of something beginning to appear or emerge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物正在开始显现、出现或冒出的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa tkun qed tibda tidher jew toħroġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: in the process of appearing or emerging
sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在显现或出现的过程；某物开始冒出、逐渐可见的状态。

collocations.en: the emergence of the first leaves

formal.mt: L-osservazzjonijiet ta' kuljum juru l-feġġien tal-ewwel weraq fuq il-pjanta.
formal.en: The daily observations show the emergence of the first leaves on the plant.
formal.zh: 每日观察记录显示，这株植物正在长出最初几片叶子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tieħu ritratt tal-pjanta kuljum? Toni: Biex nuri l-feġġien tal-ewwel weraq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you taking a photo of the plant every day? Toni: To show the emergence of its first leaves.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么每天都给这株植物拍照？托尼：为了展示它最初几片叶子冒出的过程。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tieħu ritratt tal-pjanta kuljum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tieħu ritratt tal-pjanta kuljum?
messages.zh: 你为什么每天都给这株植物拍照？
messages.en: Why are you taking a photo of the plant every day?

messages.speaker: Toni (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 为了展示它最初几片叶子冒出的过程。
messages.en: To show the emergence of its first leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象连续拍摄的新叶照片：叶子正在一点点冒出来。把 feġġien 与“出现正在进行中”的过程画面相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become clear, said of the sky or the weather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指天空或天气由阴沉转为晴朗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għas-sema jew għat-temp meta jiċċara wara s-sħab jew ix-xita.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become clear (used in a weather context, of the sky etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 放晴；指天空等在天气语境中变得晴朗。

collocations.en: it cleared up after the rain

formal.mt: Wara x-xita ta' filgħodu, is-sema feħa u l-grupp kompla bil-mixja.
formal.en: After the morning rain, the sky cleared and the group continued its walk.
formal.zh: 早晨的雨停后，天空放晴，大家继续步行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad hemm ħafna sħab? Mark: Le, is-sema feħa. Nistgħu noħorġu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are there still lots of clouds? Mark: No, the sky has cleared. We can go out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：现在云还很多吗？马克：不多了，天空已经放晴。我们可以出门了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 现在云还很多吗？
messages.en: Are there still lots of clouds?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不多了，天空已经放晴。我们可以出门了。
messages.en: No, the sky has cleared. We can go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雨后乌云散开、天空放晴的画面，把 feħa 与天气变晴这个变化联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make goods or products, especially through an organized production process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过有组织的生产过程制造物品或产品，尤其指工厂生产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel prodotti jew oġġetti, speċjalment permezz ta' proċess ta' produzzjoni f'fabbrika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制造；生产产品

formal.mt: Il-manifattur ffabbrika partijiet tal-metall skont l-ispeċifikazzjonijiet tal-klijent.
formal.en: The manufacturer manufactured metal parts according to the client's specifications.
formal.zh: 制造商按照客户的规格要求制造了金属零件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ffabbrika din il-mejda? Pawlu: Manifattur lokali. Għażilna l-injam aħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who manufactured this table? Pawlu: A local manufacturer. We chose the wood ourselves.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张桌子是谁制造的？保罗：一家本地制造商。木材是我们自己选的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张桌子是谁制造的？
messages.en: Who manufactured this table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 一家本地制造商。木材是我们自己选的。
messages.en: A local manufacturer. We chose the wood ourselves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ffabbrika 放进工厂生产线的画面：原料经过加工，变成家具或零件，记住“制造”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put documents or records into an organized system for storage and later use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把文件或记录按一定次序放入档案系统中，以便保存和日后查阅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed dokumenti jew rekords f'sistema organizzata biex jinżammu u jinstabu aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将文件归档；存档

formal.mt: L-assistent ffajlja d-dokumenti skont id-data biex ikunu jistgħu jinstabu faċilment.
formal.en: The assistant filed the documents by date so that they could be found easily.
formal.zh: 助理按日期将文件归档，以便日后查找。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn huma l-irċevuti tax-xahar li għadda? Mark: Toni ffajlja l-irċevuti fil-fowlder blu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where are last month's receipts? Mark: Toni filed the receipts in the blue folder.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：上个月的收据在哪里？马克：托尼把收据归档到蓝色文件夹里了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn huma l-irċevuti tax-xahar li għadda?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn huma l-irċevuti tax-xahar li għadda?
messages.zh: 上个月的收据在哪里？
messages.en: Where are last month's receipts?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 托尼把收据归档到蓝色文件夹里了。
messages.en: Toni filed the receipts in the blue folder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“收据按日期放进文件夹”的动作记 ffajlja；重点是有条理地保存，方便以后查找。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make or alter a document, record, or other item so that it falsely appears genuine or accurate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作虚假的文件、记录等，或加以篡改，使其看起来真实或准确。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħloq jew ibiddel dokument, rekord jew oġġett ieħor biex jidher ġenwin jew korrett meta mhuwiex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伪造；篡改文件、记录等，使其呈现虚假内容

formal.mt: L-investigazzjoni kkonfermat li l-impjegat ffalsifika r-rekords tal-ħlasijiet.
formal.en: The investigation confirmed that the employee had falsified the payment records.
formal.zh: 调查证实，该员工篡改了付款记录。

colloquial.mt: Lea: Għaliex ma aċċettawx il-formola? Samwel: Għax xi ħadd ffalsifika l-firma. Issa jridu formola ġdida bil-firma vera.
colloquial.en: Lea: Why didn't they accept the form? Samwel: Because someone forged the signature. Now they want a new form with the genuine signature.
colloquial.zh: 莱娅：他们为什么没接受那张表格？萨姆韦尔：因为有人伪造了签名。现在他们要一张带有真实签名的新表格。

messages.speaker: Lea (同事)
messages.zh: 他们为什么没接受那张表格？
messages.en: Why didn't they accept the form?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax xi ħadd ffalsifika l-firma. Issa jridu formola ġdida bil-firma vera.
messages.mt_standard: Għax xi ħadd ffalsifika l-firma. Issa jridu formola ġdida bil-firma vera.
messages.zh: 因为有人伪造了签名。现在他们要一张带有真实签名的新表格。
messages.en: Because someone forged the signature. Now they want a new form with the genuine signature.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ffalsifika 与“把假的做得像真的”联系起来：伪造签名、篡改记录都能帮助记住这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give a shot spin, making the ball rotate as it travels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 击球时使球带有旋转。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti dawran lill-ballun meta tolqtu f'xutt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使击出的球带有旋转；打出旋转球。

formal.mt: Il-plejer ffalzja x-xutt, u l-ballun dar waqt li kien miexi lejn il-lasta.
formal.en: The player put spin on the shot, and the ball rotated as it travelled towards the goal.
formal.zh: 球员踢出了旋转球，球在飞向球门时不断旋转。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-ballun qed idur hekk? Lara: Għax il-plejer ffalzja x-xutt.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is the ball spinning like that? Lara: Because the player put spin on the shot.
colloquial.zh: 马克：球为什么那样旋转？拉拉：因为球员击球时加了旋转。

messages.speaker: Mark (观众)
messages.zh: 球为什么那样旋转？
messages.en: Why is the ball spinning like that?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为球员击球时加了旋转。
messages.en: Because the player put spin on the shot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和击球瞬间联系起来：球被击出后还在转，记住的是加旋转这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak proudly about one's achievements or possessions in order to impress others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为给别人留下深刻印象而夸耀自己的成就或财物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titkellem bi ftaħir dwar dak li għamilt jew għandek biex timpressjona lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to brag, to boast, to show off
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吹嘘自己的本事、成就或财物；夸耀；炫耀。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, id-direttur ffanfarunja bis-suċċessi tiegħu mingħajr ma semma l-kontribut tat-tim.
formal.en: During the meeting, the director boasted about his successes without mentioning the team's contribution.
formal.zh: 会议期间，主管夸耀自己的成就，却没有提到团队的贡献。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar l-ikel ma' Pawlu? Nina: Ffanfarunja bil-karozza l-ġdida tiegħu l-ħin kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the meal with Pawlu? Nina: He showed off his new car the whole time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：和保罗一起吃饭怎么样？妮娜：他一直在炫耀自己的新车。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 和保罗一起吃饭怎么样？
messages.en: How was the meal with Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ffanfarunja bil-karozza l-ġdida tiegħu l-ħin kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Ffanfarunja bil-karozza l-ġdida tiegħu l-ħin kollu.
messages.zh: 他一直在炫耀自己的新车。
messages.en: He showed off his new car the whole time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人不停展示新车、奖杯和成绩，把这个词记作说个不停地夸耀自己。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To boast about oneself or show off something one has in order to attract admiration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了获得赞赏而自吹自擂，或炫耀自己拥有的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiftaħar bik innifsek jew b'xi ħaġa li għandek biex ħaddieħor jammirak.

sense_translations.en_definition: to brag, to boast, to show off
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吹牛；夸耀自己的能力或成绩；炫耀所拥有的东西。

collocations.en: boasted in front of his friends

formal.mt: Fl-intervista, l-atleta ffanfra bil-midalji tiegħu u qal li ħadd ma seta' jegħlbu.
formal.en: In the interview, the athlete boasted about his medals and said that nobody could beat him.
formal.zh: 采访中，这位运动员夸耀自己的奖牌，并说没有人能击败他。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qal Ben wara l-logħba? Mark: Ffanfra quddiem kulħadd u qal li rebaħ waħdu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Ben say after the game? Mark: He boasted in front of everyone and said he had won it on his own.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：本在比赛后说了什么？马克：他当着大家的面吹牛，说比赛全靠他一个人才赢。

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.zh: 本在比赛后说了什么？
messages.en: What did Ben say after the game?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ffanfra quddiem kulħadd u qal li rebaħ waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Ffanfra quddiem kulħadd u qal li rebaħ waħdu.
messages.zh: 他当着大家的面吹牛，说比赛全靠他一个人才赢。
messages.en: He boasted in front of everyone and said he had won it on his own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象赛后有人举着奖牌反复说全靠自己，把这个画面和吹牛、自夸一起记住。

gloss_zh: 吃得过量；在泥水中打滚

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat excessively, consuming more food than is needed or comfortable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进食过量，吃下超过需要或让身体感到舒适的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiekol iżżejjed, aktar milli għandek bżonn jew aktar milli tiflaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃得过多；过量进食；大吃大喝。
在泥、水等里面打滚或翻滚。

formal.mt: Wara li ffanga fl-ikel waqt il-festa, ir-raġel ħassu mimli wisq biex ikompli jiekol.
formal.en: After eating excessively at the celebration, the man felt too full to eat any more.
formal.zh: 在庆祝活动上吃得过量之后，这名男子撑得再也吃不下了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħanżir kollu tajn? Toni: Għax ffanga fit-tajn ħdejn l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the pig covered in mud? Toni: Because it wallowed in the mud beside the water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这头猪怎么浑身都是泥？托尼：因为它刚才在水边的泥里打滚。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场访客)
messages.zh: 这头猪怎么浑身都是泥？
messages.en: Why is the pig covered in mud?

messages.speaker: Toni (农场主)
messages.zh: 因为它刚才在水边的泥里打滚。
messages.en: Because it wallowed in the mud beside the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分开记两张图：餐桌前吃得太撑，泥塘里来回打滚；用食物和泥巴提示不同义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wrap an injured body part in a bandage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用绷带包住受伤的身体部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Torbot parti midruba tal-ġisem b'faxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某物加上条纹或条带状图案。
用绷带包扎伤口或受伤部位。

collocations.en: striped the wall with blue stripes

formal.mt: L-infermier naddaf il-ferita u ffaxxja l-id tal-pazjent b'faxxa nadifa.
formal.en: The nurse cleaned the wound and bandaged the patient's hand with a clean bandage.
formal.zh: 护士清洁伤口后，用干净的绷带包扎了患者的手。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'biddel il-pittur fil-kamra? Lara: Ffaxxja l-ħajt bi strixxi blu u bojod.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did the painter change in the room? Lara: He striped the wall in blue and white.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：油漆工把房间改了什么？拉拉：他给墙面刷上了蓝白条纹。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 油漆工把房间改了什么？
messages.en: What did the painter change in the room?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ffaxxja l-ħajt bi strixxi blu u bojod.
messages.mt_standard: Ffaxxja l-ħajt bi strixxi blu u bojod.
messages.zh: 他给墙面刷上了蓝白条纹。
messages.en: He striped the wall in blue and white.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两种带状画面帮助记忆：墙面上的彩色条纹，以及伤手外面缠着的绷带。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep oneself busy with household tasks such as cleaning and tidying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续忙于清洁、整理等家务活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' okkupat bix-xogħol tad-dar, bħat-tindif u t-tqegħid tal-affarijiet f'posthom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忙于做家务；不停地料理家务

collocations.en: keep busy doing housework at home
keep busy doing housework all morning

formal.mt: Pawlu ffaċenda d-dar matul l-għodwa kollha biex il-kmamar ikunu nodfa għall-mistednin.
formal.en: Pawlu kept busy doing housework all morning so that the rooms would be clean for the guests.
formal.zh: 保罗整个上午都忙着做家务，好让房间干干净净地迎接客人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'għamel missierek dalgħodu? Ben: Ffaċenda d-dar. Naddaf il-kċina u rranġa s-salott.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did your dad do this morning? Ben: He kept busy doing housework. He cleaned the kitchen and tidied the living room.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你爸爸今天上午做什么了？本：他一直忙着做家务，打扫了厨房，还整理了客厅。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸今天上午做什么了？
messages.en: What did your dad do this morning?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ffaċenda d-dar. Naddaf il-kċina u rranġa s-salott.
messages.mt_standard: Ffaċenda d-dar. Naddaf il-kċina u rranġa s-salott.
messages.zh: 他一直忙着做家务，打扫了厨房，还整理了客厅。
messages.en: He kept busy doing housework. He cleaned the kitchen and tidied the living room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个上午在厨房与客厅之间来回忙碌：ffaċenda 强调忙着料理家务的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an action or process easier to carry out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过提供帮助或改善条件，使某项行动或过程更容易进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel azzjoni jew proċess aktar faċli biex jitwettaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使更容易进行；为……提供便利；促进

formal.mt: Is-servizz il-ġdid ffaċilita l-aċċess għall-informazzjoni għall-istudenti kollha.
formal.en: The new service facilitated access to information for all students.
formal.zh: 这项新服务使所有学生都能更方便地获取信息。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-grupp il-ġdid għenkom? David: Iva, ffaċilita l-komunikazzjoni. Issa kulħadd jirċievi l-aħbarijiet fl-istess ħin.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has the new group helped you? David: Yes, it has made communication easier. Now everyone receives the news at the same time.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：新建的群帮到你们了吗？戴维：帮到了，沟通方便多了。现在大家能同时收到消息。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 新建的群帮到你们了吗？
messages.en: Has the new group helped you?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ffaċilita l-komunikazzjoni. Issa kulħadd jirċievi l-aħbarijiet fl-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ffaċilita l-komunikazzjoni. Issa kulħadd jirċievi l-aħbarijiet fl-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 帮到了，沟通方便多了。现在大家能同时收到消息。
messages.en: Yes, it has made communication easier. Now everyone receives the news at the same time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ffaċilita 想成给办事过程铺平道路：少一道障碍，就多一分便利，事情更容易完成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut or shape a gemstone or another object so that it has small flat faces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 切割或加工宝石等物体，使其表面形成多个小平面，即刻面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' jew jaħdem ġawhra jew oġġett ieħor biex jagħtih uċuħ żgħar u ċatti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给宝石等切磨出小平面；加工刻面

formal.mt: L-artiġjan ffaċċettja l-ġawhra b'attenzjoni biex joħloq uċuħ żgħar u regolari.
formal.en: The craftsperson carefully faceted the gemstone to create small, regular faces.
formal.zh: 工匠仔细地为宝石加工刻面，形成细小而规整的平面。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex din il-ġawhra għandha tant uċuħ żgħar? Toni: Għax l-artiġjan ffaċċettja l-ġawhra. Ara kif tirrifletti d-dawl.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does this gemstone have so many little faces? Toni: Because the craftsperson faceted it. Look how it reflects the light.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这颗宝石为什么有这么多小平面？托尼：因为工匠给它切磨了刻面。你看它怎样反射光线。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din il-ġawhra għandha tant uċuħ żgħar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din il-ġawhra għandha tant uċuħ żgħar?
messages.zh: 这颗宝石为什么有这么多小平面？
messages.en: Why does this gemstone have so many little faces?

messages.speaker: Toni (珠宝商)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-artiġjan ffaċċettja l-ġawhra. Ara kif tirrifletti d-dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-artiġjan ffaċċettja l-ġawhra. Ara kif tirrifletti d-dawl.
messages.zh: 因为工匠给它切磨了刻面。你看它怎样反射光线。
messages.en: Because the craftsperson faceted it. Look how it reflects the light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把圆滑的宝石加工成许多闪光的小平面：ffaċċettja 对应“切磨出刻面”这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To present oneself before someone, or to confront a person, situation, or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出现在某人面前、出面或现身；也指面对某人、某种情况或困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jippreżenta ruħu quddiem xi ħadd, jew jikkonfronta persuna, sitwazzjoni jew diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出面；现身；出现在某人面前
面对；正视或应对某人、情况或困难

formal.mt: It-tim ffaċċja diversi diffikultajiet waqt it-twettiq tal-proġett.
formal.en: The team faced several difficulties while carrying out the project.
formal.zh: 团队在实施项目的过程中遇到并面对了多项困难。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif mar l-eżami ta' Mark? Luqa: Ffaċċja mistoqsija diffiċli, imma baqa' kalm.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Mark's exam go? Luqa: He faced a difficult question, but he stayed calm.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克考得怎么样？卢卡：他碰到了一道难题，不过一直很冷静。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 马克考得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark's exam go?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ffaċċja mistoqsija diffiċli, imma baqa' kalm.
messages.mt_standard: Ffaċċja mistoqsija diffiċli, imma baqa' kalm.
messages.zh: 他碰到了一道难题，不过一直很冷静。
messages.en: He faced a difficult question, but he stayed calm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 ffaċċja：走到别人面前是“出面”，站在困难面前是“面对”。这是情境联想。

gloss_zh: 使组成联合会；使结成联邦

teaching_sense.en_definition: To unite separate organizations or states into a federation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使原本分开的组织或国家联合起来，组成联合会或联邦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad organizzazzjonijiet jew stati separati f'federazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使多个组织组成联合会，或使多个政治实体结成联邦。

collocations.zh: 使地方协会组成联合会
使体育俱乐部组成联合会

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ffedera l-għaqdiet lokali biex ikunu jistgħu jirrappreżentaw l-interessi komuni tagħhom.
formal.en: The committee federated the local associations so that they could represent their common interests.
formal.zh: 委员会促使地方协会组成联合会，以便共同代表各自共有的利益。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-kumitat ffedera l-klabbs? Sara: Biex jaħdmu flimkien u jorganizzaw kampjonat wieħed.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did the committee federate the clubs? Sara: So they could work together and organize a single championship.
colloquial.zh: 马克：委员会为什么让这些俱乐部组成联合会？萨拉：为了让它们合作，共同举办一项锦标赛。

messages.speaker: Mark (俱乐部会员)
messages.zh: 委员会为什么让这些俱乐部组成联合会？
messages.en: Why did the committee federate the clubs?

messages.speaker: Sara (俱乐部负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jaħdmu flimkien u jorganizzaw kampjonat wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jaħdmu flimkien u jorganizzaw kampjonat wieħed.
messages.zh: 为了让它们合作，共同举办一项锦标赛。
messages.en: So they could work together and organize a single championship.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几家俱乐部把各自的旗帜放到同一面联合会旗帜下，记住组成联合组织的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put up a fence around or along an area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某一区域周围或沿其边界架设围栏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twaqqaf ċint madwar żona jew tul il-konfini tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to fence, to erect a fence
sense_translations.zh_definition: 架设围栏或篱笆；用围栏围住一块地方。

formal.mt: Is-sid ffensja l-għalqa biex iżomm l-annimali ġewwa u jipproteġi l-uċuħ tar-raba' ta' ħdejha.
formal.en: The owner fenced the field to keep the animals inside and protect the crops next to it.
formal.zh: 主人用围栏围住田地，把动物留在里面，并保护旁边的农作物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Toni fil-ġnien ilbieraħ? Ben: Ffensja l-ġnien biex il-kelb ma joħroġx fit-triq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Toni do in the garden yesterday? Ben: He fenced the garden so the dog would not get out onto the road.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼昨天在花园做了什么？本：他给花园装了围栏，免得狗跑到马路上。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 托尼昨天在花园做了什么？
messages.en: What did Toni do in the garden yesterday?

messages.speaker: Ben (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ffensja l-ġnien biex il-kelb ma joħroġx fit-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Ffensja l-ġnien biex il-kelb ma joħroġx fit-triq.
messages.zh: 他给花园装了围栏，免得狗跑到马路上。
messages.en: He fenced the garden so the dog would not get out onto the road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象沿花园边界一根根立起栏杆，最后围成一圈，把这个词和架设围栏一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To provide the money needed for a project, activity, or purchase.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为项目、活动或购买事项提供所需资金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tipprovdi l-flus meħtieġa għal proġett, attività jew xirja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某项活动、项目或购买提供资金；资助。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill lokali ffinanzja l-proġett biex il-librerija tkun tista' tixtri kompjuters ġodda.
formal.en: The local council financed the project so that the library could buy new computers.
formal.zh: 地方议会为该项目提供资金，使图书馆能够购买新电脑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ffinanzja x-xiri tat-tagħmir il-ġdid? Mark: Il-klabb ħallas għalih bil-flus li ġabar mill-membri.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who financed the purchase of the new equipment? Mark: The club paid for it with the money it collected from its members.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：购置新设备的钱是谁提供的？马克：俱乐部用向会员筹集的钱支付了费用。

messages.speaker: Sara (俱乐部会员)
messages.zh: 购置新设备的钱是谁提供的？
messages.en: Who financed the purchase of the new equipment?

messages.speaker: Mark (俱乐部财务负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-klabb ħallas għalih bil-flus li ġabar mill-membri.
messages.mt_standard: Il-klabb ħallas għalih bil-flus li ġabar mill-membri.
messages.zh: 俱乐部用向会员筹集的钱支付了费用。
messages.en: The club paid for it with the money it collected from its members.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象项目计划旁边放着一笔专门准备的经费，记住这个词表示为事情提供所需资金。

gloss_zh: 确定；安排；执着于；使照片影像定影

teaching_sense.en_definition: To decide on and establish something, such as a date, time or arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把日期、时间或安排等确定下来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeċiedi u tistabbilixxi xi ħaġa, bħal data, ħin jew arranġament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事过分着迷或反复挂心，难以转移注意力。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fix, arrange, set, sort out
sense_translations.zh_definition: 确定、安排、设定或处理妥当。
使摄影影像定影，让显出的影像固定下来。
抱定一个想法，固执地认定某事。

collocations.en: set a date for the meeting
set a time for the appointment

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ffissa d-data tal-laqgħa għall-għaxra ta' Mejju u informa lill-membri kollha.
formal.en: The committee set the meeting date for 10 May and informed all the members.
formal.zh: 委员会将会议日期定在五月十日，并通知了全体成员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark ffissa ħin għal-laqgħa? Lara: Iva, fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu. Maja: Sewwa, nasal ftit qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Mark set a time for the meeting? Lara: Yes, at nine in the morning. Maja: Good, I'll arrive a little early.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克确定开会时间了吗？拉拉：确定了，早上九点。玛雅：好，我会提前一点到。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克确定开会时间了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark set a time for the meeting?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 确定了，早上九点。
messages.en: Yes, at nine in the morning.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 好，我会提前一点到。
messages.en: Good, I'll arrive a little early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“固定下来”的画面串联各义：日期固定是确定安排，注意力固定在一点是执着，摄影影像固定则是定影。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel hungry and want something to eat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到肚子饿，想吃东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħoss il-ġuħ u tkun trid tiekol xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到饥饿；肚子饿。

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, it-tifel ffjakka u talab xi ħaġa x'jiekol.
formal.en: After the long walk, the boy felt hungry and asked for something to eat.
formal.zh: 长时间步行后，男孩感到饥饿，便要了些吃的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu mar fil-kċina? Maja: Ffjakka wara l-mixja u mar jagħmel biċċa ħobż. Lara: Nagħmillu ftit te wkoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu go into the kitchen? Maja: He felt hungry after the walk and went to prepare some bread. Lara: I'll make him some tea too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗为什么去厨房了？玛雅：他散步后饿了，去准备点面包。拉拉：我也给他泡点茶。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么去厨房了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu go into the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ffjakka wara l-mixja u mar jagħmel biċċa ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Ffjakka wara l-mixja u mar jagħmel biċċa ħobż.
messages.zh: 他散步后饿了，去准备点面包。
messages.en: He felt hungry after the walk and went to prepare some bread.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我也给他泡点茶。
messages.en: I'll make him some tea too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“走完长路就找面包”的小故事，记住它描述肚子饿的感觉，尚未表示已经吃东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow or develop successfully; also, for a plant to produce flowers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生长或发展得很好，呈现兴旺状态；也指植物开花。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikber jew tiżviluppa tajjeb u tirnexxi; għal pjanta, tagħmel il-fjuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蓬勃发展；繁荣兴旺。
开花；绽放。

formal.mt: In-negozju lokali ffjorixxa wara li nfetaħ is-suq il-ġdid, u nħolqu aktar impjiegi.
formal.en: Local business flourished after the new market opened, and more jobs were created.
formal.zh: 新市场开业后，当地商业蓬勃发展，创造了更多就业机会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-ġiżimin fil-ġnien? Lara: Iva, fl-aħħar ffjorixxa! Maja: Il-fjuri tiegħu għandhom riħa sabiħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen the jasmine in the garden? Lara: Yes, it has finally bloomed! Maja: Its flowers smell lovely.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见花园里的茉莉了吗？拉拉：看见了，终于开花了！玛雅：它的花真香。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你看见花园里的茉莉了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the jasmine in the garden?

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 看见了，终于开花了！
messages.en: Yes, it has finally bloomed!

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 它的花真香。
messages.en: Its flowers smell lovely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象花园开满花，再把同一幅热闹景象移到市场：植物是“开花”，商业或艺术是“兴旺发展”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take a photograph of a person, place or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用相机等设备给人、地方或物体拍照。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieħu ritratt ta' persuna, post jew oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拍摄照片；给……照相。

formal.mt: Il-fotografu ffotografa l-bini storiku minn diversi angoli biex jiddokumenta l-kundizzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The photographer photographed the historic building from several angles to document its condition.
formal.zh: 摄影师从多个角度拍摄这座历史建筑，以记录其状况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ffotografa lill-familja lbieraħ? Maja: Ħija, bil-kamera l-ġdida tiegħu. Lara: Ir-ritratt ħareġ sabiħ ħafna!
colloquial.en: Lara: Who photographed the family yesterday? Maja: My brother, with his new camera. Lara: The photo turned out really well!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：昨天是谁给一家人拍的照？玛雅：我哥哥，用他的新相机拍的。拉拉：照片拍得真好！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天是谁给一家人拍的照？
messages.en: Who photographed the family yesterday?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥，用他的新相机拍的。
messages.en: My brother, with his new camera.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片拍得真好！
messages.en: The photo turned out really well!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词里的 fotografa 与英语 photograph 作拼写联想，再想象按下快门；这是记忆提示，不是词源说明。

gloss_zh: 用鱼叉等叉取；狼吞虎咽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To catch something using a harpoon, trident or similar implement; also, to eat greedily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用鱼叉、三叉戟等器具叉住猎物；也指贪婪地大口吃东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqbad xi ħaġa b'arpun, trident jew għodda simili; ukoll, tiekol b'regħba.

sense_translations.en_definition: to catch something with a harpoon, trident, etc.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用鱼叉、三叉戟等器具叉取或捕获某物。
贪婪地吃；狼吞虎咽。

collocations.en: caught a fish with a harpoon

collocations.zh: 狼吞虎咽地吃光了所有食物

formal.mt: Is-sajjied ffoxxna ħuta b'arpun u poġġieha f'kontenitur fuq id-dgħajsa.
formal.en: The fisherman caught a fish with a harpoon and placed it in a container on the boat.
formal.zh: 渔夫用鱼叉捕到一条鱼，将它放进船上的容器里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fadal xi ħaġa x'nieklu? Lara: Le, Pawlu ffoxxna l-ikel kollu! Maja: Mela nagħmlu xi ħaġa oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there anything left for us to eat? Lara: No, Pawlu gobbled up all the food! Maja: Then let's make something else.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：还有什么留给我们吃的吗？拉拉：没有，保罗狼吞虎咽地把吃的全吃光了！玛雅：那我们再做点别的吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 还有什么留给我们吃的吗？
messages.en: Is there anything left for us to eat?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 没有，保罗狼吞虎咽地把吃的全吃光了！
messages.en: No, Pawlu gobbled up all the food!

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 那我们再做点别的吧。
messages.en: Then let's make something else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两格记忆漫画：第一格用鱼叉叉鱼，第二格大口吃饭。两格分别记两个义项，不把漫画当作词义演变说明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To save money, time or effort, or to be spared trouble or work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 节约金钱、时间或精力，或免去原本可能遭遇的麻烦、工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiffranka flus, ħin jew sforz, jew tevita taħbit jew xogħol li kien ikollok tagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 节省金钱、时间等；减少支出或耗用。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be spared (of trouble, work, etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 免受麻烦；免去工作等负担。

formal.mt: Billi bagħat id-dokumenti online, l-applikant ffranka l-ħin u l-ispiża tal-vjaġġ.
formal.en: By sending the documents online, the applicant saved time and the cost of the journey.
formal.zh: 申请人通过在线提交文件，节省了时间和路费。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark mar bil-karozza tal-linja? Maja: Iva, u ffranka l-flus tal-parkeġġ. Lara: Sewwa għamel, hemm il-parkeġġ għali.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark take the bus? Maja: Yes, and he saved the parking money. Lara: Good choice, parking is expensive there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克是坐公交车去的吗？玛雅：是啊，还省下了停车费。拉拉：这样挺好，那里的停车费很贵。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克是坐公交车去的吗？
messages.en: Did Mark take the bus?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，还省下了停车费。
messages.en: Yes, and he saved the parking money.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这样挺好，那里的停车费很贵。
messages.en: Good choice, parking is expensive there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成生活中的三个“省”：省钱、省时、省麻烦。看到后面的名词，就判断省下的是资源还是负担。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To visit or go to a place regularly or often.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常或定期前往某个地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tmур f'post ta' spiss jew b'mod regolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常光顾；常去某个地方。

collocations.zh: 经常光顾同一家咖啡馆

formal.mt: Matul is-sena akkademika, l-istudent ffrekwenta l-librerija biex jikkonsulta kotba għall-istudji tiegħu.
formal.en: During the academic year, the student frequented the library to consult books for his studies.
formal.zh: 这一学年里，这名学生经常到图书馆查阅学习所需的书籍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu jafha sew dik il-kafetterija? Lara: Iva, ffrekwenta l-post għal snin sħaħ. Maja: Mela jista' jgħidilna x'inhu tajjeb hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Pawlu know that café well? Lara: Yes, he frequented the place for years. Maja: Then he can tell us what's good there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗很熟悉那家咖啡馆吗？拉拉：是啊，他好多年来经常去。玛雅：那他可以告诉我们那里什么好吃。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗很熟悉那家咖啡馆吗？
messages.en: Does Pawlu know that café well?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ffrekwenta l-post għal snin sħaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ffrekwenta l-post għal snin sħaħ.
messages.zh: 是啊，他好多年来经常去。
messages.en: Yes, he frequented the place for years.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela jista' jgħidilna x'inhu tajjeb hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Mela jista' jgħidilna x'inhu tajjeb hemm.
messages.zh: 那他可以告诉我们那里什么好吃。
messages.en: Then he can tell us what's good there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想英语 frequent 的“经常”，再想象日历上多次标着同一家咖啡馆，记住这里强调反复去某处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something freeze, or to become frozen and turn into ice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物冻结、变成冰，或指某物自身结冰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel xi ħaġa ssir silġ, jew issir silġ minħabba l-kesħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to freeze something; turn it into ice
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物冻结；把某物冻成冰。
冻结；自身变成冰。

formal.mt: It-tekniku ffriża kampjun tal-ilma fil-friża. Wara diversi sigħat, l-ilma ffriża kompletament.
formal.en: The technician froze a water sample in the freezer. After several hours, the water froze completely.
formal.zh: 技术员把一份水样放进冷冻柜冷冻。几个小时后，水完全结成了冰。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna silġ għax-xorb? Maja: Iva, Mark ffriża l-ilma lbieraħ. Lara: Tajjeb, inġibu t-trej mill-friża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do we have ice for the drinks? Maja: Yes, Mark froze the water yesterday. Lara: Good, let's get the tray from the freezer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们有放进饮料里的冰吗？玛雅：有，马克昨天把水冻好了。拉拉：好，我们把冰格从冷冻室拿出来吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 我们有放进饮料里的冰吗？
messages.en: Do we have ice for the drinks?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 有，马克昨天把水冻好了。
messages.en: Yes, Mark froze the water yesterday.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我们把冰格从冷冻室拿出来吧。
messages.en: Good, let's get the tray from the freezer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两句对照记忆：Mark ffriża l-ilma 是“马克把水冻住”，l-ilma ffriża 是“水结冰了”；留意谁在充当主语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deceive someone in order to obtain money, property, or another benefit dishonestly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以欺骗手段获取他人的金钱、财物或其他利益。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqarraq b'xi ħadd biex jikseb flus, proprjetà jew benefiċċju ieħor b'mod diżonest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诈骗；以欺骗手段骗取他人的财物或利益。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif l-aġent ffroda lill-klijenti billi talab ħlas għal servizzi li qatt ma pprovda.
formal.en: The report describes how the agent defrauded customers by demanding payment for services he never provided.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这名代理人如何收取从未提供的服务的费用，从而诈骗顾客。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ma tridx tixtri mingħand dak il-bejjiegħ? Pawlu: Għax ffroda lil ħabib tiegħi: ħa l-flus u ma bagħat xejn.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why don't you want to buy from that seller? Pawlu: Because he defrauded a friend of mine: he took the money and sent nothing.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么不想向那个卖家买东西？保罗：因为他骗了我的一个朋友，收了钱却什么也没寄。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx tixtri mingħand dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx tixtri mingħand dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想向那个卖家买东西？
messages.en: Why don't you want to buy from that seller?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ffroda lil ħabib tiegħi: ħa l-flus u ma bagħat xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ffroda lil ħabib tiegħi: ħa l-flus u ma bagħat xejn.
messages.zh: 因为他骗了我的一个朋友，收了钱却什么也没寄。
messages.en: Because he defrauded a friend of mine: he took the money and sent nothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“卖家收钱却不发货”的场景记忆 ffroda，把欺骗和骗取利益两个要点一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To face a person, problem, or challenge directly, or to stand up to someone in defiance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 直接面对某人、问题或挑战，也可指挺身抗拒或公然挑战某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaffaċċja persuna, problema jew sfida direttament, jew jieqaf lil xi ħadd b'sfida.

sense_translations.en_definition: to face, to front, to defy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 面对；迎面应对；公然抗拒或挑战。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ffronta l-problema direttament u ppreżenta proposta biex isolviha.
formal.en: The committee faced the problem directly and presented a proposal to solve it.
formal.zh: 委员会直接面对了问题，并提出了解决方案。

colloquial.mt: Nina: David evita l-problema? Mark: Le, ffronta l-problema u tkellem ma' kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did David avoid the problem? Mark: No, he faced the problem and spoke to everyone.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：戴维回避那个问题了吗？马克：没有，他直面问题，和大家都谈了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 戴维回避那个问题了吗？
messages.en: Did David avoid the problem?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ffronta l-problema u tkellem ma' kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ffronta l-problema u tkellem ma' kulħadd.
messages.zh: 没有，他直面问题，和大家都谈了。
messages.en: No, he faced the problem and spoke to everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ffronta 配上“迎着问题站上前”的画面；面对困难和迎战对手，都抓住直接应对这一点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel disappointed or annoyed by blocking progress, or to prevent a plan from succeeding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因阻碍进展而使人受挫或烦恼，也可指阻挠计划，使其不能成功。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss diżappunt jew dwejjaq billi jfixkel il-progress, jew iwaqqaf pjan milli jirnexxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使受挫、沮丧或烦恼；阻挠，使计划或努力不能成功。

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' informazzjoni ċara ffrustra lill-applikanti u dewwem il-proċess.
formal.en: The lack of clear information frustrated the applicants and delayed the process.
formal.zh: 缺乏清晰的信息使申请人感到受挫，也拖慢了办理流程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqaft taħdem fuq il-proġett? Luqa: Il-kompjuter baqa' jieqaf u ffrustra lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you stop working on the project? Luqa: The computer kept freezing and frustrated everyone.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么停下了项目工作？卢卡：电脑老是卡住，弄得大家都很烦。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么停下了项目工作？
messages.en: Why did you stop working on the project?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kompjuter baqa' jieqaf u ffrustra lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kompjuter baqa' jieqaf u ffrustra lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 电脑老是卡住，弄得大家都很烦。
messages.en: The computer kept freezing and frustrated everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象作业快完成时电脑反复卡住：事情受阻，人也烦恼，用这个双重画面记住 ffrustra。

gloss_zh: 人头牌；名义上的领袖；Fgura（马耳他地名）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A playing card bearing a figure, such as a king, queen, or jack.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 牌面上有人物形象的扑克牌，例如国王、王后或杰克。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Karta tal-logħob li jkollha figura ta' persuna, bħal re, reġina jew ġakk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牌面上有人物图像的牌；人头牌。
挂名或象征性的领袖，即拥有头衔却没有实际权力的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: Fgura (a town and local council of the Port Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: Fgura：马耳他港口大区的一座城镇及其地方议会。

formal.mt: F'din il-logħba, kull fgura għandha valur ta' għaxar punti.
formal.en: In this game, each face card is worth ten points.
formal.zh: 在这个游戏中，每张人头牌计十分。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'karta ġbidt? Ben: Ġbidt fgura, reġina!
colloquial.en: Lara: What card did you draw? Ben: I drew a face card, a queen!
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你抽到了什么牌？本：我抽到了一张人头牌，是王后！

messages.speaker: Lara (牌友)
messages.zh: 你抽到了什么牌？
messages.en: What card did you draw?

messages.speaker: Ben (牌友)
messages.zh: 我抽到了一张人头牌，是王后！
messages.en: I drew a face card, a queen!

cognitive_memory_aid: 做三张情景卡分别记忆：扑克牌上的人物、只有头衔的领袖、地图上的 Fgura；地名用大写开头。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rapid, uncoordinated contractions of muscle fibres, especially those of the heart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肌肉纤维快速而不协调的收缩，尤指心肌的这种颤动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontrazzjonijiet rapidi u mhux koordinati tal-fibri tal-muskoli, speċjalment dawk tal-qalb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纤维性颤动，尤指心肌纤维快速而不协调的收缩。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tat-tabib jiddeskrivi episodju ta' fibrillazzjoni atrijali.
formal.en: The doctor's report describes an episode of atrial fibrillation.
formal.zh: 医生的报告描述了一次心房颤动发作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ir-rapport isemmi l-fibrillazzjoni. Xi tfisser din il-kelma? Mark: Hawn tfisser li l-fibri tal-muskolu tal-qalb jikkuntrattaw b'mod mhux koordinat.
colloquial.en: Lara: The report mentions fibrillation. What does that word mean? Mark: Here it means that the fibres of the heart muscle contract in an uncoordinated way.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：报告里提到了颤动。这个词是什么意思？马克：这里指心肌纤维以不协调的方式收缩。

messages.speaker: Lara (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rapport isemmi l-fibrillazzjoni. Xi tfisser din il-kelma?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rapport isemmi l-fibrillazzjoni. Xi tfisser din il-kelma?
messages.zh: 报告里提到了颤动。这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: The report mentions fibrillation. What does that word mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li l-fibri tal-muskolu tal-qalb jikkuntrattaw b'mod mhux koordinat.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li l-fibri tal-muskolu tal-qalb jikkuntrattaw b'mod mhux koordinat.
messages.zh: 这里指心肌纤维以不协调的方式收缩。
messages.en: Here it means that the fibres of the heart muscle contract in an uncoordinated way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 fibrillazzjoni 时，想象一组肌肉纤维各自快速颤动、无法协调一致的画面；再把两个搭配分别记成心房颤动和心室颤动。

gloss_zh: 有疗愈作用的；有助于愈合的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having properties that help healing or recovery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有帮助伤口愈合或身体康复的性质的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu proprjetajiet li jgħinu l-fejqan jew l-irkupru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有疗愈作用的；具有帮助愈合或康复的性质的。

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-balzmu huwa deskritt bħala fieqi minħabba l-proprjetajiet tiegħu li jgħinu l-fejqan.
formal.en: In the text, the balm is described as having healing properties because it helps the healing process.
formal.zh: 文中将这种膏剂描述为具有疗愈作用，因为它有帮助愈合的性质。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-kittieb isejjaħ dan iż-żejt fieqi? Pawlu: Għax qed jgħid li għandu proprjetajiet li jgħinu l-fejqan.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does the writer describe this oil as healing? Pawlu: Because he is saying that it has properties that help healing.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：作者为什么说这种油有疗愈作用？保罗：因为他是在说，它具有帮助愈合的性质。
