messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kittieb isejjaħ dan iż-żejt fieqi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kittieb isejjaħ dan iż-żejt fieqi?
messages.zh: 作者为什么说这种油有疗愈作用？
messages.en: Why does the writer describe this oil as healing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed jgħid li għandu proprjetajiet li jgħinu l-fejqan.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed jgħid li għandu proprjetajiet li jgħinu l-fejqan.
messages.zh: 因为他是在说，它具有帮助愈合的性质。
messages.en: Because he is saying that it has properties that help healing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fieqi 放在膏剂或油的旁边记忆：它描述的是东西具有帮助愈合的作用，而不是说使用者已经痊愈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause a wound or to hurt someone grievously.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人受到创伤，或使人遭受严重伤害与痛苦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jikkawża ferita jew iweġġa' lil xi ħadd b'mod gravi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使受伤；造成伤口或创伤。
严重伤害；使遭受深重的痛苦。

formal.mt: Id-daqqa fiera lir-raġel f'idu, u t-tim mediku tah l-ewwel għajnuna.
formal.en: The blow wounded the man's hand, and the medical team gave him first aid.
formal.zh: 那一击伤了男子的手，医疗团队为他进行了急救。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Marija ħarġet tibki? Luqa: Il-kliem ta' Pawlu fiera qalbha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Marija leave in tears? Luqa: Pawlu's words hurt her deeply.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：玛丽娅为什么哭着离开了？卢卡：保罗的话深深伤了她的心。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 玛丽娅为什么哭着离开了？
messages.en: Why did Marija leave in tears?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗的话深深伤了她的心。
messages.en: Pawlu's words hurt her deeply.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 fiera：一击造成身体伤口，一句话造成深重心伤；分别对应“使受伤”和“严重伤害”两个义项。

gloss_zh: 骑士般的；具有骑士风范的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the qualities or bearing associated with a knight, such as courage and honour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有骑士般的品质或风度的，如勇敢、重视荣誉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kwalitajiet jew imġiba ta' kavallier, bħall-kuraġġ u s-sens tal-unur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骑士般的；具有骑士品质或风范的。

formal.mt: L-awtur jagħti lill-protagonist spirtu fiersi u sens qawwi ta' unur.
formal.en: The author gives the protagonist a knightly spirit and a strong sense of honour.
formal.zh: 作者赋予主人公骑士般的精神和强烈的荣誉感。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif tiddeskrivi lill-kavallier f'din l-istorja? Mark: Għandu spirtu fiersi: huwa kuraġġuż u jgħin lid-dgħajfa.
colloquial.en: Lara: How would you describe the knight in this story? Mark: He has a knightly spirit: he is courageous and helps the weak.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你会怎样描述这个故事里的骑士？马克：他有骑士风范：勇敢，而且帮助弱者。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 你会怎样描述这个故事里的骑士？
messages.en: How would you describe the knight in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu spirtu fiersi: huwa kuraġġuż u jgħin lid-dgħajfa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu spirtu fiersi: huwa kuraġġuż u jgħin lid-dgħajfa.
messages.zh: 他有骑士风范：勇敢，而且帮助弱者。
messages.en: He has a knightly spirit: he is courageous and helps the weak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 fiersi 时，想象故事中勇敢、重荣誉并帮助弱者的骑士；把这个形容词和“骑士风范”的整体形象连起来。

gloss_zh: 在什么里面；在什么方面

teaching_sense.en_definition: In what thing, container, activity, or respect; used in questions and embedded questions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“在什么里面”或“在什么方面”，用于直接问句或嵌入句中的疑问结构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża f'mistoqsijiet diretti jew indiretti biex tistaqsi dwar il-ħaġa jew il-qasam li fih tinsab jew issir xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在什么里面；在什么事物、活动或方面之中。

collocations.en: What does the project consist of?
collocations.zh: 这个项目包含哪些内容？

collocations.en: What will you put the books in?
collocations.zh: 你要把书放在什么里面？

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega fiex jikkonsisti l-proġett u kif se jitwettaq.
formal.en: The report explains what the project consists of and how it will be carried out.
formal.zh: 报告解释了项目包含哪些内容，以及将如何实施。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fiex se tpoġġi l-kotba? Pawlu: Se npoġġihom f'kaxxa ħdejn il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Nina: What will you put the books in? Pawlu: I'll put them in a box next to the table.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你要把书放在什么里面？保罗：我要把它们放在桌子旁边的一个箱子里。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你要把书放在什么里面？
messages.en: What will you put the books in?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我要把它们放在桌子旁边的一个箱子里。
messages.en: I'll put them in a box next to the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 fiex，就在脑中放一个带问号的容器，问“在什么里面”；讨论项目内容时，再把容器换成抽象的内容范围。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very large mammal with a long trunk and large ears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种体形巨大的哺乳动物，具有长鼻和大耳朵，即大象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal mammiferu kbir ħafna, b'tromba twila u widnejn kbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大象，一种具有长鼻和大耳朵的大型哺乳动物。

formal.mt: Il-fil juża t-tromba tiegħu biex jiġbor l-ikel u jixrob l-ilma.
formal.en: The elephant uses its trunk to pick up food and drink water.
formal.zh: 大象用鼻子取食和喝水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-fil! Kemm għandu tromba twila! Mark: Iva, qed jużaha biex jiġbor l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that elephant! What a long trunk it has! Mark: Yes, it's using it to pick up food.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看那头大象！它的鼻子真长！马克：是啊，它正用鼻子取食。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-fil! Kemm għandu tromba twila!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-fil! Kemm għandu tromba twila!
messages.zh: 看那头大象！它的鼻子真长！
messages.en: Look at that elephant! What a long trunk it has!

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jużaha biex jiġbor l-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jużaha biex jiġbor l-ikel.
messages.zh: 是啊，它正用鼻子取食。
messages.en: Yes, it's using it to pick up food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把名词 fil 写在一张长鼻大象的图卡下，再配上“大象的鼻子”这个搭配；用动物形象固定本词条的名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to introduce what is actually true, often to clarify or correct an impression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于说明真实情况，常用来澄清或纠正原有印象，相当于“其实”或“事实上”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex tintroduċi dak li hu tassew minnu, spiss biex tiċċara jew tikkoreġi impressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 其实；实际上；事实上。

formal.mt: Għall-ewwel, il-proposta tidher għalja; fil-verità, tista' tnaqqas l-ispejjeż fit-tul.
formal.en: At first, the proposal seems expensive; in fact, it may reduce costs in the long term.
formal.zh: 乍看之下，这项提案似乎成本很高；事实上，它可能降低长期成本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok il-film? David: Fil-verità, sibthu ftit twil, imma t-tmiem għoġobni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like the film? David: Actually, I found it a little long, but I liked the ending.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你喜欢这部电影吗？David：其实，我觉得有点长，不过我喜欢结尾。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这部电影吗？
messages.en: Did you like the film?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-verità, sibthu ftit twil, imma t-tmiem għoġobni.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-verità, sibthu ftit twil, imma t-tmiem għoġobni.
messages.zh: 其实，我觉得有点长，不过我喜欢结尾。
messages.en: Actually, I found it a little long, but I liked the ending.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fil-verità 当作说出真实情况前的提示牌：先在心里说“其实”，再接上你真正想表达的内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To earn a large amount of money, or to give money as a donation, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境表示赚取大量金钱，或将金钱捐出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaqla' ħafna flus, jew li jagħti flus bħala donazzjoni, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.en_definition: to earn a lot of money
sense_translations.zh_definition: 赚取很多钱；获得大量金钱收入。
捐钱；将金钱作为捐款赠出。

collocations.en: earned a lot of money from trade

formal.mt: Il-benefattur files għall-proġett tal-librerija billi ta somma flus biex jinxtraw kotba ġodda.
formal.en: The benefactor donated money to the library project by providing a sum for the purchase of new books.
formal.zh: 这位捐助者向图书馆项目捐款，提供了一笔购买新书的资金。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif irnexxielu Mark jixtri dar daqshekk kbira? Luqa: Files mill-kummerċ; in-negozju tiegħu mar tajjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Mark manage to buy such a big house? Luqa: He earned a lot of money from trade; his business did very well.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克怎么有能力买这么大的房子？卢卡：他做生意赚了很多钱，生意非常好。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irnexxielu Mark jixtri dar daqshekk kbira?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irnexxielu Mark jixtri dar daqshekk kbira?
messages.zh: 马克怎么有能力买这么大的房子？
messages.en: How did Mark manage to buy such a big house?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Files mill-kummerċ; in-negozju tiegħu mar tajjeb ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Files mill-kummerċ; in-negozju tiegħu mar tajjeb ħafna.
messages.zh: 他做生意赚了很多钱，生意非常好。
messages.en: He earned a lot of money from trade; his business did very well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅金钱流动图记 files：商人把大笔钱赚进来，捐助者把钱捐出去；结合贸易或慈善的语境判断具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small dried pepper berry used whole or ground as a spice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作香料的干燥胡椒果实，可以整粒使用或磨成粉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta żgħira u mnixxfa tal-pjanta tal-bżar, li tintuża bħala ħwawar sħiħa jew mitħuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡椒粒，即作为香料使用的干燥胡椒果实。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob filfel sħiħ, li jitneħħa mis-soppa qabel ma tiġi servuta.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a whole peppercorn, which is removed from the soup before it is served.
formal.zh: 食谱要求加入一整粒胡椒，并在上汤前将其取出。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dan it-tond żgħir fis-soppa? Pawlu: Dak filfel sħiħ; poġġejtu hemm biex jagħti t-togħma.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's this little round thing in the soup? Pawlu: That's a whole peppercorn; I put it in to add flavour.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：汤里这个圆圆的小东西是什么？保罗：那是一整粒胡椒，我放进去提味的。

messages.speaker: Nina (用餐者)
messages.zh: 汤里这个圆圆的小东西是什么？
messages.en: What's this little round thing in the soup?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak filfel sħiħ; poġġejtu hemm biex jagħti t-togħma.
messages.mt_standard: Dak filfel sħiħ; poġġejtu hemm biex jagħti t-togħma.
messages.zh: 那是一整粒胡椒，我放进去提味的。
messages.en: That's a whole peppercorn; I put it in to add flavour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 filfel 记成汤里一颗圆圆的胡椒粒，再想象它被磨碎的过程；这样可以同时记住整粒和磨碎两个实用搭配。

gloss_zh: 仔细检查；细察这一行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of examining something very carefully and paying close attention to its details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仔细查看某物、逐一留意其细节的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li teżamina xi ħaġa bir-reqqa u tagħti attenzjoni lid-dettalji tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 细察、审视或仔细检查某物这一行为。

formal.mt: Wara fili bir-reqqa tad-dokumenti, il-kumitat sab żewġ żbalji fid-dati.
formal.en: After careful scrutiny of the documents, the committee found two errors in the dates.
formal.zh: 委员会仔细检查文件后，发现日期中有两处错误。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed iddum fuq din il-paġna? Mark: Qed nagħmel fili tad-dettalji; irrid nara jekk hemmx żball.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you spending so long on this page? Mark: I'm scrutinising the details; I want to see whether there is a mistake.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么看这一页看了这么久？Mark：我在仔细检查细节，想看看有没有错误。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iddum fuq din il-paġna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iddum fuq din il-paġna?
messages.zh: 你为什么看这一页看了这么久？
messages.en: Why are you spending so long on this page?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel fili tad-dettalji; irrid nara jekk hemmx żball.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel fili tad-dettalji; irrid nara jekk hemmx żball.
messages.zh: 我在仔细检查细节，想看看有没有错误。
messages.en: I'm scrutinising the details; I want to see whether there is a mistake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fili 记成拿放大镜逐项查看细节的动作；本条是名词，表示“细察这件事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in Southeast Asia, officially called the Republic of the Philippines.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 东南亚国家菲律宾，正式名称为菲律宾共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fix-Xlokk tal-Asja li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika tal-Filippini.

sense_translations.en_definition: Philippines (a country in Southeast Asia; official name: Repubblika tal-Filippini)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 菲律宾，位于东南亚的国家；正式名称为菲律宾共和国。

collocations.zh: 一次前往菲律宾的旅行

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħejjew preżentazzjoni dwar il-Filippini, pajjiż fix-Xlokk tal-Asja.
formal.en: The students prepared a presentation about the Philippines, a country in Southeast Asia.
formal.zh: 学生们准备了一份介绍东南亚国家菲律宾的演示报告。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? David: Se mmur il-Filippini ma' ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where are you going on holiday? David: I'm going to the Philippines with a friend of mine.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你要去哪里度假？David：我要和一个朋友去菲律宾。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur il-Filippini ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur il-Filippini ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我要和一个朋友去菲律宾。
messages.en: I'm going to the Philippines with a friend of mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Filippini 和英语 Philippines 并排认读，再配上“菲律宾”中文标签；在例句中整体记住 il-Filippini。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to show that one event is followed almost immediately by another: no sooner or barely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示一件事刚发生，另一件事便紧接着发生，相当于“刚……就……”或“才一……便……”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex juri li ġrajja tiġi segwita minn oħra kważi minnufih, spiss fil-forma filli ... filli.

sense_translations.en_definition: no sooner, as soon as, barely

collocations.en: no sooner had he arrived than he left
it had barely begun before it was over

formal.mt: Filli bdiet il-laqgħa, filli kellha tieqaf minħabba ħsara fid-dawl.
formal.en: No sooner had the meeting begun than it had to stop because of a power failure.
formal.zh: 会议刚开始，就因停电而不得不中断。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kellek ħin tistrieħ? Ġanni: Le! Filli poġġejt bilqiegħda, filli daqq it-telefon.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you have time to rest? Ġanni: No! I had barely sat down when the phone rang.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你有时间休息吗？Ġanni：没有！我才刚坐下，电话就响了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有时间休息吗？
messages.en: Did you have time to rest?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le! Filli poġġejt bilqiegħda, filli daqq it-telefon.
messages.mt_standard: Le! Filli poġġejt bilqiegħda, filli daqq it-telefon.
messages.zh: 没有！我才刚坐下，电话就响了。
messages.en: No! I had barely sat down when the phone rang.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“刚坐下，电话就响”这幅连续画面记忆 filli；两个 filli 分别提示前后紧接的两件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A film intended to frighten its audience through frightening events, characters or atmosphere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过惊悚事件、人物或气氛使观众感到害怕的电影。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Film maħsub biex ibeżża' lill-udjenza permezz ta' ġrajjiet, karattri jew atmosfera tal-biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恐怖电影；恐怖片。

formal.mt: Fir-reċensjoni tagħha, l-istudenta tispjega kif il-mużika toħloq tensjoni f'dan il-film tal-biża'.
formal.en: In her review, the student explains how the music creates tension in this horror film.
formal.zh: 这名学生在影评中解释了音乐如何在这部恐怖片里营造紧张感。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tara film tal-biża' llejla? Mark: Iva, imma ejja narawh bid-dawl mixgħul!
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to watch a horror film tonight? Mark: Yes, but let's watch it with the light on!
colloquial.zh: Sara：今晚想看一部恐怖片吗？Mark：想，不过我们开着灯看吧！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚想看一部恐怖片吗？
messages.en: Do you want to watch a horror film tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ejja narawh bid-dawl mixgħul!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ejja narawh bid-dawl mixgħul!
messages.zh: 想，不过我们开着灯看吧！
messages.en: Yes, but let's watch it with the light on!

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用熟悉的 film 联想到电影，再把整个 film tal-biża' 配上“吓得开灯看”的画面，记住“恐怖片”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who studies or develops ideas about fundamental questions such as knowledge, existence and morality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究或提出有关知识、存在和道德等根本问题的思想的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tistudja jew tiżviluppa ideat dwar mistoqsijiet fundamentali bħall-għarfien, l-eżistenza u l-moralità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哲学家；研究哲学问题的人。

formal.mt: Fl-esej tiegħu, l-istudent janalizza l-argument ta' filosfu dwar il-ġustizzja.
formal.en: In his essay, the student analyses a philosopher's argument about justice.
formal.zh: 这名学生在论文中分析了一位哲学家关于正义的论证。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jagħmel filosfu? Pawlu: Jistaqsi mistoqsijiet kbar, bħal kif nafu jekk xi ħaġa hijiex vera.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does a philosopher do? Pawlu: A philosopher asks big questions, such as how we know whether something is true.
colloquial.zh: Lara：哲学家做什么？Pawlu：哲学家会提出重大问题，比如我们怎样知道某件事是否真实。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 哲学家做什么？
messages.en: What does a philosopher do?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jistaqsi mistoqsijiet kbar, bħal kif nafu jekk xi ħaġa hijiex vera.
messages.mt_standard: Jistaqsi mistoqsijiet kbar, bħal kif nafu jekk xi ħaġa hijiex vera.
messages.zh: 哲学家会提出重大问题，比如我们怎样知道某件事是否真实。
messages.en: A philosopher asks big questions, such as how we know whether something is true.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 filosfu 与英语 philosopher 配对认读，再想象一个反复追问“什么是真实”的人，帮助记住“哲学家”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Paralysis affecting one side of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体一侧发生瘫痪的状况，即偏瘫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Paraliżi li taffettwa naħa waħda tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏瘫；身体一侧瘫痪。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jiddeskrivi filġa fuq in-naħa tal-lemin tal-ġisem.
formal.en: The medical report describes hemiplegia affecting the right side of the body.
formal.zh: 医疗报告描述了身体右侧的偏瘫。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi tfisser filġa? Pawlu: Tfisser li naħa waħda tal-ġisem tkun paralizzata.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does filġa mean? Pawlu: It means that one side of the body is paralysed.
colloquial.zh: Marija：filġa 是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是身体的一侧瘫痪。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: filġa 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does filġa mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li naħa waħda tal-ġisem tkun paralizzata.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li naħa waħda tal-ġisem tkun paralizzata.
messages.zh: 意思是身体的一侧瘫痪。
messages.en: It means that one side of the body is paralysed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时画一个人形，只给左半边涂色，把 filġa 与“身体一侧瘫痪”的画面相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The field or activity concerned with obtaining, managing and using money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及资金筹集、管理和使用的领域或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qasam jew l-attività li jittrattaw il-kisba, il-ġestjoni u l-użu tal-flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金融；财务；有关资金筹集、管理和使用的事务。

formal.mt: Il-kors fil-finanza jintroduċi lill-istudenti għall-ġestjoni tal-flus u għall-ippjanar tal-baġit.
formal.en: The finance course introduces students to money management and budget planning.
formal.zh: 这门金融课程向学生介绍资金管理和预算规划。

colloquial.mt: Anna: F'liema qasam tixtieq taħdem? Mark: Fil-finanza, għax inħobb in-numri u l-ippjanar.
colloquial.en: Anna: What field would you like to work in? Mark: Finance, because I like numbers and planning.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你想在哪个领域工作？Mark：金融领域，因为我喜欢数字和规划。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 你想在哪个领域工作？
messages.en: What field would you like to work in?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-finanza, għax inħobb in-numri u l-ippjanar.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-finanza, għax inħobb in-numri u l-ippjanar.
messages.zh: 金融领域，因为我喜欢数字和规划。
messages.en: Finance, because I like numbers and planning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 finanza 与英语 finance 配对记忆，再联想一本记录资金来源、支出和预算的账本，记住“金融、财务”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who manages, invests, or provides large amounts of money for businesses or projects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事大额资金管理、投资或为企业及项目提供资金的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi jew tinvesti somom kbar ta' flus, jew tipprovdi fondi għal negozji u proġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金融家；经营、投资或筹措大额资金的人。

formal.mt: Il-finanzier qabel li jipprovdi parti mill-fondi meħtieġa għall-proġett.
formal.en: The financier agreed to provide part of the funding needed for the project.
formal.zh: 这位金融家同意提供该项目所需的部分资金。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jgħinna nsibu l-flus għall-proġett? Mark: Naf finanzier li jista' jkun interessat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will help us find the money for the project? Mark: I know a financier who might be interested.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁能帮我们为项目找到资金？马克：我认识一位可能感兴趣的金融家。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jgħinna nsibu l-flus għall-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jgħinna nsibu l-flus għall-proġett?
messages.zh: 谁能帮我们为项目找到资金？
messages.en: Who will help us find the money for the project?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Naf finanzier li jista' jkun interessat.
messages.mt_standard: Naf finanzier li jista' jkun interessat.
messages.zh: 我认识一位可能感兴趣的金融家。
messages.en: I know a financier who might be interested.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 finanzier 放进“为项目提供资金的人”这个画面里，记住它指人，可译为金融家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to money, funding, or the management of money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与金钱、资金筹措或资金管理有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-flus, mal-fondi jew mat-tmexxija tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 财务的；财政的；金融的，具体译法取决于所修饰的对象。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport finanzjali juri kif intużaw il-fondi matul is-sena.
formal.en: The financial report shows how the funds were used during the year.
formal.zh: 财务报告说明了这一年中资金的使用情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nitlob għajnuna finanzjali għall-kors? Pawlu: Iva, tista' timla l-formola llum.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I apply for financial assistance for the course? Pawlu: Yes, you can fill in the form today.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我可以申请这门课程的经济援助吗？保罗：可以，你今天就能填写表格。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 我可以申请这门课程的经济援助吗？
messages.en: Can I apply for financial assistance for the course?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (课程工作人员)
messages.zh: 可以，你今天就能填写表格。
messages.en: Yes, you can fill in the form today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“财务报告”和“经济援助”两组搭配记 finanzjali：它是形容词，说明事物与钱有关。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In relation to money or financial resources; by providing money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从财务或经济资源的角度而言；通过提供金钱的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'dak li għandu x'jaqsam mal-flus jew permezz ta' għajnuna bil-flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在财务上；在经济上；以提供资金的方式。

formal.mt: Il-fondazzjoni se tappoġġja finanzjarjament l-istudenti li jissodisfaw il-kriterji.
formal.en: The foundation will financially support students who meet the criteria.
formal.zh: 基金会将为符合条件的学生提供经济支持。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ġenituri tiegħek għadhom jgħinuk finanzjarjament? Nina: Le, issa nħallas l-ispejjeż tiegħi jien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do your parents still help you financially? Nina: No, I pay my own expenses now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你父母现在还在经济上帮助你吗？妮娜：没有了，我现在自己负担开销。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你父母现在还在经济上帮助你吗？
messages.en: Do your parents still help you financially?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa nħallas l-ispejjeż tiegħi jien.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa nħallas l-ispejjeż tiegħi jien.
messages.zh: 没有了，我现在自己负担开销。
messages.en: No, I pay my own expenses now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记整句“在经济上帮助”：finanzjarjament 说明帮助的方面或方式，回答“在哪方面、怎样帮助”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deep sadness caused by a loss or another painful experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因失去重要的人或事物，或经历痛苦事件而产生的深切悲伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Niket profond minħabba telf jew esperjenza ta' wġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悲痛；哀伤，尤指失去亲人或遭遇重大损失后的深切悲伤。

formal.mt: Il-poeta esprima l-fini tiegħu wara t-telf ta' ħabib għażiż.
formal.en: The poet expressed his grief after the loss of a dear friend.
formal.zh: 诗人在失去挚友后表达了自己的悲痛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadni nħoss fini kbir wara l-mewt tan-nanna. Lara: Nifhmek. Jekk trid titkellem, jien hawn.
colloquial.en: Sara: I still feel great grief after my grandmother's death. Lara: I understand. If you want to talk, I'm here.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：奶奶去世后，我至今仍感到深深的悲痛。拉拉：我理解。你想聊聊的话，我就在这里。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni nħoss fini kbir wara l-mewt tan-nanna.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni nħoss fini kbir wara l-mewt tan-nanna.
messages.zh: 奶奶去世后，我至今仍感到深深的悲痛。
messages.en: I still feel great grief after my grandmother's death.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhmek. Jekk trid titkellem, jien hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhmek. Jekk trid titkellem, jien hawn.
messages.zh: 我理解。你想聊聊的话，我就在这里。
messages.en: I understand. If you want to talk, I'm here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fini 与失去挚友后的沉重心情联系起来，再用 fini kbir 记住“深切悲痛”这一搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act, appearance, or object presented as genuine when it is not.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被表现为真实、实际却不真实的行为、表象或物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att, dehra jew oġġett li jiġi ppreżentat bħala veru meta mhuwiex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 假象；虚假的做法或表演，表面上像真的，实则并非如此。
假货；冒充真品的东西。
假的；装出来的；并非真实的。
伪造的；仿造真品并冒充真品的。

formal.mt: L-espert eżamina l-munita u kkonkluda li kienet finta.
formal.en: The expert examined the coin and concluded that it was counterfeit.
formal.zh: 专家检查了这枚硬币，并判定它是伪造的。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-borża vera tad-ditta? Lara: Le, hija finta. Xtrajtha għall-kulur.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this bag really from that brand? Lara: No, it's a fake. I bought it for the colour.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个包真是那个品牌的吗？拉拉：不是，是仿品。我买它是因为喜欢这个颜色。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个包真是那个品牌的吗？
messages.en: Is this bag really from that brand?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，是仿品。我买它是因为喜欢这个颜色。
messages.en: No, it's a fake. I bought it for the colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图记 finta：装出来的笑容是假表情，冒充真品的硬币是假货；同时留意名词与形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something presented or imagined rather than real, such as a pretence, a counterfeit, or an invented story.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 并非真实而被表现或想象出来的事物，可指假装、赝品或虚构的故事与作品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li mhijiex vera iżda tiġi ppreżentata jew immaġinata, bħal taparsi, oġġett falz jew storja vvintata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 假装；佯装；为使人相信而表现出来的虚假状态或态度。
一件赝品；一件冒充真品的伪造物。
虚构；虚构文学或作品，其人物、情节等出自创作。

formal.mt: Dan ir-rumanz huwa xogħol ta' finzjoni, għalkemm xi ġrajjiet fih huma ispirati minn esperjenzi reali.
formal.en: This novel is a work of fiction, although some events in it are inspired by real experiences.
formal.zh: 这部小说是虚构作品，尽管其中一些事件的灵感来自真实经历。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din l-istorja ġrat tassew? Maja: Le, hija finzjoni, imma l-postijiet jeżistu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did this story really happen? Maja: No, it's fiction, but the places exist.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个故事真的发生过吗？玛雅：没有，是虚构的，不过那些地方确实存在。

messages.speaker: Mark (读者)
messages.zh: 这个故事真的发生过吗？
messages.en: Did this story really happen?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hija finzjoni, imma l-postijiet jeżistu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hija finzjoni, imma l-postijiet jeżistu.
messages.zh: 没有，是虚构的，不过那些地方确实存在。
messages.en: No, it's fiction, but the places exist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 finzjoni 配三张学习卡：假装的态度、冒充真品的物件、编出来的故事；遇到它先凭语境选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something seem real when it is not, or to act as if something were true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把不真实的事表现得像真的一样，或装作某种情况属实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa tidher vera meta mhijiex, jew jaġixxi bħallikieku xi ħaġa kienet vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伪装；装出某种表情、状态或反应，使其看起来像真的。
假装；装作某事属实或自己处于某种状态。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel finġa li kien rieqed sabiex jisma' l-konversazzjoni.
formal.en: In the story, the boy pretended to be asleep so that he could listen to the conversation.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩为了听到谈话而假装睡着了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex David ma weġibx meta sejjaħtlu? Mark: Finġa li ma semax għax ma riedx ikellimni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't David answer when you called him? Mark: He pretended not to hear because he didn't want to talk to me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你叫戴维时，他为什么没回应？马克：他假装没听见，因为他不想和我说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex David ma weġibx meta sejjaħtlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex David ma weġibx meta sejjaħtlu?
messages.zh: 你叫戴维时，他为什么没回应？
messages.en: Why didn't David answer when you called him?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Finġa li ma semax għax ma riedx ikellimni.
messages.mt_standard: Finġa li ma semax għax ma riedx ikellimni.
messages.zh: 他假装没听见，因为他不想和我说话。
messages.en: He pretended not to hear because he didn't want to talk to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人明明醒着却装睡：用 finġa li 接上他假装属实的情况，连成具体场景来记。

gloss_zh: 奉献礼；弥撒中的奉献环节

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of a church service, especially Mass, in which offerings are presented.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 教会礼拜中呈献奉献物的环节，尤指弥撒中的奉献礼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti taċ-ċelebrazzjoni fil-knisja, speċjalment tal-quddiesa, li fiha jitressqu l-offerti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奉献礼；礼拜中呈献奉献物的环节，尤指弥撒中的奉献部分。

formal.mt: Waqt il-firi, il-fidili ressqu l-ħobż u l-inbid lejn l-artal.
formal.en: During the offertory, the faithful brought the bread and wine to the altar.
formal.zh: 奉献礼期间，信众将饼和酒送到祭台前。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Meta se nressqu l-ħobż u l-inbid? Pawlu: Waqt il-firi. Nersqu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Anna: When will we bring up the bread and wine? Pawlu: During the offertory. We'll go up together.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们什么时候把饼和酒送上去？保罗：在奉献礼的时候。我们一起上前。

messages.speaker: Anna (教友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se nressqu l-ħobż u l-inbid?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se nressqu l-ħobż u l-inbid?
messages.zh: 我们什么时候把饼和酒送上去？
messages.en: When will we bring up the bread and wine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教友)
messages.zh: 在奉献礼的时候。我们一起上前。
messages.en: During the offertory. We'll go up together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 firi 放进弥撒中信众呈上饼和酒的画面，用 waqt il-firi 记住“在奉献礼期间”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Soon, immediately, or with little delay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示事情很快发生，或行动立即、迅速地进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi żmien qasir, minnufih jew mingħajr dewmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 很快；马上；迅速地

formal.mt: Il-persunal għandu jirrispondi fis għal kull talba urġenti.
formal.en: Staff should respond promptly to every urgent request.
formal.zh: 工作人员应迅速回应每一项紧急请求。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ejja fis, il-karozza tal-linja waslet! Pawlu: Ġej, stennieni!
colloquial.en: Marta: Come quickly, the bus is here! Pawlu: I'm coming, wait for me!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：快来，公交车到了！保罗：我来了，等等我！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 快来，公交车到了！
messages.en: Come quickly, the bus is here!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我来了，等等我！
messages.en: I'm coming, wait for me!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fis 放进“快来”的呼喊 ejja fis 中记忆：它催促动作快些发生，并注意不要与双写 s 的 fiss 混淆。

gloss_zh: 在寂静中；默默地；不出声地

teaching_sense.en_definition: In silence, without speaking or making a noise while doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在做某事时保持安静，不说话或不发出声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla ma wieħed jitkellem jew jagħmel ħoss waqt li jkun qed jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see f’, il-, skiet.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 按各组成部分的字面意义使用：在寂静之中；参见所列组成部分。

sense_translations.en_definition: in silence; silently; quietly; without speaking (during something or about something)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 静静地；默默地；在某事进行期间不说话，或对某事保持沉默。

formal.mt: L-istudenti qraw is-silta fis-skiet qabel ma wieġbu l-mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: The students read the passage silently before answering the questions.
formal.zh: 学生们先默读短文，然后回答问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed titkellem daqshekk baxx? Pawlu: Anna qed taqra; ejja nistennew fis-skiet sakemm tlesti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you speaking so softly? Pawlu: Anna is reading; let's wait quietly until she finishes.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么说话这么轻？Pawlu：Anna 正在读书，我们安静地等她读完吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说话这么轻？
messages.en: Why are you speaking so softly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Anna qed taqra; ejja nistennew fis-skiet sakemm tlesti.
messages.mt_standard: Anna qed taqra; ejja nistennew fis-skiet sakemm tlesti.
messages.zh: Anna 正在读书，我们安静地等她读完吧。
messages.en: Anna is reading; let's wait quietly until she finishes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fis-skiet 和图书馆里大家默读的画面绑定，记住它表示动作进行时安静无声。

gloss_zh: 无声的屁；悄悄放屁这件事

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instance of passing intestinal gas without making a sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指排出肠道气体却没有发出声音的一次行为，即放了一个无声的屁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ ta' gass mill-imsaren mingħajr ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无声地放屁这一行为；一个无声的屁

collocations.en: the smell of a silent fart

formal.mt: Il-pazjent irrapporta li għamel fisa, jiġifieri ħareġ gass mill-imsaren mingħajr ħoss.
formal.en: The patient reported passing wind silently, that is, releasing intestinal gas without a sound.
formal.zh: 患者报告说自己放了一个无声的屁，即排出肠道气体时没有发出声音。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik ir-riħa? Mark: Skużani, għamilt fisa. Niftaħ it-tieqa?
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that smell? Mark: Sorry, I passed wind silently. Shall I open the window?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是什么味道？马克：不好意思，我放了个无声的屁。我把窗户打开好吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这是什么味道？
messages.en: What's that smell?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 不好意思，我放了个无声的屁。我把窗户打开好吗？
messages.en: Sorry, I passed wind silently. Shall I open the window?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象“没有声音，却闻到气味”的场景来记 fisa；搭配 għamel fisa，记住这里用名词表示一次无声排气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Gentle persuasion used to win someone over; also corruption or moral deterioration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指通过温言软语使人接受或配合的哄劝；也指腐败或道德上的败坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persważjoni bi kliem ħelu biex wieħed jikseb il-kunsens ta' ħaddieħor; ukoll korruzzjoni jew taħsir morali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哄劝；用温和讨好的言语使人答应或配合
腐败；败坏

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz juri l-fisda tal-karattru tal-mexxej hekk kif jikseb aktar poter.
formal.en: The novel depicts the corruption of the leader's character as he gains more power.
formal.zh: 小说描写了这位领导者随着权力增加而出现的品格败坏。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif irnexxielek iġġiegħlu jipprova s-soppa? Rita: Bil-fisda! Għedtlu jipprova kuċċarina waħda biss.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did you get him to try the soup? Rita: By coaxing him! I told him to try just one spoonful.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你是怎么让他尝那碗汤的？丽塔：哄着劝呀！我跟他说只尝一勺就好。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是怎么让他尝那碗汤的？
messages.en: How did you get him to try the soup?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-fisda! Għedtlu jipprova kuċċarina waħda biss.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-fisda! Għedtlu jipprova kuċċarina waħda biss.
messages.zh: 哄着劝呀！我跟他说只尝一勺就好。
messages.en: By coaxing him! I told him to try just one spoonful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fisda 做两张情景卡：一张是温声哄人尝汤，另一张是人物品格败坏；两个义项分别记，不强行编造联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spoil someone or something by damaging their character, quality, or condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某物变坏，损害其品格、品质或原有状态，也可指把人宠坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħassar lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa, billi għamel ħsara lill-karattru, lill-kwalità jew lill-kundizzjoni tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变坏；败坏；宠坏；糟蹋

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ġid fised lill-protagonist u bidillu l-mod kif jittratta lil ħaddieħor.
formal.en: In the novel, wealth spoiled the protagonist and changed the way he treated others.
formal.zh: 在小说中，财富使主人公变坏，也改变了他对待他人的方式。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex it-tifel jippretendi rigal kuljum? Pawlu: Missieru fised lil ibnu billi dejjem tah dak kollu li ried.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the boy expect a present every day? Pawlu: His father spoiled him by always giving him everything he wanted.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么那孩子每天都觉得自己该收到礼物？保罗：他爸爸总是要什么给什么，把儿子宠坏了。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 为什么那孩子每天都觉得自己该收到礼物？
messages.en: Why does the boy expect a present every day?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieru fised lil ibnu billi dejjem tah dak kollu li ried.
messages.mt_standard: Missieru fised lil ibnu billi dejjem tah dak kollu li ried.
messages.zh: 他爸爸总是要什么给什么，把儿子宠坏了。
messages.en: His father spoiled him by always giving him everything he wanted.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“样样满足，结果宠坏”这一因果画面记 fised；学习时抓住“使原本的人或事物变坏”的动作意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Set and not changing, or held firmly in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经确定而不随意变动的，或牢固地保持在某个位置的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stabbilit u li ma jinbidilx, jew li jibqa' sod f'postu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 固定的；确定不变的；牢固的

formal.mt: Il-laqgħat isiru f'ħin fiss kull nhar ta' Tnejn.
formal.en: The meetings take place at a fixed time every Monday.
formal.zh: 会议每周一在固定时间举行。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-prezz huwa fiss? Toni: Iva, huwa fiss; ma nistax innaqqsu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the price fixed? Toni: Yes, it's fixed; I can't lower it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个价格是固定的吗？托尼：是的，价格固定，我不能再降了。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个价格是固定的吗？
messages.en: Is the price fixed?

messages.speaker: Toni (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa fiss; ma nistax innaqqsu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa fiss; ma nistax innaqqsu.
messages.zh: 是的，价格固定，我不能再降了。
messages.en: Yes, it's fixed; I can't lower it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fiss 想成标签上“固定不变”的价格；双写 s 可作为视觉记号，提醒自己它是形容词，区别于表示迅速的 fis。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A persistent, excessive focus on a person, thing, or idea that is difficult to set aside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某个人、事物或想法持续而过度地关注，难以放下的执念或迷恋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsieb jew interess qawwi u persistenti f'persuna, ħaġa jew idea li jkun diffiċli twarrbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 执念；过分迷恋；难以摆脱的专注

formal.mt: L-awtur juri kif il-fissazzjoni tal-karattru prinċipali fuq is-suċċess tagħmel ħsara lir-relazzjonijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The author shows how the main character's obsession with success damages his relationships.
formal.zh: 作者展示了主人公对成功的执念如何损害他的人际关系。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Erġajt biddilt il-kulur tat-titlu? Lara: Iva, għandi fissazzjoni fuq id-dettalji. Issa se nħallih hekk.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you change the title's colour again? Lara: Yes, I have a fixation on details. I'll leave it like this now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你又改标题的颜色了？拉拉：是啊，我对细节太执着了。现在就这样定下来吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你又改标题的颜色了？
messages.en: Did you change the title's colour again?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi fissazzjoni fuq id-dettalji. Issa se nħallih hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi fissazzjoni fuq id-dettalji. Issa se nħallih hekk.
messages.zh: 是啊，我对细节太执着了。现在就这样定下来吧。
messages.en: Yes, I have a fixation on details. I'll leave it like this now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象注意力被一处细节牢牢吸住，反复修改也放不下；用 fissazzjoni fuq 加关注对象，记住“对某事的执念”。

gloss_zh: 溺爱别人的人；容易把人宠坏的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who pampers others and spoils them through excessive indulgence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过度迁就、宠爱别人，以至于容易把对方宠坏的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tfisser lil ħaddieħor bi mħabba u indulġenza żejda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 溺爱、纵容别人并把对方宠坏的人

collocations.en: someone who pampers and spoils children
someone who pampers and spoils the grandchildren

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-nannu jidher bħala fissied li qatt ma jirrifjuta talba tan-neputijiet.
formal.en: In the story, the grandfather is portrayed as someone who spoils his grandchildren and never refuses their requests.
formal.zh: 在故事中，祖父被描写成一个溺爱孙辈的人，从不拒绝他们的要求。

colloquial.mt: Sara: In-nannu reġa' ġabilhom il-ħelu? Mark: Iva, huwa fissied! Ma jafx jgħidilhom le.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Grandpa bring them sweets again? Mark: Yes, he's such a spoiler! He doesn't know how to say no to them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：爷爷又给他们带糖果了？马克：是啊，他就是个宠孩子的人！他都不知道怎么对他们说不。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 爷爷又给他们带糖果了？
messages.en: Did Grandpa bring them sweets again?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa fissied! Ma jafx jgħidilhom le.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa fissied! Ma jafx jgħidilhom le.
messages.zh: 是啊，他就是个宠孩子的人！他都不知道怎么对他们说不。
messages.en: Yes, he's such a spoiler! He doesn't know how to say no to them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给总是递糖、从不拒绝孩子的爷爷贴上 fissied 的人物标签；它指“宠别人的人”，不是“被宠坏的人”。

gloss_zh: 爱宠人的；惯于溺爱别人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to pamper others by giving them excessive attention, comfort, or indulgence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或性格倾向于过分关照、迁就和宠爱别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jfisser lil ħaddieħor b'attenzjoni, kumdità jew indulġenza żejda.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to pamper others
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有宠爱、迁就别人倾向的；爱溺爱别人的

collocations.en: a character inclined to pamper others
a man who tends to pamper others

formal.mt: Il-karattru fissiedi tal-missier jidher fil-mod kif jaċċetta kull talba ta' wliedu.
formal.en: The father's indulgent character is evident in the way he accepts every request from his children.
formal.zh: 这位父亲有求必应的做法，体现了他惯于溺爱孩子的性格。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex dejjem tixtrilhom xi ħaġa? Pawlu: Għandi karattru fissiedi; nieħu gost narahom kuntenti.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why do you always buy them something? Pawlu: I tend to pamper people; I enjoy seeing them happy.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么总给他们买东西？保罗：我性格就是爱宠人，看到他们开心我就高兴。

messages.speaker: Anna (妻子)
messages.zh: 你为什么总给他们买东西？
messages.en: Why do you always buy them something?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi karattru fissiedi; nieħu gost narahom kuntenti.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi karattru fissiedi; nieħu gost narahom kuntenti.
messages.zh: 我性格就是爱宠人，看到他们开心我就高兴。
messages.en: I tend to pamper people; I enjoy seeing them happy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fissiedi 放在 karattru 后面，记成“爱宠人的性格”；与名词 fissied 对照，一个描述倾向，一个指具有这种行为的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Providing an explanation that helps someone understand a subject, statement, or idea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于解释某个主题、说法或观点，帮助读者或听者理解的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti spjegazzjoni biex jgħin lil xi ħadd jifhem suġġett, stqarrija jew idea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解释性的；起说明作用的。

formal.mt: Il-ktieb jinkludi test fissieri biex il-qarrej jifhem aħjar id-dijagramma.
formal.en: The book includes an explanatory text to help the reader understand the diagram better.
formal.zh: 本书附有说明性文字，帮助读者更好地理解这幅示意图。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma fhimtx din id-dijagramma. Mark: Aqra t-test fissieri taħtha; jgħinek tifhimha.
colloquial.en: Maja: I didn't understand this diagram. Mark: Read the explanatory text below it; it will help you understand it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我没看懂这幅示意图。Mark：读一下下面的说明文字，会帮助你理解。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我没看懂这幅示意图。
messages.en: I didn't understand this diagram.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqra t-test fissieri taħtha; jgħinek tifhimha.
messages.mt_standard: Aqra t-test fissieri taħtha; jgħinek tifhimha.
messages.zh: 读一下下面的说明文字，会帮助你理解。
messages.en: Read the explanatory text below it; it will help you understand it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象图画旁有一段专门解释内容的文字，把 fissieri 与“帮助理解的说明”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An abnormal passage connecting organs or connecting an organ to the skin; also, informally, an annoying person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 器官之间或器官与皮肤之间形成的异常通道，即瘘或瘘管；也可在非正式表达中指讨厌的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Passaġġ mhux normali bejn organi jew bejn organu u l-ġilda; tintuża wkoll informalment għal persuna li ddejjaq lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瘘；瘘管，指器官之间或器官与皮肤之间的异常通道。
讨厌的人；惹人烦的人，属于不客气的非正式称呼。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jiddeskrivi fistla bejn żewġ organi.
formal.en: The medical report describes a fistula between two organs.
formal.zh: 医疗报告描述了两个器官之间的一条瘘管。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lestejt? Lestejt? Nistgħu nitilqu? Anna: Tkunx fistla; ħallini nlesti din il-paġna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you finished? Have you finished? Can we leave? Anna: Don't be a nuisance; let me finish this page.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你弄完了吗？弄完了吗？我们能走了吗？Anna：别烦人了，让我把这一页弄完。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弄完了吗？弄完了吗？我们能走了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished? Have you finished? Can we leave?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkunx fistla; ħallini nlesti din il-paġna.
messages.mt_standard: Tkunx fistla; ħallini nlesti din il-paġna.
messages.zh: 别烦人了，让我把这一页弄完。
messages.en: Don't be a nuisance; let me finish this page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fistla 做两张场景卡：医院里是“瘘管”，朋友抱怨时是“烦人的人”；分开记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 与放屁有关的；与排肠气有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to passing gas from the bowels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与从肠道排出气体，也就是放屁这一行为有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ħruġ tal-gass mill-imsaren.

sense_translations.en_definition: pertaining to the breaking of wind
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与放屁或排肠气有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-reċensjoni tiddeskrivi l-umoriżmu fiswi fil-film bħala mhux adattat għal kull udjenza.
formal.en: The review describes the film's humour about farting as unsuitable for some audiences.
formal.zh: 影评指出，影片中以放屁为题材的幽默并不适合所有观众。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'kien dak il-ħoss fil-filmat? Ben: Ħoss fiswi miżjud bħala ċajta.
colloquial.en: Nina: What was that sound in the video? Ben: A farting sound added as a joke.
colloquial.zh: Nina：视频里那个是什么声音？Ben：是为了搞笑加上的放屁声。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 视频里那个是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound in the video?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 是为了搞笑加上的放屁声。
messages.en: A farting sound added as a joke.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象喜剧视频给放屁配上音效，把 fiswi 放在“声音”旁记，理解为“与放屁有关的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name written Fiteni, used to identify a person by surname.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个写作 Fiteni 的姓氏，用于姓名中标示某人的姓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jinkiteb Fiteni u jintuża bħala parti mill-isem ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏：Fiteni。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Fiteni se jattendi l-laqgħa bħala rappreżentant tal-familja.
formal.en: Mr Fiteni will attend the meeting as the family's representative.
formal.zh: Fiteni 先生将作为家庭代表出席会议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu kunjomok? Daniel: Fiteni. Tridni niktbu għalik?
colloquial.en: Sara: What's your surname? Daniel: Fiteni. Would you like me to write it down for you?
colloquial.zh: Sara：你姓什么？Daniel：Fiteni。要我写给你吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (接待员)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What's your surname?

messages.speaker: Daniel (访客)
messages.zh: Fiteni。要我写给你吗？
messages.en: Fiteni. Would you like me to write it down for you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象登记表的“姓氏”栏填着 Fiteni；把它当作完整姓氏记忆，实际书写时首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who explores places or searches for information through investigation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 探索地点、开展探险，或通过调查寻找信息的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tesplora postijiet jew tfittex informazzjoni permezz ta' investigazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 探索者；探险者，指探索地点或未知环境的人。
调查者；调查员，指搜集信息以查明事情的人。

formal.mt: Il-fittiex tal-għerien irreġistra l-osservazzjonijiet tiegħu f'rapport dettaljat.
formal.en: The cave explorer recorded his observations in a detailed report.
formal.zh: 这位洞穴探索者在一份详细报告中记录了自己的观察结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jurina l-għar? Toni: Fittiex li jaf dan il-post sew; se niltaqgħu miegħu fid-daħla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will show us the cave? Toni: An explorer who knows this place well; we'll meet him at the entrance.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁带我们参观这个洞穴？Toni：一位很熟悉这里的探索者，我们会在入口处和他碰面。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 谁带我们参观这个洞穴？
messages.en: Who will show us the cave?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fittiex li jaf dan il-post sew; se niltaqgħu miegħu fid-daħla.
messages.mt_standard: Fittiex li jaf dan il-post sew; se niltaqgħu miegħu fid-daħla.
messages.zh: 一位很熟悉这里的探索者，我们会在入口处和他碰面。
messages.en: An explorer who knows this place well; we'll meet him at the entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fittiex 配一位拿着地图、寻找线索的人物：探索地点是探险者，查找事实是调查者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to search, look for information, or investigate things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于主动搜寻、查找信息或探究事物的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jfittex, jiġbor informazzjoni jew jistħarreġ l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有搜寻倾向的；喜欢查找或探究的。

formal.mt: Student fittiexi jfittex aktar minn sors wieħed biex jifhem is-suġġett aħjar.
formal.en: An inquisitive student consults more than one source to understand the subject better.
formal.zh: 好探究的学生会查阅不止一个来源，以便更好地理解这个主题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dejjem tfittex aktar tagħrif wara l-lezzjoni? Ben: Għandi moħħ fittiexi; inħobb insib tweġibiet għall-mistoqsijiet tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you always look for more information after the lesson? Ben: I have an inquiring mind; I like finding answers to my questions.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么下课后总要再找些资料？Ben：我爱探究，喜欢为自己的问题找到答案。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dejjem tfittex aktar tagħrif wara l-lezzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dejjem tfittex aktar tagħrif wara l-lezzjoni?
messages.zh: 你为什么下课后总要再找些资料？
messages.en: Why do you always look for more information after the lesson?

messages.speaker: Ben (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi moħħ fittiexi; inħobb insib tweġibiet għall-mistoqsijiet tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi moħħ fittiexi; inħobb insib tweġibiet għall-mistoqsijiet tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我爱探究，喜欢为自己的问题找到答案。
messages.en: I have an inquiring mind; I like finding answers to my questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fittiexi 贴在“总爱再查一查”的学生身上；它描述爱搜寻的倾向，可搭配学生或头脑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who interferes with other people or disrupts an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 干涉他人、打断活动或妨碍事情正常进行的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tindaħal jew tfixkel lil ħaddieħor waqt xi attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干扰者；捣乱的人，指干涉他人或扰乱活动的人。

collocations.en: to be a nuisance to other people

formal.mt: L-għalliem iddeskriva lill-istudent bħala fixkiel fil-klassi għax kien jinterrompi lil sħabu kontinwament.
formal.en: The teacher described the student as a disruptive person in class because he kept interrupting his classmates.
formal.zh: 老师称这名学生是课堂上的捣乱者，因为他不断打断同学。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Pawlu, tkunx fixkiel għal ħaddieħor; qed nippruvaw naħdmu. Pawlu: Sewwa, se nieqaf ninterrompi u nħallikom taħdmu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Pawlu, don't be a nuisance to everyone; we're trying to work. Pawlu: All right, I'll stop interrupting and let you work.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Pawlu，别干扰大家，我们正想好好做事呢。Pawlu：好，我不再打断你们了，让你们好好做事。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu, tkunx fixkiel għal ħaddieħor; qed nippruvaw naħdmu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu, tkunx fixkiel għal ħaddieħor; qed nippruvaw naħdmu.
messages.zh: Pawlu，别干扰大家，我们正想好好做事呢。
messages.en: Pawlu, don't be a nuisance to everyone; we're trying to work.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, se nieqaf ninterrompi u nħallikom taħdmu.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, se nieqaf ninterrompi u nħallikom taħdmu.
messages.zh: 好，我不再打断你们了，让你们好好做事。
messages.en: All right, I'll stop interrupting and let you work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小组做事时总有人插话打断，把本词条的 fixkiel 记成“那个干扰大家的人”。

gloss_zh: 扰乱思路的；造成干扰的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing confusion or interrupting someone's attention or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人混乱、分散注意力或妨碍活动正常进行的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħawwad il-ħsieb, itellef l-attenzjoni jew ifixkel attività.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a confusing or disruptive influence
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使人混乱或扰乱正常活动的影响的。

collocations.zh: 使人困惑或造成干扰的话

formal.mt: Waqt il-qari, ħoss fixkieli minn barra naqqas il-konċentrazzjoni tal-istudenti.
formal.en: During the reading session, a distracting noise from outside reduced the students' concentration.
formal.zh: 阅读时，外面传来的干扰性噪声降低了学生的专注程度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħoss fixkieli ma jħallinix naqra. Pawlu: Nagħlaq it-tieqa biex tkun tista' tikkonċentra.
colloquial.en: Maja: This distracting noise won't let me read. Pawlu: I'll close the window so you can concentrate.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这噪声太干扰人了，我没法读书。Pawlu：我把窗户关上，让你能集中注意力。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħoss fixkieli ma jħallinix naqra.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħoss fixkieli ma jħallinix naqra.
messages.zh: 这噪声太干扰人了，我没法读书。
messages.en: This distracting noise won't let me read.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħlaq it-tieqa biex tkun tista' tikkonċentra.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħlaq it-tieqa biex tkun tista' tikkonċentra.
messages.zh: 我把窗户关上，让你能集中注意力。
messages.en: I'll close the window so you can concentrate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fixkieli 放进“噪声干扰阅读”的画面，记住它是形容干扰性质的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An obstruction or interference that makes movement or an activity difficult.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使通行或活动难以顺利进行的阻碍或干扰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xkiel li jagħmel il-moviment jew it-twettiq ta' attività aktar diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阻碍；妨碍通行或事情进行的障碍。
车轮中的辐条，即连接轮毂与轮缘的条状部件。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħlijiet fit-triq ikkawżaw fixkil fit-traffiku għal diversi sigħat.
formal.en: The roadworks caused traffic obstruction for several hours.
formal.zh: 道路施工造成了持续数小时的交通阻碍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hemm ħafna fixkil fit-triq illum? Mark: Iva, qed isiru xi xogħlijiet ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there much obstruction on the road today? Mark: Yes, there's some work going on near the square.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今天路上有很多阻碍吗？Mark：有，广场附近正在施工。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天路上有很多阻碍吗？
messages.en: Is there much obstruction on the road today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed isiru xi xogħlijiet ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed isiru xi xogħlijiet ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.zh: 有，广场附近正在施工。
messages.en: Yes, there's some work going on near the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张独立词卡记 fixkil：一张画道路受阻，一张画车轮辐条；根据语境选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Confusion in one's thoughts or a distraction that draws attention away from an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 思绪混乱的状态，或使注意力离开当前活动的干扰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħwid fil-ħsieb jew xi ħaġa li ttellef l-attenzjoni minn attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混乱；思绪不清或难以理清事情的状态。
分心；使注意力转移的干扰。

formal.mt: Waqt l-istudju, il-messaġġi kontinwi fuq it-telefon jistgħu jkunu sors ta' fixkla.
formal.en: During study, constant messages on the phone can be a source of distraction.
formal.zh: 学习时，手机上不断收到的消息可能成为使人分心的来源。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-telefon qed ikun fixkla waqt li nistudja. Adam: Poġġih f'kamra oħra għal ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: The phone is becoming a distraction while I study. Adam: Put it in another room for a while.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我学习的时候，手机总让我分心。Adam：先把它放到另一个房间吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: It-telefon qed ikun fixkla waqt li nistudja.
messages.mt_standard: It-telefon qed ikun fixkla waqt li nistudja.
messages.zh: 我学习的时候，手机总让我分心。
messages.en: The phone is becoming a distraction while I study.

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.zh: 先把它放到另一个房间吧。
messages.en: Put it in another room for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手机消息把思路打乱：fixkla 既可记“脑中混乱”，也可记“注意力被引开”。

gloss_zh: 糊涂的人；心不在焉的人；精神状态不稳定的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is confused, distracted, or mentally unstable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于糊涂、注意力分散或精神状态不稳定情形的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mħawda, distratta jew mhux stabbli mentalment.

sense_translations.en_definition: a confused, distracted or mentally ustable person
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个糊涂、心不在焉或精神状态不稳定的人。

collocations.en: to seem like a confused or distracted person
collocations.zh: 显得像个糊涂或心不在焉的人
觉得自己糊里糊涂、丢三落四

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jidher qisu fixkula: jinsa l-appuntamenti u jitlef il-ħsieb waqt il-konversazzjoni.
formal.en: In the story, the character seems scatterbrained: he forgets appointments and loses his train of thought during conversation.
formal.zh: 故事中的人物显得心不在焉：他忘记约定，交谈时也会思路中断。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Illum inħossni fixkula; insejt iċ-ċwievet u l-lista tax-xiri. Sara: Ejja nieqfu ftit u naraw x'għandna bżonn.
colloquial.en: Toni: I feel scatterbrained today; I forgot the keys and the shopping list. Sara: Let's stop for a moment and see what we need.
colloquial.zh: Toni：今天我真是丢三落四，钥匙和购物清单都忘了。Sara：我们先停一下，看看需要些什么。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum inħossni fixkula; insejt iċ-ċwievet u l-lista tax-xiri.
messages.mt_standard: Illum inħossni fixkula; insejt iċ-ċwievet u l-lista tax-xiri.
messages.zh: 今天我真是丢三落四，钥匙和购物清单都忘了。
messages.en: I feel scatterbrained today; I forgot the keys and the shopping list.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieqfu ftit u naraw x'għandna bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieqfu ftit u naraw x'għandna bżonn.
messages.zh: 我们先停一下，看看需要些什么。
messages.en: Let's stop for a moment and see what we need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fixkula 配上一个忘带钥匙、说话走神的人物画面，记住这个名词指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of confusion in which thoughts, information, or arrangements are unclear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 思路、信息或安排不清楚，令人难以理解或理顺的混乱状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' taħwid li fih il-ħsibijiet, l-informazzjoni jew l-arranġamenti ma jkunux ċari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混乱；事情或思绪不清楚而产生的困惑。

formal.mt: Il-bidla fil-ħin tal-laqgħa ħolqot fixla fost il-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The change in the meeting time created confusion among the participants.
formal.zh: 会议时间的变更使与会者产生了困惑。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'fixla! Il-laqgħa fit-tlieta jew fl-erbgħa? David: Fl-erbgħa; għadhom kif bagħtu l-ħin il-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Marta: What confusion! Is the meeting at three or four? David: At four; they've just sent the new time.
colloquial.zh: Marta：真乱！会议到底是三点还是四点？David：四点，他们刚发来新的时间。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 真乱！会议到底是三点还是四点？
messages.en: What confusion! Is the meeting at three or four?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-erbgħa; għadhom kif bagħtu l-ħin il-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-erbgħa; għadhom kif bagħtu l-ħin il-ġdid.
messages.zh: 四点，他们刚发来新的时间。
messages.en: At four; they've just sent the new time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fixla 联想到两份时间不同的会议通知，脱口说“真混乱”，用具体情境记词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greater flamingo (Phoenicopterus roseus), a large waterbird with long legs, a long neck, and pale pink plumage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大红鹳，学名 Phoenicopterus roseus，一种腿长、颈长、羽毛呈浅粉色的大型水鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ilma kbir tal-ispeċi Phoenicopterus roseus, b'saqajn twal, għonq twil u rix roża ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大红鹳，学名 Phoenicopterus roseus。

collocations.en: a greater flamingo with a long neck
a greater flamingo in shallow water

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenti raw fjamingu miexi bil-mod fl-ilma baxx.
formal.en: During the observation session, the students saw a greater flamingo walking slowly in shallow water.
formal.zh: 观察活动中，学生们看到一只大红鹳在浅水中缓慢行走。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara dak il-fjamingu! Kemm għandu saqajh twal! Ben: Iva, u ara kif miexi fl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Lina: Look at that greater flamingo! Its legs are so long! Ben: Yes, and look at how it's walking in the water.
colloquial.zh: Lina：看那只大红鹳！它的腿真长！Ben：是啊，再看看它在水里走路的样子。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-fjamingu! Kemm għandu saqajh twal!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-fjamingu! Kemm għandu saqajh twal!
messages.zh: 看那只大红鹳！它的腿真长！
messages.en: Look at that greater flamingo! Its legs are so long!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ara kif miexi fl-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ara kif miexi fl-ilma.
messages.zh: 是啊，再看看它在水里走路的样子。
messages.en: Yes, and look at how it's walking in the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用粉红羽毛、长脖子和浅水中迈步的长腿画面记 fjamingu，英文 flamingo 的相似拼写也能辅助联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The visible burning part of a fire, such as the flame of a candle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燃烧时可见的发光火焰，例如蜡烛燃烧时的焰头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tan-nar li tidher u tagħti d-dawl waqt il-ħruq, bħal dik ta' xemgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火焰；物体燃烧时可见的发光部分。

formal.mt: Il-fjamma tax-xemgħa kienet tagħti dawl ħafif lill-kamra.
formal.en: The candle flame cast a soft light in the room.
formal.zh: 蜡烛的火焰为房间带来了柔和的光。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-fjamma tax-xemgħa qed titħarrek ħafna. Ġużeppi: Hemm riħ mit-tieqa; nagħlaqha.
colloquial.en: Marija: The candle flame is flickering a lot. Ġużeppi: There's a draught from the window; I'll close it.
colloquial.zh: Marija：蜡烛的火焰晃得很厉害。Ġużeppi：有风从窗户吹进来，我把它关上。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 蜡烛的火焰晃得很厉害。
messages.en: The candle flame is flickering a lot.

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (室友)
messages.zh: 有风从窗户吹进来，我把它关上。
messages.en: There's a draught from the window; I'll close it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 fjamma 就想象蜡烛顶端摇动的小火苗，再配读 il-fjamma tax-xemgħa，整组记住“蜡烛的火焰”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or state of a plant producing and opening flowers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物长出并开放花朵的过程或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-istat ta' pjanta li toħroġ u tiftaħ il-fjuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开花；花朵绽放的过程或状态。

formal.mt: L-istudenti rreġistraw il-bidu tal-fjoritura ta' kull pjanta fil-ġnien.
formal.en: The students recorded the start of flowering for each plant in the garden.
formal.zh: 学生们记录了花园中每株植物开始开花的时间。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Bdiet il-fjoritura tas-siġra fil-ġnien? Pietru: Iva, illum rajt l-ewwel fjuri miftuħa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has the tree in the garden started blossoming? Pietru: Yes, I saw the first open flowers today.
colloquial.zh: Anna：花园里的树开始开花了吗？Pietru：是的，我今天看到了第一批开放的花。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 花园里的树开始开花了吗？
messages.en: Has the tree in the garden started blossoming?

messages.speaker: Pietru (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum rajt l-ewwel fjuri miftuħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum rajt l-ewwel fjuri miftuħa.
messages.zh: 是的，我今天看到了第一批开放的花。
messages.en: Yes, I saw the first open flowers today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fjoritura 配成花苞逐渐开放的一段画面，记住它强调“开花”的过程或状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flowering plant, or the blossom that forms part of a plant's reproductive system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指开花的植物，也指植物上承担繁殖功能的花朵；阅读时需根据语境区分整株植物与花朵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li tagħmel il-fjuri, jew il-parti riproduttiva ta' pjanta li tiftaħ fi fjur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花；作为植物种类或整株植物来理解的开花植物。
花；花朵，植物的繁殖结构。

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu josserva fjur miftuħ u jiddeskrivi l-partijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The student should observe an open flower and describe its parts.
formal.zh: 学生应观察一朵盛开的花，并描述它的各个部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema fjur trid fil-vażun? Mark: Dak l-abjad, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which flower would you like in the vase? Mark: The white one, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想把哪朵花放进花瓶？马克：白色的那朵，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想把哪朵花放进花瓶？
messages.en: Which flower would you like in the vase?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 白色的那朵，谢谢。
messages.en: The white one, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fjur 配成两张图卡：一张画整株开花植物，一张只画花朵，用语境区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An iris: a plant belonging to the genus Iris, without specifying a particular species.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸢尾属植物的通称；单独使用时不限定某一个具体物种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ġeneru Iris, mingħajr ma tkun speċifikata speċi partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸢尾；泛指鸢尾属（Iris）及其各物种的植物。

formal.mt: Fil-gwida, l-isem fjurduliż jirreferi għal pjanta tal-ġeneru Iris.
formal.en: In the guide, the name fjurduliż refers to a plant of the genus Iris.
formal.zh: 在这本指南中，fjurduliż 这个名称指鸢尾属植物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-pjanta fjurduliż? Pawlu: Iva, imma ma nafx liema speċi hi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this plant an iris? Pawlu: Yes, but I don't know which species it is.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这株植物是鸢尾吗？保罗：是的，不过我不知道它是哪一种。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 这株植物是鸢尾吗？
messages.en: Is this plant an iris?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ma nafx liema speċi hi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ma nafx liema speċi hi.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我不知道它是哪一种。
messages.en: Yes, but I don't know which species it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fjurduliż 放在“鸢尾属”总卡上，下面再放各物种卡，记住它可以只表示通称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The iris species Iris albicans, known in English as cemetery iris.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Iris albicans 的白花鸢尾，英语名称为 cemetery iris。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' fjurduliż bl-isem xjentifiku Iris albicans.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白花鸢尾（Iris albicans）；英语名称为 cemetery iris。

collocations.en: a label for a cemetery iris

formal.mt: It-tikketta tal-fjurduliż abjad għandha tinkludi l-isem xjentifiku Iris albicans.
formal.en: The cemetery iris label should include the scientific name Iris albicans.
formal.zh: 白花鸢尾的标签应包含其学名 Iris albicans。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'nikteb fuq din it-tikketta? Toni: Ikteb fjurduliż abjad u, taħtu, Iris albicans.
colloquial.en: Sara: What should I write on this label? Toni: Write fjurduliż abjad and, underneath it, Iris albicans.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张标签上该写什么？托尼：写 fjurduliż abjad，再在下面写 Iris albicans。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 这张标签上该写什么？
messages.en: What should I write on this label?

messages.speaker: Toni (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb fjurduliż abjad u, taħtu, Iris albicans.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb fjurduliż abjad u, taħtu, Iris albicans.
messages.zh: 写 fjurduliż abjad，再在下面写 Iris albicans。
messages.en: Write fjurduliż abjad and, underneath it, Iris albicans.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 abjad“白色的”帮助记住白花鸢尾，再把整个名称与 Iris albicans 配对背诵。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The iris known as German iris, with the scientific name Iris × germanica.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指德国鸢尾，学名为 Iris × germanica；学习时应把整个马耳他语名称作为一个植物名称记忆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' fjurduliż bl-isem xjentifiku Iris × germanica.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 德国鸢尾（Iris × germanica）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a German iris

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jelenka l-fjurduliż ikħal bl-isem xjentifiku Iris × germanica.
formal.en: The catalogue lists German iris under the scientific name Iris × germanica.
formal.zh: 目录以学名 Iris × germanica 列出德国鸢尾。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom fjurduliż ikħal? Rita: Iva, ara din il-pjanta bit-tikketta Iris × germanica.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have German iris? Rita: Yes, look at this plant labelled Iris × germanica.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们有德国鸢尾吗？丽塔：有，看看这株标着 Iris × germanica 的植物。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们有德国鸢尾吗？
messages.en: Do you have German iris?

messages.speaker: Rita (苗圃店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara din il-pjanta bit-tikketta Iris × germanica.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara din il-pjanta bit-tikketta Iris × germanica.
messages.zh: 有，看看这株标着 Iris × germanica 的植物。
messages.en: Yes, look at this plant labelled Iris × germanica.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fjurduliż ikħal、德国鸢尾和 Iris × germanica 写在同一张卡上，按完整名称对应记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The iris species Iris pseudacorus, known in English as yellow flag.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指黄菖蒲，学名为 Iris pseudacorus，英语名称为 yellow flag。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' fjurduliż bl-isem xjentifiku Iris pseudacorus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄菖蒲（Iris pseudacorus），一种鸢尾属植物。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-fjurduliż isfar huwa identifikat bħala Iris pseudacorus.
formal.en: In the report, yellow flag is identified as Iris pseudacorus.
formal.zh: 报告将黄菖蒲确定为 Iris pseudacorus。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan ir-ritratt ta' fjurduliż isfar? Ġużepp: Iva, u l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu hu Iris pseudacorus.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this a photograph of yellow flag? Ġużepp: Yes, and its scientific name is Iris pseudacorus.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这是黄菖蒲的照片吗？朱塞佩：是的，它的学名是 Iris pseudacorus。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这是黄菖蒲的照片吗？
messages.en: Is this a photograph of yellow flag?

messages.speaker: Ġużepp (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu hu Iris pseudacorus.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu hu Iris pseudacorus.
messages.zh: 是的，它的学名是 Iris pseudacorus。
messages.en: Yes, and its scientific name is Iris pseudacorus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 isfar“黄色的”连接中文“黄菖蒲”，再把 Iris pseudacorus 加在图卡背面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The iris species Iris susiana, known in English as mourning iris.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Iris susiana 的鸢尾，英语名称为 mourning iris，可对应记作“哀悼鸢尾”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' fjurduliż bl-isem xjentifiku Iris susiana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哀悼鸢尾（Iris susiana）；英语名称为 mourning iris。

collocations.en: a photograph of a mourning iris
the scientific name of mourning iris

formal.mt: Il-gwida tagħti Iris susiana bħala l-isem xjentifiku tal-fjurduliż ittigrat.
formal.en: The guide gives Iris susiana as the scientific name of mourning iris.
formal.zh: 指南给出的哀悼鸢尾学名为 Iris susiana。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Kif insib il-fjurduliż ittigrat fl-indiċi? David: Fittex ukoll taħt Iris susiana.
colloquial.en: Emma: How can I find mourning iris in the index? David: Look under Iris susiana as well.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：我怎么在索引里找到哀悼鸢尾？戴维：也查一下 Iris susiana 这个条目。

messages.speaker: Emma (读者)
messages.zh: 我怎么在索引里找到哀悼鸢尾？
messages.en: How can I find mourning iris in the index?

messages.speaker: David (图书管理员)
messages.zh: 也查一下 Iris susiana 这个条目。
messages.en: Look under Iris susiana as well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fjurduliż ittigrat 与 Iris susiana 连成一组，再与 fjurduliż ta' Farawni 并排，记住两名对应同种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The iris species Iris pallida, known in English as sweet iris.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指淡色鸢尾，学名为 Iris pallida，英语名称为 sweet iris。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' fjurduliż bl-isem xjentifiku Iris pallida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淡色鸢尾（Iris pallida）；英语名称为 sweet iris。

collocations.en: a label for a sweet iris

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-pjanti, il-fjurduliż Sqalli jidher bl-isem xjentifiku Iris pallida.
formal.en: In the plant list, sweet iris appears under the scientific name Iris pallida.
formal.zh: 在植物名录中，淡色鸢尾以学名 Iris pallida 列出。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Qed infittex fjurduliż Sqalli. Mario: Ara din it-tikketta; hemm miktub Iris pallida.
colloquial.en: Anna: I'm looking for sweet iris. Mario: Look at this label; it says Iris pallida.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我在找淡色鸢尾。马里奥：看看这张标签，上面写着 Iris pallida。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 我在找淡色鸢尾。
messages.en: I'm looking for sweet iris.

messages.speaker: Mario (苗圃店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara din it-tikketta; hemm miktub Iris pallida.
messages.mt_standard: Ara din it-tikketta; hemm miktub Iris pallida.
messages.zh: 看看这张标签，上面写着 Iris pallida。
messages.en: Look at this label; it says Iris pallida.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作三面对应卡：fjurduliż Sqalli、淡色鸢尾、Iris pallida，每次遮住一项练习回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A name for the iris species Iris susiana, known in English as mourning iris.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Iris susiana 的哀悼鸢尾；与 fjurduliż ittigrat 对应同一物种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal speċi ta' fjurduliż bl-isem xjentifiku Iris susiana, magħrufa wkoll bħala fjurduliż ittigrat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哀悼鸢尾（Iris susiana）；英语名称为 mourning iris。

collocations.en: a photograph of a mourning iris

formal.mt: L-ismijiet fjurduliż ta' Farawni u fjurduliż ittigrat jirreferu għall-istess speċi, Iris susiana.
formal.en: The names fjurduliż ta' Farawni and fjurduliż ittigrat refer to the same species, Iris susiana.
formal.zh: fjurduliż ta' Farawni 和 fjurduliż ittigrat 这两个名称指同一物种，即 Iris susiana。

colloquial.mt: Lea: Fjurduliż ta' Farawni u fjurduliż ittigrat huma l-istess pjanta? Simon: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għal Iris susiana.
colloquial.en: Lea: Are fjurduliż ta' Farawni and fjurduliż ittigrat the same plant? Simon: Yes, both names refer to Iris susiana.
colloquial.zh: 莉娅：fjurduliż ta' Farawni 和 fjurduliż ittigrat 是同一种植物吗？西蒙：是的，这两个名称都指 Iris susiana。

messages.speaker: Lea (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fjurduliż ta' Farawni u fjurduliż ittigrat huma l-istess pjanta?
messages.mt_standard: Fjurduliż ta' Farawni u fjurduliż ittigrat huma l-istess pjanta?
messages.zh: fjurduliż ta' Farawni 和 fjurduliż ittigrat 是同一种植物吗？
messages.en: Are fjurduliż ta' Farawni and fjurduliż ittigrat the same plant?

messages.speaker: Simon (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għal Iris susiana.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għal Iris susiana.
messages.zh: 是的，这两个名称都指 Iris susiana。
messages.en: Yes, both names refer to Iris susiana.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两条箭头：fjurduliż ta' Farawni 和 fjurduliż ittigrat 都指向 Iris susiana，用同种双名称帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Yellow flag, the yellow-flowered iris species Iris pseudacorus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黄菖蒲，学名为 Iris pseudacorus 的黄色花鸢尾属植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-iris bi fjuri sofor, magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Iris pseudacorus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄菖蒲（Iris pseudacorus），一种开黄色花的鸢尾属植物。

collocations.en: the yellow flowers of yellow flag

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi ritratt tal-fjurduliż tal-ilma li ġie osservat ħdejn l-għadira.
formal.en: The report includes a photograph of the yellow flag observed beside the pond.
formal.zh: 报告收录了一张在池塘边观察到的黄菖蒲照片。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi dik il-pjanta bil-fjuri sofor? Mark: Dik hi l-fjurduliż tal-ilma. Nina: Ejja nieħdu ritratt tagħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that plant with the yellow flowers? Mark: That's yellow flag. Nina: Let's take a photo of it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那株开黄花的植物是什么？马克：那是黄菖蒲。妮娜：我们给它拍张照吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 那株开黄花的植物是什么？
messages.en: What's that plant with the yellow flowers?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是黄菖蒲。
messages.en: That's yellow flag.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们给它拍张照吧。
messages.en: Let's take a photo of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 tal-ilma 就联想水边，再把水边黄色花朵与“黄菖蒲”配对；英语 yellow flag 在这里也是植物名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Spanish iris, the plant species Iris xiphium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 西班牙鸢尾，学名为 Iris xiphium 的鸢尾属植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-iris magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Iris xiphium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西班牙鸢尾（Iris xiphium）。

collocations.en: the flowers of the Spanish iris

formal.mt: Fit-tikketta tal-ġnien botaniku, il-fjurduliż tal-ġonna huwa identifikat bħala Iris xiphium.
formal.en: On the botanical garden's label, the Spanish iris is identified as Iris xiphium.
formal.zh: 植物园的标牌将西班牙鸢尾标注为 Iris xiphium。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Pawlu: Dan hu l-fjurduliż tal-ġonna. Lara: Se nikteb l-isem biex niftakru.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's this plant called? Pawlu: This is a Spanish iris. Lara: I'll write down the name so I remember it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这株植物叫什么？保罗：这是西班牙鸢尾。拉拉：我要把名字写下来，方便记住。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's this plant called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.zh: 这是西班牙鸢尾。
messages.en: This is a Spanish iris.

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 我要把名字写下来，方便记住。
messages.en: I'll write down the name so I remember it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组与一张写着“西班牙鸢尾”的花园标牌配对记忆；用 tal-ġonna 提醒自己这是本组的花园词条。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clubs, the playing-card suit represented by the symbol ♣.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扑克牌中的梅花花色，以 ♣ 为标志。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieħed mill-erba' żrieragħ tal-karti tal-logħob, rappreżentat bis-simbolu ♣.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梅花，扑克牌的四种花色之一，符号为 ♣。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jagħżlu l-karti kollha tal-fjuri u jqegħduhom f'ringiela.
formal.en: In this exercise, students should select all the clubs and arrange them in a row.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生应挑出所有梅花牌，并把它们排成一行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek l-ass tal-fjuri? Toni: Le, għandi r-re tal-fjuri. Sara: Tajjeb, urini l-karta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have the ace of clubs? Toni: No, I have the king of clubs. Sara: Okay, show me the card.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你有梅花 A 吗？托尼：没有，我有梅花 K。萨拉：好，给我看看那张牌。

messages.speaker: Sara (牌友)
messages.zh: 你有梅花 A 吗？
messages.en: Do you have the ace of clubs?

messages.speaker: Toni (牌友)
messages.zh: 没有，我有梅花 K。
messages.en: No, I have the king of clubs.

messages.speaker: Sara (牌友)
messages.zh: 好，给我看看那张牌。
messages.en: Okay, show me the card.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张 ♣ 梅花牌作记忆卡，正面写 fjuri，背面写“梅花花色”；再连读 l-ass tal-fjuri，记住梅花 A。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substance used to produce heat or energy, for example to power an engine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于产生热量或能量的物质，例如为发动机提供动力的燃料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża biex tipproduċi sħana jew enerġija, pereżempju biex tħaddem magna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燃料，用于产生热量或提供动力的物质。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel il-konsum tal-fjuwil taż-żewġ vetturi waqt l-istess vjaġġ.
formal.en: The report compares the fuel consumption of the two vehicles over the same journey.
formal.zh: 报告比较了两辆车在相同路程中的燃料消耗量。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għad għandna biżżejjed fjuwil? David: Le, it-tank kważi vojt. Marija: Mela nieqfu fl-istazzjon li jmiss.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do we still have enough fuel? David: No, the tank is almost empty. Marija: Then let's stop at the next station.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我们的燃料还够吗？戴维：不够，油箱快空了。玛丽娅：那就在下一个加油站停吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (乘客)
messages.zh: 我们的燃料还够吗？
messages.en: Do we still have enough fuel?

messages.speaker: David (司机)
messages.zh: 不够，油箱快空了。
messages.en: No, the tank is almost empty.

messages.speaker: Marija (乘客)
messages.zh: 那就在下一个加油站停吧。
messages.en: Then let's stop at the next station.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fjuwil 与英语 fuel 对照朗读，再想象油箱指针接近零的画面；用 tank tal-fjuwil 一起记住“燃料箱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A placeholder name for a person whose actual name is unknown or deliberately left unmentioned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代替某个人姓名的称呼，用于不知道或不愿说出其真实姓名时，相当于“某某”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża minflok isem persuna meta l-isem ma jkunx magħruf jew ma jkunx mixtieq li jissemma.

sense_translations.en_definition: so-and-so, that bloke; a placeholder for a person whose name one cannot or does not want to mention, as in the phrase; "wieħed flien".
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某某；某个家伙。用作人的代称，表示说不出或不愿提及姓名的人，例如 wieħed flien。
某人；任何人，用于不具体指明某个人。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-espressjoni "wieħed flien" tintuża biex tirreferi għal persuna mingħajr ma jingħata isimha.
formal.en: In the exercise, the expression "wieħed flien" is used to refer to a person without giving their name.
formal.zh: 练习中使用“wieħed flien”这一表达来指代某个人，而不提供其姓名。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min qallek hekk? Ben: Wieħed flien; ma rridx insemmi ismu. Anna: Tajjeb, fhimt.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who told you that? Ben: Some bloke; I don't want to mention his name. Anna: Okay, I understand.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁告诉你的？本：某个人，我不想说他的名字。安娜：好，我明白了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁告诉你的？
messages.en: Who told you that?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wieħed flien; ma rridx insemmi ismu.
messages.mt_standard: Wieħed flien; ma rridx insemmi ismu.
messages.zh: 某个人，我不想说他的名字。
messages.en: Some bloke; I don't want to mention his name.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我明白了。
messages.en: Okay, I understand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人物名牌上的姓名被“某某”遮住，用 flien 填入这个位置；先整块记住 wieħed flien，表示某个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Paralysis, or, in another sense, a state of fatigue or exhaustion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指瘫痪，即身体某部位丧失运动能力；另一个义项指疲乏或筋疲力尽的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Paraliżi, jiġifieri telf tal-ħila li tiċċaqlaq parti mill-ġisem; f'sens ieħor, għeja jew eżawriment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瘫痪，身体某部位丧失运动能力的状态。
疲乏；疲劳，感到乏力或精力耗尽的状态。

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-kelma "fliġ" tirreferi għall-paraliżi, filwaqt li f'test ieħor tista' tirreferi għall-għeja.
formal.en: In this text, the word "fliġ" refers to paralysis, whereas in another text it may refer to fatigue.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本中，fliġ 指瘫痪；在另一篇文本中，它也可能指疲乏。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'jiġifieri "fliġ" f'din is-sentenza dwar ix-xogħol? Ġanni: Hawn tfisser għeja kbira. Marta: Mela hawn qed jitkellem fuq kemm hu għajjien.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does "fliġ" mean in this sentence about work? Ġanni: Here it means great fatigue. Marta: So here he's talking about how tired he is.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这句谈工作的句子里，fliġ 是什么意思？詹尼：这里指非常疲乏。玛尔塔：所以这里说的是他有多累。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 这句谈工作的句子里，fliġ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does "fliġ" mean in this sentence about work?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (老师)
messages.zh: 这里指非常疲乏。
messages.en: Here it means great fatigue.

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela hawn qed jitkellem fuq kemm hu għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Mela hawn qed jitkellem fuq kemm hu għajjien.
messages.zh: 所以这里说的是他有多累。
messages.en: So here he's talking about how tired he is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fliġ 做两张独立义项卡：一张写“瘫痪”，一张写“疲乏”；阅读时依据上下文选卡，不把两种状态混为一谈。
