teaching_sense.en_definition: Instead of; used to introduce the person, thing, or action being replaced by another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代替；而不是。用于引出被另一人、事物或行动替换的对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Minflok; tintuża biex turi l-persuna, il-ħaġa jew l-azzjoni li tkun qed tiġi sostitwita b'oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代替；而不是，表示选择或使用另一对象来替换所提及的对象。

collocations.zh: 代替汽车；不用汽车而用别的方式

formal.mt: Għal dan il-vjaġġ, il-parteċipanti għandhom jużaw il-ferrovija flok il-karozza.
formal.en: For this journey, participants should use the train instead of the car.
formal.zh: 此次出行，参与者应乘坐火车，而不是开车。

colloquial.mt: Lisa: Trid kafè? Samwel: Illum nieħu te flok kafè. Lisa: Tajjeb, nagħmillek te.
colloquial.en: Lisa: Would you like coffee? Samwel: Today I'll have tea instead of coffee. Lisa: Okay, I'll make you some tea.
colloquial.zh: 莉萨：你要咖啡吗？萨姆韦尔：今天我喝茶，不喝咖啡。莉萨：好，我给你泡茶。

messages.speaker: Lisa (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要咖啡吗？
messages.en: Would you like coffee?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天我喝茶，不喝咖啡。
messages.en: Today I'll have tea instead of coffee.

messages.speaker: Lisa (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我给你泡茶。
messages.en: Okay, I'll make you some tea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“A flok B”这个替换框架：选 A，替下 B；用 te flok kafè 练习，就是喝茶代替咖啡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flying jib, a headsail set farther forward than the jib on a sailing vessel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 飞艏帆，即帆船上设置在普通艏三角帆更前方的一面前帆，也称外艏三角帆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qlugħ fuq quddiem ta' bastiment bil-qlugħ, imqiegħed aktar 'il quddiem mill-jib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 飞艏帆；外艏三角帆，位于普通艏三角帆更前方的前帆。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-pożizzjoni tal-flokk ta' quddiem u tiddistingwih mill-qlugħ l-oħra tal-bastiment.
formal.en: The diagram shows the position of the flying jib and distinguishes it from the vessel's other sails.
formal.zh: 示意图展示了飞艏帆的位置，并将它与船上的其他帆区分开来。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Liema hu l-flokk ta' quddiem? Karl: Dak hemm, aktar 'il quddiem mill-jib. Rita: Issa qed narah, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Rita: Which one is the flying jib? Karl: That one there, farther forward than the jib. Rita: I can see it now, thanks.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：哪一面是飞艏帆？卡尔：那一面，在普通艏三角帆更前方。丽塔：现在我看到了，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Rita (航海学员)
messages.zh: 哪一面是飞艏帆？
messages.en: Which one is the flying jib?

messages.speaker: Karl (航海教练)
messages.zh: 那一面，在普通艏三角帆更前方。
messages.en: That one there, farther forward than the jib.

messages.speaker: Rita (航海学员)
messages.zh: 现在我看到了，谢谢。
messages.en: I can see it now, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一艘朝前航行的帆船，把 flokk ta' quddiem 标在普通艏三角帆更前方；借 quddiem 的“前方”提示记住整条航海术语。

gloss_zh: 弗洛里亚纳（马耳他城镇及地方议会辖区）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Floriana, a town in Malta's Port Region and the local council area bearing the same name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 弗洛里亚纳，马耳他港口地区的一座城镇，也是同名地方议会辖区的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Floriana hija belt fir-Reġjun tal-Port ta' Malta u l-isem taż-żona tal-kunsill lokali tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: Floriana (a town and local council of the Port Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 弗洛里亚纳（马耳他港口地区的一座城镇及其地方议会辖区）

formal.mt: L-istudenti se jagħmlu żjara f'Floriana biex isiru jafu aħjar din il-belt.
formal.en: The students will visit Floriana to get to know this town better.
formal.zh: 学生们将到弗洛里亚纳参观，以进一步了解这座城镇。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid niġu f'Floriana għada? Mark: Iva, niltaqgħu hemm fl-għaxra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go to Floriana tomorrow? Mark: Yes, let's meet there at ten.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们明天去弗洛里亚纳好吗？Mark：好，我们十点在那里见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天去弗洛里亚纳好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go to Floriana tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我们十点在那里见。
messages.en: Yes, let's meet there at ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Floriana 当作地图上的专名来记：想象在“弗洛里亚纳”站下车，再用“到访”和“居民”两个场景巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money held or paid as physical banknotes and coins.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以实体纸币和硬币形式持有或支付的钱，即现金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus fil-forma ta' karti tal-flus u muniti, li jistgħu jingħataw direttament bħala ħlas.

sense_translations.en_definition: cash (money in the form of notes/bills and coins)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 现金，即纸币和硬币形式的钱

formal.mt: Il-klijent ħallas bi flus qabd u rċieva rċevuta għall-ħlas.
formal.en: The customer paid in cash and received a receipt for the payment.
formal.zh: 顾客用现金付款，并收到了付款收据。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nħallas bi flus qabd? Pawlu: Iva, tista'. Għandek il-bqija eżatta?
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I pay in cash? Pawlu: Yes, you can. Do you have the exact change?
colloquial.zh: Lara：我可以用现金付款吗？Pawlu：可以。你有正好的零钱吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 我可以用现金付款吗？
messages.en: Can I pay in cash?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 可以。你有正好的零钱吗？
messages.en: Yes, you can. Do you have the exact change?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 flus qabd 整体记成“现金”：想象收银台上递出纸币、接回硬币，再跟读“用现金付款”的完整搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element fluorine, represented by the symbol F.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素氟，元素符号为 F。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku bis-simbolu F.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氟，一种化学元素

formal.mt: Fit-tabella perjodika, il-fluworu għandu s-simbolu F.
formal.en: In the periodic table, fluorine has the symbol F.
formal.zh: 在元素周期表中，氟的符号是 F。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu s-simbolu tal-fluworu? David: F. Ejja nsibuh fit-tabella perjodika.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is the symbol for fluorine? David: F. Let's find it in the periodic table.
colloquial.zh: Nina：氟的元素符号是什么？David：F。我们在元素周期表里找找它吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 氟的元素符号是什么？
messages.en: What is the symbol for fluorine?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: F。我们在元素周期表里找找它吧。
messages.en: F. Let's find it in the periodic table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三面联想卡：fluworu、中文“氟”、符号 F；每次看到 F，就回想并读出完整的马耳他语词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small inn offering accommodation to travellers; the diminutive form of fondoq.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供旅客住宿的小客栈或小旅店；是 fondoq 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fondoq żgħir fejn jistgħu joqogħdu l-vjaġġaturi; il-forma diminuttiva ta' fondoq.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small inn (the diminutive form of 'fondoq')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小客栈、小旅店（fondoq 的指小形式）

collocations.en: a small inn in the countryside
a room in a small inn

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġaturi qattgħu żewġt iljieli f'fnejdaq fil-kampanja.
formal.en: The travellers spent two nights at a small inn in the countryside.
formal.zh: 旅客们在乡间的一家小客栈住了两晚。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se norqdu llejla? Toni: Hemm fnejdaq qrib il-pjazza. Nistaqsu jekk għandhomx kamra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are we going to sleep tonight? Toni: There's a small inn near the square. Let's ask whether they have a room.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们今晚住哪里？Toni：广场附近有一家小客栈。我们去问问有没有房间吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅伴)
messages.zh: 我们今晚住哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going to sleep tonight?

messages.speaker: Toni (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm fnejdaq qrib il-pjazza. Nistaqsu jekk għandhomx kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm fnejdaq qrib il-pjazza. Nistaqsu jekk għandhomx kamra.
messages.zh: 广场附近有一家小客栈。我们去问问有没有房间吧。
messages.en: There's a small inn near the square. Let's ask whether they have a room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fondoq 与 fnejdaq 成对记忆：前者对应客栈，后者对应小客栈；脑中画一栋只有几间客房的小楼。

gloss_zh: 闷浊的空气；室内不通风的憋闷感

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stuffy indoor atmosphere, especially when the air is warm, stale, or poorly circulated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 室内空气闷热、污浊或不流通的状态，也指这种环境造成的憋闷感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' arja tqila jew magħluqa f'post li ma jkunx ivventilat tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 室内闷热污浊的空气
（房间等处）空气不流通的憋闷状态

formal.mt: Minħabba l-foga fis-sala, infetħu t-twieqi biex tidħol arja friska.
formal.en: Because of the stuffiness in the hall, the windows were opened to let in fresh air.
formal.zh: 由于大厅里空气憋闷，人们打开了窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm hawn foga! Nista' niftaħ it-tieqa? Ġanni: Iva, iftaħha. Għandna bżonn ftit arja friska.
colloquial.en: Marija: It's so stuffy in here! Can I open the window? Ġanni: Yes, open it. We need some fresh air.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这里真闷！我可以打开窗户吗？Ġanni：可以，打开吧。我们需要一点新鲜空气。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hawn foga! Nista' niftaħ it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hawn foga! Nista' niftaħ it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 这里真闷！我可以打开窗户吗？
messages.en: It's so stuffy in here! Can I open the window?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iftaħha. Għandna bżonn ftit arja friska.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iftaħha. Għandna bżonn ftit arja friska.
messages.zh: 可以，打开吧。我们需要一点新鲜空气。
messages.en: Yes, open it. We need some fresh air.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象关着窗、挤满人的房间，脱口而出“这里真闷”：把这种空气不流通的感觉与 foga 直接相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The leaves of a plant or group of plants considered collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一株或多株植物的叶子总体，常译为枝叶、叶丛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-weraq ta' pjanta jew ta' grupp ta' pjanti meqjus bħala ħaġa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物的叶子总称；枝叶；叶丛

formal.mt: Il-foljam dens tas-siġar jipprovdi dell tul il-mogħdija.
formal.en: The trees' dense foliage provides shade along the path.
formal.zh: 树木茂密的枝叶为小径沿途提供了荫凉。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn hu l-għasfur? Ma nistax narah. Samwel: Qiegħed moħbi fil-foljam, fuq dik il-fergħa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where is the bird? I can't see it. Samwel: It's hidden in the foliage, on that branch.
colloquial.zh: Rita：鸟在哪里？我看不见它。Samwel：它藏在枝叶里，就在那根树枝上。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-għasfur? Ma nistax narah.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-għasfur? Ma nistax narah.
messages.zh: 鸟在哪里？我看不见它。
messages.en: Where is the bird? I can't see it.

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed moħbi fil-foljam, fuq dik il-fergħa.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed moħbi fil-foljam, fuq dik il-fergħa.
messages.zh: 它藏在枝叶里，就在那根树枝上。
messages.en: It's hidden in the foliage, on that branch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把视线从一片叶子拉远到整片树冠：foljam 指整体的叶丛；想象小鸟藏在绿叶中，帮助记住集合含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The mouth of a person or animal, or an opening such as the mouth of a container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或动物的嘴，也可指容器等物体的口部或开口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-ġisem li minnha jidħol l-ikel; ukoll il-fetħa ta' oġġett, bħal flixkun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘴；口，人或动物进食的身体部位
口；孔口；开口，可指物体的口部

formal.mt: Qabel timla l-flixkun, kun żgur li l-fomm tiegħu jkun nadif.
formal.en: Before filling the bottle, make sure its mouth is clean.
formal.zh: 装满瓶子之前，请确保瓶口干净。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tħares lejja b'fomm miftuħ? Toni: Għax ma stennejtx li tirbaħ l-ewwel premju!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you looking at me with your mouth open? Toni: Because I didn't expect you to win first prize!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么张着嘴看着我？Toni：因为我没想到你会拿一等奖！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tħares lejja b'fomm miftuħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tħares lejja b'fomm miftuħ?
messages.zh: 你为什么张着嘴看着我？
messages.en: Why are you looking at me with your mouth open?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma stennejtx li tirbaħ l-ewwel premju!
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma stennejtx li tirbaħ l-ewwel premju!
messages.zh: 因为我没想到你会拿一等奖！
messages.en: Because I didn't expect you to win first prize!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把人的“嘴”和瓶子的“口”并排画出来，都标上 fomm；借助中文也用“口”表示开口这一点，记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 河口；河流入海或汇入其他水体之处

teaching_sense.en_definition: The place where a river flows into the sea, a lake, or another river.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 河流流入海洋、湖泊或另一条河流的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-post fejn xmara tiżbokka fil-baħar, f'għadira jew fi xmara oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 河口，即河流汇入海洋或其他水体的出口。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif is-sediment jinġabar f'fomm ix-xmara.
formal.en: The report describes how sediment accumulates at the river mouth.
formal.zh: 报告描述了沉积物如何在河口堆积。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Toni: Ħdejn il-pont, qrib fomm ix-xmara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet? Toni: By the bridge, near the river mouth.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里碰面？托尼：桥边，靠近河口的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 桥边，靠近河口的地方。
messages.en: By the bridge, near the river mouth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把河流想成一条通向大海的路线，水流离开河道的出口就是河口；整组记住 fomm ix-xmara。

gloss_zh: 加深；猛地沉入；潜到底部；浇铸液态金属

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something deeper; also to plunge or dive to the bottom, or to cast liquid metal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变得更深；也可指猛地沉入、潜到底部，或浇铸液态金属。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar fonda; jista' jfisser ukoll jinżel f'daqqa, jogħdos sal-qiegħ jew jitfa' metall imdewweb f'forma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加深，使深度增加。
猛地沉入或冲入。
潜到水底。
浇铸液态金属，将熔化的金属倒入铸模。

formal.mt: It-tim fonda l-kanal biex l-ilma jkun jista' jgħaddi aktar faċilment.
formal.en: The team deepened the channel so that water could flow through more easily.
formal.zh: 团队加深了水道，以便水流更顺畅地通过。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex fonda l-ħofra? Mark: Għax l-ewwel kienet baxxa wisq għas-siġra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did he deepen the hole? Mark: Because it was initially too shallow for the tree.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他为什么把坑挖得更深？马克：因为原来的坑太浅，不适合种这棵树。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 他为什么把坑挖得更深？
messages.en: Why did he deepen the hole?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-ewwel kienet baxxa wisq għas-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-ewwel kienet baxxa wisq għas-siġra.
messages.zh: 因为原来的坑太浅，不适合种这棵树。
messages.en: Because it was initially too shallow for the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“把坑挖深”记住加深义，再分开记“猛地沉入、潜到底部、浇铸金属”；看到宾语和场景再选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study of how speech sounds are organized and function as a system in a language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究语言中的语音如何组成系统，以及这些语音在系统中发挥什么作用的学科。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju ta' kif il-ħsejjes tad-diskors huma organizzati u jaħdmu bħala sistema f'lingwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 音系学，研究语言中语音的系统组织及其功能。

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu dwar il-fonoloġija tal-Malti jispjega kif il-ħsejjes jiffurmaw sistema.
formal.en: This chapter on Maltese phonology explains how sounds form a system.
formal.zh: 本章讨论马耳他语音系，解释语音如何构成一个系统。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed tistudja llum? Pawlu: Il-fonoloġija; qed nara kif jaħdmu l-ħsejjes f'lingwa.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you studying today? Pawlu: Phonology; I'm looking at how sounds work in a language.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天在学什么？保罗：音系学；我在看语音在一种语言中如何发挥作用。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你今天在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fonoloġija; qed nara kif jaħdmu l-ħsejjes f'lingwa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-fonoloġija; qed nara kif jaħdmu l-ħsejjes f'lingwa.
messages.zh: 音系学；我在看语音在一种语言中如何发挥作用。
messages.en: Phonology; I'm looking at how sounds work in a language.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一种语言的声音想成有规则的队伍：研究队伍怎样组织、怎样发挥作用，就是 fonoloġija 音系学。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the organization and function of speech sounds in a language, or to the study of that system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与语言中语音的系统组织和功能有关的，或与音系学研究有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sistema tal-ħsejjes ta' lingwa jew mal-istudju ta' din is-sistema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 音系的；音系学的，涉及语言的语音系统及其组织规律。

formal.mt: L-istudju jippreżenta analiżi fonoloġika tal-kliem miġbur waqt l-intervisti.
formal.en: The study presents a phonological analysis of the words collected during the interviews.
formal.zh: 该研究对访谈中收集的词语进行了音系分析。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser 'fonoloġiku'? David: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sistema tal-ħsejjes ta' lingwa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'phonological' mean? David: It means relating to a language's sound system.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：“音系的”是什么意思？戴维：意思是与一种语言的语音系统有关。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: “音系的”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'phonological' mean?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sistema tal-ħsejjes ta' lingwa.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sistema tal-ħsejjes ta' lingwa.
messages.zh: 意思是与一种语言的语音系统有关。
messages.en: It means relating to a language's sound system.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fonoloġija 与 fonoloġiku 成对记：前者是“音系学”这门学科，后者用来描述“音系的”过程或分析。

gloss_zh: 挑剔的；难以取悦的；难相处的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who is hard to please or difficult to deal with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人难以满足、很挑剔，或不容易相处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li diffiċli tissodisfah jew li diffiċli tittratta miegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: a person who is hard to please
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容难以取悦、很难感到满意的人。
形容难相处或难应付的人。

formal.mt: Meta klijent ikun fonqla, ikun utli li wieħed jispjega l-għażliet b'mod ċar.
formal.en: When a customer is hard to please, it is useful to explain the options clearly.
formal.zh: 遇到挑剔的顾客时，清楚说明各个选项会有帮助。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għoġbu r-rigal lil ħuk? Ġanni: Le, hu fonqla; dejjem isib xi ħaġa li ma togħġbux.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did your brother like the present? Ġanni: No, he's hard to please; he always finds something he doesn't like.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你哥哥喜欢那份礼物吗？詹尼：不喜欢，他很挑剔；总能找到不满意的地方。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥喜欢那份礼物吗？
messages.en: Did your brother like the present?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hu fonqla; dejjem isib xi ħaġa li ma togħġbux.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hu fonqla; dejjem isib xi ħaġa li ma togħġbux.
messages.zh: 不喜欢，他很挑剔；总能找到不满意的地方。
messages.en: No, he's hard to please; he always finds something he doesn't like.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象送出三份礼物，对方仍然样样不满意；用这个场景记 fonqla 的“挑剔、难取悦、难相处”。

gloss_zh: 丰塔纳，马耳他戈佐地区的村庄及地方议会辖区

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fontana, a village and local council area in the Gozo Region of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 丰塔纳，位于马耳他戈佐地区的一个村庄，也是一个地方议会辖区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Fontana, raħal u lokalità b'kunsill lokali fir-Reġjun ta' Għawdex, Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Fontana (a village and local council of the Gozo Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 丰塔纳，马耳他戈佐地区的村庄及地方议会辖区。

formal.mt: Il-programm taż-żjara jinkludi waqfa fil-Fontana, raħal fir-Reġjun ta' Għawdex.
formal.en: The visit programme includes a stop in Fontana, a village in the Gozo Region.
formal.zh: 参访行程包括在戈佐地区的丰塔纳村停留。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn toqgħod? Mario: Fil-Fontana, f'Għawdex.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where do you live? Mario: In Fontana, on Gozo.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你住在哪里？马里奥：住在戈佐岛的丰塔纳。

messages.speaker: Elena (新同学)
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Mario (学生)
messages.zh: 住在戈佐岛的丰塔纳。
messages.en: In Fontana, on Gozo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Fontana 放进“马耳他—戈佐—村庄”的地图层级中记忆；作为地名，在句子中保留大写 F。

gloss_zh: 供应；向某人提供某物；另作名词指小烤炉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To provide someone with something they need or use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人供应或提供其需要、使用的物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti jew jipprovdi lil xi ħadd b'dak li jkollu bżonn jew juża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人供应某物；为某人提供所需物品。

sense_translations.en_definition: small over [cf. Slavomír Čéplö, Jaroslav Drobný (eds.),Maltese Linguistics on the Danube; p 15]
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小烤炉；小型烤箱。

formal.mt: Il-fornitur forna lill-iskola bil-kotba meħtieġa qabel il-bidu tas-sena skolastika.
formal.en: The supplier provided the school with the required books before the start of the school year.
formal.zh: 供应商在学年开始前向学校提供了所需书籍。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min forna lill-ħanut bil-ħobż illum? Toni: Il-furnar ta' ħdejn id-dar tagħna.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who supplied the shop with bread today? Toni: The baker near our house.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：今天是谁给商店供应面包的？托尼：我们家附近的那位面包师。

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 今天是谁给商店供应面包的？
messages.en: Who supplied the shop with bread today?

messages.speaker: Toni (店主)
messages.zh: 我们家附近的那位面包师。
messages.en: The baker near our house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“供应商把书送到学校”的供应场景；另设一张“小烤炉”名词卡，同一拼写的两个词性分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The provision of goods or materials, or the goods and materials supplied.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供货物或材料的供应活动，也指所供应的货物、材料或物资。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-provvista ta' oġġetti jew materjali, jew l-oġġetti u l-materjali li jiġu pprovduti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供应；供给，即提供所需物品或材料。
供应品；物资，即为某项用途提供的货物或材料。

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ta' forniment jistabbilixxi l-kwantità tal-materjal u d-dati tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The supply contract specifies the quantity of material and the delivery dates.
formal.zh: 供货合同规定了材料数量和交货日期。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex m'hemmx ilma? Mark: Hemm problema fil-forniment tal-ilma; qalu li qed isewwuha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is there no water? Mark: There's a problem with the water supply; they said they're fixing it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：为什么没水了？马克：供水出了问题；他们说正在维修。

messages.speaker: Anna (住户)
messages.zh: 为什么没水了？
messages.en: Why is there no water?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm problema fil-forniment tal-ilma; qalu li qed isewwuha.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm problema fil-forniment tal-ilma; qalu li qed isewwuha.
messages.zh: 供水出了问题；他们说正在维修。
messages.en: There's a problem with the water supply; they said they're fixing it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象物资从仓库送到使用者手中：关注提供过程时是“供应”，关注送来的东西时是“供应品、物资”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company that provides goods or services to customers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向客户提供商品或服务的个人或公司，尤指商业交易中的供应商。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tipprovdi prodotti jew servizzi lill-klijenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供应商；提供商品或服务的个人或机构。

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija għażlet fornitur ġdid biex jipprovdi l-materjal meħtieġ għall-produzzjoni.
formal.en: The company selected a new supplier to provide the materials needed for production.
formal.zh: 公司选定了一家新供应商，为生产提供所需材料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna fornitur għall-ħaxix tal-festa? Mark: Iva, il-fornitur tagħna se jġib kollox is-Sibt filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have a supplier for the party vegetables? Mark: Yes, our supplier will bring everything on Saturday morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：聚会要用的蔬菜有供应商了吗？马克：有，我们的供应商星期六早上会把东西全部送来。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 聚会要用的蔬菜有供应商了吗？
messages.en: Do we have a supplier for the party vegetables?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动协办者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-fornitur tagħna se jġib kollox is-Sibt filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-fornitur tagħna se jġib kollox is-Sibt filgħodu.
messages.zh: 有，我们的供应商星期六早上会把东西全部送来。
messages.en: Yes, our supplier will bring everything on Saturday morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象商店门口每天来送货的人，把 fornitur 与“谁来供货”这个问题绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The provision of goods or materials, especially as part of a commercial arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 商品或材料的供应，尤指商业安排或交易中的供货。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-provvista ta' prodotti jew materjal, speċjalment fil-kummerċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供应；供货，尤用于商业语境。

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jistabbilixxi l-prezz u l-kundizzjonijiet tal-fornitura tal-materjal lill-fabbrika.
formal.en: The contract sets out the price and conditions for the supply of materials to the factory.
formal.zh: 合同规定了向工厂供应材料的价格与条件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-fornitura tal-karta se tasal illum? Pawlu: Iva, qalu li se jwassluha qabel nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Will the paper supply arrive today? Pawlu: Yes, they said they would deliver it before noon.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：供应的纸张今天会到吗？保罗：会，他们说中午之前送到。

messages.speaker: Lara (办公室职员)
messages.zh: 供应的纸张今天会到吗？
messages.en: Will the paper supply arrive today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qalu li se jwassluha qabel nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qalu li se jwassluha qabel nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 会，他们说中午之前送到。
messages.en: Yes, they said they would deliver it before noon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fornitura 放在订单和供货合同旁记忆：关注“供应这件事”，与指供货方的 fornitur 配对区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk unevenly because one leg or foot cannot be used normally, for example because of pain or injury.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因一条腿或一只脚不能正常用力而走路不均衡，例如因疼痛或受伤而一瘸一拐地走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mexa b'pass mhux indaqs għax ma setax juża sieq waħda sew, pereżempju minħabba wġigħ jew korriment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跛行；因腿脚不便而一瘸一拐地走。

collocations.en: he limped for a few steps
collocations.zh: 他一瘸一拐地走了几步

collocations.en: he limped because of the pain

formal.mt: Wara li weġġa' siequ waqt il-logħba, it-tifel forok għal ftit passi u mbagħad qagħad bilqiegħda.
formal.en: After hurting his foot during the game, the boy limped for a few steps and then sat down.
formal.zh: 男孩在比赛中伤到脚后，一瘸一拐地走了几步，然后坐了下来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Tom forok meta ħareġ mill-grawnd? Ben: Weġġa' siequ waqt il-logħba, u issa qiegħed jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Tom limp when he left the pitch? Ben: He hurt his foot during the game, and now he is resting.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：汤姆离开球场时为什么一瘸一拐的？本：他在比赛中伤到了脚，现在正在休息。

messages.speaker: Sara (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Tom forok meta ħareġ mill-grawnd?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Tom forok meta ħareġ mill-grawnd?
messages.zh: 汤姆离开球场时为什么一瘸一拐的？
messages.en: Why did Tom limp when he left the pitch?

messages.speaker: Ben (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Weġġa' siequ waqt il-logħba, u issa qiegħed jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Weġġa' siequ waqt il-logħba, u issa qiegħed jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 他在比赛中伤到了脚，现在正在休息。
messages.en: He hurt his foot during the game, and now he is resting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 forok 时想象脚步一轻一重、身体左右不均衡的画面，用动作记住“一瘸一拐地走”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening by chance rather than as a planned or intended result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因偶然而发生、并非预先计划或有意造成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jseħħ b'kumbinazzjoni, mingħajr ma jkun ippjanat jew maħsub minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偶然的；意外发生的；碰巧出现的。

formal.mt: L-awtur iddeskriva s-sejba tad-dokument bħala avveniment fortuwitu li bidel id-direzzjoni tar-riċerka.
formal.en: The author described the discovery of the document as a fortuitous event that changed the direction of the research.
formal.zh: 作者把发现这份文件描述为一件改变了研究方向的偶然事件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kont ippjanajt li tiltaqa' ma' Leo fil-ħanut? Mark: Le, kien każ fortuwitu; it-tnejn morna nixtru l-ħobż fl-istess ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Had you planned to meet Leo at the shop? Mark: No, it was a chance occurrence; we both went to buy bread at the same time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你事先约好在商店见利奥了吗？马克：没有，是碰巧遇上的，我们同时去买面包。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont ippjanajt li tiltaqa' ma' Leo fil-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Kont ippjanajt li tiltaqa' ma' Leo fil-ħanut?
messages.zh: 你事先约好在商店见利奥了吗？
messages.en: Had you planned to meet Leo at the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien każ fortuwitu; it-tnejn morna nixtru l-ħobż fl-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien każ fortuwitu; it-tnejn morna nixtru l-ħobż fl-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 没有，是碰巧遇上的，我们同时去买面包。
messages.en: No, it was a chance occurrence; we both went to buy bread at the same time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时把 fortuwitu 写在“事件”旁边，表示事件是偶然的；再与名词 fortuwità“偶然、巧合”配对练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An event or circumstance that happens by chance rather than through planning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 并非出于计划，而是碰巧发生的事件或情况；偶然性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja jew ċirkostanza li sseħħ b'kumbinazzjoni u mhux għax kienet ippjanata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偶然性；偶然发生的事情或巧合。

formal.mt: Kienet fortuwità li ż-żewġ riċerkaturi sabu l-istess dokument fl-istess jum, mingħajr ma kienu kkuntattjaw lil xulxin.
formal.en: It was a fortuity that the two researchers found the same document on the same day without having contacted each other.
formal.zh: 两位研究人员事先没有联系，却在同一天找到了同一份文件，这纯属巧合。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kienet fortuwità li ltqajna hawn; ma kontx naf li ġej. David: Lanqas jien ma kont naf li se tkun hawn!
colloquial.en: Nina: It was a coincidence that we met here; I didn't know you were coming. David: I didn't know you would be here either!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们在这里碰见真是巧合，我不知道你会来。戴维：我也不知道你会在这里！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet fortuwità li ltqajna hawn; ma kontx naf li ġej.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet fortuwità li ltqajna hawn; ma kontx naf li ġej.
messages.zh: 我们在这里碰见真是巧合，我不知道你会来。
messages.en: It was a coincidence that we met here; I didn't know you were coming.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lanqas jien ma kont naf li se tkun hawn!
messages.mt_standard: Lanqas jien ma kont naf li se tkun hawn!
messages.zh: 我也不知道你会在这里！
messages.en: I didn't know you would be here either!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fortuwità 想成两位没有约好的朋友同时推开咖啡馆门的画面，记住“偶然发生的巧合”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An edible nut with a greenish kernel, eaten as a snack or used in foods such as sweets and ice cream.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种果仁呈绿色的可食用坚果，可作零食，也用于甜点和冰淇淋等食品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġewż li jittiekel, b'qalba ħadranija, u li jintuża wkoll fil-ħelu u fil-ġelat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开心果；可直接食用或用于制作甜食的坚果。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob li jiżdied il-fosdoq imqatta' fuq il-kejk qabel ma jiġi servut.
formal.en: The recipe calls for chopped pistachios to be added on top of the cake before it is served.
formal.zh: 食谱要求在蛋糕上桌前，在表面撒上切碎的开心果。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema ġelat tixtieq, bil-fosdoq jew biċ-ċikkulata? Pawlu: Bil-fosdoq, jekk jogħġbok, u nixtieq ukoll ftit fosdoq imqatta' fuqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which ice cream would you like, pistachio or chocolate? Pawlu: Pistachio, please, and I'd also like some chopped pistachios on top.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想要哪种冰淇淋，开心果味还是巧克力味？保罗：请给我开心果味的，上面也想加一点开心果碎。

messages.speaker: Lara (冰淇淋店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema ġelat tixtieq, bil-fosdoq jew biċ-ċikkulata?
messages.mt_standard: Liema ġelat tixtieq, bil-fosdoq jew biċ-ċikkulata?
messages.zh: 你想要哪种冰淇淋，开心果味还是巧克力味？
messages.en: Which ice cream would you like, pistachio or chocolate?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-fosdoq, jekk jogħġbok, u nixtieq ukoll ftit fosdoq imqatta' fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-fosdoq, jekk jogħġbok, u nixtieq ukoll ftit fosdoq imqatta' fuqu.
messages.zh: 请给我开心果味的，上面也想加一点开心果碎。
messages.en: Pistachio, please, and I'd also like some chopped pistachios on top.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fosdoq 与绿色开心果仁和一球开心果冰淇淋放在同一张记忆卡上，用颜色与味道帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element phosphorus, represented by the symbol P.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素磷，元素符号为 P。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku bis-simbolu P.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磷，化学元素，符号为 P。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-kimika, l-istudenti tgħallmu li l-fosforu għandu s-simbolu P u n-numru atomiku 15.
formal.en: In the chemistry lesson, the students learned that phosphorus has the symbol P and atomic number 15.
formal.zh: 在化学课上，学生们学到了磷的元素符号是 P，原子序数是 15。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu s-simbolu tal-fosforu? David: P. Ikteb fosforu ħdejh biex tiftakar l-isem.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is the symbol for phosphorus? David: P. Write fosforu next to it to remember the name.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：磷的元素符号是什么？戴维：P。在旁边写上 fosforu，帮助记住名称。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 磷的元素符号是什么？
messages.en: What is the symbol for phosphorus?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: P. Ikteb fosforu ħdejh biex tiftakar l-isem.
messages.mt_standard: P. Ikteb fosforu ħdejh biex tiftakar l-isem.
messages.zh: P。在旁边写上 fosforu，帮助记住名称。
messages.en: P. Write fosforu next to it to remember the name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张写着“fosforu—磷—P”的三语记忆卡，再用白磷和红磷两个搭配反复巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to photography, photographs, or the process of taking photographs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与摄影、照片或拍摄照片的过程有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-fotografija, mar-ritratti jew mal-proċess tat-teħid tar-ritratti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摄影的；照片的；与摄影技术或活动有关的。

formal.mt: Il-mużew qed joħloq arkivju fotografiku biex jiddokumenta l-bidliet fit-toroq tal-belt matul is-snin.
formal.en: The museum is creating a photographic archive to document changes in the city's streets over the years.
formal.zh: 博物馆正在建立照片档案，以记录多年来城市街道的变化。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek it-tagħmir fotografiku lest għall-ħarġa ta' għada? Ben: Iva, il-kamera u l-lentijiet qegħdin fil-basket.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you got the photographic equipment ready for tomorrow's outing? Ben: Yes, the camera and lenses are in the bag.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：明天出游的摄影器材准备好了吗？本：准备好了，相机和镜头都在包里。

messages.speaker: Sara (摄影爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek it-tagħmir fotografiku lest għall-ħarġa ta' għada?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek it-tagħmir fotografiku lest għall-ħarġa ta' għada?
messages.zh: 明天出游的摄影器材准备好了吗？
messages.en: Have you got the photographic equipment ready for tomorrow's outing?

messages.speaker: Ben (摄影伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kamera u l-lentijiet qegħdin fil-basket.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kamera u l-lentijiet qegħdin fil-basket.
messages.zh: 准备好了，相机和镜头都在包里。
messages.en: Yes, the camera and lenses are in the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 fotografiku 就想象相机、镜头和照片档案，练习把它接在名词后面，表达“与摄影有关的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who takes photographs, especially as a profession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拍摄照片的人，尤指以摄影为职业的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu ritratti, speċjalment bħala xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摄影师；拍摄照片的人

formal.mt: Il-fotografu ħa ritratti tal-parteċipanti waqt il-konferenza.
formal.en: The photographer took photographs of the participants during the conference.
formal.zh: 摄影师在会议期间为与会者拍摄了照片。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jieħu r-ritratti fit-tieġ? Mark: Qabbadna fotografu li rrakkomandat oħti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is going to take the wedding photos? Mark: We hired a photographer my sister recommended.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：婚礼上谁来拍照？马克：我们请了一位我姐姐推荐的摄影师。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 婚礼上谁来拍照？
messages.en: Who is going to take the wedding photos?

messages.speaker: Mark (新郎)
messages.zh: 我们请了一位我姐姐推荐的摄影师。
messages.en: We hired a photographer my sister recommended.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fotografu 和“举着相机拍照的人”绑定记忆；搭配 professjonali，就得到“专业摄影师”。

gloss_zh: 欺诈行为；作弊行为；骗局

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual act of fraud or cheating, or a trick used to deceive someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次欺诈或作弊行为，也可指用来欺骗他人的诡计。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att ta' frodi jew qerq, jew ingann biex xi ħadd jitqarraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次欺诈行为
一次作弊或欺骗行为
诡计；骗人的把戏

collocations.en: a fraudulent act in a sale

formal.mt: L-investigazzjoni kixfet fottatura fil-bejgħ ta' biljetti li ma kinux validi.
formal.en: The investigation exposed a scam involving the sale of invalid tickets.
formal.zh: 调查揭露了一起出售无效票券的骗局。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ħallast għall-biljett, imma ma stajtx nidħol. Pawlu: Din tidher fottatura; għandek il-prova tal-ħlas?
colloquial.en: Nina: I paid for the ticket, but I couldn't get in. Pawlu: This looks like a scam; do you have proof of payment?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我付钱买了票，却进不去。保罗：这看起来是个骗局；你有付款凭证吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (购票者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallast għall-biljett, imma ma stajtx nidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallast għall-biljett, imma ma stajtx nidħol.
messages.zh: 我付钱买了票，却进不去。
messages.en: I paid for the ticket, but I couldn't get in.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din tidher fottatura; għandek il-prova tal-ħlas?
messages.mt_standard: Din tidher fottatura; għandek il-prova tal-ħlas?
messages.zh: 这看起来是个骗局；你有付款凭证吗？
messages.en: This looks like a scam; do you have proof of payment?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“买到无效票，揭穿一场骗局”的画面记 fottatura；把它与一次具体的欺诈事件联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who spoils other people's enjoyment or dampens a cheerful mood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 破坏别人兴致、使欢乐气氛冷下来的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħassar il-gost ta' ħaddieħor jew iddaħħal dwejjaq f'atmosfera ferrieħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扫兴的人；破坏欢乐气氛的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jissejjaħ fottifesti għax dejjem iħassar il-gost ta' sħabu.
formal.en: In the story, the character is called a killjoy because he always spoils his friends' enjoyment.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个人物被称为扫兴鬼，因为他总是破坏朋友们的兴致。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ejja nkantaw kanzunetta oħra! Mark: Le, biżżejjed kant għal-lum. Maja: Tkunx fottifesti, waħda biss!
colloquial.en: Maja: Let's sing another song! Mark: No, that's enough singing for today. Maja: Don't be a killjoy, just one!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们再唱一首吧！马克：不了，今天唱得够多了。玛雅：别扫兴嘛，就一首！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们再唱一首吧！
messages.en: Let's sing another song!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不了，今天唱得够多了。
messages.en: No, that's enough singing for today.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 别扫兴嘛，就一首！
messages.en: Don't be a killjoy, just one!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家正开心唱歌，有人突然让全场冷下来；把这个“扫兴的人”记作 fottifesti。

gloss_zh: 欺诈活动；作弊；欺骗手段

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fraudulent activity, cheating, or the use of tricks to deceive others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欺诈或作弊活动，也指使用诡计欺骗他人的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività ta' frodi jew qerq, jew l-użu ta' inganni biex jitqarraq ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺诈活动
作弊；欺骗行为
欺骗手段；耍诈

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-fottiment li seħħ waqt il-kompetizzjoni u jipproponi kontrolli aħjar.
formal.en: The report describes the cheating that occurred during the competition and proposes better checks.
formal.zh: 报告描述了比赛期间发生的作弊行为，并提出了更完善的检查措施。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif rebaħ kull darba jekk kien qed jaħbi l-karti? Toni: Dak fottiment; ejja nerġgħu nilagħbu bir-regoli ċari.
colloquial.en: Lara: How could he win every time when he was hiding cards? Toni: That's cheating; let's play again with clear rules.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他一直藏牌，怎么还能次次算赢？托尼：那是作弊；我们把规则说清楚，再玩一次。

messages.speaker: Lara (牌友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif rebaħ kull darba jekk kien qed jaħbi l-karti?
messages.mt_standard: Kif rebaħ kull darba jekk kien qed jaħbi l-karti?
messages.zh: 他一直藏牌，怎么还能次次算赢？
messages.en: How could he win every time when he was hiding cards?

messages.speaker: Toni (牌友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak fottiment; ejja nerġgħu nilagħbu bir-regoli ċari.
messages.mt_standard: Dak fottiment; ejja nerġgħu nilagħbu bir-regoli ċari.
messages.zh: 那是作弊；我们把规则说清楚，再玩一次。
messages.en: That's cheating; let's play again with clear rules.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fottiment 放进“比赛中有人一直作弊”的场景，记住它可以概括欺诈、作弊或耍诈这种活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who cheats or deceives others to gain an unfair advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过作弊或欺骗他人来获取不公平优势的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqarraq b'ħaddieħor biex tikseb vantaġġ mhux ġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作弊者；欺骗他人的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-fottitur jipprova jirbaħ il-logħba billi jaħbi karta taħt il-mejda.
formal.en: In the story, the cheater tries to win the game by hiding a card under the table.
formal.zh: 故事中，作弊者试图把一张牌藏在桌下，以此赢得游戏。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma tridx tilgħab ma' Ben? Mark: Għax hu fottitur; rajtu jbiddel il-karti bil-moħbi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why don't you want to play with Ben? Mark: Because he's a cheater; I saw him secretly swapping the cards.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么不想和本一起玩？马克：因为他作弊；我看见他偷偷换牌。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx tilgħab ma' Ben?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx tilgħab ma' Ben?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想和本一起玩？
messages.en: Why don't you want to play with Ben?

messages.speaker: Mark (牌友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu fottitur; rajtu jbiddel il-karti bil-moħbi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu fottitur; rajtu jbiddel il-karti bil-moħbi.
messages.zh: 因为他作弊；我看见他偷偷换牌。
messages.en: Because he's a cheater; I saw him secretly swapping the cards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时给 fottitur 画一个“偷偷换牌的人”；这个词指作弊的人，可与表示作弊活动的 fottiment 对照。

gloss_zh: 欺诈行为；作弊行为；诡计

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of fraud or cheating, or a deceptive trick played on someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次欺诈或作弊行为，也可指对他人施加的骗人把戏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att ta' frodi jew qerq, jew ingann magħmul biex jitqarraq xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次欺诈行为
一次作弊或欺骗行为
诡计；骗人的把戏

formal.mt: Il-klijent skopra fottitura meta sab li l-irċevuta kienet turi somma differenti minn dik li ħallas.
formal.en: The customer discovered a fraudulent act when he found that the receipt showed a different amount from what he had paid.
formal.zh: 顾客发现收据所列金额与实际付款金额不同，由此发现了一次欺诈行为。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Qaluli li l-kunsinna kienet b'xejn, imma żiedu għaxar ewro. Pawlu: Din fottitura; ejja naraw x'kien miktub fl-offerta.
colloquial.en: Rita: They told me delivery was free, but they added ten euros. Pawlu: That's a trick; let's see what the offer said.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：他们说免费送货，却又加收了十欧元。保罗：这是骗人的把戏；我们看看优惠说明里写了什么。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Qaluli li l-kunsinna kienet b'xejn, imma żiedu għaxar ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Qaluli li l-kunsinna kienet b'xejn, imma żiedu għaxar ewro.
messages.zh: 他们说免费送货，却又加收了十欧元。
messages.en: They told me delivery was free, but they added ten euros.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din fottitura; ejja naraw x'kien miktub fl-offerta.
messages.mt_standard: Din fottitura; ejja naraw x'kien miktub fl-offerta.
messages.zh: 这是骗人的把戏；我们看看优惠说明里写了什么。
messages.en: That's a trick; let's see what the offer said.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“说好免费，结账却偷偷加钱”来记 fottitura；与 fottatura 并排练习时，特别看清中间的 i 和 a。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pointed fishing weapon or implement, such as a trident, fishspear, or harpoon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于刺捕鱼类的尖头器具或武器，如三叉戟、鱼叉或捕鲸叉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda jew arma bil-ponta, bħal trident jew lanza tas-sajd, li tintuża biex jinqabad il-ħut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三叉戟；鱼叉；捕鲸叉

formal.mt: It-tpinġija turi sajjied b'foxxna f'idu u ħuta fl-ilma ħdejh.
formal.en: The drawing shows a fisherman holding a fishspear, with a fish in the water beside him.
formal.zh: 图画中，一名渔民手持鱼叉，旁边的水里有一条鱼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik ħdejn ix-xibka? Toni: Dik foxxna; tintuża biex taqbad il-ħut.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that next to the net? Toni: That's a fishspear; it's used to catch fish.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：渔网旁边那个是什么？托尼：那是鱼叉，用来捕鱼。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 渔网旁边那个是什么？
messages.en: What's that next to the net?

messages.speaker: Toni (渔民)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik foxxna; tintuża biex taqbad il-ħut.
messages.mt_standard: Dik foxxna; tintuża biex taqbad il-ħut.
messages.zh: 那是鱼叉，用来捕鱼。
messages.en: That's a fishspear; it's used to catch fish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 foxxna 写在鱼叉图旁，想象尖端伸向水中的鱼；再用 sajd bil-foxxna 整组记住“用鱼叉捕鱼”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Words or expressions of praise and admiration, sometimes so excessive that they become adulation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达认可和钦佩的赞扬；程度过分时，也可指吹捧或奉承。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem li juri apprezzament jew ammirazzjoni; meta jkun esaġerat, jista' jfisser tifħir żejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞扬；称赞
过分的赞美；吹捧；奉承

formal.mt: Id-direttriċi qalet kliem ta' foħrija dwar ix-xogħol tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The headteacher expressed praise for the students' work.
formal.zh: 校长对学生们的作品给予了赞扬。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għoġbok id-diskors? Mark: Iva, imma kien hemm wisq foħrija għall-organizzatur.
colloquial.en: Elena: Did you like the speech? Mark: Yes, but there was too much praise for the organiser.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你喜欢那场演讲吗？Mark：喜欢，不过对组织者的赞美有点过头了。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢那场演讲吗？
messages.en: Did you like the speech?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma kien hemm wisq foħrija għall-organizzatur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma kien hemm wisq foħrija għall-organizzatur.
messages.zh: 喜欢，不过对组织者的赞美有点过头了。
messages.en: Yes, but there was too much praise for the organiser.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 foħrija 配一条“赞美程度尺”：适量时是称赞，过量时成吹捧；用同一画面记住两个相关义项。

gloss_zh: 贫穷的；可怜的（fqir 的指小形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Poor, expressed with the diminutive form of fqir, which can convey sympathy for someone with little money or few resources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贫穷的，是 fqir 的指小形式，可带有对生活困窘者的怜惜语气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ftit flus jew mezzi; forma diminuttiva ta' fqir li tista' tesprimi ħasra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贫穷的；可怜的（fqir 的指小形式，可带怜惜语气）

collocations.zh: 一个贫穷而令人怜惜的男人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, raġel fqajjar jaqsam il-ftit ikel li għandu ma' ġar bil-ġuħ.
formal.en: In the story, a poor man shares the little food he has with a hungry neighbour.
formal.zh: 故事中，一个贫穷的男人把自己仅有的一点食物分给了饥饿的邻居。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak ir-raġel fqajjar għandu biżżejjed x'jiekol? Marija: Mhux dejjem; illum se nieħdulu ftit ikel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does that poor man have enough to eat? Marija: Not always; today we're going to take him some food.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那个可怜的穷人有足够的东西吃吗？玛丽亚：并不总有；今天我们会给他送些食物。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel fqajjar għandu biżżejjed x'jiekol?
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel fqajjar għandu biżżejjed x'jiekol?
messages.zh: 那个可怜的穷人有足够的东西吃吗？
messages.en: Does that poor man have enough to eat?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux dejjem; illum se nieħdulu ftit ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux dejjem; illum se nieħdulu ftit ikel.
messages.zh: 并不总有；今天我们会给他送些食物。
messages.en: Not always; today we're going to take him some food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 fqir 与 fqajjar 并排记：都围绕“穷”，后者是指小形式；配上关切的语气记住“可怜的穷人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Close and careful examination of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事物进行细致、认真的检查或审查。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżami mill-qrib u bir-reqqa ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 细察；仔细审查。

formal.mt: Il-fqid tad-dokumenti għandu jsir qabel tittieħed id-deċiżjoni finali.
formal.en: Scrutiny of the documents should take place before the final decision is made.
formal.zh: 应在作出最终决定之前仔细审查文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lest ir-rapport? Mark: Kważi, imma għad għandu bżonn fqid bir-reqqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the report ready? Mark: Almost, but it still needs careful scrutiny.
colloquial.zh: Maja：报告准备好了吗？Mark：差不多了，不过还需要仔细审查。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 报告准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the report ready?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi, imma għad għandu bżonn fqid bir-reqqa.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi, imma għad għandu bżonn fqid bir-reqqa.
messages.zh: 差不多了，不过还需要仔细审查。
messages.en: Almost, but it still needs careful scrutiny.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fqid 和拿着放大镜逐项检查文件的画面联系起来，记住它强调细察与审查。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or event of something suddenly breaking open or bursting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体突然破开、爆开或胀裂的过程或事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-ġrajja ta' xi ħaġa li tinfaqa' f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爆裂；突然破开或胀裂。

formal.mt: Il-fqigħ tal-pajp ikkawża ħsara fil-kamra.
formal.en: The bursting of the pipe caused damage in the room.
formal.zh: 管道爆裂造成了房间内的损坏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Pawlu: Kien il-fqigħ ta' bużżieqa. Kollox sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that sound? Pawlu: It was a balloon bursting. Everything is fine.
colloquial.zh: Lara：刚才是什么声音？Pawlu：是一个气球爆了。一切都好。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien il-fqigħ ta' bużżieqa. Kollox sew.
messages.mt_standard: Kien il-fqigħ ta' bużżieqa. Kollox sew.
messages.zh: 是一个气球爆了。一切都好。
messages.en: It was a balloon bursting. Everything is fine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象气球突然砰地爆开，用这一瞬间的动作记住 fqigħ 表示爆裂这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process in which a young animal emerges from an egg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 幼小动物从卵或蛋中破壳而出的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih annimal żgħir joħroġ mill-bajda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 孵化；幼小动物破卵或破壳而出的过程。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-fqis tal-bajd u kitbu dak li raw.
formal.en: The students observed the hatching of the eggs and wrote down what they saw.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了蛋的孵化过程，并记录了所见。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Beda l-fqis tal-bajd? Toni: Iva, ara dak il-fellus ħiereġ!
colloquial.en: Nina: Have the eggs started hatching? Toni: Yes, look at that chick coming out!
colloquial.zh: Nina：蛋开始孵化了吗？Toni：是的，快看那只正在出来的小鸡！

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 蛋开始孵化了吗？
messages.en: Have the eggs started hatching?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，快看那只正在出来的小鸡！
messages.en: Yes, look at that chick coming out!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fqis 配上小鸡啄开蛋壳的画面，记住这个名词指孵化、破壳的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Loud, disruptive noise or a noisy disturbance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 响亮而扰人的吵闹声，或伴有吵闹的骚动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss qawwi li jdejjaq, jew taħwid b'ħafna storbju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喧闹；吵闹声；吵闹的骚动。

formal.mt: Il-frakass fit-triq interrompa l-laqgħa diversi drabi.
formal.en: The racket in the street interrupted the meeting several times.
formal.zh: 街上的喧闹声多次打断了会议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dan il-frakass kollu? Ben: Qed inċaqilqu s-siġġijiet. Issa nispiċċaw.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's all this racket? Ben: We're moving the chairs. We'll be finished in a moment.
colloquial.zh: Sara：怎么这么吵？Ben：我们正在搬椅子，马上就好了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 怎么这么吵？
messages.en: What's all this racket?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 我们正在搬椅子，马上就好了。
messages.en: We're moving the chairs. We'll be finished in a moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象搬椅子时一阵哐当乱响，把 frakass 记成让人忍不住问怎么这么吵的声音。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft fabric with a slightly fuzzy surface, used for clothing and other textile items.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种表面略带绒毛、触感柔软的织物，可用于制作衣物等纺织品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp artab b'wiċċ kemxejn sufi, użat għall-ħwejjeġ u għal oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法兰绒，一种柔软、表面略带绒毛的织物。

formal.mt: Għal din il-qmis intgħażlet franella ratba u komda.
formal.en: Soft, comfortable flannel was chosen for this shirt.
formal.zh: 这件衬衫选用了柔软舒适的法兰绒。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-qmis tal-franella? Rita: Iva, missha. Kemm hi ratba!
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this shirt made of flannel? Rita: Yes, feel it. It's so soft!
colloquial.zh: Lara：这件衬衫是法兰绒的吗？Rita：是的，摸摸看。多柔软啊！

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件衬衫是法兰绒的吗？
messages.en: Is this shirt made of flannel?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 是的，摸摸看。多柔软啊！
messages.en: Yes, feel it. It's so soft!

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 franella 时想象手摸柔软绒面衬衫，把词语与法兰绒的触感一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In an honest and direct way; used to introduce a candid opinion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以诚实、直接的方式；也用于引出坦率的个人看法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod sinċier u dirett; tintuża wkoll biex tintroduċi opinjoni sinċiera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坦率地；坦白说。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-awtur jgħid frankament li l-proposta teħtieġ aktar xogħol.
formal.en: In the report, the author states frankly that the proposal needs more work.
formal.zh: 作者在报告中坦率地指出，这份提案还需要进一步完善。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għoġbok il-film? Nina: Frankament, kien twil wisq għalija.
colloquial.en: Toni: Did you like the film? Nina: Frankly, it was too long for me.
colloquial.zh: Toni：你喜欢这部电影吗？Nina：坦白说，我觉得太长了。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这部电影吗？
messages.en: Did you like the film?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 坦白说，我觉得太长了。
messages.en: Frankly, it was too long for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 frankament 放在表达真实看法的句首练习，每次开口都先在心里说坦白说。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called francium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素钫的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bħala franċju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钫，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-kimika, l-għalliema talbet lill-istudenti jsibu l-franċju fit-tabella perjodika.
formal.en: In the chemistry lesson, the teacher asked the students to find francium in the periodic table.
formal.zh: 在化学课上，老师让学生们在元素周期表中找到钫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tgħid francium bil-Malti? Mark: Franċju. Qed infittxu fit-tabella perjodika.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do you say francium in Maltese? Mark: Franċju. I'm looking for it in the periodic table.
colloquial.zh: Maja：钫用马耳他语怎么说？Mark：Franċju。我正在元素周期表里找它。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 钫用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do you say francium in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: Franċju。我正在元素周期表里找它。
messages.en: Franċju. I'm looking for it in the periodic table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语元素卡，正面写 franċju，背面写钫和 francium，反复对应记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species known as the black-winged stilt, Himantopus himantopus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为黑翅长脚鹬的鸟类，学名为 Himantopus himantopus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ispeċi ta' għasfur magħrufa bħala fras-servjent, bl-isem xjentifiku Himantopus himantopus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑翅长脚鹬（学名 Himantopus himantopus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a black-winged stilt
collocations.zh: 一张黑翅长脚鹬的照片

formal.mt: Il-gwida identifikat l-għasfur fir-ritratt bħala fras-servjent.

formal.zh: 向导认出照片中的鸟是一只黑翅长脚鹬。

colloquial.en: Sara: What's this bird in the photograph called? Pawlu: A black-winged stilt. Let's look it up in the bird book.
colloquial.zh: Sara：照片里的这只鸟叫什么？Pawlu：黑翅长脚鹬。我们在鸟类图鉴里查查吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (观鸟爱好者)

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)

messages.en: A black-winged stilt. Let's look it up in the bird book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fras-servjent 整体写在黑翅长脚鹬的图片下，与英文鸟名并排复习，连同中间的连字符一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male member of a religious community or church, referred to as a brother.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教团体或教会中被称为“弟兄”的男性成员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Membru raġel ta' komunità reliġjuża jew ta' knisja, imsejjaħ ħu fil-komunità.

sense_translations.en_definition: brother (member of a religious community or church)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 修士；弟兄，指宗教团体或教会的成员。

formal.en: A brother from the religious community welcomed the visitors and explained the day's programme.
formal.zh: 宗教团体的一位修士接待了来访者，并介绍了当天的安排。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min laqgħek meta wasalt? Mark: Laqagħni fratell tal-komunità u wrieni fejn kelli mmur.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who welcomed you when you arrived? Mark: A brother from the community welcomed me and showed me where to go.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你到的时候是谁接待你的？马克：团体里的一位修士接待了我，还告诉我该去哪里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你到的时候是谁接待你的？

messages.zh: 团体里的一位修士接待了我，还告诉我该去哪里。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young male member of a religious order of friars.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 修会中一位年轻的男性修士。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Patri żagħżugħ li jagħmel parti minn ordni reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年轻的修士。

collocations.en: a young friar in the friary

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fil-kunvent, fratiċell spjega lill-istudenti kif kienet tgħaddi l-ġurnata fil-komunità.
formal.en: During the visit to the friary, a young friar explained to the students how the community spent its day.
formal.zh: 参观修院时，一位年轻修士向学生们介绍了团体一天的生活。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min uriek il-ġnien tal-kunvent? Pawlu: Fratiċell li kien qed jaħdem hemm.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who showed you the friary garden? Paul: A young friar who was working there.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁带你参观了修院的花园？保罗：一位当时正在那里干活的年轻修士。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)

messages.speaker: Pawlu (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fratiċell li kien qed jaħdem hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Fratiċell li kien qed jaħdem hemm.
messages.zh: 一位当时正在那里干活的年轻修士。
messages.en: A young friar who was working there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 fratiċell 时想象一位在修院花园干活的年轻修士，把“年轻”和“修士”一起记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who kills their own brother or sister.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 杀害自己兄弟或姐妹的人，指行为实施者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li toqtol lil ħuha jew lil oħtha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杀害自己兄弟姐妹的人；杀害手足者。

collocations.en: the role of the sibling killer

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rumanz, l-istudenti ddiskutew il-motiv tal-fratriċida u l-effett tal-azzjonijiet tiegħu fuq il-familja.
formal.en: In their analysis of the novel, the students discussed the sibling killer's motive and the effect of his actions on the family.
formal.zh: 分析这部小说时，学生们讨论了杀害手足者的动机，以及他的行为对家庭的影响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser fratriċida f'dan ir-rumanz? Ben: Hawn jirreferi għall-persuna li qatlet lil ħuha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does fratriċida mean in this novel? Ben: Here it refers to the person who killed their brother.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这部小说里的 fratriċida 是什么意思？本：这里指杀害自己兄弟的那个人。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这部小说里的 fratriċida 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does fratriċida mean in this novel?

messages.speaker: Ben (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn jirreferi għall-persuna li qatlet lil ħuha.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn jirreferi għall-persuna li qatlet lil ħuha.
messages.zh: 这里指杀害自己兄弟的那个人。
messages.en: Here it refers to the person who killed their brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fratriċida 写在小说人物卡上，旁边标“实施杀害手足行为的人”，与表示行为的 fratriċidju 配对区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of killing one's own brother or sister.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 杀害自己兄弟或姐妹的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li persuna toqtol lil ħuha jew lil oħtha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杀害自己兄弟或姐妹的行为；杀害手足。

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza kif ir-rumanz juri l-konsegwenzi tal-fratriċidju fuq il-membri tal-familja.
formal.en: The study analyses how the novel portrays the consequences of fratricide for the family members.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了小说如何呈现杀害手足的行为给家庭成员带来的后果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fratriċidju jfisser il-persuna jew l-att? Mark: L-att li xi ħadd joqtol lil ħuh jew lil oħtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does fratriċidju mean the person or the act? Mark: The act of someone killing their own brother or sister.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：fratriċidju 指人还是行为？马克：指一个人杀害自己兄弟或姐妹的行为。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: fratriċidju 指人还是行为？
messages.en: Does fratriċidju mean the person or the act?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-att li xi ħadd joqtol lil ħuh jew lil oħtu.
messages.mt_standard: L-att li xi ħadd joqtol lil ħuh jew lil oħtu.
messages.zh: 指一个人杀害自己兄弟或姐妹的行为。
messages.en: The act of someone killing their own brother or sister.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fratriċidju 放进“案件与行为”栏，把 fratriċida 放进“人物”栏，通过同一事件中的人和事来区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Trouble or difficulty that causes inconvenience or worry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带来不便、烦恼或阻碍的麻烦与困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inkwiet jew diffikultà li tfixkel lil xi ħadd jew toħloqlu problema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 麻烦；困难；困扰。

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' komunikazzjoni jista' joħloq frawdità għall-parteċipanti u jdewwem l-attività.
formal.en: A lack of communication can cause trouble for the participants and delay the activity.
formal.zh: 沟通不足可能给参与者造成麻烦，并使活动延误。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din il-bidla ġabitli frawdità. Pawlu: Nista' ngħinek tirranġa l-pjan?
colloquial.en: Anna: This change has caused me trouble. Paul: Can I help you adjust the plan?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个变动给我添麻烦了。保罗：我能帮你调整一下计划吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 这个变动给我添麻烦了。
messages.en: This change has caused me trouble.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 我能帮你调整一下计划吗？
messages.en: Can I help you adjust the plan?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 frawdità 和“计划临时变动，给人添麻烦”的情景绑定，再用 toħloq frawdità 练习“造成麻烦”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involving deliberate deception intended to obtain an unfair benefit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及故意欺骗，以获取不正当利益的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi qerq intenzjonat biex jinkiseb vantaġġ mhux ġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺诈的；通过故意欺骗谋取不正当利益的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif intuża dokument frawdulent biex jinkiseb ħlas li ma kienx dovut.
formal.en: The report describes how a fraudulent document was used to obtain a payment that was not due.
formal.zh: 报告说明了一份欺诈性文件如何被用来获取本不应支付的款项。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma aċċettawx id-dokument? Ben: Għax sabu li kien frawdulent.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't they accept the document? Ben: Because they found that it was fraudulent.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他们为什么没有接受那份文件？本：因为他们发现那份文件涉及欺诈。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 他们为什么没有接受那份文件？
messages.en: Why didn't they accept the document?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.zh: 因为他们发现那份文件涉及欺诈。
messages.en: Because they found that it was fraudulent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 frawdulent 贴在“故意造假以骗取款项的文件”旁，记住核心是故意欺骗和谋取不当利益。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, soft fruit that is usually red when ripe and has tiny seeds on its surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 草莓，一种成熟时通常呈红色、果肉柔软、表面带有细小种子的水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta żgħira u ratba, ġeneralment ħamra meta tkun misjura, b'żerriegħa ċkejkna fuq il-wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 草莓。

formal.mt: Kull frawla għandha tinħasel qabel tittiekel jew tintuża biex iżżejjen il-kejk.
formal.en: Each strawberry should be washed before it is eaten or used to decorate the cake.
formal.zh: 每颗草莓在食用或用于装饰蛋糕前都应清洗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid frawla oħra? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Din ħelwa ħafna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like another strawberry? Mark: Yes, please. This one is very sweet!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还想再吃一颗草莓吗？马克：想，谢谢。这颗真甜！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还想再吃一颗草莓吗？
messages.en: Would you like another strawberry?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Din ħelwa ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Din ħelwa ħafna!
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。这颗真甜！
messages.en: Yes, please. This one is very sweet!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看着一颗草莓说 frawla，再加上 misjura 说“成熟的草莓”，把实物、读音和搭配一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An ash tree, a kind of tree whose wood can be used to make objects such as furniture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 白蜡树，也称梣树，其木材可用于制作家具等物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra li l-injam tagħha jista' jintuża biex isiru għamara u oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白蜡树；梣树。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-ġnien jinkludi siġra tal-fraxxnu qrib il-mogħdija ewlenija.
formal.en: The garden plan includes an ash tree near the main path.
formal.zh: 花园规划包括在主路附近种植一棵白蜡树。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'siġra hi dik ħdejn il-bank? Pawlu: Dik siġra tal-fraxxnu. Ejja noqogħdu ftit fid-dell tagħha.
colloquial.en: Anna: What tree is that next to the bench? Paul: That's an ash tree. Let's sit in its shade for a while.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：长椅旁边那是什么树？保罗：那是一棵白蜡树。我们去它的树荫下坐一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 长椅旁边那是什么树？
messages.en: What tree is that next to the bench?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik siġra tal-fraxxnu. Ejja noqogħdu ftit fid-dell tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Dik siġra tal-fraxxnu. Ejja noqogħdu ftit fid-dell tagħha.
messages.zh: 那是一棵白蜡树。我们去它的树荫下坐一会儿吧。
messages.en: That's an ash tree. Let's sit in its shade for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fraxxnu 和公园长椅旁的一棵白蜡树联系起来，再用 siġra tal-fraxxnu 与 injam tal-fraxxnu 分别记树和木材。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A book containing useful phrases, often with translations, for everyday communication in another language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收录实用短语和日常会话表达的手册，通常附有翻译，方便用另一种语言交流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktieb bi frażijiet utli, spiss bit-traduzzjonijiet tagħhom, biex jgħin fil-komunikazzjoni ta' kuljum b'lingwa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 常用语手册；收录实用短语和会话表达的书。

collocations.zh: 马耳他语与英语对照会话手册

formal.mt: Il-frażarju jinkludi espressjonijiet utli biex wieħed jistaqsi għad-direzzjonijiet u jordna l-ikel.
formal.en: The phrasebook includes useful expressions for asking for directions and ordering food.
formal.zh: 这本会话手册收录了问路和点餐时实用的表达。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek frażarju bil-Malti? Mark: Iva, nista' nsellefulek għall-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a Maltese phrasebook? Mark: Yes, I can lend it to you for the trip.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有马耳他语会话手册吗？Mark：有，我可以借给你旅行时用。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有马耳他语会话手册吗？
messages.en: Do you have a Maltese phrasebook?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我可以借给你旅行时用。
messages.en: Yes, I can lend it to you for the trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它想成口袋里的会话小书：问路翻一页，点餐翻一页，整本就是实用短语手册。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The words, phrases, and characteristic ways of expressing ideas used in a language, field, or type of text.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种语言、专业领域或文体中使用的词语、短语及具有特点的表达方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kliem, il-frażijiet u l-modi ta' espressjoni li jintużaw f'lingwa, f'qasam jew f'tip ta' test.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 措辞；某种语言、领域或文体所采用的短语和惯用表达方式。

formal.mt: Il-frażjoloġija tar-rapport għandha tkun ċara u adattata għall-qarrejja.
formal.en: The report's phraseology should be clear and appropriate for its readers.
formal.zh: 报告的措辞应当清晰，并适合其读者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed nifhem il-kliem, imma l-frażjoloġija ta' dan il-kuntratt qed tħawwadni. Mark: Ejja naqrawh flimkien, sentenza b'sentenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: I understand the words, but the phraseology of this contract is confusing me. Mark: Let's read it together, sentence by sentence.
colloquial.zh: Maja：单词我懂，但这份合同的措辞让我有点糊涂。Mark：我们一起逐句读吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nifhem il-kliem, imma l-frażjoloġija ta' dan il-kuntratt qed tħawwadni.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nifhem il-kliem, imma l-frażjoloġija ta' dan il-kuntratt qed tħawwadni.
messages.zh: 单词我懂，但这份合同的措辞让我有点糊涂。
messages.en: I understand the words, but the phraseology of this contract is confusing me.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我们一起逐句读吧。
messages.en: Let's read it together, sentence by sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住它关注的是一句话怎样组织和表达；读合同看措辞，读技术文看惯用表达，都可联想到这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small branch of a tree or plant; the diminutive form of 'fergħ'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 树木或植物上的小枝条，是 fergħ 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fergħ żgħir ta' siġra jew pjanta; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'fergħ'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small branch (the diminutive form of 'fergħ')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小树枝；小枝条，为 fergħ 的指小形式。

formal.mt: L-istudent poġġa frejgħa fuq il-mejda biex josserva l-weraq tagħha.
formal.en: The student placed a small branch on the table to observe its leaves.
formal.zh: 学生把一根小树枝放在桌上，以观察上面的叶片。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara, hemm frejgħa niexfa mal-art. Pawlu: Ħalliha hemm, forsi għasfur jużaha biex jibni bejta.
colloquial.en: Lina: Look, there's a dry twig on the ground. Pawlu: Leave it there; perhaps a bird will use it to build a nest.
colloquial.zh: Lina：看，地上有一根干枯的小树枝。Pawlu：让它留在那里吧，也许会有鸟用它筑巢。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，地上有一根干枯的小树枝。
messages.en: Look, there's a dry twig on the ground.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħalliha hemm, forsi għasfur jużaha biex jibni bejta.
messages.mt_standard: Ħalliha hemm, forsi għasfur jużaha biex jibni bejta.
messages.zh: 让它留在那里吧，也许会有鸟用它筑巢。
messages.en: Leave it there; perhaps a bird will use it to build a nest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fergħ 想成树枝，再把画面缩小成小鸟能叼走的一根细枝，帮助记住 frejgħa 的指小意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A little devil; the diminutive form of 'fergħun'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小魔鬼，是 fergħun 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xitan żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'fergħun'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 魔鬼；小魔鬼，为 fergħun 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a little devil in the tale
a drawing of a little devil

formal.mt: Fil-ħrafa, frejgħen joħroġ minn għar u jipprova jbeżża' lill-vjaġġaturi.
formal.en: In the tale, a little devil emerges from a cave and tries to frighten the travellers.
formal.zh: 故事中，一个小魔鬼从山洞里走出来，试图吓唬旅人。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhu dak fil-ktieb, mostru? Pawlu: Le, huwa frejgħen fil-ħrafa li qed naqra.
colloquial.en: Lina: What's that in the book, a monster? Pawlu: No, it's a little devil in the tale I'm reading.
colloquial.zh: Lina：书里那个是什么，怪兽吗？Pawlu：不是，是我正在读的故事里的小魔鬼。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 书里那个是什么，怪兽吗？
messages.en: What's that in the book, a monster?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa frejgħen fil-ħrafa li qed naqra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa frejgħen fil-ħrafa li qed naqra.
messages.zh: 不是，是我正在读的故事里的小魔鬼。
messages.en: No, it's a little devil in the tale I'm reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用童话插图中的小魔鬼作记忆画面；同时留意词尾，frejgħen 是小魔鬼，frejgħa 是小树枝。

gloss_zh: 反复体的；表示动作反复发生的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a verb form or grammatical meaning that expresses a repeated action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述动词形式或语法意义，表示某个动作反复发生的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi forma verbali jew tifsira grammatikali li tesprimi azzjoni li tirrepeti ruħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复体的；在语法上表示动作反复发生的。

formal.mt: It-terminu 'frekwentattiv' jintuża fil-grammatika biex jiddeskrivi azzjoni li tirrepeti ruħha.
formal.en: The term 'frequentative' is used in grammar to describe an action that repeats.
formal.zh: 语法中使用“反复体的”这一术语来描述反复发生的动作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'frekwentattiv' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Ifisser li l-verb jesprimi azzjoni li ssir darba wara l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'frequentative' mean in this exercise? Mark: It means that the verb expresses an action that happens again and again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这道练习里的“反复体的”是什么意思？Mark：意思是这个动词表达一个一次又一次发生的动作。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的“反复体的”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'frequentative' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-verb jesprimi azzjoni li ssir darba wara l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-verb jesprimi azzjoni li ssir darba wara l-oħra.
messages.zh: 意思是这个动词表达一个一次又一次发生的动作。
messages.en: It means that the verb expresses an action that happens again and again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象语法课上把同一个动作画成连续几个重复画面：这个词专门描述动作反复发生的语法意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who visits a particular place regularly or often.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常前往某个地方的人，例如某家咖啡馆的常客。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmur spiss jew regolarment f'post partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 常客；经常到访某个场所的人。

collocations.en: a regular visitor to the library

formal.mt: Bħala frekwentatur tal-librerija, is-Sur Borg jaf sew fejn jinsabu l-kotba tal-istorja.
formal.en: As a regular visitor to the library, Mr Borg knows very well where the history books are.
formal.zh: 博尔格先生经常到这家图书馆，因此很清楚历史书放在哪里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif taf lill-wejter b'ismu? Mark: Jien frekwentatur ta' din il-kafetterija; niġi hawn kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do you know the waiter's name? Mark: I'm a regular at this café; I come here every week.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么知道服务员的名字？Mark：我是这家咖啡馆的常客，每周都来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么知道服务员的名字？
messages.en: How do you know the waiter's name?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien frekwentatur ta' din il-kafetterija; niġi hawn kull ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien frekwentatur ta' din il-kafetterija; niġi hawn kull ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 我是这家咖啡馆的常客，每周都来。
messages.en: I'm a regular at this café; I come here every week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚进咖啡馆，店员就认出你并知道你常点什么；这个经常出现的人就是常客。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Often; on many occasions or at short intervals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常地；表示某事多次发生，或发生的间隔较短。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spiss; f'ħafna okkażjonijiet jew b'intervalli qosra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常；频繁地。

formal.mt: L-għalliem jiċċekkja frekwentement il-progress tal-istudenti biex jadatta t-tagħlim għall-ħtiġijiet tagħhom.
formal.en: The teacher frequently checks the students' progress to adapt the teaching to their needs.
formal.zh: 教师经常检查学生的学习进展，以根据他们的需要调整教学。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tiltaqa' frekwentement ma' oħtok? Mark: Iva, nieħdu kafè flimkien darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you meet up with your sister frequently? Mark: Yes, we have coffee together twice a week.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你经常和你姐妹见面吗？Mark：是的，我们每周一起喝两次咖啡。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你经常和你姐妹见面吗？
messages.en: Do you meet up with your sister frequently?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nieħdu kafè flimkien darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nieħdu kafè flimkien darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，我们每周一起喝两次咖啡。
messages.en: Yes, we have coffee together twice a week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在动作旁边记：经常旅行、经常检查。它回答动作发生得多不多，是表示频率的副词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening often or recurring at short intervals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常发生的，或以较短间隔反复出现的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġri spiss jew jerġa' jseħħ b'intervalli qosra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁的；经常发生的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika l-iżbalji l-aktar frekwenti fit-testi tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The report identifies the most frequent mistakes in the students' texts.
formal.zh: 报告指出了学生文章中最常出现的错误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-karozzi tal-linja huma frekwenti hawn? Mark: Iva, matul il-jum tgħaddi waħda kull għaxar minuti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are buses frequent here? Mark: Yes, during the day one comes every ten minutes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的公交车班次密集吗？Mark：是的，白天每十分钟就有一班。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 这里的公交车班次密集吗？
messages.en: Are buses frequent here?

messages.speaker: Mark (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, matul il-jum tgħaddi waħda kull għaxar minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, matul il-jum tgħaddi waħda kull għaxar minuti.
messages.zh: 是的，白天每十分钟就有一班。
messages.en: Yes, during the day one comes every ten minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张排满探访日期的日历记住“频繁的探访”；frekwenti 描述事物，frekwentement 则说明动作经常发生。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The separation or division of people or things that were together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原本在一起的人或事物彼此分离，或被划分开来的过程或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-istat li fih persuni jew affarijiet li kienu flimkien jinfirdu jew jitqassmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分离；原本相聚或相连的人或事物彼此分开的过程或状态。
划分；把一个整体分成不同部分。

collocations.en: the division of the group into two parts
collocations.zh: 把这个小组分成两部分

formal.mt: Il-frid tal-grupp f'żewġ partijiet ippermetta lill-parteċipanti jaħdmu fuq żewġ kompiti differenti.
formal.en: The division of the group into two parts allowed the participants to work on two different tasks.
formal.zh: 把小组分成两部分后，参与者便能分别完成两项不同的任务。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif qed tħossok minn meta mort tgħix barra? Pawlu: Il-frid mill-familja hu diffiċli, imma nitkellmu kuljum.
colloquial.en: Marta: How have you been feeling since you moved abroad? Pawlu: Being separated from my family is difficult, but we talk every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：搬到国外以后，你感觉怎么样？保罗：与家人分开很难受，不过我们每天都聊天。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif qed tħossok minn meta mort tgħix barra?
messages.mt_standard: Kif qed tħossok minn meta mort tgħix barra?
messages.zh: 搬到国外以后，你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How have you been feeling since you moved abroad?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-frid mill-familja hu diffiċli, imma nitkellmu kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Il-frid mill-familja hu diffiċli, imma nitkellmu kuljum.
messages.zh: 与家人分开很难受，不过我们每天都聊天。
messages.en: Being separated from my family is difficult, but we talk every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 frid 配上两幅画面记忆：家人暂时分开表示“分离”，一个小组拆成两组表示“划分”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An empty state, an absence of contents, or a sense of nothingness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有内容或事物存在的空无状态，也可指内心缺少充实感的空虚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' vojt jew nuqqas ta' kontenut, jew sensazzjoni li ma hemm xejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空无；空虚；没有内容的状态或内心空落的感觉。
虚空；仿佛没有任何事物存在的空无。

formal.mt: Fil-poeżija, il-frigħ tal-univers jirrifletti s-solitudni tal-bniedem.
formal.en: In the poem, the void of the universe reflects human loneliness.
formal.zh: 在这首诗中，宇宙的虚空映照着人的孤独。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif ħassejtek wara li telqu l-mistednin? Nina: Ħassejt frigħ kbir; id-dar f'daqqa waħda saret kwieta wisq.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you feel after the guests left? Nina: I felt a great emptiness; the house suddenly became too quiet.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：客人走了以后，你感觉怎么样？妮娜：我觉得特别空落落的，家里一下子安静得让人不习惯。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassejtek wara li telqu l-mistednin?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassejtek wara li telqu l-mistednin?
messages.zh: 客人走了以后，你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How did you feel after the guests left?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt frigħ kbir; id-dar f'daqqa waħda saret kwieta wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt frigħ kbir; id-dar f'daqqa waħda saret kwieta wisq.
messages.zh: 我觉得特别空落落的，家里一下子安静得让人不习惯。
messages.en: I felt a great emptiness; the house suddenly became too quiet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 frigħ 时想象热闹散去后的空房间，再把画面扩大成宇宙虚空，连接“空虚”和“虚空”两个义项。

gloss_zh: 摩擦音的；具有擦音性质的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a speech sound made by forcing air through a narrow passage, producing friction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述气流通过发音器官形成的狭窄通道、产生摩擦噪声的语音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi ħoss tad-diskors magħmul billi l-arja tgħaddi minn passaġġ dejjaq u toħloq frizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摩擦音的；发音时气流通过狭窄通道并产生摩擦噪声的。

collocations.zh: 具有摩擦音性质的声音；擦音

formal.mt: Il-ħoss /f/ huwa frikativ bla leħen: l-arja tgħaddi bejn ix-xoffa t'isfel u s-snien ta' fuq mingħajr vibrazzjoni tal-kordi vokali.
formal.en: The sound /f/ is a voiceless fricative: air passes between the lower lip and the upper teeth without vibration of the vocal cords.
formal.zh: /f/ 是清擦音：气流从下唇与上齿之间通过，声带不振动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ħoss /s/ jissejjaħ frikativ? Mark: Għax l-arja tgħaddi minn passaġġ dejjaq u tisma' l-frizzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the sound /s/ called fricative? Mark: Because air passes through a narrow passage and you can hear the friction.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么说 /s/ 具有擦音性质？马克：因为气流经过狭窄通道，你能听见摩擦声。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么说 /s/ 具有擦音性质？
messages.en: Why is the sound /s/ called fricative?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-arja tgħaddi minn passaġġ dejjaq u tisma' l-frizzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-arja tgħaddi minn passaġġ dejjaq u tisma' l-frizzjoni.
messages.zh: 因为气流经过狭窄通道，你能听见摩擦声。
messages.en: Because air passes through a narrow passage and you can hear the friction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 frikativ 时持续发出 /f/ 或 /s/，感受气流经过窄缝的摩擦；再用 ħoss frikativ 记住它在这里是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of tearing something apart or separating it into parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物撕开、扯开，或使其各部分分离的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha xi ħaġa titqatta' jew tinfired f'partijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of tearing apart or separating
sense_translations.zh_definition: 撕开、扯开或使事物分离的动作。

collocations.en: the tearing apart of the paper
the tearing apart of the fabric

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, ġiet imkejla l-forza meħtieġa għall-friq tad-drapp.
formal.en: During the experiment, the force required to tear the fabric apart was measured.
formal.zh: 实验中测量了将布料扯开所需的力。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Toni: Kien il-friq tal-karta; kont qed niftaħ il-pakkett.
colloquial.en: Marija: What was that sound? Toni: It was the paper tearing; I was opening the package.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：刚才是什么声音？托尼：是纸被撕开的声音，我刚才在拆包裹。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien il-friq tal-karta; kont qed niftaħ il-pakkett.
messages.mt_standard: Kien il-friq tal-karta; kont qed niftaħ il-pakkett.
messages.zh: 是纸被撕开的声音，我刚才在拆包裹。
messages.en: It was the paper tearing; I was opening the package.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 friq 和双手撕开一张纸的动作绑定：重点记住“撕开或分离这一动作”，而不是撕开后留下的碎片。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of spreading material over an area or surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把材料铺开、摊开或撒布到某一区域或表面上的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha materjal jitqassam jew jinfirex fuq żona jew wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺开、摊开或撒布的动作。

formal.mt: Il-frix taż-żerriegħa fuq il-ħamrija għandu jsir b'mod uniformi.
formal.en: The spreading of seeds over the soil should be done evenly.
formal.zh: 应当把种子均匀地撒布在土壤上。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Lest il-frix tar-ramel? Ġorġ: Kważi; għad hemm rokna żgħira li rrid ngħatti.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the spreading of the sand finished? Ġorġ: Almost; there is still a small corner I need to cover.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：沙子铺撒好了吗？乔治：快了，还有一个小角落需要铺上。

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺同伴)
messages.zh: 沙子铺撒好了吗？
messages.en: Is the spreading of the sand finished?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (园艺同伴)
