messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; għad hemm rokna żgħira li rrid ngħatti.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; għad hemm rokna żgħira li rrid ngħatti.
messages.zh: 快了，还有一个小角落需要铺上。
messages.en: Almost; there is still a small corner I need to cover.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 frix 时想象把一小堆沙子向四周铺开，关注材料从集中到分布开来的动作，可与 friq 的“撕开”画面对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resistance between surfaces moving against each other, or tension and disagreement between people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接触表面相对运动时产生的阻力，也可比喻人与人之间的紧张或不和。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reżistenza bejn uċuħ li jiċċaqilqu kontra xulxin, jew tensjoni u nuqqas ta' qbil bejn persuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摩擦；接触表面相对运动时产生的阻力，也可比喻人际关系中的摩擦或冲突。

formal.mt: Il-lubrikazzjoni tnaqqas il-frizzjoni bejn il-partijiet li jiċċaqilqu fil-magna.
formal.en: Lubrication reduces friction between the moving parts of the machine.
formal.zh: 润滑可以减少机器运动部件之间的摩擦。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex hemm daqshekk frizzjoni bejnkom? David: Ma qbilniex fuq ix-xogħol, imma se nitkellmu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is there so much friction between you? David: We disagreed about the work, but we are going to talk calmly.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你们之间怎么有这么多摩擦？戴维：我们在工作上有分歧，不过会心平气和地谈谈。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 你们之间怎么有这么多摩擦？
messages.en: Why is there so much friction between you?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma qbilniex fuq ix-xogħol, imma se nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Ma qbilniex fuq ix-xogħol, imma se nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 我们在工作上有分歧，不过会心平气和地谈谈。
messages.en: We disagreed about the work, but we are going to talk calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 frizzjoni 与英语 friction 配对朗读，再记“两块表面相互摩擦”和“两个同事发生摩擦”两幅画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who deliberately deceives others to obtain money, property, or another benefit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 故意欺骗他人，以获取金钱、财物或其他利益的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqarraq apposta b'ħaddieħor biex tikseb flus, proprjetà jew xi vantaġġ ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诈骗者；以欺骗手段骗取他人财物或利益的人。

formal.mt: Il-frodatur uża dokumenti foloz biex jikkonvinċi lill-vittma tittrasferixxi l-flus.
formal.en: The defrauder used false documents to persuade the victim to transfer the money.
formal.zh: 诈骗者使用伪造文件，说服受害人转账。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi ħadd bagħatli messaġġ u talabni d-dettalji tal-karta. Mark: Jista' jkun frodatur; ċempel lill-bank biex tiċċekkja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Someone sent me a message asking for my card details. Mark: It could be a defrauder; call the bank to check.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：有人给我发消息，索要我的银行卡信息。马克：可能是诈骗者，打电话给银行核实一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd bagħatli messaġġ u talabni d-dettalji tal-karta.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd bagħatli messaġġ u talabni d-dettalji tal-karta.
messages.zh: 有人给我发消息，索要我的银行卡信息。
messages.en: Someone sent me a message asking for my card details.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun frodatur; ċempel lill-bank biex tiċċekkja.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun frodatur; ċempel lill-bank biex tiċċekkja.
messages.zh: 可能是诈骗者，打电话给银行核实一下。
messages.en: It could be a defrauder; call the bank to check.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 frodatur 记成故事里“拿假文件骗钱的那个人”；用人物卡片记词，突出它指行骗者这一身份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A forward part or line, including a line of confrontation, a united position, or a boundary between air masses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 朝前的部分或界线；依语境可指对峙的前线、共同立场形成的阵线，或不同气团之间的锋面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' quddiem jew linja li tista' tindika konfront, pożizzjoni komuni, jew il-konfini bejn mases ta' arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 前部；前线或阵线；在气象语境中指不同气团之间的锋面。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport tat-temp, front kiesaħ se jgħaddi minn fuq il-gżejjer matul il-lejl.
formal.en: According to the weather report, a cold front will pass over the islands during the night.
formal.zh: 根据天气预报，一道冷锋将在夜间经过这些岛屿。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif se nippreżentaw it-talba tagħna fil-laqgħa? Samwel: Ejja naqblu minn qabel u nuru front magħqud.
colloquial.en: Lina: How are we going to present our request at the meeting? Samwel: Let's agree beforehand and present a united front.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我们在会上怎么提出自己的请求？萨姆韦尔：先商量好，到时候表现出一致立场。

messages.speaker: Lina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nippreżentaw it-talba tagħna fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nippreżentaw it-talba tagħna fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 我们在会上怎么提出自己的请求？
messages.en: How are we going to present our request at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqblu minn qabel u nuru front magħqud.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqblu minn qabel u nuru front magħqud.
messages.zh: 先商量好，到时候表现出一致立场。
messages.en: Let's agree beforehand and present a united front.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张画面记 front：队伍最前方、同伴并肩形成阵线、天气图上的冷锋；每次结合搭配判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A picture or title page at the beginning of a book.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 书籍开头的卷首插图或列出书名等信息的扉页。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stampa jew paġna bit-titlu fil-bidu ta' ktieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷首插图；扉页，即书籍开头列出书名等信息的页面。

collocations.en: the book's frontispiece or title page
a decorated frontispiece or title page
collocations.zh: 带有装饰的卷首插图或扉页

formal.mt: Il-frontispizju ta' din l-edizzjoni juri t-titlu tal-ktieb u isem l-awtur.
formal.en: The title page of this edition displays the book's title and the author's name.
formal.zh: 这个版本的扉页列出了书名和作者姓名。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn insib isem l-awtur? Mark: Ħares lejn il-frontispizju, fil-bidu tal-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I find the author's name? Mark: Look at the title page, at the beginning of the book.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我在哪里能找到作者姓名？Mark：看扉页，就在书的开头。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.zh: 我在哪里能找到作者姓名？
messages.en: Where can I find the author's name?

messages.speaker: Mark (图书管理员)
messages.zh: 看扉页，就在书的开头。
messages.en: Look at the title page, at the beginning of the book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象翻开一本书，先看卷首图，再找书名页；把这两个开篇画面一起关联到 frontispizju。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An illustration placed at the beginning of a book.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在书籍开头的插图，供读者在进入正文前观看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stampa mqiegħda fil-bidu ta' ktieb, qabel it-test ewlieni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷首插图，位于书籍开头的图像。

collocations.en: the frontispiece of an old edition

formal.mt: Il-frontun ta' din l-edizzjoni juri xena marbuta mal-istorja.
formal.en: The frontispiece of this edition depicts a scene connected with the story.
formal.zh: 这个版本的卷首插图描绘了一个与故事有关的场景。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt l-istampa fil-bidu tal-ktieb? Pawlu: Iva, il-frontun għoġobni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see the picture at the beginning of the book? Pawlu: Yes, I really liked the frontispiece.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你看到书开头的那幅图了吗？Pawlu：看到了，我很喜欢那幅卷首插图。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到书开头的那幅图了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the picture at the beginning of the book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，我很喜欢那幅卷首插图。
messages.en: Yes, I really liked the frontispiece.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 frontun 记成读故事前先看到的一幅图；用“书开头的图像”这个位置画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A benefit or useful result; in another sense, a flux or flow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事带来的益处或有用结果；另一个义项表示流动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġid jew vantaġġ li jirriżulta minn xi ħaġa; f'tifsira oħra, fluss jew ċaqliq ta' likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 益处，好处，即某事带来的有利结果。
流动，流，即物质持续移动的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-froxx li dan il-proġett jista' jġib lill-komunità.
formal.en: The report explains the benefit this project may bring to the community.
formal.zh: 报告说明了这个项目可能给社区带来的益处。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser froxx f'din is-sentenza dwar l-ilma? Toni: Hawn ifisser il-fluss tal-ilma.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does froxx mean in this sentence about water? Toni: Here it means the flow of water.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这句关于水的话里，froxx 是什么意思？Toni：这里指水的流动。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser froxx f'din is-sentenza dwar l-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser froxx f'din is-sentenza dwar l-ilma?
messages.zh: 这句关于水的话里，froxx 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does froxx mean in this sentence about water?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.zh: 这里指水的流动。
messages.en: Here it means the flow of water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 froxx 做两张情境卡：社区项目对应“益处”，水流画面对应“流动”；用上下文区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of receding or gradually ebbing away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向后退去或逐渐消退的过程，例如水逐渐退离岸边。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa tirtira jew tonqos bil-mod, bħall-ilma li jitbiegħed mix-xatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退去，后退，即逐渐退离原先位置的过程。
逐渐消退，逐渐减弱或退去的过程。

formal.mt: L-osservazzjonijiet juru frugħ gradwali tal-ilma qrib ix-xatt.
formal.en: The observations show a gradual receding of the water near the shore.
formal.zh: 观测显示，岸边的水正在逐渐退去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed naraw aktar ramel issa? Mark: Minħabba l-frugħ tal-ilma; qed jitbiegħed mix-xatt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can we see more sand now? Mark: Because of the water receding; it is moving away from the shore.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么现在能看到更多沙地了？Mark：因为水在退去，正逐渐退离岸边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed naraw aktar ramel issa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed naraw aktar ramel issa?
messages.zh: 为什么现在能看到更多沙地了？
messages.en: Why can we see more sand now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-frugħ tal-ilma; qed jitbiegħed mix-xatt.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-frugħ tal-ilma; qed jitbiegħed mix-xatt.
messages.zh: 因为水在退去，正逐渐退离岸边。
messages.en: Because of the water receding; it is moving away from the shore.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象岸边水线慢慢后移、露出更多沙地；用这个连续退去的过程记住名词 frugħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Frivolity, vanity, lack of interesting substance, or emptiness, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指轻浮不严肃、虚荣、内容淡而无味，或空虚的状态，具体含义由上下文决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' serjetà, vanità, nuqqas ta' kontenut interessanti, jew stat ta' vojt, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻浮，不严肃或过于看重琐碎事物的态度。
虚荣，过分看重自己的外表、成就或他人赞赏。
淡而无味，缺乏有趣或有分量的内容。
空虚，缺少内容、实质或充实感的状态。

formal.mt: Il-kritika tenfasizza l-frugħija tad-diskors, li fih ħafna kliem iżda ftit ideat.
formal.en: The critique highlights the vapidity of the speech, which contains many words but few ideas.
formal.zh: 这篇评论指出，讲话内容空洞乏味，虽然话很多，却没有多少实质想法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għoġbok id-diskors? Pawlu: Le, ħassejt fih ħafna frugħija; ma smajtx ideat ġodda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you like the speech? Pawlu: No, I found it very empty; I did not hear any new ideas.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你喜欢那场讲话吗？Pawlu：不喜欢，我觉得内容很空洞，没听到什么新想法。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢那场讲话吗？
messages.en: Did you like the speech?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħassejt fih ħafna frugħija; ma smajtx ideat ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħassejt fih ħafna frugħija; ma smajtx ideat ġodda.
messages.zh: 不喜欢，我觉得内容很空洞，没听到什么新想法。
messages.en: No, I found it very empty; I did not hear any new ideas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四格情境记 frugħija：态度轻浮、爱慕虚荣、讲话乏味、内心空虚；每格对应一个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fructose, a type of sugar found in fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 果糖，一种存在于水果中的糖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' zokkor li jinsab fil-frott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 果糖，一种糖类。

formal.mt: It-tabella turi l-ammont ta' fruttożju f'kull kampjun analizzat.
formal.en: The table shows the amount of fructose in each analysed sample.
formal.zh: 表格列出了每份受检样品中的果糖含量。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser fruttożju fuq din it-tikketta? Toni: Huwa tip ta' zokkor li jinsab ukoll fil-frott.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does fructose mean on this label? Toni: It is a type of sugar also found in fruit.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个标签上的 fruttożju 是什么意思？Toni：是果糖，一种水果中也有的糖。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser fruttożju fuq din it-tikketta?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser fruttożju fuq din it-tikketta?
messages.zh: 这个标签上的 fruttożju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does fructose mean on this label?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa tip ta' zokkor li jinsab ukoll fil-frott.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa tip ta' zokkor li jinsab ukoll fil-frott.
messages.zh: 是果糖，一种水果中也有的糖。
messages.en: It is a type of sugar also found in fruit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fruttożju 和英语 fructose 并排写在水果图旁，借助词形相似和“果糖”画面共同记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small swaddling clothes for a baby; the diminutive form of fisqija.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 包裹婴儿用的小襁褓；是 fisqija 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fisqija żgħira biex titgeżwer fiha tarbija; il-forma diminuttiva ta' fisqija.

sense_translations.en_definition: swaddling clothes for a small child (the diminutive form of 'fisqija')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 包裹幼小婴孩用的小襁褓，是 fisqija 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-oġġetti tat-tarbija hemm fsejqija ratba tal-qoton.
formal.en: The list of baby items includes soft cotton swaddling clothes.
formal.zh: 婴儿用品清单中列有柔软的棉质小襁褓。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn qiegħda l-fsejqija tat-tarbija? Ġużeppi: Fil-kexxun ta' fuq, ħdejn il-ħwejjeġ nodfa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where are the baby's swaddling clothes? Ġużeppi: In the top drawer, next to the clean clothes.
colloquial.zh: Marija：宝宝的小襁褓在哪里？Ġużeppi：在最上面的抽屉里，干净衣服旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝的小襁褓在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the baby's swaddling clothes?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kexxun ta' fuq, ħdejn il-ħwejjeġ nodfa.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kexxun ta' fuq, ħdejn il-ħwejjeġ nodfa.
messages.zh: 在最上面的抽屉里，干净衣服旁边。
messages.en: In the top drawer, next to the clean clothes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fisqija 与 fsejqija 配成大小两张襁褓图；后者是指小形式，联想到婴儿用的小襁褓。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bleeding: the loss or discharge of blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出血，即血液流出的过程或现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ tad-demm, pereżempju minn ferita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出血，流血，即血液流出的现象或过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-fsid mill-ferita u jindika meta waqaf.
formal.en: The report describes the bleeding from the wound and indicates when it stopped.
formal.zh: 报告描述了伤口的出血情况，并注明了出血停止的时间。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Waqaf il-fsid minn subgħajk? Mark: Iva, issa m'għadux ħiereġ demm.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has the bleeding from your finger stopped? Mark: Yes, there is no more blood coming out now.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你手指的血止住了吗？Mark：止住了，现在已经不流血了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你手指的血止住了吗？
messages.en: Has the bleeding from your finger stopped?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 止住了，现在已经不流血了。
messages.en: Yes, there is no more blood coming out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“出血—止血”两幅连续画面记 fsid，并搭配 waqaf il-fsid，理解为“出血停止了”。

gloss_zh: 剥壳；打破蛋壳等的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of removing or breaking a shell, such as when cracking eggs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剥去或敲破外壳的动作，例如打破蛋壳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li titneħħa jew tinkiser qoxra, bħal meta jinkiser il-bajd.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of shelling or breaking (eggs etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥壳或打破外壳的动作，例如打破蛋壳。

formal.mt: Waqt il-fsiq tal-bajd, biċċa qoxra waqgħet fl-iskutella.
formal.en: While the eggs were being cracked, a piece of shell fell into the bowl.
formal.zh: 打鸡蛋时，一片蛋壳掉进了碗里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-fsiq tal-bajd? Pawlu: Jien; int ħallat id-dqiq maz-zokkor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will take care of cracking the eggs? Pawlu: I will; you mix the flour with the sugar.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来负责打鸡蛋？保罗：我来；你把面粉和糖混合起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-fsiq tal-bajd?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-fsiq tal-bajd?
messages.zh: 谁来负责打鸡蛋？
messages.en: Who will take care of cracking the eggs?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 我来；你把面粉和糖混合起来。
messages.en: I will; you mix the flour with the sugar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鸡蛋在碗边轻轻一敲：fsiq指敲壳或剥壳这个动作，不是掉下来的蛋壳。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small ftira, a type of Maltese bread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个头较小的ftira，即一种马耳他面包的小份形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftira ta' daqs żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个小的ftira面包；小份马耳他面包。

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar, kull parteċipant ingħata ftajra bit-tadam u ż-żejt.
formal.en: For lunch, each participant was given a small ftira with tomatoes and oil.
formal.zh: 午餐时，每位参加者都领到了一份配番茄和油的小ftira面包。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek ftajra mimlija bit-tonn? Rita: Iva, tridha wkoll bit-tadam?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a small ftira filled with tuna? Rita: Yes, would you like tomatoes in it too?
colloquial.zh: 马克：有夹金枪鱼的小ftira面包吗？丽塔：有，也要加番茄吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 有夹金枪鱼的小ftira面包吗？
messages.en: Do you have a small ftira filled with tuna?

messages.speaker: Rita (面包店店员)
messages.zh: 有，也要加番茄吗？
messages.en: Yes, would you like tomatoes in it too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面包店里一份较小的ftira，给画面贴上ftajra标签；记忆重点是面包的个头较小。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of bringing something back to mind or learning it so that it can be recalled from memory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事情重新想起来的过程，或通过学习把内容记住、背下来的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jiftakar f'xi ħaġa jew jitgħallimha bl-amment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 回想；想起已经知道或经历过的事情。
记忆；背记；把内容学习并牢记下来。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jgħaqqad il-ftakir ta' esperjenzi personali mal-kitba ta' deskrizzjoni qasira.
formal.en: The exercise combines remembering personal experiences with writing a short description.
formal.zh: 这项练习把回想个人经历与撰写简短描述结合起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għall-ftakir tal-poeżija, taqraha darba biss? Pawlu: Le, nirrepeti kull vers sakemm inkun naf il-poeżija kollha bl-amment.
colloquial.en: Maja: To memorise the poem, do you read it only once? Pawlu: No, I repeat each line until I know the whole poem by heart.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为了背下这首诗，你只读一遍吗？保罗：不是，我逐行重复，直到把整首诗背下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 为了背下这首诗，你只读一遍吗？
messages.en: To memorise the poem, do you read it only once?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nirrepeti kull vers sakemm inkun naf il-poeżija kollha bl-amment.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nirrepeti kull vers sakemm inkun naf il-poeżija kollha bl-amment.
messages.zh: 不是，我逐行重复，直到把整首诗背下来。
messages.en: No, I repeat each line until I know the whole poem by heart.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记ftakir：翻旧照片是回想过去，反复读诗是背记新内容；两种都与记忆有关。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's lower jaw start to project forwards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一个人的下颌开始向前突出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal persuna meta x-xedaq t'isfel tagħha jibda joħroġ 'il barra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to have one's lower jaw begin to protrude
sense_translations.zh_definition: 下颌开始向前突出。

collocations.en: his lower jaw began to protrude over time
collocations.zh: 随着时间推移，他的下颌开始前突

collocations.en: his lower jaw gradually began to protrude
collocations.zh: 他的下颌逐渐开始前突

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-verb 'ftaqam' jiddeskrivi persuna li x-xedaq t'isfel tagħha beda joħroġ 'il barra.
formal.en: In the text, the verb 'ftaqam' describes a person whose lower jaw began to protrude.
formal.zh: 文中，动词ftaqam描述的是一个下颌开始向前突出的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'ftaqam' f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Ifisser li x-xedaq t'isfel tal-persuna beda joħroġ 'il barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ftaqam' mean in this sentence? Pawlu: It means that the person's lower jaw began to protrude.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的ftaqam是什么意思？保罗：意思是那个人的下颌开始向前突出。

messages.speaker: Maja (语言学习者)
messages.zh: 这句话里的ftaqam是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ftaqam' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li x-xedaq t'isfel tal-persuna beda joħroġ 'il barra.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li x-xedaq t'isfel tal-persuna beda joħroġ 'il barra.
messages.zh: 意思是那个人的下颌开始向前突出。
messages.en: It means that the person's lower jaw began to protrude.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张侧脸，用箭头标出下颌开始向前突出，再标上ftaqam；同时记住部位是下颌、变化是开始前突。

gloss_zh: 变穷；陷入经济困境；财务破败

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become poor or suffer financial ruin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得贫困，或因经济损失而陷入财务破败的境地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir fqir jew jitlef il-ġid tiegħu u jispiċċa f'qagħda finanzjarja ħażina ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得贫困；陷入贫穷。
在经济上遭受严重损失而破败；陷入财务绝境。

collocations.en: he became impoverished after losing his business
collocations.zh: 他失去生意后陷入贫困

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist ftaqar wara li tilef in-negozju u l-biċċa l-kbira tat-tfaddil tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist suffered financial ruin after losing his business and most of his savings.
formal.zh: 小说中，主人公失去了生意和大部分积蓄，经济上陷入了绝境。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karattru biegħ id-dar? Pawlu: Għax ftaqar u ma setax iħallas id-djun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the character sell his house? Pawlu: Because he became impoverished and could not pay his debts.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个人物为什么卖掉了房子？保罗：因为他变穷了，无法偿还债务。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这个人物为什么卖掉了房子？
messages.en: Why did the character sell his house?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ftaqar u ma setax iħallas id-djun.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ftaqar u ma setax iħallas id-djun.
messages.zh: 因为他变穷了，无法偿还债务。
messages.en: Because he became impoverished and could not pay his debts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说人物的钱袋从满到空，把ftaqar记成变穷的动态过程；严重时可表示财务破败。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The close and careful examination of something, especially to check its details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事物进行细致、认真的检查，尤其是核查其中的细节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżami bir-reqqa ta' xi ħaġa biex jiġu ċċekkjati d-dettalji tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仔细审查；细致检查。

formal.mt: Il-ftaqid tad-dokumenti żvela differenza bejn iż-żewġ verżjonijiet tal-kuntratt.
formal.en: Close scrutiny of the documents revealed a difference between the two versions of the contract.
formal.zh: 对文件的仔细审查发现，合同的两个版本之间存在一处差异。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Lestejt il-ftaqid tad-dokumenti? Mark: Kważi; għad irrid inqabbel l-aħħar żewġ paġni.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you finished scrutinising the documents? Mark: Almost; I still need to compare the last two pages.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：文件仔细检查完了吗？马克：快了；我还要核对最后两页。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 文件仔细检查完了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished scrutinising the documents?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; għad irrid inqabbel l-aħħar żewġ paġni.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; għad irrid inqabbel l-aħħar żewġ paġni.
messages.zh: 快了；我还要核对最后两页。
messages.en: Almost; I still need to compare the last two pages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着放大镜逐行核对文件，把ftaqid与细查动作联系起来，重点是认真检查每个细节。

gloss_zh: 贫困化；陷入贫穷的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming poorer or losing the resources needed to maintain one's standard of living.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经济状况变差、生活资源减少而逐渐陷入贫困的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuna jew grupp isir ifqar u jkollu inqas riżorsi għall-għajxien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贫困化；经济资源减少而陷入贫穷的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz juri l-ftaqir gradwali ta' familja li titlef is-sors ewlieni tad-dħul tagħha.
formal.en: The novel portrays the gradual impoverishment of a family that loses its main source of income.
formal.zh: 这部小说描写了一个家庭失去主要收入来源后逐渐陷入贫困的过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ftaqir tal-familja fir-rumanz ġara f'daqqa? Pawlu: Le, bil-mod; kull xahar kien fadlilhom inqas flus.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the family's impoverishment in the novel happen suddenly? Pawlu: No, gradually; each month they had less money left.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小说里这个家庭是突然陷入贫困的吗？保罗：不是，是逐渐变穷的；他们每个月剩下的钱都更少。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 小说里这个家庭是突然陷入贫困的吗？
messages.en: Did the family's impoverishment in the novel happen suddenly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bil-mod; kull xahar kien fadlilhom inqas flus.
messages.mt_standard: Le, bil-mod; kull xahar kien fadlilhom inqas flus.
messages.zh: 不是，是逐渐变穷的；他们每个月剩下的钱都更少。
messages.en: No, gradually; each month they had less money left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把逐月缩水的家庭钱袋画成连续几格，ftaqir就是整段贫困化过程的名称；作为名词记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Talk that draws attention to one's own achievements, abilities, or possessions in a boastful way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以炫耀的方式谈论自己的成就、能力或财物的言语或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem li bih wieħed jiftaħar bil-kisbiet, bil-ħiliet jew b'dak li għandu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吹嘘；夸耀自己的成就、能力或财物。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jagħti fatti konkreti u jevita l-ftaħir dwar ir-riżultati.
formal.en: The report presents concrete facts and avoids boasting about the results.
formal.zh: 报告列出了具体事实，避免夸耀成果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan kollu ftaħir, jew veru rebaħ? Pawlu: Veru rebaħ, imma m'hemmx għalfejn jirrepetih il-ħin kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this all boasting, or did he really win? Pawlu: He really won, but he doesn't need to keep repeating it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些都是吹牛，还是真赢了？保罗：他确实赢了，不过没必要一直说。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan kollu ftaħir, jew veru rebaħ?
messages.mt_standard: Dan kollu ftaħir, jew veru rebaħ?
messages.zh: 这些都是吹牛，还是真赢了？
messages.en: Is this all boasting, or did he really win?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru rebaħ, imma m'hemmx għalfejn jirrepetih il-ħin kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Veru rebaħ, imma m'hemmx għalfejn jirrepetih il-ħin kollu.
messages.zh: 他确实赢了，不过没必要一直说。
messages.en: He really won, but he doesn't need to keep repeating it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ftaħir联想到一个人反复展示奖杯、夸自己厉害的场景，记住它表示吹嘘这种行为。

gloss_zh: 被理解；与某人达成协议

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be understood, or to reach an agreement with another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指意思被人理解，或与另一个人商定某事、达成一致。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża meta t-tifsira tkun ċara għal ħaddieħor, jew meta persuna tasal għal qbil ma' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被理解；所表达的意思被人领会。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make an agreement with sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与某人达成协议；与某人商定某事。

collocations.en: reached an agreement with his companion

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant ftehem mal-fornitur fuq il-prezz u d-data tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The representative agreed with the supplier on the price and the delivery date.
formal.zh: 代表与供应商商定了价格和交货日期。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu ftehem ma' Mark dwar il-ħin? Luqa: Iva, ftehem miegħu li jiltaqgħu fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did Pawlu agree with Mark on the time? Luqa: Yes, he agreed with him that they would meet at eight.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu和Mark商定时间了吗？Luqa：商定了，他们约好八点见面。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ftehem ma' Mark dwar il-ħin?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ftehem ma' Mark dwar il-ħin?
messages.zh: Pawlu和Mark商定时间了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu agree with Mark on the time?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftehem miegħu li jiltaqgħu fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftehem miegħu li jiltaqgħu fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 商定了，他们约好八点见面。
messages.en: Yes, he agreed with him that they would meet at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项串成小故事：意思先被理解，双方再达成一致；见到与人搭配时，联想“商定”。

gloss_zh: 小股喷出；微不足道的小事

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small burst, or a little thing of very little importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指少量、短暂的喷出，也可指不重要、微不足道的小事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ f'daqqa ta' kwantità żgħira, jew ħaġa żgħira ta' ftit importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小股喷出；少量而突然的一次迸出。
微不足道的小事；不值得在意的小东西。

formal.mt: Meta nfetaħ il-vit, ħarġet ftejqa ta' ilma li xarrbet il-karta fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: When the tap was opened, a small burst of water came out and wet the paper on the table.
formal.zh: 水龙头打开时喷出了一小股水，弄湿了桌上的纸。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Skużani, waqqajt ftit zokkor fuq il-mejda. Toni: Tinkwetax għal ftejqa bħal din; niġbruh malajr.
colloquial.en: Nina: Sorry, I spilled a little sugar on the table. Toni: Don't worry about such a little trifle; we'll clean it up quickly.
colloquial.zh: Nina：不好意思，我把一点糖洒在桌上了。Toni：别为这点小事担心，我们很快就能清理好。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, waqqajt ftit zokkor fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, waqqajt ftit zokkor fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我把一点糖洒在桌上了。
messages.en: Sorry, I spilled a little sugar on the table.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tinkwetax għal ftejqa bħal din; niġbruh malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Tinkwetax għal ftejqa bħal din; niġbruh malajr.
messages.zh: 别为这点小事担心，我们很快就能清理好。
messages.en: Don't worry about such a little trifle; we'll clean it up quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“小”把两个意思连起来：水只喷出一小股，事情也只是一桩小事；这是记义联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slices of bread, considered as separate cut portions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 切成片状的面包，表示多片面包。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċiet ċatti tal-ħobż maqtugħin minn ħobża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面包片；切下来的多片面包。

formal.mt: Għal kull persuna, poġġi żewġ ftiet ħobż fuq platt u żid ftit ġobon.
formal.en: For each person, place two slices of bread on a plate and add a little cheese.
formal.zh: 为每个人在盘中放上两片面包，再加一点奶酪。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm-il ftila ħobż trid? Mark: Żewġ ftiet, jekk jogħġbok, bi ftit butir.
colloquial.en: Sara: How many slices of bread would you like? Mark: Two slices, please, with a little butter.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你想要几片面包？Mark：请给我两片，抹一点黄油。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 你想要几片面包？
messages.en: How many slices of bread would you like?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Żewġ ftiet, jekk jogħġbok, bi ftit butir.
messages.mt_standard: Żewġ ftiet, jekk jogħġbok, bi ftit butir.
messages.zh: 请给我两片，抹一点黄油。
messages.en: Two slices, please, with a little butter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象盘里并排放着两片面包，把 ftiet 和“多片、切片”绑定记忆，特别留意它表示复数。

gloss_zh: 蘸入咖啡或肉汤的食物，通常指面包

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something, typically bread, that is dunked in coffee or broth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蘸入或浸入咖啡、肉汤中的食物，通常是一块面包。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ikel, ġeneralment ħobż, li titgħaddas fil-kafè jew fil-brodu.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. which is dunked in coffee or broth (typically bread)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蘸入咖啡或肉汤中的东西，通常指面包。

collocations.en: a piece of bread dunked in coffee
a piece of bread dunked in broth

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-kelma ftieta tirreferi għal biċċa ħobż mgħaddsa fil-brodu.
formal.en: In this example, the word ftieta refers to a piece of bread dunked in broth.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，ftieta一词指蘸入肉汤中的一块面包。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ħallejt biċċa ħobż ħdejn il-kafè? Pawlu: Biex nagħmel ftieta; inħobb ngħaddas il-ħobż fil-kafè.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did you leave a piece of bread beside the coffee? Pawlu: To make a dunked piece of bread; I like dipping bread in coffee.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你为什么在咖啡旁边放了一块面包？Pawlu：用来蘸咖啡吃，我喜欢把面包浸进咖啡里。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħallejt biċċa ħobż ħdejn il-kafè?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħallejt biċċa ħobż ħdejn il-kafè?
messages.zh: 你为什么在咖啡旁边放了一块面包？
messages.en: Why did you leave a piece of bread beside the coffee?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nagħmel ftieta; inħobb ngħaddas il-ħobż fil-kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nagħmel ftieta; inħobb ngħaddas il-ħobż fil-kafè.
messages.zh: 用来蘸咖啡吃，我喜欢把面包浸进咖啡里。
messages.en: To make a dunked piece of bread; I like dipping bread in coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中定格“面包进入咖啡杯”的画面：ftieta指蘸进去的食物，记住它与浸蘸场景的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of quarreling or arguing with someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与别人争执、吵嘴的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitlewwem jew jiġġieled bil-kliem ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 争吵；与他人发生口头争执。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ftil bejn il-ġirien dwar l-użu tal-bitħa komuni.
formal.en: The report describes the quarreling between the neighbours over the use of the shared courtyard.
formal.zh: 报告描述了邻居们因公共庭院的使用而发生的争吵。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhu dan l-istorbju? Ġorġ: Ftil bejn il-ġirien dwar il-parkeġġ; nispera li jikkalmaw dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Marta: What's all that noise? Ġorġ: The neighbours are quarreling about parking; I hope they calm down soon.
colloquial.zh: Marta：怎么这么吵？Ġorġ：邻居们在为停车的事争吵，希望他们很快冷静下来。

messages.speaker: Marta (居民)
messages.zh: 怎么这么吵？
messages.en: What's all that noise?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftil bejn il-ġirien dwar il-parkeġġ; nispera li jikkalmaw dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Ftil bejn il-ġirien dwar il-parkeġġ; nispera li jikkalmaw dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 邻居们在为停车的事争吵，希望他们很快冷静下来。
messages.en: The neighbours are quarreling about parking; I hope they calm down soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ftil 配上两个人隔着篱笆吵嘴的画面，记作“争吵这一行为”，用场景牢牢记住名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of ending a baby's or young animal's dependence on milk feeding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使婴儿或幼小动物逐渐停止依赖乳汁喂养的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih tarbija jew annimal żgħir jieqaf jiddependi fuq it-treddigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 断奶；使婴儿或幼小动物逐渐停止依赖乳汁喂养。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jispjega t-tifsira tal-ftim u jiddeskrivi dan il-proċess fil-ħajja tat-tarbija.
formal.en: The chapter explains the meaning of weaning and describes this process in a baby's life.
formal.zh: 本章解释断奶的含义，并描述婴儿生命中的这一过程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser ftim f'dan il-ktieb? Marija: Ifisser il-proċess li bih it-tarbija tieqaf tiddependi fuq it-treddigħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does ftim mean in this book? Marija: It means the process by which a baby stops depending on milk feeding.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这本书里的ftim是什么意思？Marija：指婴儿逐渐停止依赖乳汁喂养的过程，也就是断奶。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这本书里的ftim是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ftim mean in this book?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser il-proċess li bih it-tarbija tieqaf tiddependi fuq it-treddigħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser il-proċess li bih it-tarbija tieqaf tiddependi fuq it-treddigħ.
messages.zh: 指婴儿逐渐停止依赖乳汁喂养的过程，也就是断奶。
messages.en: It means the process by which a baby stops depending on milk feeding.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ftim 放进“宝宝逐渐告别吃奶”的成长画面，重点记住它表示断奶的过程，而非某一种食物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of having one's meal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃一顿饭、进行用餐的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jiekol l-ikla tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进餐；吃自己的那顿饭。

formal.mt: Waqt il-ftir, il-parteċipanti baqgħu bilqiegħda fil-kamra tal-ikel; wara komplew il-laqgħa.
formal.en: While having their meal, the participants remained seated in the dining room; afterwards they continued the meeting.
formal.zh: 用餐期间，与会者留在餐厅就座；之后他们继续开会。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Nista' nċempillek f'nofsinhar? David: Aħjar wara l-ftir, biex inkunu nistgħu nitkellmu bil-kwiet.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can I call you at noon? David: Better after I've had my meal, so we can talk without interruption.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我中午能给你打电话吗？David：最好等我吃完饭，这样我们就能安安静静地聊。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 我中午能给你打电话吗？
messages.en: Can I call you at noon?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar wara l-ftir, biex inkunu nistgħu nitkellmu bil-kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar wara l-ftir, biex inkunu nistgħu nitkellmu bil-kwiet.
messages.zh: 最好等我吃完饭，这样我们就能安安静静地聊。
messages.en: Better after I've had my meal, so we can talk without interruption.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日程表上“正在吃饭”的一格，把 ftir 记成用餐这件事，再连记“用餐期间、用餐之后”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tear or opening in material or tissue; in medicine, a hernia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料或组织出现的裂口或破裂；在医学语境中也指疝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiċrita jew fetħa f'materjal jew tessut; fil-mediċina, ħruġ ta' tessut minn parti dgħajfa tal-ħajt li jżommu f'postu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撕裂形成的裂口，尤指布料等材料上的破口。
疝，即组织或器官通过周围支撑组织的薄弱处突出。
破裂；原本相连的材料或组织裂开。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab ftuq fid-drapp li jgħatti s-siġġu.
formal.en: During the inspection, a rip was found in the fabric covering the chair.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，椅子的包覆布料上有一道裂口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm ftuq fil-qmis tiegħi. Mark: Rajtu. Nista' nsewwihlek jekk trid.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a rip in my shirt. Mark: I saw it. I can mend it for you if you like.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的衬衫破了一个口子。马克：我看到了。你愿意的话，我可以帮你补好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的衬衫破了一个口子。
messages.en: There's a rip in my shirt.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看到了。你愿意的话，我可以帮你补好。
messages.en: I saw it. I can mend it for you if you like.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把衣服裂口、组织破裂和疝放在同一张学习卡上，再用语境区分：看到 qmis 想衣服破口，看到 addominali 想腹部疝。

gloss_zh: 有通便作用的；有泻下作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that promotes bowel movements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有促进排便、产生通便或泻下效果的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jġiegħel l-imsaren jitbattlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有泻下作用的；能够促进肠道排空的。

formal.mt: Fit-test, ir-rimedju huwa deskritt bħala ftuħi, jiġifieri li għandu effett li jġiegħel l-imsaren jitbattlu.
formal.en: In the text, the remedy is described as purgative, meaning that it has an effect that causes the bowels to empty.
formal.zh: 文中将这种药剂描述为有泻下作用，即能够促使肠道排空。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser ftuħi ħdejn il-kelma rimedju? Mark: Ifisser li r-rimedju jgħin lill-imsaren jitbattlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does ftuħi mean beside the word remedy? Mark: It means that the remedy helps the bowels empty.
colloquial.zh: Maja：rimedju旁边的ftuħi是什么意思？Mark：意思是这种药剂有帮助肠道排空的作用。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser ftuħi ħdejn il-kelma rimedju?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser ftuħi ħdejn il-kelma rimedju?
messages.zh: rimedju旁边的ftuħi是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ftuħi mean beside the word remedy?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li r-rimedju jgħin lill-imsaren jitbattlu.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li r-rimedju jgħin lill-imsaren jitbattlu.
messages.zh: 意思是这种药剂有帮助肠道排空的作用。
messages.en: It means that the remedy helps the bowels empty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ftuħi 写在“通便作用”的标签旁，记住它是描述效果的形容词，可与“药剂、作用”等名词搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Broad beans, eaten fresh or cooked as food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蚕豆，可作为食材鲜食或烹煮；使用时可泛指这种豆类或一定数量的蚕豆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fażola b'żerriegħa kbira u ċatta li tittiekel friska jew imsajra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蚕豆；可指这种豆类，也可统称若干蚕豆。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, għalli l-ful u mbagħad żid iż-żejt taż-żebbuġa.
formal.en: For this recipe, boil the broad beans and then add the olive oil.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，先把蚕豆煮熟，再加入橄榄油。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid ftit ful mal-ħobż? Ben: Iva, grazzi. Żidli ftit żejt ukoll.
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you like some broad beans with the bread? Ben: Yes, thanks. Add a little oil for me too.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：要不要来点蚕豆配面包？本：好，谢谢。也帮我加一点油。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 要不要来点蚕豆配面包？
messages.en: Would you like some broad beans with the bread?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Żidli ftit żejt ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Żidli ftit żejt ukoll.
messages.zh: 好，谢谢。也帮我加一点油。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Add a little oil for me too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ful 写在一碗蚕豆的图旁，再分别配上 frisk“新鲜的”和 mgħolli“煮熟的”，用两种上桌方式牢牢记住同一种豆。

gloss_zh: 挂在心上；在脑中惦记着

teaching_sense.en_definition: Present in someone's thoughts, especially as something they keep considering or worrying about.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某件事一直占据某人的思绪，表示惦记、挂心或反复考虑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-ħsieb ta' xi ħadd, speċjalment meta jibqa' jaħseb dwar xi ħaġa jew jinkwieta dwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某人心上；被某人惦记着或反复想着。

collocations.en: I have a lot on my mind
he has something on his mind

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, l-istudenta kitbet li kellha l-eżami fuq moħħha.
formal.en: In her letter, the student wrote that the exam was on her mind.
formal.zh: 这名学生在信中写道，她一直惦记着考试。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex int daqshekk kwiet? Mark: Għandi x-xogħol fuq moħħi. Għada rrid inlesti r-rapport.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you so quiet? Mark: I've got work on my mind. I have to finish the report tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么这么安静？马克：我心里惦记着工作。明天我得把报告写完。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么这么安静？
messages.en: Why are you so quiet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi x-xogħol fuq moħħi. Għada rrid inlesti r-rapport.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi x-xogħol fuq moħħi. Għada rrid inlesti r-rapport.
messages.zh: 我心里惦记着工作。明天我得把报告写完。
messages.en: I've got work on my mind. I have to finish the report tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脑中贴着一张待办便签，表示事情一直挂在心上；配对记忆 moħħi“我的心思”、moħħu“他的心思”、moħħha“她的心思”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated high up or in an upper position relative to something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于高处或相对较上方的，用来说明事物所处的位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'pożizzjoni għolja jew aktar 'il fuq minn xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高处的；位于上方或较高位置的。

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi li l-uffiċċju jinsab fis-sular fuqani tal-bini.
formal.en: The plan shows that the office is on the upper floor of the building.
formal.zh: 平面图显示，办公室位于这栋建筑的上层。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Mark: Fis-sular fuqani. Jien ħdejn it-taraġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where shall we meet? Mark: On the upper floor. I'm near the stairs.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们在哪里见面？马克：在楼上那层。我在楼梯旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 在楼上那层。我在楼梯旁边。
messages.en: On the upper floor. I'm near the stairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一栋两层小楼，把 fuqani 标在上层，再把它标在画框的上边缘；两个位置都提示“在较高处、在上方”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to ask what subject someone is thinking, speaking, or writing about.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问思考、谈话或写作所涉及的话题，相当于“关于什么”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex tistaqsi dwar is-suġġett ta' ħsieb, taħdita jew kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关于什么；就什么话题而言，用于询问内容或主题。

formal.mt: Fuqiex se tikteb fir-rapport tiegħek dwar iż-żjara?
formal.en: What will you write about in your report on the visit?
formal.zh: 你将在参观报告中写些什么？

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fuqiex qed taħseb? David: Fuq il-vjaġġ ta' għada. Għad irrid inħejji l-bagalja.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you thinking about? David: Tomorrow's trip. I still need to pack my suitcase.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在想什么？戴维：明天的旅行。我还得收拾行李。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在想什么？
messages.en: What are you thinking about?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-vjaġġ ta' għada. Għad irrid inħejji l-bagalja.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-vjaġġ ta' għada. Għad irrid inħejji l-bagalja.
messages.zh: 明天的旅行。我还得收拾行李。
messages.en: Tomorrow's trip. I still need to pack my suitcase.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fuqiex 放在一个写着“话题？”的对话气泡里：对方在想、在说、在写时，都可以借它追问“关于什么”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An amount of food picked up or held on a fork at one time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用叉子一次叉起或托起的食物量，即“一叉子”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ammont ta' ikel li jinġabar jew jinżamm fuq furketta f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一叉子量；叉子一次叉起或托起的食物。

formal.mt: Waqt id-degustazzjoni, kull parteċipant daq furkettata għaġin biz-zalza l-ġdida.
formal.en: During the tasting, each participant tried a forkful of pasta with the new sauce.
formal.zh: 试吃时，每位参与者都尝了一叉子配有新酱汁的意面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid idduq l-għaġin tiegħi? Ben: Iva, agħtini furkettata biss. Għadni kif kilt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like to try my pasta? Ben: Yes, just give me a forkful. I've only just eaten.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：要尝尝我的意面吗？本：好，给我一叉子就行。我刚吃过。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 要尝尝我的意面吗？
messages.en: Would you like to try my pasta?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, agħtini furkettata biss. Għadni kif kilt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, agħtini furkettata biss. Għadni kif kilt.
messages.zh: 好，给我一叉子就行。我刚吃过。
messages.en: Yes, just give me a forkful. I've only just eaten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象叉子上卷着一小口意面，把这份食物标成 furkettata；记住它表示“一叉子的量”，关注的是食物份量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A potato hoe, a farming tool used to dig up potatoes from the soil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于把马铃薯从土中挖起的农用锄具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tal-biedja li tintuża biex tinqala' l-patata mill-ħamrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马铃薯锄；用来从土中挖起马铃薯的农具。

collocations.en: to dig up potatoes with a potato hoe
collocations.zh: 用马铃薯锄挖起马铃薯

formal.mt: Il-bidwi uża furkettun biex qala' l-patata mill-ħamrija.
formal.en: The farmer used a potato hoe to dig the potatoes out of the soil.
formal.zh: 农民用马铃薯锄把马铃薯从土中挖了出来。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Fejn hu l-furkettun? Irrid naqla' l-patata. Rita: Fil-barrakka, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Where's the potato hoe? I want to dig up the potatoes. Rita: In the shed, next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：马铃薯锄在哪里？我要去挖马铃薯。丽塔：在棚屋里，门旁边。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-furkettun? Irrid naqla' l-patata.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-furkettun? Irrid naqla' l-patata.
messages.zh: 马铃薯锄在哪里？我要去挖马铃薯。
messages.en: Where's the potato hoe? I want to dig up the potatoes.

messages.speaker: Rita (农场同事)
messages.zh: 在棚屋里，门旁边。
messages.en: In the shed, next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 furkettun 标在田边农具上，旁边画出刚挖起的马铃薯；每次连读“农具、挖土、马铃薯”，用完整劳动场景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small lice that live in pubic hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寄生在阴毛中的小型虱类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qamel żgħir li jgħix fix-xagħar tal-partijiet intimi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴虱。

formal.mt: Dan il-fuljett jagħti informazzjoni dwar il-furrax.
formal.en: This leaflet provides information about crab lice.
formal.zh: 这份宣传单提供有关阴虱的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma furrax f'dan il-fuljett? Rita: Tfisser qamel li jgħix fix-xagħar tal-partijiet intimi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word furrax mean in this leaflet? Rita: It means lice that live in pubic hair.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份宣传单里的 furrax 是什么意思？丽塔：指寄生在阴毛中的虱子。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma furrax f'dan il-fuljett?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma furrax f'dan il-fuljett?
messages.zh: 这份宣传单里的 furrax 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word furrax mean in this leaflet?

messages.speaker: Rita (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser qamel li jgħix fix-xagħar tal-partijiet intimi.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser qamel li jgħix fix-xagħar tal-partijiet intimi.
messages.zh: 指寄生在阴毛中的虱子。
messages.en: It means lice that live in pubic hair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 furrax 写在“阴虱”词卡上，配合卫生宣传单的阅读场景记忆，避免与普通头虱混淆。

gloss_zh: 蚁鴷，furrax is-summien 的同义名称

teaching_sense.en_definition: Another name for the wryneck, also called furrax is-summien.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟名，指蚁鴷，与 furrax is-summien 同义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf ukoll bħala furrax is-summien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: furrax is-summien 的同义名称，指蚁鴷。

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, l-isem furrax il-bqaraq jirreferi għall-istess għasfur bħall-isem furrax is-summien.
formal.en: In this list, the name furrax il-bqaraq refers to the same bird as the name furrax is-summien.
formal.zh: 在这份名录中，furrax il-bqaraq 与 furrax is-summien 指同一种鸟。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Furrax il-bqaraq u furrax is-summien huma żewġ għasafar differenti? Lara: Le, huma żewġ ismijiet għall-istess għasfur.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are furrax il-bqaraq and furrax is-summien two different birds? Lara: No, they are two names for the same bird.
colloquial.zh: 马克：furrax il-bqaraq 和 furrax is-summien 是两种不同的鸟吗？拉拉：不是，它们是同一种鸟的两个名称。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Furrax il-bqaraq u furrax is-summien huma żewġ għasafar differenti?
messages.mt_standard: Furrax il-bqaraq u furrax is-summien huma żewġ għasafar differenti?
messages.zh: furrax il-bqaraq 和 furrax is-summien 是两种不同的鸟吗？
messages.en: Are furrax il-bqaraq and furrax is-summien two different birds?

messages.speaker: Lara (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huma żewġ ismijiet għall-istess għasfur.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huma żewġ ismijiet għall-istess għasfur.
messages.zh: 不是，它们是同一种鸟的两个名称。
messages.en: No, they are two names for the same bird.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在一张蚁鴷图片下并列写出两个马耳他语名称，用“同一张图、两个名字”记住同义关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird called a wryneck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸟的名称，中文称为蚁鴷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala wryneck.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蚁鴷。

formal.mt: L-istampa tal-furrax is-summien tidher ħdejn ismu fil-gwida tal-għasafar.
formal.en: The picture of the wryneck appears beside its name in the bird guide.
formal.zh: 在鸟类指南中，蚁鴷的图片列在它的名称旁边。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif jissejjaħ dan l-għasfur fl-istampa? Pawlu: Dan hu furrax is-summien. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ wryneck.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is this bird in the picture called? Pawlu: This is a furrax is-summien. In English it is called a wryneck.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：图片里的这只鸟叫什么？保罗：这是 furrax is-summien，英语叫 wryneck，中文叫蚁鴷。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里的这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the picture called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu furrax is-summien. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ wryneck.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu furrax is-summien. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ wryneck.
messages.zh: 这是 furrax is-summien，英语叫 wryneck，中文叫蚁鴷。
messages.en: This is a furrax is-summien. In English it is called a wryneck.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把完整词组 furrax is-summien 与“蚁鴷／wryneck”放在同一张鸟类词卡上，整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated in the middle, between other parts or positions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于其他部分或位置之间，处在中间的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab fin-nofs, bejn partijiet jew pożizzjonijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中间的；处于中央位置的。

formal.mt: Is-saff fustani jinsab bejn is-saff ta' fuq u dak ta' isfel.
formal.en: The middle layer lies between the upper layer and the lower one.
formal.zh: 中间层位于上层与下层之间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema saff għandi npinġi blu? Mark: Is-saff fustani, bejn dak ta' fuq u dak ta' isfel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which layer should I paint blue? Mark: The middle layer, between the top one and the bottom one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我该把哪一层涂成蓝色？马克：中间那层，就在上层和下层之间。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我该把哪一层涂成蓝色？
messages.en: Which layer should I paint blue?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-saff fustani, bejn dak ta' fuq u dak ta' isfel.
messages.mt_standard: Is-saff fustani, bejn dak ta' fuq u dak ta' isfel.
messages.zh: 中间那层，就在上层和下层之间。
messages.en: The middle layer, between the top one and the bottom one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画三条横线，把 fustani 标在中间一条旁边，再读 is-saff fustani，把词义与位置一起记住。

gloss_zh: 工作时随手擦手用的布

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cloth kept within reach for wiping your hands while working.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 工作时放在手边、供擦手使用的一块布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp li tinżamm fil-qrib biex wieħed jimsaħ idejh waqt ix-xogħol.

sense_translations.en_definition: a piece of cloth kept at hand for wiping one’s hands during work
sense_translations.zh_definition: 工作时放在手边、随时用来擦手的一块布。

collocations.en: to wipe your hands with the work cloth
to keep a wiping cloth nearby

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol, il-ħaddiem iżomm futa fil-qrib biex jimsaħ idejh.
formal.en: While working, the worker keeps a cloth nearby to wipe his hands.
formal.zh: 工作时，工人把一块布放在手边，以便擦手。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi l-futa? Għandi bżonn nimsaħ idejja. Toni: Ħdejn l-għodda, fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the wiping cloth? I need to wipe my hands. Toni: Beside the tools, on the table.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：擦手布在哪儿？我需要擦擦手。托尼：在工具旁边，桌子上。

messages.speaker: Lara (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-futa? Għandi bżonn nimsaħ idejja.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-futa? Għandi bżonn nimsaħ idejja.
messages.zh: 擦手布在哪儿？我需要擦擦手。
messages.en: Where is the wiping cloth? I need to wipe my hands.

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 在工具旁边，桌子上。
messages.en: Beside the tools, on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工作台旁总放着一块擦手布，伸手拿布时默念 futa，用“工作中随手擦手”的动作记词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes pots and other objects from clay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用黏土制作陶罐及其他陶器的人，即陶工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel qsari u oġġetti oħra mit-tafal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陶工；以黏土制作陶器的人。
陶制的；用黏土烧制而成的。

formal.mt: Il-fuħħari wera lill-istudenti kif jagħmel vażett mit-tafal.
formal.en: The potter showed the students how he makes a jar from clay.
formal.zh: 陶工向学生们示范了如何用黏土制作小罐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min għamel dan il-vażett? Pawlu: Fuħħari mir-raħal tagħna. Għandu ħanut ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who made this jar? Pawlu: A potter from our village. He has a shop near the square.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个小罐是谁做的？保罗：我们村的一位陶工。他在广场附近有一家店。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个小罐是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this jar?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuħħari mir-raħal tagħna. Għandu ħanut ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Fuħħari mir-raħal tagħna. Għandu ħanut ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.zh: 我们村的一位陶工。他在广场附近有一家店。
messages.en: A potter from our village. He has a shop near the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象陶工举起自己做的陶罐：指着人时记名词“陶工”，描述罐子时记形容词“陶制的”，用同一幅画区分两个词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A smell or fragrance that you notice with your nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼻子能闻到的气味，也可指香气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riħa li tinħass bl-imnieħer, jew riħa tfuħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 气味；香气。

formal.mt: Il-fwejħa tal-fjuri mliet il-kamra.
formal.en: The fragrance of the flowers filled the room.
formal.zh: 花香弥漫了整个房间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'fwejħa ħelwa! Minn fejn ġejja? Rita: Mill-fjuri li poġġejt ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What a sweet fragrance! Where is it coming from? Rita: From the flowers I put beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：好香啊！香气是从哪儿来的？丽塔：是我放在窗边的那些花散发出来的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 好香啊！香气是从哪儿来的？
messages.en: What a sweet fragrance! Where is it coming from?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 是我放在窗边的那些花散发出来的。
messages.en: From the flowers I put beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开窗户闻到花香，把 fwejħa 与“鼻子闻到的气味”相连，再用 fwejħa ħelwa 记住香气这一用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of confusion in which something is unclear or difficult to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事情不清楚、难以理解时产生的混乱或困惑状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' konfużjoni meta xi ħaġa ma tkunx ċara jew tkun diffiċli biex tinftiehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混乱；困惑。

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ verżjonijiet differenti tal-istruzzjonijiet ħolqu fxil fost il-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The two different versions of the instructions caused confusion among the participants.
formal.zh: 两个不同版本的说明使参与者感到困惑。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Hawn miktub id-disgħa, imma fil-messaġġ hemm l-għaxra. X'fxil! Maja: Il-laqgħa tibda fl-għaxra. Din il-karta hi qadima.
colloquial.en: Mark: It says nine here, but the message says ten. What a mix-up! Maja: The meeting starts at ten. This sheet is old.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这里写九点，可消息里写十点。真乱！玛雅：会议十点开始。这张纸是旧的。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub id-disgħa, imma fil-messaġġ hemm l-għaxra. X'fxil!
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub id-disgħa, imma fil-messaġġ hemm l-għaxra. X'fxil!
messages.zh: 这里写九点，可消息里写十点。真乱！
messages.en: It says nine here, but the message says ten. What a mix-up!

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-laqgħa tibda fl-għaxra. Din il-karta hi qadima.
messages.mt_standard: Il-laqgħa tibda fl-għaxra. Din il-karta hi qadima.
messages.zh: 会议十点开始。这张纸是旧的。
messages.en: The meeting starts at ten. This sheet is old.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两张通知写着不同时间，让人越看越糊涂；给这个场景标上 fxil，再练习感叹 X'fxil!。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An episode of bleeding from the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 血液从鼻子流出的现象或一次流鼻血的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ ta' demm mill-imnieħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻出血；一次流鼻血的情况。

formal.mt: Skont in-nota tal-għalliem, l-istudent kellu fġir waqt il-lezzjoni u ħareġ mill-klassi.
formal.en: According to the teacher's note, the student had a nosebleed during the lesson and left the classroom.
formal.zh: 根据教师的记录，这名学生在上课时流了鼻血，随后离开了教室。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex għandu demm fuq il-flokk? Toni: Kellu fġir ftit ilu, imma issa waqaf id-demm.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why does he have blood on his shirt? Toni: He had a nosebleed a little while ago, but the bleeding has stopped now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：他的上衣上怎么有血？托尼：他刚才流鼻血了，不过现在已经不流了。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 他的上衣上怎么有血？
messages.en: Why does he have blood on his shirt?

messages.speaker: Toni (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellu fġir ftit ilu, imma issa waqaf id-demm.
messages.mt_standard: Kellu fġir ftit ilu, imma issa waqaf id-demm.
messages.zh: 他刚才流鼻血了，不过现在已经不流了。
messages.en: He had a nosebleed a little while ago, but the bleeding has stopped now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fġir 写在一张画着鼻子和血滴的词卡上，并连读 kellu fġir，记住“他流了鼻血”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a male animal that has been castrated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容雄性动物已经接受阉割、被去势的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi annimal maskili li ġie msewwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被阉割的；去势的，通常用于雄性动物。

formal.mt: Fir-reġistru tar-razzett, dan l-annimal huwa deskritt bħala żiemel fħuli.
formal.en: In the farm register, this animal is described as a gelded horse.
formal.zh: 农场登记册将这只动物记为一匹去势的公马。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi jfisser 'fħuli' fuq din il-karta? Ġużeppi: Ifisser li ż-żiemel ġie msewwi.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does 'fħuli' mean on this card? Ġużeppi: It means that the horse has been castrated.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这张卡片上的“fħuli”是什么意思？朱塞佩：意思是这匹公马已经去势。

messages.speaker: Anna (骑术学员)
messages.zh: 这张卡片上的“fħuli”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'fħuli' mean on this card?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (骑术教练)
messages.zh: 意思是这匹公马已经去势。
messages.en: It means that the horse has been castrated.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żiemel fħuli 整组记作“去势公马”；fħuli 描述动物的生理状态，不表示它是否温顺。

gloss_zh: 力量；尤指男性的强健力量

teaching_sense.en_definition: Physical strength or vigor, especially that of a male.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体的力量或强健活力，尤指男性的力量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saħħa jew qawwa tal-ġisem, speċjalment dik ta' raġel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 力量，尤指男性的体力或强健力量。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħaddiem wera l-fħulija tiegħu meta għolla l-ġebla tqila.
formal.en: In the story, the worker showed his strength when he lifted the heavy stone.
formal.zh: 故事中，这名工人举起沉重的石头，展示了他的力量。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif irnexxielu jġorr dik il-kaxxa waħdu? Mario: Għandu fħulija kbira; jien kelli bżonn l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Rita: How did he manage to carry that box on his own? Mario: He has great physical strength; I needed help.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：他怎么能独自搬动那个箱子？马里奥：他力气很大，我搬就得找人帮忙。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irnexxielu jġorr dik il-kaxxa waħdu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irnexxielu jġorr dik il-kaxxa waħdu?
messages.zh: 他怎么能独自搬动那个箱子？
messages.en: How did he manage to carry that box on his own?

messages.speaker: Mario (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu fħulija kbira; jien kelli bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu fħulija kbira; jien kelli bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 他力气很大，我搬就得找人帮忙。
messages.en: He has great physical strength; I needed help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一个人搬起重箱”的画面记住 fħulija；它是表示力量的名词，可连同 fħulija kbira 一起背。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Obscenity or indecency in language or behavior; a synonym of faħx.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 言语或行为中的粗鄙、猥亵或下流，与 faħx 同义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oxxenità jew indeċenza fil-kliem jew fl-imġiba; sinonimu ta' faħx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 faħx 同义，指粗鄙、猥亵或下流。

formal.mt: L-editur talab li titneħħa l-fħuxija mid-djalogu qabel il-pubblikazzjoni.
formal.en: The editor requested that the obscenity be removed from the dialogue before publication.
formal.zh: 编辑要求在出版前删去对话中的猥亵内容。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex ma għoġbokx dak il-filmat? Samwel: Kien mimli fħuxija, u ma sibthiex tad-daħk.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why didn't you like that video? Samwel: It was full of obscenity, and I didn't find it funny.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你为什么不喜欢那个视频？萨姆韦尔：里面满是下流内容，我觉得一点也不好笑。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不喜欢那个视频？
messages.en: Why didn't you like that video?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien mimli fħuxija, u ma sibthiex tad-daħk.
messages.mt_standard: Kien mimli fħuxija, u ma sibthiex tad-daħk.
messages.zh: 里面满是下流内容，我觉得一点也不好笑。
messages.en: It was full of obscenity, and I didn't find it funny.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fħuxija 和 faħx 放在同一张“粗鄙猥亵”词卡上；想象编辑删去下流台词，帮助记住使用场景。

gloss_zh: 桅上水手；在桅杆高处工作的水手

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sailor who works aloft in the upper parts of a sailing ship's masts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在帆船桅杆高处工作的水手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Baħri li jaħdem fil-partijiet għoljin tal-arbli ta' bastiment bil-qlugħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 桅上水手，负责在帆船桅杆高处工作的船员。

formal.mt: Il-gabbier tela' fuq l-arblu biex jiċċekkja l-ħbula tal-qlugħ.
formal.en: The topman climbed the mast to check the sail ropes.
formal.zh: 桅上水手爬上桅杆，检查控制船帆的绳索。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu dak il-baħri hemm fuq l-arblu? Pawlu: Dak hu l-gabbier. Qed jiċċekkja l-ħbula.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who's that sailor up on the mast? Pawlu: That's the topman. He's checking the ropes.
colloquial.zh: Nina：桅杆上那个水手是谁？Pawlu：那是桅上水手。他正在检查绳索。

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak il-baħri hemm fuq l-arblu?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak il-baħri hemm fuq l-arblu?
messages.zh: 桅杆上那个水手是谁？
messages.en: Who's that sailor up on the mast?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu l-gabbier. Qed jiċċekkja l-ħbula.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu l-gabbier. Qed jiċċekkja l-ħbula.
messages.zh: 那是桅上水手。他正在检查绳索。
messages.en: That's the topman. He's checking the ropes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一艘帆船，把gabbier标签贴到桅杆高处的水手身上，连同英语topman一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A farmer who rents land from its owner and cultivates it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向土地所有者租用土地并进行耕作的农民，即佃农。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidwi li jikri art mingħand sidha u jaħdimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 佃农；租用他人土地从事耕作的农民。

collocations.en: a tenant farmer cultivating the land

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jistabbilixxi l-kera li l-gabillott għandu jħallas lis-sid tal-art kull sena.
formal.en: The agreement specifies the rent that the tenant farmer must pay the landowner each year.
formal.zh: 协议规定了佃农每年须向土地所有者支付的租金。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din l-għalqa hija ta' Ġużeppi? Mark: Le, hu gabillott. Jikriha u jaħdimha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this field belong to Ġużeppi? Mark: No, he's a tenant farmer. He rents it and cultivates it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这块田属于Ġużeppi吗？Mark：不，他是佃农。他租下这块田来耕种。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块田属于Ġużeppi吗？
messages.en: Does this field belong to Ġużeppi?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hu gabillott. Jikriha u jaħdimha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hu gabillott. Jikriha u jaħdimha.
messages.zh: 不，他是佃农。他租下这块田来耕种。
messages.en: No, he's a tenant farmer. He rents it and cultivates it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把gabillott放进“交租金、种田地”的双格画面：同一个人先付地租，再下田耕作，就是佃农。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in Central Africa, officially called the Gabonese Republic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于非洲中部的国家，正式名称为加蓬共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika Ċentrali, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika Gaboniża.

sense_translations.en_definition: Gabon (a country in Central Africa; official name: Repubblika Gaboniża)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 加蓬，位于非洲中部的国家；正式名称为加蓬共和国，马耳他语为 Repubblika Gaboniża。

formal.mt: Għal dan il-proġett tal-ġeografija, l-istudenti għandhom jimmarkaw il-Gabon fuq mappa tal-Afrika.
formal.en: For this geography project, students should mark Gabon on a map of Africa.
formal.zh: 在这项地理作业中，学生应在非洲地图上标出加蓬。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn hu l-Gabon? David: Fl-Afrika Ċentrali. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where is Gabon? David: In Central Africa. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: Marta：加蓬在哪里？David：在非洲中部。我们在地图上找找吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 加蓬在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Gabon?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-Afrika Ċentrali. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-Afrika Ċentrali. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在非洲中部。我们在地图上找找吧。
messages.en: In Central Africa. Let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在非洲地图中部贴一张写着“Gabon＝加蓬”的便签，用地图位置和中外名称一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Gadolinium, a metallic chemical element.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钆，一种金属化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku metalliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钆，化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jiddeskrivi l-proprjetajiet tal-gadolinju.
formal.en: The laboratory report describes the properties of gadolinium.
formal.zh: 实验室报告描述了钆的性质。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser gadolinju bl-Ingliż? Mark: Gadolinium. Hu element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does gadolinju mean in English? Mark: Gadolinium. It's a chemical element.
colloquial.zh: Lara：gadolinju用英语怎么说？Mark：Gadolinium，就是钆。它是一种化学元素。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: gadolinju用英语怎么说？
messages.en: What does gadolinju mean in English?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: Gadolinium，就是钆。它是一种化学元素。
messages.en: Gadolinium. It's a chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把gadolinju、gadolinium、钆写在同一张元素卡上，圈出前两个词相似的开头，建立三语对应。

gloss_zh: 盖伦帆船；大型多桅帆船

teaching_sense.en_definition: A galleon: a large sailing ship with several masts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盖伦帆船，一种有多根桅杆的大型帆船。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastiment kbir bil-qlugħ u b'diversi arbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盖伦帆船，一种大型多桅帆船。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesibixxi mudell ta' galjun li juri l-arbli u l-qlugħ tiegħu fid-dettall.
formal.en: The museum displays a model of a galleon showing its masts and sails in detail.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一艘盖伦帆船模型，细致呈现其桅杆和船帆。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'tip ta' bastiment hu dan il-mudell? Toni: Hu galjun. Ara kemm għandu qlugħ!
colloquial.en: Nina: What kind of ship does this model represent? Toni: It's a galleon. Look how many sails it has!
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个模型展示的是什么船？Toni：是盖伦帆船。看，它有好多船帆！

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tip ta' bastiment hu dan il-mudell?
messages.mt_standard: X'tip ta' bastiment hu dan il-mudell?
messages.zh: 这个模型展示的是什么船？
messages.en: What kind of ship does this model represent?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu galjun. Ara kemm għandu qlugħ!
messages.mt_standard: Hu galjun. Ara kemm għandu qlugħ!
messages.zh: 是盖伦帆船。看，它有好多船帆！
messages.en: It's a galleon. Look how many sails it has!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把galjun和英语galleon并排写在一艘多桅帆船图下，再标上“盖伦帆船”，用相似拼写和船形共同记忆。

gloss_zh: 加利西亚的；加利西亚人；加利西亚语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Galicia, its people, or its language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与加利西亚、加利西亚人或加利西亚语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut ma' Galizja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-lingwa tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加利西亚的；加利西亚人的；加利西亚语的。
加利西亚人。
加利西亚语。

formal.mt: L-istudent għażel test Gallegjan għall-eżerċizzju tat-traduzzjoni.
formal.en: The student chose a Galician text for the translation exercise.
formal.zh: 这名学生选了一篇加利西亚语文本来做翻译练习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema lingwa qed titgħallem? Tom: Qed nitgħallem il-Gallegjan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which language are you learning? Tom: I'm learning Galician.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在学哪种语言？Tom：我在学加利西亚语。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在学哪种语言？
messages.en: Which language are you learning?

messages.speaker: Tom (语言学习者)
messages.zh: 我在学加利西亚语。
messages.en: I'm learning Galician.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Gallegjan 放进三张学习卡：修饰作家时是形容词，指人时是加利西亚人，跟“学习”搭配时是加利西亚语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thin, crisp crackers eaten as a snack or with other food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 薄而酥脆的饼干，可当零食或搭配其他食物食用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel irqiq u tqarmeċ li jittiekel bħala ikla ħafifa jew ma' ikel ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 薄脆饼干。

formal.mt: Għall-waqfa, ġew ippreparati gallett u ġobon għall-parteċipanti.
formal.en: Crackers and cheese were prepared for the participants for the break.
formal.zh: 为供参与者在休息时食用，准备了薄脆饼干和奶酪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit gallett? Tom: Iva, bil-ġobon jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some crackers? Tom: Yes, with cheese, please.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你要吃点薄脆饼干吗？Tom：要，请配点奶酪。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要吃点薄脆饼干吗？
messages.en: Would you like some crackers?

messages.speaker: Tom (客人)
messages.zh: 要，请配点奶酪。
messages.en: Yes, with cheese, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开一包薄脆饼干，再放上一片奶酪，把 gallett 与“包装袋、酥脆口感、奶酪”三个画面连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird called the Eurasian oystercatcher, scientifically named Haematopus ostralegus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指蛎鹬这一鸟种，学名为 Haematopus ostralegus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Haematopus ostralegus, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala Eurasian oystercatcher.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛎鹬（学名：Haematopus ostralegus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a Eurasian oystercatcher

formal.mt: Il-gwida tidentifika l-gallina tal-baħar bl-isem xjentifiku Haematopus ostralegus.
formal.en: The guide identifies the Eurasian oystercatcher by the scientific name Haematopus ostralegus.
formal.zh: 这本指南以学名 Haematopus ostralegus 标明蛎鹬这一鸟种。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fir-ritratt? Tom: Dan jismu gallina tal-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the bird in the photograph called? Tom: It's called a Eurasian oystercatcher.
colloquial.zh: Maja：照片里的这只鸟叫什么？Tom：它叫蛎鹬。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is the bird in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Tom (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 它叫蛎鹬。
messages.en: It's called a Eurasian oystercatcher.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gallina tal-baħar 整体写在蛎鹬图片下，再配上英文 oystercatcher；整组对应记忆，避免拆开后误认鸟种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called gallium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为镓的化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala gallium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镓，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proprjetajiet tal-gallju u jagħti tagħrif dwar il-kampjun.
formal.en: The report describes the properties of gallium and provides information about the sample.
formal.zh: 报告描述了镓的性质，并提供了有关样品的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm f'dan il-kontenitur? Tom: Hemm kampjun ta' gallju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's in this container? Tom: There's a sample of gallium.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个容器里装着什么？Tom：里面有一份镓样品。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个容器里装着什么？
messages.en: What's in this container?

messages.speaker: Tom (化学教师)
messages.zh: 里面有一份镓样品。
messages.en: There's a sample of gallium.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在想象中的化学样品标签上并排写“gallju—gallium—镓”，用三语标签把这个词固定在化学元素语境里。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird called the corncrake, scientifically named Crex crex.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指长脚秧鸡这一鸟种，学名为 Crex crex。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Crex crex, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala corncrake.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长脚秧鸡（学名：Crex crex）。

collocations.en: the scientific name of the corncrake

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, il-gallozz huwa mniżżel bl-isem xjentifiku Crex crex.
formal.en: In this list, the corncrake is recorded under the scientific name Crex crex.
formal.zh: 在这份名录中，长脚秧鸡以学名 Crex crex 登记。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-għasfur jismu gallozz? Tom: Iva, u l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu huwa Crex crex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this bird called a corncrake? Tom: Yes, and its scientific name is Crex crex.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这种鸟叫长脚秧鸡吗？Tom：对，它的学名是 Crex crex。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 这种鸟叫长脚秧鸡吗？
messages.en: Is this bird called a corncrake?

messages.speaker: Tom (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu huwa Crex crex.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu huwa Crex crex.
messages.zh: 对，它的学名是 Crex crex。
messages.en: Yes, and its scientific name is Crex crex.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 gallozz 配一张写有“长脚秧鸡、Crex crex”的卡片；再与 gallozz aħmar 并排复习，记住两条都对应同一鸟种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Maltese name for the corncrake, the bird species Crex crex.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长脚秧鸡的一个马耳他语名称，指学名为 Crex crex 的鸟种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem Malti għall-għasfur tal-ispeċi Crex crex, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala corncrake.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长脚秧鸡（学名：Crex crex）。

formal.mt: Il-karta tat-tagħlim tagħti l-isem gallozz aħmar għall-ispeċi Crex crex.
formal.en: The learning card gives gallozz aħmar as the name for the species Crex crex.
formal.zh: 这张学习卡将 gallozz aħmar 列为 Crex crex 这一鸟种的名称。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Gallozz aħmar u gallozz huma l-istess għasfur? Tom: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għal Crex crex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are gallozz aħmar and gallozz the same bird? Tom: Yes, both names refer to Crex crex.
colloquial.zh: Maja：gallozz aħmar 和 gallozz 指同一种鸟吗？Tom：对，这两个名称都指长脚秧鸡，学名 Crex crex。

messages.speaker: Maja (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Gallozz aħmar u gallozz huma l-istess għasfur?
messages.mt_standard: Gallozz aħmar u gallozz huma l-istess għasfur?
messages.zh: gallozz aħmar 和 gallozz 指同一种鸟吗？
messages.en: Are gallozz aħmar and gallozz the same bird?

messages.speaker: Tom (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għal Crex crex.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għal Crex crex.
messages.zh: 对，这两个名称都指长脚秧鸡，学名 Crex crex。
messages.en: Yes, both names refer to Crex crex.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用红色笔圈出 aħmar 作为词形提示，再把整个名称连到“长脚秧鸡”；红色只是学习标记，不据此推断鸟的外观。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird called the common moorhen, scientifically named Gallinula chloropus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指黑水鸡这一鸟种，学名为 Gallinula chloropus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Gallinula chloropus, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala common moorhen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑水鸡（学名：Gallinula chloropus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a common moorhen

formal.mt: Il-gwida tagħti l-isem xjentifiku Gallinula chloropus għall-gallozz iswed.
formal.en: The guide gives Gallinula chloropus as the scientific name of the common moorhen.
formal.zh: 这本指南将 Gallinula chloropus 列为黑水鸡的学名。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan gallozz iswed jew gallozz aħmar? Tom: Dan gallozz iswed; ara l-isem Gallinula chloropus taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this a common moorhen or a corncrake? Tom: It's a common moorhen; look at the name Gallinula chloropus below the photograph.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这是黑水鸡还是长脚秧鸡？Tom：这是黑水鸡；你看照片下面的学名 Gallinula chloropus。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan gallozz iswed jew gallozz aħmar?
messages.mt_standard: Dan gallozz iswed jew gallozz aħmar?
messages.zh: 这是黑水鸡还是长脚秧鸡？
messages.en: Is this a common moorhen or a corncrake?

messages.speaker: Tom (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan gallozz iswed; ara l-isem Gallinula chloropus taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Dan gallozz iswed; ara l-isem Gallinula chloropus taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 这是黑水鸡；你看照片下面的学名 Gallinula chloropus。
messages.en: It's a common moorhen; look at the name Gallinula chloropus below the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iswed 的“黑色”义与中文名“黑水鸡”的“黑”连起来记，同时保留完整名称，避免与 gallozz aħmar 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird called the purple swamphen, scientifically named Porphyrio porphyrio.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指紫水鸡这一鸟种，学名为 Porphyrio porphyrio。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Porphyrio porphyrio, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala purple swamphen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紫水鸡（学名：Porphyrio porphyrio）。

collocations.en: a picture of a purple swamphen

formal.mt: Il-materjal tat-tagħlim jidentifika l-gallozz prim bħala l-ispeċi Porphyrio porphyrio.
formal.en: The teaching material identifies the purple swamphen as the species Porphyrio porphyrio.
formal.zh: 这份教材将紫水鸡标明为 Porphyrio porphyrio 这一鸟种。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ngħid purple swamphen bil-Malti? Tom: Ngħidu gallozz prim; l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu huwa Porphyrio porphyrio.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I say purple swamphen in Maltese? Tom: We say gallozz prim; its scientific name is Porphyrio porphyrio.
colloquial.zh: Maja：紫水鸡用马耳他语怎么说？Tom：说 gallozz prim；它的学名是 Porphyrio porphyrio。

messages.speaker: Maja (语言学习者)
messages.zh: 紫水鸡用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say purple swamphen in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Tom (马耳他语教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħidu gallozz prim; l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu huwa Porphyrio porphyrio.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħidu gallozz prim; l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu huwa Porphyrio porphyrio.
messages.zh: 说 gallozz prim；它的学名是 Porphyrio porphyrio。
messages.en: We say gallozz prim; its scientific name is Porphyrio porphyrio.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在紫色学习卡上写“gallozz prim—紫水鸡—Porphyrio porphyrio”，借颜色和完整名称建立对应，不把 prim 单独解释成紫色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maltese name for Allen's gallinule, the bird species Porphyrio alleni.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类艾伦水鸡的马耳他语名称，指 Porphyrio alleni 这一物种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa xjentifikament bħala Porphyrio alleni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 艾伦水鸡，学名 Porphyrio alleni。

collocations.en: a photograph of an Allen's gallinule

formal.mt: Il-gwida tuża l-isem gallozz tal-Afrika għall-ispeċi Porphyrio alleni.
formal.en: The guide uses the name gallozz tal-Afrika for the species Porphyrio alleni.
formal.zh: 这本指南用 gallozz tal-Afrika 这一名称指称 Porphyrio alleni 这一物种。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Dan hu gallozz tal-Afrika; ara l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the bird in this photograph called? Pawlu: It's an Allen's gallinule; look at the name below the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这只鸟叫什么？保罗：这是艾伦水鸡，你看照片下面的名称。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What's the bird in this photograph called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu gallozz tal-Afrika; ara l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu gallozz tal-Afrika; ara l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 这是艾伦水鸡，你看照片下面的名称。
messages.en: It's an Allen's gallinule; look at the name below the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张配图词卡，把整个名称 gallozz tal-Afrika 与 Porphyrio alleni 配对；用 Afrika 的字形帮助区分相邻词条，不据此推断分布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maltese name for the purple gallinule, the bird species Porphyrio martinica.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类美洲紫水鸡的马耳他语名称，指 Porphyrio martinica 这一物种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa xjentifikament bħala Porphyrio martinica.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 美洲紫水鸡，学名 Porphyrio martinica。

collocations.en: a photograph of a purple gallinule
collocations.zh: 一张美洲紫水鸡的照片

collocations.en: the identification of the purple gallinule

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jagħti l-isem gallozz tal-Amerika lill-ispeċi Porphyrio martinica.
formal.en: The catalogue gives the name gallozz tal-Amerika to the species Porphyrio martinica.
formal.zh: 该目录将 Porphyrio martinica 这一物种列为 gallozz tal-Amerika。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ukoll gallozz tal-Afrika? Mark: Le, dan gallozz tal-Amerika; it-tikketta tgħid Porphyrio martinica.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this an Allen's gallinule too? Mark: No, this is a purple gallinule; the label says Porphyrio martinica.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这也是艾伦水鸡吗？马克：不是，这是美洲紫水鸡；标签上写着 Porphyrio martinica。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这也是艾伦水鸡吗？
messages.en: Is this an Allen's gallinule too?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan gallozz tal-Amerika; it-tikketta tgħid Porphyrio martinica.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan gallozz tal-Amerika; it-tikketta tgħid Porphyrio martinica.
messages.zh: 不是，这是美洲紫水鸡；标签上写着 Porphyrio martinica。
messages.en: No, this is a purple gallinule; the label says Porphyrio martinica.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gallozz tal-Amerika 整体写在美洲紫水鸡的词卡上，再与 tal-Afrika 那张并排复习；重点看清 Amerika，分别记住两个物种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maltese name for Baillon's crake, the bird species Zapornia pusilla, also called Porzana pusilla.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类姬田鸡的马耳他语名称，指 Zapornia pusilla，亦称 Porzana pusilla。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa xjentifikament bħala Zapornia pusilla, b'sinonimu Porzana pusilla.

sense_translations.en_definition: Baillon's crake (Zapornia pusilla, syn. Porzana pusilla)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 姬田鸡，学名 Zapornia pusilla，同物异名为 Porzana pusilla。

collocations.en: a photograph of a Baillon's crake
