formal.mt: Fl-indiċi, il-gallozz tal-faxxi jidher taħt Zapornia pusilla, u Porzana pusilla jingħata bħala sinonimu.
formal.en: In the index, Baillon's crake appears under Zapornia pusilla, and Porzana pusilla is given as a synonym.
formal.zh: 索引将姬田鸡列在 Zapornia pusilla 名下，并将 Porzana pusilla 列为同物异名。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm żewġ ismijiet xjentifiċi ħdejn gallozz tal-faxxi? David: It-tnejn jirreferu għall-istess speċi: Zapornia pusilla u Porzana pusilla.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are there two scientific names next to Baillon's crake? David: Both refer to the same species: Zapornia pusilla and Porzana pusilla.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么姬田鸡旁边有两个学名？戴维：两者指的是同一物种：Zapornia pusilla 和 Porzana pusilla。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm żewġ ismijiet xjentifiċi ħdejn gallozz tal-faxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm żewġ ismijiet xjentifiċi ħdejn gallozz tal-faxxi?
messages.zh: 为什么姬田鸡旁边有两个学名？
messages.en: Why are there two scientific names next to Baillon's crake?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tnejn jirreferu għall-istess speċi: Zapornia pusilla u Porzana pusilla.
messages.mt_standard: It-tnejn jirreferu għall-istess speċi: Zapornia pusilla u Porzana pusilla.
messages.zh: 两者指的是同一物种：Zapornia pusilla 和 Porzana pusilla。
messages.en: Both refer to the same species: Zapornia pusilla and Porzana pusilla.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 gallozz tal-faxxi 做一张双学名词卡：上写 Zapornia pusilla，下写 Porzana pusilla，中间只画一只鸟，提醒自己两名对应同一物种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maltese name for the striped crake, the bird species Aenigmatolimnas marginalis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类条纹田鸡的马耳他语名称，指 Aenigmatolimnas marginalis 这一物种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa xjentifikament bħala Aenigmatolimnas marginalis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 条纹田鸡，学名 Aenigmatolimnas marginalis。

collocations.en: a photograph of a striped crake
the identification of the striped crake

formal.mt: It-tikketta taħt l-istampa tagħti l-isem gallozz tal-istrixxi u l-isem xjentifiku Aenigmatolimnas marginalis.
formal.en: The label below the illustration gives the name gallozz tal-istrixxi and the scientific name Aenigmatolimnas marginalis.
formal.zh: 插图下方的标签标有 gallozz tal-istrixxi 这一名称及学名 Aenigmatolimnas marginalis。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema stampa turi l-gallozz tal-istrixxi? Ġanni: Din fuq il-lemin; l-isem xjentifiku taħtha hu Aenigmatolimnas marginalis.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which illustration shows the striped crake? Ġanni: This one on the right; the scientific name below it is Aenigmatolimnas marginalis.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：哪幅图画的是条纹田鸡？詹尼：右边这幅；下面的学名是 Aenigmatolimnas marginalis。

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.zh: 哪幅图画的是条纹田鸡？
messages.en: Which illustration shows the striped crake?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din fuq il-lemin; l-isem xjentifiku taħtha hu Aenigmatolimnas marginalis.
messages.mt_standard: Din fuq il-lemin; l-isem xjentifiku taħtha hu Aenigmatolimnas marginalis.
messages.zh: 右边这幅；下面的学名是 Aenigmatolimnas marginalis。
messages.en: This one on the right; the scientific name below it is Aenigmatolimnas marginalis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在条纹田鸡词卡的边框画几条平行线，作为 striped 的视觉提示，再朗读完整名称 gallozz tal-istrixxi；这是记忆图案，不是辨鸟依据。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maltese name for the spotted crake, the bird species Porzana porzana.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类斑胸田鸡的马耳他语名称，指 Porzana porzana 这一物种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa xjentifikament bħala Porzana porzana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斑胸田鸡，学名 Porzana porzana。

collocations.en: a photograph of a spotted crake
the identification of the spotted crake

formal.mt: L-istudent kiteb gallozz tat-tikek ħdejn l-isem xjentifiku Porzana porzana fit-tabella tiegħu.
formal.en: The student wrote gallozz tat-tikek beside the scientific name Porzana porzana in his table.
formal.zh: 这名学生在表格中的学名 Porzana porzana 旁写下了 gallozz tat-tikek。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Ktibt Porzana porzana darbtejn bi żball? Luqa: Le, hekk hu l-isem xjentifiku tal-gallozz tat-tikek.
colloquial.en: Emma: Did you write Porzana porzana twice by mistake? Luqa: No, that's the scientific name of the spotted crake.
colloquial.zh: 埃玛：你是不是不小心把 Porzana porzana 写重复了？卢卡：没有，斑胸田鸡的学名就是这样。

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ktibt Porzana porzana darbtejn bi żball?
messages.mt_standard: Ktibt Porzana porzana darbtejn bi żball?
messages.zh: 你是不是不小心把 Porzana porzana 写重复了？
messages.en: Did you write Porzana porzana twice by mistake?

messages.speaker: Luqa (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hekk hu l-isem xjentifiku tal-gallozz tat-tikek.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hekk hu l-isem xjentifiku tal-gallozz tat-tikek.
messages.zh: 没有，斑胸田鸡的学名就是这样。
messages.en: No, that's the scientific name of the spotted crake.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maltese name for the water rail, the bird species Rallus aquaticus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类普通秧鸡的马耳他语名称，指 Rallus aquaticus 这一物种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa xjentifikament bħala Rallus aquaticus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 普通秧鸡，学名 Rallus aquaticus。

collocations.en: a photograph of a water rail
the identification of the water rail

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-ismijiet, gallozz tax-xitwa jikkorrispondi għal water rail bl-Ingliż u għal Rallus aquaticus bħala isem xjentifiku.
formal.en: In the list of names, gallozz tax-xitwa corresponds to water rail in English and to Rallus aquaticus as the scientific name.
formal.zh: 在名称表中，gallozz tax-xitwa 对应的英文名为 water rail，学名为 Rallus aquaticus。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif ngħid gallozz tax-xitwa bl-Ingliż? Ben: Water rail; tista' tikteb ukoll Rallus aquaticus biex ikun ċar liema speċi hi.
colloquial.en: Marija: How do I say gallozz tax-xitwa in English? Ben: Water rail; you can also write Rallus aquaticus to make clear which species it is.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：gallozz tax-xitwa 用英语怎么说？本：Water rail；你也可以写上 Rallus aquaticus，明确指的是哪个物种。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: gallozz tax-xitwa 用英语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say gallozz tax-xitwa in English?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Water rail; tista' tikteb ukoll Rallus aquaticus biex ikun ċar liema speċi hi.
messages.mt_standard: Water rail; tista' tikteb ukoll Rallus aquaticus biex ikun ċar liema speċi hi.
messages.zh: Water rail；你也可以写上 Rallus aquaticus，明确指的是哪个物种。
messages.en: Water rail; you can also write Rallus aquaticus to make clear which species it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三面词卡连接 gallozz tax-xitwa、water rail 和普通秧鸡，翻卡时轮流说出另外两面；将 tax-xitwa 整段圈出，帮助区别其他 gallozz 名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maltese name for the little crake, the bird species Porzana parva.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类小田鸡的马耳他语名称，指 Porzana parva 这一物种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa xjentifikament bħala Porzana parva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小田鸡，学名 Porzana parva。

collocations.en: a photograph of a little crake
the identification of the little crake

formal.mt: F'din il-gwida, gallozz żgħir huwa l-isem tal-ispeċi Porzana parva.
formal.en: In this guide, gallozz żgħir is the name of the species Porzana parva.
formal.zh: 在这本指南中，gallozz żgħir 是 Porzana parva 这一物种的名称。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Gallozz żgħir hu isem ta' speċi? Toni: Iva, hawn jirreferi għal Porzana parva, little crake bl-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is gallozz żgħir a species name? Toni: Yes, here it refers to Porzana parva, the little crake in English.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：gallozz żgħir 是物种名称吗？托尼：是的，这里指 Porzana parva，英文叫 little crake。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Gallozz żgħir hu isem ta' speċi?
messages.mt_standard: Gallozz żgħir hu isem ta' speċi?
messages.zh: gallozz żgħir 是物种名称吗？
messages.en: Is gallozz żgħir a species name?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn jirreferi għal Porzana parva, little crake bl-Ingliż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn jirreferi għal Porzana parva, little crake bl-Ingliż.
messages.zh: 是的，这里指 Porzana parva，英文叫 little crake。
messages.en: Yes, here it refers to Porzana parva, the little crake in English.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gallozz żgħir、little crake 和小田鸡排成一行，下面补上 Porzana parva；整组当作物种名称记忆，避免仅凭鸟的大小套用这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A worker who coats metal with zinc.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事金属镀锌工作的工人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaddiem li jiksi l-metall b'saff ta' żingu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镀锌工，即从事金属镀锌工作的人。

collocations.zh: 一名经验丰富的镀锌工

formal.mt: Il-galvanajżer huwa responsabbli għall-kisi tal-partijiet tal-metall b'saff ta' żingu.
formal.en: The galvanizer is responsible for coating the metal parts with a layer of zinc.
formal.zh: 镀锌工负责在金属零件表面镀上一层锌。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lil min nista' nagħti dawn il-biċċiet tal-metall biex jinksew biż-żingu? Rita: Kellem lil Pawlu; hu galvanajżer b'esperjenza.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who can I give these metal pieces to for zinc coating? Rita: Talk to Pawlu; he's an experienced galvanizer.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些金属件可以交给谁来镀锌？丽塔：找保罗谈谈，他是个经验丰富的镀锌工。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nista' nagħti dawn il-biċċiet tal-metall biex jinksew biż-żingu?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nista' nagħti dawn il-biċċiet tal-metall biex jinksew biż-żingu?
messages.zh: 这些金属件可以交给谁来镀锌？
messages.en: Who can I give these metal pieces to for zinc coating?

messages.speaker: Rita (车间接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellem lil Pawlu; hu galvanajżer b'esperjenza.
messages.mt_standard: Kellem lil Pawlu; hu galvanajżer b'esperjenza.
messages.zh: 找保罗谈谈，他是个经验丰富的镀锌工。
messages.en: Talk to Pawlu; he's an experienced galvanizer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一名工人给金属件穿上薄薄的锌外衣，同时朗读 galvanajżer；把人物、动作和镀锌工三个信息连在一起记住。

gloss_zh: 原电的；与电流的化学作用有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to electric current produced by chemical action or to the chemical effects of electric current.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述由化学作用产生的电流，或与电流引起的化学作用有关的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' kurrent elettriku prodott minn azzjoni kimika jew mal-effetti kimiċi tal-kurrent elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原电的；与化学作用产生的电流或电流的化学作用有关的

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-istudenti spjegaw kif l-azzjoni kimika pproduċiet kurrent galvaniku.
formal.en: In the report, the students explained how chemical action produced a galvanic current.
formal.zh: 学生们在报告中解释了化学作用如何产生原电流。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser kurrent galvaniku? Pawlu: Hawnhekk ifisser kurrent elettriku li jiġi minn reazzjoni kimika.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does galvanic current mean? Pawlu: Here it means an electric current that comes from a chemical reaction.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：原电流是什么意思？保罗：这里指由化学反应产生的电流。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 原电流是什么意思？
messages.en: What does galvanic current mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ifisser kurrent elettriku li jiġi minn reazzjoni kimika.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ifisser kurrent elettriku li jiġi minn reazzjoni kimika.
messages.zh: 这里指由化学反应产生的电流。
messages.en: Here it means an electric current that comes from a chemical reaction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 galvaniku 放进“化学反应让电流流动”的画面中，并搭配 kurrent 一起记，提醒自己这是描述性质的形容词。

gloss_zh: 镀锌工；从事金属镀锌的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who coats metal with zinc to help protect it from corrosion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给金属表面覆上锌层，以帮助防止腐蚀的工作人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiksi l-metall b'saff taż-żingu biex tgħin tipproteġih mill-korrużjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镀锌工；给金属表面镀上保护性锌层的人

formal.mt: Il-galvanist eżamina l-wiċċ tal-metall qabel beda l-proċess tal-kisi biż-żingu.
formal.en: The galvanizer examined the metal surface before beginning the zinc-coating process.
formal.zh: 镀锌工在开始镀锌工序前检查了金属表面。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min se jiksi dawn il-biċċiet biż-żingu? Rita: Il-galvanist se jieħu ħsiebhom għada.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is going to coat these pieces with zinc? Rita: The galvanizer will take care of them tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁来给这些零件镀锌？丽塔：镀锌工明天会处理。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jiksi dawn il-biċċiet biż-żingu?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jiksi dawn il-biċċiet biż-żingu?
messages.zh: 谁来给这些零件镀锌？
messages.en: Who is going to coat these pieces with zinc?

messages.speaker: Rita (车间主管)
messages.zh: 镀锌工明天会处理。
messages.en: The galvanizer will take care of them tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 galvanist 想成车间里负责给金属穿上“锌外衣”的工人；用具体人物来记住本条的职业含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or device that applies a protective coating of zinc to metal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给金属覆上保护性锌层的人或设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew apparat li jiksi l-metall b'saff protettiv taż-żingu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镀锌者；给金属覆上锌层的设备

formal.mt: Il-fabbrika tuża galvanizzatur awtomatiku biex tiksi l-komponenti tal-metall b'saff protettiv taż-żingu.
formal.en: The factory uses an automatic galvanizer to coat metal components with a protective layer of zinc.
formal.zh: 这家工厂使用自动镀锌设备，为金属部件覆上保护性锌层。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għal xiex jintuża dan il-galvanizzatur? Samwel: Biex il-biċċiet tal-metall jinksew biż-żingu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is this galvanizer used for? Samwel: For coating the metal pieces with zinc.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这台镀锌设备是做什么用的？萨姆韦尔：用来给金属零件镀锌。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.zh: 这台镀锌设备是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this galvanizer used for?

messages.speaker: Samwel (技术员)
messages.zh: 用来给金属零件镀锌。
messages.en: For coating the metal pieces with zinc.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“一台给零件镀锌的机器”记住 galvanizzatur 的设备用法，再记它也可指做这项工作的人；本条对话选用机器场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of coating metal with zinc to help protect it from corrosion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在金属表面覆上锌层，以帮助防止腐蚀的处理过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-metall jinkesa b'saff taż-żingu biex ikun protett mill-korrużjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镀锌；在金属表面形成保护性锌层的工艺

formal.mt: L-ispeċifikazzjoni titlob il-galvanizzazzjoni tal-partijiet tal-azzar biex jitnaqqas ir-riskju ta' korrużjoni.
formal.en: The specification requires galvanization of the steel parts to reduce the risk of corrosion.
formal.zh: 技术规范要求对钢制零件进行镀锌处理，以降低腐蚀风险。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex għażilt il-galvanizzazzjoni għal dan il-grada? Rita: Għax is-saff taż-żingu jgħin jipproteġi l-metall mis-sadid.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you choose galvanization for this gate? Rita: Because the zinc layer helps protect the metal from rust.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么选择给这扇大门镀锌？丽塔：因为锌层有助于保护金属，防止生锈。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għażilt il-galvanizzazzjoni għal dan il-grada?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għażilt il-galvanizzazzjoni għal dan il-grada?
messages.zh: 你为什么选择给这扇大门镀锌？
messages.en: Why did you choose galvanization for this gate?

messages.speaker: Rita (金属工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax is-saff taż-żingu jgħin jipproteġi l-metall mis-sadid.
messages.mt_standard: Għax is-saff taż-żingu jgħin jipproteġi l-metall mis-sadid.
messages.zh: 因为锌层有助于保护金属，防止生锈。
messages.en: Because the zinc layer helps protect the metal from rust.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 galvanizzazzjoni 记成“给金属穿锌外衣的整个过程”，再与 galvanizzatur 所指的执行者或设备配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Electricity produced by chemical action, or the effects produced by such electricity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由化学作用产生的电，以及这种电所产生的作用或现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Elettriku prodott minn azzjoni kimika, jew l-effetti li jipproduċi dan l-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原电现象；由化学作用产生电及其相关效应

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni dwar il-galvaniżmu spjegat ir-rabta bejn l-azzjoni kimika u l-produzzjoni ta' kurrent elettriku.
formal.en: The lesson on galvanism explained the connection between chemical action and the production of electric current.
formal.zh: 关于原电现象的课程解释了化学作用与电流产生之间的联系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-galvaniżmu għandu x'jaqsam mal-kimika? Toni: Iva, qed nitkellmu dwar elettriku prodott minn azzjoni kimika.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does galvanism have something to do with chemistry? Toni: Yes, we are talking about electricity produced by chemical action.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：原电现象和化学有关吗？托尼：有，我们说的是由化学作用产生的电。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 原电现象和化学有关吗？
messages.en: Does galvanism have something to do with chemistry?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed nitkellmu dwar elettriku prodott minn azzjoni kimika.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed nitkellmu dwar elettriku prodott minn azzjoni kimika.
messages.zh: 有，我们说的是由化学作用产生的电。
messages.en: Yes, we are talking about electricity produced by chemical action.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“化学作用产生电，电再产生效应”这条画面链记 galvaniżmu；它指现象和作用，可与描述性质的 galvaniku 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A technique for making printing plates by electrically depositing metal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用电沉积金属的方法制作印刷版的技术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Teknika għall-produzzjoni ta' pjanċi tal-istampar permezz tad-depożizzjoni elettrika tal-metall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电铸制版术；利用金属电沉积制作印刷版的技术

collocations.zh: 用电铸制版法制作的印刷版

formal.mt: Il-manwal jiddeskrivi kif il-galvanografija tuża d-depożizzjoni elettrika tal-metall biex tipproduċi pjanċa għall-istampar.
formal.en: The manual describes how galvanography uses electrical metal deposition to produce a printing plate.
formal.zh: 手册介绍了电铸制版术如何利用金属电沉积制作印刷版。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-pjanċa saret bil-galvanografija? Pawlu: Iva, il-metall ġie ddepożitat bl-elettriku biex jifforma l-pjanċa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was this plate made by galvanography? Pawlu: Yes, the metal was deposited electrically to form the plate.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块印刷版是用电铸制版法做的吗？保罗：是的，金属通过电沉积形成了这块版。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这块印刷版是用电铸制版法做的吗？
messages.en: Was this plate made by galvanography?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (印刷技术老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-metall ġie ddepożitat bl-elettriku biex jifforma l-pjanċa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-metall ġie ddepożitat bl-elettriku biex jifforma l-pjanċa.
messages.zh: 是的，金属通过电沉积形成了这块版。
messages.en: Yes, the metal was deposited electrically to form the plate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电流让金属逐渐沉积，最后形成一块能印图文的版，用“电流—金属—印刷版”三个画面记 galvanografija。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The scientific study of electricity produced by chemical action and its effects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究由化学作用产生的电及其效应的学科。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju xjentifiku tal-elettriku prodott minn azzjoni kimika u tal-effetti tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原电学；研究原电现象及其效应的学科

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu dwar il-galvanoloġija jispjega kif jiġu studjati l-produzzjoni kimika tal-elettriku u l-effetti tiegħu.
formal.en: The chapter on galvanology explains how the chemical production of electricity and its effects are studied.
formal.zh: 关于原电学的章节介绍了如何研究化学作用产生电的过程及其效应。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tistudja l-galvanoloġija? Toni: Tistudja l-elettriku li jiġi minn azzjoni kimika u l-effetti tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does galvanology study? Toni: It studies electricity that comes from chemical action and its effects.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：原电学研究什么？托尼：它研究由化学作用产生的电及其效应。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 原电学研究什么？
messages.en: What does galvanology study?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tistudja l-elettriku li jiġi minn azzjoni kimika u l-effetti tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Tistudja l-elettriku li jiġi minn azzjoni kimika u l-effetti tiegħu.
messages.zh: 它研究由化学作用产生的电及其效应。
messages.en: It studies electricity that comes from chemical action and its effects.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 galvanoloġija 放在“研究原电现象的课堂”里记忆：galvaniżmu 是研究对象，galvanoloġija 是研究这类现象的学科。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sensitive instrument used to detect or measure small electric currents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于检测或测量微小电流的灵敏仪器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument sensittiv li jintuża biex jinduna b'kurrenti elettriċi żgħar jew ikejjilhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 检流计；用于检测或测量微小电流的仪器

formal.mt: L-istudenti użaw galvanometru sensittiv biex jindunaw b'kurrent elettriku żgħir fiċ-ċirkwit.
formal.en: The students used a sensitive galvanometer to detect a small electric current in the circuit.
formal.zh: 学生们使用灵敏的检流计检测电路中的微小电流。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-labra tal-galvanometru ċċaqalqet! Samwel: Iva, dan juri li hemm kurrent fiċ-ċirkwit.
colloquial.en: Nina: The galvanometer needle moved! Samwel: Yes, that shows there is a current in the circuit.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：检流计的指针动了！萨姆韦尔：对，这说明电路中有电流。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 检流计的指针动了！
messages.en: The galvanometer needle moved!

messages.speaker: Samwel (实验老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan juri li hemm kurrent fiċ-ċirkwit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan juri li hemm kurrent fiċ-ċirkwit.
messages.zh: 对，这说明电路中有电流。
messages.en: Yes, that shows there is a current in the circuit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象微小电流经过，检流计的细指针轻轻偏转；把 galvanometru 与“微电流、细指针、检测仪器”三个提示一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A process of forming a metal object or reproducing a shape by depositing metal onto a mould using an electric current.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用电流使金属沉积在模具表面，以形成金属制品或复制形状的工艺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess li juża kurrent elettriku biex jiddepożita metall fuq forma u joħloq oġġett jew kopja tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电铸；通过电解沉积金属来复制形状或制成金属物件的工艺。

formal.mt: Fil-laboratorju, intużat il-galvanoplastika biex tinħoloq kopja tal-metall tal-mudell.
formal.en: In the laboratory, galvanoplasty was used to create a metal copy of the model.
formal.zh: 实验室采用电铸法制作了模型的金属复制品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għamilt din il-kopja tal-metall? Mark: Użajt il-galvanoplastika; il-metall inbena fuq il-forma bl-għajnuna tal-kurrent elettriku.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you make this metal copy? Mark: I used galvanoplasty; the metal built up on the mould with the help of an electric current.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么做出这个金属复制品的？马克：我用了电铸法，让金属借助电流沉积在模具上。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 你怎么做出这个金属复制品的？
messages.en: How did you make this metal copy?

messages.speaker: Mark (实验员)
messages.mt_spoken: Użajt il-galvanoplastika; il-metall inbena fuq il-forma bl-għajnuna tal-kurrent elettriku.
messages.mt_standard: Użajt il-galvanoplastika; il-metall inbena fuq il-forma bl-għajnuna tal-kurrent elettriku.
messages.zh: 我用了电铸法，让金属借助电流沉积在模具上。
messages.en: I used galvanoplasty; the metal built up on the mould with the help of an electric current.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象模具放进溶液，通电后金属一层层长成复制品，用这幅画面记住“电铸”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument that detects the presence of an electric current without necessarily measuring its strength.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于检测是否有电流通过的仪器，不一定测量电流的具体大小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument li juri jekk ikunx għaddej kurrent elettriku, mingħajr ma bilfors ikejjel il-qawwa tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 验电流器；用于指示电流是否存在的仪器。

formal.mt: Il-galvanoskopju ntuża biex juri jekk kienx għaddej kurrent elettriku fiċ-ċirkwit.
formal.en: The galvanoscope was used to indicate whether an electric current was flowing through the circuit.
formal.zh: 实验使用验电流器来判断电路中是否有电流通过。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-labra tal-galvanoskopju ċċaqalqet! Pawlu: Mela hemm kurrent għaddej fiċ-ċirkwit.
colloquial.en: Lara: The galvanoscope's needle moved! Pawlu: Then there is a current flowing through the circuit.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：验电流器的指针动了！保罗：那就说明电路里有电流通过。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 验电流器的指针动了！
messages.en: The galvanoscope's needle moved!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 那就说明电路里有电流通过。
messages.en: Then there is a current flowing through the circuit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它想成电流的“有无指示灯”：先记是否通电，再与测量具体数值的仪器区分。

gloss_zh: 绊人动作；策略性招法；弃子开局

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of making someone stumble by obstructing their legs; also a strategic move intended to gain an advantage, including a gambit in chess.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用腿脚阻挡别人、使其绊倒的动作；也指为取得优势而采取的策略性招法，包括国际象棋中的弃子开局。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Azzjoni li biha wieħed ifixkel saqajn persuna biex iwaqqagħha; ukoll mossa strateġika biex jinkiseb vantaġġ, bħal gambit fiċ-ċess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绊人；用腿脚阻挡他人，使其失去平衡或跌倒的动作。
为取得优势而采取的策略性招法；国际象棋中也指主动提供弃子机会以换取局面优势的开局。

collocations.zh: 国际象棋中的弃子开局

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tal-partita, l-għalliem spjega kif gambetta fiċ-ċess tista' tagħti vantaġġ fil-pożizzjoni.
formal.en: In the analysis of the game, the teacher explained how a gambit in chess can provide a positional advantage.
formal.zh: 在棋局分析中，老师解释了国际象棋中的弃子开局如何带来局面优势。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex waqa' Mark? Lara: Xi ħadd għamillu gambetta waqt il-logħba.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Mark fall? Lara: Someone tripped him during the game.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克为什么摔倒了？拉拉：有人在游戏时绊了他一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么摔倒了？
messages.en: Why did Mark fall?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd għamillu gambetta waqt il-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd għamillu gambetta waqt il-logħba.
messages.zh: 有人在游戏时绊了他一下。
messages.en: Someone tripped him during the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景分别记忆：操场上伸脚绊人，棋盘上用策略争取优势；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Gambia, a country in West Africa whose official name in Maltese is Repubblika tal-Gambja.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 冈比亚，位于西非的国家，马耳他语正式国名为 Repubblika tal-Gambja，即冈比亚共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa Repubblika tal-Gambja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Gambia (a country in West Africa; official name: Repubblika tal-Gambja)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 冈比亚，西非国家；正式名称为冈比亚共和国，马耳他语为 Repubblika tal-Gambja。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi taqsima dwar il-Gambja, pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent.
formal.en: The report includes a section on the Gambia, a country in West Africa.
formal.zh: 报告包含一个介绍西非国家冈比亚的章节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema pajjiż għażilt għall-proġett? Mark: Għażilt il-Gambja, fl-Afrika tal-Punent.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which country did you choose for the project? Mark: I chose the Gambia, in West Africa.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为这个课题选了哪个国家？马克：我选了西非的冈比亚。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你为这个课题选了哪个国家？
messages.en: Which country did you choose for the project?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我选了西非的冈比亚。
messages.en: I chose the Gambia, in West Africa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在西非地图卡片上把 Gambja 与“冈比亚”配对，特别留意拼写中的 mbj，避免与 Gana 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ghana, a country in West Africa whose official name in Maltese is Repubblika tal-Gana.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加纳，位于西非的国家，马耳他语正式国名为 Repubblika tal-Gana，即加纳共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa Repubblika tal-Gana.

sense_translations.en_definition: Ghana (a country in West Africa; official name: Repubblika tal-Gana)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 加纳，西非国家；正式名称为加纳共和国，马耳他语为 Repubblika tal-Gana。

formal.mt: Il-preżentazzjoni tintroduċi l-Gana bħala pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent.
formal.en: The presentation introduces Ghana as a country in West Africa.
formal.zh: 这份演示介绍了位于西非的国家加纳。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn tinsab il-Gana? Pawlu: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent; nistgħu nsibuha fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is Ghana? Pawlu: In West Africa; we can find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：加纳在哪里？保罗：在西非；我们可以在地图上找到它。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 加纳在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Ghana?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent; nistgħu nsibuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent; nistgħu nsibuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在西非；我们可以在地图上找到它。
messages.en: In West Africa; we can find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作三语卡片“Gana—Ghana—加纳”，记住马耳他语拼写没有英语国名中的 h，并配上西非地图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of people who spend time together or act together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常一起活动或共同做事的一群人，可指一伙伙伴或同伴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies li jqattgħu l-ħin flimkien jew jagħmlu xi ħaġa flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一伙人；结伴活动的一群人或伙伴。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, gang ta' ħbieb jiltaqa' kull ġimgħa biex jippjana attivitajiet flimkien.
formal.en: In the story, a gang of friends meets every week to plan activities together.
formal.zh: 故事里，一群朋友每周见面，一起安排活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tiġi magħna llejla? Lara: Iva, irrid niltaqa' mal-gang kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you coming with us tonight? Lara: Yes, I want to meet up with the whole gang.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今晚跟我们一起去吗？拉拉：去，我想和大家聚一聚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今晚跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Are you coming with us tonight?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 去，我想和大家聚一聚。
messages.en: Yes, I want to meet up with the whole gang.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张朋友合照，把 gang 记成“一伙伙伴”；本条强调一起活动的人群，不必联想到犯罪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small fastening fitted to a window to hold it closed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安装在窗户上，用来扣住窗扇、使窗户保持关闭的小型装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira mwaħħla ma' tieqa biex iżżommha magħluqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 窗闩；窗扣，用于扣紧窗户的小型闭合装置。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, instab li l-ganġetta tat-tieqa kienet miksura u kellha tinbidel.
formal.en: During the inspection, the window latch was found to be broken and needed replacing.
formal.zh: 检查时发现窗闩已经损坏，需要更换。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex it-tieqa ma tingħalaqx sew? Mark: Il-ganġetta miksura; irridu nibdluha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why won't the window close properly? Mark: The latch is broken; we need to replace it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：窗户怎么关不严？马克：窗扣坏了，我们得换一个。

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.zh: 窗户怎么关不严？
messages.en: Why won't the window close properly?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修工)
messages.zh: 窗扣坏了，我们得换一个。
messages.en: The latch is broken; we need to replace it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象关窗后还要扣上一个小扣件，把“ganġetta”和最后扣紧窗户的动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To propel an object through the air by releasing it with force, usually from the hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常用手施力后放开物体，使其在空中移动，即扔或投掷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitfa' oġġett fl-arja b'ċerta saħħa, normalment b'idu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扔；投掷，用力将物体抛出去。
锦标赛；由多名选手或多支队伍参加、通过一系列比赛决出胜者的赛事。

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, il-plejer gara l-ballun lejn sieħbu.
formal.en: During training, the player threw the ball towards his teammate.
formal.zh: 训练时，球员把球扔向了队友。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Se tieħu sehem fil-gara taċ-ċess nhar is-Sibt? Nina: Iva, u diġà qed nitħarreġ.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you taking part in the chess tournament on Saturday? Nina: Yes, and I'm already practising.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你要参加星期六的国际象棋锦标赛吗？妮娜：要，我已经在练习了。

messages.speaker: Mark (棋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tieħu sehem fil-gara taċ-ċess nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Se tieħu sehem fil-gara taċ-ċess nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 你要参加星期六的国际象棋锦标赛吗？
messages.en: Are you taking part in the chess tournament on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Nina (棋友)
messages.zh: 要，我已经在练习了。
messages.en: Yes, and I'm already practising.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两张卡记同形词：gara l-ballun 是“他扔了球”，gara taċ-ċess 是“象棋锦标赛”，用句中位置区分动词和名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a loud, deep animal cry, especially to bellow like cattle or roar like a lion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出响亮而低沉的动物叫声，尤指牛的哞叫或狮子的咆哮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel għajta qawwija u profonda, speċjalment bħal barri jew iljun.

sense_translations.en_definition: to bellow (used especially of bovine animals)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 哞叫；发出低沉响亮的叫声，尤用于牛类动物。
吼叫，咆哮，如狮子发出的叫声。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-iljun gargar bil-qawwa u l-annimali l-oħra waqfu jiċċaqilqu.
formal.en: In the story, the lion roared loudly and the other animals stopped moving.
formal.zh: 故事中，狮子大声咆哮，其他动物都停止了走动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien dak il-ħoss qawwi mir-razzett? Pawlu: Il-barri gargar; smajtu anki minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that loud sound from the farm? Pawlu: The bull bellowed; I heard it even from here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：农场那边刚才那么响的是什么声音？保罗：公牛叫了一声，我在这里都听见了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 农场那边刚才那么响的是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that loud sound from the farm?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-barri gargar; smajtu anki minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Il-barri gargar; smajtu anki minn hawn.
messages.zh: 公牛叫了一声，我在这里都听见了。
messages.en: The bull bellowed; I heard it even from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gargar 当作一张配音练习卡：看到公牛就配低沉哞叫，看到狮子就配响亮咆哮；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of rinsing the throat by holding liquid at the back of the mouth and passing air through it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将液体含在口腔后部，让气流通过液体以冲洗咽喉的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tlaħliħ tal-gerżuma b'likwidu li jinżamm fuq wara tal-ħalq waqt li tgħaddi l-arja minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漱喉，含漱，即含住液体并让气流通过，以冲洗咽喉。

formal.mt: Il-manwal jiddeskrivi l-gargariżmu bħala tlaħliħ tal-gerżuma b'likwidu.
formal.en: The manual describes a gargle as rinsing the throat with liquid.
formal.zh: 手册将漱喉描述为用液体冲洗咽喉的动作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ħadt tazza ilma fil-kamra tal-banju? Toni: Beħsiebni nagħmel gargariżmu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you take a glass of water into the bathroom? Toni: I'm going to have a gargle.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么拿了一杯水进浴室？托尼：我打算漱一下喉咙。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħadt tazza ilma fil-kamra tal-banju?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħadt tazza ilma fil-kamra tal-banju?
messages.zh: 你为什么拿了一杯水进浴室？
messages.en: Why did you take a glass of water into the bathroom?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 我打算漱一下喉咙。
messages.en: I'm going to have a gargle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gargariżmu 配上一杯水和漱喉时的咕噜声画面，并整组记住 tagħmel gargariżmu，帮助掌握名词与动作搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An animal sound: the bellowing of cattle or the cooing of pigeons, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种动物叫声，依语境可指牛的低沉吼叫声，也可指鸽子的咕咕声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss qawwi ta' barri jew ħoss artab ta' ħamiem, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哞叫声；牛等动物发出的低沉而响亮的吼叫声。
咕咕声，如鸽子发出的轻柔叫声。

formal.mt: Ir-reġistrazzjoni tinkludi l-gargur tal-baqar u l-gargur tal-ħamiem, u turi żewġ ħsejjes differenti.
formal.en: The recording includes the bellowing of cattle and the cooing of pigeons, illustrating two different sounds.
formal.zh: 录音包含牛的哞叫声和鸽子的咕咕声，展示了两种不同的声音。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak il-gargur ġej mill-ħamiem? Ben: Iva, il-ħamiem qiegħed fuq il-bejt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is that cooing coming from the pigeons? Ben: Yes, the pigeons are on the roof.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那阵咕咕声是鸽子发出的吗？本：是的，鸽子在屋顶上。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 那阵咕咕声是鸽子发出的吗？
messages.en: Is that cooing coming from the pigeons?

messages.speaker: Ben (邻居)
messages.zh: 是的，鸽子在屋顶上。
messages.en: Yes, the pigeons are on the roof.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 gargur 制作一张双面声音卡：一面画牛并写哞叫声，一面画鸽子并写咕咕声，提醒自己依动物和语境选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Yelkouan shearwater, a seabird of the species Puffinus yelkouan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地中海鹱，一种海鸟，学名为 Puffinus yelkouan。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-baħar tal-ispeċi Puffinus yelkouan, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala Yelkouan shearwater.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地中海鹱，学名 Puffinus yelkouan，属于海鸟。

collocations.en: a photograph of a Yelkouan shearwater

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi ritratt tal-garnija flimkien mal-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Puffinus yelkouan.
formal.en: The report includes a photograph of the Yelkouan shearwater together with its scientific name, Puffinus yelkouan.
formal.zh: 报告附有地中海鹱的照片，并列出了其学名 Puffinus yelkouan。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fil-gwida? Mark: Jismu garnija; l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu hu Puffinus yelkouan.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this bird in the guide called? Mark: It's called a Yelkouan shearwater; its scientific name is Puffinus yelkouan.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图鉴里的这种鸟叫什么？马克：叫地中海鹱，学名是 Puffinus yelkouan。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 图鉴里的这种鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the guide called?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Jismu garnija; l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu hu Puffinus yelkouan.
messages.mt_standard: Jismu garnija; l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu hu Puffinus yelkouan.
messages.zh: 叫地中海鹱，学名是 Puffinus yelkouan。
messages.en: It's called a Yelkouan shearwater; its scientific name is Puffinus yelkouan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 garnija、地中海鹱和 Puffinus yelkouan 写在同一张鸟类图片卡上，三项一起复习，记住这里指的是具体物种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sooty shearwater, a seabird of the species Ardenna grisea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 灰鹱，一种海鸟，学名为 Ardenna grisea。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-baħar tal-ispeċi Ardenna grisea, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala sooty shearwater.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灰鹱，学名 Ardenna grisea，英文名为 sooty shearwater。

collocations.en: a photograph of a sooty shearwater
the identification of the sooty shearwater

formal.mt: Il-katalgu juri l-garnija sewda taħt l-isem xjentifiku Ardenna grisea u jagħti l-isem tagħha bl-Ingliż.
formal.en: The catalogue presents the sooty shearwater under the scientific name Ardenna grisea and gives its English name.
formal.zh: 目录以学名 Ardenna grisea 收录灰鹱，并提供了它的英文名称。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ngħid 'garnija sewda' bl-Ingliż? Pawlu: Ngħidu 'sooty shearwater'; hawn fil-gwida hemm ukoll Ardenna grisea.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do I say 'garnija sewda' in English? Pawlu: We say 'sooty shearwater'; the guide also lists Ardenna grisea here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：garnija sewda 用英语怎么说？保罗：说 sooty shearwater；图鉴这里还列出了 Ardenna grisea。

messages.speaker: Lara (语言学习者)
messages.zh: garnija sewda 用英语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say 'garnija sewda' in English?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学习同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħidu 'sooty shearwater'; hawn fil-gwida hemm ukoll Ardenna grisea.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħidu 'sooty shearwater'; hawn fil-gwida hemm ukoll Ardenna grisea.
messages.zh: 说 sooty shearwater；图鉴这里还列出了 Ardenna grisea。
messages.en: We say 'sooty shearwater'; the guide also lists Ardenna grisea here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 garnija sewda 作为完整鸟名记忆，与灰鹱、sooty shearwater 和 Ardenna grisea 连成一组，避免把中文名称机械直译。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Manx shearwater, a seabird of the species Puffinus puffinus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 普通鹱，一种海鸟，学名为 Puffinus puffinus，英文名为 Manx shearwater。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-baħar tal-ispeċi Puffinus puffinus, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala Manx shearwater.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 普通鹱，学名 Puffinus puffinus，英文名为 Manx shearwater。

collocations.en: a photograph of a Manx shearwater

formal.mt: Il-folja ta' tagħrif tagħti tliet ismijiet għall-istess speċi: garnija tal-Atlantiku, Manx shearwater u Puffinus puffinus.
formal.en: The information sheet gives three names for the same species: garnija tal-Atlantiku, Manx shearwater and Puffinus puffinus.
formal.zh: 资料页列出了同一物种的三个名称：马耳他语 garnija tal-Atlantiku、英语 Manx shearwater，以及学名 Puffinus puffinus。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din it-tikketta tgħid 'Manx shearwater'. X'inhu l-isem bil-Malti? Toni: Garnija tal-Atlantiku; tista' tqabbel ukoll l-isem xjentifiku, Puffinus puffinus.
colloquial.en: Nina: This label says 'Manx shearwater'. What is the Maltese name? Toni: Garnija tal-Atlantiku; you can also compare the scientific name, Puffinus puffinus.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个标签写着 Manx shearwater，马耳他语名称是什么？托尼：Garnija tal-Atlantiku；你也可以核对学名 Puffinus puffinus。

messages.speaker: Nina (博物馆参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tikketta tgħid 'Manx shearwater'. X'inhu l-isem bil-Malti?
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tikketta tgħid 'Manx shearwater'. X'inhu l-isem bil-Malti?
messages.zh: 这个标签写着 Manx shearwater，马耳他语名称是什么？
messages.en: This label says 'Manx shearwater'. What is the Maltese name?

messages.speaker: Toni (参观同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Garnija tal-Atlantiku; tista' tqabbel ukoll l-isem xjentifiku, Puffinus puffinus.
messages.mt_standard: Garnija tal-Atlantiku; tista' tqabbel ukoll l-isem xjentifiku, Puffinus puffinus.
messages.zh: Garnija tal-Atlantiku；你也可以核对学名 Puffinus puffinus。
messages.en: Garnija tal-Atlantiku; you can also compare the scientific name, Puffinus puffinus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用学名中重复的 Puffinus puffinus 作记忆锚点，把 garnija tal-Atlantiku、Manx shearwater 和普通鹱固定配对，整组辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Balearic shearwater, a seabird of the species Puffinus mauretanicus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 巴利阿里鹱，一种海鸟，学名为 Puffinus mauretanicus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-baħar tal-ispeċi Puffinus mauretanicus, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala Balearic shearwater.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴利阿里鹱，学名 Puffinus mauretanicus，英文名为 Balearic shearwater。

collocations.en: the identification of the Balearic shearwater
a photograph of a Balearic shearwater
collocations.zh: 一张巴利阿里鹱的照片

formal.mt: Fit-tabella tal-ispeċi, il-garnija tal-Baleariku tidher bl-isem xjentifiku Puffinus mauretanicus u bl-isem Ingliż Balearic shearwater.
formal.en: In the species table, the Balearic shearwater appears with the scientific name Puffinus mauretanicus and the English name Balearic shearwater.
formal.zh: 物种表列出了巴利阿里鹱的学名 Puffinus mauretanicus，以及英文名 Balearic shearwater。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Sibt 'garnija tal-Baleariku' fl-indiċi. Liema isem Ingliż għandi nfittex? Ben: Fittex 'Balearic shearwater', u qabbel l-isem xjentifiku Puffinus mauretanicus.
colloquial.en: Sara: I found 'garnija tal-Baleariku' in the index. Which English name should I look for? Ben: Look for 'Balearic shearwater' and check the scientific name Puffinus mauretanicus.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我在索引里找到了 garnija tal-Baleariku，应该查哪个英文名称？本：查 Balearic shearwater，再核对学名 Puffinus mauretanicus。

messages.speaker: Sara (观鸟初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt 'garnija tal-Baleariku' fl-indiċi. Liema isem Ingliż għandi nfittex?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt 'garnija tal-Baleariku' fl-indiċi. Liema isem Ingliż għandi nfittex?
messages.zh: 我在索引里找到了 garnija tal-Baleariku，应该查哪个英文名称？
messages.en: I found 'garnija tal-Baleariku' in the index. Which English name should I look for?

messages.speaker: Ben (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Fittex 'Balearic shearwater', u qabbel l-isem xjentifiku Puffinus mauretanicus.
messages.mt_standard: Fittex 'Balearic shearwater', u qabbel l-isem xjentifiku Puffinus mauretanicus.
messages.zh: 查 Balearic shearwater，再核对学名 Puffinus mauretanicus。
messages.en: Look for 'Balearic shearwater' and check the scientific name Puffinus mauretanicus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Baleariku、Balearic 和巴利阿里并排写成三语提示，再附上 Puffinus mauretanicus，帮助完整记住这一物种的对应名称。

gloss_zh: 爱抱怨的人；牢骚不断的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who frequently complains or grumbles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常抱怨或发牢骚的人，强调一种反复出现的行为习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li spiss tilmenta jew tgerger.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who complains or grumbles a lot
sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常抱怨或发牢骚的人。

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-ġar huwa deskritt bħala garraj li dejjem isib xi ħaġa fuq xiex jilmenta.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbour is described as a grumbler who always finds something to complain about.
formal.zh: 故事把这位邻居描写成一个爱发牢骚的人，总能找到事情来抱怨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu reġa' lmenta dwar il-kafè. Rita: Kemm hu garraj! Ilbieraħ ilmenta dwar it-te wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu complained about the coffee again. Rita: What a grumbler! Yesterday he complained about the tea too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗又抱怨咖啡了。丽塔：他可真爱发牢骚！昨天他还抱怨茶呢。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗又抱怨咖啡了。
messages.en: Pawlu complained about the coffee again.

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu garraj! Ilbieraħ ilmenta dwar it-te wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu garraj! Ilbieraħ ilmenta dwar it-te wkoll.
messages.zh: 他可真爱发牢骚！昨天他还抱怨茶呢。
messages.en: What a grumbler! Yesterday he complained about the tea too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个每天对咖啡和茶都挑毛病的人，把 garraj 与“牢骚不断的人”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A breathing organ through which a fish or another aquatic animal takes oxygen from water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鱼等水生动物从水中获取氧气的呼吸器官。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organu li bih ħuta jew annimal ieħor tal-ilma jieħu l-ossiġnu mill-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鳃，鱼等动物从水中获取氧气的器官。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi kif l-ilma jgħaddi minn fuq il-garġa tal-ħuta waqt it-teħid tan-nifs.
formal.en: The diagram shows how water passes over the fish's gill during breathing.
formal.zh: 这幅示意图展示了鱼呼吸时水如何流过鳃。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi din il-parti tal-ħuta fl-istampa? Mark: Dik garġa; tgħin lill-ħuta tieħu n-nifs fl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this part of the fish in the picture? Mark: That's a gill; it helps the fish breathe in water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图片里鱼的这个部位是什么？马克：那是鳃，帮助鱼在水里呼吸。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里鱼的这个部位是什么？
messages.en: What is this part of the fish in the picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik garġa; tgħin lill-ħuta tieħu n-nifs fl-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Dik garġa; tgħin lill-ħuta tieħu n-nifs fl-ilma.
messages.zh: 那是鳃，帮助鱼在水里呼吸。
messages.en: That's a gill; it helps the fish breathe in water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在鱼的示意图上给鳃标注 garġa，再画一道流经鳃的水流箭头，把词形与水中呼吸的功能一起记住。

gloss_zh: 用不足的酵母和面；踩实湿土

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make dough with too little yeast, or to stamp wet earth down so that it becomes hard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指和面时酵母放得不足；也指用脚踩压湿土，使其变硬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel għaġina b'inqas ħmira milli hemm bżonn; jew għaffeġ l-art imxarrba bis-saqajn sakemm ibbieset.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make dough without enough yeast
sense_translations.zh_definition: 和面时没有放入足够的酵母。

sense_translations.en_definition: to stamp down on wet earth, causing it to harden
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用脚踩压湿土，使土壤变硬。

collocations.en: made the dough with too little yeast
stamped down the wet earth until it hardened

formal.mt: Il-furnar garżam l-għaġina: uża inqas ħmira milli kien hemm bżonn.
formal.en: The baker made the dough with insufficient yeast: he used less yeast than was needed.
formal.zh: 面包师和面时酵母放得不足：他使用的酵母少于所需的量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-art ħdejn il-bieb saret daqshekk iebsa? Pawlu: Ħija garżam l-art meta kienet għadha mxarrba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has the ground by the door become so hard? Pawlu: My brother stamped it down while it was still wet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门旁边的地怎么变得这么硬？保罗：我哥哥趁土还湿的时候把它踩实了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-art ħdejn il-bieb saret daqshekk iebsa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-art ħdejn il-bieb saret daqshekk iebsa?
messages.zh: 门旁边的地怎么变得这么硬？
messages.en: Why has the ground by the door become so hard?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija garżam l-art meta kienet għadha mxarrba.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija garżam l-art meta kienet għadha mxarrba.
messages.zh: 我哥哥趁土还湿的时候把它踩实了。
messages.en: My brother stamped it down while it was still wet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画分别记忆 garżam：一幅是酵母放少的面团，一幅是被脚踩硬的湿土。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Existing in the form of a gas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以气体形态存在的，用来描述物质的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun fil-forma ta' gass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 气态的；以气体形态存在的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-materjal fl-istat gassuż tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the material in its gaseous state.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这种物质处于气态时的情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jiġifieri stat gassuż? Mark: Jiġifieri li l-materjal ikun fil-forma ta' gass.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does gaseous state mean? Mark: It means that the material is in the form of a gas.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：气态是什么意思？马克：意思是物质以气体的形态存在。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 气态是什么意思？
messages.en: What does gaseous state mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li l-materjal ikun fil-forma ta' gass.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li l-materjal ikun fil-forma ta' gass.
messages.zh: 意思是物质以气体的形态存在。
messages.en: It means that the material is in the form of a gas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gassuż 放进 stat gassuż 一起背，脑中配上“物质成为气体”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name of Italian origin, written Gatt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓氏 Gatt，源自意大利语；作为姓名的一部分使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom ta' oriġini Taljana, miktub Gatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 源自意大利语的姓氏 Gatt。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Gatt ippreżenta r-rapport waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Mr Gatt presented the report during the meeting.
formal.zh: Gatt 先生在会议上提交了报告。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandi appuntament mas-Sur Gatt. Rita: Tajjeb, stenna hawn ftit.
colloquial.en: Anna: I have an appointment with Mr Gatt. Rita: All right, please wait here a moment.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我和 Gatt 先生有预约。丽塔：好的，请在这里稍等。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 我和 Gatt 先生有预约。
messages.en: I have an appointment with Mr Gatt.

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.zh: 好的，请在这里稍等。
messages.en: All right, please wait here a moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Gatt 写在想象中的姓氏名牌上，连同“Gatt 先生”记忆，并注意姓名中的大写字母。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name, written Gauci.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓氏 Gauci，用于标识个人的家族姓氏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom miktub Gauci, użat bħala parti mill-isem ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Gauci。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Gauci bagħtet l-applikazzjoni bil-posta elettronika.
formal.en: Mrs Gauci sent the application by email.
formal.zh: Gauci 女士通过电子邮件发送了申请。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif jinkiteb il-kunjom tiegħek? Anna: Gauci: G, a, u, c, i.
colloquial.en: Mark: How do you spell your surname? Anna: Gauci: G, a, u, c, i.
colloquial.zh: 马克：您的姓怎么拼写？安娜：Gauci：G、a、u、c、i。

messages.speaker: Mark (接待员)
messages.zh: 您的姓怎么拼写？
messages.en: How do you spell your surname?

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Gauci: G, a, u, c, i.
messages.mt_standard: Gauci: G, a, u, c, i.
messages.zh: Gauci：G、a、u、c、i。
messages.en: Gauci: G, a, u, c, i.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象登记表的“姓氏”一栏填着 Gauci，再逐个默写五个字母，记住它是姓名中的姓。

gloss_zh: 享受着的；享有某种利益的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Taking pleasure in something, or enjoying the benefit of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某事中感到愉悦的，或享有某种利益、权利等的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jieħu pjaċir b'xi ħaġa jew li jgawdi minn xi benefiċċju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正从某事物中获得乐趣的；享受着某事物的。
享有某事物带来的利益、好处或权利的。

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi lil min huwa gawdent ta' dan il-benefiċċju.
formal.en: The document describes who enjoys this benefit.
formal.zh: 文件说明了哪些人享有这项利益。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser li Pawlu huwa gawdent tal-ħajja? Maja: Li jieħu pjaċir bil-ħajja u b'dak li jagħmel.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does it mean to say that Pawlu takes pleasure in life? Maja: That he enjoys life and what he does.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：说保罗享受生活是什么意思？玛雅：就是说他从生活和自己做的事情中获得乐趣。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li Pawlu huwa gawdent tal-ħajja?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li Pawlu huwa gawdent tal-ħajja?
messages.zh: 说保罗享受生活是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean to say that Pawlu takes pleasure in life?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li jieħu pjaċir bil-ħajja u b'dak li jagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Li jieħu pjaċir bil-ħajja u b'dak li jagħmel.
messages.zh: 就是说他从生活和自己做的事情中获得乐趣。
messages.en: That he enjoys life and what he does.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 gawdent 画两张人物卡：一人享受生活，一人享有福利，分别记住“享受”和“享有”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Enjoyment, joy, or a deep feeling of happiness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 享受某事时的愉悦，也可指深切的幸福或喜悦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjaċir, ferħ jew sens qawwi ta' hena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 享受；从活动或经历中获得的愉悦。
深切的幸福；极大的快乐与满足。
喜悦；欢欣。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa mill-ġdid mal-familja kienet sors ta' gawdju kbir għall-vjaġġatur.
formal.en: Being reunited with the family was a source of great joy for the traveller.
formal.zh: 与家人重聚给这位旅人带来了极大的喜悦。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt lil oħtok wara tant żmien? Mark: Ħassejt gawdju kbir; kemm kont ferħan li erġajt rajtha!
colloquial.en: Anna: How did you feel when you saw your sister after so long? Mark: I felt great joy; I was so happy to see her again!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：隔了这么久见到姐姐，你感觉怎么样？马克：我特别喜悦，能再见到她真是太高兴了！

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt lil oħtok wara tant żmien?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt lil oħtok wara tant żmien?
messages.zh: 隔了这么久见到姐姐，你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How did you feel when you saw your sister after so long?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt gawdju kbir; kemm kont ferħan li erġajt rajtha!
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt gawdju kbir; kemm kont ferħan li erġajt rajtha!
messages.zh: 我特别喜悦，能再见到她真是太高兴了！
messages.en: I felt great joy; I was so happy to see her again!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gawdju 配上家人重聚时的笑脸，从日常的“享受”联想到深切的“幸福”和“喜悦”。

gloss_zh: 喜悦的；幸福的；繁荣兴旺的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Full of joy or bliss; also flourishing or prosperous, especially when describing a period of time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 充满喜悦或幸福的；也可形容繁荣兴旺的时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mimli ferħ jew hena; ukoll prosperu, speċjalment meta jiddeskrivi żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜悦的；充满欢乐的。
幸福的；充满深切快乐与满足的。

sense_translations.en_definition: flourishing or prosperous (used especially of a period of time)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 繁荣兴旺的，尤其用于形容某个时期。

formal.mt: Ir-raħal għadda minn żmien gawdjuż, b'negozju attiv u bosta opportunitajiet ta' xogħol.
formal.en: The village went through a prosperous period, with active trade and many employment opportunities.
formal.zh: 村庄经历了一段繁荣时期，商贸活跃，就业机会众多。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien meta erġajt rajt lill-familja kollha flimkien? Pawlu: Kien mument gawdjuż; kulħadd kien jitbissem!
colloquial.en: Maja: What was it like seeing the whole family together again? Pawlu: It was a joyful moment; everyone was smiling!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：再次看到全家团聚，感觉怎么样？保罗：那是欢乐的一刻，大家都笑容满面！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien meta erġajt rajt lill-familja kollha flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien meta erġajt rajt lill-familja kollha flimkien?
messages.zh: 再次看到全家团聚，感觉怎么样？
messages.en: What was it like seeing the whole family together again?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien mument gawdjuż; kulħadd kien jitbissem!
messages.mt_standard: Kien mument gawdjuż; kulħadd kien jitbissem!
messages.zh: 那是欢乐的一刻，大家都笑容满面！
messages.en: It was a joyful moment; everyone was smiling!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gawdjuż 分别贴在团聚照片和繁荣时期的日历上：前者提示欢乐幸福，后者提示兴旺繁荣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tell someone in authority about another person's behaviour, or to accuse someone of doing something wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向有权处理的人告发他人的行为，或指控某人做了错事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid lil min għandu l-awtorità b'xi ħaġa li għamel ħaddieħor, jew jakkuża lil xi ħadd b'għemil ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向老师、家长等告发某人；打某人的小报告。
告密揭发某人；口语中指把某人的事捅出去。
指控某人；声称某人做了错事。

collocations.en: told the teacher on his brother
collocations.zh: 向老师告了他兄弟的状

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, Mark gaża lil sieħbu mal-għalliem wara l-inċident fil-klassi.
formal.en: In the story, Mark told the teacher on his friend after the classroom incident.
formal.zh: 在故事中，课堂上的事件发生后，马克向老师告发了他的朋友。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx ikellem lil Mark? Rita: Għax Mark gaża lil Pawlu mal-għalliem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Pawlu want to talk to Mark? Rita: Because Mark told the teacher on Pawlu.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么不愿意跟马克说话？丽塔：因为马克向老师告了保罗的状。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx ikellem lil Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx ikellem lil Mark?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么不愿意跟马克说话？
messages.en: Why doesn't Pawlu want to talk to Mark?

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Mark gaża lil Pawlu mal-għalliem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Mark gaża lil Pawlu mal-għalliem.
messages.zh: 因为马克向老师告了保罗的状。
messages.en: Because Mark told the teacher on Pawlu.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gaża 放进“向老师告状”的画面中，先记它表示告发这一动作，再扩展到指控某人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pacifier that an infant sucks to feel comforted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供婴儿吸吮、帮助其安定情绪的安抚奶嘴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li tarbija terda' biex tikkalma u tħossha komda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 婴儿用的安抚奶嘴。

formal.mt: Qabel il-ħruġ, il-missier poġġa gażaża nadifa fil-borża tat-tarbija.
formal.en: Before going out, the father put a clean pacifier in the baby's bag.
formal.zh: 出门前，父亲把一个干净的安抚奶嘴放进了宝宝的包里。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hi l-gażaża tat-tarbija? Mark: Hawn, fil-borża ż-żgħira.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the baby's pacifier? Mark: Here, in the little bag.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：宝宝的安抚奶嘴在哪儿？马克：在这儿，在小包里。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝的安抚奶嘴在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the baby's pacifier?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 在这儿，在小包里。
messages.en: Here, in the little bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 gażaża 时想象宝宝反复吸吮安抚奶嘴，用重复的声音帮助记住这个具体物品。

gloss_zh: 吸吮安抚奶嘴或奶瓶奶嘴

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suck on a pacifier or on the teat of a feeding bottle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用嘴吸吮安抚奶嘴或奶瓶上的奶嘴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerda' gażaża jew il-beżżula ta' flixkun tat-trabi.

sense_translations.en_definition: to suck on a comforter or the teat of a bottle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸吮安抚奶嘴或奶瓶的奶嘴。

formal.mt: It-tifel gażgaż il-gażaża għal ftit minuti qabel ma raqad.
formal.en: The boy sucked on the pacifier for a few minutes before falling asleep.
formal.zh: 小男孩睡着前吸吮了几分钟安抚奶嘴。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tifel raqad? David: Iva, gażgaż il-gażaża għal ftit u mbagħad raqad.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the boy fallen asleep? David: Yes, he sucked on the pacifier for a while and then fell asleep.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：孩子睡着了吗？戴维：睡着了，他吸了一会儿安抚奶嘴，然后就睡了。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子睡着了吗？
messages.en: Has the boy fallen asleep?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, gażgaż il-gażaża għal ftit u mbagħad raqad.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, gażgaż il-gażaża għal ftit u mbagħad raqad.
messages.zh: 睡着了，他吸了一会儿安抚奶嘴，然后就睡了。
messages.en: Yes, he sucked on the pacifier for a while and then fell asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gażgaż 当作吸吮动作的节拍来读；学习时配对记忆：gażaża 是奶嘴，gażgaż 是吸吮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of telling on someone or accusing someone of wrongdoing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向他人告发某人，或指控某人做了错事这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jikxef l-għemil ta' ħaddieħor lil min għandu l-awtorità jew jakkuża lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 告发某人、打某人小报告这一行为。
指控某人这一行为。

collocations.en: telling on one another among friends

formal.mt: Id-diskussjoni fil-klassi kienet dwar il-gażi u l-effett tiegħu fuq il-fiduċja bejn il-ħbieb.
formal.en: The class discussion concerned telling on others and its effect on trust between friends.
formal.zh: 课堂讨论围绕告发他人的行为，以及这种行为对朋友间信任的影响展开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jiġġieldu? Pawlu: Minħabba l-gażi; issa ma jafdawx lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are they arguing? Pawlu: Because of the telling on each other; now they don't trust one another.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们为什么吵架？保罗：因为互相告状，现在他们彼此不信任了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们为什么吵架？
messages.en: Why are they arguing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-gażi; issa ma jafdawx lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-gażi; issa ma jafdawx lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 因为互相告状，现在他们彼此不信任了。
messages.en: Because of the telling on each other; now they don't trust one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用词性对照记忆：gaża 表示告发这个动作，gażi 则把“告发这件事”作为名词来谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Carbonated water, also called soda water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有二氧化碳气泡的水，即苏打水或汽水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilma li fih il-gass u jagħmel il-bżieżaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苏打水；含气泡的汽水。

collocations.en: a glass of cold soda water

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ġew servuti ilma u gażuż lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: During the meeting, water and soda water were served to the participants.
formal.zh: 会议期间，主办方向与会者提供了水和苏打水。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom gażuż kiesaħ? Rita: Iva, trid tazza jew flixkun?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have cold soda water? Rita: Yes, would you like a glass or a bottle?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们有冰凉的苏打水吗？丽塔：有，你要一杯还是一瓶？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们有冰凉的苏打水吗？
messages.en: Do you have cold soda water?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.zh: 有，你要一杯还是一瓶？
messages.en: Yes, would you like a glass or a bottle?

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 gażuż 就想象杯中不断冒出的气泡，再用“一瓶苏打水”这个点单场景巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 爱告状的人；指控他人的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who tells on other people or accuses them of wrongdoing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 告发别人、打别人小报告，或指控别人做错事的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikxef l-għemil ta' ħaddieħor lil min għandu l-awtorità jew takkuża lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 告发他人、打别人小报告的人。
指控他人的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-gażżaj jitlef il-fiduċja ta' sħabu wara li jikxef is-sigrieti tagħhom.
formal.en: In the story, the telltale loses his friends' trust after revealing their secrets.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个爱告状的人泄露了朋友们的秘密，因而失去了他们的信任。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex sejjaħtli gażżaj? Mark: Għax għedt lill-għalliem dak li għamilt.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why did you call me a telltale? Mark: Because you told the teacher what I did.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你为什么说我是个爱告状的人？马克：因为你把我做的事告诉了老师。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么说我是个爱告状的人？
messages.en: Why did you call me a telltale?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għedt lill-għalliem dak li għamilt.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għedt lill-għalliem dak li għamilt.
messages.zh: 因为你把我做的事告诉了老师。
messages.en: Because you told the teacher what I did.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个词分配给三个画面：gaża 是告状动作，gażi 是告状这件事，gażżaj 是做这件事的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An acacia tree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 金合欢树；这里用作树木名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra magħrufa bħala acacia.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金合欢，指金合欢树。

formal.mt: Il-pjanta tal-ġnien turi gażżija ħdejn id-daħla prinċipali.
formal.en: The garden plan shows an acacia tree beside the main entrance.
formal.zh: 花园平面图标示出主入口旁的一棵金合欢树。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se niltaqgħu fil-ġnien? David: Taħt il-gażżija ħdejn id-daħla.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we meet in the garden? David: Under the acacia tree beside the entrance.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们在花园的什么地方碰面？戴维：入口旁的金合欢树下。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在花园的什么地方碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet in the garden?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 入口旁的金合欢树下。
messages.en: Under the acacia tree beside the entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gażżija 记成花园里的碰面地标，反复联想“在金合欢树下”，用完整场景固定树名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The tree species Vachellia karroo, known in English as sweet thorn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英文称为 sweet thorn 的树种，学名为 Vachellia karroo，可记作甜刺金合欢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' gażżija magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala sweet thorn u bl-isem xjentifiku Vachellia karroo.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甜刺金合欢，即学名为 Vachellia karroo 的树种。

collocations.en: a label for the sweet thorn tree

formal.mt: Fil-katalgu tal-ġnien, il-gażżija tax-xewk hija mniżżla bl-isem xjentifiku Vachellia karroo.
formal.en: In the garden catalogue, the sweet thorn is listed under the scientific name Vachellia karroo.
formal.zh: 在花园目录中，甜刺金合欢以学名 Vachellia karroo 登记。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din x'siġra hi? Rita: Hi gażżija tax-xewk; ara l-isem Vachellia karroo fuq it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What kind of tree is this? Rita: It's a sweet thorn; look at the name Vachellia karroo on the label.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是什么树？丽塔：这是甜刺金合欢，你看标牌上的名字 Vachellia karroo。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 这是什么树？
messages.en: What kind of tree is this?

messages.speaker: Rita (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Hi gażżija tax-xewk; ara l-isem Vachellia karroo fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Hi gażżija tax-xewk; ara l-isem Vachellia karroo fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 这是甜刺金合欢，你看标牌上的名字 Vachellia karroo。
messages.en: It's a sweet thorn; look at the name Vachellia karroo on the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把完整名称 gażżija tax-xewk 和植物标牌上的 Vachellia karroo 配对记忆，提醒自己这是具体树种名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A little lie, expressed by the diminutive form of 'gidba'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个小谎言；是 gidba 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gidba żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'gidba'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a little lie (the diminutive form of 'gidba')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个小谎言（gidba 的指小形式）

collocations.en: to hide the truth with a little lie
collocations.zh: 用一个小谎言掩盖真相

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, gdejba dwar ktieb mitluf twassal għal problema akbar.
formal.en: In the story, a little lie about a lost book leads to a bigger problem.
formal.zh: 故事中，一个关于书本丢失的小谎言引出了更大的问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għedt li l-karozza tal-linja waslet tard? Pawlu: Għedt gdejba għax qomt tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you say the bus was late? Pawlu: I told a little lie because I got up late.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么说公交车晚点了？Pawlu：我起晚了，所以说了个小谎。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għedt li l-karozza tal-linja waslet tard?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għedt li l-karozza tal-linja waslet tard?
messages.zh: 你为什么说公交车晚点了？
messages.en: Why did you say the bus was late?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我起晚了，所以说了个小谎。
messages.en: I told a little lie because I got up late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和 gidba 配对记忆：同样是谎言，gdejba 表示一个小谎；想象为了掩饰起晚而编的小借口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small snout: the projecting nose and mouth area of an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物向前突出的较小口鼻部，即小吻部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Geddum żgħir ta' annimal, jiġifieri l-parti ta' quddiem fejn hemm l-imnieħer u l-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动物的小吻部；较小的口鼻部

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, il-ġeru għandu gdejdem imxarrab wara li xorob l-ilma.
formal.en: In the photograph, the puppy has a wet little snout after drinking water.
formal.zh: 照片中，小狗喝过水后，小口鼻部湿漉漉的。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara l-gdejdem tal-ġeru, kollu ħalib! Mark: Ħa nġib ċarruta u nimsaħlu wiċċu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look at the puppy's little snout, all covered in milk! Mark: I'll get a cloth and wipe its face.
colloquial.zh: Sara：看小狗的小嘴鼻，沾满了奶！Mark：我去拿块布，给它擦擦脸。

messages.speaker: Sara (宠物主人)
messages.zh: 看小狗的小嘴鼻，沾满了奶！
messages.en: Look at the puppy's little snout, all covered in milk!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħa nġib ċarruta u nimsaħlu wiċċu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħa nġib ċarruta u nimsaħlu wiċċu.
messages.zh: 我去拿块布，给它擦擦脸。
messages.en: I'll get a cloth and wipe its face.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小狗喝奶后，鼻子和嘴巴周围沾了一圈奶；把这一小块口鼻部与 gdejdem 连在一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bite, expressed by the diminutive form of 'gidma'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻轻的一咬，或咬下的一小口；是 gidma 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gidma żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'gidma'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small bite (the diminutive form of 'gidma')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻轻一咬；一小口（gidma 的指小形式）

collocations.en: a small bite of the bread

formal.mt: Waqt il-waqfa, it-tifla ħadet gdejma mill-ħobż u xorbot ftit ilma.
formal.en: During the break, the girl took a small bite of the bread and drank some water.
formal.zh: 休息时，女孩咬了一小口面包，喝了些水。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nieħu gdejma mill-kejk tiegħek? Ben: Iva, ħu ftit biex idduqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I have a small bite of your cake? Ben: Yes, have a little to taste it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我能咬一小口你的蛋糕吗？Ben：可以，吃一点尝尝吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我能咬一小口你的蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Can I have a small bite of your cake?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，吃一点尝尝吧。
messages.en: Yes, have a little to taste it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gidma 与 gdejma 配对：后者把一口缩小成尝味道的一小口，联想只咬掉蛋糕一个小角。

gloss_zh: 咬；咬的一口；一小口食物

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of biting; also a bite or a small morsel of food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咬的行为，也可指咬的一口或一小口食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tigdem; jista' jfisser ukoll gidma jew ftit ikel f'biċċiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咬的行为；啃咬
咬的一口；一次咬
一小口食物；少量可口的小食

collocations.en: a few small morsels of food

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-gdim tal-kelb waqt il-logħob.
formal.en: The report describes the dog's biting during play.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这只狗在玩耍时的啃咬行为。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadek bil-ġuħ? Toni: Ftit; nieħu ftit gdim qabel nitlaq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you still hungry? Toni: A little; I'll have a few small morsels before I leave.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你还饿吗？Toni：有一点；我走之前再吃几小口。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还饿吗？
messages.en: Are you still hungry?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit; nieħu ftit gdim qabel nitlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit; nieħu ftit gdim qabel nitlaq.
messages.zh: 有一点；我走之前再吃几小口。
messages.en: A little; I'll have a few small morsels before I leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个连续画面记义项：牙齿正在咬、咬下的一口、盘中的一小口食物；再靠语境判断 gdim 的具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To swindle or cheat someone by acting dishonestly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不诚实的手段欺骗他人或骗取他人的钱财。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqarraq b'xi ħadd b'mod diżonest, pereżempju biex jieħu flusu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诈骗；骗取他人的钱财
欺骗；以不诚实的方式占便宜

collocations.zh: 他诈骗了自己的合伙人

formal.mt: Skont l-ilment, il-bejjiegħ gebbeġ lill-klijent billi biegħlu arloġġ falz bħala wieħed oriġinali.
formal.en: According to the complaint, the seller swindled the customer by selling him a fake watch as a genuine one.
formal.zh: 根据投诉，卖家把假表当真表卖给顾客，实施了诈骗。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan l-arloġġ falz! Sara: Mela l-bejjiegħ gebbeġ lilek ukoll?
colloquial.en: Mark: This watch is fake! Sara: So the seller cheated you too?
colloquial.zh: Mark：这块表是假的！Sara：这么说，那个卖家也骗了你？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这块表是假的！
messages.en: This watch is fake!

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这么说，那个卖家也骗了你？
messages.en: So the seller cheated you too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想卖家把假表说成真表的情景：顾客受骗、钱被赚走，用这幅画面记住 gebbeġ 的欺骗和诈骗义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something sturdier or more solid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物更加结实、稳固或牢靠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar soda u b'saħħitha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物更加结实；加固某物

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa geddel il-mejda billi żied appoġġ taħtha.
formal.en: The carpenter made the table sturdier by adding a support underneath it.
formal.zh: 木匠在桌子下方增设支撑，使桌子更加稳固。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-mejda għadha tiċċaqlaq? Ben: Le, il-mastrudaxxa geddel il-mejda lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does the table still wobble? Ben: No, the carpenter made it sturdier yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Lara：桌子还晃吗？Ben：不晃了，木匠昨天把它加固了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 桌子还晃吗？
messages.en: Does the table still wobble?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 不晃了，木匠昨天把它加固了。
messages.en: No, the carpenter made the table sturdier yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张摇晃的桌子加上支撑后站稳了；把从晃动到牢固的变化记作 geddel。

gloss_zh: 堆东西的人；喜欢依偎拥抱的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who heaps things up; also a person who likes to cuddle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西堆起来的人；也指喜欢依偎、拥抱的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tpoġġi l-affarijiet f'munzelli; ukoll persuna li tħobb titgħannaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西堆起来的人；堆放东西的人
喜欢依偎或拥抱的人

collocations.zh: 喜欢把纸张堆起来的人

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, Pawlu hu geddies tal-kotba: ipoġġihom f'munzelli fuq kull mejda.
formal.en: In the story, Pawlu is someone who heaps up books: he puts them in piles on every table.
formal.zh: 故事中的 Pawlu 是个爱堆书的人：他把书一摞摞堆在每张桌子上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tifel tiegħek dejjem irid tgħanniqa! Rita: Iva, hu geddies; iħobb joqgħod ħdejja u jgħannaqni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your son always wants a hug! Rita: Yes, he's a cuddler; he likes sitting beside me and hugging me.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你儿子总想要抱抱！Rita：是啊，他很爱依偎，喜欢坐在我身边抱着我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你儿子总想要抱抱！
messages.en: Your son always wants a hug!

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu geddies; iħobb joqgħod ħdejja u jgħannaqni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu geddies; iħobb joqgħod ħdejja u jgħannaqni.
messages.zh: 是啊，他很爱依偎，喜欢坐在我身边抱着我。
messages.en: Yes, he's a cuddler; he likes sitting beside me and hugging me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 geddies 画两张人物卡：一张是把书堆成摞的人，一张是爱抱抱的人；两义分别记，看到上下文再选。

gloss_zh: 爱堆积的；有囤积倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to heap things up or to keep accumulating possessions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于把东西堆起来，或不断积存物品的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jqiegħed l-affarijiet f'munzelli jew iżomm ħafna affarijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to heap or hoard
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有堆积或囤积东西倾向的

collocations.en: a person inclined to heap or hoard things
collocations.zh: 一个爱堆积或囤积东西的人

formal.mt: Il-karattru prinċipali huwa bniedem geddiesi li jżomm kull kaxxa, anki meta ma jkollux bżonnha.
formal.en: The main character is a person inclined to hoarding who keeps every box, even when he has no use for it.
formal.zh: 主人公有囤积东西的倾向，每个盒子都留着，即使根本用不上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex iżżomm dawn il-kaxxi kollha? Mark: Jien ftit geddiesi; dejjem naħseb li xi darba jkolli bżonnhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you keep all these boxes? Mark: I tend to hoard things a little; I always think I'll need them someday.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么留着这么多盒子？Mark：我有点爱囤东西，总觉得以后会用上。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么留着这么多盒子？
messages.en: Why do you keep all these boxes?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ftit geddiesi; dejjem naħseb li xi darba jkolli bżonnhom.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ftit geddiesi; dejjem naħseb li xi darba jkolli bżonnhom.
messages.zh: 我有点爱囤东西，总觉得以后会用上。
messages.en: I tend to hoard things a little; I always think I'll need them someday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面对一屋空盒子还说以后用得上的人；geddiesi 描述这种爱堆积、爱囤物的倾向，可用来修饰人的性格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A monkey, an animal that climbs and moves among trees.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 猴子，一种会攀爬并在树木间活动的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal li jitla' mas-siġar u jiċċaqlaq minn fergħa għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猴子。

formal.mt: It-tfal osservaw gedmejmun jitla' ma' siġra u jieqaf fuq fergħa.
formal.en: The children observed a monkey climbing a tree and stopping on a branch.
formal.zh: 孩子们观察到一只猴子爬上树，在一根树枝上停下来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-gedmejmun fuq is-siġra! Luqa: Rajtu! Issa qiegħed jaqbeż għal fergħa oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that monkey in the tree! Luqa: I see it! Now it's jumping to another branch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树上那只猴子！卢卡：看到了！它现在正跳向另一根树枝。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看树上那只猴子！
messages.en: Look at that monkey in the tree!

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu! Issa qiegħed jaqbeż għal fergħa oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu! Issa qiegħed jaqbeż għal fergħa oħra.
messages.zh: 看到了！它现在正跳向另一根树枝。
messages.en: I see it! Now it's jumping to another branch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gedmejmun 和猴子在树枝间跳跃的画面配对，边指图边说这个词，记住它指动物。

gloss_zh: 嘟囔；低声含糊的说话声

teaching_sense.en_definition: Quiet, indistinct speech that is difficult for others to hear clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 低声而含糊的说话或说话声，让旁人难以听清内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem imlissen b'leħen baxx u mhux ċar, li ħaddieħor isibha diffiċli jifhmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘟囔；低声含糊地说话或发出的声音。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa nstema' gedwid minn wara l-kamra, iżda l-kliem ma kienx ċar.
formal.en: During the meeting, muttering could be heard from the back of the room, but the words were unclear.
formal.zh: 会议期间，房间后方传来嘟囔声，但话语内容听不清楚。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak il-gedwid? Qed tgħid xi ħaġa lili? Pawlu: Le, qed naqra l-lista bejni u bejn ruħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's that muttering? Are you saying something to me? Pawlu: No, I'm reading the list to myself.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在嘟囔什么？是在跟我说话吗？保罗：没有，我在自己念清单。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-gedwid? Qed tgħid xi ħaġa lili?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-gedwid? Qed tgħid xi ħaġa lili?
messages.zh: 你在嘟囔什么？是在跟我说话吗？
messages.en: What's that muttering? Are you saying something to me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed naqra l-lista bejni u bejn ruħi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed naqra l-lista bejni u bejn ruħi.
messages.zh: 没有，我在自己念清单。
messages.en: No, I'm reading the list to myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象身旁有人低头念念有词，你听得到声音却听不清内容；用这个场景记住 gedwid。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large quantity of things or a group gathered together, such as a crowd of people or a gaggle of geese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大量的事物，或聚在一起的一群，可指人群，也可指一群鹅等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwantità kbira ta' affarijiet jew grupp miġbur flimkien, bħal nies jew wiżż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量；很大的一批或数量。
一群聚集的人；人群。
一群，尤指聚在一起的一群鹅。

formal.mt: Quddiem id-daħla kien hemm gedwidija ta' nies jistennew li jinfetħu l-bibien.
formal.en: There was a crowd of people in front of the entrance waiting for the doors to open.
formal.zh: 入口前聚集着一大群人，等待开门。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara x'gedwidija ta' karti hemm fuq il-mejda! Mark: Iva, ejja nqassmuhom f'żewġ munzelli.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that huge pile of papers on the table! Mark: Yes, let's divide them into two piles.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看桌上有多大一堆纸！马克：是啊，我们把它们分成两堆吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara x'gedwidija ta' karti hemm fuq il-mejda!
messages.mt_standard: Ara x'gedwidija ta' karti hemm fuq il-mejda!
messages.zh: 看桌上有多大一堆纸！
messages.en: Look at that huge pile of papers on the table!

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们把它们分成两堆吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's divide them into two piles.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅图记 gedwidija：一大堆纸、一大群人、一群鹅；共同提示是数量多或聚成一群。

gloss_zh: 惯常嘟囔的人；说话总含糊不清的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who habitually speaks quietly and indistinctly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 习惯低声含糊说话、经常让别人听不清的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ta' spiss titkellem b'leħen baxx u bi kliem mhux ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯常低声嘟囔、说话含糊不清的人。

collocations.en: a habitual mumbler whom you cannot understand
collocations.zh: 一个说话总含糊得让你听不懂的人

collocations.mt: titlob lil gedwied jitkellem aktar ċar
collocations.en: to ask a habitual mumbler to speak more clearly
collocations.zh: 请一个惯常嘟囔的人说清楚些

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-ġar huwa gedwied li jitkellem b'mod tant mhux ċar li l-oħrajn spiss jitolbuh jirrepeti.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbour is a habitual mumbler who speaks so indistinctly that others often ask him to repeat himself.
formal.zh: 故事中的邻居是个惯常嘟囔的人，说话含糊得让别人常常请他重复。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Jien gedwied? Spiss jgħiduli li ma jifhmunix. Toni: Kultant titkellem baxx wisq. Għolli leħnek ftit.
colloquial.en: Marta: Am I a habitual mumbler? People often tell me they can't understand me. Toni: Sometimes you speak too quietly. Raise your voice a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我是不是总说话含糊？别人经常说听不懂我。托尼：你有时声音太小了，稍微大声一点。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien gedwied? Spiss jgħiduli li ma jifhmunix.
messages.mt_standard: Jien gedwied? Spiss jgħiduli li ma jifhmunix.
messages.zh: 我是不是总说话含糊？别人经常说听不懂我。
messages.en: Am I a habitual mumbler? People often tell me they can't understand me.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kultant titkellem baxx wisq. Għolli leħnek ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Kultant titkellem baxx wisq. Għolli leħnek ftit.
messages.zh: 你有时声音太小了，稍微大声一点。
messages.en: Sometimes you speak too quietly. Raise your voice a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gedwied 记成一个总被问“你刚才说什么”的人物；重点是惯常这样说话的人。

gloss_zh: 刷去或搓掉果蔬表面的泥土

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove soil from the surface of vegetables or fruit by brushing or rubbing it off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过刷拭或搓擦，去掉蔬菜或水果表面附着的泥土。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tneħħi t-trab jew il-ħamrija minn fuq il-ħaxix jew il-frott billi togħrok il-wiċċ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to brush away the soil off vegetables or fruits
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刷去或搓掉蔬菜、水果表面的泥土。

collocations.en: brush the soil off the potatoes
brush the soil off the carrots
collocations.zh: 刷去胡萝卜表面的泥土

formal.mt: Gelbel il-patata biex tneħħi l-ħamrija minn fuqha qabel taħsilha.
formal.en: Brush the soil off the potatoes before washing them.
formal.zh: 清洗土豆之前，先刷掉表面的泥土。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Gelbel il-karrotti qabel iddaħħalhom fil-kċina, jekk jogħġbok. Sam: Tajjeb, għad hemm ħafna ħamrija fuqhom.
colloquial.en: Rita: Please brush the soil off the carrots before bringing them into the kitchen. Sam: All right, there's still a lot of soil on them.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：请先刷掉胡萝卜上的泥，再拿进厨房。萨姆：好的，上面还沾着很多泥。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
