messages.mt_spoken: Gelbel il-karrotti qabel iddaħħalhom fil-kċina, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Gelbel il-karrotti qabel iddaħħalhom fil-kċina, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请先刷掉胡萝卜上的泥，再拿进厨房。
messages.en: Please brush the soil off the carrots before bringing them into the kitchen.

messages.speaker: Sam (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, għad hemm ħafna ħamrija fuqhom.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, għad hemm ħafna ħamrija fuqhom.
messages.zh: 好的，上面还沾着很多泥。
messages.en: All right, there's still a lot of soil on them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着刚挖出的土豆，把表面泥土刷落；做这个动作时默念 gelbel，记住动作与对象。

gloss_zh: 搓去蔬菜表面泥土的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who removes soil from vegetables by rubbing it off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过搓擦去掉蔬菜表面泥土的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li togħrok il-ħaxix biex tneħħi l-ħamrija minn fuqu.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who rubs soil off vegetables
sense_translations.zh_definition: 搓擦蔬菜以去除表面泥土的人。

collocations.en: a person who rubs soil off vegetables
collocations.zh: 搓去蔬菜表面泥土的人

collocations.en: a vegetable cleaner rubbing off soil
collocations.zh: 正在搓掉泥土的蔬菜清理者

formal.mt: Il-gelbiel neħħa l-ħamrija minn fuq il-ħaxix qabel ma tqiegħed fil-kaxxi.
formal.en: The person cleaning the vegetables rubbed off the soil before the vegetables were placed in boxes.
formal.zh: 负责清理蔬菜的人先搓去表面的泥土，然后蔬菜才被装进箱子。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jkun il-gelbiel illum? Il-patata kollha mimlija ħamrija. Ġorġ: Jien! Int poġġi l-patata nadifa fil-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who's going to rub the soil off the vegetables today? The potatoes are all covered in soil. Ġorġ: I will! You put the clean potatoes in the box.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：今天谁来搓掉蔬菜上的泥？土豆全都沾满了泥。乔治：我来！你把清理好的土豆放进箱子。

messages.speaker: Marija (农场同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun il-gelbiel illum? Il-patata kollha mimlija ħamrija.
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun il-gelbiel illum? Il-patata kollha mimlija ħamrija.
messages.zh: 今天谁来搓掉蔬菜上的泥？土豆全都沾满了泥。
messages.en: Who's going to rub the soil off the vegetables today? The potatoes are all covered in soil.

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (农场同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! Int poġġi l-patata nadifa fil-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! Int poġġi l-patata nadifa fil-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 我来！你把清理好的土豆放进箱子。
messages.en: I will! You put the clean potatoes in the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象分工时一人专门搓掉蔬菜上的泥，把这个人的胸牌写成 gelbiel，记住词义指做这件事的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flow out strongly or make a bubbling, gurgling sound, especially of water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指水等液体大量涌出，或流动时发出汩汩声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ bil-qawwa jew jagħmel ħoss ta' tbaqbiq, speċjalment meta jkun ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涌出；大量而急速地流出。
发出汩汩声；流动时产生冒泡般的声音。

collocations.en: The water gushed from the rocks.
The water gurgled in the pipe.

formal.mt: Wara x-xita qawwija, l-ilma gelgel minn fetħa fil-ħajt u mela l-bitħa.
formal.en: After the heavy rain, water gushed through an opening in the wall and filled the courtyard.
formal.zh: 大雨过后，水从墙上的一个开口涌出，积满了院子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-ħoss fil-kċina? Mark: L-ilma gelgel fil-pajp meta ftaħt il-vit.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that sound in the kitchen? Mark: The water gurgled in the pipe when I turned on the tap.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：厨房里刚才是什么声音？马克：我打开水龙头时，水在管道里汩汩作响。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 厨房里刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilma gelgel fil-pajp meta ftaħt il-vit.
messages.mt_standard: L-ilma gelgel fil-pajp meta ftaħt il-vit.
messages.zh: 我打开水龙头时，水在管道里汩汩作响。
messages.en: The water gurgled in the pipe when I turned on the tap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时把 gelgel 配上水涌出的画面和“汩汩”声：既记水的动作，也记水的声音。

gloss_zh: 涌水或发出汩汩声的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that gushes or produces a gurgling sound, such as a source of flowing water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会涌出液体或发出汩汩声的东西，例如一处涌水源。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li minnha joħroġ l-ilma bil-qawwa jew li tagħmel ħoss ta' tbaqbiq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会涌出液体或发出汩汩声的东西。

collocations.en: something that gushes or gurgles with water
collocations.zh: 涌水或流水汩汩作响的东西

collocations.en: the sound of the gurgling source

formal.mt: Bejn il-blat hemm gelgiel żgħir, u l-ħoss tiegħu jinstema' minn fuq il-mogħdija.
formal.en: There is a small gurgling source among the rocks, and its sound can be heard from the path.
formal.zh: 岩石间有一处小小的涌水源，走在小路上就能听到它的汩汩声。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn ġej dak il-ħoss tal-ilma? Pawlu: Hemm gelgiel wara dawk il-ġebel. Ejja narawh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is that sound of water coming from? Pawlu: There is a gurgling source behind those stones. Let's go and see it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那流水声是从哪里来的？保罗：那些石头后面有个汩汩涌水的地方。我们去看看吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġej dak il-ħoss tal-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġej dak il-ħoss tal-ilma?
messages.zh: 那流水声是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is that sound of water coming from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm gelgiel wara dawk il-ġebel. Ejja narawh.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm gelgiel wara dawk il-ġebel. Ejja narawh.
messages.zh: 那些石头后面有个汩汩涌水的地方。我们去看看吧。
messages.en: There is a gurgling source behind those stones. Let's go and see it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象指着一处汩汩涌水的东西说 gelgiel，重点记住它是给“东西”命名的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Flowing or coming out strongly and abundantly, especially of water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容水等液体强劲而大量涌出的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ jew jimxi bil-qawwa u fi kwantità kbira, speċjalment ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涌流的；大量而强劲地流出的。

formal.mt: Il-fluss gelgieli tal-ilma wara l-maltemp ġarr il-ħamrija lejn il-wied.
formal.en: The gushing flow of water after the storm carried the soil towards the valley.
formal.zh: 暴风雨后，强劲的水流把泥土冲向了山谷。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nistgħu naqsmu minn hawn? Mark: Aħjar le. Ara kemm hu gelgieli l-ilma llum!
colloquial.en: Nina: Can we cross here? Mark: Better not. Look how strongly the water is gushing today!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们能从这里过去吗？马克：最好别。你看今天这水涌得多猛！

messages.speaker: Nina (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 我们能从这里过去吗？
messages.en: Can we cross here?

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar le. Ara kemm hu gelgieli l-ilma llum!
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar le. Ara kemm hu gelgieli l-ilma llum!
messages.zh: 最好别。你看今天这水涌得多猛！
messages.en: Better not. Look how strongly the water is gushing today!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gelgieli 当作贴在水流画面上的“喷涌的”标签，练习用它描述水流的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spring or source of gushing water, including a large spring, or a cascade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指泉或涌水的源头，可指大泉；也可指飞瀑或瀑布式的水流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajn tal-ilma, ukoll waħda kbira, jew post minn fejn joħroġ l-ilma bil-qawwa; jista' jfisser ukoll kaskata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大泉；规模较大的天然出水泉。
飞瀑；向下倾泻的瀑布或层叠水流。
涌水源；水不断喷涌而出的源头。
泉；地下水自然涌出地面的地方。

collocations.en: the water of the spring or cascade

formal.mt: Il-gelgul f'qiegħ il-wied jipprovdi ilma lill-għelieqi tal-madwar.
formal.en: The spring at the bottom of the valley supplies water to the surrounding fields.
formal.zh: 谷底的泉为周围的农田供水。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se nieqfu nistrieħu? Toni: Ħdejn il-gelgul. Hemm id-dell u nistgħu nisimgħu l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we stop for a rest? Toni: Beside the spring. There is shade there, and we can listen to the water.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们在哪里停下来休息？托尼：泉边吧。那里有树荫，还能听流水声。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里停下来休息？
messages.en: Where shall we stop for a rest?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-gelgul. Hemm id-dell u nistgħu nisimgħu l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-gelgul. Hemm id-dell u nistgħu nisimgħu l-ilma.
messages.zh: 泉边吧。那里有树荫，还能听流水声。
messages.en: Beside the spring. There is shade there, and we can listen to the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“大泉涌水、飞瀑落水”两幅画面记 gelgul，再根据上下文判断是泉还是瀑流。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young animal, especially a calf; figuratively, a person who behaves immaturely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指幼小的动物，尤其可指小牛；比喻行为幼稚、心智不成熟的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir, bħall-għoġol; b'mod figurattiv, persuna li ġġib ruħha bla maturità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幼兽；尚未长成的动物。
小牛；尚未长成的牛。
不成熟的人；行为或想法显得幼稚的人。

collocations.en: to feed the young animal or calf
to behave like an immature person

formal.mt: Il-bidwi żamm il-gellux qrib ommu u tah l-ikel xieraq għall-età tiegħu.
formal.en: The farmer kept the calf close to its mother and gave it food suitable for its age.
formal.zh: 农民让小牛待在母牛身边，并给它适合其年龄的食物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq hekk kif tlifna l-logħba? Lara: Xi kultant iġib ruħu ta' gellux; għadu jrid jitgħallem jaċċetta t-telfa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he leave as soon as we lost the game? Lara: Sometimes he behaves immaturely; he still needs to learn to accept defeat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们一输掉比赛，他怎么就走了？拉拉：他有时很幼稚，还得学会接受失败。

messages.speaker: Maja (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex telaq hekk kif tlifna l-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex telaq hekk kif tlifna l-logħba?
messages.zh: 我们一输掉比赛，他怎么就走了？
messages.en: Why did he leave as soon as we lost the game?

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi kultant iġib ruħu ta' gellux; għadu jrid jitgħallem jaċċetta t-telfa.
messages.mt_standard: Xi kultant iġib ruħu ta' gellux; għadu jrid jitgħallem jaċċetta t-telfa.
messages.zh: 他有时很幼稚，还得学会接受失败。
messages.en: Sometimes he behaves immaturely; he still needs to learn to accept defeat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“还没长大的小牛”，再联想“做事还不成熟的人”；这是帮助区分词义的学习联想。

gloss_zh: 抱怨；含糊地说；低声嘟囔

teaching_sense.en_definition: To complain in a low voice, speak unclearly, or say something quietly under one's breath.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 低声抱怨、含糊不清地说话，或压低声音嘟囔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilmenta b'leħen baxx, jitkellem bla ċarezza, jew jgħid xi ħaġa minn taħt l-ilsien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抱怨；不满地低声发牢骚。
含糊地说；说话声音低且吐字不清。
低声嘟囔；压低声音说话。

formal.mt: Meta sar jaf bid-dewmien, il-passiġġier gemgem dwar in-nuqqas ta' informazzjoni.
formal.en: When he learned about the delay, the passenger grumbled about the lack of information.
formal.zh: 得知延误后，那名乘客低声抱怨信息不足。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'qal Mark? Ma fhimtux. Pawlu: Gemgem xi ħaġa dwar ix-xogħol, imma lanqas jien ma fhimtu sew.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did Mark say? I didn't understand him. Pawlu: He mumbled something about work, but I didn't understand him properly either.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克说了什么？我没听懂。保罗：他含糊地说了些工作上的事，不过我也没听清楚。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 马克说了什么？我没听懂。
messages.en: What did Mark say? I didn't understand him.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Gemgem xi ħaġa dwar ix-xogħol, imma lanqas jien ma fhimtu sew.
messages.mt_standard: Gemgem xi ħaġa dwar ix-xogħol, imma lanqas jien ma fhimtu sew.
messages.zh: 他含糊地说了些工作上的事，不过我也没听清楚。
messages.en: He mumbled something about work, but I didn't understand him properly either.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人嘴里低低地“咕哝咕哝”：有不满就是抱怨，听不清就是含糊说，轻声说就是嘟囔。

gloss_zh: 脾气不好的人；爱抱怨的人；牢骚鬼

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is ill-tempered or frequently complains and grumbles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指脾气不好、经常抱怨或爱发牢骚的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ta' burdata ħażina jew li spiss tilmenta u tgemgem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脾气不好的人；容易表现出烦躁或不悦的人。
爱抱怨的人；经常表达不满的人。
牢骚鬼；动不动就嘟囔着抱怨的人。

formal.mt: Il-karattru ewlieni tar-rakkont huwa gemgiem li jsib difett f'kull proposta.
formal.en: The main character in the story is a grumbler who finds fault with every proposal.
formal.zh: 故事的主人公是个牢骚鬼，每个提议他都要挑毛病。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Toni reġa' lmenta dwar ir-ristorant? Mark: Iva, huwa gemgiem kbir; din id-darba lanqas għoġbitu l-mużika.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Toni complain about the restaurant again? Mark: Yes, he is a great grumbler; this time he didn't even like the music.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：托尼又抱怨那家餐厅了？马克：是啊，他特别爱发牢骚；这次连音乐也不喜欢。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼又抱怨那家餐厅了？
messages.en: Did Toni complain about the restaurant again?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa gemgiem kbir; din id-darba lanqas għoġbitu l-mużika.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa gemgiem kbir; din id-darba lanqas għoġbitu l-mużika.
messages.zh: 是啊，他特别爱发牢骚；这次连音乐也不喜欢。
messages.en: Yes, he is a great grumbler; this time he didn't even like the music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给总在挑毛病的人画一张人物卡，写上 gemgiem；记住这个名词指“爱抱怨的那个人”。

gloss_zh: 抱怨；含糊的话语；低声嘟囔

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or sound of grumbling, speaking unclearly, or muttering in a low voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指发牢骚、含糊说话或低声嘟囔的行为，也可指由此发出的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-ħoss ta' min jilmenta b'leħen baxx, jitkellem bla ċarezza, jew jitkellem minn taħt l-ilsien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抱怨；低声发牢骚的行为或声音。
含糊说话；低声且吐字不清的话语。
低声嘟囔；压低声音说话的行为或声音。

formal.mt: Wara li tħabbret iż-żieda fil-prezzijiet, instema' gemgim fost il-klijenti.
formal.en: After the price increase was announced, grumbling could be heard among the customers.
formal.zh: 涨价消息公布后，顾客中传出了低声抱怨。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt x'qal? Maja: Le, smajt biss gemgim. Staqsih jitkellem aktar ċar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear what he said? Maja: No, I only heard mumbling. Ask him to speak more clearly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听到他说什么了吗？玛雅：没有，我只听到含糊的嘟囔声。请他讲清楚一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你听到他说什么了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear what he said?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, smajt biss gemgim. Staqsih jitkellem aktar ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, smajt biss gemgim. Staqsih jitkellem aktar ċar.
messages.zh: 没有，我只听到含糊的嘟囔声。请他讲清楚一点。
messages.en: No, I only heard mumbling. Ask him to speak more clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gemgim 记成一段“嘟囔声”的录音：它命名的是抱怨或含糊说话这件事及其声音。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large bovine animal, either a bison or a buffalo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指野牛或水牛这类体形较大的牛科动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal kbir li jixbah barri; il-kelma tista' tirreferi għal tipi differenti ta' dan l-annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 野牛；水牛。

collocations.zh: 一头体形很大的野牛或水牛

collocations.en: a herd of bison or buffalo

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher gemus kbir wieqaf ħdejn ix-xmara.
formal.en: The picture shows a large buffalo standing beside the river.
formal.zh: 图中有一头大水牛站在河边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak l-annimal fl-istampa? Toni: Dak gemus. Ara kemm hu kbir!
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that animal in the picture? Toni: That's a buffalo. Look how big it is!
colloquial.zh: Maja：图片里那是什么动物？Toni：那是水牛。看它多大！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 图片里那是什么动物？
messages.en: What is that animal in the picture?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak gemus. Ara kemm hu kbir!
messages.mt_standard: Dak gemus. Ara kemm hu kbir!
messages.zh: 那是水牛。看它多大！
messages.en: That's a buffalo. Look how big it is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gemus 配上一张大牛的图来记：可指野牛或水牛，阅读时再靠具体场景区分。

gloss_zh: 野豌豆类攀缘植物；小碗

teaching_sense.en_definition: A climbing plant of the vetch group; in a separate sense, a small bowl.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种野豌豆类攀缘植物；另一个独立词义指小碗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li tixxabbat, ta' tip ta' ġilbiena; f'tifsira oħra, skutella żgħira.

sense_translations.en_definition: a climbing plant (of the vetch species)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种野豌豆类的攀缘植物。
小碗；小型碗状容器。

collocations.en: a vetch-type plant climbing up the wall
collocations.zh: 攀着墙生长的野豌豆类植物

collocations.en: a small bowl full of rice

formal.mt: Fuq il-mejda tqiegħed gerbejb mimli ross ħdejn il-platt prinċipali.
formal.en: A small bowl filled with rice was placed on the table beside the main dish.
formal.zh: 一只盛满米饭的小碗被放在桌上，摆在主菜旁边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-pjanta li qed titla' mal-ħajt? Toni: Dik gerbejb; ara kif tixxabbat.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that plant growing up the wall? Toni: That's a vetch-type climbing plant; look how it climbs.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那株沿着墙往上长的是什么植物？Toni：那是野豌豆类攀缘植物，你看它攀着往上长。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik il-pjanta li qed titla' mal-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik il-pjanta li qed titla' mal-ħajt?
messages.zh: 那株沿着墙往上长的是什么植物？
messages.en: What is that plant growing up the wall?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是野豌豆类攀缘植物，你看它攀着往上长。
messages.en: That's a vetch-type climbing plant; look how it climbs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 gerbejb 做两张独立图卡：一张画攀墙植物，一张画小碗；两个词义分别记，不强行联想来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To damage something or handle it roughly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西弄坏，或用粗暴、不小心的方式摆弄东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel ħsara lil xi ħaġa jew tużaha u tmexxiha b'mod goff u bla attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 损坏某物；把某物弄坏。
粗暴地摆弄、搬动或使用某物。

collocations.en: he handled the box roughly or damaged it
collocations.zh: 他粗暴地搬弄箱子，或把箱子弄坏了

collocations.en: he handled the toy roughly or damaged it
collocations.zh: 他粗暴地摆弄玩具，或把玩具弄坏了

formal.mt: Waqt it-trasport, il-ħaddiem gerbeġ il-kaxxa u għamel ħsara lill-kontenut tagħha.
formal.en: During transport, the worker handled the box roughly and damaged its contents.
formal.zh: 运输时，工人粗暴地搬弄箱子，损坏了里面的物品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-ġugarell m'għadux jaħdem? Toni: Pawlu gerbeġ il-ġugarell waqt il-logħob.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't this toy work anymore? Toni: Pawlu damaged the toy while playing.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个玩具怎么不能用了？Toni：Pawlu 玩的时候把它弄坏了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个玩具怎么不能用了？
messages.en: Why doesn't this toy work anymore?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 玩的时候把它弄坏了。
messages.en: Pawlu damaged the toy while playing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“粗手粗脚摆弄玩具”的画面记 gerbeġ：动作可强调粗暴摆弄，结果可强调弄坏东西。

gloss_zh: 可滚动的东西，通常为圆形物体

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object that can roll, typically because it is round.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够滚动的物体，通常指圆形或圆滚滚的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jista' jdur u jimxi fuq wiċċ, ġeneralment għax ikun tond.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that can roll (typically, sth. round)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够滚动的东西，通常是圆形物体。

collocations.zh: 一个能够滚动的木制物体

collocations.en: a rollable object on the floor
collocations.zh: 地上的一个可滚动物体

formal.mt: Għall-esperiment, tqiegħed gerbieb tal-injam fuq wiċċ inklinat biex jiġi osservat il-moviment tiegħu.
formal.en: For the experiment, a rollable wooden object was placed on a sloping surface so that its movement could be observed.
formal.zh: 实验中，一个可滚动的木制物体被放在斜面上，以观察它的运动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm taħt is-siġġu? Toni: Hemm gerbieb tal-injam; waqa' minn fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's under the chair? Toni: There's a rollable wooden object; it fell off the table.
colloquial.zh: Maja：椅子下面有什么？Toni：有个能滚动的木头物件，是从桌上掉下来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 椅子下面有什么？
messages.en: What's under the chair?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm gerbieb tal-injam; waqa' minn fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm gerbieb tal-injam; waqa' minn fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 有个能滚动的木头物件，是从桌上掉下来的。
messages.en: There's a rollable wooden object; it fell off the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 gerbieb 时想象桌上一件圆物滚落地面：这个名词指“能滚的东西”，不必限定为球。

gloss_zh: 可滚动的小物件，常为球或碗

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small object that can roll, often a ball or a bowl.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够滚动的小物件，常指小球或小碗等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir li jista' jdur u jimxi fuq wiċċ, bħal ballun jew skutella.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small rollable object (often a ball or bowl)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够滚动的小物件，通常是球或碗一类的东西。

collocations.zh: 一个可滚动的玻璃小物件

collocations.en: a small rollable object under the table
collocations.zh: 桌子下面的一个可滚动小物件

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività, it-tfal osservaw kif gerbieba tal-ħġieġ niżlet tul wiċċ inklinat.
formal.en: During the activity, the children observed a small rollable glass object moving down a sloping surface.
formal.zh: 活动中，孩子们观察了一个可滚动的玻璃小物件沿斜面向下运动的过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn marret il-gerbieba? Toni: Daħlet taħt il-mejda. Se nġibha jien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the little rollable object go? Toni: It went under the table. I'll get it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个能滚的小东西去哪儿了？Toni：跑到桌子下面了。我来拿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个能滚的小东西去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the little rollable object go?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Daħlet taħt il-mejda. Se nġibha jien.
messages.mt_standard: Daħlet taħt il-mejda. Se nġibha jien.
messages.zh: 跑到桌子下面了。我来拿。
messages.en: It went under the table. I'll get it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gerbieba 记成“滚到桌下的小东西”：记忆画面突出体积小、能够滚动，可联想到小球或小碗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to roll, or round or circular in shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物体能够滚动，或形状为圆形、圆环形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jdur u jimxi fuq wiċċ, jew li għandu forma tonda jew ta' ċirku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够滚动的；具有滚动能力的。
圆的；呈圆形或圆环形的。

collocations.zh: 能够滚动的物体；圆形物体

formal.mt: Għall-attività ntgħażel oġġett gerbiebi sabiex it-tfal setgħu josservaw kif jimxi fuq wiċċ inklinat.
formal.en: A rollable object was selected for the activity so that the children could observe how it moves on a sloping surface.
formal.zh: 活动选用了一个能够滚动的物体，让孩子们观察它如何在斜面上运动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan l-oġġett ma jibqax f'postu? Toni: Għax hu gerbiebi, u l-mejda mhix dritta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why won't this object stay in place? Toni: Because it can roll, and the table isn't level.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个东西怎么总待不住？Toni：因为它能滚，而且桌面不平。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan l-oġġett ma jibqax f'postu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan l-oġġett ma jibqax f'postu?
messages.zh: 这个东西怎么总待不住？
messages.en: Why won't this object stay in place?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu gerbiebi, u l-mejda mhix dritta.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu gerbiebi, u l-mejda mhix dritta.
messages.zh: 因为它能滚，而且桌面不平。
messages.en: Because it can roll, and the table isn't level.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 gerbiebi 配两幅图：圆形轮廓表示“圆的”，斜面上滚动表示“能滚的”；记住它是描述性质的形容词。

gloss_zh: 把事情弄混的人；做事杂乱的人；制造混乱的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who mixes things up, is disorderly, or creates confusion and disorder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指容易把事情弄混、做事杂乱，或给周围制造混乱的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħawwad l-affarijiet, ma żżommx l-ordni, jew toħloq konfużjoni u diżordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把事情或物品弄混的人。
做事杂乱、缺乏条理的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: a person who creates disorder or chaos
sense_translations.zh_definition: 制造混乱或造成秩序紊乱的人。

collocations.en: a person who mixes up the papers
a disorderly person who leaves everything lying around

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-gerfiex ħallat id-dokumenti u ħoloq konfużjoni fost il-ħaddiema.
formal.en: In the story, the person who muddled things up mixed up the documents and caused confusion among the workers.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个做事混乱的人把文件弄混了，导致工人们一头雾水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħallat il-karti kollha? Toni: Pawlu. Xi gerfiex! Issa rridu nerġgħu nqegħdu kollox fl-ordni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who mixed up all the papers? Toni: Pawlu. What a muddler! Now we have to put everything back in order.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把所有文件都弄混了？Toni：Pawlu。他可真会添乱！现在我们得重新整理。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 谁把所有文件都弄混了？
messages.en: Who mixed up all the papers?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu. Xi gerfiex! Issa rridu nerġgħu nqegħdu kollox fl-ordni.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu. Xi gerfiex! Issa rridu nerġgħu nqegħdu kollox fl-ordni.
messages.zh: Pawlu。他可真会添乱！现在我们得重新整理。
messages.en: Pawlu. What a muddler! Now we have to put everything back in order.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个把文件混在一起、东西乱放、让大家忙着收拾的人；gerfiex 指这个“人”，三个义项分别突出他的不同表现。

gloss_zh: 容易制造混乱的；爱把事情弄乱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to make things disorderly or confusing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或其做事方式容易造成杂乱、混淆或混乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jħawwad l-affarijiet jew joħloq diżordni u konfużjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to create disorder or confusion
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易制造杂乱或混乱的；有把事情弄混倾向的。

collocations.en: a person who tends to create confusion
collocations.zh: 一个容易把事情弄乱的人

collocations.en: a way of working that tends to create disorder
collocations.zh: 容易造成混乱的工作方式

formal.mt: Il-karattru huwa gerfiexi: kull meta jorganizza l-karti, jispiċċa jħallat id-dokumenti.
formal.en: The character tends to create disorder: whenever he organizes the papers, he ends up mixing up the documents.
formal.zh: 这个角色做事容易添乱：每次整理文件，最后都会把文件弄混。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu se jirranġa l-kexxun? Toni: Aħjar ngħinuh; hu gerfiexi u jista' jħallat kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu going to organize the drawer? Toni: We'd better help him; he tends to muddle things up and might mix everything together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 要整理抽屉吗？Toni：我们最好帮帮他，他做事容易弄乱，可能会把东西全混在一起。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: Pawlu 要整理抽屉吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu going to organize the drawer?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar ngħinuh; hu gerfiexi u jista' jħallat kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar ngħinuh; hu gerfiexi u jista' jħallat kollox.
messages.zh: 我们最好帮帮他，他做事容易弄乱，可能会把东西全混在一起。
messages.en: We'd better help him; he tends to muddle things up and might mix everything together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gerfiexi 放进“他做事容易添乱”来记，重点是描述倾向的形容词；与指人的名词 gerfiex 分开使用。

gloss_zh: 头脑混乱的；慌乱无序的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Confused or disordered in thought or behaviour, especially when a person cannot organize what to think or do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人思绪混乱或举止慌乱，无法理清想法或安排好行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun imħawwad fil-ħsieb jew fl-imġiba u ma jkunx jista' jorganizza sew dak li jaħseb jew jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头脑混乱的；思绪或举止无序的，指人。

formal.mt: Wara li sema' diversi struzzjonijiet differenti, l-istudent deher gerfuxi u talab spjegazzjoni oħra.
formal.en: After hearing several different instructions, the student looked confused and asked for another explanation.
formal.zh: 听到几种不同的指示后，这名学生显得思绪混乱，要求再解释一次。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tidher gerfuxi llum? Mark: Għandi ħafna x'nagħmel u ma nafx minn fejn nibda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you look so confused today? Mark: I have a lot to do and don't know where to start.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天怎么显得这么慌乱？马克：我有很多事要做，不知道从哪里开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么显得这么慌乱？
messages.en: Why do you look so confused today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħafna x'nagħmel u ma nafx minn fejn nibda.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħafna x'nagħmel u ma nafx minn fejn nibda.
messages.zh: 我有很多事要做，不知道从哪里开始。
messages.en: I have a lot to do and don't know where to start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gerfuxi 和一个面对满桌任务、脑中一团乱的人联系起来；记住这里主要形容人的混乱状态。

gloss_zh: 使不快；使厌恶；冒犯；使失望

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel irritated, displeased, disgusted, offended, or disappointed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到烦恼、不快、厌恶、受到冒犯或失望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss dwejjaq, stmerrija, offiża jew diżappunt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人烦恼或不快。
使人厌恶；使人反感。
冒犯；使人感到受辱或被得罪。
使人失望；辜负某人的期待。

formal.mt: Il-kumment bla rispett gerges lil diversi parteċipanti, u l-kelliem talab skuża.
formal.en: The disrespectful comment offended several participants, and the speaker apologized.
formal.zh: 这句不尊重人的评论冒犯了几名参与者，发言者随后道了歉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark telaq? Lara: Dak il-kumment gerges lil Mark; ħaseb li kont qed tidħaq bih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark leave? Lara: That comment offended Mark; he thought you were making fun of him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么走了？拉拉：那句话冒犯了马克；他以为你在嘲笑他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kumment gerges lil Mark; ħaseb li kont qed tidħaq bih.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kumment gerges lil Mark; ħaseb li kont qed tidħaq bih.
messages.zh: 那句话冒犯了马克；他以为你在嘲笑他。
messages.en: That comment offended Mark; he thought you were making fun of him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张逐渐皱起眉头的脸记 gerges：从不快、反感，到被冒犯或失望，都表示让别人产生负面感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn or spin around a centre or axis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕一个中心或轴转动、旋转。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idur madwar ċentru jew assi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旋转；绕着转圈。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, il-ġugarell gergex fuq il-mejda għal ftit sekondi qabel waqaf.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the toy spun on the table for a few seconds before stopping.
formal.zh: 演示时，玩具在桌面上旋转了几秒钟，然后停了下来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt kif gergex il-ġugarell? Mark: Iva, dam idur sakemm mess it-tarf tal-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see how the toy spun? Mark: Yes, it kept spinning until it touched the edge of the table.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到玩具怎么转了吗？马克：看到了，它一直转，直到碰到桌边。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到玩具怎么转了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how the toy spun?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dam idur sakemm mess it-tarf tal-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dam idur sakemm mess it-tarf tal-mejda.
messages.zh: 看到了，它一直转，直到碰到桌边。
messages.en: Yes, it kept spinning until it touched the edge of the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 gergex 时，在脑中播放一个玩具绕中心不停旋转的画面，用圆形运动来固定词义。

gloss_zh: 使人不快的人；惹人讨厌的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who causes displeasure or makes other people feel annoyed or unhappy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人感到不快、烦恼或不高兴的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġib id-dwejjaq lil ħaddieħor jew iġġiegħlu jħossu mhux kuntent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人不快的人；惹别人不高兴的人。

collocations.en: a person who causes displeasure in the group
a person who causes displeasure among colleagues

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-karattru ewlieni huwa gergies li jġiegħel lil sħabu jħossuhom skomdi bil-kummenti tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the main character is a person who causes displeasure, making his friends uncomfortable with his comments.
formal.zh: 故事中的主角是个惹人不快的人，他的评论让朋友们感到不自在。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħid li hu gergies? Lara: Għax kull darba li jiġi, jagħmel kummenti li jdejqu lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you say he's someone who causes displeasure? Lara: Because every time he comes, he makes comments that upset everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说他是个惹人不快的人？拉拉：因为他每次来，都说些让大家不高兴的话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个惹人不快的人？
messages.en: Why do you say he's someone who causes displeasure?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kull darba li jiġi, jagħmel kummenti li jdejqu lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba li jiġi, jagħmel kummenti li jdejqu lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为他每次来，都说些让大家不高兴的话。
messages.en: Because every time he comes, he makes comments that upset everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gergies 记成聚会里一开口就让大家皱眉的那个人；这是指人的名词，重点是他使别人不快。

gloss_zh: 令人不快的；令人失望的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing displeasure or disappointment, especially by being unpleasant or failing to meet expectations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因令人不舒服或未达到期待而使人不快、失望的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib id-dwejjaq jew id-diżappunt, speċjalment għax ma jilħaqx dak li wieħed jistenna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人不快的；使人不高兴的。
令人失望的；未达到期待的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iddeskriva r-riżultat bħala gergiesi, għax il-proġett ma laħaqx l-għanijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The report described the result as disappointing because the project did not achieve its goals.
formal.zh: 报告称这一结果令人失望，因为项目没有实现既定目标。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif kien il-film? Maja: Gergiesi; stennejt storja aħjar.
colloquial.en: Mark: How was the film? Maja: Disappointing; I expected a better story.
colloquial.zh: 马克：电影怎么样？玛雅：挺令人失望的；我本来期待故事更好一些。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影怎么样？
messages.en: How was the film?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 挺令人失望的；我本来期待故事更好一些。
messages.en: Disappointing; I expected a better story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 gergiesi 配上期待落空后的皱眉表情：用它评价令人不快的评论，或令人失望的结果。

gloss_zh: 爱抱怨的人；牢骚多的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who frequently complains or expresses dissatisfaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常抱怨、发牢骚或表达不满的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li spiss tgerger jew tilmenta u tesprimi n-nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱抱怨的人；经常发牢骚的人。

collocations.en: a person who grumbles about everything

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ġar huwa gergur li jilmenta kontinwament dwar l-istorbju u t-temp.
formal.en: In the novel, the neighbour is a grumbler who constantly complains about the noise and the weather.
formal.zh: 小说里的邻居是个爱发牢骚的人，不停抱怨噪声和天气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħid li Mark hu gergur? Lara: Għax jilmenta dwar kollox, anki meta kollox sejjer tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you say Mark is a grumbler? Lara: Because he complains about everything, even when everything is going well.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说马克是个爱发牢骚的人？拉拉：因为他什么都要抱怨，就算一切顺利也一样。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li Mark hu gergur?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li Mark hu gergur?
messages.zh: 你为什么说马克是个爱发牢骚的人？
messages.en: Why do you say Mark is a grumbler?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jilmenta dwar kollox, anki meta kollox sejjer tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jilmenta dwar kollox, anki meta kollox sejjer tajjeb.
messages.zh: 因为他什么都要抱怨，就算一切顺利也一样。
messages.en: Because he complains about everything, even when everything is going well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个对天气、饭菜、排队都要嘟囔抱怨的人，用这个具体人物记住名词 gergur。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very talkative, tending to speak at length and often more than other people want to hear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 话很多、容易长篇说个不停的，常使听者觉得说得过多。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem ħafna u fit-tul, xi drabi aktar milli jixtiequ jisimgħu l-oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喋喋不休的；絮叨的；话特别多的。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-ġar bħala raġel gerguri li jirrakkonta stejjer twal lil kull min jiltaqa' miegħu.
formal.en: The author describes the neighbour as a garrulous man who tells long stories to everyone he meets.
formal.zh: 作者把这位邻居描写成一个喋喋不休的男人，见到谁都要讲很长的故事。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex domt daqshekk għand il-ġar? Mark: Hu gerguri ħafna; beda storja u ma waqafx jitkellem!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you spend so long at the neighbour's? Mark: He's very talkative; he started a story and wouldn't stop talking!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么在邻居家待了那么久？马克：他话特别多；一讲起故事就说个不停！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么在邻居家待了那么久？
messages.en: Why did you spend so long at the neighbour's?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu gerguri ħafna; beda storja u ma waqafx jitkellem!
messages.mt_standard: Hu gerguri ħafna; beda storja u ma waqafx jitkellem!
messages.zh: 他话特别多；一讲起故事就说个不停！
messages.en: He's very talkative; he started a story and wouldn't stop talking!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gerguri 贴在一个不断冒出长长对话气泡的人旁边，提醒自己它形容话多，不一定是在抱怨。

gloss_zh: 使蒙上烟灰；弄脏；弄得邋遢

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover something with soot, or more generally to make something dirty or scruffy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物蒙上烟灰，也泛指把某物弄脏或弄得邋遢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi xi ħaġa bin-nugrufun, jew b'mod aktar ġenerali jagħmilha maħmuġa jew traskurata fid-dehra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使蒙上烟灰；用烟灰弄黑。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sth. scruffy or dirty
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物弄得邋遢或肮脏。

collocations.en: it covered the wall with soot
he dirtied the coat with mud

formal.mt: Id-duħħan min-nar germed il-ħajt bin-nugrufun, u kien meħtieġ tindif bir-reqqa.
formal.en: The smoke from the fire covered the wall with soot, and thorough cleaning was required.
formal.zh: 火产生的烟使墙壁蒙上了烟灰，因此需要仔细清洁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lill-kowt tiegħi? Mark: Skużani, il-kelb germed il-kowt bit-tajn meta qabeż fuqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to my coat? Mark: Sorry, the dog dirtied the coat with mud when it jumped on it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的外套怎么了？马克：对不起，狗跳到外套上，把它弄得都是泥。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的外套怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to my coat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, il-kelb germed il-kowt bit-tajn meta qabeż fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, il-kelb germed il-kowt bit-tajn meta qabeż fuqu.
messages.zh: 对不起，狗跳到外套上，把它弄得都是泥。
messages.en: Sorry, the dog dirtied the coat with mud when it jumped on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 germed：白墙被烟灰熏黑，干净外套被泥弄脏；共同点都是使原本干净的东西变脏。

gloss_zh: 使人或东西显得脏乱的东西；污物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that makes a person or thing look dirty, untidy, or scruffy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或物显得肮脏、不整洁或邋遢的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tħammeġ lil persuna jew oġġett u tagħtihom dehra traskurata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人或物显得脏乱、邋遢的东西。

collocations.zh: 使衣服显得脏乱的污物

collocations.en: to remove the grime that makes something look scruffy
collocations.zh: 清除使东西显得脏乱的污物

formal.mt: Qabel il-laqgħa, neħħa l-germied minn fuq il-ġakketta biex jidher pulit.
formal.en: Before the meeting, he removed the grime from his jacket so that he would look neat.
formal.zh: 开会前，他清除了夹克上的污物，让自己显得整洁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek il-germied fuq il-kmiem. Mark: Veru, se nnaddafhom qabel noħroġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: You've got grime on your sleeves. Mark: You're right, I'll clean them before I go out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的袖子上有污物。马克：确实，我出门前会把袖子清理干净。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的袖子上有污物。
messages.en: You've got grime on your sleeves.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 确实，我出门前会把袖子清理干净。
messages.en: You're right, I'll clean them before I go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象开会前拍掉袖子上的污物：germied 指让外表变邋遢的东西，可用“清除污物、恢复整洁”的画面记忆。

gloss_zh: 沾满烟灰的；肤色深的；邋遢的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Covered in soot; in a separate sense, having dark skin; or looking scruffy and untidy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指沾满烟灰，也可独立表示肤色深，或形容外表邋遢、不整洁；具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miksi bin-nugrufun; f'tifsira oħra, b'ġilda skura; jew b'dehra traskurata u mhux pulita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表面沾满烟灰或煤烟污垢的。
肤色较深的；此义描述肤色，不表示肮脏。
外表邋遢、不整洁的。

collocations.en: a worker covered in soot after cleaning the chimney
collocations.zh: 清理烟囱后沾满烟灰的工人

collocations.en: a scruffy man in torn clothes
collocations.zh: 穿着破衣服、外表邋遢的男子

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem kien germiedi wara li naddaf iċ-ċumnija, għalhekk biddel ħwejġu qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The worker was covered in soot after cleaning the chimney, so he changed his clothes before the meeting.
formal.zh: 工人清理烟囱后沾满了烟灰，因此在开会前换了衣服。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex int daqshekk germiedi? Pawlu: Għadni kif naddaft iċ-ċumnija; se ninħasel issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you so covered in soot? Pawlu: I've just cleaned the chimney; I'm going to wash now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么沾了这么多烟灰？保罗：我刚清理完烟囱，现在就去洗。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你怎么沾了这么多烟灰？
messages.en: Why are you so covered in soot?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni kif naddaft iċ-ċumnija; se ninħasel issa.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni kif naddaft iċ-ċumnija; se ninħasel issa.
messages.zh: 我刚清理完烟囱，现在就去洗。
messages.en: I've just cleaned the chimney; I'm going to wash now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张独立图片记忆：烟灰覆盖的工人、深肤色的人、衣着邋遢的人。三个义项分开记，切勿把肤色与脏乱混为一谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To infect someone or something, especially by transmitting a disease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或其他对象受到感染，尤其指传染疾病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikkawża infezzjoni f'persuna jew f'xi ħaġa, speċjalment billi jgħaddi marda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使感染，尤指使感染某种疾病。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-mikrobu gernes il-ferita.
formal.en: The report describes how the microbe infected the wound.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这种微生物如何使伤口发生感染。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara mill-ferita ta' Mark? Lara: Mikrobu gernes il-ferita, u t-tabib qed jieħu ħsiebha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to Mark's wound? Lara: A microbe infected it, and the doctor is treating it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克的伤口怎么了？拉拉：微生物使伤口感染了，医生正在处理。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克的伤口怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Mark's wound?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mikrobu gernes il-ferita, u t-tabib qed jieħu ħsiebha.
messages.mt_standard: Mikrobu gernes il-ferita, u t-tabib qed jieħu ħsiebha.
messages.zh: 微生物使伤口感染了，医生正在处理。
messages.en: A microbe infected it, and the doctor is treating it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gernes 放进“微生物→伤口→感染”的三步画面中，记住它强调使对象受到感染这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scratch repeatedly or continuously, keeping up the scratching action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复或持续地抓挠、刮擦，强调动作不断进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jobrox darba wara oħra jew għal ħin twil mingħajr ma jieqaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不停地抓挠；持续地刮擦。

collocations.zh: 不停地抓挠自己的手臂

formal.mt: Il-qattus gerref il-bieb għal diversi minuti sakemm xi ħadd fetaħlu.
formal.en: The cat kept scratching the door for several minutes until someone opened it for him.
formal.zh: 猫连续抓了好几分钟的门，直到有人给它开门。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'kien dak il-ħoss mal-bieb? Maja: Il-qattus gerref il-bieb għax ried jidħol.
colloquial.en: Mark: What was that noise at the door? Maja: The cat kept scratching the door because he wanted to come in.
colloquial.zh: 马克：刚才门口是什么声音？玛雅：猫想进来，所以一直在抓门。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 刚才门口是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise at the door?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qattus gerref il-bieb għax ried jidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qattus gerref il-bieb għax ried jidħol.
messages.zh: 猫想进来，所以一直在抓门。
messages.en: The cat kept scratching the door because he wanted to come in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象猫在门外连续发出抓抓抓的声音，用重复动作记 gerref：重点是持续抓挠，而不是只抓一下。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bite something repeatedly by gnawing it, or to eat it in small bites by nibbling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复啃咬某物，或以小口、一点点的方式咬食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jigdem xi ħaġa darba wara oħra, jew jiekol minnha ftit ftit b'gdim żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啃咬；用牙齿反复咬磨。
小口咬食；一点点地啃食。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, il-ġurdien gerrem biċċa njama ħdejn il-bieb.
formal.en: During the night, the mouse gnawed a piece of wood beside the door.
formal.zh: 夜里，老鼠啃咬了门旁的一块木头。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ben kiel xi ħaġa wara l-iskola? Maja: Iva, gerrem gallettina waqt li kien qed jaqra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Ben eat anything after school? Maja: Yes, he nibbled a biscuit while he was reading.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：本放学后吃东西了吗？玛雅：吃了，他一边看书，一边小口啃了一块饼干。

messages.speaker: Lara (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Ben kiel xi ħaġa wara l-iskola?
messages.mt_standard: Ben kiel xi ħaġa wara l-iskola?
messages.zh: 本放学后吃东西了吗？
messages.en: Did Ben eat anything after school?

messages.speaker: Maja (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, gerrem gallettina waqt li kien qed jaqra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, gerrem gallettina waqt li kien qed jaqra.
messages.zh: 吃了，他一边看书，一边小口啃了一块饼干。
messages.en: Yes, he nibbled a biscuit while he was reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅嘴部动作图记 gerrem：老鼠反复啃木头对应 gnaw，人小口咬饼干对应 nibble；共同点都是一点点咬。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel upset, distressed, or emotionally troubled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到难过、心烦或情绪不安。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mdejjaq jew imħasseb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人难过、心烦或情绪不安。

formal.mt: Il-messaġġ gerres lill-familja, li kienet qed tistenna aħbar tajba.
formal.en: The message upset the family, who had been expecting good news.
formal.zh: 这条消息使一家人很难过，因为他们原本期待的是好消息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark jidher imdejjaq? Lara: Il-kumment ta' sieħbu gerres lil Mark.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Mark look upset? Lara: His friend's comment upset him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么看起来不开心？拉拉：他朋友的一句话让他难过了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么看起来不开心？
messages.en: Why does Mark look upset?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumment ta' sieħbu gerres lil Mark.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumment ta' sieħbu gerres lil Mark.
messages.zh: 他朋友的一句话让他难过了。
messages.en: His friend's comment upset him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gerres 记成“一句话让笑脸变愁脸”的情境：关注对情绪造成的影响，常可译为使难过或使心烦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to feel regret about something that happened or a choice they made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人对已经发生的事情或作出的选择感到后悔、遗憾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiddispjaċih għal xi ħaġa li ġrat jew għal għażla li għamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人感到后悔或遗憾。

collocations.en: caused the decision-maker to feel regret
collocations.zh: 使作出决定的人感到后悔

collocations.mt: gerreż lil Mark għal żmien twil
collocations.zh: 使马克长时间感到后悔

formal.mt: L-iżball gerreż lil Pawlu għal żmien twil, għax kien seta' jevitah.
formal.en: The mistake caused Pawlu lasting regret because he could have avoided it.
formal.zh: 这个错误使保罗后悔了很久，因为他本来可以避免它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għadu jiddispjaċih li ma marx? Lara: Iva, il-fatt li tilef il-kunċert gerreż lil Mark ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Mark still regret not going? Lara: Yes, missing the concert caused him a lot of regret.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克还在后悔没去吗？拉拉：是啊，错过那场音乐会让他非常后悔。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark għadu jiddispjaċih li ma marx?
messages.mt_standard: Mark għadu jiddispjaċih li ma marx?
messages.zh: 马克还在后悔没去吗？
messages.en: Does Mark still regret not going?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-fatt li tilef il-kunċert gerreż lil Mark ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-fatt li tilef il-kunċert gerreż lil Mark ħafna.
messages.zh: 是啊，错过那场音乐会让他非常后悔。
messages.en: Yes, missing the concert caused him a lot of regret.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象错过音乐会后反复说“早知道就去了”，用这种回望过去的遗憾记 gerreż，突出事情使人后悔。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who scratches, whether scratching their own body or another surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做出抓挠或刮擦动作的人，可指抓自己的身体或抓擦其他表面的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tobrox ġisimha jew xi wiċċ ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓挠或刮擦的人。

collocations.en: a person who scratches the wall

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-gerrief ħalla marki fuq il-ħajt kull darba li għadda minn ħdejh.
formal.en: In the story, the person who scratched the wall left marks every time he passed it.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个抓刮墙壁的人每次从墙边经过，都会留下痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-gerrief li ħalla dawn il-marki fuq il-mejda? Ben: Kont jien; għamilthom bid-dwiefer.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's the scratcher who left these marks on the table? Ben: It was me; I made them with my fingernails.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：是谁在桌子上抓出了这些痕迹？本：是我，我用指甲抓的。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-gerrief li ħalla dawn il-marki fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-gerrief li ħalla dawn il-marki fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 是谁在桌子上抓出了这些痕迹？
messages.en: Who's the scratcher who left these marks on the table?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 是我，我用指甲抓的。
messages.en: It was me; I made them with my fingernails.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到抓痕就问“是谁抓的”，把答案中的那个人与 gerrief 联系起来；它是指人的名词，记住“做抓挠动作的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool resembling a hoe, used for turning the soil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种形似锄头、用来翻动土壤的农具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tixbah lil mgħażqa u tintuża biex tqalleb il-ħamrija.

sense_translations.en_definition: an implement for turning the soil (resembling a hoe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 翻动土壤用的工具，外形类似锄头。

collocations.en: a tool for turning the soil

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża gerriefa biex iqalleb il-ħamrija qabel iż-żrigħ.
formal.en: The worker used a hoe-like tool to turn the soil before sowing.
formal.zh: 工人在播种前用锄状工具翻动土壤。

colloquial.mt: Marta: B'liema għodda se nqalleb din il-ħamrija? Pawlu: Uża l-gerriefa; qiegħda ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Marta: Which tool should I use to turn this soil? Pawlu: Use the hoe-like tool; it's beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我该用哪件工具翻这块土？保罗：用那件锄状翻土工具，就在门边。

messages.speaker: Marta (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: B'liema għodda se nqalleb din il-ħamrija?
messages.mt_standard: B'liema għodda se nqalleb din il-ħamrija?
messages.zh: 我该用哪件工具翻这块土？
messages.en: Which tool should I use to turn this soil?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺老师)
messages.zh: 用那件锄状翻土工具，就在门边。
messages.en: Use the hoe-like tool; it's beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gerriefa 和播种前翻土的画面绑定：手里拿着像锄头的工具，把土一块块翻松。

gloss_zh: 粗糙扎人的；有刮擦感的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rough in a way that scratches or irritates the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容表面粗糙，接触皮肤时有刮擦或扎人的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinħass aħrax u jigrif jew jirrita l-ġilda meta jmissha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摸起来粗糙、接触皮肤时有刮擦感或扎人的。

formal.mt: Għal ħwejjeġ li jmissu direttament mal-ġilda, għandu jintgħażel drapp artab minflok drapp gerriefi.
formal.en: For clothing that touches the skin directly, soft fabric should be chosen instead of scratchy fabric.
formal.zh: 直接接触皮肤的衣物应选用柔软布料，避免使用扎人的布料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tridx tilbes dan il-flokk? Mark: Id-drapp gerriefi u qed jirritali għonqi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you want to wear this top? Mark: The fabric is scratchy and it's irritating my neck.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不想穿这件上衣？马克：布料太扎了，磨得我脖子难受。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx tilbes dan il-flokk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx tilbes dan il-flokk?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想穿这件上衣？
messages.en: Why don't you want to wear this top?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-drapp gerriefi u qed jirritali għonqi.
messages.mt_standard: Id-drapp gerriefi u qed jirritali għonqi.
messages.zh: 布料太扎了，磨得我脖子难受。
messages.en: The fabric is scratchy and it's irritating my neck.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 gerriefi 时想象粗羊毛擦过脖子：不是柔软舒服，而是粗糙扎人的触感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gnaws at things with their teeth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用牙齿反复啃咬东西的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tigdem u tomgħod affarijiet bis-snien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啃咬东西的人；啃咬者。

collocations.en: a person who gnaws on pencils
a person who gnaws at their nails

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-lezzjoni, il-kelma gerriem tirreferi għal tifel li joqgħod jigdem il-lapsijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: In the lesson's example, the word gerriem refers to a boy who keeps gnawing on his pencils.
formal.zh: 在本课的例子中，gerriem 指一个总是啃自己铅笔的男孩。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min gidem il-lapes tiegħi? Ben: Jien! Jien gerriem tal-lapsijiet meta nkun nervuż.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who chewed my pencil? Ben: I did! I'm a pencil gnawer when I'm nervous.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁啃了我的铅笔？本：我！我一紧张就成了啃铅笔的人。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 谁啃了我的铅笔？
messages.en: Who chewed my pencil?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! Jien gerriem tal-lapsijiet meta nkun nervuż.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! Jien gerriem tal-lapsijiet meta nkun nervuż.
messages.zh: 我！我一紧张就成了啃铅笔的人。
messages.en: I did! I'm a pencil gnawer when I'm nervous.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给啃铅笔的人贴上 gerriem 标签，记住这个名词回答的是“谁在啃”，重点是啃咬者。

gloss_zh: 有啃咬倾向的；爱啃东西的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to gnaw at things with the teeth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容有用牙齿啃咬东西的倾向或习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jigdem u jomgħod affarijiet bis-snien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有啃咬倾向的；容易或习惯啃东西的。

collocations.en: a boy inclined to gnaw at things

formal.mt: Annimal gerriemi jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-oġġetti tal-injam jekk jibqa' jigdimhom.
formal.en: An animal inclined to gnaw can damage wooden objects if it keeps biting them.
formal.zh: 有啃咬倾向的动物如果持续啃咬木制物品，可能会将其损坏。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed taħbi l-lapsijiet? Omm: Ħuk gerriemi; kull darba li jsib wieħed, jibda jigdmu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you hiding the pencils? Mum: Your brother likes gnawing at things; whenever he finds one, he starts chewing it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么把铅笔藏起来？妈妈：你弟弟爱啃东西，每次找到一支就开始啃。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 你为什么把铅笔藏起来？
messages.en: Why are you hiding the pencils?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk gerriemi; kull darba li jsib wieħed, jibda jigdmu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk gerriemi; kull darba li jsib wieħed, jibda jigdmu.
messages.zh: 你弟弟爱啃东西，每次找到一支就开始啃。
messages.en: Your brother likes gnawing at things; whenever he finds one, he starts chewing it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gerriemi 放在“爱啃东西的孩子”旁边记忆：它描述啃咬倾向，是形容词。

gloss_zh: 吓退他者的东西；驱吓物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that frightens others and makes them stay away or leave.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能吓住其他人或动物，使其远离或离开的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tbeżża' u ġġiegħel lil oħrajn jitbiegħdu jew jitilqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来或能够吓退其他人或动物的东西。

collocations.en: to be used as something that scares others off

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien tqiegħed gerriex biex ibiegħed l-għasafar miż-żrieragħ.
formal.en: Something to scare birds away was placed in the garden to keep them away from the seeds.
formal.zh: 花园里放置了一个驱鸟物，让鸟类远离种子。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex dendilt dawk iż-żigarelli mal-arblu? Toni: Se nużahom bħala gerriex għall-għasafar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you hang those ribbons on the pole? Toni: I'm going to use them to scare the birds away.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么把那些丝带挂在杆子上？托尼：我要把它们当作驱鸟的东西。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 你为什么把那些丝带挂在杆子上？
messages.en: Why did you hang those ribbons on the pole?

messages.speaker: Toni (园主)
messages.zh: 我要把它们当作驱鸟的东西。
messages.en: I'm going to use them to scare the birds away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鸟儿看见田里的驱吓物就飞走，把那个“使它们不敢靠近的东西”记为 gerriex。

gloss_zh: 引起恐惧的；使人逃离的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Frightening, or causing someone to run away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容会引起恐惧，或使人、动物逃离的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqajjem il-biża' jew iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jaħrab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起恐惧的；令人害怕的。
使人或动物逃离的；具有吓跑作用的。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss gerriexi tal-magna ġiegħel lill-għasafar jaħarbu mis-siġar.
formal.en: The machine's frightening sound made the birds flee from the trees.
formal.zh: 机器发出的吓人声音使鸟儿纷纷逃离树木。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ħrabt mill-kamra? Luqa: Smajt ħoss gerriexi u bżajt!
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you run out of the room? Luqa: I heard a frightening sound and got scared!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么从房间里跑出来？卢卡：我听见一个吓人的声音，害怕了！

messages.speaker: Marija (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你为什么从房间里跑出来？
messages.en: Why did you run out of the room?

messages.speaker: Luqa (弟弟)
messages.zh: 我听见一个吓人的声音，害怕了！
messages.en: I heard a frightening sound and got scared!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“听见声音，先害怕，再跑开”的连续画面记 gerriexi，分别对应引起恐惧和使其逃离两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who laments, or who is given to moaning and complaining.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 哀叹的人，也可指惯于发牢骚、抱怨的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tilmenta b'niket, jew li għandha d-drawwa tgerger u ssib xi tgħid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为不幸、损失等感到悲伤并发出哀叹的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. given to moaning or complaining
sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于发牢骚或抱怨的人。

collocations.en: a person who complains about everything

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-gerrież jesprimi n-niket tiegħu għat-telfa ta' ħabib.
formal.en: In the story, the lamenter expresses his sorrow over the loss of a friend.
formal.zh: 在故事中，哀叹者表达了自己失去朋友的悲痛。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed isejħulu gerrież? David: Għax dejjem isib xi ħaġa fuqiex igerger, anki meta kollox imur tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are they calling him a complainer? David: Because he always finds something to moan about, even when everything goes well.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：他们为什么叫他牢骚大王？戴维：因为他总能找到事情抱怨，连一切顺利时也一样。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 他们为什么叫他牢骚大王？
messages.en: Why are they calling him a complainer?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem isib xi ħaġa fuqiex igerger, anki meta kollox imur tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem isib xi ħaġa fuqiex igerger, anki meta kollox imur tajjeb.
messages.zh: 因为他总能找到事情抱怨，连一切顺利时也一样。
messages.en: Because he always finds something to moan about, even when everything goes well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 gerrież 配两幅人物图：一人因失去朋友而哀叹，另一人凡事都抱怨；靠情境区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 可能令人后悔的；能引起懊悔的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of causing someone to feel regret.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容可能使人产生后悔、懊悔之情的言行或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiddispjaċih.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the capacity to cause regret
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使人后悔或懊悔的可能性或作用的。

collocations.en: a comment that may cause regret

formal.mt: Aġir gerrieżi jista' jħalli lil min jaġixxi hekk jiddispjaċih għal żmien twil.
formal.en: Conduct capable of causing regret may leave the person who acts that way feeling sorry for a long time.
formal.zh: 可能招致后悔的行为，可能使做出这种行为的人长时间感到懊悔。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Se nibgħatlu dan il-messaġġ issa. Karl: Stenna ftit; fih kumment gerrieżi. Aqrah mill-ġdid meta tikkalma.
colloquial.en: Elena: I'm going to send him this message now. Karl: Wait a moment; it contains a comment you may regret. Read it again when you calm down.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我现在就把这条消息发给他。卡尔：等一下，里面有句话可能让你后悔。冷静下来再读一遍。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 我现在就把这条消息发给他。
messages.en: I'm going to send him this message now.

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; fih kumment gerrieżi. Aqrah mill-ġdid meta tikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; fih kumment gerrieżi. Aqrah mill-ġdid meta tikkalma.
messages.zh: 等一下，里面有句话可能让你后悔。冷静下来再读一遍。
messages.en: Wait a moment; it contains a comment you may regret. Read it again when you calm down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象按下发送键之前停一停：这句话可能让我后悔。用这个提醒记住 gerrieżi 的“能引起懊悔”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or animal that gnaws; also, a rodent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 啃咬东西的人或动物；也可指啮齿动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew annimal li jgerrem; ukoll annimal bħal ġurdien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啃咬东西的人或动物；啃咬者。
啮齿动物。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab gerrum żgħir ħdejn il-kaxxi tal-ikel.
formal.en: During the inspection, a small rodent was found beside the food boxes.
formal.zh: 检查时，在食品箱旁发现了一只小型啮齿动物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien hemm ħdejn il-kaxxa? Toni: Gerrum żgħir, qisu ġurdien.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was beside the box? Toni: A small rodent, like a mouse.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：箱子旁边刚才有什么？托尼：一只小型啮齿动物，像老鼠。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 箱子旁边刚才有什么？
messages.en: What was beside the box?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 一只小型啮齿动物，像老鼠。
messages.en: A small rodent, like a mouse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gerrum 联想成箱边啃木头的小动物：先记“啃咬者”，再连到“啮齿动物”。这是场景记忆法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to keep gnawing things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有不断啃咬东西的倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza li jgerrem l-affarijiet bla waqfien.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to gnaw continuously
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有持续啃咬倾向的；爱不停啃咬的。

collocations.en: an animal that tends to keep gnawing
a rabbit that tends to keep gnawing

formal.mt: Dan l-annimal huwa gerrumi u għandu tendenza li jgerrem l-oġġetti ta' madwaru.
formal.en: This animal tends to keep gnawing and is inclined to gnaw the objects around it.
formal.zh: 这只动物爱不停啃咬，常有啃咬周围物品的倾向。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-fenek tiegħek dejjem jgerrem xi ħaġa? Mark: Iva, huwa gerrumi ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is your rabbit always gnawing something? Mark: Yes, he really tends to keep gnawing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的兔子总是在啃东西吗？马克：是啊，它特别爱不停地啃。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fenek tiegħek dejjem jgerrem xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Il-fenek tiegħek dejjem jgerrem xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: 你的兔子总是在啃东西吗？
messages.en: Is your rabbit always gnawing something?

messages.speaker: Mark (宠物主人)
messages.zh: 是啊，它特别爱不停地啃。
messages.en: Yes, he really tends to keep gnawing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 gerrumi 时想象兔子啃完木条又啃纸箱，用“总爱啃个不停”的画面记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To talk nonsensically or to chatter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说没有条理或意义的话；也可指闲聊、叽叽喳喳地说话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titkellem bla sens jew tpaċpaċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡言乱语；说没有意义的话。
闲聊；叽叽喳喳地说话。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ir-raġel gerwex bla sens minflok wieġeb il-mistoqsija.
formal.en: During the meeting, the man talked nonsense instead of answering the question.
formal.zh: 会议期间，那名男子没有回答问题，而是胡言乱语了一通。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamel Pawlu waqt li kont qed issajjar? Sara: Gerwex miegħi dwar il-vaganza tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did Pawlu do while you were cooking? Sara: He chattered with me about his holiday.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你做饭的时候，保罗在做什么？萨拉：他和我闲聊他的假期。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel Pawlu waqt li kont qed issajjar?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel Pawlu waqt li kont qed issajjar?
messages.zh: 你做饭的时候，保罗在做什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do while you were cooking?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他和我闲聊他的假期。
messages.en: He chattered with me about his holiday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 gerwex 配两个画面：开会时说得没意义是“胡言乱语”，朋友间随意说话是“闲聊”，靠语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who talks too much.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话过多的人，常带有嫌对方话多的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem iżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 话太多的人；话痨。

collocations.en: a chatterbox who will not let you speak

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġar huwa gerwiel li ma jagħtix ċans lill-oħrajn jitkellmu.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbour is a chatterbox who gives others no chance to speak.
formal.zh: 故事中的邻居是个话痨，不给别人说话的机会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar il-vjaġġ ma' Leo? Toni: Leo gerwiel! Tkellem il-ħin kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the trip with Leo? Toni: Leo is a chatterbox! He talked the whole time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：和利奥一起出行怎么样？托尼：利奥是个话痨！他一路都在说。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 和利奥一起出行怎么样？
messages.en: How was the trip with Leo?

messages.speaker: Toni (旅伴)
messages.zh: 利奥是个话痨！他一路都在说。
messages.en: Leo is a chatterbox! He talked the whole time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gerwiel 记成旅途中一直讲话、让别人插不上话的同伴；它指“话多的人”，重点在人物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shake involuntarily, as when feeling cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体不由自主地颤抖，例如因寒冷而打寒战。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titriegħed, bħal meta tħoss il-bard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发抖；打寒战。

formal.mt: It-tifel gesges bil-bard waqt li kien qed jistenna barra.
formal.en: The boy shivered with cold while he was waiting outside.
formal.zh: 男孩在外面等候时冷得发抖。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tajt kutra lil Sam? Mark: Gesges bil-bard meta ħareġ mill-ilma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you give Sam a blanket? Mark: He shivered with cold when he came out of the water.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么给萨姆一条毯子？马克：他从水里出来时冷得发抖。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么给萨姆一条毯子？
messages.en: Why did you give Sam a blanket?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他从水里出来时冷得发抖。
messages.en: He shivered with cold when he came out of the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读 gesges 时配上肩膀轻轻抖动的动作，想象刚出水就冷得发抖，用动作记住“打寒战”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To draw information out of someone through questioning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过询问，从某人口中探出或问出信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġbed informazzjoni mingħand xi ħadd billi tistaqsih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从某人口中探出信息；向某人问出情况。

collocations.en: drew information out of his friend
collocations.zh: 从朋友口中探出了信息
为获取更多细节而探问

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur gess lill-parteċipant sakemm kiseb aktar dettalji dwar l-esperjenza tiegħu.
formal.en: The researcher drew information out of the participant until he obtained more details about the participant's experience.
formal.zh: 研究人员向参与者探问，直到问出了有关其经历的更多细节。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif sar jaf bid-data tal-festa? Sara: Gess lil ħuh sakemm qallu.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did he find out the date of the party? Sara: He drew it out of his brother by questioning him until he told him.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他怎么知道聚会日期的？萨拉：他向哥哥探问，直到哥哥告诉了他。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 他怎么知道聚会日期的？
messages.en: How did he find out the date of the party?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他向哥哥探问，直到哥哥告诉了他。
messages.en: He drew it out of his brother by questioning him until he told him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 gess 配上“通过提问把消息问出来”的画面：信息原本在对方那里，经过探问才到了自己这里。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To start speaking, especially after being silent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始说话，尤其指原先沉默的人开口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tibda titkellem, speċjalment wara li tkun kont sieket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始说话；开口讲话

collocations.en: he began talking after a long silence
collocations.zh: 他在长时间沉默之后开口了

formal.mt: Wara silenzju twil, ix-xhud gezz u spjega x'kien ra.
formal.en: After a long silence, the witness began talking and explained what he had seen.
formal.zh: 在长时间沉默之后，证人开口讲述了自己看到的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar Mark fil-laqgħa? Lara: Għall-ewwel baqa' sieket, imma mbagħad gezz u qal x'jaħseb.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark get on in the meeting? Lara: At first he stayed quiet, but then he began talking and said what he thought.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克在会上表现怎么样？拉拉：开始时他一直没说话，后来开口说了自己的想法。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克在会上表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark get on in the meeting?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-ewwel baqa' sieket, imma mbagħad gezz u qal x'jaħseb.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-ewwel baqa' sieket, imma mbagħad gezz u qal x'jaħseb.
messages.zh: 开始时他一直没说话，后来开口说了自己的想法。
messages.en: At first he stayed quiet, but then he began talking and said what he thought.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放在从安静到开口的瞬间记忆；再留意拼写中的 z 没有圆点，避免与 geżż 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A crowd or large gathering of people, or a large number of people or things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聚在一起的一群人或大型聚集，也可表示人或事物数量很多。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Folla jew ġemgħa kbira ta' nies, jew għadd kbir ta' nies jew affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人群；聚集在一起的一群人。
大型聚集；很多人聚在一起的场面。
大量；很大的数目。

formal.mt: Wara l-preżentazzjoni, il-kelliem wieġeb geġwieġa ta' mistoqsijiet mill-udjenza.
formal.en: After the presentation, the speaker answered a large number of questions from the audience.
formal.zh: 报告结束后，发言人回答了听众提出的大量问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hemm geġwieġa ta' nies ħdejn il-palk! Ben: Ejja noqogħdu hawn; minn hawn naraw tajjeb ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: There's a huge crowd near the stage! Ben: Let's stay here; we can see well from here too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：舞台旁边有一大群人！本：我们待在这里吧，这里也看得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm geġwieġa ta' nies ħdejn il-palk!
messages.mt_standard: Hemm geġwieġa ta' nies ħdejn il-palk!
messages.zh: 舞台旁边有一大群人！
messages.en: There's a huge crowd near the stage!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu hawn; minn hawn naraw tajjeb ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu hawn; minn hawn naraw tajjeb ukoll.
messages.zh: 我们待在这里吧，这里也看得很清楚。
messages.en: Let's stay here; we can see well from here too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象舞台前密集的人群，再想象听众提出的大量问题；两幅画面帮助记住 geġwieġa 的聚集与数量义。

gloss_zh: 一大群人；众人交谈的嘈杂声

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large group of people, or the noise produced by many people talking together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一大群人，也指许多人同时交谈所产生的嘈杂声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp kbir ta' nies, jew il-ħoss li jagħmlu ħafna nies jitkellmu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一大群人；人数众多的群体。

sense_translations.en_definition: the noise made by a large group of people talking
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一大群人交谈时发出的嘈杂声。

formal.mt: Il-geġwiġ tal-folla fis-sala għamilha diffiċli biex l-udjenza tisma' l-avviż.
formal.en: The chatter of the crowd in the hall made it difficult for the audience to hear the announcement.
formal.zh: 大厅里人群的嘈杂交谈声让听众难以听清通知。

colloquial.mt: Anna: B'dan il-geġwiġ kollu ma nistax nisma' x'qed tgħid. David: Ejja noħorġu ftit barra, fejn hemm inqas storbju.
colloquial.en: Anna: With all this chatter, I can't hear what you're saying. David: Let's step outside for a moment, where it's quieter.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这里人声太嘈杂，我听不清你在说什么。戴维：我们出去一会儿吧，外面安静些。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: B'dan il-geġwiġ kollu ma nistax nisma' x'qed tgħid.
messages.mt_standard: B'dan il-geġwiġ kollu ma nistax nisma' x'qed tgħid.
messages.zh: 这里人声太嘈杂，我听不清你在说什么。
messages.en: With all this chatter, I can't hear what you're saying.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noħorġu ftit barra, fejn hemm inqas storbju.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noħorġu ftit barra, fejn hemm inqas storbju.
messages.zh: 我们出去一会儿吧，外面安静些。
messages.en: Let's step outside for a moment, where it's quieter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 geġwiġ 配一张人群照片和一段交谈录音：照片提示一群人，录音提示他们发出的嘈杂声。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who wraps things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品包裹起来的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgeżwer l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包裹东西的人；包装者。

formal.mt: Il-geżwier tar-rigali juża karta u żigarelli biex jipprepara kull rigal.
formal.en: The gift wrapper uses paper and ribbons to prepare each gift.
formal.zh: 负责包礼物的人用包装纸和丝带包好每份礼物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jgeżwer dawn ir-rigali kollha? Toni: Jien il-geżwier illum; għaddili l-karta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to wrap all these gifts? Toni: I'm the gift wrapper today; pass me the paper.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些礼物全由谁来包？托尼：今天我是负责包装的人，把纸递给我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jgeżwer dawn ir-rigali kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jgeżwer dawn ir-rigali kollha?
messages.zh: 这些礼物全由谁来包？
messages.en: Who is going to wrap all these gifts?

messages.speaker: Toni (帮忙包装的朋友)
messages.zh: 今天我是负责包装的人，把纸递给我。
messages.en: I'm the gift wrapper today; pass me the paper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌边拿着包装纸和丝带的那个人，把 geżwier 贴在他身上，记住这个名词指“包装的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to wrap things up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够把物品包裹起来的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li kapaċi jgeżwer l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够把物品包裹起来的；会包东西的。

collocations.en: a worker who can wrap things
a person able to wrap things

formal.mt: Għal dan ix-xogħol hemm bżonn ħaddiem geżwieri li jista' jgeżwer oġġetti ta' daqsijiet differenti.
formal.en: This job requires a worker able to wrap objects of different sizes.
formal.zh: 这项工作需要一名会包装的工人，能够包裹不同大小的物品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min jista' jgeżwer dan il-vażun? Mark: Pawlu geżwieri; jista' jagħmel dan hu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who can wrap this vase? Mark: Pawlu can wrap things; he can do it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁能把这个花瓶包起来？马克：保罗会包东西，可以让他来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁能把这个花瓶包起来？
messages.en: Who can wrap this vase?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu geżwieri; jista' jagħmel dan hu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu geżwieri; jista' jagħmel dan hu.
messages.zh: 保罗会包东西，可以让他来。
messages.en: Pawlu can wrap things; he can do it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 geżwieri 时想象有人能把方盒和圆花瓶都包好，用“会包东西”记能力；这是描述能力的形容词。

gloss_zh: 包裹物的一层；夸张离奇的故事

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wrapping placed around an object; also, an exaggerated or unbelievable story.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围在物体外面的包裹层；也指夸大其词、令人难以相信的故事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kisja madwar oġġett; ukoll, storja esaġerata jew diffiċli biex temminha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 围在物体外面的包裹层或包裹物
夸张离奇、令人难以相信的故事

collocations.en: a tall story that nobody believes
collocations.zh: 一个谁也不信的夸张故事

formal.mt: Il-vażun għandu geżwira ta' drapp madwaru biex ikun protett waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The vase has a cloth wrapping around it to protect it during transport.
formal.zh: 花瓶外面包着一层布，以便在运输途中受到保护。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu qal li qabad ħuta ikbar mid-dgħajsa tiegħu. Lara: Dik geżwira! Jien ma nemminhiex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Paul said he caught a fish bigger than his boat. Lara: That's a tall story! I don't believe it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗说他钓到了一条比他的船还大的鱼。拉拉：那也太夸张了！我才不信。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu qal li qabad ħuta ikbar mid-dgħajsa tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu qal li qabad ħuta ikbar mid-dgħajsa tiegħu.
messages.zh: 保罗说他钓到了一条比他的船还大的鱼。
messages.en: Paul said he caught a fish bigger than his boat.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那也太夸张了！我才不信。
messages.en: That's a tall story! I don't believe it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张画面记忆：物体外面包一层布，故事外面添一层夸张；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 挤奶；从一只动物挤得的奶量

teaching_sense.en_definition: To draw milk from an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从动物的乳房中挤出奶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħleb annimal biex tiġbor il-ħalib tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给动物挤奶

sense_translations.en_definition: the quantity of milk obtained from an animal
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从一只动物挤得的奶量

collocations.en: the quantity of milk obtained from this goat
collocations.zh: 从这只母山羊挤得的奶量

formal.mt: Il-bidwi geżż il-baqra u kejjel il-ħalib li ġabar.
formal.en: The farmer milked the cow and measured the milk he collected.
formal.zh: 农民给母牛挤了奶，并测量了收集到的奶量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min geżż il-baqra dalgħodu? Mark: Missieri. Il-ħalib qiegħed fil-friġġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who milked the cow this morning? Mark: My father. The milk is in the fridge.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天早上是谁给母牛挤的奶？马克：我爸爸。奶放在冰箱里。

messages.speaker: Sara (农场帮手)
messages.zh: 今天早上是谁给母牛挤的奶？
messages.en: Who milked the cow this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (农民的儿子)
messages.zh: 我爸爸。奶放在冰箱里。
messages.en: My father. The milk is in the fridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把挤奶的双手和量奶的桶一起记住：动词说挤奶动作，名词说挤出来的奶量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who milks an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给动物挤奶的人，可以是农场里的挤奶工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħleb annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给动物挤奶的人

formal.mt: Il-geżżej b'esperjenza jżomm l-annimali kalmi waqt li jaħlibhom.
formal.en: The experienced milker keeps the animals calm while milking them.
formal.zh: 经验丰富的挤奶工在挤奶时会让动物保持平静。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-baqar? Toni: Dak il-geżżej. Jaħdem hawn kull filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is that man beside the cows? Toni: That's the milker. He works here every morning.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：母牛旁边的那个男人是谁？托尼：那是挤奶工。他每天早上都在这里工作。

messages.speaker: Nina (农场访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-baqar?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-baqar?
messages.zh: 母牛旁边的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man beside the cows?

messages.speaker: Toni (农场向导)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-geżżej. Jaħdem hawn kull filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-geżżej. Jaħdem hawn kull filgħodu.
messages.zh: 那是挤奶工。他每天早上都在这里工作。
messages.en: That's the milker. He works here every morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象农场里提着奶桶的工作人员，把这个词固定贴在人物身上，记住它指挤奶的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To milk an animal by drawing out the milk in separate squirts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给动物挤奶，使奶一股一股地喷出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħleb annimal billi toħroġ il-ħalib f'ġettijiet qosra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to milk an animal in squirts
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给动物挤奶，使奶一股一股地喷出

collocations.en: he milked the goat in squirts
collocations.zh: 他一股一股地给母山羊挤奶

collocations.en: he slowly milked the cow in squirts
collocations.zh: 他慢慢地给母牛挤奶，让奶一股一股地流出

formal.mt: Il-bidwi geżżeż il-mogħża, u l-ħalib ħareġ f'ġettijiet qosra fil-barmil.
formal.en: The farmer milked the goat in squirts, and the milk came out in short jets into the bucket.
formal.zh: 农民给母山羊挤奶，奶一小股一小股地喷进桶里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex smajt dak il-ħoss fil-barmil? Pawlu: Missieri geżżeż il-mogħża, u l-ħalib laqat il-qiegħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did I hear that sound in the bucket? Paul: My father milked the goat in squirts, and the milk hit the bottom.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我怎么听见桶里有那种声音？保罗：我爸爸在一股一股地给母山羊挤奶，奶打到了桶底。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场访客)
messages.zh: 我怎么听见桶里有那种声音？
messages.en: Why did I hear that sound in the bucket?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民的儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri geżżeż il-mogħża, u l-ħalib laqat il-qiegħ.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri geżżeż il-mogħża, u l-ħalib laqat il-qiegħ.
messages.zh: 我爸爸在一股一股地给母山羊挤奶，奶打到了桶底。
messages.en: My father milked the goat in squirts, and the milk hit the bottom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 默念一股、再一股，同时想象奶喷进桶里的节奏，突出这个词所表达的分股挤奶动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act dishonestly to deceive someone or gain an unfair advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用不诚实的手段欺骗别人，或为取得不公平的好处而作弊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqarraq b'xi ħadd jew taġixxi b'mod diżonest biex tikseb vantaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗；以不诚实的手段作弊

formal.mt: Il-plejer ggabba waqt il-logħba billi ħeba karta taħt il-mejda.
formal.en: The player cheated during the game by hiding a card under the table.
formal.zh: 那名玩家在游戏中把一张牌藏在桌子底下作弊。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex waqqaft il-logħba? Toni: Mark ggabba. Rajtu jħares lejn il-karti tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you stop the game? Toni: Mark cheated. I saw him looking at my cards.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么把游戏停下来了？托尼：马克作弊了。我看见他偷看我的牌。

messages.speaker: Nina (牌友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把游戏停下来了？
messages.en: Why did you stop the game?

messages.speaker: Toni (牌友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark ggabba. Rajtu jħares lejn il-karti tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Mark ggabba. Rajtu jħares lejn il-karti tiegħi.
messages.zh: 马克作弊了。我看见他偷看我的牌。
messages.en: Mark cheated. I saw him looking at my cards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人偷偷把纸牌藏到桌底，把这个具体画面与词形配对，记住欺骗和作弊的共同含义。

gloss_zh: 因年老而弯腰；年老背驼

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a bent or stooped posture because of old age.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因年纪大而身体弯曲，呈弯腰或驼背的姿态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollok dahrek mgħawweġ minħabba x-xjuħija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因年老而弯腰或背驼

collocations.en: he became stooped with old age
he became stooped over the years
collocations.zh: 他随着年岁增长而背驼了

formal.mt: Ir-raġel ggaffa bix-xjuħija, iżda baqa' jmur għal mixja qasira kuljum.
formal.en: The man became stooped with old age, but continued to take a short walk every day.
formal.zh: 这位男子因年老而背驼了，但仍然每天散一小会儿步。

colloquial.mt: Sara: In-nannu għadu jmur sal-ħanut bil-mixi? Mark: Iva, għalkemm ggaffa bix-xjuħija, għadu jimxi kuljum.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does Grandpa still walk to the shop? Mark: Yes, although he has become stooped with old age, he still walks every day.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：爷爷还会走路去商店吗？马克：会，虽然他年纪大了，背也驼了，但他每天还是走路。

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷还会走路去商店吗？
messages.en: Does Grandpa still walk to the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għalkemm ggaffa bix-xjuħija, għadu jimxi kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għalkemm ggaffa bix-xjuħija, għadu jimxi kuljum.
messages.zh: 会，虽然他年纪大了，背也驼了，但他每天还是走路。
messages.en: Yes, although he has become stooped with old age, he still walks every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与年长者略弯的背影联系起来，同时记住年老这一条件，别只记成一般的弯曲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tilt to one side, as a ship may do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向一边倾斜，例如船身发生侧倾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tmil lejn naħa waħda, bħalma jista' jagħmel bastiment.

sense_translations.en_definition: to list (to tilt to one side)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 向一侧倾斜，尤可用于描述船身侧倾

formal.mt: Il-bastiment ggalluna lejn il-lemin meta ċċaqalqet it-tagħbija.
formal.en: The ship listed to the right when the cargo shifted.
formal.zh: 货物移位时，船身向右侧倾斜了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-bastiment ggalluna lejn naħa waħda? Pawlu: Għax it-tagħbija ċċaqalqet lejn dik in-naħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the ship list to one side? Paul: Because the cargo shifted to that side.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：船为什么向一边倾斜了？保罗：因为货物移到了那一边。

messages.speaker: Lara (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-bastiment ggalluna lejn naħa waħda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-bastiment ggalluna lejn naħa waħda?
messages.zh: 船为什么向一边倾斜了？
messages.en: Why did the ship list to one side?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (船员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax it-tagħbija ċċaqalqet lejn dik in-naħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax it-tagħbija ċċaqalqet lejn dik in-naħa.
messages.zh: 因为货物移到了那一边。
messages.en: Because the cargo shifted to that side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一艘左右不平的船，在较低的一侧画箭头，再把词写在旁边，记住向一侧倾斜的方向感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To coat iron or steel with zinc to protect it from rust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在铁或钢的表面镀上一层锌，以防生锈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi l-ħadid jew l-azzar b'saff taż-żingu biex jipproteġih mis-sadid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给铁或钢镀锌，使其不易生锈。

formal.mt: Il-manifattur ggalvanizza l-partijiet tal-azzar biex jipproteġihom mis-sadid.
formal.en: The manufacturer galvanized the steel parts to protect them from rust.
formal.zh: 制造商给钢制零件镀了锌，以防生锈。
