colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ħaddiem ggalvanizza l-grada? Pawlu: Iva, issa għandha saff taż-żingu li jipproteġiha mis-sadid.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the worker galvanize the gate? Pawlu: Yes, it now has a layer of zinc that protects it from rust.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：工人给大门镀锌了吗？保罗：镀了，现在门上有一层锌，可以防锈。

messages.speaker: Lara (屋主)
messages.zh: 工人给大门镀锌了吗？
messages.en: Did the worker galvanize the gate?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandha saff taż-żingu li jipproteġiha mis-sadid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandha saff taż-żingu li jipproteġiha mis-sadid.
messages.zh: 镀了，现在门上有一层锌，可以防锈。
messages.en: Yes, it now has a layer of zinc that protects it from rust.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和铁门穿上“锌外衣”的画面一起记：外面多一层锌，里面的铁就受到保护。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join others in acting against a person or another group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与其他人结成一伙，共同针对某个人或另一个群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħaqad ma' oħrajn biex jaġixxu flimkien kontra persuna jew grupp ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结伙对付某人；联合起来针对某人或某个群体。

collocations.mt: ggangja ma' sħabu kontra xi ħadd
collocations.en: gang up with his friends against someone

formal.mt: Grupp ta' studenti ggangja kontra student ġdid, u l-għalliema intervjeniet biex twaqqaf l-imġiba.
formal.en: A group of students ganged up on a new student, and the teacher intervened to stop the behavior.
formal.zh: 一群学生结伙针对一名新生，老师介入制止了这种行为。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Mark telaq mil-logħba? Adam: Il-grupp ggangja kontrih, u ħassu waħdu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Mark leave the game? Adam: The group ganged up on him, and he felt alone.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克为什么退出游戏了？亚当：那群人联合起来针对他，他觉得自己孤立无援。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么退出游戏了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave the game?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-grupp ggangja kontrih, u ħassu waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-grupp ggangja kontrih, u ħassu waħdu.
messages.zh: 那群人联合起来针对他，他觉得自己孤立无援。
messages.en: The group ganged up on him, and he felt alone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个人站到同一边，一起指向一个人；用“结成一伙、共同针对”的场景记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To promise that something is true or will happen, or to make certain that a result is achieved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承诺某事属实或一定会发生，或者采取措施确保某种结果实现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti assigurazzjoni li xi ħaġa hija vera jew se sseħħ, jew jiżgura li jinkiseb riżultat.

sense_translations.en_definition: to guarantee, to warrant, to ensure, to assure
sense_translations.zh_definition: 保证；担保；确保；向某人作出保证，使其放心。

formal.mt: Il-fornitur ggarantixxa li l-ordni tasal sad-data miftiehma.
formal.en: The supplier guaranteed that the order would arrive by the agreed date.
formal.zh: 供应商保证订单会在约定日期之前送达。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Żgur li l-mejda tasal sal-Ġimgħa? David: Il-bejjiegħ ggarantixxa li tasal sa dakinhar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are we sure the table will arrive by Friday? David: The seller guaranteed that it would arrive by then.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：桌子确定能在星期五之前送到吗？戴维：卖家保证到那时一定送到。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 桌子确定能在星期五之前送到吗？
messages.en: Are we sure the table will arrive by Friday?

messages.speaker: David (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bejjiegħ ggarantixxa li tasal sa dakinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bejjiegħ ggarantixxa li tasal sa dakinhar.
messages.zh: 卖家保证到那时一定送到。
messages.en: The seller guaranteed that it would arrive by then.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“卖家拍胸口保证按时送到”的场景，联系质量保证、付款担保和确保结果一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rinse the throat by holding liquid at the back of the mouth and bubbling air through it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把液体含在口腔后部，通过呼气使其发出咕噜声，借此漱洗喉部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laħlaħ il-gerżuma billi jżomm likwidu fuq wara tal-ħalq u jgħaddi l-arja minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含着液体发出咕噜声以漱洗喉部；漱喉。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant gгargarizza bl-ilma u mbagħad beżqu fis-sink.
formal.en: The participant gargled with water and then spat it into the sink.
formal.zh: 参与者用水漱了喉，然后把水吐进洗手池。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'kien dak il-ħoss mill-kamra tal-banju? Leo: Pawlu gгargarizza bl-ilma; issa spiċċa.
colloquial.en: Marta: What was that sound from the bathroom? Leo: Pawlu was gargling with water; he has finished now.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：刚才浴室里是什么声音？莱奥：保罗在用水漱喉，现在已经好了。

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.zh: 刚才浴室里是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound from the bathroom?

messages.speaker: Leo (家人)
messages.zh: 保罗在用水漱喉，现在已经好了。
messages.en: Pawlu was gargling with water; he has finished now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读时配上漱喉的“咕噜咕噜”声音，把词形和含水漱喉的动作一起记；这是学习联想。

gloss_zh: 用榫舌与凹槽接合；榫槽拼接

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join pieces of wood by fitting a projecting tongue into a matching groove.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将一块木料突出的榫舌嵌入另一块木料相应的凹槽，使两者接合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad biċċiet tal-injam billi jdaħħal ilsien ta' biċċa waħda f'kanal li jaqbel miegħu f'biċċa oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to feather, to join by a tongue and groove
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用榫舌和凹槽接合木料；进行榫槽拼接。

collocations.en: join two boards with a tongue-and-groove joint
join the floorboards with tongue-and-groove joints

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa ggargna ż-żewġ twavel billi daħħal l-ilsien ta' waħda fil-kanal tal-oħra.
formal.en: The carpenter joined the two boards by fitting the tongue of one into the groove of the other.
formal.zh: 木匠把一块木板的榫舌嵌入另一块的凹槽，将两块木板拼接起来。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif għaqqadhom dawn iż-żewġ twavel? Toni: Il-mastrudaxxa ggargnahom; l-ilsien ta' waħda jidħol fil-kanal tal-oħra.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did he join these two boards? Toni: The carpenter used a tongue-and-groove joint; the tongue of one fits into the groove of the other.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：他是怎么把这两块木板接起来的？托尼：木匠用了榫槽拼接，一块的榫舌嵌进另一块的凹槽。

messages.speaker: Anna (学徒)
messages.zh: 他是怎么把这两块木板接起来的？
messages.en: How did he join these two boards?

messages.speaker: Toni (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mastrudaxxa ggargnahom; l-ilsien ta' waħda jidħol fil-kanal tal-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Il-mastrudaxxa ggargnahom; l-ilsien ta' waħda jidħol fil-kanal tal-oħra.
messages.zh: 木匠用了榫槽拼接，一块的榫舌嵌进另一块的凹槽。
messages.en: The carpenter used a tongue-and-groove joint; the tongue of one fits into the groove of the other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两块木板，一边凸出、一边凹进，再把它们拼合；用“凸榫进入凹槽”的动作记这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To expose a place, a person, or a thing to gas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某处施放气体，或使人、物暴露于气体中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesponi post, persuna jew ħaġa għal gass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用气体处理；向某处施放气体；使人或物受到气体作用。

collocations.zh: 对仓库施放气体进行处理

formal.mt: It-tim speċjalizzat ggassja l-maħżen bħala parti mit-trattament kontra l-insetti.
formal.en: The specialist team gassed the warehouse as part of the treatment against insects.
formal.zh: 专业团队对仓库进行了气体处理，作为除虫作业的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'għamel it-tim fil-maħżen illum? Mark: Ggassja l-maħżen biex jeqred l-insetti.
colloquial.en: Rita: What did the team do in the warehouse today? Mark: They gassed the warehouse to get rid of the insects.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：团队今天在仓库做了什么？马克：他们对仓库进行了气体处理，以消灭虫害。

messages.speaker: Rita (仓库管理员)
messages.zh: 团队今天在仓库做了什么？
messages.en: What did the team do in the warehouse today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 他们对仓库进行了气体处理，以消灭虫害。
messages.en: They gassed the warehouse to get rid of the insects.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与英文 gas 配对记忆，再想象气体进入一个待处理的空间；重点记住“施放气体”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To coat something with gum or attach it using gum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体表面涂上胶，或用胶把东西粘合起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi xi ħaġa bil-gomma li twaħħal, jew iwaħħalha biha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某物涂胶；用胶粘贴或粘合。

collocations.en: gum the back of the label
gum the edge of the paper

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ggomma d-dahar tat-tikketta qabel waħħalha mal-kaxxa.
formal.en: The worker gummed the back of the label before attaching it to the box.
formal.zh: 工人先给标签背面涂胶，再把它贴到箱子上。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Din it-tikketta lesta biex inwaħħalha? Ben: Iva, Pawlu diġà ggomma d-dahar tagħha.
colloquial.en: Ella: Is this label ready for me to stick on? Ben: Yes, Pawlu has already gummed its back.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：这张标签可以直接贴了吗？本：可以，保罗已经在背面涂好胶了。

messages.speaker: Ella (店员)
messages.zh: 这张标签可以直接贴了吗？
messages.en: Is this label ready for me to stick on?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Pawlu diġà ggomma d-dahar tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Pawlu diġà ggomma d-dahar tagħha.
messages.zh: 可以，保罗已经在背面涂好胶了。
messages.en: Yes, Pawlu has already gummed its back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给标签背面刷上一层黏胶，再把标签贴到箱子上；把“涂胶”和“粘合”两个动作连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To conduct a war against another country, ruler, or opposing force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对另一个国家、统治者或敌对力量进行战争。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel gwerra kontra pajjiż, ħakkiem jew forza avversarja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行战争；对敌对一方作战。

collocations.en: wage war against the neighboring kingdom

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ir-re ggwerra kontra r-renju ġar għal ħafna snin qabel intlaħaq ftehim ta' paċi.
formal.en: In the novel, the king waged war against the neighboring kingdom for many years before a peace agreement was reached.
formal.zh: 小说中，国王与邻国交战多年，双方才达成和平协议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel ir-re f'dan il-kapitlu? Luke: Ggwerra kontra r-renju ġar, imma fl-aħħar aċċetta l-paċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the king do in this chapter? Luke: He waged war against the neighboring kingdom, but eventually accepted peace.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：国王在这一章做了什么？卢克：他与邻国交战，但最后接受了和平。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 国王在这一章做了什么？
messages.en: What did the king do in this chapter?

messages.speaker: Luke (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ggwerra kontra r-renju ġar, imma fl-aħħar aċċetta l-paċi.
messages.mt_standard: Ggwerra kontra r-renju ġar, imma fl-aħħar aċċetta l-paċi.
messages.zh: 他与邻国交战，但最后接受了和平。
messages.en: He waged war against the neighboring kingdom, but eventually accepted peace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在阅读笔记中画出两个交战王国，并在它们之间写上这个动词，用“进行战争”的完整场景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bite or chew something repeatedly, gradually wearing it away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复用牙齿啃咬某物，使其逐渐磨损或减少。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jigdem jew jomgħod xi ħaġa ripetutament, u ftit ftit inaqqasha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啃；反复啃咬

formal.mt: Il-ġurdien giddem l-injam tal-bieb u ħalla marki żgħar.
formal.en: The mouse gnawed the wood of the door and left small marks.
formal.zh: 老鼠啃咬了门上的木头，留下了细小的痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex hemm dawn il-marki fuq il-lapes? Pawlu: Ħija giddem il-lapes waqt li kien jaħseb.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are there these marks on the pencil? Pawlu: My brother gnawed the pencil while he was thinking.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：铅笔上怎么有这些痕迹？保罗：我弟弟想事情的时候啃了铅笔。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dawn il-marki fuq il-lapes?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dawn il-marki fuq il-lapes?
messages.zh: 铅笔上怎么有这些痕迹？
messages.en: Why are there these marks on the pencil?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija giddem il-lapes waqt li kien jaħseb.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija giddem il-lapes waqt li kien jaħseb.
messages.zh: 我弟弟想事情的时候啃了铅笔。
messages.en: My brother gnawed the pencil while he was thinking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象铅笔被反复啃出牙印，用这个连续动作记住 giddem 的“啃咬”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who lies habitually or compulsively; an emphatic form of 'giddieb'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人惯于或不由自主地撒谎，语气比 giddieb 更强，可理解为“大骗子”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jigdeb ta' spiss jew bla kontroll; forma aktar qawwija ta' 'giddieb'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a habitual or compulsive liar (the augmentative form of 'giddieb')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于或不由自主地撒谎的；大骗子（giddieb 的增大形式，语气更强）

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist huwa raġel giddibun li jitlef il-fiduċja ta' ħbiebu.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist is a habitual liar who loses his friends' trust.
formal.zh: 小说中的主人公惯于撒谎，最终失去了朋友们的信任。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Temmnu meta jgħid li rebaħ premju ieħor? Mark: Le, dak giddibun; kull darba jirrakkonta storja differenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you believe him when he says he won another prize? Mark: No, he's a habitual liar; every time he tells a different story.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他说自己又得奖了，你信他吗？马克：不信，他就是个大骗子，每次讲的都不一样。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Temmnu meta jgħid li rebaħ premju ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Temmnu meta jgħid li rebaħ premju ieħor?
messages.zh: 他说自己又得奖了，你信他吗？
messages.en: Do you believe him when he says he won another prize?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak giddibun; kull darba jirrakkonta storja differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak giddibun; kull darba jirrakkonta storja differenti.
messages.zh: 不信，他就是个大骗子，每次讲的都不一样。
messages.en: No, he's a habitual liar; every time he tells a different story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 giddibun 配上“又在编故事”的人物画面，记住它强调惯常撒谎。

teaching_sense.en_definition: False or untruthful, especially when describing words or statements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 虚假的、不真实的，尤其用于描述言语或陈述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Falz jew li ma jgħidx il-verità, speċjalment dwar kliem jew stqarrijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虚假的；不真实的
谎言；不符合事实的话

formal.mt: L-awtur juri kif kliem giddiebi jista' jagħmel ħsara lir-relazzjonijiet bejn in-nies.
formal.en: The author shows how untruthful words can damage relationships between people.
formal.zh: 作者展示了不实的话语如何损害人与人之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qal li l-ħanut se jagħlaq għal dejjem. Tumas: Dak diskors giddiebi; għadni kif tkellimt mas-sid.
colloquial.en: Nina: He said the shop is going to close forever. Tumas: That's false talk; I've just spoken to the owner.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他说这家店要永久关门了。图马斯：那是骗人的话，我刚跟店主说过话。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li l-ħanut se jagħlaq għal dejjem.
messages.mt_standard: Qal li l-ħanut se jagħlaq għal dejjem.
messages.zh: 他说这家店要永久关门了。
messages.en: He said the shop is going to close forever.

messages.speaker: Tumas (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak diskors giddiebi; għadni kif tkellimt mas-sid.
messages.mt_standard: Dak diskors giddiebi; għadni kif tkellimt mas-sid.
messages.zh: 那是骗人的话，我刚跟店主说过话。
messages.en: That's false talk; I've just spoken to the owner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 giddiebi 放进“虚假的话语”这个搭配中，连着记住虚假与谎言两层意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to bite, especially when describing an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易咬人或咬东西的，尤其用于形容动物具有这种倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jigdem, speċjalment meta jingħad għal annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有咬人或咬东西的倾向的；爱咬的

collocations.en: a dog that tends to bite
an animal with a tendency to bite

formal.mt: Il-persunal għandu joqgħod attent meta jieħu ħsieb annimal giddiemi.
formal.en: Staff should take care when looking after an animal with a tendency to bite.
formal.zh: 工作人员照料有咬人倾向的动物时应当小心。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' mmiss il-kelb? Ġanni: Aħjar le, huwa giddiemi meta jibża'.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I pet the dog? Ġanni: Better not; he tends to bite when he's scared.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我能摸摸这只狗吗？詹尼：最好别摸，它害怕的时候容易咬人。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.zh: 我能摸摸这只狗吗？
messages.en: Can I pet the dog?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar le, huwa giddiemi meta jibża'.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar le, huwa giddiemi meta jibża'.
messages.zh: 最好别摸，它害怕的时候容易咬人。
messages.en: Better not; he tends to bite when he's scared.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象狗笼上的“爱咬人”提示牌，用 giddiemi 记一种倾向或习性。

gloss_zh: 摩羯座（星座；黄道十二宫之一）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name Capricorn, referring either to the constellation or to the zodiac sign.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摩羯座的名称，可指天文学中的星座，也可指占星学中的黄道星座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem li jirreferi kemm għal kostellazzjoni kif ukoll għal sinjal taż-żodijaku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摩羯座，天文学中的星座
摩羯座，占星学中的黄道星座

collocations.zh: 摩羯宫；黄道星座摩羯座

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-astronomija, l-istudenti fittxew il-kostellazzjoni ta' Gidi l-Kbir fuq mappa tas-sema.
formal.en: In the astronomy lesson, the students looked for the constellation Capricorn on a sky map.
formal.zh: 天文课上，学生们在星图上寻找摩羯座。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema sinjal taż-żodijaku għandek? Luqa: Gidi l-Kbir. U int?
colloquial.en: Maja: What's your zodiac sign? Luqa: Capricorn. And yours?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是什么星座？卢卡：摩羯座。你呢？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是什么星座？
messages.en: What's your zodiac sign?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 摩羯座。你呢？
messages.en: Capricorn. And yours?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Gidi l-Kbir 配两张卡片：星图上的摩羯座，以及聊天时说的摩羯星座。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use the teeth to grip or cut into something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用牙齿咬住或咬入某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqbad jew jaqta' xi ħaġa bis-snien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咬；用牙齿咬住或咬入

formal.mt: It-tifel ginda t-tuffieħa u mbagħad poġġieha fuq il-platt.
formal.en: The boy bit the apple and then placed it on the plate.
formal.zh: 男孩咬了苹果，然后把它放在盘子上。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min ginda t-tuffieħa tiegħi? Ben: Ħija ż-żgħir. Ħa nġiblek oħra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who bit my apple? Ben: My little brother. Let me get you another one.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁咬了我的苹果？本：我弟弟。我给你拿另一个。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁咬了我的苹果？
messages.en: Who bit my apple?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 我弟弟。我给你拿另一个。
messages.en: My little brother. Let me get you another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象苹果上留下一个清楚的牙印，把 ginda 与“咬一口”的动作相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in Central Africa whose official name is the Republic of Equatorial Guinea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于中非的国家，正式名称为赤道几内亚共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika Ċentrali bl-isem uffiċjali Ir-Repubblika tal-Ginea Ekwatorjali.

sense_translations.en_definition: Equatorial Guinea (a country in Central Africa; official name: Ir-Repubblika tal-Ginea Ekwatorjali).
sense_translations.zh_definition: 赤道几内亚，中非国家；正式名称为赤道几内亚共和国。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta informazzjoni ġenerali dwar il-Ginea Ekwatorjali, pajjiż fl-Afrika Ċentrali.
formal.en: The report presents general information about Equatorial Guinea, a country in Central Africa.
formal.zh: 这份报告介绍了中非国家赤道几内亚的基本情况。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn hi l-Ginea Ekwatorjali fuq din il-mappa? David: Fl-Afrika Ċentrali. Ejja nfittxuha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where is Equatorial Guinea on this map? David: In Central Africa. Let's look for it together.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这张地图上，赤道几内亚在哪里？戴维：在中非。我们一起找找。

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-Ginea Ekwatorjali fuq din il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-Ginea Ekwatorjali fuq din il-mappa?
messages.zh: 这张地图上，赤道几内亚在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Equatorial Guinea on this map?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 在中非。我们一起找找。
messages.en: In Central Africa. Let's look for it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把完整名称 Ginea Ekwatorjali 写在中非地图卡片上，与中文“赤道几内亚”整体配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grind something into coarse particles rather than a fine powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物磨成较粗的颗粒，而非细粉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħan xi ħaġa f'biċċiet żgħar u ħoxnin, mingħajr ma jagħmilha trab fin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗磨；磨成粗颗粒

formal.mt: Il-bidwi girex il-qamħ u ġabar il-frak oħxon f'kontenitur.
formal.en: The farmer ground the wheat coarsely and collected the coarse particles in a container.
formal.zh: 农民把小麦磨成粗粒，并将粗粒收集在容器里。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex dan il-qamħ għadu daqshekk oħxon? Toni: Missieri girex il-qamħ; ma għamlux dqiq fin.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is this wheat still so coarse? Toni: My father ground the wheat coarsely; he didn't turn it into fine flour.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这些小麦怎么还这么粗？托尼：我爸爸只是把小麦粗磨了一下，没有磨成细面粉。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-qamħ għadu daqshekk oħxon?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-qamħ għadu daqshekk oħxon?
messages.zh: 这些小麦怎么还这么粗？
messages.en: Why is this wheat still so coarse?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri girex il-qamħ; ma għamlux dqiq fin.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri girex il-qamħ; ma għamlux dqiq fin.
messages.zh: 我爸爸只是把小麦粗磨了一下，没有磨成细面粉。
messages.en: My father ground the wheat coarsely; he didn't turn it into fine flour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象磨盘旁仍看得见颗粒的麦子，用 girex 记住“磨过但颗粒仍粗”的状态。

gloss_zh: 哀叹；哼哼抱怨；（牛）哞哞叫

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express sorrow or dissatisfaction with a complaining sound, or, of a cow, to moo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用哀叹或哼哼声表达悲伤、不满；用于牛时，表示发出哞哞声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi niket jew dwejjaq b'leħen ta' tgergir, jew, meta jintuża għall-baqar, jagħmel il-ħoss tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为不幸、损失等哀叹。
用哼哼唧唧的声音抱怨。
（用于牛）发出哞哞叫声。

formal.mt: Wara li sema' l-aħbar, ir-raġel gireż minħabba t-telf.
formal.en: After hearing the news, the man bemoaned the loss.
formal.zh: 听到消息后，那名男子为损失而哀叹。

colloquial.mt: Marija: It-tifel gireż il-ħin kollu fil-karozza. Pawlu: Forsi kien għajjien; issa ħallih jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: The boy whined the whole time in the car. Pawlu: Perhaps he was tired; let him rest now.
colloquial.zh: Marija：那孩子在车上一直哼哼唧唧。Pawlu：他可能累了，现在让他休息吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 那孩子在车上一直哼哼唧唧。
messages.en: The boy whined the whole time in the car.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi kien għajjien; issa ħallih jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi kien għajjien; issa ħallih jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 他可能累了，现在让他休息吧。
messages.en: Perhaps he was tired; let him rest now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项画成三幅发声图：失落者哀叹、孩子哼哼、牛哞哞；按发声者和情境区分意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fighter who takes part in combat in an arena for spectators.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在竞技场中进行搏斗、供观众观看的斗士。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġellied li jiġġieled f'arena quddiem l-ispettaturi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 角斗士；在竞技场中搏斗的斗士。

formal.mt: L-istampa turi gladjatur fl-arena b'elmu fuq rasu.
formal.en: The picture shows a gladiator in the arena wearing a helmet.
formal.zh: 图片展示了一名头戴头盔、身处竞技场的角斗士。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak fl-istampa? Mark: Dak gladjatur; ara l-elmu tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that in the picture? Mark: That is a gladiator; look at his helmet.
colloquial.zh: Lara：图片里那个人是谁？Mark：那是角斗士，看看他的头盔。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that in the picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 那是角斗士，看看他的头盔。
messages.en: That is a gladiator; look at his helmet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把gladjatur和“竞技场、头盔、搏斗”三张图卡放在一起，看到这个词就回想角斗士的形象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Great honour, praise, or admiration associated with an achievement or someone worthy of esteem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因成就或值得敬重的表现而获得的荣耀、赞美与崇敬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġieħ, tifħir jew ammirazzjoni kbira marbuta ma' kisba jew ma' xi ħadd li jistħoqqlu stima.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荣耀；光荣；受到高度赞颂的荣誉。

formal.mt: Il-kaptan qal li l-glorja tar-rebħa kienet tat-tim kollu.
formal.en: The captain said that the glory of the victory belonged to the whole team.
formal.zh: 队长表示，胜利的荣耀属于整个团队。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-glorja kollha għalik illum! David: Għalina lkoll; kulħadd għen biex irbaħna.
colloquial.en: Nina: All the glory is yours today! David: It is for all of us; everyone helped us win.
colloquial.zh: Nina：今天荣耀全归你了！David：是我们大家的，每个人都为胜利出了力。

messages.speaker: Nina (队友)
messages.zh: 今天荣耀全归你了！
messages.en: All the glory is yours today!

messages.speaker: David (队长)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalina lkoll; kulħadd għen biex irbaħna.
messages.mt_standard: Għalina lkoll; kulħadd għen biex irbaħna.
messages.zh: 是我们大家的，每个人都为胜利出了力。
messages.en: It is for all of us; everyone helped us win.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象领奖台上的掌声，把glorja记成大家赋予胜利者的“荣耀”，并用“胜利的荣耀”整组复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the glottis, the opening between the vocal folds, especially in speech production.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与声带之间的开口即声门有关的，尤其用于描述发音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-glottide, il-fetħa bejn il-kordi vokali, speċjalment fil-produzzjoni tal-ħsejjes tad-diskors.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 声门的；涉及声门部位或声门发音的。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-fonetika, l-għalliema spjegat kif jiġi prodott ħoss glottali.
formal.en: In the phonetics lesson, the teacher explained how a glottal sound is produced.
formal.zh: 在语音学课上，教师解释了声门音是如何发出的。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser glottali hawn? Toni: Ifisser li l-ħoss għandu x'jaqsam mal-glottide, bejn il-kordi vokali.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does glottal mean here? Toni: It means that the sound involves the glottis, between the vocal folds.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这里的“声门的”是什么意思？Toni：意思是这个音涉及声带之间的声门。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“声门的”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does glottal mean here?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-ħoss għandu x'jaqsam mal-glottide, bejn il-kordi vokali.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-ħoss għandu x'jaqsam mal-glottide, bejn il-kordi vokali.
messages.zh: 意思是这个音涉及声带之间的声门。
messages.en: It means that the sound involves the glottis, between the vocal folds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两条声带，在中间的开口旁写glottali；用位置图记住它表示“声门的”，再搭配“声门音”复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A simple sugar that the body uses as a source of energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种可供身体利用、提供能量的单糖，即葡萄糖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' zokkor sempliċi li l-ġisem juża bħala sors ta' enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 葡萄糖，一种单糖。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħejjew soluzzjoni ta' glukożju għall-esperiment fil-laboratorju.
formal.en: The students prepared a glucose solution for the laboratory experiment.
formal.zh: 学生们为实验室实验配制了葡萄糖溶液。

colloquial.mt: Emma: X'hemm f'dan il-flixkun? Luke: Soluzzjoni ta' glukożju għall-esperiment ta' għada.
colloquial.en: Emma: What is in this bottle? Luke: A glucose solution for tomorrow's experiment.
colloquial.zh: Emma：这个瓶子里装的是什么？Luke：明天实验要用的葡萄糖溶液。

messages.speaker: Emma (学生)
messages.zh: 这个瓶子里装的是什么？
messages.en: What is in this bottle?

messages.speaker: Luke (实验搭档)
messages.mt_spoken: Soluzzjoni ta' glukożju għall-esperiment ta' għada.
messages.mt_standard: Soluzzjoni ta' glukożju għall-esperiment ta' għada.
messages.zh: 明天实验要用的葡萄糖溶液。
messages.en: A glucose solution for tomorrow's experiment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把glukożju和英语glucose并排写在“葡萄糖”卡片上，再画一个标有葡萄糖溶液的实验瓶帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A muscle in the body that contracts to produce movement or maintain position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体中能够收缩、帮助产生动作或保持姿势的一块肌肉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Muskolu fil-ġisem li jinġibed biex joħloq moviment jew iżomm il-ġisem f'pożizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体中的肌肉。

formal.mt: Id-disinn juri godla fid-driegħ u l-pożizzjoni tagħha fil-ġisem.
formal.en: The diagram shows a muscle in the arm and its position in the body.
formal.zh: 这幅示意图展示了手臂中的一块肌肉及其在身体中的位置。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din il-parti ħamra fid-disinn x'inhi? Ivan: Dik godla fid-driegħ; il-kulur jgħinek taraha aħjar.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is this red part in the diagram? Ivan: That is a muscle in the arm; the colour helps you see it better.
colloquial.zh: Marta：图里这块红色的部分是什么？Ivan：那是手臂中的一块肌肉，颜色能帮你看得更清楚。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 图里这块红色的部分是什么？
messages.en: What is this red part in the diagram?

messages.speaker: Ivan (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik godla fid-driegħ; il-kulur jgħinek taraha aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Dik godla fid-driegħ; il-kulur jgħinek taraha aħjar.
messages.zh: 那是手臂中的一块肌肉，颜色能帮你看得更清楚。
messages.en: That is a muscle in the arm; the colour helps you see it better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在手臂示意图上圈出一块肌肉并标注godla；每次屈臂时回想图中的标记，把词与身体部位联系起来。

gloss_zh: 粗壮的；结实的；丰满的；肌肉发达的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a solid, strong, full, or muscular build.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容体格厚实、强壮、丰满或肌肉发达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ġisem sod, b'saħħtu, mimli jew b'muskoli żviluppati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗壮的；体格厚实的。
结实的；强健的。
丰满的；胖乎乎的。
肌肉发达的；肌肉结实的。
体格健壮的；身材结实匀称的。
强壮结实的；体格强健的。

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-ħaddiem huwa deskritt bħala raġel godli li jġorr il-kaxxi b'faċilità.
formal.en: In the story, the worker is described as a sturdy man who carries the boxes with ease.
formal.zh: 故事将这名工人描写为一个体格结实、搬箱子很轻松的男子。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif nista' nagħraf lil ħuk? Ben: Huwa r-raġel godli bil-qmis blu ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: How can I recognise your brother? Ben: He is the well-built man in the blue shirt by the door.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我怎么认出你哥哥？Ben：他就是门边那个穿蓝衬衫、体格健壮的男子。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我怎么认出你哥哥？
messages.en: How can I recognise your brother?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa r-raġel godli bil-qmis blu ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa r-raġel godli bil-qmis blu ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 他就是门边那个穿蓝衬衫、体格健壮的男子。
messages.en: He is the well-built man in the blue shirt by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把godli写在人像轮廓旁，分别画出厚实、丰满和肌肉明显的体形；用语境判断它强调哪种体格特点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a sticky, elastic, or chewy texture like gum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质地像胶一样黏、有弹性或有嚼劲的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tessut iwaħħal, elastiku jew li jeħtieġ ħafna tomgħod, bħall-gomma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胶状的；黏韧的；像胶一样有黏性或嚼劲的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kampjun bħala materjal b'tessut gommuż li jeħel mal-wiċċ tal-kontenitur.
formal.en: The report describes the sample as a material with a gummy texture that sticks to the surface of the container.
formal.zh: 报告将该样品描述为一种质地黏韧、会黏在容器表面的材料。

colloquial.mt: Klara: Dan il-ħelu gommuż wisq għalija. Samwel: Ipprova dan l-ieħor; huwa aktar faċli biex tomogħdu.
colloquial.en: Klara: This candy is too gummy for me. Samwel: Try this other one; it is easier to chew.
colloquial.zh: Klara：这个糖对我来说太黏韧了。Samwel：试试另外这颗，更容易嚼。

messages.speaker: Klara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个糖对我来说太黏韧了。
messages.en: This candy is too gummy for me.

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova dan l-ieħor; huwa aktar faċli biex tomogħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova dan l-ieħor; huwa aktar faċli biex tomogħdu.
messages.zh: 试试另外这颗，更容易嚼。
messages.en: Try this other one; it is easier to chew.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象软糖被拉长后仍黏在指尖，用“黏、弹、嚼”三个感觉提示词记住gommuż所描述的质地。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the government or its activities, services, and institutions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与政府及其活动、服务或机构有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-gvern, mal-ħidma tiegħu jew mal-istituzzjonijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 政府的；与政府有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-gvern.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport governattiv jispjega kif se jitjiebu s-servizzi pubbliċi.
formal.en: The government report explains how public services will be improved.
formal.zh: 这份政府报告说明了将如何改善公共服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sibt din l-informazzjoni? Mark: F'rapport governattiv li qrajt dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you find this information? Mark: In a government report I read this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在哪里找到这些信息的？Mark：在我今天早上读的一份政府报告里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在哪里找到这些信息的？
messages.en: Where did you find this information?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在我今天早上读的一份政府报告里。
messages.en: In a government report I read this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把政府大楼与一份官方报告放在同一幅记忆图里，用 governattiv 给报告贴上“政府的”标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit of mass equal to one-thousandth of a kilogram, written with the symbol g.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质量单位“克”，等于千分之一千克，符号为 g。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità ta' massa li hija parti minn elf ta' kilogramma, bis-simbolu g.

sense_translations.en_definition: gram (a unit of mass equal to one-thousandth of a kilogram; symbol: g)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 克：质量单位，等于千分之一千克，符号为 g。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Unità ta' massa daqs parti minn elf ta' kilogramma; is-simbolu tagħha huwa g.

formal.mt: Għal dan l-esperiment, iżen gramm wieħed ta' melħ u ħollu fl-ilma.
formal.en: For this experiment, weigh out one gram of salt and dissolve it in water.
formal.zh: 进行这个实验时，称取一克盐并将其溶解在水中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm melħ inżid? Mark: Gramm wieħed biss; uża l-miżien.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much salt should I add? Mark: Just one gram; use the scales.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我该加多少盐？Mark：只加一克，用秤称一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我该加多少盐？
messages.en: How much salt should I add?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 只加一克，用秤称一下。
messages.en: Just one gram; use the scales.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电子秤显示“1 g”，旁边标着 gramm；把这个词与“一克”的小份量直接对应起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A claw or talon: a hard, usually curved and pointed structure on an animal's foot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物足部坚硬、通常弯曲而尖锐的爪或利爪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Difer iebes, ġeneralment mgħawweġ u bil-ponta, f'sieq ta' annimal jew għasfur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爪；动物或鸟类的尖锐利爪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Difer qawwi u bil-ponta ta' annimal jew għasfur.

formal.mt: Fit-tpinġija jidher il-granf tal-ajkla, mgħawweġ u bil-ponta.
formal.en: The drawing shows the eagle's talon, curved and pointed.
formal.zh: 图中展示了鹰的利爪，弯曲而尖锐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara l-granf tal-ajkla f'dan ir-ritratt! Pawlu: Iva, jidher jaqta' ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at the eagle's talon in this photo! Pawlu: Yes, it looks very sharp.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看这张照片里鹰的利爪！Pawlu：是啊，看起来很锋利。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 看这张照片里鹰的利爪！
messages.en: Look at the eagle's talon in this photo!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 是啊，看起来很锋利。
messages.en: Yes, it looks very sharp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象照片中一只弯曲尖锐的鹰爪，在爪旁写上 granf，用具体形状记住“利爪”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Maize or corn, the cereal crop and its grain; a synonym of qamħirrum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 玉米，可指这种谷物作物及其籽粒，与 qamħirrum 同义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qamħirrum; pjanta taċ-ċereali u l-qamħ li tipproduċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 qamħirrum 同义：玉米。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma oħra għal qamħirrum.

formal.mt: Il-bidwi jkabbar il-grantork f'għalqa qrib ir-raħal.
formal.en: The farmer grows maize in a field near the village.
formal.zh: 农民在村庄附近的一块田里种植玉米。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'dqiq għandna bżonn għal din ir-riċetta? Mark: Dqiq tal-grantork; hemm pakkett fl-armarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What flour do we need for this recipe? Mark: Maize flour; there's a packet in the cupboard.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这道食谱需要什么粉？Mark：玉米粉，柜子里有一包。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'dqiq għandna bżonn għal din ir-riċetta?
messages.mt_standard: X'dqiq għandna bżonn għal din ir-riċetta?
messages.zh: 这道食谱需要什么粉？
messages.en: What flour do we need for this recipe?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 玉米粉，柜子里有一包。
messages.en: Maize flour; there's a packet in the cupboard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在玉米图片下并排写 grantork 和 qamħirrum，把两个同义词连到同一根玉米上记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bran: the outer layers of cereal grain separated during milling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 麸皮或谷物糠皮，即谷物磨制时分离出来的外层部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qxur ta' barra tal-qamħ jew ta' ċereali oħra li jinfirdu waqt it-tħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 麸皮；谷物磨制时分离出的外层糠皮。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qxur tal-qamħ jew ta' ċereali oħra li jibqgħu wara t-tħin.

formal.mt: F'din ir-riċetta, il-granza titħallat mad-dqiq qabel ma jiżdied l-ilma.
formal.en: In this recipe, the bran is mixed with the flour before the water is added.
formal.zh: 在这道食谱中，先将麸皮与面粉混合，再加水。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'se żżid mal-għaġina? Pawlu: Ftit granza, għax irrid nagħmel ħobż bil-granza.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you going to add to the dough? Pawlu: A little bran, because I want to make bread with bran.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你准备往面团里加什么？Pawlu：一点麸皮，因为我想做麸皮面包。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备往面团里加什么？
messages.en: What are you going to add to the dough?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit granza, għax irrid nagħmel ħobż bil-granza.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit granza, għax irrid nagħmel ħobż bil-granza.
messages.zh: 一点麸皮，因为我想做麸皮面包。
messages.en: A little bran, because I want to make bread with bran.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把磨面后分开的谷物外皮画在面粉旁边，并标注 granza，记住它指麸皮这一部分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to gravity, the attraction between bodies that have mass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与引力或重力有关的，即与有质量的物体之间的吸引作用有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-gravità, il-forza li biha korpi li għandhom massa jiġbdu lil xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引力的；重力的；与引力作用有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-gravità.

formal.mt: Il-forza gravitazzjonali bejn żewġ korpi tiddependi mill-massa tagħhom u mid-distanza bejniethom.
formal.en: The gravitational force between two bodies depends on their masses and the distance between them.
formal.zh: 两个物体之间的引力取决于它们的质量及彼此之间的距离。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'iżomm il-Qamar fl-orbita tiegħu madwar id-Dinja? Pawlu: Il-forza gravitazzjonali bejn id-Dinja u l-Qamar.
colloquial.en: Lara: What keeps the Moon in its orbit around Earth? Pawlu: The gravitational force between Earth and the Moon.
colloquial.zh: Lara：是什么让月球保持在绕地球运行的轨道上？Pawlu：地球与月球之间的引力。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'iżomm il-Qamar fl-orbita tiegħu madwar id-Dinja?
messages.mt_standard: X'iżomm il-Qamar fl-orbita tiegħu madwar id-Dinja?
messages.zh: 是什么让月球保持在绕地球运行的轨道上？
messages.en: What keeps the Moon in its orbit around Earth?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-forza gravitazzjonali bejn id-Dinja u l-Qamar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-forza gravitazzjonali bejn id-Dinja u l-Qamar.
messages.zh: 地球与月球之间的引力。
messages.en: The gravitational force between Earth and the Moon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出地球与月球之间相互吸引的箭头，给箭头配上 forza gravitazzjonali，记住它用于描述“引力的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The seriousness of a situation; also, the physical attraction between bodies that have mass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事情或局势的严重程度；也指有质量的物体之间的引力，包括使物体落向地面的重力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kemm sitwazzjoni hija serja; ukoll il-forza li biha korpi li għandhom massa jiġbdu lil xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严重性；事情或局势的严重程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kemm ħaġa jew sitwazzjoni hija serja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重力；引力，即有质量的物体之间的相互吸引作用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-forza li biha korpi li għandhom massa jiġbdu lil xulxin.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-gravità tas-sitwazzjoni u jitlob azzjoni immedjata.
formal.en: The report stresses the seriousness of the situation and calls for immediate action.
formal.zh: 报告强调了局势的严重性，并呼吁立即采取行动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ballun jaqa' meta nitilqu? Mark: Minħabba l-gravità tad-Dinja, li tiġbdu lejn l-art.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the ball fall when I let go of it? Mark: Because of Earth's gravity, which pulls it towards the ground.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么我一松手，球就掉下去？Mark：因为地球重力把它拉向地面。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么我一松手，球就掉下去？
messages.en: Why does the ball fall when I let go of it?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-gravità tad-Dinja, li tiġbdu lejn l-art.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-gravità tad-Dinja, li tiġbdu lejn l-art.
messages.zh: 因为地球重力把它拉向地面。
messages.en: Because of Earth's gravity, which pulls it towards the ground.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分别记义：下落的球表示“重力”，严肃的情况报告表示“严重性”，都标上 gravità。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓氏 Grech，用作个人姓名中的家族姓氏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala parti mill-isem ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个姓氏：Grech。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kunjom.

formal.mt: Is-Sur Grech se jattendi l-laqgħa bħala rappreżentant tal-iskola.
formal.en: Mr Grech will attend the meeting as a representative of the school.
formal.zh: Grech 先生将作为学校代表出席会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi appuntament mas-Sur Grech. Lara: Tajjeb, stenna hawn u ninfurmah li wasalt.
colloquial.en: Maja: I have an appointment with Mr Grech. Lara: All right, wait here and I'll let him know you've arrived.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我和 Grech 先生有预约。Lara：好的，请在这里稍等，我通知他您到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 我和 Grech 先生有预约。
messages.en: I have an appointment with Mr Grech.

messages.speaker: Lara (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, stenna hawn u ninfurmah li wasalt.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, stenna hawn u ninfurmah li wasalt.
messages.zh: 好的，请在这里稍等，我通知他您到了。
messages.en: All right, wait here and I'll let him know you've arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门牌上写着“Sur Grech”，把 Grech 记作人的姓氏，并注意姓名中的首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Scratching as an action, or the marks left on a surface by scratching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指抓挠、刮擦的动作，也指这种动作留在表面的抓痕或刮痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tigrif, jew il-marki li jibqgħu fuq wiċċ wara li jkun ġie migruf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓挠；刮擦这一动作。
抓挠或刮擦留下的痕迹；抓痕，刮痕。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, ġie nnutat grif fuq il-wiċċ tal-mejda.
formal.en: During the inspection, scratch marks were noted on the surface of the table.
formal.zh: 检查时，发现桌面上有刮痕。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-grif fuq il-bieb kien hemm qabel? Mark: Le, innutajtu dalgħodu meta ftaħt il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Were these scratch marks on the door there before? Mark: No, I noticed them this morning when I opened the door.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：门上的这些刮痕以前就有吗？马克：没有，我今天早上开门时才注意到。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-grif fuq il-bieb kien hemm qabel?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-grif fuq il-bieb kien hemm qabel?
messages.zh: 门上的这些刮痕以前就有吗？
messages.en: Were these scratch marks on the door there before?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, innutajtu dalgħodu meta ftaħt il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Le, innutajtu dalgħodu meta ftaħt il-bieb.
messages.zh: 没有，我今天早上开门时才注意到。
messages.en: No, I noticed them this morning when I opened the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象指甲划过桌面：划动是抓挠，留下的是抓痕，用同一画面记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 爱伸手抢拿的；见东西就抓的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who readily grabs things for themselves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人爱伸手抓取或抢拿东西，常想先拿到自己手里。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħtaf l-affarijiet għalih innifsu malli jkollu l-opportunità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容爱伸手抓取或抢拿东西的人；爱抢拿的。

collocations.en: a boy who grabs things for himself
a man who is quick to grab things
collocations.zh: 动不动就伸手抢拿的男人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel grifti ħataf l-aħħar biċċa ħobż qabel ma l-oħrajn setgħu jieħdu sehemhom.
formal.en: In the story, the boy who was quick to grab things snatched the last piece of bread before the others could take their share.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个爱抢拿的男孩抢走了最后一块面包，其他人还没来得及拿自己的份。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tgħid li Ben hu grifti? Nina: Għax jaħtaf il-logħob minn idejn l-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you saying Ben is always grabbing things? Nina: Because he snatches toys from other people's hands.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你为什么说本爱抢拿东西？妮娜：因为他会从别人手里抢玩具。

messages.speaker: Lara (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħid li Ben hu grifti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħid li Ben hu grifti?
messages.zh: 你为什么说本爱抢拿东西？
messages.en: Why are you saying Ben is always grabbing things?

messages.speaker: Nina (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jaħtaf il-logħob minn idejn l-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jaħtaf il-logħob minn idejn l-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 因为他会从别人手里抢玩具。
messages.en: Because he snatches toys from other people's hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词配上一个总抢先伸手拿东西的人，用动作记住“爱抢拿”的性格描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name, written Grima with an initial capital.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人家族姓氏的专名，书写时首字母大写，为 Grima。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom ta' persuna jew familja, li jinkiteb Grima b'ittra kbira fil-bidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Grima。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Grima talbet kopja tad-dokument għall-arkivju tal-familja.
formal.en: Mrs Grima requested a copy of the document for the family archive.
formal.zh: Grima 女士申请了一份文件副本，用于家庭档案。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Taħt liema kunjom hi r-riservazzjoni? Mark: Grima. Ir-riservazzjoni hi għal żewġ persuni.
colloquial.en: Anna: What surname is the reservation under? Mark: Grima. The reservation is for two people.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：预订登记的姓氏是什么？马克：Grima。预订的是两个人。

messages.speaker: Anna (接待员)
messages.zh: 预订登记的姓氏是什么？
messages.en: What surname is the reservation under?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Grima. Ir-riservazzjoni hi għal żewġ persuni.
messages.mt_standard: Grima. Ir-riservazzjoni hi għal żewġ persuni.
messages.zh: Grima。预订的是两个人。
messages.en: Grima. The reservation is for two people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Grima 写在预订表的“姓氏”栏里，并留意大写 G，用登记场景记住它是姓氏。

gloss_zh: 粗磨；潮湿夹砂砾的尘土

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coarse grinding, or wet dust containing gritty particles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指把材料磨得较粗的加工过程，也指潮湿、夹有砂砾颗粒的尘土。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħin oħxon, jew trab imxarrab imħallat ma' frak taż-żrar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗磨；将材料磨成较粗颗粒的加工过程。
潮湿且夹有砂砾颗粒的尘土。

collocations.en: wet, gritty dust on the ground
collocations.zh: 地上潮湿夹砂砾的尘土

formal.mt: Wara l-grix, il-qamħ baqa' f'biċċiet pjuttost kbar u kellu bżonn aktar tħin.
formal.en: After coarse grinding, the wheat remained in fairly large pieces and needed further grinding.
formal.zh: 经过粗磨后，小麦仍呈较大的碎粒，需要继续研磨。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hemm il-grix mal-art ħdejn il-bieb. Toni: Rajtu. Se niġbru bil-pala qabel nidħlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: There is wet, gritty dust on the ground by the door. Toni: I saw it. I will collect it with a shovel before we go in.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：门旁的地上有潮湿夹砂砾的尘土。托尼：我看到了。我会在我们进去前用铲子把它收起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 门旁的地上有潮湿夹砂砾的尘土。
messages.en: There is wet, gritty dust on the ground by the door.

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu. Se niġbru bil-pala qabel nidħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu. Se niġbru bil-pala qabel nidħlu.
messages.zh: 我看到了。我会在我们进去前用铲子把它收起来。
messages.en: I saw it. I will collect it with a shovel before we go in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张画面分开记：一张是磨得较粗的谷粒，一张是地上潮湿夹砂砾的尘土。

gloss_zh: 乡野而拘怯的，不合群的；野蛮凶悍的（动物）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person as rustic, unsociable or timid, or an animal as savage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人时，指带有乡野气息、不合群或拘怯；形容动物时，指野蛮、凶悍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu rustiku, ma jitħallatx man-nies jew hu mistħi, meta jingħad għal persuna; feroċi, meta jingħad għal annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容人乡野质朴、不合群或拘谨胆怯。
形容动物野蛮、凶悍。

collocations.en: a rustic, socially timid young man
collocations.zh: 带着乡野气息、社交拘怯的年轻男子

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, iż-żagħżugħ grixti kien joqgħod lura milli jitkellem ma' nies li ma kienx jaf.
formal.en: In the novel, the socially timid young man held back from speaking to people he did not know.
formal.zh: 小说中，那个拘怯、不合群的年轻男子不愿主动与陌生人交谈。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak il-kelb jidher grixti. Nersqu lejh? Mark: Le, aħjar inżommu 'l bogħod minnu.
colloquial.en: Sara: That dog looks savage. Shall we go closer to it? Mark: No, we had better keep away from it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那条狗看起来很凶。我们要走近它吗？马克：不要，我们最好离它远一点。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kelb jidher grixti. Nersqu lejh?
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kelb jidher grixti. Nersqu lejh?
messages.zh: 那条狗看起来很凶。我们要走近它吗？
messages.en: That dog looks savage. Shall we go closer to it?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不要，我们最好离它远一点。
messages.en: No, we had better keep away from it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先看修饰对象再选中文：修饰人想到乡野、拘怯与不合群，修饰动物想到野蛮凶悍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container used to heat and melt materials, especially metals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于加热并熔化材料，尤其是金属的容器，即坩埚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex jissaħħnu u jdubu fih materjali, speċjalment metalli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坩埚；用于加热、熔化材料的容器。

formal.mt: It-tekniku poġġa l-kampjun tal-metall fil-griġjol u saħħnu sakemm il-metall dab.
formal.en: The technician placed the metal sample in the crucible and heated it until the metal melted.
formal.zh: 技术员把金属样品放进坩埚，加热至金属熔化。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se npoġġu dawn il-biċċiet tal-metall? Pawlu: Fil-griġjol; hemmhekk se nsaħħnuhom biex idubu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are we going to put these pieces of metal? Pawlu: In the crucible; that is where we will heat them so they melt.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们要把这些金属块放在哪里？保罗：放进坩埚；我们会在那里加热，让它们熔化。

messages.speaker: Sara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se npoġġu dawn il-biċċiet tal-metall?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se npoġġu dawn il-biċċiet tal-metall?
messages.zh: 我们要把这些金属块放在哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going to put these pieces of metal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-griġjol; hemmhekk se nsaħħnuhom biex idubu.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-griġjol; hemmhekk se nsaħħnuhom biex idubu.
messages.zh: 放进坩埚；我们会在那里加热，让它们熔化。
messages.en: In the crucible; that is where we will heat them so they melt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中放一只盛着熔化金属的小容器，把 griġjol 与具体的坩埚画面连起来记。

gloss_zh: 阴沉不友善的人；态度粗暴的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who behaves in a surly, unfriendly or bad-tempered way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指态度阴沉、不友善，或待人粗声粗气、脾气不好的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġib ruħha b'mod goff u mhux dħuli, u spiss turi burdata ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 态度阴沉、不友善或粗声粗气的人。

collocations.en: to behave like a surly person

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġar huwa deskritt bħala guddimu li jwieġeb b'mod goff lil kull min ikellmu.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbour is described as a surly person who replies rudely to anyone who speaks to him.
formal.zh: 故事把这位邻居描写成一个阴沉不友善的人，谁跟他说话，他都粗鲁地回应。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed tgħid li hu guddimu? Pawlu: Għax staqsejtu mistoqsija sempliċi u weġibni b'mod goff.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you calling him a surly person? Pawlu: Because I asked him a simple question and he answered me rudely.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么说他是个态度恶劣的人？保罗：因为我问了他一个简单的问题，他却很粗鲁地回答我。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħid li hu guddimu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħid li hu guddimu?
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个态度恶劣的人？
messages.en: Why are you calling him a surly person?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax staqsejtu mistoqsija sempliċi u weġibni b'mod goff.
messages.mt_standard: Għax staqsejtu mistoqsija sempliċi u weġibni b'mod goff.
messages.zh: 因为我问了他一个简单的问题，他却很粗鲁地回答我。
messages.en: Because I asked him a simple question and he answered me rudely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个皱着眉、回答总是粗声粗气的人；这个词是名词，用来指这样的人。

gloss_zh: 山坡上的田地；Gudja（马耳他地名）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A field situated on the side of a hill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于山丘坡面上的一块田地，强调田地所在的坡地位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għalqa li tinsab fuq il-ġenb ta' għolja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 位于山坡上的田地。

sense_translations.en_definition: Gudja (a city and local council of the Southern Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: Gudja：马耳他南部区域的一座城市及其地方议会。

collocations.en: the soil of the hillside field

collocations.zh: 到 Gudja 的一次访问

formal.mt: Il-bidwi eżamina l-ħamrija tal-gudja qabel ma ddeċieda x'għandu jiżra' fiha.
formal.en: The farmer examined the soil of the hillside field before deciding what to sow in it.
formal.zh: 农民检查了这块山坡田地的土壤，然后才决定种什么。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se mmorru l-Gudja nhar is-Sibt? Toni: Iva, niltaqgħu hemm filgħodu u nieħdu kafè flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are we going to Gudja on Saturday? Toni: Yes, let's meet there in the morning and have a coffee together.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我们星期六去 Gudja 吗？托尼：去，我们早上在那里见面，一起喝杯咖啡。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们星期六去 Gudja 吗？
messages.en: Are we going to Gudja on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niltaqgħu hemm filgħodu u nieħdu kafè flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niltaqgħu hemm filgħodu u nieħdu kafè flimkien.
messages.zh: 去，我们早上在那里见面，一起喝杯咖啡。
messages.en: Yes, let's meet there in the morning and have a coffee together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用大小写配合场景记忆：小写 gudja 配山坡田地，大写 Gudja 配地图上的地名。

gloss_zh: 古戈尔边形（有 10^100 条边的多边形）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A polygon with exactly 10^100 sides.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 恰好具有 10^100 条边的多边形，是一个可以用数学定义描述的几何对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Poligonu li għandu eżattament 10^100 naħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古戈尔边形，即具有 10^100 条边的多边形。

collocations.en: the number of sides of a googolgon

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-ġeometrija, l-għalliema spjegat li gugligonu għandu 10^100 naħa.
formal.en: In the geometry lesson, the teacher explained that a googolgon has 10^100 sides.
formal.zh: 在几何课上，老师解释说，古戈尔边形有 10^100 条边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandu naħat gugligonu? Mark: Għandu 10^100 naħa. Immaġina kemm hu kbir dak in-numru!
colloquial.en: Maja: How many sides does a googolgon have? Mark: It has 10^100 sides. Imagine how huge that number is!
colloquial.zh: Maja：古戈尔边形有多少条边？Mark：有 10^100 条边。想想这个数有多大！

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 古戈尔边形有多少条边？
messages.en: How many sides does a googolgon have?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu 10^100 naħa. Immaġina kemm hu kbir dak in-numru!
messages.mt_standard: Għandu 10^100 naħa. Immaġina kemm hu kbir dak in-numru!
messages.zh: 有 10^100 条边。想想这个数有多大！
messages.en: It has 10^100 sides. Imagine how huge that number is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和写着“10^100 条边”的多边形卡片一起记，抓住它表示特定边数的几何图形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Warfare in which small groups use raids, ambushes, and similar tactics against an opposing force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由小股力量通过突袭、伏击等战术与敌方作战的战争形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gwerra li fiha gruppi żgħar jiġġieldu permezz ta' attakki għal għarrieda u ambuskati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 游击战；以小股力量进行突袭、伏击等行动的战争。

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza kif it-tattiċi ta' gwerrilla jippermettu lil gruppi żgħar jattakkaw u jirtiraw malajr.
formal.en: The study analyzes how guerrilla warfare tactics allow small groups to attack and withdraw quickly.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了游击战战术如何使小股力量能够迅速进攻并撤退。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed taqra għall-eżami? Pawlu: Kapitlu dwar il-gwerrilla. Jispjega kif gruppi żgħar jagħmlu attakki għal għarrieda.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you reading for the exam? Pawlu: A chapter about guerrilla warfare. It explains how small groups carry out surprise attacks.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你在为考试读什么？Pawlu：关于游击战的一章，里面解释了小股力量如何发动突袭。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在为考试读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading for the exam?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kapitlu dwar il-gwerrilla. Jispjega kif gruppi żgħar jagħmlu attakki għal għarrieda.
messages.mt_standard: Kapitlu dwar il-gwerrilla. Jispjega kif gruppi żgħar jagħmlu attakki għal għarrieda.
messages.zh: 关于游击战的一章，里面解释了小股力量如何发动突袭。
messages.en: A chapter about guerrilla warfare. It explains how small groups carry out surprise attacks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想小队突然出击、随后撤退的画面，把 gwerrilla 记作一种作战方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small heap or pile of material or objects; the diminutive of gozz.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由少量材料或物品聚成的小堆；是 gozz 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gozz żgħir ta' materjal jew oġġetti; il-forma diminuttiva ta' gozz.

sense_translations.en_definition: small heap or pile (the diminutive form of 'gozz')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小堆；表示少量东西堆在一起，是 gozz 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Wara x-xogħol, baqa' gzejjez ta' ramel ħdejn il-ħajt.
formal.en: After the work, a small heap of sand remained beside the wall.
formal.zh: 施工结束后，墙边还留着一小堆沙子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-ġebel? Toni: Agħmel gzejjez ħdejn il-bieb, u mbagħad niġborhom jien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put these stones? Toni: Make a small pile beside the door, and I'll collect them afterward.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些石头放在哪里？Toni：在门边堆成一小堆，之后我来收。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 这些石头放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these stones?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħmel gzejjez ħdejn il-bieb, u mbagħad niġborhom jien.
messages.mt_standard: Agħmel gzejjez ħdejn il-bieb, u mbagħad niġborhom jien.
messages.zh: 在门边堆成一小堆，之后我来收。
messages.en: Make a small pile beside the door, and I'll collect them afterward.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gozz 的“大堆”画面缩成掌心旁的一小堆，借大小对照记住 gzejjez。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dark, or to give off a faint, pale light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示天色或环境变暗，也可表示光源发出暗淡、微弱的光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża meta jibda jidlam, jew meta sors ta' dawl jagħti dawl dgħajjef u pallidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变暗；天色开始暗下来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to give off a wan light
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出暗淡、苍白而微弱的光。

collocations.en: the lamp gave off a wan light

formal.mt: Meta għabbex, il-grupp temm il-mixja u rritorna lejn ir-raħal.
formal.en: When it got dark, the group ended the walk and returned to the village.
formal.zh: 天色暗下来时，一行人结束了步行，返回村庄。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Diġà għabbex! Għadna noħorġu nimxu? Mark: Ejjew inħalluha għal għada, meta jkun hemm aktar dawl.
colloquial.en: Sara: It's already got dark! Shall we still go out for a walk? Mark: Let's leave it until tomorrow, when there's more light.
colloquial.zh: Sara：天已经暗了！我们还出去散步吗？Mark：留到明天吧，光线会更充足。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 天已经暗了！我们还出去散步吗？
messages.en: It's already got dark! Shall we still go out for a walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejjew inħalluha għal għada, meta jkun hemm aktar dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Ejjew inħalluha għal għada, meta jkun hemm aktar dawl.
messages.zh: 留到明天吧，光线会更充足。
messages.en: Let's leave it until tomorrow, when there's more light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅暗光画面记忆：窗外天色变暗，屋内油灯微亮，对应这个动词的两个义项。

gloss_zh: 使变暗的；使模糊难明的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Darkening something, or making it obscure and difficult to see or understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物变暗的，或具有使事物模糊、难以看清或理解的性质的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jdallam xi ħaġa jew jagħmilha mċajpra, diffiċli biex taraha jew tifhimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变暗的；令光线或明亮程度降低的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having the quality of making sth. obscure
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使某事物模糊不清、晦涩难明的性质的。

collocations.zh: 使意思晦涩难明的措辞

formal.mt: L-editur neħħa l-kliem għabbiexi sabiex it-tifsira tas-sentenza tkun aktar ċara.
formal.en: The editor removed the wording that obscured the meaning so that the sentence would be clearer.
formal.zh: 编辑删去了使意思晦涩难明的措辞，让句子的含义更加清楚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-filtru għandu effett għabbiexi fuq ir-ritratt. Toni: Iva, neħħih biex naraw il-wiċċ aħjar.
colloquial.en: Lara: This filter has a darkening effect on the photo. Toni: Yes, remove it so we can see the face better.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个滤镜会让照片变暗。Toni：是啊，去掉它，这样能更清楚地看到脸。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-filtru għandu effett għabbiexi fuq ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-filtru għandu effett għabbiexi fuq ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 这个滤镜会让照片变暗。
messages.en: This filter has a darkening effect on the photo.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, neħħih biex naraw il-wiċċ aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, neħħih biex naraw il-wiċċ aħjar.
messages.zh: 是啊，去掉它，这样能更清楚地看到脸。
messages.en: Yes, remove it so we can see the face better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一层让照片变暗的滤镜，再联想到让意思难懂的措辞，记住它描述使事物不清楚的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male sheep that is one year old.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年龄为一岁的公绵羊；这个词同时说明动物的种类、性别和年龄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Muntun li għandu sena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一岁大的公绵羊。

collocations.en: a one-year-old ram in the flock

collocations.zh: 一只健康的一岁公绵羊

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, il-veterinarju ċċekkja l-għabur u rreġistra l-piż tiegħu.
formal.en: During the examination, the veterinarian checked the one-year-old ram and recorded its weight.
formal.zh: 检查时，兽医查看了这只一岁公绵羊，并记录了它的体重。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-muntun kemm għandu żmien? Pawlu: Għandu sena; huwa għabur.
colloquial.en: Maja: How old is this ram? Pawlu: It's one year old; it's a għabur.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这只公绵羊多大了？Pawlu：它一岁了，是 għabur，也就是一岁公绵羊。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 这只公绵羊多大了？
messages.en: How old is this ram?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (牧羊人)
messages.zh: 它一岁了，是 għabur，也就是一岁公绵羊。
messages.en: It's one year old; it's a għabur.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给一只公绵羊画上一岁生日牌，把“公、绵羊、一岁”三个信息一起记进 għabur。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bones considered together, or bone considered as a material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 集合地指多块骨头，也可指作为制作材料的骨质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diversi għadmiet meqjusa flimkien, jew l-għadam bħala materjal.

sense_translations.en_definition: several bones; bone as a material
sense_translations.zh_definition: 多块骨头的集合称呼；也指作为材料的骨质。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jiddeskrivi moxt magħmul mill-għadam.
formal.en: The museum catalogue describes a comb made of bone.
formal.zh: 博物馆目录描述了一把用骨质材料制成的梳子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm għadam f'dan il-ħut? Mark: Iva, oqgħod attenta u neħħih qabel tiekol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are there bones in this fish? Mark: Yes, be careful and remove them before eating.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这鱼里有鱼刺吗？Mark：有，小心些，吃之前把鱼刺挑出来。

messages.speaker: Sara (食客)
messages.zh: 这鱼里有鱼刺吗？
messages.en: Are there bones in this fish?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, oqgħod attenta u neħħih qabel tiekol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, oqgħod attenta u neħħih qabel tiekol.
messages.zh: 有，小心些，吃之前把鱼刺挑出来。
messages.en: Yes, be careful and remove them before eating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一盘挑出的鱼骨和一把骨梳并排想象：前者提示骨头集合义，后者提示骨质材料义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strong anger or wrath, or a particular episode of being angry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈的愤怒，也可指一次具体的发怒或生气过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabja qawwija, jew episodju partikolari li fih persuna tirrabja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈的愤怒；震怒。
一次发怒；一阵生气。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-awtur esprima għadba kbira għall-mod kif ġew trattati l-ħaddiema.
formal.en: In his letter, the writer expressed great anger at the way the workers had been treated.
formal.zh: 作者在信中对工人所受到的待遇表达了强烈的愤怒。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għedt hekk lil Toni? Mark: Għedtu f'mument ta' għadba. Issa se nitlob skuża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you say that to Toni? Mark: I said it in a moment of anger. Now I'm going to apologize.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么对 Toni 说那种话？Mark：我是一时生气才说的。现在我要去道歉。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么对 Toni 说那种话？
messages.en: Why did you say that to Toni?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għedtu f'mument ta' għadba. Issa se nitlob skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Għedtu f'mument ta' għadba. Issa se nitlob skuża.
messages.zh: 我是一时生气才说的。现在我要去道歉。
messages.en: I said it in a moment of anger. Now I'm going to apologize.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想怒气升起又平息的过程：għadba 既能指强烈怒气，也能指某一次发怒。

gloss_zh: 使显得多骨；使骨骼突出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something bony or give it a prominently bony appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物呈现多骨、骨骼突出或骨感明显的样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel xi ħaġa tidher bl-għadam tagħha aktar prominenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变得多骨或显得骨骼突出。

collocations.zh: 使人物形象的脸部显得骨骼突出
使雕像的双臂显得骨感明显

formal.mt: L-iskultur għaddam il-wiċċ tal-figura biex jenfasizza l-effett tal-ġuħ.
formal.en: The sculptor made the figure's face bony to emphasize the effects of hunger.
formal.zh: 雕塑家使人物形象的脸部显得骨骼突出，以强调饥饿造成的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-artist għaddam il-wiċċ daqshekk? Mark: Biex il-figura tidher qisha ilha ma tiekol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the artist make the face so bony? Mark: To make the figure look as though it hasn't eaten for a long time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：艺术家为什么把这张脸塑造得这么有骨感？Mark：为了让这个人物看起来像很久没吃东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 艺术家为什么把这张脸塑造得这么有骨感？
messages.en: Why did the artist make the face so bony?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex il-figura tidher qisha ilha ma tiekol.
messages.mt_standard: Biex il-figura tidher qisha ilha ma tiekol.
messages.zh: 为了让这个人物看起来像很久没吃东西。
messages.en: To make the figure look as though it hasn't eaten for a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雕塑家把人物的颧骨塑得突出，用这个画面记住“使显得骨感”的动作义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause puddles to form in a particular place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某个地方积水并形成水洼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel għadajjar żgħar tal-ilma f'post.

sense_translations.en_definition: to create puddles in a location
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某个地点出现水洼。

formal.mt: L-ilma mill-pajp miksur għaddar il-bitħa u għamel il-mogħdija diffiċli biex wieħed jgħaddi minnha.
formal.en: Water from the broken pipe created puddles in the courtyard and made the path difficult to use.
formal.zh: 破裂水管流出的水使院子里形成了水洼，也让小路变得难以通行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għaddar il-bitħa hekk? Pawlu: Il-pajp miksur; għalaqt l-ilma issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What made all these puddles in the courtyard? Pawlu: The broken pipe; I've turned the water off now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：什么把院子弄得这么多水洼？Pawlu：是破水管；我现在已经把水关了。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 什么把院子弄得这么多水洼？
messages.en: What made all these puddles in the courtyard?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 是破水管；我现在已经把水关了。
messages.en: The broken pipe; I've turned the water off now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象漏水的管子把院子变成一片片水洼，记住这个词强调“造成水洼”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To count the same things repeatedly, often to check the total.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对同一批事物反复点数，常用于核对总数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħodd l-istess affarijiet għal darba wara l-oħra, spiss biex tiċċekkja t-total.

sense_translations.en_definition: to count over and over again
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一遍又一遍地数；反复点数。

collocations.en: counted the money over and over

formal.mt: Il-kaxxier għadded il-flus qabel għalaq il-kaxxa, biex ikun ċert li t-total kien korrett.
formal.en: The cashier counted the money repeatedly before closing the till to make sure the total was correct.
formal.zh: 收银员在关闭收银机之前反复清点钱款，以确保总额正确。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Mark għadded il-biljetti daqshekk? Ben: Għax ried ikun ċert li għandna wieħed għal kull persuna.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did Mark count the tickets so many times? Ben: Because he wanted to make sure we have one for each person.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Mark为什么把票数了一遍又一遍？Ben：因为他想确认我们每个人都有一张。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark为什么把票数了一遍又一遍？
messages.en: Why did Mark count the tickets so many times?

messages.speaker: Ben (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ried ikun ċert li għandna wieħed għal kull persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ried ikun ċert li għandna wieħed għal kull persuna.
messages.zh: 因为他想确认我们每个人都有一张。
messages.en: Because he wanted to make sure we have one for each person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放收银员数完又从头数的循环画面，把重点放在“反复数”而非只数一次。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The expression of understanding, sympathy, mercy, or patience toward another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人表现出的理解与体谅、同情、怜悯或耐心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Turija ta' fehim, simpatija, ħniena jew sabar lejn persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设身处地理解他人的感受并表现出体谅。
对他人的困难或痛苦表现出同情与关切。
表现出怜悯或宽恕，尤其是不苛责或不严惩他人。
对他人表现出耐心与容忍。

collocations.en: mercy toward someone who made a mistake

formal.mt: L-għalliem wera għadir lejn l-istudent li kien għaddej minn żmien diffiċli u tah aktar ħin biex itemm ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The teacher showed understanding toward the student who was going through a difficult time and gave him more time to finish the work.
formal.zh: 老师体谅这名正经历困难时期的学生，给了他更多时间完成作业。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Uri ftit għadir ma' ħuk; għadu qed jitgħallem. Lara: Tajjeb, nerġa' nispjegalu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Show your brother a little patience; he's still learning. Lara: All right, I'll explain it to him slowly again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：对你弟弟耐心一点，他还在学。Lara：好，我再慢慢给他解释一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Uri ftit għadir ma' ħuk; għadu qed jitgħallem.
messages.mt_standard: Uri ftit għadir ma' ħuk; għadu qed jitgħallem.
messages.zh: 对你弟弟耐心一点，他还在学。
messages.en: Show your brother a little patience; he's still learning.

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 好，我再慢慢给他解释一遍。
messages.en: All right, I'll explain it to him slowly again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四个待人动作串联记忆：理解感受、同情困难、宽恕过错、耐心等待；具体含义看语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Diving as an activity, or the process or state of immersion or submersion in water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 潜水这项活动，或浸入水中、没入水下的过程或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li tinżel taħt l-ilma, jew il-proċess jew l-istat li tkun mgħaddas fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潜水；进入水下进行活动。
浸入；使物体进入水等液体中的过程或状态。
没入水下；被液体完全覆盖的过程或状态。

formal.mt: Il-kors tal-għadis jinkludi taħriġ dwar l-użu tat-tagħmir u l-komunikazzjoni taħt l-ilma.
formal.en: The diving course includes training in equipment use and underwater communication.
formal.zh: 潜水课程包括装备使用和水下交流方面的训练。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tagħmel kors tal-għadis miegħi? Mark: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid insir naf x'tagħmir għandna bżonn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to take a diving course with me? Mark: Yes, but first I want to find out what equipment we need.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你想和我一起上潜水课吗？Mark：想，不过我想先了解我们需要什么装备。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想和我一起上潜水课吗？
messages.en: Do you want to take a diving course with me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid insir naf x'tagħmir għandna bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid insir naf x'tagħmir għandna bżonn.
messages.zh: 想，不过我想先了解我们需要什么装备。
messages.en: Yes, but first I want to find out what equipment we need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在“潜水课程、潜水装备”的画面中记忆；它可指整项活动，也可指浸入或没入状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hard part of a human or animal skeleton.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成人或动物骨骼的一块坚硬组织，即骨头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti iebsa li tifforma parti mill-iskeletru ta' bniedem jew annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骨；人或动物骨骼中的一块骨头。

formal.mt: It-tabib spjega li l-għadma miksura kienet qed tfiq u li kien hemm bżonn aktar mistrieħ.
formal.en: The doctor explained that the broken bone was healing and that more rest was needed.
formal.zh: 医生解释说，断裂的骨头正在愈合，还需要多休息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Oqgħod attent, hemm għadma f'dik il-biċċa tiġieġ. Ben: Grazzi, inneħħiha qabel niekol.
colloquial.en: Nina: Be careful, there's a bone in that piece of chicken. Ben: Thanks, I'll take it out before I eat.
colloquial.zh: Nina：小心，那块鸡肉里有骨头。Ben：谢谢，我吃之前会把它取出来。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod attent, hemm għadma f'dik il-biċċa tiġieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod attent, hemm għadma f'dik il-biċċa tiġieġ.
messages.zh: 小心，那块鸡肉里有骨头。
messages.en: Be careful, there's a bone in that piece of chicken.

messages.speaker: Ben (用餐者)
messages.zh: 谢谢，我吃之前会把它取出来。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll take it out before I eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从一块鸡肉里挑出一块硬骨头，把这个具体可数的物体与 għadma 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single act or occasion of diving into or under water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次进入水中或潜到水下的动作或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba waħda li fiha persuna tidħol fl-ilma jew tinżel taħtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次潜水或入水动作。

formal.mt: Il-grupp għamel għadsa qasira qrib ix-xatt biex josserva l-ħajja tal-baħar.
formal.en: The group made a short dive near the shore to observe marine life.
formal.zh: 小组在岸边附近进行了一次短暂的潜水，以观察海洋生物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kienet l-ewwel għadsa tiegħek? Pawlu: Kienet qasira, imma rajt ħafna ħut.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was your first dive? Pawlu: It was short, but I saw lots of fish.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你第一次潜水感觉怎么样？Pawlu：时间不长，不过我看到了很多鱼。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你第一次潜水感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How was your first dive?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (潜水学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet qasira, imma rajt ħafna ħut.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet qasira, imma rajt ħafna ħut.
messages.zh: 时间不长，不过我看到了很多鱼。
messages.en: It was short, but I saw lots of fish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给潜水经历逐次编号：第一次、第二次；每一次具体经历都可用 għadsa 来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling or relationship of hostility or hatred between people or groups.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或群体之间的敌意、仇怨或敌对关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment jew relazzjoni ta' mibegħda u ostilità bejn persuni jew gruppi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敌意；仇怨；彼此敌对的关系。

formal.mt: Il-medjatur ipprova jtemm l-għadwa bejn iż-żewġ familji permezz ta' laqgħat u djalogu.
formal.en: The mediator tried to end the enmity between the two families through meetings and dialogue.
formal.zh: 调解人试图通过会面和对话化解两个家族之间的仇怨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad hemm għadwa bejn dawk iż-żewġ familji? Mark: Le, issa jitkellmu u anke jgħinu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there still enmity between those two families? Mark: No, now they talk and even help each other.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那两个家族之间还有仇怨吗？Mark：没有了，现在他们会交谈，甚至互相帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad hemm għadwa bejn dawk iż-żewġ familji?
messages.mt_standard: Għad hemm għadwa bejn dawk iż-żewġ familji?
messages.zh: 那两个家族之间还有仇怨吗？
messages.en: Is there still enmity between those two families?

messages.speaker: Mark (社区居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa jitkellmu u anke jgħinu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa jitkellmu u anke jgħinu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 没有了，现在他们会交谈，甚至互相帮忙。
messages.en: No, now they talk and even help each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个家族因仇怨长期互不来往，再想象调解后的握手，用前后画面记住“敌意、仇怨”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dry out or become desiccated, especially when crops lose moisture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变干或干枯，尤其指庄稼失去水分而枯干。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinxef jew jitlef l-umdità, speċjalment meta jingħad għall-uċuħ tar-raba'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变干；失去水分。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become desiccated (usually said of crops)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得干枯、枯干，通常用于庄稼。

collocations.en: dried out because of the drought

formal.mt: Il-qamħ għafen minħabba n-nuqqas ta' xita matul il-perjodu tat-tkabbir.
formal.en: The wheat dried out because of the lack of rain during the growing period.
formal.zh: 由于生长期缺少降雨，小麦干枯了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara mill-qamħ f'dik l-għalqa? Toni: Għafen għax ilu ħafna ma jagħmel xita.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to the wheat in that field? Toni: It dried out because it hasn't rained for a long time.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那块田里的小麦怎么了？Toni：干枯了，因为已经很久没下雨了。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 那块田里的小麦怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the wheat in that field?

messages.speaker: Toni (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għafen għax ilu ħafna ma jagħmel xita.
messages.mt_standard: Għafen għax ilu ħafna ma jagħmel xita.
messages.zh: 干枯了，因为已经很久没下雨了。
messages.en: It dried out because it hasn't rained for a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象田里的小麦久旱失水，由青绿变成枯黄，把这个词和“庄稼变干、干枯”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply pressure to something by pressing, stamping on it, or squeezing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对物体施加压力，可指按压、用脚踩压或挤压。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel pressjoni fuq xi ħaġa billi jagħfasha, jirfisha jew jagħsarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按；压；对某物施加压力。
用脚重重地踩；踩压。
挤；捏；通过施压使某物收紧或变形。

collocations.en: stamped on the can with his foot

formal.mt: L-operatur għafeġ il-buttuna ħamra biex iwaqqaf il-magna.
formal.en: The operator pressed the red button to stop the machine.
formal.zh: 操作员按下红色按钮，使机器停止运转。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-bott huwa ċatt? Mark: Ħija għafeġ il-bott b'siequ qabel poġġieh fir-riċiklaġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the can flat? Mark: My brother stamped on it before putting it in the recycling.
colloquial.zh: Maja：罐子怎么扁了？Mark：我哥哥把它放进回收箱前，用脚踩扁了它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 罐子怎么扁了？
messages.en: Why is the can flat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija għafeġ il-bott b'siequ qabel poġġieh fir-riċiklaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija għafeġ il-bott b'siequ qabel poġġieh fir-riċiklaġġ.
messages.zh: 我哥哥把它放进回收箱前，用脚踩扁了它。
messages.en: My brother stamped on it before putting it in the recycling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把按钮、脚下的罐子和手里的海绵连成三幅图，用共同的“施加压力”记住按、踩、挤三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To squeeze something with considerable force or to squeeze it repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用较大的力挤压某物，或连续、反复地挤压。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħfas xi ħaġa bis-saħħa jew jagħfasha għal bosta drabi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力挤压，或反复挤压。

collocations.en: squeezed the sponge hard or repeatedly
collocations.zh: 用力或反复挤压了海绵

collocations.en: squeezed the rubber ball hard or repeatedly
collocations.zh: 用力或反复捏压了橡皮球

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem għaffas l-isponża diversi drabi biex ineħħi l-ilma żejjed.
formal.en: The worker squeezed the sponge repeatedly to remove the excess water.
formal.zh: 工人反复挤压海绵，以排出多余的水。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif ħareġ daqshekk ilma mill-isponża? Pawlu: Ħija għaffas l-isponża diversi drabi.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did so much water come out of the sponge? Pawlu: My brother squeezed it several times.
colloquial.zh: Nina：海绵怎么挤出了这么多水？Pawlu：我哥哥把海绵反复挤了好几次。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 海绵怎么挤出了这么多水？
messages.en: How did so much water come out of the sponge?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥把海绵反复挤了好几次。
messages.en: My brother squeezed it several times.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“使劲捏海绵，再捏几次”的动作帮助记忆，同时抓住“力度大”和“次数多”这两个意义重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of applying pressure to something by pressing or squeezing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按压或挤压某物的动作、过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tagħmel pressjoni fuq xi ħaġa billi tagħfasha jew tagħsarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按压这一动作或过程。
挤压这一动作或过程。

formal.mt: L-għafis tal-għeneb joħroġ il-meraq li jkun fih.
formal.en: Pressing grapes releases the juice they contain.
formal.zh: 压榨葡萄会使其中的汁液流出。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed tqattar l-isponża? Leo: Għad hemm ħafna ilma fiha; l-għafis jgħin biex joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is the sponge dripping? Leo: There's still a lot of water in it; squeezing helps get it out.
colloquial.zh: Marta：海绵怎么还在滴水？Leo：里面还有很多水，挤压有助于把水排出来。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 海绵怎么还在滴水？
messages.en: Why is the sponge dripping?

messages.speaker: Leo (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad hemm ħafna ilma fiha; l-għafis jgħin biex joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għad hemm ħafna ilma fiha; l-għafis jgħin biex joħroġ.
messages.zh: 里面还有很多水，挤压有助于把水排出来。
messages.en: There's still a lot of water in it; squeezing helps get it out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把压葡萄、挤海绵的动作拍成一段小视频，再给视频标上“按压过程”，帮助记住这是动作名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To press something with a finger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手指对某物施加压力；用手指按压。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħfas xi ħaġa b'subgħajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用手指按；用手指按压。

collocations.en: pressed the button with a finger
pressed the doorbell with a finger

formal.mt: Il-viżitatur għaflas il-qanpiena b'subgħajh u stenna sakemm infetaħ il-bieb.
formal.en: The visitor pressed the doorbell with his finger and waited until the door opened.
formal.zh: 访客用手指按了门铃，等候开门。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min daqq il-qanpiena? Ben: Ħija għaflas il-qanpiena b'subgħajh; qed jistenna barra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who rang the doorbell? Ben: My brother pressed it with his finger; he's waiting outside.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁按门铃了？Ben：我哥哥用手指按的，他正在外面等。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 谁按门铃了？
messages.en: Who rang the doorbell?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija għaflas il-qanpiena b'subgħajh; qed jistenna barra.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija għaflas il-qanpiena b'subgħajh; qed jistenna barra.
messages.zh: 我哥哥用手指按的，他正在外面等。
messages.en: My brother pressed it with his finger; he's waiting outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中放大一根手指按门铃的特写，每次见到这个词都先想到“手指”，再想到“按压”。

gloss_zh: 走过湿地面时用脚溅开积水

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scatter water with one's feet while walking over a wet surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走在潮湿、有水的地面上时，用脚步把水溅开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iferrex l-ilma b'saqajh waqt li jimxi fuq wiċċ imxarrab.

sense_translations.en_definition: to disperse water with one's feet as one walks on a wet surface
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在湿地面上行走时，用脚把地面的水溅散。

collocations.en: splashed through the water on foot
collocations.zh: 走过积水时把水溅开了

collocations.en: scattered water with his feet while walking on wet ground
collocations.zh: 在湿地面上行走时用脚溅开了水
