formal.mt: Wara x-xita, it-tifel għafleġ fuq il-bankina mxarrba u xerred l-ilma b'saqajh.
formal.en: After the rain, the boy walked along the wet pavement, scattering water with his feet.
formal.zh: 雨后，男孩走在湿漉漉的人行道上，脚步把地面的水溅开。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif ixxarrab il-qalziet tiegħek? David: Ħija għafleġ fl-ilma ħdejja u tajjar l-ilma fuqi.
colloquial.en: Elena: How did your trousers get wet? David: My brother splashed through the water beside me and splashed water onto me.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你的裤子怎么湿了？David：我哥哥在我旁边踩着积水走，把水溅到我身上了。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的裤子怎么湿了？
messages.en: How did your trousers get wet?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija għafleġ fl-ilma ħdejja u tajjar l-ilma fuqi.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija għafleġ fl-ilma ħdejja u tajjar l-ilma fuqi.
messages.zh: 我哥哥在我旁边踩着积水走，把水溅到我身上了。
messages.en: My brother splashed through the water beside me and splashed water onto me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雨后踩着积水走，鞋子每落一步就溅出一圈水花，把“脚步、湿地、水花”三个画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single squeeze or press that applies pressure to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某物进行的一次挤压或一下按压。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pressjoni waħda fuq xi ħaġa, bħal meta tagħfas sponża jew buttuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次挤压；一下捏压。

formal.mt: Għafsa waħda tal-buttuna tibda l-programm tal-ħasil.
formal.en: A single press of the button starts the washing programme.
formal.zh: 按一下按钮即可启动洗涤程序。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-isponża għadha mimlija ilma. Mark: Agħtiha għafsa oħra fuq is-sink.
colloquial.en: Maja: The sponge is still full of water. Mark: Give it another squeeze over the sink.
colloquial.zh: Maja：海绵里还全是水。Mark：在水槽上方再挤一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 海绵里还全是水。
messages.en: The sponge is still full of water.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 在水槽上方再挤一下。
messages.en: Give it another squeeze over the sink.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手握海绵只挤一下，心里同时数“一”，用这一个完整动作记住“一次挤压、一下按压”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Shouting, or the sound of people speaking in loud voices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喊叫这一行为，或人们高声说话、呼喊所发出的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jgħajjat, jew il-ħsejjes ta' nies jitkellmu b'leħen għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喊叫；大声呼喊的行为。
高声说话的声音；响亮的人声。

formal.mt: L-għajat fil-kuritur fixkel lill-istudenti waqt l-eżami.
formal.en: The shouting in the corridor disturbed the students during the examination.
formal.zh: 走廊里的喊叫声干扰了正在考试的学生。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dan l-għajat barra? Mark: It-tfal qed jilagħbu; dak għajat ta' ferħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's all that shouting outside? Mark: The children are playing; those are shouts of joy.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：外面怎么有这么多喊叫声？马克：孩子们在玩，那是开心的欢呼声。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 外面怎么有这么多喊叫声？
messages.en: What's all that shouting outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tfal qed jilagħbu; dak għajat ta' ferħ.
messages.mt_standard: It-tfal qed jilagħbu; dak għajat ta' ferħ.
messages.zh: 孩子们在玩，那是开心的欢呼声。
messages.en: The children are playing; those are shouts of joy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先听见走廊里的大嗓门，再看见有人喊叫：għajat 既可记喊叫行为，也可记传来的高声人声。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A variant of għajdut, referring to a rumor, hearsay or gossip, or to a proverb or saying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: għajdut 的另一形式，可指传闻、道听途说或闲话，也可指谚语、俗语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma oħra ta' għajdut: xnigħa jew kliem li jingħad dwar xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa; ukoll qawl jew espressjoni magħrufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: għajdut 的另一形式。
传闻；道听途说；流传的闲话。
谚语；俗语；人们常说的话。

formal.mt: Fl-istudju tiegħu, l-awtur jiddistingwi bejn għajduna bħala xnigħa u għajduna bħala qawl.
formal.en: In his study, the author distinguishes between għajduna as a rumor and għajduna as a proverb.
formal.zh: 作者在研究中区分了 għajduna 表示传闻和表示谚语的两种用法。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din hi aħbar ċerta jew għajduna? Ġanni: Għajduna biss; għad m'għandna ebda konferma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this confirmed news or a rumor? Ġanni: Just a rumor; we don't have any confirmation yet.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是确切消息，还是传闻？詹尼：只是传闻；我们还没有得到任何证实。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hi aħbar ċerta jew għajduna?
messages.mt_standard: Din hi aħbar ċerta jew għajduna?
messages.zh: 这是确切消息，还是传闻？
messages.en: Is this confirmed news or a rumor?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għajduna biss; għad m'għandna ebda konferma.
messages.mt_standard: Għajduna biss; għad m'għandna ebda konferma.
messages.zh: 只是传闻；我们还没有得到任何证实。
messages.en: Just a rumor; we don't have any confirmation yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把口耳相传分成两幅画面：未经证实的消息是传闻，反复引用的话是俗语；另用等号卡片记住 għajduna 与 għajdut 的形式对应。

gloss_zh: 疏于照顾；遗弃（通常指家人）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To neglect or abandon someone, especially one's family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不尽照顾责任，或抛下某人不管，通常用于自己的家人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jittraskura jew jabbanduna lil xi ħadd, speċjalment lill-familja tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to neglect or abandon (usually said of one's family)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 疏于照顾或遗弃，通常指对自己的家人不尽责任或弃之不顾。

collocations.en: he neglected or abandoned his family
collocations.zh: 他疏于照顾或遗弃了自己的家人

collocations.en: he neglected or abandoned his children
collocations.zh: 他疏于照顾或遗弃了自己的子女

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif ir-raġel għajjel lil familtu u ħalla lil uliedu mingħajr appoġġ.
formal.en: The report describes how the man neglected his family and left his children without support.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该男子如何不顾家人，使子女失去支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex it-tfal qed joqogħdu man-nanna? Toni: Missierhom għajjel lil familtu, u n-nanna qed tieħu ħsiebhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are the children staying with their grandmother? Toni: Their father abandoned his family, and their grandmother is looking after them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：孩子们为什么住在奶奶家？托尼：他们的父亲抛下家人不管，现在是奶奶在照顾他们。

messages.speaker: Maja (亲属)
messages.zh: 孩子们为什么住在奶奶家？
messages.en: Why are the children staying with their grandmother?

messages.speaker: Toni (亲属)
messages.mt_spoken: Missierhom għajjel lil familtu, u n-nanna qed tieħu ħsiebhom.
messages.mt_standard: Missierhom għajjel lil familtu, u n-nanna qed tieħu ħsiebhom.
messages.zh: 他们的父亲抛下家人不管，现在是奶奶在照顾他们。
messages.en: Their father abandoned his family, and their grandmother is looking after them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张空着的家庭餐桌座位来记 għajjel：本该承担照顾责任的人缺席，突出对家人的疏忽或遗弃。

gloss_zh: 喂养；滋养；惹人嫉妒或怨恨；激怒

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feed or nourish; in other senses, to provoke jealousy or resentment, or to make someone angry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人或动物喂食、提供滋养；其他义项指引起嫉妒或怨恨，或使某人生气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitma' jew jagħti nutriment; f'tifsiriet oħra, li jqajjem għira jew riżentiment, jew jirrabja lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喂食；给食物吃。
滋养；提供维持生命或成长所需的营养。
引起嫉妒或怨恨；使人心生妒意或不满。
使某人生气；激怒某人。

collocations.en: he nourished his body with good food
collocations.zh: 他用良好的食物滋养身体

collocations.en: he angered his companion with his words
collocations.zh: 他用自己的话激怒了同伴

formal.mt: Bil-kumment tiegħu, għajjet lil sieħbu u qajjem fih għira u riżentiment.
formal.en: With his remark, he provoked jealousy and resentment in his companion.
formal.zh: 他的一番话引起了同伴的嫉妒和怨恨。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min għajjet lit-tifel dalgħodu? Mark: Missieru għajjet lit-tifel qabel ħadu l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who fed the boy this morning? Mark: His father fed him before taking him to school.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天早上是谁给孩子吃饭的？马克：他爸爸在送他上学前给他吃了饭。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 今天早上是谁给孩子吃饭的？
messages.en: Who fed the boy this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieru għajjet lit-tifel qabel ħadu l-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Missieru għajjet lit-tifel qabel ħadu l-iskola.
messages.zh: 他爸爸在送他上学前给他吃了饭。
messages.en: His father fed him before taking him to school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 għajjet 准备两组画面：饭勺对应喂养与滋养，生气的脸对应嫉妒、怨恨与激怒；阅读时用上下文选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who begets or fathers a child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生育子女的男子；作为孩子生育者的父亲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li jnissel wild jew ulied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生育子女者；使孩子诞生的父亲。

collocations.en: a man who has fathered many children
collocations.zh: 生育了许多子女的男子

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-kelma 'għajjiel' tindika r-raġel li nissel il-wild.
formal.en: In this text, the word 'għajjiel' denotes the man who fathered the child.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，għajjiel 一词指生育该孩子的男子。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'għajjiel' f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Tfisser ir-raġel li nissel il-wild, jiġifieri l-missier.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'għajjiel' mean in this sentence? Pawlu: It means the man who fathered the child, that is, the father.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这句话里的 għajjiel 是什么意思？保罗：指生育这个孩子的男子，也就是孩子的父亲。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 għajjiel 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'għajjiel' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser ir-raġel li nissel il-wild, jiġifieri l-missier.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser ir-raġel li nissel il-wild, jiġifieri l-missier.
messages.zh: 指生育这个孩子的男子，也就是孩子的父亲。
messages.en: It means the man who fathered the child, that is, the father.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在家谱中从父亲画一条线连向孩子，再标上 għajjiel：用生育关系记住这个指人的名词，重点是父亲作为生育者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family, understood as a group of related people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 家庭，指具有亲属关系的一群人或一家人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Familja, jiġifieri grupp ta' nies marbutin b'rabtiet ta' parentela.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家庭；一家人。

formal.mt: L-għajla kollha ħadet sehem fiċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The whole family took part in the ceremony.
formal.zh: 全家人都参加了仪式。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma' min se tiekol il-Ħadd? Toni: Mal-għajla kollha, għand in-nanna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who are you having lunch with on Sunday? Toni: With the whole family, at Grandma's.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：星期天你和谁一起吃午饭？托尼：和全家人一起，在奶奶家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 星期天你和谁一起吃午饭？
messages.en: Who are you having lunch with on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 和全家人一起，在奶奶家。
messages.en: With the whole family, at Grandma's.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għajla 和全家围桌吃饭的画面绑定，看到这个词就回想“一家人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant species Adonis microcarpa, known in English as small-fruit pheasant's-eye.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物名，指小果侧金盏花，学名为 Adonis microcarpa。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ispeċi Adonis microcarpa, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala small-fruit pheasant's-eye.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小果侧金盏花；学名 Adonis microcarpa。

collocations.zh: 小果侧金盏花这种植物
一张小果侧金盏花的照片

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jelenka għajn is-serduq bl-isem xjentifiku Adonis microcarpa.
formal.en: The catalogue lists small-fruit pheasant's-eye under the scientific name Adonis microcarpa.
formal.zh: 目录以学名 Adonis microcarpa 收录小果侧金盏花。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta fir-ritratt? Toni: Għajn is-serduq; taħtha hemm miktub Adonis microcarpa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the plant in this photograph called? Toni: Small-fruit pheasant's-eye; Adonis microcarpa is written underneath.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的植物叫什么？托尼：小果侧金盏花；下面写着 Adonis microcarpa。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is the plant in this photograph called?

messages.mt_standard: Għajn is-serduq; taħtha hemm miktub Adonis microcarpa.
messages.zh: 小果侧金盏花；下面写着 Adonis microcarpa。
messages.en: Small-fruit pheasant's-eye; Adonis microcarpa is written underneath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għajn is-serduq 整体写在植物图片旁，再配学名 Adonis microcarpa，按完整植物名称记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To look at or regard someone or something, sometimes with particular attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 看着、注视或打量某人某物，可以强调把目光投向对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħares lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, kultant b'attenzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 注视；端详。
打量；留意地看着。
看；看着某人或某物。

formal.mt: Qabel ma wieġeb, id-direttur għajnas lejn id-dokument fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: Before replying, the director looked at the document on the table.
formal.zh: 回答之前，主任看了看桌上的文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu waqaf jitkellem? Toni: Semgħet ħoss u għajnas lejn il-bieb? Le, hu sema' ħoss u għajnas lejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu stop talking? Toni: She heard a noise and looked towards the door? No, he heard a noise and looked towards the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么不说话了？托尼：是她听到声音朝门口看去了吗？不是，是他听到声音朝门口看去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么不说话了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop talking?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Semgħet ħoss u għajnas lejn il-bieb? Le, hu sema' ħoss u għajnas lejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Semgħet ħoss u għajnas lejn il-bieb? Le, hu sema' ħoss u għajnas lejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 是她听到声音朝门口看去了吗？不是，是他听到声音朝门口看去。
messages.en: She heard a noise and looked towards the door? No, he heard a noise and looked towards the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għajnas 配上目光转向门口的动作，用“看、注视、打量”串起三个相近义项。

gloss_zh: 生计；生命或寿命；家庭女教师或女佣

teaching_sense.en_definition: A livelihood or means of supporting oneself; also life or lifespan, or a governess or household maid in a separate sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指维持生活的生计，也可指生命、寿命；另有家庭女教师或家中女佣的独立义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mezz ta' għajxien; ukoll il-ħajja jew it-tul tagħha; f'tifsira oħra, mara li tieħu ħsieb it-tfal jew taħdem bħala qaddejja fid-dar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生计；赖以维持生活的收入或谋生方式。
生命；一生；寿命。
家庭女教师；家中女佣。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol fil-ħanut jipprovdi għajxa diċenti għall-familja.
formal.en: The work in the shop provides a decent livelihood for the family.
formal.zh: 店里的工作为这家人提供了体面的生计。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Toni jaqla' l-għajxa mill-ħanut? Pawlu: Iva, dak hu x-xogħol tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Toni earn his living from the shop? Pawlu: Yes, that is his job.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼靠这家店谋生吗？保罗：是的，那就是他的工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼靠这家店谋生吗？
messages.en: Does Toni earn his living from the shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，那就是他的工作。
messages.en: Yes, that is his job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 għajxa 画三张词义卡：收入对应生计，时间轴对应寿命，家中工作人员对应女教师或女佣，靠语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To age or grow old as time passes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随着时间推移而衰老、逐渐变老。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar xiħ jew avvanza fl-età maż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衰老；年龄渐长。
逐渐变老；步入老年。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist għakkek maż-żmien, iżda baqa' interessat fil-ħajja tar-raħal.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist grew old with time but remained interested in village life.
formal.zh: 小说中，主人公随着时间推移逐渐变老，但仍然关心村里的生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt lil Pawlu wara tant snin? Toni: Iva, għakkek, imma għadu jħobb jiċċajta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see Pawlu after all these years? Toni: Yes, he has grown old, but he still loves joking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：过了这么多年，你见到保罗了吗？托尼：见到了，他老了，但还是爱开玩笑。

messages.speaker: Maja (老朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt lil Pawlu wara tant snin?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt lil Pawlu wara tant snin?
messages.zh: 过了这么多年，你见到保罗了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Pawlu after all these years?

messages.speaker: Toni (老朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għakkek, imma għadu jħobb jiċċajta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għakkek, imma għadu jħobb jiċċajta.
messages.zh: 见到了，他老了，但还是爱开玩笑。
messages.en: Yes, he has grown old, but he still loves joking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għakkek 放在同一个人青年与老年的照片之间，记住它表达随岁月逐渐变老的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A callus, or patch of thickened skin, on the shoulder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肩部的胼胝，即肩上形成的一块增厚硬皮，俗称老茧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti mill-ġilda tal-ispalla li tkun ħxienet u bbieset.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肩部胼胝；肩上的老茧或增厚硬皮。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi għakra fuq l-ispalla tax-xellug tal-ħaddiem.
formal.en: The report describes a callus on the worker's left shoulder.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这名工人左肩上的一块胼胝。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-parti iebsa fuq spalltek? Toni: Għakra; inħossha meta nilbes din il-qmis.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that hard patch on your shoulder? Toni: A callus; I can feel it when I wear this shirt.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你肩上那块硬皮是什么？托尼：是老茧；穿这件衬衫时我能感觉到它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik il-parti iebsa fuq spalltek?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik il-parti iebsa fuq spalltek?
messages.zh: 你肩上那块硬皮是什么？
messages.en: What is that hard patch on your shoulder?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għakra; inħossha meta nilbes din il-qmis.
messages.mt_standard: Għakra; inħossha meta nilbes din il-qmis.
messages.zh: 是老茧；穿这件衬衫时我能感觉到它。
messages.en: A callus; I can feel it when I wear this shirt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 għakra 时轻指肩膀，想象那里有一小块硬皮，把身体部位和“肩茧”一起记牢。

gloss_zh: 蝎子；天蝎座（星座或黄道星座）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scorpion; as a name, also Scorpius the constellation or Scorpio the zodiac sign.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指蝎子；用作专名时，也指天文学中的天蝎座或黄道十二星座中的天蝎座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal imsejjaħ skorpjun; bħala isem, ukoll il-kostellazzjoni Scorpius jew is-sinjal taż-żodijaku Scorpio.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蝎子。
天蝎座，指天文学中的星座。
天蝎座，指黄道十二星座之一。

formal.mt: Il-mappa tas-sema turi l-kostellazzjoni tal-Għakreb.
formal.en: The sky map shows the constellation Scorpius.
formal.zh: 这张星图标出了天蝎座。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm f'dan ir-ritratt? Toni: Għakreb żgħir ħdejn ġebla.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is in this photograph? Toni: A small scorpion beside a stone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张照片里有什么？托尼：一只在石头旁边的小蝎子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张照片里有什么？
messages.en: What is in this photograph?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 一只在石头旁边的小蝎子。
messages.en: A small scorpion beside a stone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张图记 għakreb：地上的蝎子、星图中的天蝎座、十二星座中的天蝎座，分别对应普通名词和两个专名义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk slowly or linger about without hurrying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缓慢地行走，或不急着离开而闲逛、徘徊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mexa bil-mod jew baqa' jdur f'post mingħajr għaġla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慢慢走；缓步行走。
闲逛；徘徊；逗留不去。

formal.mt: Wara l-laqgħa, il-viżitatur għakrek fil-bitħa qabel telaq.
formal.en: After the meeting, the visitor lingered in the courtyard before leaving.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，来访者在院子里逗留了一会儿才离开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu mar dritt id-dar? Toni: Le, għakrek ftit fil-pjazza u mbagħad telaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu go straight home? Toni: No, he loitered in the square for a bit and then left.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗直接回家了吗？托尼：没有，他在广场闲逛了一会儿，然后才离开。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗直接回家了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu go straight home?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għakrek ftit fil-pjazza u mbagħad telaq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għakrek ftit fil-pjazza u mbagħad telaq.
messages.zh: 没有，他在广场闲逛了一会儿，然后才离开。
messages.en: No, he loitered in the square for a bit and then left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għakrek 和广场上不紧不慢的脚步绑定：强调速度就是“慢走”，强调停留就是“闲逛、徘徊”。

gloss_zh: 爬行；像蜗牛一样缓慢移动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To crawl along or move forward extremely slowly, like a snail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 爬着前进，或像蜗牛一样极其缓慢地移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi jitkaxkar jew jiċċaqlaq bil-mod ħafna, bħal bebbuxu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沿着地面等表面爬行前进。

sense_translations.en_definition: to move very slowly, like a snail
sense_translations.zh_definition: 像蜗牛一样非常缓慢地移动。

collocations.en: moved as slowly as a snail

formal.mt: Il-bebbux għakrex mal-ħajt imxarrab u mexa biss ftit ċentimetri.
formal.en: The snail crawled along the wet wall and moved only a few centimetres.
formal.zh: 蜗牛沿着湿墙缓缓爬行，只前进了几厘米。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-bebbux wasal sal-werqa? Mark: Iva, imma għakrex bħal bebbuxu tul il-ġebla kollha!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the snail reach the leaf? Mark: Yes, but it moved at a snail's pace along the whole stone!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：蜗牛爬到叶子那里了吗？马克：到了，不过它沿着整块石头一路慢吞吞地爬过去！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 蜗牛爬到叶子那里了吗？
messages.en: Did the snail reach the leaf?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għakrex bħal bebbuxu tul il-ġebla kollha!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għakrex bħal bebbuxu tul il-ġebla kollha!
messages.zh: 到了，不过它沿着整块石头一路慢吞吞地爬过去！
messages.en: Yes, but it moved at a snail's pace along the whole stone!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għakrex 配上蜗牛沿湿墙慢爬的画面，记住它强调的是爬行或极慢移动这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Movement that proceeds extremely slowly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行得极其缓慢的移动或挪动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċaqliq li jsir bil-mod ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常缓慢的移动。

collocations.en: the very slow movement of snails

formal.mt: L-għakrix tat-traffiku ħdejn il-pont dewwem il-wasla tal-karozzi tal-linja.
formal.en: The crawling movement of traffic near the bridge delayed the arrival of the buses.
formal.zh: 桥附近的车流缓慢挪动，导致公共汽车延迟到达。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex wasalt tard? Pawlu: Minħabba l-għakrix tat-traffiku; għal nofs siegħa mxejna biss ftit metri.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you arrive late? Pawlu: Because of the crawling traffic; in half an hour we moved only a few metres.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么迟到了？保罗：因为车流挪得太慢了，我们半小时才前进了几米。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-għakrix tat-traffiku; għal nofs siegħa mxejna biss ftit metri.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-għakrix tat-traffiku; għal nofs siegħa mxejna biss ftit metri.
messages.zh: 因为车流挪得太慢了，我们半小时才前进了几米。
messages.en: Because of the crawling traffic; in half an hour we moved only a few metres.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象堵车时车辆一点点挪动，把 għakrix 记成这种极慢移动的名称，注意它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Famine or hunger; also oppression that causes people to suffer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指饥荒或饥饿，也可指使人遭受苦难的压迫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġuħ jew nuqqas kbir ta' ikel; ukoll oppressjoni li ġġiegħel lin-nies ibatu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大范围严重缺粮的饥荒。
因缺乏食物而产生的饥饿。
使人受苦、受制或失去自由的压迫。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi l-għaks li ġabet in-nixfa u t-tbatija tal-familji li ma kellhomx ikel.
formal.en: The account describes the famine brought by the drought and the suffering of families who had no food.
formal.zh: 这篇记述描写了干旱引发的饥荒，以及没有食物的家庭所承受的苦难。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed niġbru l-ikel? Toni: Biex ngħinu lill-familji li qed ibatu l-għaks.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are we collecting food? Toni: To help families who are suffering hunger.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我们为什么要募集食物？托尼：为了帮助正在挨饿的家庭。

messages.speaker: Lara (志愿者)
messages.zh: 我们为什么要募集食物？
messages.en: Why are we collecting food?

messages.speaker: Toni (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ngħinu lill-familji li qed ibatu l-għaks.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ngħinu lill-familji li qed ibatu l-għaks.
messages.zh: 为了帮助正在挨饿的家庭。
messages.en: To help families who are suffering hunger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景记 għaks：整村缺粮是饥荒，个人无食是饥饿，受残酷统治是压迫；阅读时靠上下文选义。

gloss_zh: 突然；出乎意料地；毫无预警地

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suddenly or unexpectedly, without any warning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示事情突然发生，事先没有预警或不在预料之中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod mhux mistenni, mingħajr ebda twissija minn qabel.

sense_translations.en_definition: suddenly, at once, unexpectedly, without warning
sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然；一下子；出乎意料地；毫无预警地。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa ntemmet għal għarrieda meta nqata' d-dawl.
formal.en: The meeting ended suddenly when the power went out.
formal.zh: 停电时，会议突然结束了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaft għal għarrieda? Mark: Għax rajt qattus fit-triq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you stop suddenly? Mark: Because I saw a cat in the road.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么突然停下？Mark：因为我看见路上有一只猫。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么突然停下？
messages.en: Why did you stop suddenly?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.zh: 因为我看见路上有一只猫。
messages.en: Because I saw a cat in the road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象车前突然出现一只猫，司机立即刹车；把整个短语与“毫无预警的突变”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a very short period of time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示持续很短的一段时间，相当于“片刻”或“一会儿”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għal perjodu qasir ħafna ta' żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 片刻；一会儿；短暂地。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem waqaf għal waqt wieħed qabel ma wieġeb il-mistoqsija.
formal.en: The speaker paused for a moment before answering the question.
formal.zh: 发言者停顿了片刻，然后回答了问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Stenna għal waqt wieħed, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Tajjeb, għadni hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Wait for a moment, please. Mark: All right, I am still here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：请等一会儿。马克：好的，我还在这里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna għal waqt wieħed, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna għal waqt wieħed, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请等一会儿。
messages.en: Wait for a moment, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好的，我还在这里。
messages.en: All right, I am still here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象谈话中举手示意暂停一小会儿，把整个短语和短暂等待的动作连起来记忆。

gloss_zh: 漠不关心地；漫不经心地

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that shows indifference, unconcern, or a lack of care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不在意、不关心或不认真对待的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juri nuqqas ta' interess jew ta' ħsieb dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to express indifference or unconcern: indifferently; carelessly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示不关心或不在意：漠然地；漫不经心地。

formal.mt: L-impjegat wieġeb għala bieb għall-ilment, mingħajr ma pprova jifhem il-problema.
formal.en: The employee answered the complaint indifferently, without trying to understand the problem.
formal.zh: 那名员工漠不关心地回应了投诉，没有尝试了解问题。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ħa l-ilment tiegħek bis-serjetà? Mark: Le, wieġeb għala bieb u kompla jħares lejn it-telefon.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did he take your complaint seriously? Mark: No, he answered indifferently and carried on looking at his phone.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他认真对待你的投诉了吗？马克：没有，他漫不经心地答了一句，就继续看手机了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 他认真对待你的投诉了吗？
messages.en: Did he take your complaint seriously?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, wieġeb għala bieb u kompla jħares lejn it-telefon.
messages.mt_standard: Le, wieġeb għala bieb u kompla jħares lejn it-telefon.
messages.zh: 没有，他漫不经心地答了一句，就继续看手机了。
messages.en: No, he answered indifferently and carried on looking at his phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għala bieb 当作整块表达来记，联想别人只顾看手机、随口应付的态度，不逐词猜测意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an error in an action, calculation, or judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在行动、计算或判断中犯下错误。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel żball f'xi azzjoni, kalkolu jew ġudizzju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯错误；把事情弄错。

collocations.en: made a mistake in the calculation

formal.mt: L-istudent għalat fil-kalkolu, iżda kkoreġa l-iżball wara li reġa' ċċekkja t-tweġiba.
formal.en: The student made a mistake in the calculation but corrected the error after checking the answer again.
formal.zh: 学生计算时出了错，但重新检查答案后改正了错误。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-pakkett wasal għand il-ġar? Pawlu: Il-kurrier għalat fl-indirizz, imma issa l-pakkett qiegħed hawn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the parcel arrive at the neighbour's? Pawlu: The courier got the address wrong, but the parcel is here now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：包裹为什么送到邻居家了？保罗：快递员弄错了地址，不过包裹现在已经在这里了。

messages.speaker: Sara (收件人)
messages.zh: 包裹为什么送到邻居家了？
messages.en: Why did the parcel arrive at the neighbour's?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kurrier għalat fl-indirizz, imma issa l-pakkett qiegħed hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kurrier għalat fl-indirizz, imma issa l-pakkett qiegħed hawn.
messages.zh: 快递员弄错了地址，不过包裹现在已经在这里了。
messages.en: The courier got the address wrong, but the parcel is here now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 għalat 就想象算式中被圈出的错误，记住它说的是某人犯错这个动作，而不是错误这个事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: So that a desired purpose or outcome can be achieved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引出希望达到的目的，表示以便或为了使。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biex jintlaħaq għan jew iseħħ riżultat mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以便；为了使某种预期情况得以实现。

collocations.en: so that you arrive on time

formal.mt: L-għalliema kitbet l-istruzzjonijiet b'mod ċar għalbiex kull student jifhem x'għandu jagħmel.
formal.en: The teacher wrote the instructions clearly so that every student would understand what to do.
formal.zh: 老师把说明写得很清楚，以便每位学生都能明白该做什么。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex se nitilqu kmieni? Toni: Għalbiex naslu fil-ħin u nsibu post fejn noqogħdu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we leaving early? Toni: So that we arrive on time and find somewhere to sit.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么要早点出发？托尼：为了准时到达，也能找到座位。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们为什么要早点出发？
messages.en: Why are we leaving early?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalbiex naslu fil-ħin u nsibu post fejn noqogħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Għalbiex naslu fil-ħin u nsibu post fejn noqogħdu.
messages.zh: 为了准时到达，也能找到座位。
messages.en: So that we arrive on time and find somewhere to sit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għalbiex 放在目的箭头上：早点出发，箭头指向准时到达；箭头处就读作以便。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Therefore or as a result of what has just been stated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承接前文的原因或情况，引出由此产生的结果或结论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għalhekk, bħala riżultat ta' dak li jkun intqal qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因此；结果；因而。

collocations.en: as a result, we had to wait

formal.mt: Il-pont kien magħluq; għaldaqshekk, il-karozzi tal-linja kellhom jużaw triq oħra.
formal.en: The bridge was closed; consequently, the buses had to use another road.
formal.zh: 桥梁关闭了，因此公共汽车必须改走其他道路。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex wasalt bil-mixi? Mark: Tlift il-karozza tal-linja; għaldaqshekk, ġejt bil-mixi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you arrive on foot? Mark: I missed the bus; so I walked here.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你为什么走着来了？马克：我没赶上公共汽车，所以就走过来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么走着来了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive on foot?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlift il-karozza tal-linja; għaldaqshekk, ġejt bil-mixi.
messages.mt_standard: Tlift il-karozza tal-linja; għaldaqshekk, ġejt bil-mixi.
messages.zh: 我没赶上公共汽车，所以就走过来了。
messages.en: I missed the bus; so I walked here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用因果链记 għaldaqshekk：没赶上车，因此步行。它连接已经给出的原因与随后的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feed or portion of food given on one occasion, usually to an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次喂食，或一次喂给的食物，通常用于动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba li fiha jingħata l-ikel, jew il-porzjon mogħti f'dik id-darba, normalment lil annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次喂食或一份供喂食的食物，通常指动物的饲喂。

collocations.en: to give the horse a feed

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ipprepara għalfa ta' ħuxlief għaż-żiemel qabel ma naddaf l-istalla.
formal.en: The worker prepared a feed of hay for the horse before cleaning the stable.
formal.zh: 工人在清理马厩之前，为马准备了一份干草。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Iż-żiemel kiel dalgħodu? Pawlu: Iva, tajtu għalfa ta' ħuxlief qabel tlaqna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did the horse eat this morning? Pawlu: Yes, I gave it a feed of hay before we left.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马今天早上吃过了吗？保罗：吃过了，我们出发前我给它喂了一份干草。

messages.speaker: Nina (马匹主人)
messages.zh: 马今天早上吃过了吗？
messages.en: Did the horse eat this morning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (饲养员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tajtu għalfa ta' ħuxlief qabel tlaqna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tajtu għalfa ta' ħuxlief qabel tlaqna.
messages.zh: 吃过了，我们出发前我给它喂了一份干草。
messages.en: Yes, I gave it a feed of hay before we left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象饲养员把一份干草放进马槽，把 għalfa 与一次喂食或这一份食物相连，记住常用于动物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Harmonious and united, with people acting together in agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容群体内部和睦、成员团结，并能协调一致地行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħqud u fi qbil, b'armonija bejn il-membri.

sense_translations.en_definition: harmonious, united, in concord and togetherness
sense_translations.zh_definition: 和谐的；团结的；彼此和睦、齐心协力的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat baqa' għalieni minkejja d-differenzi fl-opinjonijiet.
formal.en: The committee remained united despite differences of opinion.
formal.zh: 尽管存在意见分歧，委员会仍保持团结。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inhu l-grupp il-ġdid? Toni: Huwa għalieni; il-membri jgħinu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is the new group like? Toni: It is harmonious and united; the members help one another.
colloquial.zh: Sara：新小组怎么样？Toni：很和睦，也很团结；成员们互相帮助。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 新小组怎么样？
messages.en: What is the new group like?

messages.speaker: Toni (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa għalieni; il-membri jgħinu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa għalieni; il-membri jgħinu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 很和睦，也很团结；成员们互相帮助。
messages.en: It is harmonious and united; the members help one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一组人步调一致地划船：成员和睦，行动团结，用这个画面记住形容词的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being sticky, or of having a slippery, slimy feel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体容易黏附的性质，或表面带有黏液般黏滑触感的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proprjetà ta' xi ħaġa li twaħħal, jew li tinħass tiżloq u miksija b'sustanza viskuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黏性；容易黏住其他物体的性质。
黏滑性；带有黏液般滑膩触感的性质。

collocations.en: the sliminess on the surface of the fish

formal.mt: L-għalik tal-kolla jagħmilha diffiċli biex jitnaddaf il-wiċċ.
formal.en: The stickiness of the glue makes the surface difficult to clean.
formal.zh: 胶水的黏性使这个表面难以清洁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed inħoss l-għalik fuq il-wiċċ ta' din il-ħuta. Pawlu: Aħsel idejk wara li tmissha.
colloquial.en: Lara: I can feel the sliminess on the surface of this fish. Pawlu: Wash your hands after touching it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我能感觉到这条鱼表面黏黏滑滑的。Pawlu：摸过以后洗洗手。

messages.speaker: Lara (烹饪学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss l-għalik fuq il-wiċċ ta' din il-ħuta.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss l-għalik fuq il-wiċċ ta' din il-ħuta.
messages.zh: 我能感觉到这条鱼表面黏黏滑滑的。
messages.en: I can feel the sliminess on the surface of this fish.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (烹饪老师)
messages.zh: 摸过以后洗洗手。
messages.en: Wash your hands after touching it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 本条按名词记忆：胶水让手指黏住，鱼表让手指黏滑；用两种触感分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At least; indicating a minimum amount, number, or acceptable condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示数量、程度或要求的最低限度，相当于“至少、起码”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mhux inqas minn ammont jew numru msemmi, jew bħala l-inqas kundizzjoni aċċettabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 至少；起码；不低于所说的数量或最低要求。

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant għandu jġib għall-anqas kopja waħda tad-dokument.
formal.en: Each participant should bring at least one copy of the document.
formal.zh: 每位参与者应至少携带一份该文件的副本。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fadal ħin għal kafè? Toni: Iva, għandna għall-anqas għaxar minuti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there time left for a coffee? Toni: Yes, we have at least ten minutes.
colloquial.zh: Sara：还有时间喝杯咖啡吗？Toni：有啊，我们至少还有十分钟。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 还有时间喝杯咖啡吗？
messages.en: Is there time left for a coffee?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 有啊，我们至少还有十分钟。
messages.en: Yes, we have at least ten minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在数字下方画一条最低线：至少十分钟，就是十分钟起步，也可能更多；整块记住这个短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to thank God or express relief that something has turned out well.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于感谢上帝，或在事情顺利、危险解除时表达庆幸，相当于“谢天谢地”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' ħajr lil Alla jew ta' serħan il-moħħ meta xi ħaġa tispiċċa tajjeb.

sense_translations.en_definition: thank God; praise be to God
sense_translations.zh_definition: 感谢上帝；赞美上帝；谢天谢地。

collocations.en: thank God, everything is all right

formal.mt: Għall-grazzja t'Alla, il-familja kollha reġgħet lura d-dar qawwija u sħiħa.
formal.en: Thank God, the whole family returned home safe and sound.
formal.zh: 谢天谢地，全家人都平安回到了家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sibt il-passaport? Mark: Iva, għall-grazzja t'Alla! Kien fil-but tal-ġakketta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you find the passport? Mark: Yes, thank God! It was in my jacket pocket.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你找到护照了吗？马克：找到了，谢天谢地！它在我的夹克口袋里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你找到护照了吗？
messages.en: Did you find the passport?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għall-grazzja t'Alla! Kien fil-but tal-ġakketta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għall-grazzja t'Alla! Kien fil-but tal-ġakketta.
messages.zh: 找到了，谢天谢地！它在我的夹克口袋里。
messages.en: Yes, thank God! It was in my jacket pocket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句和“终于平安、松一口气”的画面绑定，想到“谢天谢地”时整体提取这个表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To an extremely high degree; used to intensify a quality or state.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某种性质或状态达到很高程度，相当于“极其、非常”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sa grad għoli ħafna; jintuża biex isaħħaħ deskrizzjoni ta' kwalità jew stat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极其；非常；程度极高地。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol kien diffiċli għallaħħar u kien jeħtieġ attenzjoni kbira.
formal.en: The work was extremely difficult and required great attention.
formal.zh: 这项工作极其困难，需要高度专注。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadek għajjien? Mark: Iva, għajjien għallaħħar wara dik il-mixja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you still tired? Mark: Yes, extremely tired after that walk.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你还累吗？Mark：是啊，走了那一趟以后累极了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还累吗？
messages.en: Are you still tired?

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għajjien għallaħħar wara dik il-mixja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għajjien għallaħħar wara dik il-mixja.
messages.zh: 是啊，走了那一趟以后累极了。
messages.en: Yes, extremely tired after that walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把程度想象成音量旋钮，转到最高就是“极其”；用“累极了”的场景记住本条副词义。

gloss_zh: 使体重下降；使消瘦；帮助克服

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to lose weight or become skinny; also, to help someone overcome something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人体重下降或变得消瘦；也可表示帮助某人克服某事或困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlef il-piż jew isir irqiq; ukoll, jgħin lil xi ħadd jegħleb xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使体重下降；使人减轻体重。
使变得消瘦；使人瘦下来。
帮助某人克服某事或战胜某种困难。

collocations.en: the illness caused the patient to lose weight

collocations.zh: 贫困使那个男人变得消瘦

formal.mt: Il-mard twil għalleb lill-pazjent, li tilef ħafna piż.
formal.en: The prolonged illness caused the patient to become thin, and he lost a great deal of weight.
formal.zh: 长期患病使这位患者消瘦，体重下降了很多。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu sar irqaq ħafna dan l-aħħar. Toni: Iva, il-mard għalleb lil Pawlu, iżda issa qed jirkupra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu has become much thinner lately. Toni: Yes, the illness made Pawlu lose weight, but he is recovering now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu最近瘦了很多。Toni：是啊，疾病让Pawlu消瘦了，不过他现在正在康复。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu sar irqaq ħafna dan l-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu sar irqaq ħafna dan l-aħħar.
messages.zh: Pawlu最近瘦了很多。
messages.en: Pawlu has become much thinner lately.

messages.speaker: Toni (Pawlu的兄弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-mard għalleb lil Pawlu, iżda issa qed jirkupra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-mard għalleb lil Pawlu, iżda issa qed jirkupra.
messages.zh: 是啊，疾病让Pawlu消瘦了，不过他现在正在康复。
messages.en: Yes, the illness made Pawlu lose weight, but he is recovering now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡分开记：一张画体重下降的人，记“使消瘦”；另一张画有人扶同伴跨越障碍，记“帮助克服”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something sticky so that it clings to other surfaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变得黏黏的，容易黏附在其他物体或表面上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa twaħħal jew teħel ma' uċuħ oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物发黏；使某物变得有黏性。

collocations.en: the syrup made the table sticky
the honey made my hands sticky
collocations.zh: 蜂蜜使我的双手黏黏的

formal.mt: Ix-xiropp li nxtered għallek il-mejda, u għalhekk kien meħtieġ li titnaddaf.
formal.en: The spilled syrup made the table sticky, so it needed to be cleaned.
formal.zh: 洒出的糖浆使桌子发黏，因此需要清洁桌面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-mejda twaħħal? Mark: Ix-xiropp li waqa' għallek il-wiċċ tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the table sticky? Mark: The syrup that spilled made its surface sticky.
colloquial.zh: Lara：桌子怎么黏黏的？Mark：洒出来的糖浆把桌面弄黏了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 桌子怎么黏黏的？
messages.en: Why is the table sticky?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xiropp li waqa' għallek il-wiċċ tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xiropp li waqa' għallek il-wiċċ tagħha.
messages.zh: 洒出来的糖浆把桌面弄黏了。
messages.en: The syrup that spilled made its surface sticky.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蜂蜜滴到手上，原本干爽的手变得黏黏的；抓住“使某物变黏”这个动作来记忆。

gloss_zh: 产出收成；使不快乐；使虚弱

teaching_sense.en_definition: To yield a harvest; also, to make someone unhappy or weak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指作物产出收成；也可表示使某人不快乐，或使某人变得虚弱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti ħsad; ukoll, iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mdejjaq jew isir dgħajjef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产出收成；结出可供收获的作物。
使某人不快乐；使某人难过。
使某人虚弱；使某人衰弱。

collocations.en: the wheat yielded a good harvest
the loss made the man unhappy
collocations.zh: 这次失去使那个男人难过

collocations.en: the hard work made the worker weak
collocations.zh: 繁重的劳动使工人变得虚弱

formal.mt: Il-qamħ għallel sew din is-sena, u l-bdiewa ġabru ħsad abbundanti.
formal.en: The wheat yielded well this year, and the farmers gathered an abundant harvest.
formal.zh: 今年小麦收成很好，农民们获得了丰收。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-qamħ għallel sew din is-sena? Pawlu: Iva, kellna ħsad tajjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the wheat yield well this year? Pawlu: Yes, we had a very good harvest.
colloquial.zh: Rita：今年小麦收成好吗？Pawlu：好啊，我们今年的收成非常好。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 今年小麦收成好吗？
messages.en: Did the wheat yield well this year?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.zh: 好啊，我们今年的收成非常好。
messages.en: Yes, we had a very good harvest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项分成三幅图：麦田有收成、人物心情低落、工人身体虚弱；分别配例句记忆，不把三义强行混成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to ask what purpose something serves or what something is intended for.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问某物的用途或某事的目的，意思是“作什么用”或“为了什么”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tistaqsi għal liema skop tintuża xi ħaġa jew issir azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为了什么；作什么用途。

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu jispjega għalli tintuża kull għodda fil-lista.
formal.en: The student should explain what each tool on the list is used for.
formal.zh: 学生应说明清单中每件工具的用途。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għalli għandek bżonn din il-kaxxa? Mark: Biex inżomm ir-ritratti fiha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you need this box for? Mark: To keep the photos in it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要这个盒子做什么？马克：用来放照片。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你要这个盒子做什么？
messages.en: What do you need this box for?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 用来放照片。
messages.en: To keep the photos in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿起一个不认识的工具，先问“作什么用”，再用用途回答，把问答场景和 għalli 连起来。

gloss_zh: 生育者；使子女出生的父亲

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who begets children, especially a man who fathers a child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指生育后代的人，尤其指使子女出生的男性，即生父。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tnissel it-tfal, speċjalment raġel li jsir missier ta' wild.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生育者；使后代诞生的人。
繁衍后代的人；生育子女的男性。

formal.mt: F'din is-silta, il-kelma 'għalliel' tindika r-raġel li nissel il-wild.
formal.en: In this passage, the word 'għalliel' denotes the man who fathered the child.
formal.zh: 在这段文字中，għalliel 一词指生育了这个孩子的男性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'għalliel' hawn? Mark: Ifisser min inissel it-tfal; hawn qed jirreferi għall-missier.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'għalliel' mean here? Mark: It means someone who begets children; here it refers to the father.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 għalliel 是什么意思？马克：指生育子女的人；这里说的是父亲。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 għalliel 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'għalliel' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser min inissel it-tfal; hawn qed jirreferi għall-missier.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser min inissel it-tfal; hawn qed jirreferi għall-missier.
messages.zh: 指生育子女的人；这里说的是父亲。
messages.en: It means someone who begets children; here it refers to the father.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“谁使这个孩子出生”来抓住词义，重点记住生育关系，避免只联想到照顾孩子的角色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: From now on, or with regard to what is coming in the future.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示从现在起的今后，或着眼于接下来将发生的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Minn issa 'l quddiem, jew b'rabta ma' dak li se jiġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从今以后；今后。
为接下来将发生的事情；为将来。

collocations.en: from now on we will do it this way
prepare ourselves for what is coming
collocations.zh: 为接下来的事情做好准备

formal.mt: Għalliġej, kull talba għandha tintbagħat bil-miktub.
formal.en: Henceforth, every request must be submitted in writing.
formal.zh: 今后，所有申请都必须以书面形式提交。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għalliġej se nitilqu ftit qabel? Mark: Iva, hekk naslu fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we leave a little earlier from now on? Mark: Yes, that way we will arrive on time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们今后早点出发，好吗？马克：好，这样就能准时到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我们今后早点出发，好吗？
messages.en: Shall we leave a little earlier from now on?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 好，这样就能准时到了。
messages.en: Yes, that way we will arrive on time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条从今天伸向未来的箭头：箭头起点提醒“从今以后”，前方提醒“为将来作准备”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Execution, particularly the act of putting someone to death by hanging.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指处决，尤其指以吊死方式执行的绞刑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twettiq ta' sentenza tal-mewt, b'mod partikolari billi persuna tiġi mgħallqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绞刑；以吊死方式处死。
处决；执行死刑。

collocations.en: a sentence of death by hanging

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ħabsi ġie kkundannat għall-għallqa, iżda s-sentenza nbidlet aktar tard.
formal.en: In the novel, the prisoner was condemned to death by hanging, but the sentence was later changed.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，囚犯被判处绞刑，但后来获得了改判。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'għallqa' f'din is-silta? Mark: Tfisser eżekuzzjoni; hawn qed titkellem dwar il-mewt bit-tgħalliq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'għallqa' mean in this passage? Mark: It means execution; here it is talking about death by hanging.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这段文字里的 għallqa 是什么意思？马克：指处决；这里具体说的是绞刑。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这段文字里的 għallqa 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'għallqa' mean in this passage?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser eżekuzzjoni; hawn qed titkellem dwar il-mewt bit-tgħalliq.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser eżekuzzjoni; hawn qed titkellem dwar il-mewt bit-tgħalliq.
messages.zh: 指处决；这里具体说的是绞刑。
messages.en: It means execution; here it is talking about death by hanging.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词放进小说中的“宣读判决”场景，记成绞刑或处决这一事件，并结合上下文判断具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that is incorrect in an action, statement, calculation, or piece of work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为、陈述、计算或工作中不正确的地方，即错误或差错。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa mhux korretta f'azzjoni, stqarrija, kalkolu jew xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个错误；一次差错。
一处错误；不正确之处。

formal.mt: Instab għalt fil-kalkolu tat-total, u ċ-ċifra ġiet ikkoreġuta qabel il-pubblikazzjoni.
formal.en: An error was found in the calculation of the total, and the figure was corrected before publication.
formal.zh: 总数计算中发现了一处错误，该数字已在发布前更正。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm għalt f'dan it-total? Mark: Iva, żidt għaxra darbtejn. Se nikkoreġih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there an error in this total? Mark: Yes, I added ten twice. I will correct it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个总数有错误吗？马克：有，我把十加了两次。我来改正。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这个总数有错误吗？
messages.en: Is there an error in this total?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żidt għaxra darbtejn. Se nikkoreġih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żidt għaxra darbtejn. Se nikkoreġih.
messages.zh: 有，我把十加了两次。我来改正。
messages.en: Yes, I added ten twice. I will correct it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师用红笔圈出一道算错的题，把圈出的“这一处错误”和名词 għalt 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of briefly closing and opening one eye, often to give a signal or share a joke.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短暂闭合再睁开一只眼睛的动作，常用于示意、传递默契或表示玩笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għeluq u l-ftuħ ta' għajn waħda għal ftit ħin, spiss biex jingħata sinjal jew biex tintwera ċajta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眨一只眼睛的动作；使眼色。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, għamiż ta' għajn juri lill-qarrej li l-kliem tal-karattru kien ċajta.
formal.en: In the story, a wink shows the reader that the character's words were a joke.
formal.zh: 在故事中，一个眨眼动作向读者表明，这个人物说的是玩笑话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt dak l-għamiż? Mark: Iva, kien qed jurina li kienet ċajta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see that wink? Mark: Yes, he was showing us that it was a joke.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到刚才那个眨眼动作了吗？马克：看到了，他是在示意我们那是个玩笑。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到刚才那个眨眼动作了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that wink?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien qed jurina li kienet ċajta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien qed jurina li kienet ċajta.
messages.zh: 看到了，他是在示意我们那是个玩笑。
messages.en: Yes, he was showing us that it was a joke.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友说完玩笑后只眨一只眼睛，把这个具体动作当作名词画面，记住 għamiż 指眨眼这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to lose the ability to see, temporarily or permanently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人失去视觉，既可指暂时看不见，也可指永久失明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlef il-ħila li jara, għal ftit ħin jew għal dejjem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人失明；使某人暂时看不见。

collocations.en: blinded the driver for a moment

formal.mt: Id-dawl qawwi għamma lis-sewwieq għal ftit sekondi, u għalhekk waqqaf il-karozza.
formal.en: The bright light blinded the driver for a few seconds, so he stopped the car.
formal.zh: 强光使司机有几秒钟看不见，因此他停下了车。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex għalaqt għajnejk? Pawlu: Il-flaxx għamma lili wkoll għal mument!
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you close your eyes? Pawlu: The flash blinded me for a moment too!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么闭上眼睛？保罗：闪光也让我一时什么都看不见！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么闭上眼睛？
messages.en: Why did you close your eyes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-flaxx għamma lili wkoll għal mument!
messages.mt_standard: Il-flaxx għamma lili wkoll għal mument!
messages.zh: 闪光也让我一时什么都看不见！
messages.en: The flash blinded me for a moment too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象闪光突然照来，眼前一片白：把 għamma 与“使人看不见”这个动作一起记。

gloss_zh: 使变暗；使模糊；使不透明

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something darker, less clear, or opaque, or to make information harder to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变暗、模糊或不透明，也可指使信息或问题变得难以理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel xi ħaġa aktar mudlama, imċajpra jew mhux trasparenti, jew għamel informazzjoni aktar diffiċli biex tinftiehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变暗；使光线或颜色变得更暗。
使含混难懂；使信息或解释变得不清楚。
遮蔽；使某物难以看清或辨明。
使变得混浊或不透明。

formal.mt: L-użu ta' kliem tekniku bla spjegazzjoni għammem il-kwistjoni għall-qarrejja.
formal.en: The use of technical terms without explanation obscured the issue for readers.
formal.zh: 使用未经解释的技术术语，使读者更难理解这个问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma nistax nara sew mill-ħġieġ? Mark: Il-fwar għammem il-ħġieġ; imsaħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't I see clearly through the glass? Mark: The steam made the glass cloudy; give it a wipe.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么隔着玻璃看不清？马克：水汽把玻璃弄模糊了，擦一下吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax nara sew mill-ħġieġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax nara sew mill-ħġieġ?
messages.zh: 为什么隔着玻璃看不清？
messages.en: Why can't I see clearly through the glass?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 水汽把玻璃弄模糊了，擦一下吧。
messages.en: The steam made the glass cloudy; give it a wipe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把起雾的玻璃和含混的解释放在同一幅画里：għammem 都让原本清楚的东西变得不清楚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something deeper, either physically or in understanding or feeling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物在实际深度上变得更深，也可指加深理解或感情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel xi ħaġa aktar fonda, jew żied il-fehim jew is-saħħa ta' sentiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使加深；增加实际深度，或加深理解、感情等。

formal.mt: L-istudju għammeq il-fehim tagħna tar-relazzjoni bejn il-lingwa u l-kultura.
formal.en: The study deepened our understanding of the relationship between language and culture.
formal.zh: 这项研究加深了我们对语言与文化之间关系的理解。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din il-ħofra kienet daqshekk fonda lbieraħ? Ġanni: Le, il-ġardinar għammeq il-ħofra dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Was this hole this deep yesterday? Ġanni: No, the gardener deepened the hole this morning.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个坑昨天就这么深吗？詹尼：不是，园丁今天早上把坑挖深了。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-ħofra kienet daqshekk fonda lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-ħofra kienet daqshekk fonda lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 这个坑昨天就这么深吗？
messages.en: Was this hole this deep yesterday?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (邻居)
messages.zh: 不是，园丁今天早上把坑挖深了。
messages.en: No, the gardener deepened the hole this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想坑被挖得更深，再想理解更深入：用同一个“深度增加”的画面记住 għammeq。

gloss_zh: 反复眨眼示意；不停闪烁

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wink repeatedly, or to twinkle continuously, as a light does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复眨眼示意；也指灯光等持续闪烁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għalaq u fetaħ għajn waħda ripetutament bħala sinjal, jew teptip kontinwament bħal dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复眨眼示意；接连使眼色。
不停地闪烁；持续闪闪发光。

formal.mt: Matul ix-xena, l-attur għammeż b'għajnu diversi drabi biex jagħti sinjal lill-pubbliku.
formal.en: During the scene, the actor winked several times to signal to the audience.
formal.zh: 在这场戏中，演员接连眨眼，向观众示意。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu għammeż b'għajnu daqshekk? Rita: Ried jurina li kien qed jiċċajta!
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Pawlu wink so much? Rita: He wanted to show us that he was joking!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：保罗为什么一个劲儿地眨眼示意？丽塔：他想让我们知道他在开玩笑！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么一个劲儿地眨眼示意？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu wink so much?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jurina li kien qed jiċċajta!
messages.mt_standard: Ried jurina li kien qed jiċċajta!
messages.zh: 他想让我们知道他在开玩笑！
messages.en: He wanted to show us that he was joking!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把反复眨动的眼睛想成一盏闪烁的小灯：għammeż 的两个义项都有接连闪动的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who administers baptism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为他人施行洗礼的人；施洗者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tamministra l-magħmudija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 施洗者；为他人施行洗礼的人。

collocations.en: the role of the person administering baptism

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi r-rwol tal-għammied waqt iċ-ċerimonja tal-magħmudija.
formal.en: The text describes the role of the person administering baptism during the baptismal ceremony.
formal.zh: 这篇文字描述了施洗者在洗礼仪式中的角色。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu r-raġel f'din l-istampa? David: Hu Ġwanni l-Għammied; hawn qed jgħammed lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is the man in this picture? David: He is John the Baptist; here he is baptizing people.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张图里的男子是谁？戴维：他是施洗者约翰，图中他正在为人们施洗。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这张图里的男子是谁？
messages.en: Who is the man in this picture?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu Ġwanni l-Għammied; hawn qed jgħammed lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Hu Ġwanni l-Għammied; hawn qed jgħammed lin-nies.
messages.zh: 他是施洗者约翰，图中他正在为人们施洗。
messages.en: He is John the Baptist; here he is baptizing people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象洗礼场景中负责施洗的那个人，把 għammied 记成“施洗者”，抓住它指人的名词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The dazzling effect of strong light that makes it difficult to see clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强光造成的刺眼、难以看清的视觉效果；眩光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-effett ta' dawl qawwi li jgħammex l-għajnejn u jagħmilha diffiċli biex wieħed jara ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强光造成的炫目或刺眼效果；眩光。

formal.mt: Il-purtieri jnaqqsu l-għammix tax-xemx u jagħmlu l-iskrin aktar faċli biex jinqara.
formal.en: The curtains reduce the sun's glare and make the screen easier to read.
formal.zh: 窗帘可以减弱太阳的眩光，使屏幕上的内容更容易阅读。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ma nistax naqra l-iskrin bl-għammix tax-xemx. Karl: Ejja noqogħdu fid-dell.
colloquial.en: Nina: I can't read the screen because of the sun's glare. Karl: Let's sit in the shade.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：阳光太刺眼，我看不清屏幕。卡尔：我们坐到阴凉处吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax naqra l-iskrin bl-għammix tax-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax naqra l-iskrin bl-għammix tax-xemx.
messages.zh: 阳光太刺眼，我看不清屏幕。
messages.en: I can't read the screen because of the sun's glare.

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐到阴凉处吧。
messages.en: Let's sit in the shade.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象阳光反射到屏幕上，亮得看不清字：għammix 是这种“眩光”的名称，按名词来记。

gloss_zh: 房屋的家具配置；布置房屋

teaching_sense.en_definition: The furnishing of a house with the furniture and other items needed for living.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为房屋配置家具及生活所需物品的布置工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tqegħid ta' għamara u oġġetti meħtieġa f'dar biex tkun lesta għall-ħajja ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为房屋配置家具及所需物品；房屋的家具布置。

formal.mt: Il-baġit għall-għamra tad-dar jinkludi sodod, imwejjed, siġġijiet u armarji.
formal.en: The budget for furnishing the house includes beds, tables, chairs, and wardrobes.
formal.zh: 房屋的家具配置预算包括床、桌子、椅子和衣柜。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Lestejtu l-għamra tad-dar? Toni: Kważi; għad jonqosna mejda għall-kċina.
colloquial.en: Elena: Have you finished furnishing the house? Toni: Almost; we still need a table for the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你们家里的家具都配齐了吗？托尼：差不多了，厨房还缺一张桌子。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们家里的家具都配齐了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished furnishing the house?

messages.speaker: Toni (新住户)
messages.zh: 差不多了，厨房还缺一张桌子。
messages.en: Almost; we still need a table for the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把床、桌椅和衣柜一件件搬进空房子：用“把家布置齐全”的过程记住 għamra。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An upright column that supports part of a building or serves as an architectural feature.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 竖立的柱状建筑构件，用来支撑建筑的一部分或作为建筑装饰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura wieqfa li ssostni parti minn bini jew tintuża bħala element arkitettoniku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柱；建筑中用于支撑或装饰的柱子。

formal.mt: L-għamud tal-ġebel ħdejn id-daħla jsostni parti mis-saqaf tal-bini.
formal.en: The stone column beside the entrance supports part of the building's roof.
formal.zh: 入口旁的石柱支撑着建筑屋顶的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Luqa: Ħdejn l-għamud tal-irħam, fuq ix-xellug tad-daħla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet? Luqa: Beside the marble column, to the left of the entrance.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里碰面？卢卡：在入口左边的大理石柱旁。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn l-għamud tal-irħam, fuq ix-xellug tad-daħla.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn l-għamud tal-irħam, fuq ix-xellug tad-daħla.
messages.zh: 在入口左边的大理石柱旁。
messages.en: Beside the marble column, to the left of the entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象入口旁一根笔直的大理石柱，再把 għamud 贴在柱身上，用具体建筑画面记住“柱子”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Amber: fossilised resin, often yellow or orange, used in jewellery and decorative objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 琥珀：由树脂形成的化石材料，常呈黄色或橙色，可用于首饰和装饰品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raża fossili, spiss safra jew oranġjo, li tintuża fil-ġojjellerija u f'oġġetti dekorattivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 琥珀。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesebixxi ġiżirana tal-għanbar ħdejn oġġetti dekorattivi oħra.
formal.en: The museum displays an amber necklace beside other decorative objects.
formal.zh: 博物馆在其他装饰品旁展出一条琥珀项链。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-ġiżirana tal-għanbar? Lara: Iva, ara kemm hu sabiħ il-kulur tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this necklace made of amber? Lara: Yes, look how beautiful its colour is.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条项链是琥珀做的吗？拉拉：是呀，你看它的颜色多漂亮。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这条项链是琥珀做的吗？
messages.en: Is this necklace made of amber?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara kemm hu sabiħ il-kulur tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara kemm hu sabiħ il-kulur tagħha.
messages.zh: 是呀，你看它的颜色多漂亮。
messages.en: Yes, look how beautiful its colour is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għanbar 配上一条金黄色琥珀项链的画面，再连读 ġiżirana tal-għanbar，用实物和搭配一起记住“琥珀”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To need something or need to do something; the form of għand changes according to who has the need.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人需要某物或需要做某事；għand 的具体形式随需要者的人称和数变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li turi li xi ħadd jeħtieġ xi ħaġa jew li jagħmel xi ħaġa; il-forma ta' għand tinbidel skont il-persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需要；有某种需求。

formal.mt: Kull student għandu bżonn dokument ta' identifikazzjoni biex jirreġistra għall-kors.
formal.en: Every student needs an identification document to register for the course.
formal.zh: 每位学生报名该课程都需要身份证明文件。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għandi bżonn ftit ilma. Maja: Hawn flixkun. Għandek bżonn tistrieħ ukoll?
colloquial.en: Toni: I need some water. Maja: Here's a bottle. Do you need to rest as well?
colloquial.zh: 托尼：我需要喝点水。玛雅：这里有一瓶。你也需要休息一下吗？

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我需要喝点水。
messages.en: I need some water.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn flixkun. Għandek bżonn tistrieħ ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn flixkun. Għandek bżonn tistrieħ ukoll?
messages.zh: 这里有一瓶。你也需要休息一下吗？
messages.en: Here's a bottle. Do you need to rest as well?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bżonn 当作“需求”提示牌，再换前面的形式：għandi 对应我，għandek 对应你；整组记成“某人需要”，不要把词条原形机械套进每个句子。

gloss_zh: 在你那里；到你那里；你有

teaching_sense.en_definition: The form of għand referring to one person being addressed, used for 'at your place', 'to your place', or 'you have'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: għand 指向第二人称单数“你”的形式，可表示在你那里、到你那里，或你拥有某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma ta' għand li tirreferi għall-persuna waħda li qed tkellimha, biex turi post marbut magħha, direzzjoni lejha jew xi ħaġa li għandha.

sense_translations.en_definition: second-person singular pronominal form of għand:
sense_translations.zh_definition: għand 的第二人称单数代词结合形式，指“你”。
在你那里；到你那里。
你有；你拥有。

formal.mt: Jekk għandek mistoqsija dwar il-kors, ikkuntattja lill-uffiċċju tal-amministrazzjoni.
formal.en: If you have a question about the course, contact the administration office.
formal.zh: 如果你对课程有疑问，请联系行政办公室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' niġi għandek wara x-xogħol? Toni: Iva, ejja fis-sitta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I come to your place after work? Toni: Yes, come at six.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：下班后我可以去你那里吗？托尼：可以，六点来吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 下班后我可以去你那里吗？
messages.en: Can I come to your place after work?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，六点来吧。
messages.en: Yes, come at six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“你那里”和“你有”共用 għandek：想象指着朋友问 Għandek ħin?，再说 Niġi għandek，把拥有与地点两个用法连成一幕。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A question addressed to one person to ask whether they need help.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向一个人询问是否需要帮助的问句，常用于主动提供协助。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mistoqsija lil persuna waħda biex tistaqsi jekk teħtieġx għajnuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你需要帮助吗？

collocations.en: Do you need help with the luggage?

collocations.mt: Għandek bżonn għajnuna biex timla l-formola?
collocations.en: Do you need help filling in the form?
collocations.zh: 你需要有人帮你填写表格吗？

formal.mt: Fil-gwida għas-servizz tal-klijenti, il-mistoqsija 'Għandek bżonn għajnuna?' tintuża biex tiġi offruta assistenza.
formal.en: In the customer service guide, the question 'Do you need help?' is used to offer assistance.
formal.zh: 客户服务指南使用“你需要帮助吗？”这一问句来提供协助。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek bżonn għajnuna bil-bagalji? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Din il-bagalja tqila ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you need help with the luggage? Mark: Yes, please. This suitcase is very heavy.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你需要帮忙拿行李吗？马克：需要，麻烦你了。这个箱子很重。

messages.speaker: Lara (酒店职员)
messages.zh: 你需要帮忙拿行李吗？
messages.en: Do you need help with the luggage?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Din il-bagalja tqila ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Din il-bagalja tqila ħafna.
messages.zh: 需要，麻烦你了。这个箱子很重。
messages.en: Yes, please. This suitcase is very heavy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三个意义块记忆：għandek“你有”、bżonn“需要”、għajnuna“帮助”；想象伸手帮别人提箱子，用上扬语调说完整问句。

gloss_zh: 在她／它那里；到她／它那里；她／它有

teaching_sense.en_definition: The form of għand referring to a female person or a grammatically feminine thing, used for location, direction, or possession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: għand 指向第三人称阴性单数的形式，可表示在她／它那里、到她／它那里，或她／它拥有某物；“它”所指名词须为语法阴性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma ta' għand li tirreferi għal persuna femminili jew għal ħaġa b'nom femminili fis-singular, u turi post, direzzjoni jew pussess.

sense_translations.en_definition: third-person feminine singular pronominal form of għand:
sense_translations.zh_definition: għand 的第三人称阴性单数代词结合形式，指“她”或语法阴性的“它”。
在她／它那里；到她／它那里。
她／它有；她／它拥有。

formal.mt: Il-librerija għandha ġabra kbira ta' kotba bil-Malti.
formal.en: The library has a large collection of books in Maltese.
formal.zh: 图书馆收藏了大量马耳他语书籍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sara qiegħda d-dar? Irrid immur għandha. Toni: Iva, u għandha l-ktieb li qed tfittex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Sara at home? I want to go to her place. Toni: Yes, and she has the book you are looking for.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：萨拉在家吗？我想去她那里。托尼：在，而且你找的那本书就在她手里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sara qiegħda d-dar? Irrid immur għandha.
messages.mt_standard: Sara qiegħda d-dar? Irrid immur għandha.
messages.zh: 萨拉在家吗？我想去她那里。
messages.en: Is Sara at home? I want to go to her place.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għandha l-ktieb li qed tfittex.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għandha l-ktieb li qed tfittex.
messages.zh: 在，而且你找的那本书就在她手里。
messages.en: Yes, and she has the book you are looking for.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一位拿着书的萨拉：għandha ktieb 是“她有书”，immur għandha 是“我去她那里”；同一人物画面帮助记住两个常见用法。

gloss_zh: 在他们那里；到他们那里；他们有

teaching_sense.en_definition: The form of għand referring to more than one person or thing, used for 'at their place', 'to their place', or 'they have'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: għand 指向第三人称复数的形式，可表示在他们那里、到他们那里，或他们拥有某物，也可指多件事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma ta' għand li tirreferi għal aktar minn persuna jew ħaġa waħda, u turi post marbut magħhom, direzzjoni lejhom jew xi ħaġa li għandhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: third-person plural pronominal form of għand:
sense_translations.zh_definition: għand 的第三人称复数代词结合形式，指“他们／她们／它们”。
在他们／她们／它们那里；到他们／她们／它们那里。
他们／她们／它们有；他们／她们／它们拥有。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom aċċess għall-materjal tal-kors permezz tal-pjattaforma diġitali.
formal.en: The students have access to the course material through the digital platform.
formal.zh: 学生可以通过数字平台获取课程材料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se tmur għand il-ġirien illejla? Mark: Iva, se niekol għandhom. Għandhom ukoll kelb ġdid li nixtieq nara.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you going to the neighbours' place tonight? Mark: Yes, I'm eating at their place. They also have a new dog I'd like to see.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今晚要去邻居家吗？马克：是的，我要在他们家吃饭。他们还养了一只新狗，我想去看看。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今晚要去邻居家吗？
messages.en: Are you going to the neighbours' place tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se niekol għandhom. Għandhom ukoll kelb ġdid li nixtieq nara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se niekol għandhom. Għandhom ukoll kelb ġdid li nixtieq nara.
messages.zh: 是的，我要在他们家吃饭。他们还养了一只新狗，我想去看看。
messages.en: Yes, I'm eating at their place. They also have a new dog I'd like to see.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għandhom 放进“一家邻居”的画面：他们有狗是 għandhom kelb，在他们家吃饭是 niekol għandhom；始终联想到复数的“他们”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to say that you feel thirsty and want something to drink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示自己感到口渴、想喝东西，相当于“我渴了”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tuża biex tgħid li tħoss l-għatx u tixtieq tixrob xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我渴了；我感到口渴。

collocations.en: I'm thirsty and I want to drink.

formal.mt: Wara l-eżerċizzju, għandi l-għatx u nixtieq tazza ilma.
formal.en: After exercising, I'm thirsty and would like a glass of water.
formal.zh: 运动之后，我渴了，想喝一杯水。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi l-għatx. Nista' nieħu ftit ilma? Anna: Dażgur, hemm flixkun fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm thirsty. Can I have some water? Anna: Of course, there's a bottle on the table.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我渴了。可以喝点水吗？安娜：当然，桌上有一瓶水。

messages.speaker: Mark (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi l-għatx. Nista' nieħu ftit ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi l-għatx. Nista' nieħu ftit ilma?
messages.zh: 我渴了。可以喝点水吗？
messages.en: I'm thirsty. Can I have some water?

messages.speaker: Anna (主人)
messages.zh: 当然，桌上有一瓶水。
messages.en: Of course, there's a bottle on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象运动后伸手拿水杯的画面，把 għandi l-għatx 和“我渴了”一起说；用水杯画面区别表示饥饿的句子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to say that you feel hungry and want something to eat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示自己感到饥饿、想吃东西，相当于“我饿了”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tuża biex tgħid li tħoss il-ġuħ u tixtieq tiekol xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我饿了；我感到饥饿。

collocations.en: I'm hungry and I want to eat.

formal.mt: Wara mixja twila, għandi l-ġuħ u nixtieq niekol ikla sħuna.
formal.en: After a long walk, I'm hungry and would like to eat a hot meal.
formal.zh: 长途步行之后，我饿了，想吃一顿热饭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi l-ġuħ. Għandek xi ħaġa x'niekol? Lara: Iva, hemm ftit ħobż u ġobon fil-kċina.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm hungry. Do you have anything I can eat? Lara: Yes, there's some bread and cheese in the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我饿了。你有什么可以让我吃的吗？拉拉：有，厨房里有一些面包和奶酪。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi l-ġuħ. Għandek xi ħaġa x'niekol?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi l-ġuħ. Għandek xi ħaġa x'niekol?
messages.zh: 我饿了。你有什么可以让我吃的吗？
messages.en: I'm hungry. Do you have anything I can eat?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ftit ħobż u ġobon fil-kċina.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ftit ħobż u ġobon fil-kċina.
messages.zh: 有，厨房里有一些面包和奶酪。
messages.en: Yes, there's some bread and cheese in the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己摸着肚子找面包，把 għandi l-ġuħ 整句和“我饿了”绑定；再与表示口渴的 għandi l-għatx 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to introduce a question that you want to ask.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于表示自己有一个问题要问，常用来引出提问。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tuża biex tgħid li hemm xi ħaġa li tixtieq tistaqsi dwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我有一个问题；我有事想问。

collocations.en: I have a question about the lesson
collocations.zh: 我有一个关于这节课的问题

formal.mt: Għandi mistoqsija dwar il-proċedura ta' reġistrazzjoni: liema dokumenti għandi nibgħat?
formal.en: I have a question about the registration procedure: which documents should I send?
formal.zh: 我有一个关于注册流程的问题：我应该提交哪些文件？

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi mistoqsija. Meta jibda l-kors? Pawlu: It-Tnejn, fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: I have a question. When does the course start? Pawlu: On Monday, at nine in the morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我有一个问题。课程什么时候开始？保罗：星期一上午九点。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 我有一个问题。课程什么时候开始？
messages.en: I have a question. When does the course start?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 星期一上午九点。
messages.en: On Monday, at nine in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把举手提问的动作与整句绑定：先说 għandi mistoqsija，再说具体问题；记住这里是想提问，不是报告遇到了麻烦。

gloss_zh: 你们有；在你们那里；到你们那里

teaching_sense.en_definition: The form of għand referring to more than one person addressed, used for being at or going to their place and for saying that they have something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: għand 对应第二人称复数“你们”的形式，可表示“在你们那里”“到你们那里”，也可表示“你们有”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma ta' għand li tirreferi għal aktar minn persuna waħda li qed tkellem, biex tindika l-post tagħhom jew xi ħaġa li għandhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: second-person plural pronominal form of għand:
sense_translations.zh_definition: għand 的第二人称复数代词形式，指向说话人所称呼的“你们”。
在你们那里；到你们那里。
你们有；你们拥有。

collocations.en: I leave the books at your place

formal.mt: Jekk għandkom mistoqsijiet dwar il-proġett, nista' niġi għandkom biex niddiskutuhom.
formal.en: If you have questions about the project, I can come to your place to discuss them.
formal.zh: 如果你们对这个项目有疑问，我可以到你们那里讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandkom ħin illejla? Nista' niġi għandkom? Lara: Iva, jien u Mark se nkunu d-dar wara s-sebgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have time tonight? Can I come over to your place? Lara: Yes, Mark and I will be home after seven.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们今晚有空吗？我可以去你们那里吗？拉拉：可以，马克和我七点以后会在家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom ħin illejla? Nista' niġi għandkom?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom ħin illejla? Nista' niġi għandkom?
messages.zh: 你们今晚有空吗？我可以去你们那里吗？
messages.en: Do you have time tonight? Can I come over to your place?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien u Mark se nkunu d-dar wara s-sebgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien u Mark se nkunu d-dar wara s-sebgħa.
messages.zh: 可以，马克和我七点以后会在家。
messages.en: Yes, Mark and I will be home after seven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面前站着两位朋友：问他们有没有时间，用 għandkom；说要去他们家，也用 għandkom。用“你们这边”串起两种用法。

gloss_zh: 我们有；在我们这里；到我们这里

teaching_sense.en_definition: The form of għand referring to the speaker together with others, used for being at or coming to their place and for saying that they have something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: għand 对应第一人称复数“我们”的形式，可表示“在我们这里”“到我们这里”，也可表示“我们有”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma ta' għand li tirreferi għal min qed jitkellem flimkien ma' oħrajn, biex tindika l-post tagħhom jew xi ħaġa li għandhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: first-person plural pronominal form of għand:
sense_translations.zh_definition: għand 的第一人称复数代词形式，指说话人及其他人组成的“我们”。
在我们这里；到我们这里。
我们有；我们拥有。

formal.mt: Għandna kamra disponibbli għall-laqgħa, u t-tim jista' jiġi għandna nhar il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: We have a room available for the meeting, and the team can come to our premises on Friday.
formal.zh: 我们有一间可供开会使用的房间，团队可以在星期五到我们这里来。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandna biżżejjed ikel għal kulħadd. Ejja għandna llejla! Sara: Grazzi! Niġi fis-sebgħa.
colloquial.en: Anna: We have enough food for everyone. Come over to our place tonight! Sara: Thanks! I'll come at seven.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们的食物够大家吃。今晚来我们家吧！萨拉：谢谢！我七点来。

messages.speaker: Anna (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna biżżejjed ikel għal kulħadd. Ejja għandna llejla!
messages.mt_standard: Għandna biżżejjed ikel għal kulħadd. Ejja għandna llejla!
messages.zh: 我们的食物够大家吃。今晚来我们家吧！
messages.en: We have enough food for everyone. Come over to our place tonight!

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢！我七点来。
messages.en: Thanks! I'll come at seven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己和家人一起招待客人：介绍“我们有食物”用 għandna，邀请“来我们这里”也用 għandna，把两句连成同一幅画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Livestock considered collectively, especially sheep; the word has a broader meaning than cattle understood only as cows and bulls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对牲畜的集合称呼，尤其指绵羊；其范围比仅指牛的说法更广。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimali tar-razzett meqjusa flimkien, speċjalment in-nagħaġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: livestock, cattle (in the broader sense), especially sheep
sense_translations.zh_definition: 牲畜；广义的家畜，尤其指绵羊，并非仅指牛。

collocations.zh: 牲畜饲养，尤指绵羊养殖
牲畜饲料，尤指绵羊饲料

formal.mt: Ir-raħħal ħejja biżżejjed ilma u għalf għall-għanem qabel il-wasla tas-sħana.
formal.en: The farmer prepared enough water and feed for the livestock before the hot weather arrived.
formal.zh: 农场主在炎热天气到来之前，为牲畜准备了充足的水和饲料。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Diġà tajt l-ilma lill-għanem? Pawlu: Iva, u issa se nġib l-għalf.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you already given the livestock water? Pawlu: Yes, and now I'm going to get the feed.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你已经给牲畜喂水了吗？保罗：是的，现在我要去拿饲料。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场主)
messages.zh: 你已经给牲畜喂水了吗？
messages.en: Have you already given the livestock water?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u issa se nġib l-għalf.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u issa se nġib l-għalf.
messages.zh: 是的，现在我要去拿饲料。
messages.en: Yes, and now I'm going to get the feed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għanem 配上一幅以绵羊为主的牧场图，记作集合性的“牲畜”；遇到英语 cattle 的释义时，别把画面缩成只有牛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work quickly and efficiently, making good progress with a task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 迅速而高效地做事，使手头的工作顺利推进。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħdem malajr u b'effiċjenza, b'tali mod li x-xogħol jimxi 'l quddiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 快速而高效地工作；做事又快又有效率。

collocations.en: she worked quickly and efficiently in the kitchen
collocations.zh: 她在厨房里快速而高效地干活

collocations.en: she worked quickly and efficiently to finish on time
collocations.zh: 她高效赶工，以便按时完成

formal.mt: Marija għanet u lestiet ix-xogħol kollu qabel nofsinhar.
formal.en: Marija worked quickly and efficiently and completed all the work before noon.
formal.zh: 玛丽亚工作迅速而高效，在中午之前完成了全部工作。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif lestiet kollox Rita daqshekk malajr? Lara: Għanet dalgħodu, u sal-għaxra kollox kien lest.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did Rita finish everything so quickly? Lara: She worked quickly and efficiently this morning, and by ten everything was ready.
colloquial.zh: 马克：丽塔怎么这么快就把所有事情做完了？拉拉：她今天上午干活又快又有效率，到十点一切就准备好了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif lestiet kollox Rita daqshekk malajr?
messages.mt_standard: Kif lestiet kollox Rita daqshekk malajr?
messages.zh: 丽塔怎么这么快就把所有事情做完了？
messages.en: How did Rita finish everything so quickly?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għanet dalgħodu, u sal-għaxra kollox kien lest.
messages.mt_standard: Għanet dalgħodu, u sal-għaxra kollox kien lest.
messages.zh: 她今天上午干活又快又有效率，到十点一切就准备好了。
messages.en: She worked quickly and efficiently this morning, and by ten everything was ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象丽塔在十点前把任务逐项打勾：用 għanet 记住“动作快、效率高”两个要点，不能只记成单纯忙碌。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young goat at approximately one year of age.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指年龄大约一岁的小山羊，学习时应同时记住动物种类和年龄范围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mogħża żgħira li għandha madwar sena.

sense_translations.en_definition: a young goat (at roughly one year of age)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 大约一岁的小山羊。

collocations.en: a young goat about one year old
to look after the young goat

formal.mt: Fir-razzett hemm għaniqa ta' madwar sena, u r-raħħal jieħu ħsiebha kuljum.
formal.en: There is a young goat about one year old on the farm, and the farmer looks after it every day.
formal.zh: 农场里有一只约一岁的小山羊，农场主每天照料它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandha żmien din l-għaniqa? Pawlu: Madwar sena. Trid tgħinni nitmagħha?
colloquial.en: Maja: How old is this young goat? Pawlu: About a year. Do you want to help me feed it?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这只小山羊多大了？保罗：大约一岁。你想帮我喂它吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 这只小山羊多大了？
messages.en: How old is this young goat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (饲养员)
messages.zh: 大约一岁。你想帮我喂它吗？
messages.en: About a year. Do you want to help me feed it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给脑海中的小山羊挂上一张“一岁左右”的生日牌，把 għaniqa 与这个画面绑定；同时记住“山羊”和“约一岁”两个信息。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The biblical book known as the Song of Songs, the Song of Solomon, or Canticles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 《圣经》中的《雅歌》，英语也称 Song of Solomon 或 Canticles。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ktieb tal-Bibbja magħruf bħala l-Għanja tal-Għanjiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: Canticles, Song of Songs, Song of Solomon
sense_translations.zh_definition: 《雅歌》，亦称《所罗门之歌》；英语名称包括 Canticles、Song of Songs 和 Song of Solomon。

collocations.en: to read the Song of Songs
a passage from the Song of Songs

formal.mt: Fl-istudju tiegħu, l-awtur janalizza x-xbihat poetiċi fl-Għanja tal-Għanjiet.
formal.en: In his study, the author analyses the poetic imagery in the Song of Songs.
formal.zh: 作者在研究中分析了《雅歌》中的诗歌意象。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'qed taqra? Pawlu: Silta mill-Għanja tal-Għanjiet. Marija: Taqrahieli wkoll?
colloquial.en: Marija: What are you reading? Pawlu: A passage from the Song of Songs. Marija: Will you read it to me too?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你在读什么？保罗：《雅歌》中的一段。玛丽娅：也读给我听听好吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 《雅歌》中的一段。
messages.en: A passage from the Song of Songs.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 也读给我听听好吗？
messages.en: Will you read it to me too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个书名连同一本诗歌集的画面一起记住，并将“歌中之歌”的标题意象对应到中文书名《雅歌》。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce a substantial quantity of grapes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 结出数量可观的葡萄，强调葡萄产量较多。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti l-għeneb fi kwantità kbira.

sense_translations.en_definition: to produce grapes in significant quantities
