sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量结葡萄；产出数量可观的葡萄。

collocations.en: a garden that produced plenty of grapes
produced plenty of grapes this year

formal.mt: Il-ġnien għanneb din is-sena, u parti mill-ħsad tqassmet fost il-familji tar-raħal.
formal.en: The garden produced plenty of grapes this year, and part of the harvest was distributed among the village families.
formal.zh: 今年园子里葡萄丰收，部分收成分给了村里的各户人家。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kemm għandkom għeneb! Ġużeppi: Il-ġnien għanneb din is-sena. Lina: Mela nista' nieħu ftit?
colloquial.en: Lina: You have so many grapes! Ġużeppi: The garden produced plenty this year. Lina: Can I take some, then?
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你们的葡萄真多！朱塞佩：今年园子结了大量葡萄。莉娜：那我可以拿一点吗？

messages.speaker: Lina (邻居)
messages.zh: 你们的葡萄真多！
messages.en: You have so many grapes!

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园主)
messages.zh: 今年园子结了大量葡萄。
messages.en: The garden produced plenty of grapes this year.

messages.speaker: Lina (邻居)
messages.zh: 那我可以拿一点吗？
messages.en: Can I take some, then?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象葡萄多到装满好几筐，把 għanneb 和“大量结葡萄”的整幅画面绑定；记住它强调产量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of holding someone in your arms, often to show affection or give comfort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用双臂抱住某人的动作，常用于表达亲爱、欢迎或安慰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att li fih iddawwar dirgħajk ma' xi ħadd biex turi mħabba jew tagħti faraġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拥抱；搂抱。

formal.mt: Meta waslet id-dar, bintha laqgħetha b'għanqa kbira.
formal.en: When she arrived home, her daughter welcomed her with a big hug.
formal.zh: 她到家时，女儿给了她一个大大的拥抱，欢迎她回来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Illum kelli ġurnata diffiċli. Marija: Trid għanqa? Sara: Iva, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Sara: I've had a difficult day. Marija: Would you like a hug? Sara: Yes, thank you.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我今天过得很不顺。玛丽娅：想要一个拥抱吗？萨拉：想，谢谢你。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天过得很不顺。
messages.en: I've had a difficult day.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 想要一个拥抱吗？
messages.en: Would you like a hug?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，谢谢你。
messages.en: Yes, thank you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 għanqa 就想象朋友张开双臂迎接你；搭配 tagħti għanqa，整句记成“给一个拥抱”。

gloss_zh: 成串结果；结出成簇的果实

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bear fruit that grows together in bunches or clusters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 结出聚集成串或成簇的果实，强调果实的聚集形态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti frott li jikber flimkien f'għenieqed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成串结果；结出成簇的果实。

collocations.en: a shrub that bore fruit in bunches
bore fruit in bunches for the first time
collocations.zh: 第一次结出成串的果实

formal.mt: L-arbuxxell għanqad għall-ewwel darba, u l-frott deher fi gruppi fuq il-friegħi.
formal.en: The shrub bore fruit in bunches for the first time, with the fruit appearing in groups on the branches.
formal.zh: 这株灌木第一次结出成串的果实，枝条上的果实聚集成簇。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ara kif il-frott kollu flimkien! Rita: Iva, dan l-arbuxxell għanqad din is-sena. Mark: Ħa nieħu ritratt.
colloquial.en: Mark: Look how the fruit is all clustered together! Rita: Yes, this shrub bore fruit in bunches this year. Mark: Let me take a photo.
colloquial.zh: 马克：看，果实都聚在一起！丽塔：是啊，这株灌木今年结出了成串的果实。马克：我来拍张照片。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 看，果实都聚在一起！
messages.en: Look how the fruit is all clustered together!

messages.speaker: Rita (园主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan l-arbuxxell għanqad din is-sena.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan l-arbuxxell għanqad din is-sena.
messages.zh: 是啊，这株灌木今年结出了成串的果实。
messages.en: Yes, this shrub bore fruit in bunches this year.

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 我来拍张照片。
messages.en: Let me take a photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għanqad 画成枝头一串串聚在一起的果实，重点记“成串”；与强调葡萄产量的 għanneb 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A goitre, meaning an enlargement of the thyroid gland; also a double chin, meaning fullness beneath the chin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指甲状腺肿，也可指下巴下方形成的双下巴；具体含义须根据上下文区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkabbir tal-glandola tat-tirojde; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll geddum doppju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甲状腺肿；也指双下巴。

collocations.en: a double chin beneath the chin

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, it-tabib irreġistra għanqra u talab aktar eżamijiet tat-tirojde.
formal.en: In the report, the doctor recorded a goitre and requested further thyroid examinations.
formal.zh: 医生在报告中记录了甲状腺肿，并要求进一步检查甲状腺。

colloquial.mt: Anna: F'dan ir-ritratt tidher li għandi għanqra. Marija: Trid nieħu ieħor minn ftit aktar 'il fuq? Anna: Iva, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Anna: In this photo, it looks like I have a double chin. Marija: Shall I take another from a little higher up? Anna: Yes, thanks.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这张照片看起来我有双下巴。玛丽娅：要我把相机抬高一点再拍一张吗？安娜：好，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan ir-ritratt tidher li għandi għanqra.
messages.mt_standard: F'dan ir-ritratt tidher li għandi għanqra.
messages.zh: 这张照片看起来我有双下巴。
messages.en: In this photo, it looks like I have a double chin.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid nieħu ieħor minn ftit aktar 'il fuq?
messages.mt_standard: Trid nieħu ieħor minn ftit aktar 'il fuq?
messages.zh: 要我把相机抬高一点再拍一张吗？
messages.en: Shall I take another from a little higher up?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 għanqra 做两张语境卡：医生报告对应“甲状腺肿”，拍照谈外貌对应“双下巴”，分别记住两个含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having no value or worth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容没有价值或不值钱的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li m'għandu ebda valur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无价值的；不值钱的。

formal.mt: Wara l-eżami, l-espert iddeskriva l-oġġett bħala għansri u ma tah ebda valur monetarju.
formal.en: After examining it, the expert described the object as worthless and assigned it no monetary value.
formal.zh: 检查之后，专家认为这件物品不值钱，没有为其评定任何货币价值。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Taħseb li dan jiswa xi ħaġa? Rita: Le, dan għansri. Mark: Mela nżommu biss bħala tifkira.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you think this is worth anything? Rita: No, it's worthless. Mark: Then I'll just keep it as a souvenir.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你觉得这个值钱吗？丽塔：不，这个不值钱。马克：那我就留着当纪念吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (物主)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dan jiswa xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dan jiswa xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: 你觉得这个值钱吗？
messages.en: Do you think this is worth anything?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 不，这个不值钱。
messages.en: No, it's worthless.

messages.speaker: Mark (物主)
messages.zh: 那我就留着当纪念吧。
messages.en: Then I'll just keep it as a souvenir.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一件物品旁贴着“价值为零”的标签，把 għansri 记成形容价值的词，再用 oġġett għansri 连读巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A protective case in which the blade of a sword is kept.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收纳和保护剑身的套状器物，即剑鞘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kisi protettiv li fih tidħol ix-xafra ta' xabla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剑鞘；用于收纳剑身的保护套。

collocations.en: to draw the sword from its scabbard

formal.mt: Il-mużew esebixxa x-xabla flimkien mal-għant tagħha f'vetrina waħda.
formal.en: The museum displayed the sword together with its scabbard in a single display case.
formal.zh: 博物馆将这把剑和它的剑鞘放在同一个展柜中展出。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Din il-biċċa twila ħdejn ix-xabla x'inhi? Nina: Dak l-għant tagħha. Luca: Issa fhimt fejn tidħol ix-xabla.
colloquial.en: Luca: What's this long piece beside the sword? Nina: That's its scabbard. Luca: Now I understand where the sword goes.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：剑旁边这个长长的东西是什么？妮娜：那是它的剑鞘。卢卡：现在我明白剑收在哪里了。

messages.speaker: Luca (博物馆访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-biċċa twila ħdejn ix-xabla x'inhi?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-biċċa twila ħdejn ix-xabla x'inhi?
messages.zh: 剑旁边这个长长的东西是什么？
messages.en: What's this long piece beside the sword?

messages.speaker: Nina (博物馆导览员)
messages.zh: 那是它的剑鞘。
messages.en: That's its scabbard.

messages.speaker: Luca (博物馆访客)
messages.zh: 现在我明白剑收在哪里了。
messages.en: Now I understand where the sword goes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xabla 想成剑，把 għant 想成剑的收纳套；脑中演示一次拔剑出鞘，记住 għant 指包住剑身的外套。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To glisten because of dew on a surface, especially on grass or leaves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指草、叶片等表面因附着露水而闪闪发亮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddi minħabba n-nida fuq wiċċu, bħal ħaxix jew weraq filgħodu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因沾有露水而闪闪发亮。

collocations.en: the leaf glistened with dew in the sunshine
collocations.zh: 叶片上的露水在阳光下闪亮

formal.mt: Filgħodu, il-ħaxix għanċeċ bin-nida taħt l-ewwel raġġi tax-xemx.
formal.en: In the morning, the grass glistened with dew under the first rays of sunlight.
formal.zh: 清晨，草上的露水在初升的阳光下闪闪发亮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt kif il-ħaxix għanċeċ bin-nida dalgħodu? Toni: Iva, ħadt ritratt qabel ma nixef.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see how the grass glistened with dew this morning? Toni: Yes, I took a photo before it dried.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见今早草上的露水闪闪发亮了吗？托尼：看见了，我趁草还没干拍了张照片。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt kif il-ħaxix għanċeċ bin-nida dalgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt kif il-ħaxix għanċeċ bin-nida dalgħodu?
messages.zh: 你看见今早草上的露水闪闪发亮了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how the grass glistened with dew this morning?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħadt ritratt qabel ma nixef.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħadt ritratt qabel ma nixef.
messages.zh: 看见了，我趁草还没干拍了张照片。
messages.en: Yes, I took a photo before it dried.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清晨草叶上的露珠一闪一闪，把这个动作配给 għanċeċ；再连记 bin-nida“带着露水”，锁定露水闪亮的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Glistening: the appearance of small bright reflections on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 闪亮、闪烁的光泽，指物体表面呈现点点明亮反光的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dehra ta' tleqqija b'riflessi żgħar ta' dawl fuq wiċċ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪亮；闪烁的光泽或现象。

formal.mt: Il-poeta jiddeskrivi l-għanċiċ tan-nida fuq il-weraq fl-ewwel dawl ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The poet describes the glistening of the dew on the leaves in the first morning light.
formal.zh: 诗人描写了晨光初现时叶片上露水闪烁的光泽。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara l-għanċiċ tan-nida fuq dawn il-weraq! Mark: Kemm hu sabiħ! Ejja nieħdu ritratt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at the glistening of the dew on these leaves! Mark: How beautiful! Let's take a photo.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看这些叶片上露水闪烁的光泽！马克：真漂亮！我们拍张照片吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara l-għanċiċ tan-nida fuq dawn il-weraq!
messages.mt_standard: Ara l-għanċiċ tan-nida fuq dawn il-weraq!
messages.zh: 看这些叶片上露水闪烁的光泽！
messages.en: Look at the glistening of the dew on these leaves!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sabiħ! Ejja nieħdu ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sabiħ! Ejja nieħdu ritratt.
messages.zh: 真漂亮！我们拍张照片吧。
messages.en: How beautiful! Let's take a photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡区分：għanċeċ 记“露水闪亮了”的动作，għanċiċ 记“这一片闪光”的现象；后者在本词条中是名词。

gloss_zh: 民事结合；民事伴侣关系

teaching_sense.en_definition: A legally recognised partnership between two people, also called unjoni ċivili in Maltese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两人之间获得法律承认的伴侣结合关系；在马耳他语中也称 unjoni ċivili。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta bejn żewġ persuni rikonoxxuta mil-liġi, magħrufa wkoll bħala unjoni ċivili.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of unjoni ċivili: civil union
sense_translations.zh_definition: unjoni ċivili 的同义表达：民事结合，即法律承认的民事伴侣关系。

collocations.en: to enter into a civil union

formal.mt: Il-koppja ppreżentat kopja taċ-ċertifikat tal-għaqda ċivili tagħha flimkien mal-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: The couple submitted a copy of their civil union certificate with the application.
formal.zh: 这对伴侣在提交申请时，一并递交了民事伴侣关系证明书的副本。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Aħna se nidħlu f'għaqda ċivili x-xahar id-dieħel. Marija: Prosit! Se tagħmlu xi ċelebrazzjoni? Sara: Iva, ikla żgħira mal-familja.
colloquial.en: Sara: We're entering into a civil union next month. Marija: Congratulations! Will you have a celebration? Sara: Yes, a small meal with the family.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们下个月要缔结民事伴侣关系。玛丽娅：恭喜！你们会庆祝一下吗？萨拉：会，和家人简单吃顿饭。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħna se nidħlu f'għaqda ċivili x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Aħna se nidħlu f'għaqda ċivili x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 我们下个月要缔结民事伴侣关系。
messages.en: We're entering into a civil union next month.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 恭喜！你们会庆祝一下吗？
messages.en: Congratulations! Will you have a celebration?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 会，和家人简单吃顿饭。
messages.en: Yes, a small meal with the family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两位伴侣一起拿着关系证明书，把 għaqda ċivili 整体记为“民事结合”，并与同义表达 unjoni ċivili 配对复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become wiser or more mature in one's judgment and behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在判断和行为上逐渐变得明智、成熟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar għaref jew matur fil-ġudizzju u fl-imġiba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐变得明智，更懂得作出审慎判断。
在思想或行为上变得成熟。

collocations.zh: 随着时间推移变得更成熟

formal.mt: Matul is-snin, Pawlu għaqel u tgħallem jikkunsidra l-konsegwenzi qabel jieħu deċiżjoni.
formal.en: Over the years, Pawlu grew wiser and learned to consider the consequences before making a decision.
formal.zh: 这些年来，保罗变得更明智，学会了在作决定前考虑后果。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu għadu jieħu deċiżjonijiet bl-għaġla? Anna: Le, għaqel ħafna; issa jaħseb qabel jaġixxi.
colloquial.en: Marija: Does Pawlu still make decisions in a rush? Anna: No, he has grown much wiser; now he thinks before he acts.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗还会匆忙作决定吗？安娜：不会了，他明智多了，现在会先想清楚再行动。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗还会匆忙作决定吗？
messages.en: Does Pawlu still make decisions in a rush?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għaqel ħafna; issa jaħseb qabel jaġixxi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għaqel ħafna; issa jaħseb qabel jaġixxi.
messages.zh: 不会了，他明智多了，现在会先想清楚再行动。
messages.en: No, he has grown much wiser; now he thinks before he acts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上“先想后做”的画面：同一个人从冲动到审慎，记住它表示变得明智或成熟的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of gathering people or things together, or the process by which a substance coagulates or congeals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或事物聚集到一起的行为，也指物质发生凝固、凝结的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jinġabru nies jew affarijiet flimkien, jew il-proċess li bih sustanza tagħqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人或事物聚集到一起的行为。
凝固；尤指血液等液体形成凝块的过程。
凝结；液态物质变稠或变为固态的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-għaqid tad-demm fil-kampjun.
formal.en: The report describes the coagulation of blood in the sample.
formal.zh: 报告描述了样本中血液的凝固过程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ix-xaħam fil-borma m'għadux likwidu? Toni: Dan hu għaqid tax-xaħam wara li kesaħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the fat in the pot no longer liquid? Toni: This is the congealing of the fat after it cooled.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：锅里的脂肪怎么不再是液体了？托尼：这是脂肪冷却后发生了凝结。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 锅里的脂肪怎么不再是液体了？
messages.en: Why is the fat in the pot no longer liquid?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu għaqid tax-xaħam wara li kesaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu għaqid tax-xaħam wara li kesaħ.
messages.zh: 这是脂肪冷却后发生了凝结。
messages.en: This is the congealing of the fat after it cooled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅图分别记义：人群聚到一起、血液形成凝块、脂肪冷却凝结；共同画面只作记忆辅助，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make mounds by heaping material into small raised piles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把泥土等材料堆起，形成一个个小丘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel għoljiet żgħar billi jiġma' l-ħamrija jew materjal ieħor f'munzelli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 堆起小丘；把材料堆成隆起的小堆。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem għaqqab il-ħamrija tul it-tarf tal-ġnien.
formal.en: The worker heaped the soil into mounds along the edge of the garden.
formal.zh: 工人沿着花园边缘把泥土堆成了一个个小丘。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min għamel dawn l-għoljiet żgħar fir-ramel? Mark: Leo għaqqab ir-ramel waqt li kien qed jilgħab.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who made these little mounds in the sand? Mark: Leo heaped the sand into mounds while he was playing.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些小沙丘是谁堆的？马克：利奥玩的时候把沙子堆成了小丘。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għamel dawn l-għoljiet żgħar fir-ramel?
messages.mt_standard: Min għamel dawn l-għoljiet żgħar fir-ramel?
messages.zh: 这些小沙丘是谁堆的？
messages.en: Who made these little mounds in the sand?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Leo għaqqab ir-ramel waqt li kien qed jilgħab.
messages.mt_standard: Leo għaqqab ir-ramel waqt li kien qed jilgħab.
messages.zh: 利奥玩的时候把沙子堆成了小丘。
messages.en: Leo heaped the sand into mounds while he was playing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把平铺的沙土推成几个小山包；用“平地变小丘”的动作画面记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop ulcers or become ulcerated, said of a person's skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人的皮肤出现溃疡，发生溃烂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifforma ulċeri jew isir ulċerat, meta jingħad għall-ġild ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生溃疡、溃烂，用于描述人的皮肤。

collocations.en: the skin on his arm became ulcerated
collocations.zh: 他手臂上的皮肤发生了溃烂

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinnota li l-ġild ta' driegħ il-pazjent għaqqar.
formal.en: The report notes that the skin on the patient's arm became ulcerated.
formal.zh: 报告指出，患者手臂上的皮肤发生了溃烂。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'ġara minn driegħ Pawlu? Marija: Il-ġild għaqqar, u Pawlu mar għand it-tabib.
colloquial.en: Anna: What happened to Pawlu's arm? Marija: The skin became ulcerated, and Pawlu went to the doctor.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗的手臂怎么了？玛丽娅：皮肤溃烂了，保罗去看医生了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗的手臂怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Pawlu's arm?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġild għaqqar, u Pawlu mar għand it-tabib.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġild għaqqar, u Pawlu mar għand it-tabib.
messages.zh: 皮肤溃烂了，保罗去看医生了。
messages.en: The skin became ulcerated, and Pawlu went to the doctor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“皮肤发生溃烂”的完整句子里记：这里表达的是皮肤的变化过程，学习时与表示溃疡的名词分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow wiser or become more mature in thought and behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在思想和行为上变得更明智，逐渐成熟起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar għaref jew matur fil-ħsieb u fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得明智；逐渐懂得更审慎地思考和判断。
成熟起来；思想或行为逐渐成熟。

collocations.zh: 随着时间推移成熟起来
在那次经历后变得更明智

formal.mt: Matul is-sena, it-tifel għaqqel u beda jerfa' aktar responsabbiltà għall-għażliet tiegħu.
formal.en: During the year, the boy matured and began taking more responsibility for his choices.
formal.zh: 这一年里，男孩成熟起来，开始为自己的选择承担更多责任。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ben għadu jitlaq ix-xogħol kollu għall-aħħar? David: Le, għaqqel; issa jippjana minn qabel.
colloquial.en: Rita: Does Ben still leave all his work until the last minute? David: No, he has matured; now he plans ahead.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：本还会把所有事情都拖到最后一刻吗？戴维：不会了，他成熟了，现在会提前安排。

messages.speaker: Rita (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Ben għadu jitlaq ix-xogħol kollu għall-aħħar?
messages.mt_standard: Ben għadu jitlaq ix-xogħol kollu għall-aħħar?
messages.zh: 本还会把所有事情都拖到最后一刻吗？
messages.en: Does Ben still leave all his work until the last minute?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għaqqel; issa jippjana minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għaqqel; issa jippjana minn qabel.
messages.zh: 不会了，他成熟了，现在会提前安排。
messages.en: No, he has matured; now he plans ahead.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“以前拖延，现在会安排”的前后对照记住成熟这一义；再联想到判断更明智，并留意词中双写的 q。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cheat or deceive someone by acting dishonestly or making them believe something false.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不诚实的行为或虚假信息欺骗、蒙骗他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqarraq b'xi ħadd permezz ta' mġiba diżonesta jew billi jġiegħlu jemmen xi ħaġa falza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以不诚实的手段欺骗他人或占取便宜。
蒙骗；使他人相信虚假的事情。

formal.mt: Fl-ilment tiegħu, il-klijent stqarr li l-bejjiegħ għaqqex lilu billi tah informazzjoni falza dwar il-prodott.
formal.en: In his complaint, the customer stated that the seller had deceived him by giving him false information about the product.
formal.zh: 顾客在投诉中表示，卖家提供了关于产品的虚假信息，欺骗了他。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-bejjiegħ qal li l-arloġġ kien ġdid? Mark: Iva, imma kien użat; għaqqex lili.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the seller say the watch was new? Mark: Yes, but it was used; he cheated me.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：卖家说这块表是新的吗？马克：是啊，可它是用过的；他骗了我。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bejjiegħ qal li l-arloġġ kien ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Il-bejjiegħ qal li l-arloġġ kien ġdid?
messages.zh: 卖家说这块表是新的吗？
messages.en: Did the seller say the watch was new?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma kien użat; għaqqex lili.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma kien użat; għaqqex lili.
messages.zh: 是啊，可它是用过的；他骗了我。
messages.en: Yes, but it was used; he cheated me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象卖家把旧表说成新表的场景：说法与事实不符，有人因此上当，用这个情节记住欺骗和蒙骗。

gloss_zh: 难相处的人；难以合作、制造麻烦的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A difficult person who creates problems and is hard to cooperate with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 难以相处或合作的人，尤其指经常制造困难、妨碍合作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna diffiċli li toħloq problemi u li jkun diffiċli taħdem magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 难相处的人；不好打交道的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who creates difficulties and is hard to cooperate with
sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常制造困难、令人难以与之合作的人。

collocations.en: to work with a difficult person
to deal with a difficult person

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kap tat-tim huwa għaqqux li joħloq diffikultajiet kull darba li l-kollegi jipproponu bidla.
formal.en: In the story, the team leader is a difficult person who creates problems whenever colleagues propose a change.
formal.zh: 故事中的团队负责人很难合作，每当同事提出改变时，他都会制造困难。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif sejjer ix-xogħol ma' dak ir-raġel? Toni: Hu għaqqux; joġġezzjona għal kollox u ma jridx jikkopera.
colloquial.en: Nina: How is working with that man going? Toni: He's a difficult person; he objects to everything and won't cooperate.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：跟那个男人共事怎么样？托尼：他很难合作，什么都反对，也不愿意配合。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer ix-xogħol ma' dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer ix-xogħol ma' dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 跟那个男人共事怎么样？
messages.en: How is working with that man going?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu għaqqux; joġġezzjona għal kollox u ma jridx jikkopera.
messages.mt_standard: Hu għaqqux; joġġezzjona għal kollox u ma jridx jikkopera.
messages.zh: 他很难合作，什么都反对，也不愿意配合。
messages.en: He's a difficult person; he objects to everything and won't cooperate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小组里总给合作添障碍的那个人，把词直接对应到“难合作的人”；这是指人的名词，与表示欺骗动作的 għaqqex 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An ulcer: an open sore on the skin or on an internal lining of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 溃疡，即皮肤或体内黏膜表面形成的开放性创面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ulċera: ferita miftuħa fuq il-ġilda jew fuq kisja interna tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 溃疡；皮肤或黏膜表面的开放性创面。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jiddeskrivi għaqra fil-ġilda fuq is-sieq tal-pazjent.
formal.en: The medical report describes a skin ulcer on the patient's foot.
formal.zh: 医疗报告描述了患者脚上的一处皮肤溃疡。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'qallek it-tabib dwar dik il-ferita? Pawlu: Qalli li hija għaqra fil-ġilda.
colloquial.en: Marija: What did the doctor tell you about that sore? Pawlu: He told me it is a skin ulcer.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：医生怎么说你那处伤口？保罗：他说那是一处皮肤溃疡。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生怎么说你那处伤口？
messages.en: What did the doctor tell you about that sore?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (患者)
messages.zh: 他说那是一处皮肤溃疡。
messages.en: He told me it is a skin ulcer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这一处溃疡”来记名词 għaqra，再用“皮肤发生溃烂”记动词 għaqqar；一处病灶与变化动作分开记更清楚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow old or become physically frail or infirm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐渐变老，或身体变得衰弱、虚弱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixjieħ jew isir dgħajjef f'ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变老；逐渐年迈。
身体变得衰弱；变得虚弱无力。

collocations.zh: 身体变得衰弱，需要帮助了

formal.mt: Maż-żmien, is-Sur Borg għaġeż u beda jkollu bżonn aktar għajnuna fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: Over time, Mr Borg grew old and began to need more help in everyday life.
formal.zh: 随着年岁增长，博格先生逐渐老去，日常生活开始需要更多帮助。

colloquial.mt: Anna: In-nannu għadu jmur waħdu sal-ħanut? Luqa: Għaġeż u jimxi aktar bil-mod; issa mmur miegħu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does Grandpa still go to the shop on his own? Luqa: He's grown old and walks more slowly; I go with him now.
colloquial.zh: Anna：爷爷现在还自己去商店吗？Luqa：他年纪大了，走路慢些了，现在我陪他去。

messages.speaker: Anna (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷现在还自己去商店吗？
messages.en: Does Grandpa still go to the shop on his own?

messages.speaker: Luqa (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaġeż u jimxi aktar bil-mod; issa mmur miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għaġeż u jimxi aktar bil-mod; issa mmur miegħu.
messages.zh: 他年纪大了，走路慢些了，现在我陪他去。
messages.en: He's grown old and walks more slowly; I go with him now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象相册中的人随岁月渐渐年迈，再联想到身体可能变弱，分别记住“变老”和“变得衰弱”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a texture or consistency like dough.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质地或稠度像面团的；呈面团状的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu konsistenza jew nisġa bħal dik tal-għaġina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面团状的；质地像面团的。

collocations.zh: 具有面团般稠度的材料

formal.mt: Wara li żdied l-ilma, it-tafal sar għaġni u seta' jingħata forma bl-idejn.
formal.en: After water was added, the clay became doughlike and could be shaped by hand.
formal.zh: 加水后，黏土变成面团状，可以用手塑形。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu t-tafal issa? Mark: Sar għaġni; nista' nagħtih forma b'idejja.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the clay like now? Mark: It has become doughlike; I can shape it with my hands.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：黏土现在怎么样了？马克：变得像面团了，我可以用手给它塑形。

messages.speaker: Maja (手工课同学)
messages.zh: 黏土现在怎么样了？
messages.en: What is the clay like now?

messages.speaker: Mark (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sar għaġni; nista' nagħtih forma b'idejja.
messages.mt_standard: Sar għaġni; nista' nagħtih forma b'idejja.
messages.zh: 变得像面团了，我可以用手给它塑形。
messages.en: It has become doughlike; I can shape it with my hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把黏土揉成一团面团：għaġni 描写的是面团般的质地，不是面团这个物品的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Acting or done too quickly, without enough care or thought.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行动过急或做事仓促的，往往缺少充分考虑或细心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaġixxi jew isir b'għaġla, mingħajr biżżejjed ħsieb jew attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仓促的；急于行动而考虑不周的。

collocations.zh: 仓促的一步；草率的举措

formal.mt: Il-kumitat evita pass għaġuli u talab aktar informazzjoni qabel ħa deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The committee avoided a hasty step and requested more information before making a decision.
formal.zh: 委员会避免仓促行事，在作出决定前要求提供更多信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tixtrih mingħajr ma tqabbel il-prezzijiet? Pawlu: Għandek raġun, kont għaġuli; l-ewwel inqabbel ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you going to buy it without comparing prices? Pawlu: You're right, I was being hasty; I'll compare a few first.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你不比较价格就要买吗？保罗：你说得对，我太急了；我先比较几家。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tixtrih mingħajr ma tqabbel il-prezzijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Se tixtrih mingħajr ma tqabbel il-prezzijiet?
messages.zh: 你不比较价格就要买吗？
messages.en: Are you going to buy it without comparing prices?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, kont għaġuli; l-ewwel inqabbel ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, kont għaġuli; l-ewwel inqabbel ftit.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我太急了；我先比较几家。
messages.en: You're right, I was being hasty; I'll compare a few first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għaġuli 配上一个还没看完价格牌就掏钱的人：重点记住行动太急、考虑不足的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An old man; in a separate sense, a shore crab of the species Carcinus maenas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年老的男子；另一个独立义项指岸蟹，学名为 Carcinus maenas。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel xwejjaħ; f'tifsira oħra, granċ tax-xatt tal-ispeċi Carcinus maenas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 老人；年老的男子。
岸蟹，指 Carcinus maenas 这一物种。

collocations.en: a shore crab among the rocks

formal.mt: L-għalliem spjega li 'għaġuż' jista' jfisser raġel xwejjaħ jew granċ tax-xatt, skont il-kuntest.
formal.en: The teacher explained that 'għaġuż' can mean an old man or a shore crab, depending on the context.
formal.zh: 老师解释说，għaġuż 根据语境可以指一位老人，也可以指一只岸蟹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawnhekk 'għaġuż' ifisser raġel xwejjaħ? Toni: Le, qed nitkellmu fuq il-baħar; hawn ifisser granċ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does 'għaġuż' mean an old man here? Toni: No, we're talking about the sea; here it means a crab.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的 għaġuż 是指老人吗？托尼：不是，我们在谈海边的事；这里指的是螃蟹。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 għaġuż 是指老人吗？
messages.en: Does 'għaġuż' mean an old man here?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed nitkellmu fuq il-baħar; hawn ifisser granċ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed nitkellmu fuq il-baħar; hawn ifisser granċ.
messages.zh: 不是，我们在谈海边的事；这里指的是螃蟹。
messages.en: No, we're talking about the sea; here it means a crab.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张独立词义卡：一张是坐着的老人，一张是海边的岸蟹。两义靠语境区分，不必编造它们之间的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose trade is selling cheese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以出售奶酪为业的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tbigħ il-ġobon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奶酪商；专门出售奶酪的人。

collocations.en: to buy cheese from the cheesemonger

formal.mt: Il-ġabban spjega lill-klijent id-differenzi bejn it-tipi ta' ġobon għall-bejgħ.
formal.en: The cheesemonger explained to the customer the differences between the types of cheese for sale.
formal.zh: 奶酪商向顾客解释了在售各类奶酪之间的区别。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn xtrajt dan il-ġobon? Pawlu: Mingħand il-ġabban tas-suq. Għandu ħafna tipi differenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you buy this cheese? Pawlu: From the cheesemonger at the market. He has many different types.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块奶酪你在哪儿买的？保罗：在市场的奶酪商那里。他卖很多不同种类的奶酪。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块奶酪你在哪儿买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy this cheese?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mingħand il-ġabban tas-suq. Għandu ħafna tipi differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Mingħand il-ġabban tas-suq. Għandu ħafna tipi differenti.
messages.zh: 在市场的奶酪商那里。他卖很多不同种类的奶酪。
messages.en: From the cheesemonger at the market. He has many different types.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象市场里站在奶酪柜台后的商人，把 ġabban 标在人物旁，再用“向奶酪商买奶酪”的整句巩固。

gloss_zh: 具有集体性质的；集体性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a collective character, involving a group considered together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有集体性质的，涉及作为一个整体看待的群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu karattru kollettiv u jinvolvi grupp meqjus bħala ħaġa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有集体性质的；体现群体整体特征的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-karattru ġabbari tal-proġett, li jgħaqqad il-ħidma tal-parteċipanti kollha.
formal.en: The report emphasizes the collective character of the project, which brings together the work of all the participants.
formal.zh: 报告强调该项目的集体性质：它汇集了所有参与者的工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ix-xogħol għandu aspett ġabbari. Mark: Iva, għax kulħadd qed jagħti sehmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: This work has a collective aspect. Mark: Yes, because everyone is contributing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这项工作具有集体性。马克：是啊，因为每个人都在出力。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这项工作具有集体性。
messages.en: This work has a collective aspect.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax kulħadd qed jagħti sehmu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax kulħadd qed jagħti sehmu.
messages.zh: 是啊，因为每个人都在出力。
messages.en: Yes, because everyone is contributing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġabbari 和“大家共同完成一件事”的画面绑定，记住它描述的是集体性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce musical sounds with the voice; to sing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用嗓音发出有旋律的声音；唱歌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikanta, jiġifieri joħroġ ħsejjes mużikali bil-vuċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 唱歌；用嗓音唱出旋律。

formal.mt: Matul iċ-ċerimonja, it-tifel ġagġag għanja quddiem il-mistednin.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the boy sang a song in front of the guests.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，男孩在来宾面前唱了一首歌。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ġagġag fil-festa lbieraħ? Pawlu: Ħija! Kien ferħan ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who sang at the party yesterday? Pawlu: My brother! He was very happy.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：昨天聚会上是谁唱歌了？保罗：我兄弟！他当时特别开心。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天聚会上是谁唱歌了？
messages.en: Who sang at the party yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我兄弟！他当时特别开心。
messages.en: My brother! He was very happy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读 ġagġag 时配上两拍旋律，把整个词和“开口唱歌”的动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone do something through force or pressure, or to urge someone to act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过强制或压力使某人做某事，也可指敦促某人采取行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa bil-forza jew bi pressjoni, jew iħeġġu biex jaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强迫；用强制手段使某人做某事。
迫使；使某人在压力或情势下不得不做某事。

sense_translations.en_definition: to urge sb. to do sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 敦促某人做某事；力劝某人采取行动。

formal.mt: L-għeluq tat-triq ġagħal lis-sewwieq jieħu rotta oħra.
formal.en: The road closure compelled the driver to take another route.
formal.zh: 道路封闭迫使司机改走另一条路线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tlaqt daqshekk kmieni? Mark: L-istorbju ġagħal lili nitlaq; ma stajtx nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you leave so early? Mark: The noise forced me to leave; I couldn't rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么那么早就走了？马克：噪声逼得我离开了，我没法休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么那么早就走了？
messages.en: Why did you leave so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-istorbju ġagħal lili nitlaq; ma stajtx nistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: L-istorbju ġagħal lili nitlaq; ma stajtx nistrieħ.
messages.zh: 噪声逼得我离开了，我没法休息。
messages.en: The noise forced me to leave; I couldn't rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“压力推着人行动”的画面：ġagħal 可表示强迫、迫使，也可表示敦促，强度由语境判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Curly in texture or shape, used to describe a person's hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人的头发呈卷曲状态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu nokkli jew curls; jingħad dwar ix-xagħar ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷曲的；用于形容人的头发。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, ir-raġel jidher b'xagħar qasir u ġagħdi.
formal.en: In the photograph, the man is shown with short, curly hair.
formal.zh: 照片中的男子留着短卷发。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu ħuk f'dan ir-ritratt? Maja: Dak bix-xagħar ġagħdi, ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which one is your brother in this photograph? Maja: The one with curly hair, beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张照片里哪个是你兄弟？玛雅：窗户旁边那个卷头发的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张照片里哪个是你兄弟？
messages.en: Which one is your brother in this photograph?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 窗户旁边那个卷头发的。
messages.en: The one with curly hair, beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xagħar ġagħdi 整组记成“卷头发”，脑中画出一圈圈发卷，牢牢记住它的头发语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or use of compulsion, including making someone act or enforcing a requirement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强迫他人行动的行为或手段，也指对要求的强制执行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa jew li tinforza rekwiżit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强迫；使人不得不采取行动的压力或强制。
强制执行；使规则、要求或决定得到遵守和落实。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipazzjoni fil-proġett għandha tkun volontarja u mingħajr ġagħil.
formal.en: Participation in the project should be voluntary and free from compulsion.
formal.zh: 参与该项目应出于自愿，不应受到强迫。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Mort minn jeddek jew kien hemm xi ġagħil? Sara: Mort minn jeddi; ħadd ma għamel pressjoni fuqi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you go of your own accord, or was there some compulsion? Sara: I went of my own accord; nobody put pressure on me.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你是自己愿意去的，还是受了什么强迫？萨拉：我是自己愿意去的，没人向我施压。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mort minn jeddek jew kien hemm xi ġagħil?
messages.mt_standard: Mort minn jeddek jew kien hemm xi ġagħil?
messages.zh: 你是自己愿意去的，还是受了什么强迫？
messages.en: Did you go of your own accord, or was there some compulsion?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mort minn jeddi; ħadd ma għamel pressjoni fuqi.
messages.mt_standard: Mort minn jeddi; ħadd ma għamel pressjoni fuqi.
messages.zh: 我是自己愿意去的，没人向我施压。
messages.en: I went of my own accord; nobody put pressure on me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġagħil 放进 mingħajr ġagħil“没有强迫”来记；它是名词，可以给“强迫或执行这件事”命名。

gloss_zh: 紧眯双眼；光线昏暗；雾；薄雾

teaching_sense.en_definition: To squeeze one's eyes tightly shut or narrow them tightly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把双眼紧紧闭起或眯紧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħlaq jew idejjaq għajnejh sewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧紧眯起双眼；把眼睛用力闭紧。
光线昏暗；照明不足的状况。
雾；使周围景物难以看清的近地面水滴聚集现象。
薄雾；较轻、较淡的雾气。

formal.mt: Meta d-dawl qawwi waqa' fuq wiċċu, ir-raġel ġahar għajnejh.
formal.en: When the bright light fell on his face, the man squeezed his eyes tightly shut.
formal.zh: 强光照到脸上时，男子紧紧闭起了双眼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ġahar għajnejh? Sara: Ix-xemx kienet direttament f'wiċċu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu squeeze his eyes tightly shut? Sara: The sun was shining directly into his face.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么把眼睛闭得那么紧？萨拉：阳光正对着他的脸照。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么把眼睛闭得那么紧？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu squeeze his eyes tightly shut?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 阳光正对着他的脸照。
messages.en: The sun was shining directly into his face.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ġahar 做两张词性卡：动词画“紧眯眼”，名词分别画“暗光、雾、薄雾”，按句子判断义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having fog or mist in the air, making things less clear to see.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 空气中有雾或薄雾、使景物不易看清的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih ċpar jew ċpar ħafif, b'mod li l-affarijiet jidhru inqas ċari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有雾的；被雾笼罩的。
有薄雾的；笼罩着淡淡雾气的。

formal.mt: It-temp kien ġahri filgħodu, u l-għoljiet ma kinux jidhru sew.
formal.en: The weather was foggy in the morning, and the hills could not be seen clearly.
formal.zh: 早晨天气有雾，远处的山丘看不清楚。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ma nistax nara l-għolja? Maja: It-temp ġahri llum; stenna ftit u forsi jiċċara.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why can't I see the hill? Maja: It's misty today; wait a little and perhaps it will clear.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我怎么看不见那座山丘？玛雅：今天有薄雾，等一会儿也许就散了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我怎么看不见那座山丘？
messages.en: Why can't I see the hill?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-temp ġahri llum; stenna ftit u forsi jiċċara.
messages.mt_standard: It-temp ġahri llum; stenna ftit u forsi jiċċara.
messages.zh: 今天有薄雾，等一会儿也许就散了。
messages.en: It's misty today; wait a little and perhaps it will clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 temp ġahri 想成“天气蒙上一层雾纱”，记住 ġahri 是描述有雾状态的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act involving deception and betrayal of trust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过欺骗而背弃他人信任的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att ta' qerq u tradiment li jikser il-fiduċja ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗和背叛的行为；背信弃义之举。

collocations.en: he committed an act of deception and betrayal
collocations.zh: 他做了一件欺骗背叛之事

collocations.en: an act of deception and betrayal against a friend
collocations.zh: 欺骗并背叛朋友的行为

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-bejgħ tas-sigriet lill-għadu huwa ġakbinata li teqred il-fiduċja bejn il-ħbieb.
formal.en: In the novel, selling the secret to the enemy is an act of deception and betrayal that destroys trust between friends.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，把秘密出卖给敌人是一种欺骗背叛行为，摧毁了朋友之间的信任。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qalli li kien se jgħinni, imma bil-moħbi ħadem kontrija. Mark: Dik kienet ġakbinata.
colloquial.en: Sara: He told me he would help me, but secretly he worked against me. Mark: That was an act of deception and betrayal.
colloquial.zh: Sara：他跟我说会帮我，背地里却跟我作对。Mark：那真是欺骗和背叛。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli li kien se jgħinni, imma bil-moħbi ħadem kontrija.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli li kien se jgħinni, imma bil-moħbi ħadem kontrija.
messages.zh: 他跟我说会帮我，背地里却跟我作对。
messages.en: He told me he would help me, but secretly he worked against me.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那真是欺骗和背叛。
messages.en: That was an act of deception and betrayal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġakbinata 配成一个小情节：“嘴上答应帮助，背地出卖朋友。”同时抓住“欺骗”和“背叛”两层意思。

gloss_zh: 男性名，对应英语 James 或 Jacob

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male given name corresponding to English James or Jacob.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个男性名字，对应英语中的 James 或 Jacob。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raġel li jikkorrispondi għall-ismijiet Ingliżi James jew Jacob.

sense_translations.en_definition: a male given name from Sicilian [in turn from Latin, in turn from Ancient Greek, in turn from Hebrew], equivalent to English James or Jacob
sense_translations.zh_definition: 源自西西里语的男性名字，对应英语 James 或 Jacob；其来源依次可追溯至拉丁语、古希腊语和希伯来语。

formal.mt: Ġakbu bagħat it-talba tiegħu lill-iskola u rċieva tweġiba bil-miktub.
formal.en: Ġakbu sent his request to the school and received a written reply.
formal.zh: Ġakbu 向学校提交了请求，并收到了书面回复。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jiġi magħna għada? Lara: Ġakbu, il-ħabib tiegħi. Se niltaqgħu miegħu ħdejn l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is coming with us tomorrow? Lara: Ġakbu, my friend. We are meeting him near the school.
colloquial.zh: Maja：明天谁跟我们一起去？Lara：我的朋友 Ġakbu。我们会在学校附近跟他碰面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天谁跟我们一起去？
messages.en: Who is coming with us tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Ġakbu, il-ħabib tiegħi. Se niltaqgħu miegħu ħdejn l-iskola.
messages.zh: 我的朋友 Ġakbu。我们会在学校附近跟他碰面。
messages.en: Ġakbu, my friend. We are meeting him near the school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Ġakbu 做一张人物名片，旁边写“James / Jacob”；记住词尾是 bu，再与 Ġakmu 的 mu 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to raise and support a heavy object, such as a car.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于抬起并支撑汽车等重物的装置，即千斤顶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex terfa' u żżomm oġġett tqil, bħal karozza.

sense_translations.en_definition: jack (device for raising and supporting a heavy object)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 千斤顶；用于抬起和支撑重物的装置。
旗；旗帜；舰首旗。
胸甲；护卫躯干的铠甲。

collocations.en: to raise the car with a jack

formal.mt: Il-mekkanik uża ġakk idrawliku biex jerfa' l-karozza qabel ma poġġa l-appoġġi taħtha.
formal.en: The mechanic used a hydraulic jack to raise the car before placing supports beneath it.
formal.zh: 机械师先用液压千斤顶抬起汽车，再把支撑架放到车下。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu l-ġakk? Għandi bżonnu biex nibdel ir-rota. Pawlu: Fil-bagoll, ħdejn ir-rota żejda.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the jack? I need it to change the wheel. Pawlu: In the boot, next to the spare wheel.
colloquial.zh: Mark：千斤顶在哪儿？我要用它换轮胎。Pawlu：在后备箱里，备胎旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (车主)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-ġakk? Għandi bżonnu biex nibdel ir-rota.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-ġakk? Għandi bżonnu biex nibdel ir-rota.
messages.zh: 千斤顶在哪儿？我要用它换轮胎。
messages.en: Where is the jack? I need it to change the wheel.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 在后备箱里，备胎旁边。
messages.en: In the boot, next to the spare wheel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġakk 分别配上“车下千斤顶、杆上旗帜、身上胸甲”三张图；这是三个词义的记忆卡，不必把它们强行解释成同一用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male given name corresponding to English James.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个男性名字，对应英语中的 James。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raġel li jikkorrispondi għall-isem Ingliż James.

sense_translations.en_definition: a male given name from Italian [in turn from Latin, in turn from Ancient Greek, in turn from Hebrew], equivalent to English James
sense_translations.zh_definition: 源自意大利语的男性名字，对应英语 James；其来源依次可追溯至拉丁语、古希腊语和希伯来语。

formal.mt: Ġakmu se jippreżenta r-riżultati tar-riċerka waqt il-laqgħa ta' nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: Ġakmu will present the research results at Monday's meeting.
formal.zh: Ġakmu 将在星期一的会议上介绍研究结果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ġakmu diġà wasal? Toni: Iva, qiegħed jistenniena ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has Ġakmu arrived already? Toni: Yes, he is waiting for us by the door.

messages.en: Yes, he is waiting for us by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Ġakmu 做一张写有“James”的人物卡，特别圈出词尾 mu；与 Ġakbu 并排练习，避免把两个名字的字母看混。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male given name corresponding to English Jacob.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个男性名字，对应英语中的 Jacob。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raġel li jikkorrispondi għall-isem Ingliż Jacob.

sense_translations.en_definition: a male given name from Italian [in turn from Latin, in turn from Ancient Greek, in turn from Hebrew], equivalent to English Jacob
sense_translations.zh_definition: 源自意大利语的男性名字，对应英语 Jacob；其来源依次可追溯至拉丁语、古希腊语和希伯来语。

formal.mt: Ġakobb kiteb ittra lill-kunsill lokali biex jitlob aktar kotba għal-librerija.
formal.en: Ġakobb wrote a letter to the local council to request more books for the library.
formal.zh: Ġakobb 给地方议会写了一封信，请求为图书馆添置更多书籍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min tak dawn il-kotba? Mark: Ġakobb, il-ġar tiegħi. Qalli li nista' nżommhom għal ġimgħa.

colloquial.zh: Lara：这些书是谁给你的？Mark：我的邻居 Ġakobb。他说我可以借一个星期。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)

messages.en: Who gave you these books?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġakobb, il-ġar tiegħi. Qalli li nista' nżommhom għal ġimgħa.

messages.en: Ġakobb, my neighbour. He said I could keep them for a week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ġakobb 与英语 Jacob 放在同一张人物卡上，圈出马耳他语拼写末尾的双写 bb；每次默写都检查两个 b 是否齐全。

gloss_zh: 雅各布派成员；雅各布主义支持者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who belongs to or supports the Jacobite movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于雅各布派或支持雅各布主义运动的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel parti mill-moviment tal-ġakobitiżmu jew tappoġġjah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雅各布派成员；雅各布主义的支持者。

collocations.zh: 一位知名的雅各布派成员
一位雅各布派成员的观点

formal.mt: L-awtur iqabbel l-opinjonijiet ta' ġakobita ma' dawk tal-avversarji tiegħu.
formal.en: The author compares the opinions of a Jacobite with those of his opponents.
formal.zh: 作者将一位雅各布派成员的观点与其反对者的观点进行比较。

colloquial.en: Maja: What does ġakobita mean in this text? Mark: A person who supports Jacobitism.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章里的 ġakobita 是什么意思？马克：指支持雅各布主义的人。

messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 ġakobita 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ġakobita mean in this text?

messages.zh: 指支持雅各布主义的人。
messages.en: A person who supports Jacobitism.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġakobita 放在人物卡上记：这个词指派别中的人，可与表示主义的 ġakobitiżmu 对照学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement and beliefs supported by Jacobites.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雅各布派所支持的运动及其思想主张。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment u t-twemmin li jappoġġjaw il-ġakobiti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雅各布主义；雅各布派的运动及思想主张。

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jiddiskuti l-ġakobitiżmu u l-ideat tal-partitarji tiegħu.
formal.en: This chapter discusses Jacobitism and the ideas of its supporters.
formal.zh: 本章讨论雅各布主义及其支持者的思想。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fuq xiex se tikteb? Daniel: Fuq il-ġakobitiżmu; irrid nifhem aħjar dan il-moviment.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you going to write about? Daniel: Jacobitism; I want to understand this movement better.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你准备写什么？丹尼尔：雅各布主义；我想更好地了解这个运动。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你准备写什么？

messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-ġakobitiżmu; irrid nifhem aħjar dan il-moviment.

messages.zh: 雅各布主义；我想更好地了解这个运动。
messages.en: Jacobitism; I want to understand this movement better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作两张对照卡：ġakobita 记人物，ġakobitiżmu 记主义或运动，用“人支持一种主义”的画面区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gather things or bring people together in one place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品收集起来，或把人召集到一起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib affarijiet jew nies flimkien f'post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收集；把分散的物品集中起来。
使聚集；把人或事物集中到一起。

formal.zh: 老师把学生召集到大厅，说明当天的安排。

colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把桌上的纸收起来了？马克：我收的。我把它们全放进这个文件夹了。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牙买加，加勒比地区的岛屿及国家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet spread made by boiling fruit with sugar; also a blockage or congestion that prevents smooth movement.

堵塞；拥堵，指通道、交通或运转受阻。

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收集或积攒钱款、物品，尤其用于钱款或可收藏的物品。

sense_translations.en_definition: to collect (used especially for money or collectable items)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 收集；积攒；募集，尤指钱款或可收藏的物品。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燃烧或灼热发红，通常形容煤炭或类似燃料受热燃烧的状态。

collocations.en: glowed with heat in the hearth

formal.mt: Il-faħam ġammar fil-fuklar u baqa' jagħti s-sħana għal diversi sigħat.
formal.en: The charcoal glowed in the hearth and continued to give off heat for several hours.
formal.zh: 木炭在炉膛里灼热发红，并持续散热数小时。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-faħam ġammar sew? Pawlu: Iva, għadu aħmar u jaħraq ħafna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did the charcoal get properly glowing? Pawlu: Yes, it's still red and very hot.
colloquial.zh: 马克：木炭烧得够红了吗？保罗：是的，现在还红着，烫得很。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 木炭烧得够红了吗？
messages.en: Did the charcoal get properly glowing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu aħmar u jaħraq ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu aħmar u jaħraq ħafna.
messages.zh: 是的，现在还红着，烫得很。
messages.en: Yes, it's still red and very hot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ġammar 就想象炉中发红发热的木炭；把“红、热、燃烧”三个视觉提示一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling an acorn in shape; also describing fruit that is not yet ripe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状像橡子的；也用于形容尚未成熟的果实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah ġandra fil-forma; ukoll jingħad għal frott li għadu mhux misjur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橡子状的；外形像橡子的。
未成熟的；尚未熟透的，尤指果实。

formal.mt: Il-frott għadu ġandri u għandu jitħalla fuq is-siġra sakemm isir.
formal.en: The fruit is still unripe and should be left on the tree until it ripens.
formal.zh: 果实尚未成熟，应留在树上，直到成熟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan l-oġġett huwa deskritt bħala ġandri? Mark: Għax il-forma tiegħu tixbah ġandra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this object described as acornlike? Mark: Because its shape resembles an acorn.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么说这个物体是橡子状的？马克：因为它的形状像橡子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan l-oġġett huwa deskritt bħala ġandri?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan l-oġġett huwa deskritt bħala ġandri?
messages.zh: 为什么说这个物体是橡子状的？
messages.en: Why is this object described as acornlike?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 因为它的形状像橡子。
messages.en: Because its shape resembles an acorn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ġandri 画两张学习图：一张突出橡子的外形，一张画树上未熟的果实，分别记“形状”和“成熟程度”两个义项。

gloss_zh: 连接；组装；零星收集；连接者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join separate things together, assemble parts, or gather things piece by piece.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把分开的东西连接起来、把部件组装起来，或一点一点地收集东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad affarijiet separati, jiġbor partijiet flimkien, jew jiġbor affarijiet ftit ftit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把分开的东西连接在一起。
把各个部件组装或集合起来。
零零星星地收集；一点一点地凑齐。
把分开的东西连接在一起的人；连接者。

collocations.en: collected the pieces bit by bit

formal.mt: L-artiġjan ġannat il-partijiet tal-injam biex jifforma qafas wieħed.
formal.en: The craftsperson joined the wooden parts together to form a single frame.
formal.zh: 工匠把木制部件连接起来，做成一个完整的框架。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ġannat dawn il-biċċiet kollha? Mark: Missieri. Ġabarhom ftit ftit u għaqqadhom flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who put all these pieces together? Mark: My father. He collected them bit by bit and joined them together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把这些碎片全都拼到一起的？Mark：我爸爸。他一点一点地收集，再把它们拼起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把这些碎片全都拼到一起的？
messages.en: Who put all these pieces together?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri. Ġabarhom ftit ftit u għaqqadhom flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri. Ġabarhom ftit ftit u għaqqadhom flimkien.
messages.zh: 我爸爸。他一点一点地收集，再把它们拼起来。
messages.en: My father. He collected them bit by bit and joined them together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把散落的拼图片逐块收齐再拼合，用这个画面串起连接、组装和零星收集三个动词义；名词义则指做连接工作的人。

gloss_zh: 有连接能力的；善于把东西结合起来的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the ability to join separate things together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有把分开的东西连接或结合起来的能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jgħaqqad affarijiet separati flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有连接、结合或使事物相连的能力的。

collocations.en: a person able to join things together
collocations.zh: 有能力把东西连接起来的人

collocations.en: a craftsperson skilled at joining things together

formal.mt: L-artiġjan huwa ġannati: għandu l-ħila jgħaqqad partijiet separati f'oġġett wieħed.
formal.en: The craftsperson is skilled at joining: he can combine separate parts into a single object.
formal.zh: 这位工匠善于连接部件：他能把分开的部件结合成一个完整的物件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu huwa ġannati? Nina: Iva, jaf jgħaqqad dawn il-biċċiet kollha biex jagħmel mudell wieħed.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Pawlu good at joining things together? Nina: Yes, he knows how to combine all these pieces to make one model.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu善于把东西连接起来吗？Nina：是的，他知道怎样把这些零件全都组合成一个模型。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: Pawlu善于把东西连接起来吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu good at joining things together?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jaf jgħaqqad dawn il-biċċiet kollha biex jagħmel mudell wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jaf jgħaqqad dawn il-biċċiet kollha biex jagħmel mudell wieħed.
messages.zh: 是的，他知道怎样把这些零件全都组合成一个模型。
messages.en: Yes, he knows how to combine all these pieces to make one model.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词放在工匠身旁来记：眼前的人有本领把散开的零件接成整体，重点是连接的能力。

gloss_zh: 蛀出许多孔洞；切除；拔取

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make many holes in something, especially through insect damage; also to cut off or pluck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物布满孔洞，尤指昆虫蛀蚀；也可表示切除或拔取。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħafna toqob f'xi ħaġa, speċjalment meta jkun insett li jiekol minnha; ukoll jaqta' jew jaqla' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to riddle with holes (used especially of insects)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使布满孔洞；尤指昆虫把东西蛀得千疮百孔。
切掉；割除。
拔取；揪下；摘取。

formal.mt: Id-dud ġarad l-injam tal-armarju u ħalla ħafna toqob żgħar fil-wiċċ tiegħu.
formal.en: The insects riddled the cupboard's wood with holes, leaving many small openings in its surface.
formal.zh: 虫子把柜子的木材蛀出了许多孔洞，在表面留下密密的小孔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm daqshekk toqob f'dan l-injam? Toni: Id-dud ġarad l-injam. Ara kemm sar dgħajjef.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there so many holes in this wood? Toni: Insects have riddled the wood with holes. Look how weak it has become.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这块木头怎么有这么多洞？Toni：虫子把木头蛀坏了。你看，它已经变得多不结实了。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm daqshekk toqob f'dan l-injam?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm daqshekk toqob f'dan l-injam?
messages.zh: 这块木头怎么有这么多洞？
messages.en: Why are there so many holes in this wood?

messages.speaker: Toni (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dud ġarad l-injam. Ara kemm sar dgħajjef.
messages.mt_standard: Id-dud ġarad l-injam. Ara kemm sar dgħajjef.
messages.zh: 虫子把木头蛀坏了。你看，它已经变得多不结实了。
messages.en: Insects have riddled the wood with holes. Look how weak it has become.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用虫蛀木板上密密的小孔记住主要义，再把切除和拔取作为另外两个动作分别记忆，避免混成同一个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To demolish a structure or cause something standing to topple down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拆毁建筑或构筑物，或使原本站立的东西倒下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwaqqa' bini jew xi ħaġa oħra li tkun wieqfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆毁；拆除建筑或构筑物。
把某物推倒；使某物倾倒或倒塌。

formal.mt: Il-kuntrattur ġaraf il-bini l-qadim wara li ż-żona ġiet magħluqa għall-pubbliku.
formal.en: The contractor demolished the old building after the area had been closed to the public.
formal.zh: 该区域停止对公众开放后，承包商拆除了那栋旧建筑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara lill-ħajt tal-ġnien? Mark: Ir-riħ ġaraf il-ħajt matul il-lejl.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened to the garden wall? Mark: The wind knocked the wall down during the night.
colloquial.zh: Sara：花园的墙怎么了？Mark：夜里风把墙吹倒了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 花园的墙怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the garden wall?

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.zh: 夜里风把墙吹倒了。
messages.en: The wind knocked the wall down during the night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放一堵直立的墙轰然倒下的画面：人为拆毁和外力使它倾倒，都围绕使原物倒下这一动作来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bell: an instrument that produces a ringing sound when struck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到敲击时发出清脆鸣响的铃或钟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument li joħroġ ħoss meta jintlaqat, bħal qanpiena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铃；钟；通过敲击发声的打击乐器或器具。

formal.mt: Il-mużiċist daqq il-ġaras darba biex jagħti s-sinjal tal-bidu.
formal.en: The musician rang the bell once to signal the beginning.
formal.zh: 乐手敲了一下铃，发出开始的信号。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt il-ġaras? Pawlu: Iva, daqq darba. Issa nibdew il-logħba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear the bell? Pawlu: Yes, it rang once. Now we start the game.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你听见铃声了吗？Pawlu：听见了，响了一下。现在我们开始游戏。

messages.speaker: Lara (游戏伙伴)
messages.zh: 你听见铃声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the bell?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (游戏伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, daqq darba. Issa nibdew il-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, daqq darba. Issa nibdew il-logħba.
messages.zh: 听见了，响了一下。现在我们开始游戏。
messages.en: Yes, it rang once. Now we start the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师敲一下小铃，清脆声音提醒大家开始；把词和铃的实物绑定，铃声则用带有声音一词的搭配表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Experience gained through doing or undergoing something; also a trial or a fitting of clothing at a tailor's.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 亲自做过或经历某事而获得的经验；也指试验，或在裁缝处试穿衣服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Esperjenza miksuba billi wieħed jagħmel jew jgħaddi minn xi ħaġa; ukoll prova jew prova ta' ħwejjeġ għand ħajjat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经验；亲身经历。
试验；尝试；试用。

sense_translations.en_definition: trying on of clothing (at a tailor's)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在裁缝处试穿衣服，以检查尺寸和合身程度。

collocations.en: a fitting of the dress or suit

formal.mt: Il-ġarb tal-libsa se jsir għand il-ħajjat nhar il-Ħamis, biex jiġu ċċekkjati t-tul u l-qies.
formal.en: The fitting will take place at the tailor's on Thursday to check the garment's length and size.
formal.zh: 周四将在裁缝处试穿这件衣服，检查衣长和尺寸。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Meta għandi niġi għall-ġarb tal-libsa? Toni: Ejja l-Ħamis, biex naraw jekk it-tul huwiex tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Anna: When should I come for the fitting? Toni: Come on Thursday so we can see whether the length is right.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我什么时候来试穿衣服？Toni：周四来吧，我们看看衣长是否合适。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 我什么时候来试穿衣服？
messages.en: When should I come for the fitting?

messages.speaker: Toni (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja l-Ħamis, biex naraw jekk it-tul huwiex tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja l-Ħamis, biex naraw jekk it-tul huwiex tajjeb.
messages.zh: 周四来吧，我们看看衣长是否合适。
messages.en: Come on Thursday so we can see whether the length is right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用亲身试过的三个学习画面记忆：经历生活获得经验、试一试做试验、到裁缝处试衣服；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gnaw at something, gradually wearing it away by repeated biting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复啃咬某物，使它逐渐磨损或被咬去一部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiekol jew inaqqar xi ħaġa bis-snien ftit ftit, b'gdim ripetut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不断啃咬某物，逐渐把它啃掉或啃损。

formal.mt: Il-ġurdien ġardam il-kaxxa tal-kartun u ħalla marki tas-snien mat-truf.
formal.en: The mouse gnawed at the cardboard box and left tooth marks along the edges.
formal.zh: 老鼠不断啃咬纸板箱，在边缘留下了齿痕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għamel dawn il-marki fuq il-kaxxa? Mark: Il-ġurdien ġardam il-kaxxa matul il-lejl.
colloquial.en: Maja: What made these marks on the box? Mark: The mouse gnawed at the box during the night.
colloquial.zh: Maja：箱子上的这些痕迹是什么弄出来的？Mark：老鼠夜里啃了箱子。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għamel dawn il-marki fuq il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Min għamel dawn il-marki fuq il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 箱子上的这些痕迹是什么弄出来的？
messages.en: What made these marks on the box?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 老鼠夜里啃了箱子。
messages.en: The mouse gnawed at the box during the night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老鼠贴着箱角一口一口地啃，纸板慢慢缺了一块；抓住反复小口啃咬、逐渐损耗的动作特点。

gloss_zh: 会考验人或事物的；把人或事物置于考验中的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who puts a person or thing to the test.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容会检验、考验某人或某物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqiegħed lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa għall-prova.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. that puts someone or sth. to th test
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容把某人或某物置于考验之中、检验其能力或表现的人。

collocations.en: a teacher who puts learners to the test
a coach who puts people to the test

formal.mt: L-għalliem ġarrabi ta lill-istudenti problema ġdida biex jara kif japplikaw dak li tgħallmu.
formal.en: The teacher who puts learners to the test gave the students a new problem to see how they would apply what they had learned.
formal.zh: 这位善于考验学生的教师给学生出了一道新题，观察他们如何运用所学知识。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kowċ il-ġdid huwa ġarrabi? Pawlu: Iva, jagħtina sfidi ġodda biex jara x'nafu nagħmlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does the new coach put people to the test? Pawlu: Yes, he gives us new challenges to see what we can do.
colloquial.zh: Lara：新教练会考验队员吗？Pawlu：会，他给我们新的挑战，看看我们能做到什么。

messages.speaker: Lara (队员)
messages.zh: 新教练会考验队员吗？
messages.en: Does the new coach put people to the test?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jagħtina sfidi ġodda biex jara x'nafu nagħmlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jagħtina sfidi ġodda biex jara x'nafu nagħmlu.
messages.zh: 会，他给我们新的挑战，看看我们能做到什么。
messages.en: Yes, he gives us new challenges to see what we can do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词贴在不断出挑战的教练身上：他主动考验别人。记住它描述的是施加考验的人及其特点。

gloss_zh: 打得千疮百孔；拔除；啃咬之物

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make many holes in something, leaving it full of small openings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某物上弄出许多孔洞，使其变得千疮百孔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel ħafna toqob f'xi ħaġa, hekk li ssir mimlija toqob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使布满孔洞；把某物打得千疮百孔。
拔；摘；将某物拔下或扯下。
啃咬或啮蚀东西之物。

collocations.en: riddled the metal sheet with holes
collocations.zh: 把金属薄板打得满是孔洞

formal.mt: Matul il-prova, it-tekniku ġarrad il-folja tal-metall b'għodda speċjali.
formal.en: During the test, the technician riddled the metal sheet with holes using a special tool.
formal.zh: 在测试过程中，技术人员用专用工具在金属薄板上打出了许多孔洞。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min ġarrad din il-biċċa njam? Rita: Jien, biex nara kif taħdem l-għodda l-ġdida.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who made all these holes in this piece of wood? Rita: I did, to see how the new tool works.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁把这块木头弄得满是孔洞？丽塔：我弄的，想看看新工具怎么用。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把这块木头弄得满是孔洞？
messages.en: Who made all these holes in this piece of wood?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, biex nara kif taħdem l-għodda l-ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, biex nara kif taħdem l-għodda l-ġdida.
messages.zh: 我弄的，想看看新工具怎么用。
messages.en: I did, to see how the new tool works.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġarrad 和一块满是小洞的木板放在同一张记忆卡上；另把“拔除”和名词“啃咬之物”分栏记，避免混淆词性。

gloss_zh: 爱啃咬的；有啮咬倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to gnaw or repeatedly bite at things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有啃咬东西的倾向，常反复咬啮物体的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jigdem u jiekol ftit ftit minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有啃咬倾向的；爱咬啮东西的。

collocations.en: a mouse that tends to gnaw

formal.mt: Annimal ġarradi jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-injam u lill-kejbils.
formal.en: An animal prone to gnawing can damage wood and cables.
formal.zh: 有啃咬习性的动物可能损坏木材和电缆。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ġurdien ġarradi ħafna! Pawlu: Iva, diġà gidem il-kantuniera tal-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Lara: This mouse really likes gnawing! Pawlu: Yes, it has already gnawed the corner of the box.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这只老鼠真爱啃东西！保罗：是啊，它已经把箱子的一角啃了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这只老鼠真爱啃东西！
messages.en: This mouse really likes gnawing!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 是啊，它已经把箱子的一角啃了。
messages.en: Yes, it has already gnawed the corner of the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 ġarradi，就想象老鼠不停啃箱角；它描述“爱啃咬的”性质，学习时要和表示动作的动词分开。

gloss_zh: 使物体倒塌的；能使东西倾倒的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing things to fall over or collapse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会使物体翻倒、倾倒或倒塌的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel l-affarijiet jaqgħu jew jiġġarrfu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使东西倾倒或倒塌的。

collocations.en: an effect that causes things to topple

formal.mt: Ir-riħ ġarrafi waqqa' diversi siġar u għamel ħsara lill-bini.
formal.en: The toppling wind brought down several trees and damaged buildings.
formal.zh: 这股能使物体倾倒的强风吹倒了几棵树，并损坏了建筑物。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan riħ ġarrafi; il-qsari qed jaqgħu! Toni: Ejja ndaħħluhom ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Nina: This wind is knocking things over; the plant pots are falling! Toni: Let's bring them inside.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这风能把东西吹倒，花盆都在往下掉！托尼：我们把它们搬进去吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan riħ ġarrafi; il-qsari qed jaqgħu!
messages.mt_standard: Dan riħ ġarrafi; il-qsari qed jaqgħu!
messages.zh: 这风能把东西吹倒，花盆都在往下掉！
messages.en: This wind is knocking things over; the plant pots are falling!

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.zh: 我们把它们搬进去吧。
messages.en: Let's bring them inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“大风把花盆吹倒”的画面记 ġarrafi：重点是造成倾倒的力量，不是已经倒下的状态。

gloss_zh: 搬运；挪动；搬家；搬运者；脚夫

teaching_sense.en_definition: To carry something from one place to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物从一个地方搬到另一个地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġorr xi ħaġa minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搬运或携带某物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to shift the position of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挪动某物；改变某物的位置。
搬家；迁居。
搬东西的人；搬运者。
搬运工；替人搬运行李或货物的脚夫。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ġarrar il-kaxxi mill-maħżen sal-vann.
formal.en: The worker carried the boxes from the storeroom to the van.
formal.zh: 工人把箱子从储藏室搬到了货车旁。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min ġarrar il-mejda sal-kċina? David: Ħija; jien għentu biss bil-kaxxi.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who moved the table to the kitchen? David: My brother; I only helped him with the boxes.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：谁把桌子搬到厨房的？戴维：我哥哥；我只是帮他搬了箱子。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把桌子搬到厨房的？
messages.en: Who moved the table to the kitchen?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥；我只是帮他搬了箱子。
messages.en: My brother; I only helped him with the boxes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġarrar 放进搬家画面：搬箱子、挪家具、换住所；遇到名词用法，再把注意力转向负责搬东西的人。

gloss_zh: 珠宝；宝石；珍贵之物；瑰宝

teaching_sense.en_definition: Jewellery, precious stones, and valuable ornaments worn or kept for their beauty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因美观和价值而佩戴或收藏的珠宝、宝石及贵重饰物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġojjelli, ħaġar prezzjuż u ornamenti ta' valur li jintlibsu jew jinżammu għas-sbuħija tagħhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: jewellery, jewels or precious stones and ornaments
sense_translations.zh_definition: 珠宝、宝石及贵重装饰品。

sense_translations.en_definition: anything precious, a jewel, treasure (e.g. historical, natural)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 任何珍贵之物；瑰宝、珍宝，如历史或自然瑰宝。

formal.mt: Il-mużew qed juri ġawhar antik flimkien ma' dokumenti dwar is-sidien tiegħu.
formal.en: The museum is displaying antique jewellery together with documents about its owners.
formal.zh: 博物馆正在展出古老珠宝，以及介绍其主人的文献。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn poġġejt il-ġawhar tan-nanna? Ben: Fil-kaxxa ż-żgħira, ħdejn il-mera.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did you put Grandma's jewellery? Ben: In the small box, next to the mirror.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你把奶奶的珠宝放哪儿了？本：放在镜子旁边的小盒子里了。

messages.speaker: Anna (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你把奶奶的珠宝放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put Grandma's jewellery?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.zh: 放在镜子旁边的小盒子里了。
messages.en: In the small box, next to the mirror.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用珠宝盒记住 ġawhar 的实物义，再把同样珍惜的古迹和自然景观想成“瑰宝”，连接它的比喻义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel hungry and need or want food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到肚子饿，产生需要或想要进食的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss il-ġuħ u l-ħtieġa jew ix-xewqa li jiekol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到饥饿；肚子饿。

formal.mt: Wara diversi sigħat mingħajr ikel, it-tifel ġaħ u talab xi ħaġa x'jiekol.
formal.en: After several hours without food, the boy felt hungry and asked for something to eat.
formal.zh: 几个小时没有进食后，男孩感到饿了，便要了些东西吃。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark kiel daqshekk kmieni? Pawlu: Ġaħ wara l-mixja u ma riedx jistenna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark eat so early? Pawlu: He felt hungry after the walk and didn't want to wait.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么那么早就吃东西了？保罗：他走完路后饿了，不想再等。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么那么早就吃东西了？
messages.en: Why did Mark eat so early?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġaħ wara l-mixja u ma riedx jistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Ġaħ wara l-mixja u ma riedx jistenna.
messages.zh: 他走完路后饿了，不想再等。
messages.en: He felt hungry after the walk and didn't want to wait.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ġaħ 时配上摸肚子的动作，把这个短词和“走完路，肚子饿了”的情境一起记住。

gloss_zh: 贾汉（马耳他民间故事中的机智愚人）；傻瓜

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ġaħan is a character in Maltese folktales who combines foolish behaviour with unexpected wisdom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贾汉是马耳他民间故事中的人物，常表现得愚笨，却又流露出出人意料的智慧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġaħan huwa karattru fil-ħrejjef Maltin li jgħaqqad l-imġiba ta' iblah ma' għerf mhux mistenni.

sense_translations.en_definition: A character in Maltese folktales, a “wise fool”, equivalent to the Arabic Joha, Ladino Djoha and Sicilian Giufà, similar also to the Turko-Persian Molla Nasreddin, the Jewish Hershel of Ostropol, the German Till Eulenspiegel, etc.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他民间故事中的人物，是一位“机智的愚人”，对应阿拉伯故事中的 Joha、拉迪诺语故事中的 Djoha 和西西里故事中的 Giufà，也类似突厥—波斯传统中的 Molla Nasreddin、犹太故事中的 Hershel of Ostropol、德国故事中的 Till Eulenspiegel 等。
傻瓜；愚笨的人。

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, l-istudenti jaqraw ħrafa dwar Ġaħan u jiddiskutu r-rabta bejn il-bluha u l-għerf.
formal.en: In this lesson, the students read a folktale about Ġaħan and discuss the relationship between foolishness and wisdom.
formal.zh: 在这节课上，学生阅读一则关于贾汉的民间故事，并讨论愚笨与智慧之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf xi ħrafa dwar Ġaħan? Mark: Iva, naf waħda li tidħak ħafna biha. Trid nirrakkontahielek?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know any folktales about Ġaħan? Mark: Yes, I know one that really makes you laugh. Shall I tell it to you?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你知道关于贾汉的民间故事吗？Mark：知道，我知道一个特别好笑的。要我讲给你听吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你知道关于贾汉的民间故事吗？
messages.en: Do you know any folktales about Ġaħan?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naf waħda li tidħak ħafna biha. Trid nirrakkontahielek?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naf waħda li tidħak ħafna biha. Trid nirrakkontahielek?
messages.zh: 知道，我知道一个特别好笑的。要我讲给你听吗？
messages.en: Yes, I know one that really makes you laugh. Shall I tell it to you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ġaħan 记成故事里“看似傻、偶有妙计”的人物；大写形式先联想到人名，小写名词义则记作“傻瓜”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who barely earns enough to make a living.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收入仅够勉强维持生活的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li bilkemm taqla' biżżejjed biex tgħix.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who barely makes a living (with
sense_translations.zh_definition: 勉强维持生计的人。

collocations.en: the life of someone barely making a living
collocations.zh: 勉强维持生计者的生活

collocations.en: a person barely making a living who is looking for work
collocations.zh: 正在找工作、勉强糊口的人

formal.mt: Il-karattru ewlieni tar-rakkont huwa ġaħġieħ li jaħdem kuljum iżda bilkemm jaqla' biżżejjed biex jgħix.
formal.en: The story's main character is a person who works every day but barely earns enough to live on.
formal.zh: 这篇故事的主人公每天都工作，收入却只够勉强糊口。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser ġaħġieħ? Pawlu: Xi ħadd li bilkemm jaqla' biżżejjed biex jgħix.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does ġaħġieħ mean? Pawlu: Someone who barely earns enough to live on.
colloquial.zh: Lara：ġaħġieħ 是什么意思？Pawlu：指收入只够勉强维持生活的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: ġaħġieħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ġaħġieħ mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd li bilkemm jaqla' biżżejjed biex jgħix.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd li bilkemm jaqla' biżżejjed biex jgħix.
messages.zh: 指收入只够勉强维持生活的人。
messages.en: Someone who barely earns enough to live on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġaħġieħ 配上一幅“每天数零钱、刚够生活”的人物图，先牢牢记住它指人；再与表示勉强完成某事的 ġaħġiħ 对照。

gloss_zh: 平平地做事；勉强应付或过关

teaching_sense.en_definition: Doing something without excelling, or managing to get through it only just.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做某事时表现平平，或只是勉强完成、勉强过关的情形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twettiq ta' xi ħaġa mingħajr ma wieħed jispikka, jew il-fatt li wieħed jgħaddi minnha bilkemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做某事但表现平平，未达到出色的程度。
勉强完成某事；勉强过关。

collocations.en: getting by in one's studies without excelling
getting by at work without excelling
collocations.zh: 工作上表现平平、勉强应付

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-kelma ġaħġiħ tiddeskrivi xogħol li jitwettaq mingħajr livell ta' eċċellenza.
formal.en: In the report, the word ġaħġiħ describes work that is carried out without achieving excellence.
formal.zh: 在这份报告中，ġaħġiħ 一词用来描述虽然完成、却未达到出色水平的工作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ġaħġiħ ifisser li għamilt xi ħaġa tajjeb ħafna? Toni: Le, ifisser li ma spikkajtx, jew li għaddejt bilkemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does ġaħġiħ mean that you did something really well? Toni: No, it means that you did not excel, or that you only just scraped through.
colloquial.zh: Nina：ġaħġiħ 是说某件事做得特别好吗？Toni：不是，是说表现不突出，或者只是勉强过关。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġaħġiħ ifisser li għamilt xi ħaġa tajjeb ħafna?
messages.mt_standard: Ġaħġiħ ifisser li għamilt xi ħaġa tajjeb ħafna?
messages.zh: ġaħġiħ 是说某件事做得特别好吗？
messages.en: Does ġaħġiħ mean that you did something really well?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ifisser li ma spikkajtx, jew li għaddejt bilkemm.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ifisser li ma spikkajtx, jew li għaddejt bilkemm.
messages.zh: 不是，是说表现不突出，或者只是勉强过关。
messages.en: No, it means that you did not excel, or that you only just scraped through.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“刚跨过及格线”的画面记 ġaħġiħ：事情勉强做成，却谈不上出色。注意它表示做事的情形，与指糊口者的 ġaħġieħ 分开记。

gloss_zh: 拉动；吸引；偏向；拉伸；倾向；猛拉

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of pulling something towards oneself or in a particular direction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物向自己或某个方向拉动的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tiġbed xi ħaġa lejk jew f'direzzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉；拉动的动作。
吸引；吸引力。
偏向；偏袒；不中立的倾向。
拉伸；伸展。
倾向；趋向。
用力的一拉；猛拉一下。

formal.mt: Il-ġbid tal-ħabel għandu jsir bil-mod biex it-tagħbija tibqa' stabbli.
formal.en: The rope should be pulled slowly so that the load remains stable.
formal.zh: 拉绳时应缓慢用力，以保持负载稳定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħassejt ġbid fil-ħabel? Ġanni: Iva, hemm xi ħaġa tqila fit-tarf l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you feel a tug on the rope? Ġanni: Yes, there's something heavy at the other end.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你感觉到绳子被拉了一下吗？詹尼：感觉到了，另一头有个重东西。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你感觉到绳子被拉了一下吗？
messages.en: Did you feel a tug on the rope?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm xi ħaġa tqila fit-tarf l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm xi ħaġa tqila fit-tarf l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 感觉到了，另一头有个重东西。
messages.en: Yes, there's something heavy at the other end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 以“被拉向某个方向”串联 ġbid：绳子被拉、肌肉被伸展、注意力被吸引、判断出现偏向。这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of gathering things, money, or information together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品、款项或信息集中起来的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li tiġbor flimkien affarijiet, flus jew informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收集；募集；把事物集中起来。
汇编；把资料搜集并编排在一起。

formal.mt: Il-ġbir ta' informazzjoni għall-istudju se jibda x-xahar id-dieħel.
formal.en: The collection of information for the study will begin next month.
formal.zh: 这项研究的信息收集工作将于下个月开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer il-ġbir ta' fondi? Mark: Tajjeb! Diġà għandna biżżejjed flus għall-kotba.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is the fundraising going? Mark: Well! We already have enough money for the books.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：筹款进行得怎么样？马克：很顺利！我们已经筹到足够买书的钱了。

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者)
messages.zh: 筹款进行得怎么样？
messages.en: How is the fundraising going?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Diġà għandna biżżejjed flus għall-kotba.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Diġà għandna biżżejjed flus għall-kotba.
messages.zh: 很顺利！我们已经筹到足够买书的钱了。
messages.en: Well! We already have enough money for the books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一群人把钱、文件和信息集中到桌上的画面记 ġbir；搭配 fondi 记筹款，搭配 informazzjoni 记信息收集。

gloss_zh: 收集品；汇集的一组事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A collection of things brought together as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收集或汇集在一起、构成一组的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' affarijiet miġbura flimkien bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收集品；汇集在一起的一组事物。

formal.mt: Il-librerija rċeviet ġbira ta' ittri antiki mingħand familja lokali.
formal.en: The library received a collection of old letters from a local family.
formal.zh: 图书馆收到了一户当地家庭赠送的一批旧信件。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'hemm f'din il-kaxxa? Luqa: Ġbira ta' ritratti tal-familja. Trid tarahom?
colloquial.en: Elena: What's in this box? Luqa: A collection of family photographs. Would you like to see them?
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：这个盒子里有什么？卢卡：一批家庭照片。你想看看吗？

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个盒子里有什么？
messages.en: What's in this box?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġbira ta' ritratti tal-familja. Trid tarahom?
messages.mt_standard: Ġbira ta' ritratti tal-familja. Trid tarahom?
messages.zh: 一批家庭照片。你想看看吗？
messages.en: A collection of family photographs. Would you like to see them?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġbira 想成盒子里已经放在一起的一批照片，再用 ġbira ta' ritratti 整块记忆，抓住“汇集成组”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dirt or filth; in a separate disease sense, leprosy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指脏东西、污垢或污秽；另有独立的疾病义，指麻风病，须根据上下文区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħmieġ jew ħmieġ kbir; f'tifsira oħra, il-marda magħrufa bħala lebbra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污垢；附着在物体表面的脏东西。
污秽；令人厌恶的脏污。
麻风病；此处为疾病名称。

formal.mt: Qabel iż-żebgħa, għandu jitneħħa l-ġdiem kollu minn fuq il-wiċċ.
formal.en: Before painting, all dirt must be removed from the surface.
formal.zh: 上漆前，必须清除表面的全部污垢。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għad hemm il-ġdiem fuq il-mejda? Pawlu: Iva, se nneħħih b'ċarruta.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is there still dirt on the table? Pawlu: Yes, I'll remove it with a cloth.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：桌上还有污垢吗？保罗：有，我用抹布擦掉。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 桌上还有污垢吗？
messages.en: Is there still dirt on the table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 有，我用抹布擦掉。
messages.en: Yes, I'll remove it with a cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成两张语境卡：清洁场景对应污垢，疾病场景对应麻风病；不要把两个义项混成一种解释。

gloss_zh: 蔬菜残桩；尤指卷心菜或芜菁的残留硬茎

teaching_sense.en_definition: The stump of a vegetable, especially the remaining firm base of a cabbage or turnip.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蔬菜切除其他部分后留下的残桩或硬茎基部，尤指卷心菜或芜菁的这类部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti iebsa li tibqa' minn ħaxixa, speċjalment minn kaboċċa jew ġidra, wara li jitneħħew il-partijiet l-oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: the stump of a vegetable (especially a cabbage or turnip)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蔬菜的残桩或残留硬茎，尤指卷心菜或芜菁的这类部分。

formal.mt: Neħħi l-ġdura tal-kaboċċa qabel ma tqatta' l-weraq f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: Remove the cabbage stump before cutting the leaves into small pieces.
formal.zh: 先去除卷心菜的硬茎残桩，再把菜叶切成小块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Inħalli l-ġdura tal-kaboċċa hawn? Toni: Iva, warrabha u poġġi l-weraq fl-iskutella.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall I leave the cabbage stump here? Toni: Yes, set it aside and put the leaves in the bowl.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：卷心菜的硬茎就放这里吗？托尼：对，先放到一边，把菜叶放进碗里。

messages.speaker: Lara (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 卷心菜的硬茎就放这里吗？
messages.en: Shall I leave the cabbage stump here?

messages.speaker: Toni (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, warrabha u poġġi l-weraq fl-iskutella.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, warrabha u poġġi l-weraq fl-iskutella.
messages.zh: 对，先放到一边，把菜叶放进碗里。
messages.en: Yes, set it aside and put the leaves in the bowl.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象剥去卷心菜菜叶后，砧板上剩下一截硬硬的菜桩；用这个厨房画面记住词义。

gloss_zh: 使变得多石或石质化；使产生钙沉积

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something stony, or to cause calcium deposits, especially in the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变得多石、呈石质或像石头一样；也指使产生钙沉积，尤其用于身体内部的沉积。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa ġeblija jew bħal ġebel; ukoll jikkawża depożiti tal-kalċju, speċjalment fil-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变得多石、呈石质或像石头一样。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause calcium deposits (especially in the body)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使产生钙沉积，尤其指在身体内形成钙沉积。

collocations.zh: 使表面变得像石头一样

collocations.en: caused calcium deposits in the tissue

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-verb 'ġebbel' jiddeskrivi proċess li kkawża depożiti tal-kalċju fit-tessut.
formal.en: In the report, the verb 'ġebbel' describes a process that caused calcium deposits in the tissue.
formal.zh: 报告中的动词 ġebbel 描述了一个使组织产生钙沉积的过程。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamel dan il-kisi lill-wiċċ? Mark: Ġebbel il-wiċċ; issa hu iebes bħall-ġebel.
