colloquial.en: Nina: What did this coating do to the surface? Mark: It made the surface stony; now it's hard like stone.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这层涂料让表面发生了什么变化？马克：它让表面变得像石头一样，现在摸起来很硬。

messages.speaker: Nina (手工作坊学员)
messages.zh: 这层涂料让表面发生了什么变化？
messages.en: What did this coating do to the surface?

messages.speaker: Mark (手工作坊教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġebbel il-wiċċ; issa hu iebes bħall-ġebel.
messages.mt_standard: Ġebbel il-wiċċ; issa hu iebes bħall-ġebel.
messages.zh: 它让表面变得像石头一样，现在摸起来很硬。
messages.en: It made the surface stony; now it's hard like stone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“使……发生变化”记住动词身份：材料语境是使其石质化，身体语境是使其产生钙沉积。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that pulls, such as a device used to draw or move another object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够牵拉其他物体的东西，例如用于拉动物件的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tiġbed, bħal apparat li jiġbed jew iċaqlaq oġġett ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起牵拉作用的东西；拉动物体的装置或物件。

formal.mt: Għal dan ix-xogħol, għandu jintuża ġebbied adattat għall-kejbil.
formal.en: For this task, a pulling device suitable for the cable must be used.
formal.zh: 这项作业应使用适合该电缆的牵引装置。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Fejn hu l-ġebbied tal-kejbils? Rita: Qiegħed fil-kaxxa tal-għodda, ħdejn it-tnalja.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Where's the cable puller? Rita: It's in the toolbox, next to the pliers.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：电缆牵引装置在哪里？丽塔：在工具箱里，钳子旁边。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (维修学徒)
messages.zh: 电缆牵引装置在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the cable puller?

messages.speaker: Rita (维修师傅)
messages.zh: 在工具箱里，钳子旁边。
messages.en: It's in the toolbox, next to the pliers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工具箱里有一件专门把东西拉过来的工具；这个词命名的是“拉东西的物件”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family lineage, or a group of people regarded as being of the same kind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指家族世系或血统，也可指被看作同一类的一群人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nisel jew linja ta' familja; ukoll nies meqjusa tal-istess xorta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家系、血统；或指同类、同一类人。

collocations.en: of the same lineage or ilk
collocations.zh: 属于同一家系或同一类

formal.mt: Ir-reġistri tal-familja juru li ż-żewġ fergħat huma tal-istess ġebbieda.
formal.en: The family records show that the two branches belong to the same lineage.
formal.zh: 家族记录显示，这两个分支属于同一家系。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dawn iż-żewġ familji huma tal-istess ġebbieda? Ġanni: Iva, għandhom antenat komuni.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are these two families of the same lineage? Ġanni: Yes, they have a common ancestor.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这两个家族出自同一家系吗？詹尼：是的，他们有共同的祖先。

messages.speaker: Marija (研究家谱的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn iż-żewġ familji huma tal-istess ġebbieda?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn iż-żewġ familji huma tal-istess ġebbieda?
messages.zh: 这两个家族出自同一家系吗？
messages.en: Are these two families of the same lineage?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (研究家谱的朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他们有共同的祖先。
messages.en: Yes, they have a common ancestor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一棵家谱树，把同一祖先的分支圈在一起，记住“同一家系”；再扩展到“同一类人”。

gloss_zh: 能牵拉的；具有拉动能力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the ability to pull or draw something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某物具备牵引或拉动其他物体的能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jiġbed xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有牵拉能力的；能够拉动其他物体的。

formal.mt: L-apparat ġebbiedi jintuża biex jiġbed il-kejbil minn ġol-pajp.
formal.en: The device with pulling capability is used to draw the cable through the pipe.
formal.zh: 这台具有牵引能力的装置用于把电缆拉过管道。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan l-apparat ġebbiedi jista' jiġbed il-kaxxa? Toni: Iva, imma l-ewwel irridu nwaħħlu l-ħabel sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can this pulling device pull the box? Toni: Yes, but first we need to attach the rope properly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个能牵拉的装置可以拉动箱子吗？托尼：可以，不过得先把绳子固定好。

messages.speaker: Sara (作坊学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-apparat ġebbiedi jista' jiġbed il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-apparat ġebbiedi jista' jiġbed il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 这个能牵拉的装置可以拉动箱子吗？
messages.en: Can this pulling device pull the box?

messages.speaker: Toni (作坊教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel irridu nwaħħlu l-ħabel sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel irridu nwaħħlu l-ħabel sew.
messages.zh: 可以，不过得先把绳子固定好。
messages.en: Yes, but first we need to attach the rope properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给装置贴一张“能拉动”的功能标签，记住这是描述能力的形容词；可与命名物件的 ġebbied 对照学习。

gloss_zh: 具有石化作用的；使物体变得像石头的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that turns something into stone or makes it stone-like.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容具有使某物石化或变得像石头一样的作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jagħmel xi ħaġa ġebel jew bħal ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有石化作用的；能使某物变为石头或呈现石头般性质的。

collocations.en: a process with a petrifying effect

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'ġebbieli' tiddeskrivi l-effett ta' proċess li jagħmel materjal bħal ġebel.
formal.en: The word 'ġebbieli' describes the effect of a process that makes a material stone-like.
formal.zh: ġebbieli 一词描述某种过程使材料变得像石头一样的作用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġifieri 'effett ġebbieli'? Mark: Jiġifieri effett li jagħmel xi ħaġa bħal ġebel.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'effett ġebbieli' mean? Mark: It means an effect that makes something stone-like.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：effett ġebbieli 是什么意思？马克：意思是使某物变得像石头一样的作用。

messages.speaker: Lara (马耳他语学生)
messages.zh: effett ġebbieli 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'effett ġebbieli' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (马耳他语教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri effett li jagħmel xi ħaġa bħal ġebel.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri effett li jagħmel xi ħaġa bħal ġebel.
messages.zh: 意思是使某物变得像石头一样的作用。
messages.en: It means an effect that makes something stone-like.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一件物品逐渐变成石头，把“具有这种作用的”作为形容词标签，连同 effett ġebbieli 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A worker who applies and smooths plaster on walls, ceilings, or other surfaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事抹灰或石膏施工的工人，负责在墙壁、天花板等表面涂抹并抹平灰泥或石膏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaddiem li jaħdem bil-ġibs biex jiksi u jillixxa ħitan, soqfa jew uċuħ oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抹灰工；在墙面、天花板等处进行灰泥或石膏施工的工人。

formal.mt: Il-ġebbies għandu jlesti l-ħitan u s-saqaf qabel ma jibda x-xogħol taż-żebgħa.
formal.en: The plasterer must finish the walls and ceiling before the painting work begins.
formal.zh: 抹灰工必须在油漆作业开始前完成墙壁和天花板的施工。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Meta ġej il-ġebbies biex isewwi s-saqaf? Pawlu: Għada filgħodu; se jara l-ħajt ukoll.
colloquial.en: Anna: When is the plasterer coming to repair the ceiling? Pawlu: Tomorrow morning; he'll look at the wall too.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：抹灰工什么时候来修天花板？保罗：明天上午，他也会看看墙面。

messages.speaker: Anna (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta ġej il-ġebbies biex isewwi s-saqaf?
messages.mt_standard: Meta ġej il-ġebbies biex isewwi s-saqaf?
messages.zh: 抹灰工什么时候来修天花板？
messages.en: When is the plasterer coming to repair the ceiling?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同住家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada filgħodu; se jara l-ħajt ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Għada filgħodu; se jara l-ħajt ukoll.
messages.zh: 明天上午，他也会看看墙面。
messages.en: Tomorrow morning; he'll look at the wall too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象装修现场一位拿着抹刀、把墙面抹平的师傅；用“做抹灰工作的人”记住这个职业名词。

gloss_zh: 有石膏般或白垩般光泽的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a surface sheen resembling that of plaster or chalk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面呈现类似石膏或白垩的光泽的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu leqq fuq il-wiċċ bħal dak tal-ġibs.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a plastery or chalky sheen
sense_translations.zh_definition: 带有石膏般或白垩般光泽的。

collocations.en: a surface with a chalky sheen

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-kampjun ġie deskritt bħala li għandu leqq ġebbiesi li jidher aħjar taħt dawl dirett.
formal.en: In the report, the sample was described as having a plaster-like sheen that is more visible under direct light.
formal.zh: 报告将该样本描述为带有石膏般的光泽，在直射光下更为明显。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-wiċċ jidher daqshekk abjad fid-dawl? Mark: Għandu leqq ġebbiesi; ifakkarni fil-ġibs.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does this surface look so white in the light? Mark: It has a chalky sheen; it reminds me of plaster.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个表面为什么在光下显得这么白？Mark：它带有白垩般的光泽，让我想到石膏。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-wiċċ jidher daqshekk abjad fid-dawl?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-wiċċ jidher daqshekk abjad fid-dawl?
messages.zh: 这个表面为什么在光下显得这么白？
messages.en: Why does this surface look so white in the light?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 它带有白垩般的光泽，让我想到石膏。
messages.en: It has a chalky sheen; it reminds me of plaster.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象灯光照在石膏表面，把 ġebbiesi 与这种白垩般的光泽联系起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing many stones or having a surface covered with stones.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有许多石头或表面布满石头的，常用来描述地面或地形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih ħafna ġebel jew li għandu wiċċ miksi bil-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多石的；布满石头的。

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija taqsam terren ġebli, għalhekk il-parteċipanti għandhom jilbsu żraben adattati għall-mixi.
formal.en: The path crosses stony terrain, so participants should wear suitable walking shoes.
formal.zh: 这条小路穿过多石地形，因此参与者应穿适合步行的鞋子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nistgħu ngħaddu bir-roti minn hawn? Pawlu: Dan it-terren huwa ġebli wisq; aħjar nimxu bir-roti maġenbna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can we cycle through here? Pawlu: This terrain is too stony; we'd better walk with our bikes beside us.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们能骑车从这里过去吗？Pawlu：这片地面石头太多了，我们最好推着车走。

messages.speaker: Sara (骑行伙伴)
messages.zh: 我们能骑车从这里过去吗？
messages.en: Can we cycle through here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (骑行伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-terren huwa ġebli wisq; aħjar nimxu bir-roti maġenbna.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-terren huwa ġebli wisq; aħjar nimxu bir-roti maġenbna.
messages.zh: 这片地面石头太多了，我们最好推着车走。
messages.en: This terrain is too stony; we'd better walk with our bikes beside us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġebli 放进徒步场景：脚下到处是石头，就用它描述这种多石的地面。

gloss_zh: 说不知所云的话；说无意义的话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak in a way that sounds like language but has no understandable meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说出听起来像语言、却没有可理解意义的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid kliem jew jagħmel ħsejjes qishom diskors, iżda mingħajr tifsira li tinftiehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说不知所云的话；说没有可理解意义的话。

collocations.zh: 没有作答，却说了些不知所云的话

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel ġebrex waqt il-logħba, u sħabu ppruvaw jagħtu tifsira lill-ħsejjes li għamel.
formal.en: In the story, the boy spoke gibberish during the game, and his friends tried to assign meaning to the sounds he made.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩在游戏时说了些不知所云的话，他的朋友们试着为那些声音赋予意义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qal Leo waqt il-logħba? Tom: Ġebrex biss; kien qed jagħmel ħsejjes bla sens biex idaħħakna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Leo say during the game? Tom: He just spoke gibberish; he was making meaningless sounds to make us laugh.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Leo 在游戏时说了什么？Tom：他只是说了些不知所云的话，发出没有意义的声音逗我们笑。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Leo 在游戏时说了什么？
messages.en: What did Leo say during the game?

messages.speaker: Tom (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġebrex biss; kien qed jagħmel ħsejjes bla sens biex idaħħakna.
messages.mt_standard: Ġebrex biss; kien qed jagħmel ħsejjes bla sens biex idaħħakna.
messages.zh: 他只是说了些不知所云的话，发出没有意义的声音逗我们笑。
messages.en: He just spoke gibberish; he was making meaningless sounds to make us laugh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象游戏中有人一本正经地发出无意义的声音，用这个画面记住 ġebrex 表示说不知所云的话。

gloss_zh: 翻新者；从事修缮翻新的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who renovates buildings or objects by repairing and renewing them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过修理、整修使建筑或物品焕然一新的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssewwi u ġġedded bini jew oġġetti biex jerġgħu jkunu f'kundizzjoni tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从事翻新或修缮的人。

formal.mt: Il-ġeddied tal-għamara eżamina l-mejda l-qadima u ħejja stima tax-xogħol meħtieġ biex iġeddidha.
formal.en: The furniture renovator examined the old table and prepared an estimate for the work needed to renovate it.
formal.zh: 家具翻新人员检查了那张旧桌子，并为所需的翻新工作拟定了估价。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-mejda għadha tista' tissewwa? Mark: Iva, naf ġeddied tal-għamara li jista' jagħmilha sabiħa mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can this table still be repaired? Mark: Yes, I know a furniture renovator who can make it look lovely again.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这张桌子还能修好吗？Mark：能，我认识一位家具翻新师，可以让它重新变漂亮。

messages.speaker: Lara (家具主人)
messages.zh: 这张桌子还能修好吗？
messages.en: Can this table still be repaired?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naf ġeddied tal-għamara li jista' jagħmilha sabiħa mill-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naf ġeddied tal-għamara li jista' jagħmilha sabiħa mill-ġdid.
messages.zh: 能，我认识一位家具翻新师，可以让它重新变漂亮。
messages.en: Yes, I know a furniture renovator who can make it look lovely again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位师傅把旧桌子修整得焕然一新：ġeddied 指这位翻新的人，学习时把人物画在词旁。

gloss_zh: 能使人或事物焕新的；有恢复活力作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Providing renewal or helping someone or something regain freshness and vitality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够带来更新，或使人及事物恢复新鲜感与活力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib tiġdid jew jgħin lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa terġa' tikseb il-ħajja u l-enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能带来更新或使之恢复活力的。

formal.mt: Il-mistrieħ fil-ġnien kellu effett ġeddiedi fuq il-parteċipanti, li reġgħu lura għax-xogħol b'enerġija ġdida.
formal.en: The rest in the garden had a renewing effect on the participants, who returned to work with fresh energy.
formal.zh: 在花园中的休息使参与者恢复了活力，他们带着新的干劲回到工作中。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif tħossok wara l-mixja? Pawlu: Ħafna aħjar! Kellha effett ġeddiedi fuqi; issa għandi aktar enerġija.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do you feel after the walk? Pawlu: Much better! It had a renewing effect on me; now I have more energy.
colloquial.zh: Sara：散步之后感觉怎么样？Pawlu：好多了！它让我恢复了精神，现在我更有活力了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 散步之后感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How do you feel after the walk?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħafna aħjar! Kellha effett ġeddiedi fuqi; issa għandi aktar enerġija.
messages.mt_standard: Ħafna aħjar! Kellha effett ġeddiedi fuqi; issa għandi aktar enerġija.
messages.zh: 好多了！它让我恢复了精神，现在我更有活力了。
messages.en: Much better! It had a renewing effect on me; now I have more energy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用休息前疲惫、休息后精神焕发的对比图记 ġeddiedi；它描述带来更新或恢复活力的作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A crease, fold, or wrinkle in the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤上形成的一道折痕、褶皱或皱纹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tinja jew linja fil-ġilda fejn din tkun mitwija jew imkemmxa.

sense_translations.en_definition: a crease or wrinkle in the skin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮肤上的一道褶皱或皱纹。

formal.mt: Fit-tpinġija tal-wiċċ, l-istudenta żiedet ġegħda ħdejn l-għajn biex turi d-dettall tal-ġilda waqt it-tbissima.
formal.en: In the drawing of the face, the student added a wrinkle beside the eye to show the detail of the skin during a smile.
formal.zh: 在面部绘画中，学生在眼睛旁添了一道皱纹，以表现微笑时皮肤的细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex żidt dik il-linja ħdejn l-għajn fit-tpinġija? Lara: Dik ġegħda fil-ġilda; tidher meta l-persuna titbissem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you add that line beside the eye in the drawing? Lara: That's a crease in the skin; it appears when the person smiles.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么在画里眼睛旁加了那条线？Lara：那是皮肤上的一道褶皱，这个人微笑时就会出现。

messages.speaker: Maja (绘画同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex żidt dik il-linja ħdejn l-għajn fit-tpinġija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex żidt dik il-linja ħdejn l-għajn fit-tpinġija?
messages.zh: 你为什么在画里眼睛旁加了那条线？
messages.en: Why did you add that line beside the eye in the drawing?

messages.speaker: Lara (绘画同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ġegħda fil-ġilda; tidher meta l-persuna titbissem.
messages.mt_standard: Dik ġegħda fil-ġilda; tidher meta l-persuna titbissem.
messages.zh: 那是皮肤上的一道褶皱，这个人微笑时就会出现。
messages.en: That's a crease in the skin; it appears when the person smiles.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象微笑时眼角出现的一道细纹，把 ġegħda 对应到皮肤上的这一道褶皱来记忆。

gloss_zh: 给头发做卷的人；卷发师

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who curls or styles hair into curls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为头发做卷、把头发造型成卷曲状的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel ix-xagħar nokkli jew tagħtih forma ta' nokkli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给头发做卷的人；卷发师。

formal.mt: Qabel il-wirja, il-ġegħied tax-xagħar ħejja n-nokkli tal-atturi skont l-istil magħżul għal kull karattru.
formal.en: Before the performance, the person curling the hair prepared the actors' curls according to the style chosen for each character.
formal.zh: 演出前，卷发师按照每个角色选定的造型，为演员做好卷发。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min għamillek dawk in-nokkli sbieħ? Sara: David, il-ġegħied tax-xagħar fis-salon ta' ħdejna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who made those lovely curls for you? Sara: David, the person who curls hair at the salon near us.
colloquial.zh: Nina：谁给你做了这么漂亮的卷发？Sara：David，就是我们附近那家美发店的卷发师。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给你做了这么漂亮的卷发？
messages.en: Who made those lovely curls for you?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: David, il-ġegħied tax-xagħar fis-salon ta' ħdejna.
messages.mt_standard: David, il-ġegħied tax-xagħar fis-salon ta' ħdejna.
messages.zh: David，就是我们附近那家美发店的卷发师。
messages.en: David, the person who curls hair at the salon near us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一位正在给顾客做卷发的师傅，把 ġegħied 标签贴在人物身上，记住它指做卷发的人。

gloss_zh: 容易使头发卷曲的；有促卷作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to cause hair to curl or become curly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使头发卷曲或形成发卷的倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jagħmel ix-xagħar nokkli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易使头发卷曲的；有使头发形成发卷的倾向的。

collocations.en: a product that tends to make hair curl

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju ta' deskrizzjoni ta' prodott, l-aġġettiv ġegħiedi jindika li l-prodott għandu t-tendenza li jagħmel ix-xagħar nokkli.
formal.en: In this example of a product description, the adjective ġegħiedi indicates that the product tends to make hair curl.
formal.zh: 在这个产品描述示例中，形容词 ġegħiedi 表示该产品具有使头发卷曲的倾向。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser ġegħiedi f'din id-deskrizzjoni? David: Ifisser li dan il-prodott għandu t-tendenza li jagħmel ix-xagħar nokkli.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does ġegħiedi mean in this description? David: It means that this product tends to make hair curl.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这段说明里的 ġegħiedi 是什么意思？David：意思是这种产品有使头发卷曲的倾向。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这段说明里的 ġegħiedi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ġegħiedi mean in this description?

messages.speaker: David (美发师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li dan il-prodott għandu t-tendenza li jagħmel ix-xagħar nokkli.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li dan il-prodott għandu t-tendenza li jagħmel ix-xagħar nokkli.
messages.zh: 意思是这种产品有使头发卷曲的倾向。
messages.en: It means that this product tends to make hair curl.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象产品旁边画着直发变成发卷的箭头，用 ġegħiedi 描述这种促使头发卷曲的倾向。

gloss_zh: 令人信服的；具有强大说服力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Compelling or persuasive enough to make someone take notice or accept an argument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有很强的说服力，使人认真关注或接受某种观点的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu qawwa persważiva u jwassal lil xi ħadd biex jagħti kas jew jaċċetta argument.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人信服的；具有强大说服力的。

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta argument ġegħieli favur il-ħarsien tal-ambjent.
formal.en: The author presents a compelling argument in favour of environmental protection.
formal.zh: 作者提出了一个支持环境保护的有力论点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qbilt miegħu? Pawlu: Għax kellu argument ġegħieli, b'eżempji ċari.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you agree with him? Pawlu: Because he had a compelling argument, with clear examples.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么同意他的看法？保罗：因为他的论点很有说服力，而且有清楚的例子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么同意他的看法？
messages.en: Why did you agree with him?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kellu argument ġegħieli, b'eżempji ċari.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kellu argument ġegħieli, b'eżempji ċari.
messages.zh: 因为他的论点很有说服力，而且有清楚的例子。
messages.en: Because he had a compelling argument, with clear examples.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和论点一起记：证据清楚、听完点头，就是具有说服力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who provides a bride with her dowry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为新娘提供嫁妆的人，指提供者本人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tipprovdi d-dota lill-għarusa.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who provides the bride's dowry
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为新娘提供嫁妆的人。

collocations.en: the provider of the bride's dowry
collocations.zh: 为这位新娘提供嫁妆的人

collocations.en: the help of the dowry provider

formal.mt: Id-dokument isemmi lill-ġehież li pprovda d-dota lill-għarusa.
formal.en: The document mentions the person who provided the bride with her dowry.
formal.zh: 文件提到了为新娘提供嫁妆的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser ġehież? Mark: Il-persuna li tipprovdi d-dota lill-għarusa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does ġehież mean? Mark: The person who provides the bride with her dowry.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：ġehież 是什么意思？马克：就是为新娘提供嫁妆的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: ġehież 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ġehież mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: 就是为新娘提供嫁妆的人。
messages.en: The person who provides the bride with her dowry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新娘收到嫁妆的场景，把这个词贴在提供嫁妆的人身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of bringing something to a person or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物带到某人身边或某个地方的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iġib xi ħaġa għand xi ħadd jew f'xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带来某物的行为。

formal.mt: Il-ġejbien tal-kotba fil-klassi qabel il-lezzjoni huwa r-responsabbiltà tal-istudenti.
formal.en: Bringing the books to class before the lesson is the students' responsibility.
formal.zh: 在上课前把书带到教室是学生的责任。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ġejbien tal-ikel għal għada f'idejk? Toni: Iva, inġib kollox qabel nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you taking care of bringing the food for tomorrow? Toni: Yes, I'll bring everything before noon.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：明天把食物带来的事由你负责吗？托尼：对，我会在中午前把东西都带来。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天把食物带来的事由你负责吗？
messages.en: Are you taking care of bringing the food for tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，我会在中午前把东西都带来。
messages.en: Yes, I'll bring everything before noon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放把书带进教室的动作，用这个词给整件带来的事命名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cowardice: a lack of courage when facing danger or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对危险或困难时缺乏勇气的怯懦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' kuraġġ quddiem il-periklu jew id-diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怯懦；缺乏勇气。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jammetti li baqa' sieket minħabba l-ġejf.
formal.en: In the story, the character admits that he remained silent because of cowardice.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物承认自己由于怯懦而保持沉默。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tħoss li kien sinjal ta' ġejf? Pawlu: Iva, ridt nitkellem, imma ma kellix il-kuraġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you feel it was a sign of cowardice? Pawlu: Yes, I wanted to speak, but I didn't have the courage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得那是怯懦的表现吗？保罗：是的，我想开口，但没有勇气。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħoss li kien sinjal ta' ġejf?
messages.mt_standard: Tħoss li kien sinjal ta' ġejf?
messages.zh: 你觉得那是怯懦的表现吗？
messages.en: Do you feel it was a sign of cowardice?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ridt nitkellem, imma ma kellix il-kuraġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ridt nitkellem, imma ma kellix il-kuraġġ.
messages.zh: 是的，我想开口，但没有勇气。
messages.en: Yes, I wanted to speak, but I didn't have the courage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象想开口却缺乏勇气的时刻，把怯懦这种状态与词义相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To revile someone by speaking to or about them in an insulting and abusive way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用侮辱性、恶毒的言语辱骂或诋毁某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħajjar jew jinsulta lil xi ħadd bi kliem iebes u offensiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辱骂某人；用恶言谩骂某人。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ir-raġel ġejjef lill-avversarju minflok wieġeb għall-argument tiegħu.
formal.en: During the meeting, the man reviled his opponent instead of answering his argument.
formal.zh: 会议期间，那名男子辱骂了对手，没有回应对方的论点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara waqt il-logħba? Mark: Wieħed mill-plejers ġejjef lill-avversarju, u r-referee waqqaf il-logħob.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened during the match? Mark: One of the players reviled his opponent, and the referee stopped play.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：比赛时发生了什么？马克：一名球员辱骂了对手，裁判就暂停了比赛。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 比赛时发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened during the match?

messages.speaker: Mark (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Wieħed mill-plejers ġejjef lill-avversarju, u r-referee waqqaf il-logħob.
messages.mt_standard: Wieħed mill-plejers ġejjef lill-avversarju, u r-referee waqqaf il-logħob.
messages.zh: 一名球员辱骂了对手，裁判就暂停了比赛。
messages.en: One of the players reviled his opponent, and the referee stopped play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用球场上恶言辱骂对手的画面记忆，重点抓住言语攻击这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who brings something to someone or to a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物带给某人或带到某处的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġib xi ħaġa għand xi ħadd jew f'xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带来某物的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-vjaġġatur jidher bħala ġejjieb ta' aħbarijiet minn pajjiż imbiegħed.
formal.en: In the story, the traveller appears as a bringer of news from a distant country.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这名旅行者以从遥远国度带来消息的人的身份出现。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu l-ġejjieb tar-rigali llum? Toni: Jien! Ġibt rigal żgħir għal kull wieħed minnkom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who's the bringer of gifts today? Toni: I am! I brought a little gift for each of you.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天谁是送礼物来的人呀？托尼：是我！我给你们每个人都带了一份小礼物。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天谁是送礼物来的人呀？
messages.en: Who's the bringer of gifts today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! Ġibt rigal żgħir għal kull wieħed minnkom.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! Ġibt rigal żgħir għal kull wieħed minnkom.
messages.zh: 是我！我给你们每个人都带了一份小礼物。
messages.en: I am! I brought a little gift for each of you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象抱着礼物走进门的人，这个名词指的就是带来东西的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the role or quality of bringing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有带来某物的作用或性质的，用来描述带来者的角色或特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu r-rwol jew il-kwalità li jġib xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有带来某物的作用或性质的。

collocations.en: a character who acts as a bringer
collocations.zh: 起带来某物作用的人物

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rakkont, il-vjaġġatur għandu rwol ġejjiebi: iwassal l-aħbarijiet lill-abitanti tar-raħal.
formal.en: In the analysis of the story, the traveller has a role as a bringer: he delivers the news to the village inhabitants.
formal.zh: 在对故事的分析中，旅行者承担带来消息的角色：他把消息传给村民。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser rwol ġejjiebi hawn? David: Ifisser li l-karattru jġib xi ħaġa; f'dan ir-rakkont, iġib l-aħbarijiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does a role as a bringer mean here? David: It means the character brings something; in this story, he brings the news.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里说的带来者角色是什么意思？戴维：意思是这个人物带来某种东西；在这个故事里，他带来的是消息。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这里说的带来者角色是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a role as a bringer mean here?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-karattru jġib xi ħaġa; f'dan ir-rakkont, iġib l-aħbarijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-karattru jġib xi ħaġa; f'dan ir-rakkont, iġib l-aħbarijiet.
messages.zh: 意思是这个人物带来某种东西；在这个故事里，他带来的是消息。
messages.en: It means the character brings something; in this story, he brings the news.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在角色旁边记忆：说明这个角色具有把某物带来的作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes another person vile or morally degraded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使另一个人变得卑劣、品行低下的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel lil persuna oħra vili jew ħażina fl-imġiba tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who renders another person vile
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使他人变得卑劣或品行低下的人。

collocations.en: someone who makes other people vile
to act as someone who morally degrades another person
collocations.zh: 充当使他人品行败坏的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jaġixxi ta' ġejjief meta jħajjar lil sieħbu jigdeb u jqarraq.
formal.en: In the story, the character acts as a corrupting influence when he encourages his companion to lie and deceive.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个人物怂恿同伴说谎、欺骗，充当了使他人品行败坏的人。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed issejjaħlu ġejjief? Pawlu: Għax dejjem iħajjar lil sieħbu jagħmel affarijiet ħżiena.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you calling him someone who corrupts others? Pawlu: Because he keeps encouraging his friend to do bad things.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么说他是使别人变坏的人？保罗：因为他总怂恿朋友做坏事。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是使别人变坏的人？
messages.en: Why are you calling him someone who corrupts others?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem iħajjar lil sieħbu jagħmel affarijiet ħżiena.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem iħajjar lil sieħbu jagħmel affarijiet ħżiena.
messages.zh: 因为他总怂恿朋友做坏事。
messages.en: Because he keeps encouraging his friend to do bad things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成故事中不断把同伴带坏的人：核心是使别人变得卑劣。

gloss_zh: 令人胆怯的；使人畏缩的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing people to feel cowardly or to lose their courage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人产生怯懦、失去勇气或畏缩不前的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqanqal il-biża' u jġiegħel lil dak li jkun jitlef il-kuraġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起怯懦、使人丧失勇气的。

collocations.en: a speech that makes people lose their courage

formal.mt: Id-diskors ġejjiefi tal-mexxej qanqal il-biża' fost il-membri tal-grupp.
formal.en: The leader's speech, which undermined people's courage, stirred fear among the members of the group.
formal.zh: 领导者那番令人胆怯的讲话，在小组成员中引起了恐惧。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dak kien kliem ġejjiefi; issa qed nibża' nipprova. Mark: Tħallihx ineħħilek il-kuraġġ. Nistgħu nippruvaw flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Those words made me lose my courage; now I'm afraid to try. Mark: Don't let him take away your courage. We can try together.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那些话真让人胆怯，我现在都不敢试了。马克：别让他打掉你的勇气，我们可以一起试。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kien kliem ġejjiefi; issa qed nibża' nipprova.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kien kliem ġejjiefi; issa qed nibża' nipprova.
messages.zh: 那些话真让人胆怯，我现在都不敢试了。
messages.en: Those words made me lose my courage; now I'm afraid to try.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħallihx ineħħilek il-kuraġġ. Nistgħu nippruvaw flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Tħallihx ineħħilek il-kuraġġ. Nistgħu nippruvaw flimkien.
messages.zh: 别让他打掉你的勇气，我们可以一起试。
messages.en: Don't let him take away your courage. We can try together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句话让人把迈出的脚缩回来，用这个画面记住“令人胆怯的”。

gloss_zh: 参加游行；婚礼中陪伴新郎或新娘

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take part in a procession, or to accompany a bride or groom during a wedding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加游行队伍，或在婚礼中陪伴新娘或新郎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu sehem f'purċissjoni, jew jakkumpanja lill-għarusa jew lill-għarus waqt tieġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to take part in a procession
sense_translations.zh_definition: 参加游行，随游行队伍行进。

sense_translations.en_definition: to accompany a bride or groom during a wedding
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在婚礼中陪伴新娘或新郎。

collocations.en: he took part in the procession
he accompanied the groom during the wedding

formal.mt: Ġużeppi ġela mal-għarus waqt it-tieġ, filwaqt li qraba oħra akkumpanjaw lill-għarusa.
formal.en: Ġużeppi accompanied the groom during the wedding, while other relatives accompanied the bride.
formal.zh: 婚礼中，朱塞佩陪伴新郎，其他亲属则陪伴新娘。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu ġela fil-purċissjoni lbieraħ? Toni: Iva, mexa magħna mill-bidu sal-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Pawlu take part in the procession yesterday? Toni: Yes, he walked with us from beginning to end.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：保罗昨天参加游行了吗？托尼：参加了，他从头到尾都和我们一起走。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗昨天参加游行了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu take part in the procession yesterday?

messages.speaker: Toni (游行参与者)
messages.zh: 参加了，他从头到尾都和我们一起走。
messages.en: Yes, he walked with us from beginning to end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个同行画面记忆：跟着游行队伍走，以及婚礼上陪着新人走。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shop that sells ice cream.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 售卖冰淇淋的店铺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanut li jbigħ il-ġelat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冰淇淋店；售卖冰淇淋的店铺。

collocations.en: an ice cream shop by the sea
we buy ice cream from the ice cream shop
collocations.zh: 我们从冰淇淋店买冰淇淋

formal.mt: Il-ġelaterija tinsab ħdejn il-pjazza u toffri ġelat b'diversi togħmiet.
formal.en: The ice cream shop is located beside the square and offers ice cream in various flavours.
formal.zh: 这家冰淇淋店位于广场旁，供应多种口味的冰淇淋。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Immorru sal-ġelaterija wara l-mixja? Ben: Iva, nixtieq ġelat taċ-ċikkulata.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we go to the ice cream shop after our walk? Ben: Yes, I'd like some chocolate ice cream.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：散步后我们去冰淇淋店好吗？本：好啊，我想吃巧克力冰淇淋。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 散步后我们去冰淇淋店好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go to the ice cream shop after our walk?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊，我想吃巧克力冰淇淋。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like some chocolate ice cream.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象散步后走进一家摆满不同口味冰淇淋的店，把整家店与这个词绑定。

gloss_zh: 涌出眼泪；涓涓流下；发芽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To well up, especially of tears; to trickle down; or to germinate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指眼泪涌出、液体缓缓流下，或种子开始发芽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitla' fl-għajnejn, meta jingħad għad-dmugħ; jinżel ftit ftit, meta jingħad għal likwidu; jew jinbet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涌出，盈满眼眶，用于眼泪。
涓涓流下；一点一点地往下流。
发芽；开始萌发。

collocations.en: tears welled up in his eyes

formal.mt: Meta sema' l-aħbar, ġelben id-dmugħ f'għajnejh u baqa' sieket għal ftit.
formal.en: When he heard the news, tears welled up in his eyes and he remained silent for a while.
formal.zh: 听到消息后，他眼中涌出泪水，沉默了片刻。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-qamħ li żrajna ġelben? Samwel: Iva, ara r-rimjiet żgħar li ħarġu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Has the wheat we sowed germinated? Samwel: Yes, look at the little shoots that have appeared.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们播下的小麦发芽了吗？萨姆韦尔：发芽了，看那些冒出来的小嫩芽。

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺同伴)
messages.zh: 我们播下的小麦发芽了吗？
messages.en: Has the wheat we sowed germinated?

messages.speaker: Samwel (园艺同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara r-rimjiet żgħar li ħarġu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara r-rimjiet żgħar li ħarġu.
messages.zh: 发芽了，看那些冒出来的小嫩芽。
messages.en: Yes, look at the little shoots that have appeared.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三格图分别记义：眼泪涌上来、水沿墙流下来、种子冒出芽；这是记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to germinate seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于使种子发芽的器具或装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex iż-żrieragħ jinbtu.

sense_translations.en_definition: a device for germinating seeds (a germinator)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于种子发芽的装置，即发芽器或催芽器。

collocations.en: we place the seeds in the germinator
collocations.zh: 我们把种子放入发芽器

formal.mt: Għall-attività tal-klassi, l-għalliema poġġiet iż-żrieragħ fil-ġelbien u talbet lill-istudenti josservawhom kuljum.
formal.en: For the class activity, the teacher placed the seeds in the germinator and asked the students to observe them every day.
formal.zh: 在课堂活动中，老师把种子放进发芽器，并让学生每天观察。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn inqiegħed dawn iż-żrieragħ? David: Fil-ġelbien, ħdejn dawk li poġġejna lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where should I put these seeds? David: In the germinator, beside the ones we put in yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这些种子放在哪里？戴维：放进发芽器，放在我们昨天放的那些旁边。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这些种子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these seeds?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-ġelbien, ħdejn dawk li poġġejna lbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-ġelbien, ħdejn dawk li poġġejna lbieraħ.
messages.zh: 放进发芽器，放在我们昨天放的那些旁边。
messages.en: In the germinator, beside the ones we put in yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词贴在种子的“发芽小装置”上，看到器具便回想 ġelbien。

gloss_zh: 能促使发芽的；有催芽作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the ability to make seeds germinate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使种子发芽的能力或作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jġiegħel iż-żrieragħ jinbtu.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to cause germination
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有促使发芽能力的；有催芽作用的。

collocations.en: a treatment capable of causing germination

formal.mt: L-istudju eżamina jekk it-trattament kellux effett ġelbieni fuq iż-żrieragħ.
formal.en: The study examined whether the treatment had an effect that caused the seeds to germinate.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察了该处理是否对种子具有催芽作用。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi jfisser li trattament hu ġelbieni? Karl: Ifisser li jista' jġiegħel iż-żrieragħ jinbtu.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does it mean to say that a treatment is germination-inducing? Karl: It means that it can make seeds germinate.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：说一种处理有催芽作用是什么意思？卡尔：意思是它能使种子发芽。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li trattament hu ġelbieni?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li trattament hu ġelbieni?
messages.zh: 说一种处理有催芽作用是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean to say that a treatment is germination-inducing?

messages.speaker: Karl (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jista' jġiegħel iż-żrieragħ jinbtu.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jista' jġiegħel iż-żrieragħ jinbtu.
messages.zh: 意思是它能使种子发芽。
messages.en: It means that it can make seeds germinate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给能让种子冒芽的处理贴上“有催芽能力”的标签，以此记住这个形容词。

gloss_zh: 涌出；涓流，尤指泪水或水

teaching_sense.en_definition: The welling up or trickling of a liquid, especially tears or water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体涌出或缓缓流动的过程，尤其指眼泪或水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ jew l-inżul ftit ftit ta' likwidu, speċjalment dmugħ jew ilma.

sense_translations.en_definition: welling up or trickling (used especially of tears or water)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 涌出或涓涓流动的过程，尤其用于眼泪或水。

collocations.en: the welling up or trickling of tears

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iddeskriva l-ġelbin tal-ilma mal-ħajt wara x-xita.
formal.en: The report described the trickling of water down the wall after the rain.
formal.zh: 报告描述了雨后水沿墙缓缓流下的现象。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss ħdejn it-tieqa? Pietru: Iva, hu l-ġelbin tal-ilma mal-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can you hear that sound near the window? Pietru: Yes, it's the trickling of water down the wall.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你听见窗边那个声音了吗？彼得：听见了，是水沿着墙涓涓流下的声音。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 你听见窗边那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that sound near the window?

messages.speaker: Pietru (室友)
messages.zh: 听见了，是水沿着墙涓涓流下的声音。
messages.en: Yes, it's the trickling of water down the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准正在涌出的眼泪或缓缓流下的水，记住这个名词表示流动过程。

gloss_zh: 好争吵的人；好斗的人；怀有敌意的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who readily quarrels or fights, or behaves with hostility toward others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易与人争吵、打斗，或对他人表现出敌意的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li malajr tidħol fi ġlied jew tilwim, jew li turi ostilità lejn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好争吵的人；容易与人起争执的人
好斗的人；动辄想与人打斗的人
怀有敌意的人；对他人态度敌对的人

collocations.en: a quarrelsome person in the classroom
a pugnacious person who looks for trouble
collocations.zh: 一个寻衅滋事的好斗者

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġellied jhedded lill-ġirien u jibda tilwima fuq kull ħaġa żgħira.
formal.en: In the story, the quarrelsome man threatens his neighbours and starts an argument over every little thing.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个好斗的人威胁邻居，凡事都要挑起争执。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tridx taħdem ma' Toni? Pawlu: Għax hu ġellied; kull diskussjoni ssir tilwima.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you want to work with Toni? Pawlu: Because he's a quarrelsome person; every discussion turns into an argument.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不想和托尼一起工作？保罗：因为他是个爱吵架的人，每次讨论都会变成争执。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx taħdem ma' Toni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx taħdem ma' Toni?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想和托尼一起工作？
messages.en: Why don't you want to work with Toni?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu ġellied; kull diskussjoni ssir tilwima.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu ġellied; kull diskussjoni ssir tilwima.
messages.zh: 因为他是个爱吵架的人，每次讨论都会变成争执。
messages.en: Because he's a quarrelsome person; every discussion turns into an argument.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġellied记成故事里总要挑起争执的那个人；这里是名词，学习时用一个具体人物帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to start arguments or fights and quick to confront others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于争吵或打斗，容易与他人发生冲突的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jidħol f'tilwim jew fi ġlied ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱争吵的；容易与人发生口角的
好斗的；动辄想与人冲突的

formal.mt: Il-karattru ġelliedi tal-protagonist iwassal għal kunflitti ripetuti mal-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: The protagonist's quarrelsome character leads to repeated conflicts with his family.
formal.zh: 主人公好争吵的性格导致他反复与家人发生冲突。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif mar il-logħob illum? David: Tifel ġelliedi beda jargumenta dwar kull punt, u waqqafna l-logħba.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did the games go today? David: A quarrelsome boy started arguing about every point, and we stopped the game.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天玩得怎么样？大卫：一个爱争吵的男孩每一分都要争，我们就停下了游戏。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天玩得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the games go today?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tifel ġelliedi beda jargumenta dwar kull punt, u waqqafna l-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: Tifel ġelliedi beda jargumenta dwar kull punt, u waqqafna l-logħba.
messages.zh: 一个爱争吵的男孩每一分都要争，我们就停下了游戏。
messages.en: A quarrelsome boy started arguing about every point, and we stopped the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用tifel ġelliedi这个短语记忆：先想到男孩，再给他贴上爱争吵的性格标签，记牢形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dresser whose exterior is upholstered in leather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外表用皮革包覆的斗柜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Komò miksi bil-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮革包面的斗柜；外表用皮革包覆的抽屉柜

collocations.zh: 一个旧式皮革包面斗柜

collocations.en: a leather-upholstered dresser in the bedroom
collocations.zh: 卧室里的皮革包面斗柜

formal.mt: L-inventarju tal-kamra jinkludi ġelludi antik ħdejn it-tieqa.
formal.en: The room inventory includes an old leather-upholstered dresser beside the window.
formal.zh: 房间物品清单中列有一个放在窗边的旧式皮革包面斗柜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġu l-ġelludi? Mark: Fil-kamra tas-sodda, ħdejn il-mera.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we put the leather-upholstered dresser? Mark: In the bedroom, beside the mirror.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个皮革包面斗柜放在哪里？马克：放在卧室里，镜子旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这个皮革包面斗柜放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put the leather-upholstered dresser?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 放在卧室里，镜子旁边。
messages.en: In the bedroom, beside the mirror.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象卧室里一个包着皮革、带有抽屉的斗柜，把ġelludi与这件完整家具一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cracking of a material, especially the sound made as it cracks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料开裂时的噼裂现象或声响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss li jagħmel materjal meta jixxaqqaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开裂；开裂时的噼裂声

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, instema' l-ġelġil tal-injam fil-bini l-antik.
formal.en: During the night, the cracking of wood could be heard in the old building.
formal.zh: 夜间，老建筑里传来了木材的噼裂声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak il-ġelġil? Mark: Iva, ġej mill-injam fin-nar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that cracking? Mark: Yes, it's coming from the wood in the fire.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见那阵噼裂声了吗？马克：听见了，是火里的木头发出的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见那阵噼裂声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that cracking?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 听见了，是火里的木头发出的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the wood in the fire.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġelġil和炉火中木头噼啪开裂的声音连在一起记，重点记住开裂声这个听觉画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To collect things or bring people or things together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品收集起来，或把人和物聚集到一起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib affarijiet jew nies flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收集；聚集；把人或物汇集起来

formal.mt: Is-segretarju ġema' d-dokumenti kollha qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The secretary gathered all the documents before the meeting.
formal.zh: 秘书在会议前把所有文件收集齐了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min ġema' l-karti minn fuq il-mejda? Mark: Toni. Poġġiehom kollha f'dan il-fajl.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who gathered the papers from the table? Mark: Toni. He put them all in this folder.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁把桌上的纸张收起来了？马克：托尼。他把它们全放进这个文件夹了。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ġema' l-karti minn fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Min ġema' l-karti minn fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 谁把桌上的纸张收起来了？
messages.en: Who gathered the papers from the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 托尼。他把它们全放进这个文件夹了。
messages.en: Toni. He put them all in this folder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġema'配上双手将散落纸张收拢的动作，记住从分散到集中的意思，并留意词尾撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The lengthening of a consonant sound, often represented in writing by a doubled consonant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 辅音在发音时延长的现象，书写时常用双写辅音字母表示。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-titwil ta' ħoss konsonantali fil-pronunzja, li spiss jintwera fil-kitba b'konsonanti doppja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辅音延长；辅音重叠现象。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti jisimgħu eżempji ta' ġeminazzjoni u jqabblu t-tul tal-konsonanti.
formal.en: In this exercise, students listen to examples of gemination and compare the duration of the consonants.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生听辅音延长的实例，并比较辅音的持续时间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser ġeminazzjoni? Pawlu: Meta ttawwal il-ħoss ta' konsonanti. Isma' kif ngħid il-kelma, imbagħad ipprova int.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does gemination mean? Pawlu: It is when you hold a consonant sound longer. Listen to how I say the word, then try it yourself.
colloquial.zh: Lara：辅音延长是什么意思？Pawlu：就是把一个辅音的声音保持得更久。听听我怎么读这个词，然后你试试。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 辅音延长是什么意思？
messages.en: What does gemination mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta ttawwal il-ħoss ta' konsonanti. Isma' kif ngħid il-kelma, imbagħad ipprova int.
messages.mt_standard: Meta ttawwal il-ħoss ta' konsonanti. Isma' kif ngħid il-kelma, imbagħad ipprova int.
messages.zh: 就是把一个辅音的声音保持得更久。听听我怎么读这个词，然后你试试。
messages.en: It is when you hold a consonant sound longer. Listen to how I say the word, then try it yourself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把辅音想成需要多按一会儿的琴键：ġeminazzjoni 提醒你延长辅音的持续时间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To save money by putting it aside, or to collect items and build up a collection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把钱留存起来逐渐积攒，或把物品收集起来形成收藏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwarrab il-flus biex ifaddalhom, jew jiġbor oġġetti biex jagħmel kollezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储蓄；积攒；把钱留存起来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to collect; to make a collection of (e.g. stamps)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 收集；收藏；把邮票等物品积累成收藏。

formal.mt: Matul is-sena, Mark ġemma' biżżejjed flus biex jixtri kompjuter għall-istudju.
formal.en: During the year, Mark saved up enough money to buy a computer for his studies.
formal.zh: 这一年里，Mark 攒够了钱，买了一台用于学习的电脑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ġemma' dawn il-bolol kollha? Mark: Missieri. Kull darba li kien jirċievi ittra, kien iżomm il-bolla.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who collected all these stamps? Mark: My father. Every time he received a letter, he would keep the stamp.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这些邮票都是谁收集的？Mark：我爸爸。他每次收到信，都会把邮票留下来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些邮票都是谁收集的？
messages.en: Who collected all these stamps?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri. Kull darba li kien jirċievi ittra, kien iżomm il-bolla.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri. Kull darba li kien jirċievi ittra, kien iżomm il-bolla.
messages.zh: 我爸爸。他每次收到信，都会把邮票留下来。
messages.en: My father. Every time he received a letter, he would keep the stamp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个盒子：一个存零钱，一个放邮票。ġemma' 都表示一点一点积起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something more beautiful or attractive, including by adding decorative details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变得更美观，或通过添加装饰细节加以美化、润饰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa isbaħ jew iżejjinha b'dettalji dekorattivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使美丽；使变得美观。
装饰；修饰；润饰。

formal.mt: Il-grupp ġemmel il-bitħa tal-iskola bi pjanti ġodda u bankijiet miżbugħa.
formal.en: The group beautified the school courtyard with new plants and painted benches.
formal.zh: 这个小组用新栽的植物和刷过漆的长椅美化了学校庭院。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ġemmel il-gallarija? Pawlu: Ommi. Żiedet ftit qsari bil-fjuri, u issa tidher ħafna isbaħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who made the balcony look so nice? Pawlu: My mother. She added a few pots of flowers, and now it looks much prettier.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁把阳台布置得这么漂亮？Pawlu：我妈妈。她添了几盆花，现在看起来漂亮多了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 谁把阳台布置得这么漂亮？
messages.en: Who made the balcony look so nice?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Ommi. Żiedet ftit qsari bil-fjuri, u issa tidher ħafna isbaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ommi. Żiedet ftit qsari bil-fjuri, u issa tidher ħafna isbaħ.
messages.zh: 我妈妈。她添了几盆花，现在看起来漂亮多了。
messages.en: My mother. She added a few pots of flowers, and now it looks much prettier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用前后对比图记 ġemmel：原本普通的角落，添花、上色之后变漂亮，重点是美化这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who covers something with soot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把烟炱，即燃烧产生的黑色烟垢，覆在某物上的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiksi xi ħaġa bin-nugrufun.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. that covers sth. with soot
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某物覆上烟炱、使其表面沾上黑色烟垢的人。

collocations.en: a person who coats stage props with soot
collocations.zh: 给舞台道具覆上烟炱的人

collocations.en: the work of the person applying soot

formal.mt: Għal din ix-xena, il-ġemmied kesa l-wiċċ tal-borma bin-nugrufun biex tidher qisha ntużat fuq in-nar.
formal.en: For this scene, the person applying soot coated the surface of the pot so that it would look as though it had been used over a fire.
formal.zh: 为布置这场戏，负责施加烟炱的人给锅的表面覆上烟炱，使它看起来像是在火上用过。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed issejjaħ lil Mark il-ġemmied? Pawlu: Għax qed jiksi dawn il-qsari bin-nugrufun għax-xena tat-teatru.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you calling Mark the soot coater? Pawlu: Because he is covering these pots with soot for the theatre scene.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么把 Mark 叫作覆烟炱的人？Pawlu：因为他正在给这些锅覆上烟炱，用来布置舞台上的场景。

messages.speaker: Lara (剧组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed issejjaħ lil Mark il-ġemmied?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed issejjaħ lil Mark il-ġemmied?
messages.zh: 你为什么把 Mark 叫作覆烟炱的人？
messages.en: Why are you calling Mark the soot coater?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (道具负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed jiksi dawn il-qsari bin-nugrufun għax-xena tat-teatru.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed jiksi dawn il-qsari bin-nugrufun għax-xena tat-teatru.
messages.zh: 因为他正在给这些锅覆上烟炱，用来布置舞台上的场景。
messages.en: Because he is covering these pots with soot for the theatre scene.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象舞台助手给道具锅抹上黑烟炱；ġemmied 指做这件事的人，记住烟炱是被覆上去的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who collects objects, often items of a particular kind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收集物品的人，常指专门收集某一类物品的收藏者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiġbor oġġetti, spiss ta' tip partikolari, biex tagħmel kollezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收集者；收藏者。

formal.mt: Il-mużew irċieva kollezzjoni ta' muniti mingħand ġemmiegħ li kien ilu jiġborhom għal ħafna snin.
formal.en: The museum received a collection of coins from a collector who had been collecting them for many years.
formal.zh: 博物馆收到了一位收藏者捐赠的钱币藏品；他收集这些钱币已有多年。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek ħafna bolol! Int ġemmiegħ? Mark: Iva, niġbor bolol minn pajjiżi differenti u nżommhom f'album.
colloquial.en: Sara: You have so many stamps! Are you a collector? Mark: Yes, I collect stamps from different countries and keep them in an album.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你有好多邮票！你是收藏者吗？Mark：是的，我收集不同国家的邮票，把它们放在集邮册里。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有好多邮票！你是收藏者吗？
messages.en: You have so many stamps! Are you a collector?

messages.speaker: Mark (集邮爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niġbor bolol minn pajjiżi differenti u nżommhom f'album.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niġbor bolol minn pajjiżi differenti u nżommhom f'album.
messages.zh: 是的，我收集不同国家的邮票，把它们放在集邮册里。
messages.en: Yes, I collect stamps from different countries and keep them in an album.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个抱着集邮册介绍藏品的人：ġemmiegħ 是收集者，记忆焦点放在这个人身上。

gloss_zh: 有收集倾向的；倾向于聚拢的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to collect things or bring things or people together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有收集事物的倾向，或倾向于把事物、人聚集在一起的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jiġbor affarijiet jew ilaqqa' affarijiet jew nies flimkien.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the tendency to collect or bring together
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有收集倾向的；倾向于把事物或人聚集起来的。

collocations.en: an instinct to gather things together

formal.mt: It-tifel juri karattru ġemmiegħi: jiġbor weraq, ġebel żgħir u oġġetti oħra li jsib waqt il-mixjiet.
formal.en: The boy shows a tendency to collect: he gathers leaves, small stones and other objects he finds on walks.
formal.zh: 这个男孩表现出爱收集东西的性格：他把散步时发现的树叶、小石头和其他物品收集起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu għandu karattru ġemmiegħi, hux? Mark: Iva, kull darba li mmorru l-baħar, jiġbor xi ċagħaq u jżommu f'kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Pawlu has a tendency to collect things, doesn't he? Mark: Yes, every time we go to the seaside, he collects some pebbles and keeps them in a box.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu 很爱收集东西，对吧？Mark：是啊，每次我们去海边，他都会捡些卵石，放在盒子里保存。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 很爱收集东西，对吧？
messages.en: Pawlu has a tendency to collect things, doesn't he?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kull darba li mmorru l-baħar, jiġbor xi ċagħaq u jżommu f'kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kull darba li mmorru l-baħar, jiġbor xi ċagħaq u jżommu f'kaxxa.
messages.zh: 是啊，每次我们去海边，他都会捡些卵石，放在盒子里保存。
messages.en: Yes, every time we go to the seaside, he collects some pebbles and keeps them in a box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġemmiegħi 贴在性格标签上：看到小物就想收起来，描述的是爱收集、爱聚拢的倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes something beautiful or adds decorative details to it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变得美观，或为其增添装饰细节的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel xi ħaġa isbaħ jew iżżejjinha b'dettalji dekorattivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装饰者；为事物增添修饰的人。
美化者；使某物变得美丽的人。

collocations.en: a person who beautifies the garden
a person who embellishes the hall

formal.mt: Bħala ġemmiel tas-sala, Pawlu għażel il-fjuri u d-drappijiet biex joħloq dehra armonjuża.
formal.en: As the person embellishing the hall, Pawlu chose the flowers and fabrics to create a harmonious appearance.
formal.zh: Pawlu 负责美化大厅，他挑选了鲜花和布料，营造出协调的整体效果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu l-ġemmiel tal-ġnien tagħkom? Mark: Ħija. Hu jagħżel il-fjuri u jirranġa l-qsari biex kollox jidher sabiħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is the person making your garden so beautiful? Mark: My brother. He chooses the flowers and arranges the pots so that everything looks lovely.
colloquial.zh: Sara：是谁把你们的花园打理得这么漂亮？Mark：我哥哥。他挑选花卉、摆放花盆，让整个花园都很好看。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 是谁把你们的花园打理得这么漂亮？
messages.en: Who is the person making your garden so beautiful?

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija. Hu jagħżel il-fjuri u jirranġa l-qsari biex kollox jidher sabiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija. Hu jagħżel il-fjuri u jirranġa l-qsari biex kollox jidher sabiħ.
messages.zh: 我哥哥。他挑选花卉、摆放花盆，让整个花园都很好看。
messages.en: My brother. He chooses the flowers and arranges the pots so that everything looks lovely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手拿鲜花和装饰带的布置者：ġemmiel 指让事物变漂亮的人，把人物形象记牢。

gloss_zh: 有美化效果的；起装饰作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that makes something more beautiful or adds to its decoration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使事物更美观的效果，或能够增添装饰效果的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel xi ħaġa isbaħ jew iżid mat-tiżjin tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: having an embellishing or beautifying effect
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有装饰或美化效果的。

formal.mt: Il-mużajk għandu effett ġemmieli fuq id-daħla tal-bini u jagħtiha aktar kulur.
formal.en: The mosaic has a beautifying effect on the building's entrance and gives it more colour.
formal.zh: 这幅马赛克为建筑入口增添了美感，也让入口的色彩更加丰富。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan id-dawl għandu effett ġemmieli fuq il-kamra, hux? Pawlu: Iva, jagħmel il-kuluri aktar sbieħ u l-kamra tidher aktar komda.
colloquial.en: Lara: This lighting has a beautifying effect on the room, doesn't it? Pawlu: Yes, it makes the colours look prettier and the room feel cosier.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这样的灯光能让房间更好看，对吧？Pawlu：是啊，它让色彩更漂亮，也让房间显得更舒适。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-dawl għandu effett ġemmieli fuq il-kamra, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-dawl għandu effett ġemmieli fuq il-kamra, hux?
messages.zh: 这样的灯光能让房间更好看，对吧？
messages.en: This lighting has a beautifying effect on the room, doesn't it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jagħmel il-kuluri aktar sbieħ u l-kamra tidher aktar komda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jagħmel il-kuluri aktar sbieħ u l-kamra tidher aktar komda.
messages.zh: 是啊，它让色彩更漂亮，也让房间显得更舒适。
messages.en: Yes, it makes the colours look prettier and the room feel cosier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开一盏灯，房间立刻更好看：ġemmieli 描述这种能增添美感的作用或效果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cry with many tears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 流下大量眼泪；痛哭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibki ħafna u jxerred ħafna dmugħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 泪流不止；流下大量眼泪

collocations.en: he wept copious tears in sorrow
he wept copious tears for a long time

formal.mt: Meta sema' l-aħbar tat-telfa, ir-raġel ġemġem għal ħin twil.
formal.en: When he heard the news of the loss, the man wept copious tears for a long time.
formal.zh: 听到失去亲人的消息后，那名男子长时间泪流不止。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhu Pawlu wara l-funeral? Sara: Ġemġem ħafna lbieraħ. Illum se noqgħod miegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is Pawlu after the funeral? Sara: He cried many tears yesterday. Today I'll stay with him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：葬礼之后保罗怎么样了？萨拉：他昨天哭得很厉害。今天我会陪着他。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 葬礼之后保罗怎么样了？
messages.en: How is Pawlu after the funeral?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġemġem ħafna lbieraħ. Illum se noqgħod miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ġemġem ħafna lbieraħ. Illum se noqgħod miegħu.
messages.zh: 他昨天哭得很厉害。今天我会陪着他。
messages.en: He cried many tears yesterday. Today I'll stay with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读ġemġem时配上一滴接一滴落泪的画面，记忆重点是大量流泪这个动作。

gloss_zh: 爱哭的；动辄流泪的；泪汪汪的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Prone to crying or readily moved to tears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易哭泣、动辄流泪的，或显得泪眼汪汪的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jibki jew li malajr iqattar id-dmugħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱哭的；容易流泪的
动辄落泪的；悲伤欲泣的；泪眼汪汪的

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru ġemġiemi jibki kull darba li jiftakar fil-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the tearful character cries whenever he remembers his family.
formal.zh: 小说中，那个容易流泪的人物每次想起家人都会哭泣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif hu t-tifel illum? Anna: Ftit ġemġiemi; jibki malajr għax għajjien.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is the boy today? Anna: A little tearful; he cries easily because he's tired.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：孩子今天怎么样？安娜：有点爱哭，因为累了，很容易掉眼泪。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 孩子今天怎么样？
messages.en: How is the boy today?

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit ġemġiemi; jibki malajr għax għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit ġemġiemi; jibki malajr għax għajjien.
messages.zh: 有点爱哭，因为累了，很容易掉眼泪。
messages.en: A little tearful; he cries easily because he's tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġemġiemi写在一个很容易掉眼泪的人物旁边，用爱哭的性情标签记住它的形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or sound of weeping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 哭泣、流泪的行为，或哭泣的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att tal-biki jew il-ħoss ta' min qed jibki.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哭泣；流泪；哭泣声

formal.mt: Wara li nqrat l-ittra, instema' ġemġim fil-kamra.
formal.en: After the letter was read, weeping could be heard in the room.
formal.zh: 信读完之后，房间里传来了哭泣声。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu dak il-ġemġim? Lara: It-tifel qed jibki għax tilef il-ġugarell. Ejja ngħinuh ifittxu.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's that weeping? Lara: The boy is crying because he lost his toy. Let's help him look for it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：那是什么哭声？拉拉：孩子弄丢了玩具，正在哭。我们帮他找找吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 那是什么哭声？
messages.en: What's that weeping?

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifel qed jibki għax tilef il-ġugarell. Ejja ngħinuh ifittxu.
messages.mt_standard: It-tifel qed jibki għax tilef il-ġugarell. Ejja ngħinuh ifittxu.
messages.zh: 孩子弄丢了玩具，正在哭。我们帮他找找吧。
messages.en: The boy is crying because he lost his toy. Let's help him look for it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġemġim当作一段哭泣声的名称来记：听见哭声时给它贴上这个名词标签。

gloss_zh: 面包外皮；人的胯部或身体侧面

teaching_sense.en_definition: The crust of a loaf of bread, or the hip or side of a person's body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一条面包的外皮，也可指人的胯部或身体侧面，须根据语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qoxra ta' ħobża, jew il-parti tal-ġisem fuq naħa waħda, qrib il-ġenbejn.

sense_translations.en_definition: the crust of a bread loaf
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一条面包的外皮。
人的胯部或身体侧面。

collocations.en: pain in the hip or side

formal.mt: Wara l-waqgħa, il-pazjent ħass uġigħ fil-ġenba tal-lemin.
formal.en: After the fall, the patient felt pain in the right hip or side.
formal.zh: 跌倒后，患者感到右侧胯部或体侧疼痛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid il-ġenba tal-ħobż? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobbha meta tkun tqarmeċ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like the bread crust? Mark: Yes, please. I like it when it's crunchy.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你要面包外皮吗？Mark：要，谢谢。我喜欢吃脆脆的外皮。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要面包外皮吗？
messages.en: Would you like the bread crust?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobbha meta tkun tqarmeċ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobbha meta tkun tqarmeċ.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。我喜欢吃脆脆的外皮。
messages.en: Yes, please. I like it when it's crunchy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分开记：餐桌上的面包外皮，以及跌倒后扶住的胯侧；看到搭配 tal-ħobż 就优先想到面包义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being general, or a broad statement that gives few specific details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指内容的一般性或概括性，也可指缺少具体细节的笼统说法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa ġenerali, jew stqarrija wiesgħa li ma tagħtix ħafna dettalji speċifiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一般性、概括性；也指不涉及具体细节的笼统说法。

collocations.zh: 没有实例支持的笼统说法

formal.mt: Il-ġeneralità tal-kliem fir-rapport tagħmilha diffiċli biex nifhmu x'miżuri konkreti qed jiġu proposti.
formal.en: The generality of the wording in the report makes it difficult to understand what concrete measures are being proposed.
formal.zh: 报告措辞笼统，使人难以理解其中提出了哪些具体措施。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ktibt li għandna ntejbu s-servizz. Pawlu: Dik ġeneralità. Tista' tagħti eżempju ta' x'għandna nbiddlu?
colloquial.en: Lara: I wrote that we should improve the service. Pawlu: That's a general statement. Can you give an example of what we should change?
colloquial.zh: Lara：我写了我们应该改善服务。Pawlu：这说得很笼统。你能举例说明我们该改什么吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 我写了我们应该改善服务。
messages.en: I wrote that we should improve the service.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ġeneralità. Tista' tagħti eżempju ta' x'għandna nbiddlu?
messages.mt_standard: Dik ġeneralità. Tista' tagħti eżempju ta' x'għandna nbiddlu?
messages.zh: 这说得很笼统。你能举例说明我们该改什么吗？
messages.en: That's a general statement. Can you give an example of what we should change?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和“说得很大概”连起来记：一句“要改善”若没有细节，就是一个 ġeneralità；补上实例才能具体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or result of forming a broad statement or rule from particular examples or observations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据个别实例或观察形成较广泛说法或规则的过程，也指所得的概括结论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ir-riżultat li bih minn eżempji jew osservazzjonijiet partikolari tinħareġ stqarrija jew regola ġenerali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 概括、归纳推广；由具体实例形成的一般性说法或结论。

collocations.en: a generalization from a few examples
collocations.zh: 依据少数实例作出的概括

formal.mt: Il-konklużjoni li l-istudenti kollha jippreferu l-istess metodu hija ġeneralizzazzjoni bbażata fuq tliet intervisti biss.
formal.en: The conclusion that all students prefer the same method is a generalization based on only three interviews.
formal.zh: 所有学生都偏好同一种方法这一结论，是仅凭三次访谈作出的概括。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Iż-żewġ karozzi tal-linja li ħadt illum waslu tard. Kollha jaslu tard! Nina: Dik ġeneralizzazzjoni żejda. Illum rajt tnejn biss.
colloquial.en: Mark: The two buses I took today were late. They're all late! Nina: That's an overgeneralization. You've only seen two today.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我今天坐的两辆公交车都晚点了。所有公交车都晚点！Nina：这概括得太过头了。你今天只见到了两辆。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żewġ karozzi tal-linja li ħadt illum waslu tard. Kollha jaslu tard!
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żewġ karozzi tal-linja li ħadt illum waslu tard. Kollha jaslu tard!
messages.zh: 我今天坐的两辆公交车都晚点了。所有公交车都晚点！
messages.en: The two buses I took today were late. They're all late!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ġeneralizzazzjoni żejda. Illum rajt tnejn biss.
messages.mt_standard: Dik ġeneralizzazzjoni żejda. Illum rajt tnejn biss.
messages.zh: 这概括得太过头了。你今天只见到了两辆。
messages.en: That's an overgeneralization. You've only seen two today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支从“几个例子”指向“一般结论”的箭头来记 ġeneralizzazzjoni；箭头跨得太远，就可能成为过度概括。

gloss_zh: 通才取向；广泛涉猎的做法

teaching_sense.en_definition: An approach that develops knowledge or skills across several fields rather than concentrating on one narrow specialty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重视跨多个领域积累知识或技能的通才取向，而非集中于单一狭窄专业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Approċċ li jagħti importanza lill-għarfien u lill-ħiliet f'diversi oqsma aktar milli lil speċjalizzazzjoni dejqa f'qasam wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通才取向；强调广泛掌握多个领域知识或技能的做法。

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkoraġġixxi l-ġeneraliżmu billi jgħaqqad studji fil-lingwi, fix-xjenza u fl-arti.
formal.en: The programme encourages generalism by combining studies in languages, science and the arts.
formal.zh: 该课程结合语言、科学和艺术学习，鼓励培养广泛涉猎的通才。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għażilt korsijiet minn tant oqsma differenti? Daniel: Jogħġobni l-ġeneraliżmu. Irrid nitgħallem minn diversi oqsma qabel nagħżel speċjalizzazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you choose courses from so many different fields? Daniel: I like generalism. I want to learn from several fields before choosing a specialization.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么选了这么多不同领域的课程？Daniel：我喜欢广泛学习。我想先接触几个领域，再选择专业方向。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għażilt korsijiet minn tant oqsma differenti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għażilt korsijiet minn tant oqsma differenti?
messages.zh: 你为什么选了这么多不同领域的课程？
messages.en: Why did you choose courses from so many different fields?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jogħġobni l-ġeneraliżmu. Irrid nitgħallem minn diversi oqsma qabel nagħżel speċjalizzazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Jogħġobni l-ġeneraliżmu. Irrid nitgħallem minn diversi oqsma qabel nagħżel speċjalizzazzjoni.
messages.zh: 我喜欢广泛学习。我想先接触几个领域，再选择专业方向。
messages.en: I like generalism. I want to learn from several fields before choosing a specialization.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个书包里同时装着语言、科学和艺术课本：ġeneraliżmu 强调知识覆盖多个领域，可用“通才取向”来记。

gloss_zh: 生成的；具有生成能力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to produce or generate new forms, structures or content.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够产生新形式、新结构或新内容的；具有生成能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-kapaċità joħloq jew jipproduċi forom, strutturi jew kontenut ġdid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生成的；能够产生新形式、结构或内容的。

formal.mt: L-istudju juża mudell ġenerativ biex jipproduċi eżempji ġodda skont sett ta' regoli.
formal.en: The study uses a generative model to produce new examples according to a set of rules.
formal.zh: 该研究使用生成模型，按照一组规则产生新的实例。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dan il-programm jagħżel biss minn stampi li diġà għandu? Adam: Le, juża mudell ġenerativ biex joħloq stampi ġodda.
colloquial.en: Elena: Does this program only choose from pictures it already has? Adam: No, it uses a generative model to create new pictures.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这个程序只是从已有图片中挑选吗？Adam：不是，它使用生成模型来创作新图片。

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-programm jagħżel biss minn stampi li diġà għandu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-programm jagħżel biss minn stampi li diġà għandu?
messages.zh: 这个程序只是从已有图片中挑选吗？
messages.en: Does this program only choose from pictures it already has?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, juża mudell ġenerativ biex joħloq stampi ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, juża mudell ġenerativ biex joħloq stampi ġodda.
messages.zh: 不是，它使用生成模型来创作新图片。
messages.en: No, it uses a generative model to create new pictures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借助英语 generative 的外形作拼写联想，再配上“产生新内容”的画面；记住 ġenerativ 是用来修饰名词的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device or system that produces something, especially a machine that generates electricity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生某种输出的装置或系统，尤其指产生电力的发电机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat jew sistema li tipproduċi xi ħaġa, speċjalment magna li tipproduċi l-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生器、生成器；尤指发电机。

formal.mt: Il-bini għandu ġeneratur ta' riżerva li jforni l-elettriku meta tinqata' l-provvista prinċipali.
formal.en: The building has a backup generator that supplies electricity when the main power supply fails.
formal.zh: 该建筑配有备用发电机，在主电源中断时供电。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex id-dwal għadhom mixgħula? Ma nqatax id-dawl? Toni: Iva, imma l-ġeneratur ta' riżerva qed jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are the lights still on? Didn't the power go out? Toni: Yes, but the backup generator is running.
colloquial.zh: Marija：灯怎么还亮着？不是停电了吗？Toni：是停电了，不过备用发电机正在运转。

messages.speaker: Marija (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex id-dwal għadhom mixgħula? Ma nqatax id-dawl?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex id-dwal għadhom mixgħula? Ma nqatax id-dawl?
messages.zh: 灯怎么还亮着？不是停电了吗？
messages.en: Why are the lights still on? Didn't the power go out?

messages.speaker: Toni (管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ġeneratur ta' riżerva qed jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ġeneratur ta' riżerva qed jaħdem.
messages.zh: 是停电了，不过备用发电机正在运转。
messages.en: Yes, but the backup generator is running.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġeneratur 和英语 generator 对照着记，再想象停电后机器启动、灯重新亮起；这是表示装置的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's mother or father; one of a child's parents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人的父亲或母亲，指双亲中的一位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-omm jew il-missier ta' persuna; wieħed mill-ġenituri ta' tifel jew tifla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 父亲或母亲；双亲中的一位。

collocations.zh: 一位家长；父母中的一位

formal.mt: Il-formola teħtieġ il-firma ta' ġenitur wieħed qabel it-tifel jew it-tifla jieħdu sehem fil-ħarġa.
formal.en: The form requires one parent's signature before the child takes part in the outing.
formal.zh: 儿童参加外出活动前，表格须由父母中的一位签名。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandhom jiġu ommi u missieri għal-laqgħa? Lara: Le, biżżejjed jiġi ġenitur wieħed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do both my mother and father need to come to the meeting? Lara: No, one parent is enough.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我妈妈和爸爸都需要来开会吗？Lara：不用，父母中的一位来就可以。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandhom jiġu ommi u missieri għal-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandhom jiġu ommi u missieri għal-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 我妈妈和爸爸都需要来开会吗？
messages.en: Do both my mother and father need to come to the meeting?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.zh: 不用，父母中的一位来就可以。
messages.en: No, one parent is enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象家长签名栏只需要爸爸或妈妈一人签字：ġenitur 指父母中的一位，搭配 wieħed 更能突出“一位”。

gloss_zh: 巧妙的；才思出众的；和善可亲的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing exceptional cleverness or inventiveness; also pleasant and friendly in manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容想法或人极其聪明、有巧思；也可形容人的举止和善可亲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri intelliġenza jew ħila kreattiva kbira; jew li jkun simpatiku u pjaċevoli fil-mod kif jittratta lin-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 才思出众的；构思巧妙的
和善可亲的；令人愉快的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta soluzzjoni ġenjali li tnaqqas l-ispejjeż mingħajr ma tnaqqas il-kwalità.
formal.en: The report presents an ingenious solution that reduces costs without reducing quality.
formal.zh: 报告提出了一个巧妙的解决办法，既降低成本，又不降低质量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien l-ospitant ilbieraħ? Mark: Kien ġenjali ħafna; laqagħna bi tbissima u għamilna nħossuna komdi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the host like yesterday? Mark: He was very pleasant; he welcomed us with a smile and made us feel comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：昨天的主人怎么样？马克：他非常和善，笑着迎接我们，让我们觉得很自在。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的主人怎么样？
messages.en: What was the host like yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien ġenjali ħafna; laqagħna bi tbissima u għamilna nħossuna komdi.
messages.mt_standard: Kien ġenjali ħafna; laqagħna bi tbissima u għamilna nħossuna komdi.
messages.zh: 他非常和善，笑着迎接我们，让我们觉得很自在。
messages.en: He was very pleasant; he welcomed us with a smile and made us feel comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个画面：巧妙方案让人眼前一亮，和善主人让人心里一暖；分别对应两个义项。

gloss_zh: 讨人喜欢的特质；亲和力

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being pleasant and easy for other people to like.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人令人喜欢、容易让人产生好感的特质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' persuna li tkun simpatika u li n-nies jieħdu gost biha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讨人喜欢的特质；令人产生好感的亲和力

formal.mt: Il-ġenjalità tal-preżentatur għenet biex tinħoloq atmosfera rilassata waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The presenter's likeability helped create a relaxed atmosphere during the meeting.
formal.zh: 主持人的亲和力有助于在会议期间营造轻松的气氛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex kulħadd jieħu gost jitkellem ma' Pawlu? Nina: Għandu ġenjalità naturali; jisma' lil kulħadd u jitbissem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does everyone enjoy talking to Pawlu? Nina: He has a natural likeability; he listens to everyone and smiles.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么大家都喜欢和保罗说话？妮娜：他有一种自然的亲和力，会倾听每个人，还总带着笑容。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd jieħu gost jitkellem ma' Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd jieħu gost jitkellem ma' Pawlu?
messages.zh: 为什么大家都喜欢和保罗说话？
messages.en: Why does everyone enjoy talking to Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu ġenjalità naturali; jisma' lil kulħadd u jitbissem.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu ġenjalità naturali; jisma' lil kulħadd u jitbissem.
messages.zh: 他有一种自然的亲和力，会倾听每个人，还总带着笑容。
messages.en: He has a natural likeability; he listens to everyone and smiles.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个让大家愿意靠近和聊天的人，把这个名词记作他身上讨人喜欢的亲和力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a very clever or inventive way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以非常聪明、有巧思或富有创意的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod għaqli u kreattiv li juri ħila kbira biex tinstab soluzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巧妙地；独具匠心地

formal.mt: L-inġiniera solviet il-problema ġenjalment billi użat mill-ġdid il-materjal li kien diġà disponibbli.
formal.en: The engineer solved the problem ingeniously by reusing material that was already available.
formal.zh: 这位工程师重新利用现有材料，巧妙地解决了问题。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif irnexxielek iddaħħal dawk il-kotba kollha fuq xkaffa waħda? Lara: Irranġajthom ġenjalment: il-kbar mimdudin u ż-żgħar fuqhom.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did you manage to fit all those books on one shelf? Lara: I arranged them ingeniously: the big ones lying flat and the small ones on top.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你怎么把那些书全放进一层书架的？拉拉：我巧妙地安排了一下：大书平放，小书放在上面。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irnexxielek iddaħħal dawk il-kotba kollha fuq xkaffa waħda?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irnexxielek iddaħħal dawk il-kotba kollha fuq xkaffa waħda?
messages.zh: 你怎么把那些书全放进一层书架的？
messages.en: How did you manage to fit all those books on one shelf?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irranġajthom ġenjalment: il-kbar mimdudin u ż-żgħar fuqhom.
messages.mt_standard: Irranġajthom ġenjalment: il-kbar mimdudin u ż-żgħar fuqhom.
messages.zh: 我巧妙地安排了一下：大书平放，小书放在上面。
messages.en: I arranged them ingeniously: the big ones lying flat and the small ones on top.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在动作旁边记：怎样解决、怎样设计？回答是巧妙地，强调做事的方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who puts things aside or sets them apart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西移到一边或另行放置的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li twarrab affarijiet jew tqegħedhom fil-ġenb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西放到一边的人；将事物另行放置的人

collocations.en: a person who sets papers aside
a person who sets objects aside

formal.mt: Fit-test, Pawlu huwa deskritt bħala ġennieb: iqiegħed fil-ġenb kull karta li ma jkollux bżonn dak il-ħin.
formal.en: In the text, Pawlu is described as someone who sets things aside: he puts aside every paper he does not need at that moment.
formal.zh: 文中把保罗描述为一个会把东西放到一边的人：当下不需要的纸张，他都会另放一边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex issejjaħ lilek innifsek ġennieb? Pawlu: Għax inwarrab il-karti li ma jkollix bżonn u nżommhom f'kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you call yourself someone who sets things aside? Pawlu: Because I put aside papers I do not need and keep them in a box.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说自己是个爱把东西放到一边的人？保罗：因为我会把不需要的纸张另放一边，收在盒子里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说自己是个爱把东西放到一边的人？
messages.en: Why do you call yourself someone who sets things aside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax inwarrab il-karti li ma jkollix bżonn u nżommhom f'kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax inwarrab il-karti li ma jkollix bżonn u nżommhom f'kaxxa.
messages.zh: 因为我会把不需要的纸张另放一边，收在盒子里。
messages.en: Because I put aside papers I do not need and keep them in a box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把桌上的纸一张张移到旁边；这个名词指做这个动作的人。

gloss_zh: 有把东西放到一边的倾向或能力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency or an ability to put things aside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有把东西移到一边、另行放置的倾向或能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jew il-ħila li jwarrab affarijiet jew iqegħedhom fil-ġenb.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the tendency or ability to set aside
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有将东西放到一边的倾向或能力的

collocations.en: a person inclined to set things aside
collocations.zh: 倾向于把东西另放一边的人

collocations.en: a disposition to set things aside
collocations.zh: 爱把东西另放一边的性情

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lil Pawlu bħala bniedem ġenniebi, għax għandu t-tendenza li jqiegħed fil-ġenb l-oġġetti li ma jużax.
formal.en: The author describes Pawlu as a person inclined to set things aside, because he tends to put aside objects he does not use.
formal.zh: 作者形容保罗有把东西另放一边的倾向，因为他常把不用的物品移到旁边。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu hu ġenniebi, hux? Mark: Iva, dejjem iwarrab l-affarijiet li ma jkollux bżonn dak il-ħin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Pawlu tends to set things aside, doesn't he? Mark: Yes, he always puts aside things he does not need at that moment.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗有把东西另放一边的习惯，对吧？马克：对，他总会把当下不需要的东西移到旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗有把东西另放一边的习惯，对吧？
messages.en: Pawlu tends to set things aside, doesn't he?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dejjem iwarrab l-affarijiet li ma jkollux bżonn dak il-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dejjem iwarrab l-affarijiet li ma jkollux bżonn dak il-ħin.
messages.zh: 对，他总会把当下不需要的东西移到旁边。
messages.en: Yes, he always puts aside things he does not need at that moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 配着人的特点来记：这个人惯于或善于把东西放到一边；这里用形容词描述倾向或能力。

gloss_zh: 种族灭绝实施者；种族灭绝的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who carries out genocide.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 实施种族灭绝行为的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li twettaq ġenoċidju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 种族灭绝实施者
种族灭绝的；旨在实施种族灭绝的

collocations.zh: 被定罪的种族灭绝实施者

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-mexxej huwa ġenoċida li jordna l-qerda ta' grupp etniku.
formal.en: In the novel, the leader is a perpetrator of genocide who orders the destruction of an ethnic group.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，那位领导人是一个种族灭绝实施者，下令毁灭一个族群。

colloquial.mt: Nina: F'dan il-kapitlu, ġenoċida tfisser persuna? Mark: Iva, tfisser persuna li twettaq ġenoċidju; iżda f'politika ġenoċida, il-kelma hija aġġettiv.
