colloquial.en: Nina: In this chapter, does ġenoċida refer to a person? Mark: Yes, it means a person who carries out genocide; but in politika ġenoċida, the word is an adjective.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：在这一章里，ġenoċida 指的是人吗？马克：对，指实施种族灭绝的人；但在 politika ġenoċida 中，这个词是形容词。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 在这一章里，ġenoċida 指的是人吗？
messages.en: In this chapter, does ġenoċida refer to a person?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tfisser persuna li twettaq ġenoċidju; iżda f'politika ġenoċida, il-kelma hija aġġettiv.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tfisser persuna li twettaq ġenoċidju; iżda f'politika ġenoċida, il-kelma hija aġġettiv.
messages.zh: 对，指实施种族灭绝的人；但在 politika ġenoċida 中，这个词是形容词。
messages.en: Yes, it means a person who carries out genocide; but in politika ġenoċida, the word is an adjective.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张词性卡片记忆：名词卡写实施者，形容词卡写种族灭绝的，再用搭配判断是哪一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The intentional destruction, in whole or in part, of a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蓄意全部或部分毁灭某个民族、族裔、种族或宗教群体的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qerda intenzjonata, sħiħa jew parzjali, ta' grupp nazzjonali, etniku, razzjali jew reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 种族灭绝；蓄意全部或部分毁灭特定民族、族裔、种族或宗教群体的行为

formal.mt: Il-wirja tfakkar lill-vittmi tal-ġenoċidju u tħeġġeġ lill-viżitaturi jirriflettu fuq il-prevenzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The exhibition commemorates the victims of genocide and encourages visitors to reflect on its prevention.
formal.zh: 展览纪念种族灭绝的受害者，并鼓励参观者思考如何预防这种暴行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex kienet il-lezzjoni tal-lum? Pawlu: Fuq il-ġenoċidju, it-tifsira tal-kelma u l-importanza li jitħarsu l-gruppi mhedda.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was today's lesson about? Pawlu: Genocide, the meaning of the word, and the importance of protecting threatened groups.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天的课讲了什么？保罗：讲了种族灭绝、这个词的含义，以及保护受威胁群体的重要性。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 今天的课讲了什么？
messages.en: What was today's lesson about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-ġenoċidju, it-tifsira tal-kelma u l-importanza li jitħarsu l-gruppi mhedda.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-ġenoċidju, it-tifsira tal-kelma u l-importanza li jitħarsu l-gruppi mhedda.
messages.zh: 讲了种族灭绝、这个词的含义，以及保护受威胁群体的重要性。
messages.en: Genocide, the meaning of the word, and the importance of protecting threatened groups.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词放在历史课主题栏里记，抓住蓄意毁灭特定群体这一核心含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To split something, make it crack, or shake it vigorously.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物劈开或弄裂，也可指用力、猛烈地摇动某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqsam xi ħaġa, iġegħelha tinqasam jew tixxaqqaq, jew iħarrek xi ħaġa bis-saħħa 'l hemm u 'l hawn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 劈开、分裂开，使某物分成几部分。
使裂开、弄裂。
用力摇动、猛烈摇晃。

formal.mt: L-istruzzjonijiet fuq it-tikketta jgħidu: 'Ġenġel il-flixkun sew qabel l-użu, bl-għatu magħluq.'
formal.en: The instructions on the label say: 'Shake the bottle vigorously before use, with the cap closed.'
formal.zh: 标签上的说明写道：“使用前盖好瓶盖，用力摇晃瓶子。”

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ġenġel il-flixkun sew qabel tferra' l-meraq. Ben: Tajjeb, l-għatu magħluq. Issa nħawdu sew.
colloquial.en: Rita: Shake the bottle vigorously before pouring the juice. Ben: Okay, the cap is closed. I'll give it a good shake now.
colloquial.zh: Rita：倒果汁前，用力摇晃一下瓶子。Ben：好，瓶盖已经盖紧了。我现在把它摇匀。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġenġel il-flixkun sew qabel tferra' l-meraq.
messages.mt_standard: Ġenġel il-flixkun sew qabel tferra' l-meraq.
messages.zh: 倒果汁前，用力摇晃一下瓶子。
messages.en: Shake the bottle vigorously before pouring the juice.

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, l-għatu magħluq. Issa nħawdu sew.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, l-għatu magħluq. Issa nħawdu sew.
messages.zh: 好，瓶盖已经盖紧了。我现在把它摇匀。
messages.en: Okay, the cap is closed. I'll give it a good shake now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个动作画面记忆：把东西劈开、把硬壳弄裂、把瓶子猛摇；前两义看分裂结果，第三义看摇动过程。

gloss_zh: 在地理上；从地理角度看

teaching_sense.en_definition: In terms of geographical location, distance, or physical features.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从地理位置、距离或自然地理特征的角度来说。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mil-lat tal-pożizzjoni, tad-distanzi jew tal-karatteristiċi ġeografiċi ta' post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在地理上；从地理位置或地理特征来看

formal.mt: Għalkemm iż-żewġ irħula huma ġeografikament qrib, il-vjaġġ bejniethom jieħu fit-tul minħabba n-nuqqas ta' triq diretta.
formal.en: Although the two villages are geographically close, travelling between them takes a long time because there is no direct road.
formal.zh: 虽然这两个村庄地理位置接近，但由于没有直达道路，往返两地需要很长时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn iż-żewġ postijiet huma qrib? Mark: Ġeografikament iva, imma bil-karozza trid iddur mal-muntanja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are these two places close? Mark: Geographically, yes, but by car you have to go around the mountain.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这两个地方近吗？马克：从地理位置看是近的，不过开车得绕过那座山。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅客)
messages.zh: 这两个地方近吗？
messages.en: Are these two places close?

messages.speaker: Mark (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġeografikament iva, imma bil-karozza trid iddur mal-muntanja.
messages.mt_standard: Ġeografikament iva, imma bil-karozza trid iddur mal-muntanja.
messages.zh: 从地理位置看是近的，不过开车得绕过那座山。
messages.en: Geographically, yes, but by car you have to go around the mountain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先展开地图再说话：这个副词提醒听者，接下来的判断是从地理位置或地形角度作出的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who studies places, landscapes, and the relationship between people and their environment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究地方、地貌以及人与环境之间关系的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tistudja l-postijiet, il-pajsaġġi u r-relazzjoni bejn in-nies u l-ambjent tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地理学家；从事地理研究的人。

formal.mt: Il-ġeografu studja kif ix-xmara bidlet il-pajsaġġ tar-reġjun.
formal.en: The geographer studied how the river changed the landscape of the region.
formal.zh: 这位地理学家研究了河流如何改变该地区的地貌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jkellimna dwar il-mapep? Mark: Ġeografu li jistudja l-ibliet u l-irħula.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to talk to us about maps? Mark: A geographer who studies cities and villages.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁要来给我们讲地图？马克：一位研究城市和村庄的地理学家。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 谁要来给我们讲地图？
messages.en: Who is going to talk to us about maps?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġeografu li jistudja l-ibliet u l-irħula.
messages.mt_standard: Ġeografu li jistudja l-ibliet u l-irħula.
messages.zh: 一位研究城市和村庄的地理学家。
messages.en: A geographer who studies cities and villages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġeografu 和“拿着地图研究山川与城市的人”这一画面绑定，记住它指地理学家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who studies geometry, including shapes, sizes, and spatial relationships.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究形状、大小和空间关系等几何问题的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tistudja l-ġeometrija, inklużi l-forom, id-daqsijiet u r-relazzjonijiet fl-ispazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 几何学家；研究几何学的人。

formal.mt: Il-ġeometra ppreżenta prova dwar il-proprjetajiet tat-trijangoli.
formal.en: The geometer presented a proof concerning the properties of triangles.
formal.zh: 这位几何学家提出了一个关于三角形性质的证明。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min jista' jispjegalna din il-prova? Pawlu: Il-ġeometra li ġie l-iskola lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who can explain this proof to us? Pawlu: The geometer who came to the school yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁能给我们解释这个证明？保罗：昨天来学校的那位几何学家。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 谁能给我们解释这个证明？
messages.en: Who can explain this proof to us?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 昨天来学校的那位几何学家。
messages.en: The geometer who came to the school yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 ġeometra 站在黑板前证明三角形定理；把整词记成“研究几何的人”，并留意末尾字母 a。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The branch of mathematics that studies shapes, sizes, positions, and spatial relationships.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究形状、大小、位置和空间关系的数学分支。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fergħa tal-matematika li tistudja l-forom, id-daqsijiet, il-pożizzjonijiet u r-relazzjonijiet fl-ispazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 几何学；研究图形及空间关系的数学学科。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-ġeometrija, l-istudenti tgħallmu jikkalkulaw l-erja ta' trijangolu.
formal.en: In the geometry lesson, the students learned to calculate the area of a triangle.
formal.zh: 在几何课上，学生们学习了如何计算三角形的面积。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għandna wara l-brejk? Ben: Għandna l-ġeometrija; tinsiex il-ħakkiem.
colloquial.en: Sara: What do we have after the break? Ben: We have geometry; don't forget your ruler.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：课间休息后我们上什么课？本：上几何课，别忘了带尺子。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 课间休息后我们上什么课？
messages.en: What do we have after the break?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 上几何课，别忘了带尺子。
messages.en: We have geometry; don't forget your ruler.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġeometrija 写在画有圆、三角形和正方形的课本封面上，用“图形学科”这一画面记住几何学。

gloss_zh: 以几何方式；从几何角度

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that uses geometry or considers geometric shapes and relationships.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 采用几何方法，或从图形及其空间关系的角度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juża l-ġeometrija jew iqis il-forom u r-relazzjonijiet ġeometriċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以几何方式；用几何方法；从几何角度。

formal.mt: Ir-relazzjoni bejn iż-żewġ kwantitajiet tista' tiġi rrappreżentata ġeometrikament permezz ta' rettangolu.
formal.en: The relationship between the two quantities can be represented geometrically using a rectangle.
formal.zh: 这两个量之间的关系可以借助矩形以几何方式表示。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Bil-formuli qed nitħawwad. Adam: Ipprova ssolviha ġeometrikament: pinġi trijangolu.
colloquial.en: Nina: I'm getting confused by the formulas. Adam: Try solving it geometrically: draw a triangle.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些公式把我弄糊涂了。亚当：试着用几何方法解吧，画一个三角形。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这些公式把我弄糊涂了。
messages.en: I'm getting confused by the formulas.

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.zh: 试着用几何方法解吧，画一个三角形。
messages.en: Try solving it geometrically: draw a triangle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ġeometrikament，就想象把一道题画成图来解；它回答“怎样解”，因此记作“用几何方法”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who studies mathematical shapes and spatial relationships as a specialist in geometry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专门研究数学图形和空间关系的几何学研究者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tispeċjalizza fil-ġeometrija u tistudja l-forom matematiċi u r-relazzjonijiet fl-ispazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 几何学家；专门研究几何学的人。

collocations.zh: 一位精通几何学的专家

formal.mt: Il-ġeometru analizza r-relazzjoni bejn l-angoli u l-ġnub tal-figura.
formal.en: The geometer analyzed the relationship between the angles and the sides of the figure.
formal.zh: 这位几何学家分析了该图形的角与边之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Min kiteb dan il-ktieb dwar iċ-ċrieki? David: Ġeometru li jispjega kollox bi tpinġijiet ċari.
colloquial.en: Elena: Who wrote this book about circles? David: A geometer who explains everything with clear drawings.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这本关于圆的书是谁写的？戴维：一位用清晰的图画解释所有内容的几何学家。

messages.speaker: Elena (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min kiteb dan il-ktieb dwar iċ-ċrieki?
messages.mt_standard: Min kiteb dan il-ktieb dwar iċ-ċrieki?
messages.zh: 这本关于圆的书是谁写的？
messages.en: Who wrote this book about circles?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġeometru li jispjega kollox bi tpinġijiet ċari.
messages.mt_standard: Ġeometru li jispjega kollox bi tpinġijiet ċari.
messages.zh: 一位用清晰的图画解释所有内容的几何学家。
messages.en: A geometer who explains everything with clear drawings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ġeometru 配一张“学者拿圆规研究图形”的词卡，记住它指人，并特别看清词尾的 u。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tolerate a person or endure something unpleasant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容忍某个人，或承受令人不快的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jissaporti persuna jew xi ħaġa li ddejqu jew tqabbdu tbatija.

sense_translations.en_definition: to bear or put up with sb. or sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 忍受、容忍某人或某事。
吞下；咽下。
消化食物。

collocations.en: he put up with the insults

formal.mt: Għal żmien twil, il-ħaddiem ġeragħ l-insulti mingħajr ma lmenta.
formal.en: For a long time, the worker put up with the insults without complaining.
formal.zh: 很长一段时间里，这名工人忍受着侮辱，没有抱怨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu reġa' kellu jisma' dawk il-kummenti? Mark: Iva, ġeragħ kollox u baqa' kalm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu have to listen to those comments again? Mark: Yes, he put up with everything and stayed calm.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗又得听那些话了吗？马克：是啊，他全都忍了下来，保持着冷静。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu reġa' kellu jisma' dawk il-kummenti?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu reġa' kellu jisma' dawk il-kummenti?
messages.zh: 保罗又得听那些话了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu have to listen to those comments again?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġeragħ kollox u baqa' kalm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġeragħ kollox u baqa' kalm.
messages.zh: 是啊，他全都忍了下来，保持着冷静。
messages.en: Yes, he put up with everything and stayed calm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个独立画面记 ġeragħ：忍住难听的话、咽下一口食物、肚子消化食物；这是义项联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move to one side, leaving space for someone or something to pass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向旁边移动，为人或物留出通过的空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur lejn il-ġenb biex iħalli spazju għal xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa tgħaddi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移到一旁；往旁边挪开。

collocations.mt: ġerben biex iħalli lil xi ħadd jgħaddi
collocations.en: he moved aside to let someone pass

formal.mt: Il-viżitatur ġerben lejn il-ġenb biex iħalli lill-persunal jgħaddi mill-kuritur.
formal.en: The visitor moved aside to let the staff pass through the corridor.
formal.zh: 这位访客挪到一旁，让工作人员从走廊通过。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif għadda r-raġel bil-kaxxa minn hemm? Ben: Mark ġerben u ħallieh jgħaddi.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did the man with the box get through there? Ben: Mark moved aside and let him pass.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那个抱着箱子的人怎么从那里过去的？本：马克挪到了一旁，让他过去了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għadda r-raġel bil-kaxxa minn hemm?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għadda r-raġel bil-kaxxa minn hemm?
messages.zh: 那个抱着箱子的人怎么从那里过去的？
messages.en: How did the man with the box get through there?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克挪到了一旁，让他过去了。
messages.en: Mark moved aside and let him pass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象狭窄走廊里有人抱着箱子过来，你往旁边挪一步；把这个让路动作和 ġerben 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An amount swallowed at once, especially a large mouthful of liquid, or the act of swallowing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次咽下的量，尤指一大口液体；也指这样一次吞咽的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont li jinbela' f'daqqa, speċjalment ammont kbir ta' likwidu, jew l-att li tibla' dak l-ammont.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一大口；一次吞咽，尤指喝下液体时的一口。

formal.mt: Wara l-ġirja, l-atleta xorob ġergħa ilma u qagħad jistrieħ fid-dell.
formal.en: After the run, the athlete drank a gulp of water and rested in the shade.
formal.zh: 跑步结束后，这名运动员喝了一大口水，在阴凉处休息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid ftit ilma? Pawlu: Iva, grazzi. Nagħti ġergħa u nkomplu nimxu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like some water? Pawlu: Yes, thanks. I'll take a gulp and then we'll keep walking.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：要喝点水吗？保罗：要，谢谢。我喝一大口，然后我们继续走。

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 要喝点水吗？
messages.en: Would you like some water?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Nagħti ġergħa u nkomplu nimxu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Nagħti ġergħa u nkomplu nimxu.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。我喝一大口，然后我们继续走。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. I'll take a gulp and then we'll keep walking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġergħa 配上“咕咚喝下一大口水”的画面；重点记住它是名词，表示这一口或这一次吞咽。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman or girl from Germany.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自德国的女子或女孩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara jew tifla mill-Ġermanja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 德国人；此处指德国女性。

collocations.en: a German woman who lives in Malta
collocations.zh: 一位住在马耳他的德国女子

collocations.en: I speak with a German woman
collocations.zh: 我与一位德国女子交谈

formal.mt: Il-mistiedna hija Ġermaniża li tgħix Malta u tistudja l-Malti.
formal.en: The guest is a German woman who lives in Malta and studies Maltese.
formal.zh: 这位女嘉宾是德国人，住在马耳他并学习马耳他语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn hi Anna? Mark: Hi Ġermaniża, imma issa tgħix hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Anna from? Mark: She's German, but she lives here now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：安娜来自哪里？马克：她是德国人，不过现在住在这里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 安娜来自哪里？
messages.en: Where is Anna from?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hi Ġermaniża, imma issa tgħix hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Hi Ġermaniża, imma issa tgħix hawn.
messages.zh: 她是德国人，不过现在住在这里。
messages.en: She's German, but she lives here now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把安娜的国籍介绍想成一张人物卡：Ġermaniża 对应德国女子，先记人，再记国籍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element germanium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素锗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku magħruf bħala ġermanju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锗，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun ta' ġermanju tqiegħed f'kontenitur bit-tikketta tiegħu.
formal.en: The germanium sample was placed in a container with its label.
formal.zh: 锗样品被放进了带有相应标签的容器中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'hemm f'dan il-kontenitur? Pawlu: Hemm kampjun ta' ġermanju; ara t-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's in this container? Pawlu: There's a sample of germanium; look at the label.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个容器里有什么？保罗：里面有一份锗样品，看看标签。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个容器里有什么？
messages.en: What's in this container?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm kampjun ta' ġermanju; ara t-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm kampjun ta' ġermanju; ara t-tikketta.
messages.zh: 里面有一份锗样品，看看标签。
messages.en: There's a sample of germanium; look at the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġermanju 写在实验室样品瓶标签上，与中文“锗”和英文 germanium 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone a wound or injury, or to hurt someone's feelings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人受伤，或使某人的感情受到伤害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikkawża ferita jew korriment lil xi ħadd, jew iweġġagħlu s-sentimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使受创伤；造成伤口。
使疼痛或难过；伤害。
使身体受到损伤。
用尖锐物刺伤。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, l-aggressur ġerraħ lill-vittma f'idha b'oġġett li jaqta'.
formal.en: According to the report, the attacker wounded the victim's hand with a sharp object.
formal.zh: 据报告，袭击者用锐器伤了受害者的手。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex int imdejjaq? Mark: Dak il-kumment ġerraħ is-sentimenti tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you upset? Mark: That comment hurt my feelings.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么难过？马克：那句话伤了我的感情。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么难过？
messages.en: Why are you upset?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那句话伤了我的感情。
messages.en: That comment hurt my feelings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 ġerraħ：一幅是手上有伤口，一幅是听到伤人话后难过，连接身体与感情上的伤害。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who swallows something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行吞咽或把某物吞下的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tibla' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吞咽者；把东西吞下的人。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-kelma 'ġerriegħ' tindika l-persuna li tibla' l-pillola.
formal.en: In this example, the word 'ġerriegħ' denotes the person who swallows the pill.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，ġerriegħ 一词指吞下药片的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'ġerriegħ'? Pawlu: Persuna li tibla' xi ħaġa, bħal pillola.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'ġerriegħ' mean? Pawlu: A person who swallows something, such as a pill.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：ġerriegħ 是什么意思？保罗：指吞下某种东西的人，比如吞下一片药的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: ġerriegħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ġerriegħ' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna li tibla' xi ħaġa, bħal pillola.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna li tibla' xi ħaġa, bħal pillola.
messages.zh: 指吞下某种东西的人，比如吞下一片药的人。
messages.en: A person who swallows something, such as a pill.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人喝水吞药，把 ġerriegħ 贴在这个人身上：记住它表示吞咽的人，而不是药片。

gloss_zh: 致伤者；造成他人受伤的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who causes a wound or injury to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使他人产生伤口或受到身体损伤的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikkawża ferita jew korriment lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who causes wounding or injury
sense_translations.zh_definition: 致伤者；造成伤口或身体损伤的人。

collocations.en: the identity of the person who caused the injury
the person who caused the injury and the victim

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ġerrieħ u l-feriti li ġarrbet il-vittma.
formal.en: The report describes the person who caused the injuries and the wounds sustained by the victim.
formal.zh: 报告描述了致伤者以及受害者所受的伤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawnhekk, 'ġerrieħ' ifisser il-persuna li ndarbet? Pawlu: Le, ifisser il-persuna li kkawżat il-ferita.
colloquial.en: Lara: Here, does 'ġerrieħ' mean the person who was wounded? Pawlu: No, it means the person who caused the wound.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的 ġerrieħ 指受伤的人吗？保罗：不是，它指造成伤口的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 ġerrieħ 指受伤的人吗？
messages.en: Here, does 'ġerrieħ' mean the person who was wounded?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ifisser il-persuna li kkawżat il-ferita.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ifisser il-persuna li kkawżat il-ferita.
messages.zh: 不是，它指造成伤口的人。
messages.en: No, it means the person who caused the wound.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出“致伤者→受伤者”的箭头，把 ġerrieħ 放在箭头起点，牢记它指造成伤害的人。

gloss_zh: 能致伤的；具有伤害能力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of causing a wound or injury.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够造成伤口或身体损伤的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jikkawża ferita jew korriment.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to wound or injure
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使人受伤或造成身体损伤的能力的。

collocations.en: an object capable of causing injury
an edge capable of causing a wound

formal.mt: L-oġġett għandu tarf ġerrieħi li jista' jikkawża ferita jekk jintmess.
formal.en: The object has an injurious edge that can cause a wound if touched.
formal.zh: 该物体有能致伤的边缘，触碰时可能造成伤口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' naqbad dan b'idi? Mark: Oqgħod attenta, għandu tarf ġerrieħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I pick this up with my hand? Mark: Be careful, it has an edge that can injure you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以用手拿起这个吗？马克：小心，它的边缘会伤人。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我可以用手拿起这个吗？
messages.en: Can I pick this up with my hand?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 小心，它的边缘会伤人。
messages.en: Be careful, it has an edge that can injure you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给锋利边缘贴上“能致伤的”标签来记 ġerrieħi；它描述伤害能力，并不表示已经有人受伤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply chalk to a surface or to cover a surface with plaster.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体表面涂上白垩，或用灰泥覆盖表面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi wiċċ bil-ġibs jew bit-tikħil.

sense_translations.en_definition: to apply chalk to a surface
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在表面涂上白垩。
抹灰；在表面涂覆灰泥。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ġess il-ħajt biex il-wiċċ ikun lixx.
formal.en: The worker plastered the wall to make the surface smooth.
formal.zh: 工人给墙抹了灰，使表面变得平整。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ġess dan il-ħajt? Mark: Il-bennej ġess il-ħajt ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who plastered this wall? Mark: The builder plastered the wall yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这面墙是谁抹的灰？马克：建筑工人昨天给这面墙抹了灰。

messages.speaker: Maja (屋主)
messages.zh: 这面墙是谁抹的灰？
messages.en: Who plastered this wall?

messages.speaker: Mark (装修工人)
messages.zh: 建筑工人昨天给这面墙抹了灰。
messages.en: The builder plastered the wall yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġess 配上工人给墙面抹灰的动作画面，再补一张表面涂白垩的图，成对记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To coat a surface with chalk or plaster.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把白垩或灰泥涂覆在物体表面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħatti wiċċ b'saff ta' ġibs jew tikħil.

sense_translations.en_definition: to apply chalk to a surface
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在表面涂上白垩。
抹灰；在表面涂覆灰泥。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ġesses is-saqaf qabel ma beda x-xogħol taż-żebgħa.
formal.en: The worker plastered the ceiling before starting the painting work.
formal.zh: 工人在开始刷漆之前给天花板抹了灰。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Is-saqaf lest għaż-żebgħa? Pawlu: Iva, il-ħaddiem ġesses is-saqaf u issa nixef.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the ceiling ready for painting? Pawlu: Yes, the worker plastered the ceiling and it's dry now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：天花板可以刷漆了吗？保罗：可以了，工人给天花板抹了灰，现在已经干了。

messages.speaker: Lara (屋主)
messages.zh: 天花板可以刷漆了吗？
messages.en: Is the ceiling ready for painting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (装修工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħaddiem ġesses is-saqaf u issa nixef.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħaddiem ġesses is-saqaf u issa nixef.
messages.zh: 可以了，工人给天花板抹了灰，现在已经干了。
messages.en: Yes, the worker plastered the ceiling and it's dry now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“涂好一层再刷漆”的装修顺序记 ġesses，并把它与 ġess 放在同一张双义词卡上复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who applies plaster to walls or other surfaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在墙壁或其他表面涂抹灰泥的工匠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikħel il-ħitan jew uċuħ oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从事墙面抹灰工作的人；抹灰工。

formal.mt: Il-ġessies se jsewwi l-wiċċ tal-ħajt qabel ma jibda x-xogħol taż-żebgħa.
formal.en: The plasterer will repair the wall surface before the painting work begins.
formal.zh: 抹灰工将在油漆工程开始前修整墙面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna bżonn ġessies għal dan il-ħajt. Mark: Naf wieħed tas-sengħa; nista' nċempillu.
colloquial.en: Maja: We need a plasterer for this wall. Mark: I know a skilled one; I can call him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这面墙需要找个抹灰工来处理。马克：我认识一位手艺好的，可以打电话给他。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna bżonn ġessies għal dan il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna bżonn ġessies għal dan il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 这面墙需要找个抹灰工来处理。
messages.en: We need a plasterer for this wall.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我认识一位手艺好的，可以打电话给他。
messages.en: I know a skilled one; I can call him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġessies 与工匠拿抹刀修平墙面的画面绑定，记住它指做抹灰工作的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of hand and arm movements to express or emphasize something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过手部和手臂动作表达意思或加强语气的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu ta' movimenti tal-idejn u tad-dirgħajn biex wieħed jesprimi jew jenfasizza xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用手势表达或强调意思；说话时的比画动作。

formal.mt: Il-ġestikulazzjoni tal-kelliem għenet lill-udjenza tifhem aħjar l-ispjegazzjoni.
formal.en: The speaker's gesticulation helped the audience understand the explanation better.
formal.zh: 演讲者的手势帮助听众更好地理解了讲解。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed iċaqlaq idejh daqshekk waqt li jitkellem? Pawlu: Dik il-ġestikulazzjoni tgħinu jenfasizza dak li qed jgħid.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is he moving his hands so much while he speaks? Pawlu: That gesticulation helps him emphasize what he is saying.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他为什么说话时手动得这么多？保罗：那些手势能帮他强调自己说的话。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iċaqlaq idejh daqshekk waqt li jitkellem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iċaqlaq idejh daqshekk waqt li jitkellem?
messages.zh: 他为什么说话时手动得这么多？
messages.en: Why is he moving his hands so much while he speaks?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik il-ġestikulazzjoni tgħinu jenfasizza dak li qed jgħid.
messages.mt_standard: Dik il-ġestikulazzjoni tgħinu jenfasizza dak li qed jgħid.
messages.zh: 那些手势能帮他强调自己说的话。
messages.en: That gesticulation helps him emphasize what he is saying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人边说边用双手比画，把整套表达动作记作 ġestikulazzjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The personal name Jesus, referring here to the central figure of Christianity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人名“耶稣”，此处指基督教的核心人物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem personali Ġesù, li hawn jirreferi għall-figura ċentrali tal-Kristjaneżmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耶稣，人名。

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jiddiskuti t-tagħlim ta' Ġesù kif jidher fl-Evanġelji.
formal.en: This chapter discusses the teachings of Jesus as presented in the Gospels.
formal.zh: 本章讨论《福音书》中呈现的耶稣教导。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fuq min hu dan il-ktieb? Mark: Fuq Ġesù u t-tagħlim tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is this book about? Mark: It is about Jesus and his teachings.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这本书是讲谁的？马克：讲耶稣和他的教导。

messages.speaker: Anna (读者)
messages.zh: 这本书是讲谁的？
messages.en: Who is this book about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 讲耶稣和他的教导。
messages.en: It is about Jesus and his teachings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ġesù 整体对应中文人名“耶稣”，书写时同时记住大写 Ġ 和末尾带重音的 ù。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name Jesus Christ, used for the central figure of Christianity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: “耶稣基督”这一称呼，指基督教的核心人物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem Ġesù Kristu, użat għall-figura ċentrali tal-Kristjaneżmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耶稣基督。

formal.mt: L-istudenti kitbu sommarju dwar il-ħajja ta' Ġesù Kristu kif deskritta fl-Evanġelji.
formal.en: The students wrote a summary of the life of Jesus Christ as described in the Gospels.
formal.zh: 学生们根据《福音书》的记述撰写了耶稣基督的生平概要。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-lezzjoni tal-lum? Pawlu: It-tagħlim ta' Ġesù Kristu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the topic of today's lesson? Pawlu: The teachings of Jesus Christ.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天这堂课的主题是什么？保罗：耶稣基督的教导。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 今天这堂课的主题是什么？
messages.en: What is the topic of today's lesson?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 耶稣基督的教导。
messages.en: The teachings of Jesus Christ.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两块记忆：Ġesù 对应“耶稣”，Kristu 对应“基督”；合起来练习完整称呼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's inner sense of right and wrong that guides their actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人内在判断是非、引导行为的良心或良知。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sens ġewwieni li jgħin lil persuna tagħraf it-tajjeb mill-ħażin u jmexxi l-għemil tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 良心；对自身行为的是非判断和道德自觉。

formal.mt: Il-karattru fir-rakkont jisma' l-ġewwenija tiegħu u jagħżel li jgħid il-verità.
formal.en: The character in the story listens to his conscience and chooses to tell the truth.
formal.zh: 故事中的人物听从自己的良心，选择说出真相。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex mort lura biex tħallas? Mark: Il-ġewwenija tiegħi ma ħallitnix nitlaq mingħajr ma nħallas.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you go back to pay? Mark: My conscience would not let me leave without paying.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么又回去付钱了？马克：我的良心不允许我不付钱就走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么又回去付钱了？
messages.en: Why did you go back to pay?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġewwenija tiegħi ma ħallitnix nitlaq mingħajr ma nħallas.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġewwenija tiegħi ma ħallitnix nitlaq mingħajr ma nħallas.
messages.zh: 我的良心不允许我不付钱就走。
messages.en: My conscience would not let me leave without paying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象心里有个提醒自己做对事的声音，把这个“良心提醒”与 ġewwenija 联系起来。

gloss_zh: 吃得很少；生活节俭；避免过度；吃得津津有味

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat only a small amount of food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 只吃少量食物；吃得很少。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiekol biss ammont żgħir ta' ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃得很少；仅吃少量食物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be sparing in one's habits
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在生活习惯上节俭、节制，少用少耗。
避免过量或过度；保持节制。
吃得津津有味；兴致勃勃地享用食物。

collocations.en: ate very little during the meal

formal.mt: Matul l-ikla ta' nofsinhar, Mark ġewweż u kiel biss ftit ħobż.
formal.en: During lunch, Mark ate very little and had only a little bread.
formal.zh: 午餐时，马克吃得很少，只吃了一点面包。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark kiel ħafna llum? Anna: Le, ġewweż; kiel biss ftit soppa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark eat a lot today? Anna: No, he ate very little; he only had a little soup.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克今天吃得多吗？安娜：不多，他吃得很少，只喝了一点汤。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克今天吃得多吗？
messages.en: Did Mark eat a lot today?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ġewweż; kiel biss ftit soppa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ġewweż; kiel biss ftit soppa.
messages.zh: 不多，他吃得很少，只喝了一点汤。
messages.en: No, he ate very little; he only had a little soup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ġewweż 做四张语境卡：少吃、节俭、避免过度、吃得津津有味。尤其把“少吃”和“吃得香”分开记，靠上下文选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated inside something or belonging to its inner part.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于某物里面的，或属于其内部的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab ġewwa xi ħaġa jew jagħmel parti minn ġewwa tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 里面的；内部的。
亲属；与某人有亲属关系的人。
内脏，尤指腹腔内的肠等器官。

formal.mt: Il-pjan juri ħajt ġewwieni li jifred il-kċina mill-kamra tal-ikel.
formal.en: The plan shows an internal wall separating the kitchen from the dining room.
formal.zh: 平面图显示，一道内墙将厨房与餐厅隔开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema bieb irrid nagħlaq? Mark: Agħlaq il-bieb ġewwieni, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which door should I close? Mark: Close the inner door, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我该关哪扇门？马克：请把里面那扇门关上。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我该关哪扇门？
messages.en: Which door should I close?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 请把里面那扇门关上。
messages.en: Close the inner door, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象房子最里面的一扇门，把 ġewwieni 与“内部的”联系起来；另把名词义“亲属”和“内脏”分卡记忆，避免混淆词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who causes others to go hungry by depriving them of sufficient food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人得不到足够食物、让别人挨饿的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġiegħel lil oħrajn ibatu l-ġuħ billi ċċaħħadhom minn ikel biżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使他人挨饿、剥夺他人足够食物的人。

collocations.en: a merciless person who starves others
collocations.zh: 无情地使别人挨饿的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, is-sid huwa deskritt bħala ġewwieħ għax iċaħħad lill-ħaddiema minn ikel biżżejjed.
formal.en: In the story, the owner is described as someone who starves others because he deprives the workers of sufficient food.
formal.zh: 故事把这位主人描写成使别人挨饿的人，因为他不让工人获得足够的食物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex isejħulu ġewwieħ fir-rakkont? Pawlu: Għax ma jagħtix lill-ħaddiema biżżejjed x'jieklu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do they call him someone who starves others in the story? Pawlu: Because he does not give the workers enough to eat.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：故事里为什么称他为使别人挨饿的人？保罗：因为他不给工人足够的食物。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 故事里为什么称他为使别人挨饿的人？
messages.en: Why do they call him someone who starves others in the story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma jagħtix lill-ħaddiema biżżejjed x'jieklu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma jagħtix lill-ħaddiema biżżejjed x'jieklu.
messages.zh: 因为他不给工人足够的食物。
messages.en: Because he does not give the workers enough to eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“有人把食物扣住，别人因此挨饿”的画面记 ġewwieħ，重点记清它指造成挨饿的人。

gloss_zh: 容易使人饥饿的；有致饥倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to make someone feel hungry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使人产生饥饿感的倾向或作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jġib il-ġuħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the propensity to cause hunger
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有引起饥饿的倾向的；容易使人感到饿的。

collocations.en: work that tends to make one hungry
training that tends to make one hungry
collocations.zh: 容易让人产生饥饿感的训练

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, il-parteċipant iddeskriva t-taħriġ bħala ġewwieħi, għax kien iħoss il-ġuħ wara kull sessjoni.
formal.en: In his report, the participant described the training as hunger-inducing because he felt hungry after every session.
formal.zh: 参与者在报告中把这项训练描述为容易使人饥饿，因为他每次训练后都会觉得饿。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan ix-xogħol ġewwieħi; diġà qed inħoss il-ġuħ! Maja: Ejja nieħdu pawża u nieklu xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Mark: This work makes you hungry; I am already feeling hungry! Maja: Let's take a break and eat something.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这活儿真让人饿，我已经觉得饿了！玛雅：咱们休息一下，吃点东西吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ix-xogħol ġewwieħi; diġà qed inħoss il-ġuħ!
messages.mt_standard: Dan ix-xogħol ġewwieħi; diġà qed inħoss il-ġuħ!
messages.zh: 这活儿真让人饿，我已经觉得饿了！
messages.en: This work makes you hungry; I am already feeling hungry!

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieħdu pawża u nieklu xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieħdu pawża u nieklu xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 咱们休息一下，吃点东西吧。
messages.en: Let's take a break and eat something.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象做完一项活动就肚子咕咕叫，用 ġewwieħi 给这种“容易让人饿”的活动贴上形容词标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who uses resources sparingly, or a person who eats only small amounts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 节约使用钱物的人；也指吃得少、食量小的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tuża l-flus u r-riżorsi bil-qies, jew persuna li tiekol ftit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 节俭的人；花钱或使用物品很节省的人。
吃得少的人；食量小的人。

collocations.en: a person who is thrifty with money

formal.mt: Pawlu huwa ġewwież: jippjana x-xiri tiegħu u jevita spejjeż bla bżonn.
formal.en: Pawlu is a thrifty person: he plans his purchases and avoids unnecessary expenses.
formal.zh: 保罗是个节俭的人：他会规划购物，避免不必要的开销。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Inżidlek ftit ikel, Mark? Mark: Le, grazzi. Jien ġewwież fl-ikel; porzjon żgħir biżżejjed għalija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall I give you some more food, Mark? Mark: No, thanks. I eat little; a small portion is enough for me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克，要再给你添点吃的吗？马克：不用，谢谢。我食量小，一小份就够了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克，要再给你添点吃的吗？
messages.en: Shall I give you some more food, Mark?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi. Jien ġewwież fl-ikel; porzjon żgħir biżżejjed għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi. Jien ġewwież fl-ikel; porzjon żgħir biżżejjed għalija.
messages.zh: 不用，谢谢。我食量小，一小份就够了。
messages.en: No, thanks. I eat little; a small portion is enough for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅小画记忆：一个人精打细算，另一个人只吃小份饭。两幅画分别提示“节俭的人”和“食量小的人”，不必把两种特点绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to eat bread together with other food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃其他食物时倾向于搭配面包的；习惯用面包佐餐的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jiekol il-ħobż ma' ikel ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to eat bread with food
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃东西时习惯搭配面包的；喜欢以面包佐餐的。

collocations.en: a man who tends to eat bread with his food
collocations.zh: 习惯用面包佐餐的男子

collocations.en: a boy who tends to eat bread with his food
collocations.zh: 习惯用面包佐餐的男孩

formal.mt: Pawlu huwa ġewwieżi u s-soltu jiekol biċċa ħobż mal-ikla tiegħu.
formal.en: Pawlu tends to eat bread with his food and usually has a piece of bread with his meal.
formal.zh: 保罗习惯用面包佐餐，吃饭时通常会配上一块面包。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid biċċa ħobż mal-ikel? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Jien ġewwieżi u nħobb il-ħobż mal-ikla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a piece of bread with your food? Mark: Yes, thanks. I tend to eat bread with my food and enjoy having it with a meal.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要一块面包配着吃吗？马克：要，谢谢。我习惯用面包佐餐，吃饭时喜欢配面包。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要一块面包配着吃吗？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of bread with your food?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Jien ġewwieżi u nħobb il-ħobż mal-ikla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Jien ġewwieżi u nħobb il-ħobż mal-ikla.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。我习惯用面包佐餐，吃饭时喜欢配面包。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. I tend to eat bread with my food and enjoy having it with a meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每次端来饭菜，旁边总要放一块面包；用这个固定餐桌画面记住 ġewwieżi，重点是“习惯配面包吃”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small spool around which thread is wound for storage or use in sewing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供缠绕、存放缝纫线或在缝纫中使用的小线轴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir li jitkebbeb il-ħajt madwaru biex jinżamm jew jintuża fil-ħjata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 线轴；供缠绕缝纫线的小筒或轴。

formal.mt: Qabel tibda l-ħjata, ipprepara ġewżaq mimli ħajt tal-kulur meħtieġ.
formal.en: Before you begin sewing, prepare a bobbin wound with thread of the required colour.
formal.zh: 开始缝纫前，准备一个绕有所需颜色缝纫线的线轴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ġewżaq bil-ħajt blu? Mark: Fil-kaxxa tal-ħjata, ħdejn l-imqass.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the bobbin with the blue thread? Mark: In the sewing box, beside the scissors.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：绕着蓝线的线轴在哪里？马克：在针线盒里，剪刀旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (缝纫学员)
messages.zh: 绕着蓝线的线轴在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the bobbin with the blue thread?

messages.speaker: Mark (缝纫老师)
messages.zh: 在针线盒里，剪刀旁边。
messages.en: In the sewing box, beside the scissors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġewżaq 写在线轴示意图旁：细线一圈圈绕在小轴上。再对照“满线轴”和“空线轴”，巩固具体物品的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of the face above the eyebrows and below the hairline.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 眉毛上方、发际线下方的面部区域，即额头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-wiċċ 'il fuq mill-ħuġbejn u taħt il-linja tax-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 额头；眉毛上方、发际线下方的部位。

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tar-ritratt, il-persuna għandha ġibha wiesgħa u għajnejn skuri.
formal.en: In the description of the portrait, the person has a broad forehead and dark eyes.
formal.zh: 肖像的文字描述提到，这个人额头宽阔，眼睛颜色深。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi għaraq fuq il-ġibha? Maja: Iva, hawn maktur biex timsaħ wiċċek.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have I got sweat on my forehead? Maja: Yes, here is a handkerchief to wipe your face.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我额头上有汗吗？玛雅：有，给你一块手帕擦擦脸。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我额头上有汗吗？
messages.en: Have I got sweat on my forehead?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn maktur biex timsaħ wiċċek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn maktur biex timsaħ wiċċek.
messages.zh: 有，给你一块手帕擦擦脸。
messages.en: Yes, here is a handkerchief to wipe your face.

cognitive_memory_aid: 指着眉毛上方的额头说 ġibha，再配合擦额头汗水的动作记忆。

gloss_zh: 直布罗陀；直布罗陀海峡

teaching_sense.en_definition: Gibraltar, a peninsula, city and British overseas territory at the southern end of Iberia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 直布罗陀，位于伊比利亚半岛南端的半岛、城市及英国海外领土。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Peniżola, belt u territorju extra-Ewropew tar-Renju Unit fit-tarf tan-nofsinhar tal-Iberja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Gibraltar (a peninsula, city, and overseas territory of the United Kingdom, at the southern end of Iberia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 直布罗陀，位于伊比利亚半岛南端的半岛、城市及英国海外领土。

sense_translations.en_definition: Gibraltar, Strait of Gibraltar (a strait connecting the Mediterranean to the Atlantic between Gibraltar and Morocco; in full, Strait of Gibraltar)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 直布罗陀海峡，位于直布罗陀与摩洛哥之间、连接地中海与大西洋的海峡。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi Ġibiltà fit-tarf tan-nofsinhar tal-Iberja u l-Istrett ta' Ġibiltà bejn Ġibiltà u l-Marokk.
formal.en: The map shows Gibraltar at the southern end of Iberia and the Strait of Gibraltar between Gibraltar and Morocco.
formal.zh: 地图标出了伊比利亚半岛南端的直布罗陀，以及直布罗陀与摩洛哥之间的直布罗陀海峡。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi Ġibiltà fuq il-mappa? Mark: Hawn, fit-tarf tan-nofsinhar tal-Iberja. Lara: U dan hu l-Istrett ta' Ġibiltà? Mark: Iva, jgħaqqad il-Mediterran mal-Atlantiku.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is Gibraltar on the map? Mark: Here, at the southern end of Iberia. Lara: And is this the Strait of Gibraltar? Mark: Yes, it connects the Mediterranean to the Atlantic.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：地图上的直布罗陀在哪里？马克：这里，在伊比利亚半岛南端。拉拉：那这里就是直布罗陀海峡吗？马克：对，它连接地中海与大西洋。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 地图上的直布罗陀在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Gibraltar on the map?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: 这里，在伊比利亚半岛南端。
messages.en: Here, at the southern end of Iberia.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: U dan hu l-Istrett ta' Ġibiltà?
messages.mt_standard: U dan hu l-Istrett ta' Ġibiltà?
messages.zh: 那这里就是直布罗陀海峡吗？
messages.en: And is this the Strait of Gibraltar?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: 对，它连接地中海与大西洋。
messages.en: Yes, it connects the Mediterranean to the Atlantic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上给陆地与海峡分别贴标签：Ġibiltà 是直布罗陀，l-Istrett ta' Ġibiltà 明确表示海峡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Djibouti, a country in East Africa whose official name is the Republic of Djibouti.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吉布提，东非国家，正式名称为吉布提共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Lvant li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika ta' Ġibuti.

sense_translations.en_definition: Djibouti (a country in East Africa; official name: Repubblika ta’ Ġibuti)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吉布提，东非国家；正式名称为吉布提共和国。

formal.mt: Ġibuti huwa pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Lvant, magħruf uffiċjalment bħala r-Repubblika ta' Ġibuti.
formal.en: Djibouti is a country in East Africa, officially known as the Republic of Djibouti.
formal.zh: 吉布提是东非国家，正式名称为吉布提共和国。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fuq liema pajjiż se tagħmel il-preżentazzjoni? Pawlu: Fuq Ġibuti. Nina: Fejn jinsab? Pawlu: Fl-Afrika tal-Lvant.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which country are you going to give your presentation on? Pawlu: Djibouti. Nina: Where is it? Pawlu: In East Africa.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你准备介绍哪个国家？保罗：吉布提。妮娜：它在哪里？保罗：在东非。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq liema pajjiż se tagħmel il-preżentazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq liema pajjiż se tagħmel il-preżentazzjoni?
messages.zh: 你准备介绍哪个国家？
messages.en: Which country are you going to give your presentation on?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 吉布提。
messages.en: Djibouti.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 它在哪里？
messages.en: Where is it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 在东非。
messages.en: In East Africa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作国家卡片，把 Ġibuti、吉布提、Djibouti 并排写在东非地图旁边记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The father of a person's father or mother; a grandfather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 父亲或母亲的父亲，即祖父或外祖父。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Missier il-missier jew missier l-omm ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 祖父；外祖父，即父亲或母亲的父亲。
祖系；血统；家族的祖先渊源。

collocations.en: the grandfather on the mother's side

formal.mt: Il-kitba dwar il-ġidd tal-familja tinkludi tagħrif dwar l-antenati u r-rabtiet bejniethom.
formal.en: The account of the family's ancestry includes information about the ancestors and the relationships between them.
formal.zh: 这份关于家族祖系的记述包含祖先的资料，以及他们之间的亲属关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dan fir-ritratt? Mark: Dan hu l-ġidd tiegħi min-naħa tal-omm. Maja: Jgħix qrib tiegħek? Mark: Iva, immur narah kull nhar ta' Ħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is this in the photograph? Mark: This is my grandfather on my mother's side. Maja: Does he live near you? Mark: Yes, I visit him every Sunday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这位是谁？马克：这是我的外祖父。玛雅：他住得离你近吗？马克：近，我每个星期日都去看他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片里的这位是谁？
messages.en: Who is this in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu l-ġidd tiegħi min-naħa tal-omm.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu l-ġidd tiegħi min-naħa tal-omm.
messages.zh: 这是我的外祖父。
messages.en: This is my grandfather on my mother's side.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他住得离你近吗？
messages.en: Does he live near you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, immur narah kull nhar ta' Ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, immur narah kull nhar ta' Ħadd.
messages.zh: 近，我每个星期日都去看他。
messages.en: Yes, I visit him every Sunday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在家谱上先圈出祖父或外祖父，再看整条祖先脉络，分别记住 ġidd 的亲属义和祖系义。

gloss_zh: 弄脏；污染；使感染麻风病

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something dirty or soiled; also, to infect someone with leprosy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变脏、受到污损；另有使某人感染麻风病的义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħammeġ jew iniġġes xi ħaġa; għandu wkoll is-sens li jinfetta lil xi ħadd bil-lebbra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物污秽；污染某物。
弄脏某物；使某物沾上污物。
使感染麻风病。

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol, il-ħaddiem ġiddem il-ħwejjeġ biż-żebgħa.
formal.en: During the work, the worker soiled his clothes with paint.
formal.zh: 工作时，那名工人用油漆弄脏了衣服。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ġiddem il-mejda? Mark: Jien, biż-żebgħa. Se nnaddafha issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who soiled the table? Mark: I did, with paint. I'll clean it now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把桌子弄脏了？马克：是我，沾上了油漆。我现在就擦干净。

messages.speaker: Maja（室友）
messages.zh: 谁把桌子弄脏了？
messages.en: Who soiled the table?

messages.speaker: Mark（室友）
messages.zh: 是我，沾上了油漆。我现在就擦干净。
messages.en: I did, with paint. I'll clean it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“油漆弄脏衣服”的画面记住这个动作词；再把“使感染麻风病”作为独立义项记忆，不与普通污渍混为一谈。

gloss_zh: 弄脏东西的人；可将麻风病传染给他人的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who dirties things; also, a person who can infect others with leprosy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指弄脏东西的人；另可指能够将麻风病传染给他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħammeġ l-affarijiet; għandu wkoll is-sens ta' persuna li tista' tinfetta lil oħrajn bil-lebbra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄脏东西的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who can infect others with leprosy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够将麻风病传染给他人的人。

collocations.en: a little person who makes things dirty
a careless person who dirties things

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, it-tifel jissejjaħ ġiddiem għax dejjem iħammeġ il-mejda waqt l-ikel.
formal.en: In the story, the boy is called someone who dirties things because he always soils the table while eating.
formal.zh: 故事里，这个男孩被称为弄脏东西的人，因为他吃饭时总把桌子弄脏。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Ara kemm frak ħallejt! Int ġiddiem żgħir illum. Ben: Se niġbor il-frak kollu, omm.
colloquial.en: Mum: Look how many crumbs you left! You're a little mess-maker today. Ben: I'll pick up all the crumbs, Mum.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：看你留下了多少碎屑！今天你真是个弄脏东西的小家伙。本：妈妈，我会把碎屑全收拾干净。

messages.speaker: Omm（母亲）
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm frak ħallejt! Int ġiddiem żgħir illum.
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm frak ħallejt! Int ġiddiem żgħir illum.
messages.zh: 看你留下了多少碎屑！今天你真是个弄脏东西的小家伙。
messages.en: Look how many crumbs you left! You're a little mess-maker today.

messages.speaker: Ben（儿子）
messages.zh: 妈妈，我会把碎屑全收拾干净。
messages.en: I'll pick up all the crumbs, Mum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词贴在“留下满桌碎屑的人”身上，记住它回答“谁弄脏东西”；涉及麻风病时，另按疾病传染者的义项理解。

gloss_zh: 容易弄脏东西的；可能传播麻风病的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to soil or dirty things; also, having the potential to infect others with leprosy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容易于弄脏东西的；另可形容具有传播麻风病可能性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jħammeġ l-affarijiet; għandu wkoll is-sens li jista' jinfetta lil oħrajn bil-lebbra.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to soil or dirty
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易弄脏东西的；有弄脏倾向的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having a potential to infect with leprosy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使他人感染麻风病的可能性的。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to dirty things
an animal that tends to dirty things

formal.mt: Il-karattru huwa deskritt bħala tifel ġiddiemi li spiss iħammeġ ħwejġu waqt il-logħob.
formal.en: The character is described as a boy who tends to dirty things and often soils his clothes while playing.
formal.zh: 这个角色被描述为一个容易弄脏东西的男孩，玩耍时常常弄脏衣服。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kelb tiegħek ġiddiemi; dejjem iħalli t-tajn mal-art. Pawlu: Iva, se nimsaħlu saqajh qabel jidħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Your dog tends to make a mess; he always leaves mud on the floor. Pawlu: Yes, I'll wipe his paws before he comes in.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的狗很容易弄脏东西，总把泥留在地板上。保罗：是啊，我会在它进来前擦干净它的爪子。

messages.speaker: Lara（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelb tiegħek ġiddiemi; dejjem iħalli t-tajn mal-art.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelb tiegħek ġiddiemi; dejjem iħalli t-tajn mal-art.
messages.zh: 你的狗很容易弄脏东西，总把泥留在地板上。
messages.en: Your dog tends to make a mess; he always leaves mud on the floor.

messages.speaker: Pawlu（狗主人）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nimsaħlu saqajh qabel jidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nimsaħlu saqajh qabel jidħol.
messages.zh: 是啊，我会在它进来前擦干净它的爪子。
messages.en: Yes, I'll wipe his paws before he comes in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只总把泥带进屋的狗，用“容易弄脏的”来记形容词功能；疾病义单独记为“有传播麻风病可能性的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chickenpox, the name of an infectious disease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水痘，一种传染病的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-marda infettiva magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala chickenpox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水痘。

formal.mt: L-iskola rċeviet avviż dwar każ ta' ġidri r-riħ fil-klassi.
formal.en: The school received a notice about a case of chickenpox in the class.
formal.zh: 学校收到了一份通知，说明班里出现了一例水痘。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Ben mhux l-iskola llum? Sara: Għandu l-ġidri r-riħ u qiegħed id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why isn't Ben at school today? Sara: He has chickenpox and is at home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：本今天为什么没来上学？萨拉：他得了水痘，现在在家。

messages.speaker: Maja（同学）
messages.zh: 本今天为什么没来上学？
messages.en: Why isn't Ben at school today?

messages.speaker: Sara（同学）
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu l-ġidri r-riħ u qiegħed id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu l-ġidri r-riħ u qiegħed id-dar.
messages.zh: 他得了水痘，现在在家。
messages.en: He has chickenpox and is at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġidri r-riħ 整组记作“水痘”，配上“同学因水痘缺课”的情景；不要拆开词组逐字猜测病名。

gloss_zh: 上臂接种疫苗留下的疤痕

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scar on the upper arm left by an injection given for vaccination against smallpox, measles, or a similar disease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为预防天花、麻疹等疾病而注射疫苗后，在上臂留下的疤痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċikatriċi fil-parti ta' fuq tad-driegħ li tibqa' wara injezzjoni ta' tilqim kontra l-ġidri, il-ħosba jew mard simili.

sense_translations.en_definition: scar in the upper arm caused by the vaccination hypodermic against smallpox, measles etc
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为预防天花、麻疹等疾病而注射疫苗所造成的上臂疤痕。

collocations.en: a vaccination scar on the arm

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni ssemmi ġidrija ċkejkna fil-parti ta' fuq tad-driegħ tax-xellug.
formal.en: The description mentions a tiny vaccination scar on the upper part of the left arm.
formal.zh: 这份描述提到，左上臂有一道很小的接种疤痕。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi dik il-marka fuq id-driegħ? Rita: Dik ġidrija; baqgħet wara t-tilqima.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that mark on your arm? Rita: That's a vaccination scar; it remained after the vaccination.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你手臂上的那个印子是什么？丽塔：那是接种疤痕，打疫苗后留下的。

messages.speaker: Nina（朋友）
messages.zh: 你手臂上的那个印子是什么？
messages.en: What's that mark on your arm?

messages.speaker: Rita（朋友）
messages.zh: 那是接种疤痕，打疫苗后留下的。
messages.en: That's a vaccination scar; it remained after the vaccination.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时用手指向上臂的一处接种印子，把“上臂、疫苗、留下的疤痕”三个要素连成一幅画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cruel or inhuman, showing a serious lack of kindness or concern for suffering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 残酷或不人道的，表现出对他人痛苦缺乏同情和关怀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kattiv u bla ħniena, li ma jurix mogħdrija lejn min ibati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 残酷的；毫无人性的；不人道的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkundanna t-trattament ġiefi tal-priġunieri.
formal.en: The report condemns the inhuman treatment of the prisoners.
formal.zh: 报告谴责了对囚犯的不人道待遇。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak ir-raġel ġiefi; qed jolqot il-kelb. Mark: Ejja nfittxu lil xi ħadd li jista' jgħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: That man is cruel; he's hitting the dog. Mark: Let's find someone who can help.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个男人真残忍，他在打那只狗。马克：我们去找能帮忙的人吧。

messages.speaker: Lara（路人）
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel ġiefi; qed jolqot il-kelb.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel ġiefi; qed jolqot il-kelb.
messages.zh: 那个男人真残忍，他在打那只狗。
messages.en: That man is cruel; he's hitting the dog.

messages.speaker: Mark（同行朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nfittxu lil xi ħadd li jista' jgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nfittxu lil xi ħadd li jista' jgħin.
messages.zh: 我们去找能帮忙的人吧。
messages.en: Let's find someone who can help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“看见别人受苦却毫不同情”的人物画面记住 ġiefi；它表达的是残酷、不人道，语气比一般的“不友好”强。

gloss_zh: 挑动他人打架；挑起争斗

teaching_sense.en_definition: To provoke other people into fighting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过挑衅或煽动，使其他人发生争斗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħajjar jew jipprovoka lil oħrajn biex jiġġieldu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挑动他人打架；煽动别人发生争斗。

collocations.en: he provoked the children into fighting
he provoked the two siblings into fighting
collocations.zh: 他挑动那两个兄弟姐妹争斗

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, it-tifel ġieled lil sħabu billi qal lil kull wieħed li l-ieħor kien insultah.
formal.en: According to the report, the boy provoked his classmates into fighting by telling each one that the other had insulted him.
formal.zh: 根据报告，这个男孩分别告诉两名同学对方辱骂了自己，从而挑动他们打架。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex bdew jiġġieldu Ben u Sam? Lara: Pawlu ġieled liż-żewġ subien; qal lil kull wieħed li l-ieħor kien qed jidħaq bih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Ben and Sam start fighting? Lara: Pawlu provoked the two boys into fighting; he told each one that the other was making fun of him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：本和萨姆为什么打起来了？拉拉：保罗挑动了那两个男孩，他分别告诉他们对方在嘲笑自己。

messages.speaker: Maja（同学）
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex bdew jiġġieldu Ben u Sam?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex bdew jiġġieldu Ben u Sam?
messages.zh: 本和萨姆为什么打起来了？
messages.en: Why did Ben and Sam start fighting?

messages.speaker: Lara（目击同学）
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ġieled liż-żewġ subien; qal lil kull wieħed li l-ieħor kien qed jidħaq bih.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ġieled liż-żewġ subien; qal lil kull wieħed li l-ieħor kien qed jidħaq bih.
messages.zh: 保罗挑动了那两个男孩，他分别告诉他们对方在嘲笑自己。
messages.en: Pawlu provoked the two boys into fighting; he told each one that the other was making fun of him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出三个人：中间的人挑拨，旁边两个人打起来。用这幅图记住本条的施事是“挑动者”，动作对象是被挑动的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short attributive form of tnejn, meaning two; also used for a couple or a small number.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: tnejn（两）的简短定语形式，用于修饰名词；也可表示几个或少量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma qasira ta' tnejn li tintuża ma' nom; tista' tfisser ukoll ftit jew numru żgħir.

sense_translations.en_definition: short attributive form of of tnejn (“two”)
sense_translations.zh_definition: tnejn（两）的简短定语形式，用于修饰名词。
几个；两三个；少量，表示数量不多。

collocations.en: two books; a couple of books
two minutes; a couple of minutes

formal.mt: Għall-qari fil-klassi, l-għalliem għażel ġiex kotba qosra.
formal.en: For classroom reading, the teacher selected a couple of short books.
formal.zh: 老师为课堂阅读选了几本篇幅较短的书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek ġiex minuti biex tgħinni? Ben: Iva, għandi ftit ħin. X'għandek bżonn?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a couple of minutes to help me? Ben: Yes, I have a little time. What do you need?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有几分钟帮我一下吗？本：有，我有一点时间。你需要什么？

messages.speaker: Maja（同学）
messages.zh: 你有几分钟帮我一下吗？
messages.en: Do you have a couple of minutes to help me?

messages.speaker: Ben（同学）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi ftit ħin. X'għandek bżonn?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi ftit ħin. X'għandek bżonn?
messages.zh: 有，我有一点时间。你需要什么？
messages.en: Yes, I have a little time. What do you need?

cognitive_memory_aid: 先伸出两根手指记“两”，再把手指稍微张开联想“少量、几个”；放在名词旁一起记，结合语境判断数量是否精确。

gloss_zh: 二；两个（置于名词前的长式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long attributive form of the numeral meaning two, used before a noun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“二”的数词长式，置于名词前，说明数量为两个。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma twila tan-numru tnejn li tintuża quddiem nom biex tindika kwantità ta' tnejn.

sense_translations.en_definition: long attributive form of of tnejn (“two”)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 数词 tnejn（“二”）置于名词前作修饰语时使用的长式。

formal.mt: Fil-frażi 'ġiext itfal', il-kelma 'ġiext' tindika n-numru ta' tfal.
formal.en: In the phrase 'ġiext itfal', the word 'ġiext' indicates the number of children.
formal.zh: 在短语 ġiext itfal（两个孩子）中，ġiext 表示孩子的数量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'ġiext itfal'? Toni: Tfisser żewġt itfal; hawn 'ġiext' tiġi quddiem in-nom.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'ġiext itfal' mean? Toni: It means two children; here 'ġiext' comes before the noun.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：ġiext itfal 是什么意思？托尼：意思是两个孩子；这里 ġiext 放在名词前。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: ġiext itfal 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ġiext itfal' mean?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser żewġt itfal; hawn 'ġiext' tiġi quddiem in-nom.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser żewġt itfal; hawn 'ġiext' tiġi quddiem in-nom.
messages.zh: 意思是两个孩子；这里 ġiext 放在名词前。
messages.en: It means two children; here 'ġiext' comes before the noun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġiext 和“两名孩子”的画面一起记：看到它站在名词前，就先想到数量“二”。

gloss_zh: 怯懦；意志薄弱；缺乏主动性

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cowardice, weakness of will or character, or a lack of initiative that keeps someone from acting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指怯懦、意志或性格软弱，也可指缺乏主动采取行动的精神。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' kuraġġ, dgħufija fir-rieda jew fil-karattru, jew nuqqas ta' inizjattiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怯懦；面对危险或困难时缺乏勇气。
意志或性格软弱；缺乏坚持立场或采取行动的决心。
缺乏主动性；不愿或不能主动开始行动。

collocations.en: cowardice in the face of danger
a sign of cowardice or weakness of character
collocations.zh: 怯懦或性格软弱的表现

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġifaġni tal-karattru żammitu milli jiddefendi lil sieħbu.
formal.en: In the story, the character's cowardice prevented him from defending his companion.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个人物因怯懦而没有挺身维护自己的同伴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karattru ma għenx lil sieħbu? Mark: Minħabba l-ġifaġni tiegħu; beża' jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't the character help his companion? Mark: Because of his cowardice; he was afraid to speak up.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个人物为什么没有帮助同伴？马克：因为他怯懦，害怕站出来说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru ma għenx lil sieħbu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru ma għenx lil sieħbu?
messages.zh: 这个人物为什么没有帮助同伴？
messages.en: Why didn't the character help his companion?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 因为他怯懦，害怕站出来说话。
messages.en: Because of his cowardice; he was afraid to speak up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“怕、软、等”串起三个义项：害怕面对、意志软弱、等待别人先行动；这是记义提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a commotion by behaving noisily or causing a disturbance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出喧闹声或引起骚动，使周围不得安静。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel storbju jew qajjem għagħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喧闹；闹出动静；引起骚动。

collocations.en: he made a commotion in the street
he made a commotion in front of the door

formal.mt: Ir-raġel ġileb quddiem il-bieb sakemm ħareġ xi ħadd biex ikellmu.
formal.en: The man made a commotion in front of the door until someone came out to speak to him.
formal.zh: 那名男子在门前吵闹，直到有人出来与他说话。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu ġileb hekk? Ben: Ried jiġbed l-attenzjoni ta' dawk li kienu ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu make such a commotion? Ben: He wanted to get the attention of the people inside.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗为什么闹得这么厉害？本：他想引起屋里那些人的注意。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么闹得这么厉害？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu make such a commotion?

messages.speaker: Ben (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jiġbed l-attenzjoni ta' dawk li kienu ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Ried jiġbed l-attenzjoni ta' dawk li kienu ġewwa.
messages.zh: 他想引起屋里那些人的注意。
messages.en: He wanted to get the attention of the people inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门前有人吵得大家都回头：ġileb 要记成“闹出动静”这个动作，而不是声音本身。

gloss_zh: 庆典欢庆（尤指婚庆）；欢乐

teaching_sense.en_definition: Festivities, especially wedding celebrations, or the joy associated with celebration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指欢庆活动，尤其是婚礼相关的庆祝，也可指欢乐之情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċelebrazzjonijiet, speċjalment dawk marbuta mat-tiġijiet, jew ferħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欢庆活动；庆典，尤其指婚礼相关的庆祝。
欢乐；喜悦之情。

collocations.en: a day of celebration and joy

formal.mt: Wara ċ-ċerimonja taż-żwieġ, il-familja nġabret għall-ġili.
formal.en: After the marriage ceremony, the family gathered for the festivities.
formal.zh: 结婚仪式结束后，全家聚在一起欢庆。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Se nibqgħu għall-ġili wara t-tieġ? David: Iva, irridu niċċelebraw mal-għarajjes.
colloquial.en: Lina: Are we staying for the festivities after the wedding? David: Yes, we want to celebrate with the newlyweds.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：婚礼后我们留下来参加庆祝吗？戴维：是的，我们想和新人一起庆祝。

messages.speaker: Lina (婚礼宾客)
messages.zh: 婚礼后我们留下来参加庆祝吗？
messages.en: Are we staying for the festivities after the wedding?

messages.speaker: David (婚礼宾客)
messages.zh: 是的，我们想和新人一起庆祝。
messages.en: Yes, we want to celebrate with the newlyweds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġili 配上婚宴欢笑的画面：外面是欢庆活动，心里是喜悦，两个义项一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procession: a group of people moving together in an ordered line or formation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按一定次序一起前进的队伍，或这种列队行进的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies li jimxu flimkien f'ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行进队伍；按次序前进的队列。

formal.mt: Il-ġilwa għaddiet mill-pjazza u kompliet lejn il-knisja.
formal.en: The procession passed through the square and continued towards the church.
formal.zh: 队伍穿过广场，继续向教堂前进。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed jistennew in-nies hawn? Pietru: Se tgħaddi l-ġilwa; ejja noqogħdu fil-ġenb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are people waiting here? Pietru: The procession is about to pass; let's stand to the side.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：大家为什么在这里等着？彼得：队伍快要经过了，我们站到旁边吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家为什么在这里等着？
messages.en: Why are people waiting here?

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tgħaddi l-ġilwa; ejja noqogħdu fil-ġenb.
messages.mt_standard: Se tgħaddi l-ġilwa; ejja noqogħdu fil-ġenb.
messages.zh: 队伍快要经过了，我们站到旁边吧。
messages.en: The procession is about to pass; let's stand to the side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一队人依次走过广场”的动态画面记 ġilwa，重点是有次序地一起前进。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To set or congeal, or to become thicker and more viscous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体或柔软物质凝固、凝结，或变得更稠、更黏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar solidu, għaqad jew sar aktar magħqud u inqas fluwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凝固；由液态或柔软状态变得固定成形。
凝结；液体或脂肪等结成较固实的状态。
变稠或变黏；流动性降低。

formal.mt: Wara li t-taħlit kesaħ, ġimed u ma baqax jiċċaqlaq faċilment fil-kontenitur.
formal.en: After the mixture cooled, it thickened and no longer moved easily in the container.
formal.zh: 混合物冷却后变稠了，在容器中不再容易流动。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ix-xaħam m'għadux likwidu? Ninu: Ġimed meta kesaħ.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is the fat no longer liquid? Ninu: It congealed when it cooled.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：脂肪怎么不再是液体了？尼努：它冷却后凝固了。

messages.speaker: Marta (烹饪学员)
messages.zh: 脂肪怎么不再是液体了？
messages.en: Why is the fat no longer liquid?

messages.speaker: Ninu (厨师)
messages.zh: 它冷却后凝固了。
messages.en: It congealed when it cooled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象碗里的液体越来越不容易流动：从变稠到凝结、凝固，用这一条变化线记住三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The skull: the bony structure of the head that surrounds and protects the brain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头部的骨性结构，包围并保护脑部，即头骨或颅骨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istruttura tal-għadam tar-ras li ddawwar u tipproteġi l-moħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头骨；颅骨。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-bijoloġija, l-għalliema użat mudell biex turi kif il-ġimġma tipproteġi l-moħħ.
formal.en: In the biology lesson, the teacher used a model to show how the skull protects the brain.
formal.zh: 生物课上，老师用模型展示头骨如何保护脑部。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-mudell juri l-ġimġma? Rita: Iva, u hawn tista' tara fejn ikun il-moħħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this model show the skull? Rita: Yes, and here you can see where the brain sits.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个模型展示的是头骨吗？丽塔：是的，这里可以看到脑部所在的位置。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个模型展示的是头骨吗？
messages.en: Does this model show the skull?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u hawn tista' tara fejn ikun il-moħħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u hawn tista' tara fejn ikun il-moħħ.
messages.zh: 是的，这里可以看到脑部所在的位置。
messages.en: Yes, and here you can see where the brain sits.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġimġma 想成脑部外面的“骨头保护盔”：记住它指头骨，里面装着的是脑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lime, a mineral substance used in building materials and whitewashing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 石灰，一种用于建筑材料和粉刷等用途的矿物性物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza minerali li tintuża fil-materjali tal-bini u biex jitbajdu l-ħitan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石灰，指这种物质。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema użaw il-ġir biex ibajdu l-ħajt ta' barra.
formal.en: The workers used lime to whitewash the outside wall.
formal.zh: 工人们用石灰刷白了外墙。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'hemm f'dik l-ixkora? Toni: Ġir; se nużawh biex inbajdu l-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's in that sack? Toni: Lime; we're going to use it to whitewash the wall.
colloquial.zh: 马克：那个袋子里装的是什么？托尼：石灰，我们要用它把墙刷白。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.zh: 那个袋子里装的是什么？
messages.en: What's in that sack?

messages.speaker: Toni (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġir; se nużawh biex inbajdu l-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Ġir; se nużawh biex inbajdu l-ħajt.
messages.zh: 石灰，我们要用它把墙刷白。
messages.en: Lime; we're going to use it to whitewash the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短词 ġir 贴在“一袋石灰、一道白墙”的画面上，用建筑材料的场景固定词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tall animal with a very long neck, long legs, and a spotted coat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种脖子和腿很长、身上有斑纹的高大动物，即长颈鹿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal għoli b'għonq u saqajn twal ħafna u b'tikek fuq ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长颈鹿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal b'għonq twil ħafna u b'tikek fuq ġismu.

collocations.en: a giraffe with a long neck

collocations.zh: 一只正在吃树叶的长颈鹿

formal.mt: Il-ġiraff juża għonqu twil biex jilħaq il-weraq fuq il-friegħi għoljin.
formal.en: The giraffe uses its long neck to reach the leaves on high branches.
formal.zh: 长颈鹿用长长的脖子够到高处树枝上的叶子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak il-ġiraff! Kemm hu għoli! Pawlu: Iva, qed jiekol il-weraq minn fuq is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that giraffe! It's so tall! Pawlu: Yes, it's eating leaves from the tree.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看那只长颈鹿！它好高啊！Pawlu：是啊，它正在吃树上的叶子。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-ġiraff! Kemm hu għoli!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-ġiraff! Kemm hu għoli!
messages.zh: 看那只长颈鹿！它好高啊！
messages.en: Look at that giraffe! It's so tall!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jiekol il-weraq minn fuq is-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jiekol il-weraq minn fuq is-siġra.
messages.zh: 是啊，它正在吃树上的叶子。
messages.en: Yes, it's eating leaves from the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġiraff和“伸长脖子吃高处树叶”的画面绑定，看到长脖子就回想这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone gain weight or grow bigger; to give an idea substance or concrete form; or to embody a quality or value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人长胖或体形变大；使想法获得具体内容或形式；或体现某种品质、价值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiżdied fil-piż jew jikber; jagħti forma konkreta lil idea; jew jesprimi kwalità jew valur f'forma li tidher.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sb. gain weight or become bigger
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人体重增加、长胖或体形变大。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiżdied fil-piż jew jikber fil-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某事物获得实质内容；使之具体化。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti kontenut jew forma konkreta lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体现；把某种观念、品质或价值具体表现出来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jesprimi idea, kwalità jew valur f'persuna, azzjoni jew oġġett.

collocations.en: gave the idea concrete form in a model
collocations.zh: 用模型把想法具体呈现出来

collocations.en: food that makes someone gain weight

formal.mt: L-iskultur ġissem l-idea tal-għaqda fi statwa li turi żewġ persuni jgħinu lil xulxin.
formal.en: The sculptor gave the idea of unity concrete form in a statue showing two people helping each other.
formal.zh: 雕塑家用一座表现两人互相帮助的雕像，将团结的理念具体呈现出来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-mudell ġissem l-idea tiegħek sew. Mark: Grazzi! Issa nista' nuri kif se jaħdem il-proġett.
