teaching_sense.en_definition: A reward or recompense given in recognition of effort, service, or good conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为肯定努力、服务或良好表现而给予的奖赏、酬谢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Premju jew ħlas mogħti bħala rikonoxximent għal sforz, servizz jew imġiba tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奖赏、酬谢；本条按所给名词词性理解为所给予的奖赏或酬谢。

formal.mt: Bħala ġiża għas-servizz tagħha, l-għaqda tat ktieb lil kull voluntiera.
formal.en: As a reward for her service, the association gave each female volunteer a book.
formal.zh: 协会给每位女志愿者赠送了一本书，作为对她服务的酬谢。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-ktieb hu għalik, bħala ġiża għall-għajnuna tiegħek. Rita: Grazzi! Kont kuntenta li stajt ngħin.
colloquial.en: Anna: This book is for you, as a reward for your help. Rita: Thank you! I was happy to help.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这本书送给你，作为对你帮忙的酬谢。Rita：谢谢！能帮上忙我很开心。

messages.speaker: Anna (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb hu għalik, bħala ġiża għall-għajnuna tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb hu għalik, bħala ġiża għall-għajnuna tiegħek.
messages.zh: 这本书送给你，作为对你帮忙的酬谢。
messages.en: This book is for you, as a reward for your help.

messages.speaker: Rita (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi! Kont kuntenta li stajt ngħin.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi! Kont kuntenta li stajt ngħin.
messages.zh: 谢谢！能帮上忙我很开心。
messages.en: Thank you! I was happy to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġiża放进“帮了忙，收到一本感谢礼物”的画面，记住它表示奖赏或酬谢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hoary stock, the flowering plant Matthiola incana.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为Matthiola incana的开花植物，中文称紫罗兰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta tal-fjuri magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Matthiola incana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紫罗兰，学名Matthiola incana。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-fjuri bl-isem xjentifiku Matthiola incana.

formal.mt: Fl-attività tal-klassi, l-istudenti osservaw il-fjuri tal-ġiżi u kitbu l-isem xjentifiku Matthiola incana.
formal.en: During the class activity, the students observed the hoary stock flowers and wrote down the scientific name Matthiola incana.
formal.zh: 在课堂活动中，学生们观察了紫罗兰的花，并写下其学名Matthiola incana。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jisimhom dawn il-fjuri? Toni: Dawn huma fjuri tal-ġiżi. Sara: Mela se nikteb l-isem ħdejn it-tpinġija.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are these flowers called? Toni: These are hoary stock flowers. Sara: Then I'll write the name next to the drawing.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这些花叫什么名字？Toni：这些是紫罗兰的花。Sara：那我把名字写在图画旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这些花叫什么名字？
messages.en: What are these flowers called?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.zh: 这些是紫罗兰的花。
messages.en: These are hoary stock flowers.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela se nikteb l-isem ħdejn it-tpinġija.
messages.mt_standard: Mela se nikteb l-isem ħdejn it-tpinġija.
messages.zh: 那我把名字写在图画旁边。
messages.en: Then I'll write the name next to the drawing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张花卉卡片，正面写ġiżi，背面写“紫罗兰、Matthiola incana”，把词与具体植物配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 小片或薄片皮肤；甲小皮

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small or thin piece of skin, including the thin skin at the base of a fingernail or toenail called the cuticle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一小片或很薄的一片皮肤；也指手指甲或脚趾甲根部的薄皮，即甲小皮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira jew rqiqa ta' ġilda; ukoll il-ġilda rqiqa fil-bażi ta' difer.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small or thin piece of skin (the diminutive form of 'ġilda'
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小片或薄薄的一片皮肤；为ġilda的指小形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira jew rqiqa ta' ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甲小皮；指甲或趾甲根部的薄层皮肤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ġilda rqiqa fil-bażi ta' difer.

collocations.en: the cuticle at the base of the nail

formal.mt: Fit-tpinġija tal-id, l-istudenta mmarkat il-ġlejda fil-bażi tad-difer b'linja fina.
formal.en: In the drawing of the hand, the student marked the cuticle at the base of the nail with a fine line.
formal.zh: 在手部示意图中，这名学生用一条细线标出了指甲根部的甲小皮。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed tara din il-ġlejda ħdejn id-difer? Marija: Iva, tidher niexfa. Nina: Innutajtha dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you see this little piece of skin beside the nail? Marija: Yes, it looks dry. Nina: I noticed it this morning.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你看到指甲旁这小片皮了吗？Marija：看到了，看起来有点干。Nina：我今天早上注意到的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara din il-ġlejda ħdejn id-difer?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara din il-ġlejda ħdejn id-difer?
messages.zh: 你看到指甲旁这小片皮了吗？
messages.en: Can you see this little piece of skin beside the nail?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，看起来有点干。
messages.en: Yes, it looks dry.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天早上注意到的。
messages.en: I noticed it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġilda“皮肤”和ġlejda“小片皮肤”成对记，再用指甲根部的一圈薄皮记住甲小皮义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Noisy disturbance or uproar caused by excited, unsettled, or disorderly activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因激动、不安或秩序混乱而出现的嘈杂骚动、喧闹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Storbju u taħwid li jinħolqu minn attività mqanqla jew minn nuqqas ta' ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骚动；伴随声响和混乱活动的扰动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taħwid u storbju waqt attività mqanqla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喧闹；大声吵嚷形成的混乱场面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għajjat u storbju qawwi li joħolqu taħwid.

formal.mt: Il-ġlib fil-kuritur waqqaf il-lezzjoni għal ftit minuti, sakemm reġgħet daħlet il-kwiet.
formal.en: The commotion in the corridor interrupted the lesson for a few minutes, until quiet returned.
formal.zh: 走廊里的喧闹使课堂中断了几分钟，随后才恢复安静。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan il-ġlib barra? Pawlu: It-tfal qed jiġru u jgħajtu fil-bitħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's all this commotion outside? Pawlu: The children are running around and shouting in the courtyard.
colloquial.zh: Maja：外面怎么这么吵？Pawlu：孩子们正在院子里跑来跑去、大声叫喊。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 外面怎么这么吵？
messages.en: What's all this commotion outside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tfal qed jiġru u jgħajtu fil-bitħa.
messages.mt_standard: It-tfal qed jiġru u jgħajtu fil-bitħa.
messages.zh: 孩子们正在院子里跑来跑去、大声叫喊。
messages.en: The children are running around and shouting in the courtyard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 听觉联想：门外突然传来脚步声、喊叫声和一阵混乱，把整片骚动画面记作ġlib。

gloss_zh: 打斗；争吵；斗争；冲突；不和

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fighting, quarrelling, or struggling between people or groups, ranging from verbal disagreement to physical conflict or continuing discord.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人与人或群体之间的打斗、争吵或斗争，可指口头争执、身体冲突，也可指持续的不和。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tilwim, taqbid jew kunflitt bejn persuni jew gruppi, bil-kliem jew bil-forza, jew nuqqas ta' qbil li jibqa' għaddej.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打斗；交战。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqbid bejn persuni jew gruppi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 争吵；口角。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tilwima bil-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斗争；奋力抗争或争夺。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sforz ta' taqbid jew reżistenza kontra xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斗殴；通常伴随吵闹和混乱的打架。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqbid storbjuż u mħawwad bejn persuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冲突；双方利益、立场或行动之间的对抗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kunflitt bejn persuni jew gruppi b'interessi jew pożizzjonijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纷争；持续或激烈的争斗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tilwim jew taqbid qawwi li jibqa' għaddej.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不和；关系中缺乏和谐或一致。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' qbil u armonija bejn persuni jew gruppi.

formal.mt: Il-medjazzjoni għenet biex jintemm il-ġlied bejn iż-żewġ familji u biex jerġa' jibda d-djalogu.
formal.en: Mediation helped end the conflict between the two families and restart dialogue.
formal.zh: 调解有助于结束两家之间的冲突，并使双方重新展开对话。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ġlied bejnkom? Mark: Ma qbilniex dwar il-flus, imma issa se nitkellmu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is there so much quarrelling between you? Mark: We disagreed about money, but now we're going to talk calmly.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你们之间怎么总有这么多争吵？Mark：我们在钱的问题上有分歧，不过现在准备平静地谈谈。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们之间怎么总有这么多争吵？
messages.en: Why is there so much quarrelling between you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma qbilniex dwar il-flus, imma issa se nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Ma qbilniex dwar il-flus, imma issa se nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 我们在钱的问题上有分歧，不过现在准备平静地谈谈。
messages.en: We disagreed about money, but now we're going to talk calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“嘴上争吵、身体打斗、长期不和”三幅画面覆盖ġlied的意义范围，再根据上下文选择中文译法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small ember: a little piece of material that remains hot or glowing after a fire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 火燃烧后留下的、仍然炽热或发红的一小块余烬或炭火。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira li tibqa' sħuna jew tixgħel wara n-nar.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small ember (the diminutive form of 'ġamra')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小块余烬或炭火；为ġamra的指小形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġamra żgħira li għadha sħuna jew tixgħel.

collocations.en: a small ember under the ash

formal.mt: Wara li ntfew il-fjammi, baqgħet ġmajra ħamra taħt saff irqiq ta' rmied.
formal.en: After the flames went out, a small red-glowing ember remained beneath a thin layer of ash.
formal.zh: 火焰熄灭后，一层薄灰下面仍留着一小块发红的余烬。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara, għad hemm ġmajra taħt l-irmied. Toni: Iva, għadha tixgħel. Se nistennew sakemm tintefa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look, there's still a small ember under the ash. Toni: Yes, it's still glowing. We'll wait until it goes out.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看，灰下面还有一小块炭火。Toni：是啊，还红着呢。我们等它熄灭吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (露营同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, għad hemm ġmajra taħt l-irmied.
messages.mt_standard: Ara, għad hemm ġmajra taħt l-irmied.
messages.zh: 看，灰下面还有一小块炭火。
messages.en: Look, there's still a small ember under the ash.

messages.speaker: Toni (露营同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadha tixgħel. Se nistennew sakemm tintefa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadha tixgħel. Se nistennew sakemm tintefa.
messages.zh: 是啊，还红着呢。我们等它熄灭吧。
messages.en: Yes, it's still glowing. We'll wait until it goes out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġamra“余烬”和ġmajra“小块余烬”成对记，想象灰层下只剩一个小红点，突出“小”的意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small group of people, or a small gathering of people in one place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人数不多的一群人，或人们聚在一处的小型聚会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp żgħir ta' nies, jew laqgħa żgħira ta' nies f'post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小群；一个小团体
小型聚会；小规模聚集

collocations.en: a small gathering in the square

formal.mt: Ġmejgħa ta' residenti ltaqgħet fil-pjazza biex tiddiskuti l-indafa tat-triq.
formal.en: A small group of residents met in the square to discuss the cleanliness of the street.
formal.zh: 一小群居民在广场会面，讨论街道清洁问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hemm barra? Mark: Hemm ġmejgħa ta' ħbieb jistennewna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is outside? Mark: There is a small group of friends waiting for us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：外面有谁？马克：有一小群朋友在等我们。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 外面有谁？
messages.en: Who is outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有一小群朋友在等我们。
messages.en: There is a small group of friends waiting for us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几位朋友围成一个小圈：看人数是一小群，看活动就是小聚会，把两个义项连在同一幅画面里记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fields that are not cultivated or used for growing crops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有进行耕作、没有用来种植作物的田地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għelieqi li mhumiex ikkultivati jew użati għat-tkabbir tal-uċuħ tar-raba'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未耕种的田地；荒田

collocations.en: the uncultivated fields beside the village

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi medda ta' ġmiem bejn ir-raħal u t-triq prinċipali.
formal.en: The map shows a stretch of uncultivated fields between the village and the main road.
formal.zh: 地图标出村庄与主干道之间有一片未耕种的田地。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'hemm wara dik il-ħajt? Pawlu: Hemm ġmiem; bħalissa ħadd ma jiżra' hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is behind that wall? Pawlu: There are uncultivated fields; nobody is planting anything there at the moment.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那堵墙后面有什么？保罗：是些荒田，目前没有人在那里种东西。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那堵墙后面有什么？
messages.en: What is behind that wall?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ġmiem; bħalissa ħadd ma jiżra' hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ġmiem; bħalissa ħadd ma jiżra' hemm.
messages.zh: 是些荒田，目前没有人在那里种东西。

gloss_zh: 集合；收集；一组；衣料褶裥

teaching_sense.en_definition: A collection or set of things, the act of collecting them, or pleats in a fabric item.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收集起来的物品或一组事物，也指收集这一行为；另可指裙子等织物制品上的褶裥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kollezzjoni jew sett ta' affarijiet, l-att li jinġabru, jew piegi f'dublett jew f'oġġett ieħor tad-drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收集起来的一批物品；收藏；集合
收集；汇集这一行为
一组；一套事物

sense_translations.en_definition: pleats (in a skirt, or other item made of fabric)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 裙子或其他织物制品上的褶裥

formal.mt: Il-ġmigħ tal-karti għandu jitlesta qabel ma tibda l-laqgħa.
formal.en: The collecting of the papers must be completed before the meeting begins.
formal.zh: 收集纸张的工作必须在会议开始前完成。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Jogħġbok dan id-dublett? Maja: Iva, speċjalment il-ġmigħ tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you like this skirt? Maja: Yes, especially its pleats.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你喜欢这条裙子吗？玛雅：喜欢，尤其喜欢它的褶裥。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)

messages.en: Do you like this skirt?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small piece of bread crust; the diminutive form of ġenba.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一小块面包的外皮；是 ġenba 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira mill-qoxra tal-ħobż; il-forma diminuttiva ta' ġenba.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small bread crust (the diminutive form of 'ġenba')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小块面包外皮，是 ġenba 的指小形式

a small piece of bread crust with butter
collocations.zh: 一小块抹了黄油的面包外皮

formal.en: On the plate there was a small piece of bread crust beside a piece of cheese.
formal.zh: 盘子里有一小块面包外皮，旁边放着一块奶酪。

colloquial.en: Ben: Is there any bread left? Anna: There is a small piece of crust left. Would you like it with butter?
colloquial.zh: 本：还有面包吗？安娜：还剩一小块面包外皮。要抹点黄油吗？

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)

messages.en: Is there any bread left?

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 还剩一小块面包外皮。要抹点黄油吗？
messages.en: There is a small piece of crust left. Would you like it with butter?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象盘边只剩一小块面包外皮，把小块和外皮两个特征一起记住；也可将它与已给出的 ġenba 配成指小形式词卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A garment that may be a jacket or a petticoat, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种衣物名称，可指夹克，也可指穿在裙子里面的衬裙，具体由语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies li jista' jkun ġakketta jew dublett ta' taħt, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夹克；衬裙

formal.mt: Il-ġobba tintlibes taħt id-dublett bħala saff ieħor ta' lbies.
formal.en: The petticoat is worn under the skirt as another layer of clothing.
formal.zh: 衬裙穿在裙子里面，作为另一层衣物。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Barra hemm il-bard. Ħu l-ġobba tas-suf. Ben: Tajjeb, nilbisha qabel noħroġ.
colloquial.en: Anna: It is cold outside. Take the woollen jacket. Ben: All right, I will put it on before I go out.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：外面很冷，带上羊毛夹克。本：好，我出门前穿上。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Barra hemm il-bard. Ħu l-ġobba tas-suf.
messages.mt_standard: Barra hemm il-bard. Ħu l-ġobba tas-suf.
messages.zh: 外面很冷，带上羊毛夹克。
messages.en: It is cold outside. Take the woollen jacket.

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 好，我出门前穿上。
messages.en: All right, I will put it on before I go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个词画两张衣物图：一张是外穿夹克，一张是裙内衬裙；遇到保暖或裙内位置的提示，再确定中文译法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a taste or quality like cheese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有奶酪的味道或奶酪般特征的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma jew karatteristika bħal dik tal-ġobon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有奶酪味的；具有奶酪般特征的

formal.mt: Dan il-mili ġobni jintuża biex jimla l-għaġin.
formal.en: This cheesy filling is used to fill pasta.
formal.zh: 这种有奶酪味的馅料用于填入意面中。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif inhu l-mili? Sara: Huwa ġobni ħafna. Jogħġobni!
colloquial.en: Mark: What is the filling like? Sara: It is very cheesy. I like it!
colloquial.zh: 马克：馅料怎么样？萨拉：奶酪味很浓，我喜欢！

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 馅料怎么样？
messages.en: What is the filling like?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 奶酪味很浓，我喜欢！
messages.en: It is very cheesy. I like it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象咬开一口馅料，马上尝到明显的奶酪味；用这幅味觉画面记住它是描述特征的形容词。

gloss_zh: 奶酪碟；盛放奶酪的器皿

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dish used to hold or serve cheese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放奶酪或把奶酪端上桌的碟子或器皿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex jitqiegħed jew jiġi servut fih il-ġobon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奶酪碟；用于盛放奶酪的器皿

collocations.en: a cheese dish with a lid

formal.mt: Il-ġobon ġie servut f'ġoboniera tal-ħġieġ fin-nofs tal-mejda.
formal.en: The cheese was served in a glass cheese dish in the middle of the table.
formal.zh: 奶酪盛在玻璃奶酪碟里，放在餐桌中央。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi l-ġobon? Mark: Fil-ġoboniera, jekk jogħġbok. Qiegħda ħdejn il-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall I put the cheese? Mark: In the cheese dish, please. It is beside the bread.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：奶酪放在哪里？马克：请放进奶酪碟里，碟子就在面包旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 奶酪放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put the cheese?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-ġoboniera, jekk jogħġbok. Qiegħda ħdejn il-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-ġoboniera, jekk jogħġbok. Qiegħda ħdejn il-ħobż.
messages.zh: 请放进奶酪碟里，碟子就在面包旁边。
messages.en: In the cheese dish, please. It is beside the bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把餐桌上的奶酪和盛它的专用碟子一起画出来，箭头指向碟子；记忆重点落在容器上，而不是里面的食物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A joint: the place where two parts meet and are connected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个部件相接并连接起来的部位，即接头或接合处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-post fejn żewġ partijiet jiltaqgħu u jingħaqdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接头；两个部分连接的部位或接合处。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, ġiet iċċekkjata l-ġontatura bejn iż-żewġ pajpijiet.
formal.en: During the inspection, the joint between the two pipes was checked.
formal.zh: 检查期间，工作人员检查了两根管子之间的接头。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed iqattar l-ilma minn din il-ġontatura. Mark: Rajt. Se niċċekkjaha issa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Water is dripping from this joint. Mark: I see. I'll check it now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个接头正在滴水。马克：看到了，我现在检查一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed iqattar l-ilma minn din il-ġontatura.
messages.mt_standard: Qed iqattar l-ilma minn din il-ġontatura.
messages.zh: 这个接头正在滴水。
messages.en: Water is dripping from this joint.

messages.speaker: Mark (维修工)
messages.zh: 看到了，我现在检查一下。
messages.en: I see. I'll check it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中圈出两根管子相接的那一点：这个词记的是接合的位置，可配合接头滴水的画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To connect things to each other, including by gluing them together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物件连接在一起，也可具体指用胶把它们粘合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad affarijiet ma' xulxin, inkluż billi jwaħħalhom bil-kolla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连接；把物件接合在一起
用胶粘合；把物件粘在一起

collocations.zh: 用胶把几块粘合在了一起

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ġonġa ż-żewġ biċċiet tal-injam bil-kolla u ħalliehom jinxfu.
formal.en: The worker glued the two pieces of wood together and left them to dry.
formal.zh: 工人用胶把两块木料粘在一起，然后放着晾干。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ġonġa dawn iż-żewġ biċċiet? Pawlu: Mark ġonġa l-biċċiet bil-kolla. Ħallihom jinxfu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who joined these two pieces? Pawlu: Mark glued the pieces together. Let them dry.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁把这两块接在一起了？保罗：马克用胶把它们粘起来了，让它们晾干吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 谁把这两块接在一起了？
messages.en: Who joined these two pieces?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark ġonġa l-biċċiet bil-kolla. Ħallihom jinxfu.
messages.mt_standard: Mark ġonġa l-biċċiet bil-kolla. Ħallihom jinxfu.
messages.zh: 马克用胶把它们粘起来了，让它们晾干吧。
messages.en: Mark glued the pieces together. Let them dry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两块木片先分开，再接到一起；画面里添上一瓶胶水，就能从一般的连接切换到具体的粘合义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of joining parts together, including by gluing or soldering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将部件连接在一起的过程，也可具体指胶合或钎焊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih partijiet jingħaqdu flimkien, fosthom bil-kolla jew bl-issaldjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连接；将分开的部分接合在一起。
胶合；用胶将物件或部件粘在一起。
钎焊；用焊料接合部件的操作。

formal.mt: Qabel il-ġonġiment bil-kolla, il-wiċċ ta' kull parti għandu jitnaddaf.
formal.en: Before joining with glue, the surface of each part should be cleaned.
formal.zh: 进行胶合之前，应清洁各个部件的表面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ġonġiment ta' dawn iż-żewġ biċċiet se jsir bil-kolla? Mark: Iva, imma l-ewwel irridu nnaddfuhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will these two pieces be joined with glue? Mark: Yes, but first we need to clean them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这两块东西要用胶接合吗？马克：对，不过我们得先把它们清理干净。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġonġiment ta' dawn iż-żewġ biċċiet se jsir bil-kolla?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġonġiment ta' dawn iż-żewġ biċċiet se jsir bil-kolla?
messages.zh: 这两块东西要用胶接合吗？
messages.en: Will these two pieces be joined with glue?

messages.speaker: Mark (师傅)
messages.zh: 对，不过我们得先把它们清理干净。
messages.en: Yes, but first we need to clean them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两块零件接在一起的动作画成记忆图：可用胶，也可钎焊；这个词重点表示接合过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who joins parts together or fixes objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事部件接合或物件修理的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħaqqad partijiet flimkien jew issewwi oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将部件接合在一起或修理物件的人。

collocations.en: a skilled person who joins or repairs things
the work of the person who joins or repairs things

formal.mt: Il-ġonġitur eżamina l-partijiet miksura qabel beda t-tiswija.
formal.en: The repairer examined the broken parts before beginning the repair.
formal.zh: 修理工在开始修理之前检查了损坏的部件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jgħaqqad dawn il-partijiet? Pawlu: Il-ġonġitur se jiġi għada biex jagħmel ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is going to join these parts together? Pawlu: The repairer is coming tomorrow to do the work.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁来把这些部件接起来？保罗：修理工明天会来做这项工作。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 谁来把这些部件接起来？
messages.en: Who is going to join these parts together?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġonġitur se jiġi għada biex jagħmel ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġonġitur se jiġi għada biex jagħmel ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 修理工明天会来做这项工作。
messages.en: The repairer is coming tomorrow to do the work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位手拿工具、把断开的零件接好的师傅；用人物画面记住这个词指做接合或修理的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Jordan: the name of a country in West Asia in the Middle East, or of a river in that region that flows into the Dead Sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 约旦：西亚中东地区的国家名称；也指该地区流入死海的约旦河。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' pajjiż fl-Asja tal-Punent, fil-Lvant Nofsani, jew ta' xmara f'dak ir-reġjun li tiżbokka fil-Baħar il-Mejjet.

sense_translations.en_definition: Jordan (a country in West Asia in the Middle East; official name: Renju Ħaxemita tal-Ġordan)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 约旦，位于西亚中东地区的国家，正式名称为约旦哈希姆王国。

sense_translations.en_definition: Jordan (a river in West Asia in the Middle East, that empties into the Dead Sea, flowing through Israel, the Golan Heights, the West Bank and Jordan)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 约旦河，位于西亚中东地区，流经以色列、戈兰高地、约旦河西岸及约旦，最终注入死海。

formal.mt: It-test jiddistingwi bejn il-Ġordan bħala pajjiż u x-xmara Ġordan.
formal.en: The text distinguishes between Jordan as a country and the River Jordan.
formal.zh: 这篇文字区分了作为国家的约旦与约旦河。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed titkellem dwar il-pajjiż jew ix-xmara Ġordan? Samwel: Dwar il-pajjiż; nixtieq inżur il-Ġordan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you talking about the country or the River Jordan? Samwel: The country; I'd like to visit Jordan.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说的是约旦这个国家，还是约旦河？萨姆韦尔：国家；我想去约旦旅游。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed titkellem dwar il-pajjiż jew ix-xmara Ġordan?
messages.mt_standard: Qed titkellem dwar il-pajjiż jew ix-xmara Ġordan?
messages.zh: 你说的是约旦这个国家，还是约旦河？
messages.en: Are you talking about the country or the River Jordan?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.zh: 国家；我想去约旦旅游。
messages.en: The country; I'd like to visit Jordan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给同一个名称配两张卡片：一张画国家地图，一张画河流；看到 xmara 就切换到约旦河。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dahlia, a plant of the genus Dahlia; another word for dalja.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大丽花，指大丽花属植物；与 dalja 同义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ġeneru Dahlia; kelma oħra għal dalja.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of dalja: dahlia (plant of the genus Dahlia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: dalja 的同义词：大丽花，即大丽花属的植物。

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien tal-iskola tħawlet ġorġina ħdejn il-mogħdija.

formal.zh: 学校花园的小径旁种了一株大丽花。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi l-ġorġina? Nina: Poġġiha ħdejn il-borma l-oħra, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I put the dahlia? Nina: Put it beside the other pot, please.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这株大丽花放在哪里？妮娜：请把它放在另一盆旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 这株大丽花放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the dahlia?

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)

messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha ħdejn il-borma l-oħra, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请把它放在另一盆旁边。
messages.en: Put it beside the other pot, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在同一盆大丽花上挂两张词卡，分别写 ġorġina 和 dalja；用一株植物记住两个同义名称。

gloss_zh: 格鲁吉亚的；格鲁吉亚人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Georgia, its people, or its language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与格鲁吉亚、格鲁吉亚人或格鲁吉亚语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Ġeorġja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-lingwa tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 格鲁吉亚的；格鲁吉亚人的；格鲁吉亚语的。
格鲁吉亚人。

formal.mt: Il-mużew qed jesebixxi xogħol ta' artist Ġorġjan.

formal.zh: 博物馆正在展出一位格鲁吉亚艺术家的作品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel? Mark: Huwa Ġorġjan li qed jistudja magħna.

colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男人是谁？马克：他是一位和我们一起学习的格鲁吉亚人。

messages.zh: 他是一位和我们一起学习的格鲁吉亚人。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张句型卡区分词性：artist Ġorġjan 中修饰艺术家，作形容词；指一位格鲁吉亚人时作名词。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kien ta' għajnuna jew ta' benefiċċju għal xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be of benefit to sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人有益；给某人带来帮助或好处。

formal.mt: It-taħriġ ġova lill-istudenti u għenhom jifhmu s-suġġett aħjar.

formal.zh: 培训使学生们受益，帮助他们更好地理解了这门学科。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Jupiter, the name of a planet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 木星，一颗行星的专有名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-pjaneta Jupiter.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 木星，指行星。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi osservazzjonijiet tal-pjaneta Ġove.

formal.zh: 这份报告包含对木星的观测记录。

colloquial.mt: Samwel: Qed tħares lejn Ġove? Maja: Iva, qed nosserva l-pjaneta bit-teleskopju.
colloquial.en: Samwel: Are you looking at Jupiter? Maja: Yes, I'm observing the planet through the telescope.
colloquial.zh: 萨姆韦尔：你在看木星吗？玛雅：对，我正在用望远镜观测这颗行星。

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在看木星吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scratch or shallow wound in which some skin has been scraped or peeled away.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一处表皮已擦掉或剥落的划伤或伤口。

formal.mt: Wara li waqa' fil-bitħa, it-tifel kellu ġrada fuq idu.
formal.en: After falling in the yard, the boy had a scrape on his hand.
formal.zh: 男孩在院子里摔倒后，手上有了一处擦伤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġiet dik il-ġrada fuq idek? Pawlu: Waqajt fil-bitħa waqt li kont qed nilgħab.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you get that scrape on your hand? Pawlu: I fell in the yard while I was playing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你手上那处擦伤是怎么弄的？保罗：我玩的时候在院子里摔倒了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġiet dik il-ġrada fuq idek?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġiet dik il-ġrada fuq idek?
messages.zh: 你手上那处擦伤是怎么弄的？
messages.en: How did you get that scrape on your hand?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqajt fil-bitħa waqt li kont qed nilgħab.
messages.mt_standard: Waqajt fil-bitħa waqt li kont qed nilgħab.
messages.zh: 我玩的时候在院子里摔倒了。
messages.en: I fell in the yard while I was playing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġrada 和手背擦破一小块皮的画面绑在一起记：重点是表皮擦掉后留下的那处伤口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of repeatedly biting or wearing something away with the teeth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用牙齿反复啃咬、逐渐磨损某物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jigdem xi ħaġa ripetutament bis-snien u jnaqqarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用牙齿反复啃咬或啮咬的动作。

formal.mt: Il-ġrid tal-injam mill-ġurdien ħalla marki żgħar fuq il-kaxxa.
formal.en: The mouse's gnawing of the wood left small marks on the box.
formal.zh: 老鼠啃咬木头，在箱子上留下了细小的痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss ta' ġrid? Mark: Iva, il-fenek qed jigdem il-biċċa injama.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear that gnawing sound? Mark: Yes, the rabbit is biting the piece of wood.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听见那个啃咬声了吗？马克：听见了，兔子正在咬那块木头。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss ta' ġrid?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss ta' ġrid?
messages.zh: 你听见那个啃咬声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that gnawing sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-fenek qed jigdem il-biċċa injama.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-fenek qed jigdem il-biċċa injama.
messages.zh: 听见了，兔子正在咬那块木头。
messages.en: Yes, the rabbit is biting the piece of wood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象兔子一口一口啃木头，把反复啃咬的动作记作 ġrid；这个词指动作本身，不是牙印。

gloss_zh: 致伤；造成创伤或身体伤害

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of causing wounds or physical injury.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或动物出现伤口或受到身体伤害的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih jiġu kkawżati feriti jew ħsara fiżika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成伤口或创伤的行为或过程。
使身体受到伤害的行为或过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ġriħ ta' żewġ persuni waqt l-inċident.
formal.en: The report describes the wounding of two people during the incident.
formal.zh: 报告描述了事件中两人受到伤害的情况。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser 'ġriħ' f'din is-sentenza? David: Ifisser li xi ħadd ikun qed jikkawża feriti jew ħsara fiżika.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'ġriħ' mean in this sentence? David: It means that someone is causing wounds or physical harm.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这句话里的 ġriħ 是什么意思？戴维：意思是有人在造成伤口或身体伤害。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 ġriħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ġriħ' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li xi ħadd ikun qed jikkawża feriti jew ħsara fiżika.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li xi ħadd ikun qed jikkawża feriti jew ħsara fiżika.
messages.zh: 意思是有人在造成伤口或身体伤害。
messages.en: It means that someone is causing wounds or physical harm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġriħ 放进“造成伤害”的动态画面里记：既可强调造成伤口，也可强调使身体受伤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small body; the diminutive form of ġisem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小小的身体或身躯，是 ġisem 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġisem żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' ġisem.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small body (the diminutive form of 'ġisem')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小身体、小身躯，是 ġisem 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Il-ġsejjem tal-għasfur kien moħbi fost il-weraq.
formal.en: The bird's little body was hidden among the leaves.
formal.zh: 鸟儿的小身躯藏在树叶之间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara l-ġsejjem tat-tarbija taħt dik il-kutra! Marija: Iva, tidher ċkejkna ħafna fiha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look at the baby's little body under that blanket! Marija: Yes, she looks so tiny in it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：看看那条毯子下面宝宝的小身躯！玛丽亚：是啊，她裹在里面显得特别小。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara l-ġsejjem tat-tarbija taħt dik il-kutra!
messages.mt_standard: Ara l-ġsejjem tat-tarbija taħt dik il-kutra!
messages.zh: 看看那条毯子下面宝宝的小身躯！
messages.en: Look at the baby's little body under that blanket!

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 是啊，她裹在里面显得特别小。
messages.en: Yes, she looks so tiny in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把已知的 ġisem“身体”缩成毯子里的一小团，便能联想到指小形式 ġsejjem“小身躯”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Juba, the capital city of South Sudan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 朱巴，南苏丹的首都，是一个城市专名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-belt kapitali tas-Sudan t'Isfel.

sense_translations.en_definition: Juba (the capital city of South Sudan)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 朱巴，南苏丹的首都。

formal.mt: Ġuba hija l-belt kapitali tas-Sudan t'Isfel.
formal.en: Juba is the capital city of South Sudan.
formal.zh: 朱巴是南苏丹的首都。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi Ġuba? Daniel: Fis-Sudan t'Isfel; hija l-belt kapitali tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Juba? Daniel: In South Sudan; it is its capital city.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：朱巴在哪里？丹尼尔：在南苏丹，它是那个国家的首都。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 朱巴在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Juba?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fis-Sudan t'Isfel; hija l-belt kapitali tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Fis-Sudan t'Isfel; hija l-belt kapitali tiegħu.
messages.zh: 在南苏丹，它是那个国家的首都。
messages.en: In South Sudan; it is its capital city.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ġuba、Juba、朱巴写成同一张地名卡，再配上“南苏丹首都”；马耳他语例句中首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A special anniversary or a celebration held to mark it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有特别意义的周年纪念，或为此举行的庆祝活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Anniversarju speċjali jew ċelebrazzjoni li ssir biex tfakkru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禧年；重要周年纪念及其庆典。

formal.mt: L-iskola se torganizza kunċert biex tiċċelebra l-ġublew tagħha.
formal.en: The school will organize a concert to celebrate its jubilee.
formal.zh: 学校将举办音乐会，庆祝其重要周年纪念。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Se tiġi għall-kunċert tal-ġublew tal-iskola? Mark: Iva, se niġi ma' ħuti.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you coming to the school's jubilee concert? Mark: Yes, I'm coming with my siblings.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你会来参加学校的周年庆典音乐会吗？马克：会，我会和兄弟姐妹一起来。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 你会来参加学校的周年庆典音乐会吗？
messages.en: Are you coming to the school's jubilee concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 会，我会和兄弟姐妹一起来。
messages.en: Yes, I'm coming with my siblings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġublew 想成学校逢重要周年挂起彩旗、举办音乐会的日子，用“周年大庆”的场景记忆。

gloss_zh: 可由法院审理的；可裁判的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of being heard and decided by a court.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够交由法院审理并作出裁决的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jitressaq quddiem qorti biex jinstema' u jiġi deċiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可由法院审理和裁判的；可受审的。

formal.mt: L-analiżi teżamina jekk il-kwistjoni hijiex ġudikabbli quddiem qorti.
formal.en: The analysis examines whether the issue is justiciable before a court.
formal.zh: 该分析探讨这一问题是否可交由法院审理和裁判。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'kwistjoni ġudikabbli'? David: Kwistjoni li qorti tista' tisma' u tiddeċiedi dwarha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'a justiciable issue' mean? David: An issue that a court can hear and decide.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“可裁判的问题”是什么意思？戴维：就是法院能够审理并作出裁决的问题。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: “可裁判的问题”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'a justiciable issue' mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Kwistjoni li qorti tista' tisma' u tiddeċiedi dwarha.
messages.mt_standard: Kwistjoni li qorti tista' tisma' u tiddeċiedi dwarha.
messages.zh: 就是法院能够审理并作出裁决的问题。
messages.en: An issue that a court can hear and decide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给案件想象贴上“法院可审”的标签，就能记住 ġudikabbli；重点是能否审理，并不表示一定胜诉。

gloss_zh: 进行评判的；负责裁判的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Performing the role of judging, assessing, or deciding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承担评判、评审或裁决职能的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu r-rwol li jiġġudika, jevalwa jew jiddeċiedi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在进行评判的；承担评审或裁判职责的。

formal.mt: Il-bord ġudikant evalwa kull xogħol skont il-kriterji mħabbra.
formal.en: The judging panel evaluated each work according to the announced criteria.
formal.zh: 评审团按照公布的标准评估了每件作品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jagħżel ir-rebbieħ? Pawlu: Il-bord ġudikant; se jevalwa l-kanzunetti kollha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who will choose the winner? Pawlu: The judging panel; it will evaluate all the songs.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁来选出获胜者？保罗：评审团，他们会评估所有歌曲。

messages.speaker: Nina (参赛者)
messages.zh: 谁来选出获胜者？
messages.en: Who will choose the winner?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bord ġudikant; se jevalwa l-kanzunetti kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bord ġudikant; se jevalwa l-kanzunetti kollha.
messages.zh: 评审团，他们会评估所有歌曲。
messages.en: The judging panel; it will evaluate all the songs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象评审团举起评分牌：ġudikant 描写“负责评判的”，搭配 bord 时便是承担评判工作的评审团。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who considers the facts or arguments and makes a judgment or decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 审视事实或各方论点并作出判断、裁决的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li teżamina l-fatti jew l-argumenti u tagħti ġudizzju jew deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 裁决者；作出评判的人。

formal.mt: Il-ġudikatur eżamina l-argumenti taż-żewġ naħat qabel ħa deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The adjudicator examined both sides' arguments before making a decision.
formal.zh: 裁决者在作出决定之前审视了双方的论点。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min se jiddeċiedi min rebaħ? Rita: Il-ġudikatur, wara li jisma' lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who will decide who won? Rita: The adjudicator, after listening to everyone.
colloquial.zh: Mark：谁来决定谁赢了？Rita：裁决者，他会先听取所有人的意见。

messages.speaker: Mark (参赛者)
messages.zh: 谁来决定谁赢了？
messages.en: Who will decide who won?

messages.speaker: Rita (组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġudikatur, wara li jisma' lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġudikatur, wara li jisma' lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 裁决者，他会先听取所有人的意见。
messages.en: The adjudicator, after listening to everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上“听双方、再裁决”的人物画面，记住它指作出评判的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The judges and courts of a country, considered together as the institution that administers justice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将一个国家的法官和法院作为整体来指称的司法机关或司法体系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-imħallfin u l-qrati ta' pajjiż, meqjusa flimkien bħala l-istituzzjoni li tamministra l-ġustizzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 司法机关；由法官和法院构成的司法体系。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddiskuti l-indipendenza tal-ġudikatura u r-rwol tagħha fis-soċjetà.
formal.en: The report discusses the independence of the judiciary and its role in society.
formal.zh: 这份报告讨论司法独立及司法机关在社会中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi l-ġudikatura? Pawlu: Hija l-imħallfin u l-qrati tal-pajjiż, meqjusa flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the judiciary? Pawlu: It is the country's judges and courts, considered together.
colloquial.zh: Lara：什么是司法机关？Pawlu：就是把一个国家的法官和法院作为整体来称呼。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是司法机关？
messages.en: What is the judiciary?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-imħallfin u l-qrati tal-pajjiż, meqjusa flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-imħallfin u l-qrati tal-pajjiż, meqjusa flimkien.
messages.zh: 就是把一个国家的法官和法院作为整体来称呼。
messages.en: It is the country's judges and courts, considered together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把全国的法院与法官圈在一个大框里，用这个整体画面记住“司法机关”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to courts, judges, or the administration of justice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与法院、法官或司法活动有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-qrati, mal-imħallfin jew mal-amministrazzjoni tal-ġustizzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 司法的；与法院或法官履行职能有关的。

formal.mt: L-istudenti analizzaw deċiżjoni ġudizzjali u ddiskutew ir-raġunijiet mogħtija mill-qorti.
formal.en: The students analysed a judicial decision and discussed the reasons given by the court.
formal.zh: 学生们分析了一项司法裁决，并讨论了法院给出的理由。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din hija deċiżjoni ġudizzjali? Daniel: Iva, ħaditha l-qorti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this a judicial decision? Daniel: Yes, the court made it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这是一项司法裁决吗？Daniel：是的，这是法院作出的。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这是一项司法裁决吗？
messages.en: Is this a judicial decision?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，这是法院作出的。
messages.en: Yes, the court made it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġudizzjali 放在“决定、程序”旁边，想成给名词贴上“与司法有关”的标签。

gloss_zh: 以司法方式；通过司法程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: Through a court or by means of judicial proceedings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过法院或司法程序，以司法方式进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Permezz tal-qorti jew ta' proċeduri ġudizzjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以司法方式；通过法院或司法程序。

collocations.zh: 通过司法程序作出裁决

collocations.en: to be challenged through the courts

formal.mt: Il-kwistjoni ġiet deċiża ġudizzjalment wara li nstemgħu l-argumenti taż-żewġ naħat.
formal.en: The matter was decided judicially after both sides' arguments were heard.
formal.zh: 在听取双方论点之后，这一事项通过司法程序得到了裁决。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-kwistjoni ssolviet ġudizzjalment? Toni: Iva, il-qorti tat deċiżjoni lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was the matter resolved through the courts? Toni: Yes, the court gave a decision yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这件事是通过法院解决的吗？Toni：是的，法院昨天作出了裁决。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这件事是通过法院解决的吗？
messages.en: Was the matter resolved through the courts?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，法院昨天作出了裁决。
messages.en: Yes, the court gave a decision yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这件事怎样解决？通过法院”来记忆；这个副词说明处理事情的方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with courts, judges, or the system for administering justice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与法院、法官或司法制度有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-qrati, mal-imħallfin jew mas-sistema tal-ġustizzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 司法的；与法院、法官或司法制度有关的。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jispjega r-rwol tal-imħallef fil-proċess ġudizzjarju.
formal.en: The chapter explains the judge's role in the judicial process.
formal.zh: 这一章解释法官在司法程序中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fuq xiex qed taqra? Ben: Fuq il-proċess ġudizzjarju u kif taħdem il-qorti.
colloquial.en: Marta: What are you reading about? Ben: The judicial process and how the court works.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你在读什么内容？Ben：司法程序，以及法院如何运作。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 你在读什么内容？
messages.en: What are you reading about?

messages.speaker: Ben (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-proċess ġudizzjarju u kif taħdem il-qorti.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-proċess ġudizzjarju u kif taħdem il-qorti.
messages.zh: 司法程序，以及法院如何运作。
messages.en: The judicial process and how the court works.

cognitive_memory_aid: 连着搭配 proċess ġudizzjarju 读，脑中画出法院办理案件的流程，帮助记住“司法的”。

gloss_zh: 判断力；明智；意见；很长时间

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ability to consider a situation carefully and make a sensible decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仔细考虑情况并作出合理决定的能力，即判断力或明智。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila li tqis sitwazzjoni sew u tieħu deċiżjoni bil-għaqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 判断；判断力；明智；处事的分寸。
意见；看法；对某事的评价。
很久；极长时间，用作时间状语。

formal.mt: Il-kap wera ġudizzju tajjeb meta qies l-għażliet kollha qabel ħa deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The manager showed good judgment by considering all the options before making a decision.
formal.zh: 主管在作出决定之前考虑了所有选项，表现出良好的判断力。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Nixtrih issa jew nistenna? Eva: Uża l-ġudizzju tiegħek u ara jekk għandekx bżonnu.
colloquial.en: Luca: Should I buy it now or wait? Eva: Use your judgment and see whether you need it.
colloquial.zh: Luca：我该现在买，还是等等？Eva：自己判断一下，看看你是否需要它。

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.zh: 我该现在买，还是等等？
messages.en: Should I buy it now or wait?

messages.speaker: Eva (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża l-ġudizzju tiegħek u ara jekk għandekx bżonnu.
messages.mt_standard: Uża l-ġudizzju tiegħek u ara jekk għandekx bżonnu.
messages.zh: 自己判断一下，看看你是否需要它。
messages.en: Use your judgment and see whether you need it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“想清楚再决定”记住判断力，再分卡片记“意见”和副词义“很久”，避免混淆词性。

gloss_zh: 明智的；审慎的；有判断力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing careful thought and good judgment when making decisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作决定时考虑周全、判断合理的；明智而审慎的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħseb sew u juża ġudizzju tajjeb meta jieħu deċiżjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明智的；审慎的；善于合理判断的。

formal.mt: Użu ġudizzjuż tar-riżorsi jgħin lill-iskola tissodisfa l-bżonnijiet tal-istudenti.
formal.en: Judicious use of resources helps the school meet students' needs.
formal.zh: 审慎合理地使用资源，有助于学校满足学生的需要。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Se nonfoq il-flus kollha llum. Mark: Kun ġudizzjuż u żomm ftit għal għada.
colloquial.en: Anna: I'm going to spend all the money today. Mark: Be judicious and keep some for tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我今天要把钱全花掉。Mark：明智一点，留一些明天用。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天要把钱全花掉。
messages.en: I'm going to spend all the money today.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kun ġudizzjuż u żomm ftit għal għada.
messages.mt_standard: Kun ġudizzjuż u żomm ftit għal għada.
messages.zh: 明智一点，留一些明天用。
messages.en: Be judicious and keep some for tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人花钱前先想明天的需要，用“考虑周全、决定明智”的画面记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An itinerant performer who entertains people with music or songs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 四处巡游，为人们演奏音乐或演唱歌曲的艺人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Artist li jivvjaġġa minn post għal ieħor u jdoqq jew ikanta biex idiverti lin-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巡游艺人；四处演出的乐师或游吟歌手。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ġuklar jasal fir-raħal u jkanta fil-pjazza quddiem in-nies.
formal.en: In the story, an itinerant minstrel arrives in the village and sings before the people in the square.
formal.zh: 故事中，一位游吟歌手来到村庄，在广场上为人们歌唱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak li qed ikanta fil-pjazza? Mark: Hu ġuklar; imur minn raħal għal ieħor u jkanta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that singing in the square? Mark: He's an itinerant minstrel; he goes from village to village singing.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个在广场上唱歌的人是谁？Mark：他是位游吟歌手，走村串乡地唱歌。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed ikanta fil-pjazza?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed ikanta fil-pjazza?
messages.zh: 那个在广场上唱歌的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that singing in the square?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ġuklar; imur minn raħal għal ieħor u jkanta.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ġuklar; imur minn raħal għal ieħor u jkanta.
messages.zh: 他是位游吟歌手，走村串乡地唱歌。
messages.en: He's an itinerant minstrel; he goes from village to village singing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġuklar想成背着乐器走进村庄的歌手，用“边走边唱”的画面记住巡游艺人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A basket used for breeding or rearing animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于动物繁育或饲育的篮子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qoffa li tintuża għat-trobbija tal-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于繁育或饲育动物的篮子。

formal.mt: Il-ġuna għandha tinżamm nadifa u titqiegħed f'post xieraq għat-trobbija.
formal.en: The breeding basket should be kept clean and placed in a suitable location for breeding.
formal.zh: 繁育篮应保持清洁，并放置在适合繁育的地方。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ġuna lesta? Pawlu: Iva, naddaft il-ġuna u poġġejtha f'post sigur.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the breeding basket ready? Pawlu: Yes, I cleaned the breeding basket and put it somewhere safe.
colloquial.zh: Lara：繁育篮准备好了吗？Pawlu：好了，我把繁育篮洗干净，放在安全的地方了。

messages.speaker: Lara (饲养员)
messages.zh: 繁育篮准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the breeding basket ready?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naddaft il-ġuna u poġġejtha f'post sigur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naddaft il-ġuna u poġġejtha f'post sigur.
messages.zh: 好了，我把繁育篮洗干净，放在安全的地方了。
messages.en: Yes, I cleaned the breeding basket and put it somewhere safe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记ġuna时想象一个贴着“繁育专用”标签的篮子，把用途和篮子的形状一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: July, the seventh month of the year; another name for Lulju.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 七月，即一年中的第七个月，是Lulju的另一名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-seba' xahar tas-sena; isem ieħor għal Lulju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Lulju的同义词，意为七月。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir fil-bidu ta' Ġunjett, jiġifieri fil-bidu ta' Lulju.
formal.en: The meeting will take place at the beginning of Ġunjett, meaning the beginning of July.
formal.zh: 会议将在Ġunjett月初举行，也就是七月初。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Hawn miktub Ġunjett. Liema xahar hu? Ben: Ġunjett hu Lulju, is-seba' xahar tas-sena.
colloquial.en: Anna: It says Ġunjett here. Which month is that? Ben: Ġunjett means July, the seventh month of the year.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这里写着Ġunjett，是哪个月？Ben：Ġunjett就是七月，一年中的第七个月。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub Ġunjett. Liema xahar hu?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub Ġunjett. Liema xahar hu?
messages.zh: 这里写着Ġunjett，是哪个月？
messages.en: It says Ġunjett here. Which month is that?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġunjett hu Lulju, is-seba' xahar tas-sena.
messages.mt_standard: Ġunjett hu Lulju, is-seba' xahar tas-sena.
messages.zh: Ġunjett就是七月，一年中的第七个月。
messages.en: Ġunjett means July, the seventh month of the year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历第七格同时写上Ġunjett和Lulju，用同一格对应两个名称，牢牢记住都是七月。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Grasshoppers or locusts: insects with strong hind legs used for jumping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蚱蜢或蝗虫这类昆虫，后腿强健，善于跳跃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insetti b'saqajn ta' wara b'saħħithom li jużawhom biex jaqbżu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蚱蜢；蝗虫。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għalqa, l-istudenti raw ġurad fuq il-weraq.
formal.en: While observing the field, the students saw grasshoppers on the leaves.
formal.zh: 学生们观察田地时，看到了叶片上的蚱蜢。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'rajt fil-ħaxix? Mark: Rajt ġurad jaqbeż bejn il-pjanti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you see in the grass? Mark: I saw grasshoppers jumping between the plants.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在草丛里看见了什么？Mark：我看见蚱蜢在植物之间跳跃。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在草丛里看见了什么？
messages.en: What did you see in the grass?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看见蚱蜢在植物之间跳跃。
messages.en: I saw grasshoppers jumping between the plants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到ġurad就想象草丛里突然跳起的蚱蜢，再联想到成群飞来的蝗虫，连接两个中文义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a part of the human body that is uncovered or exposed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人体某个部位没有遮盖、露在外面的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi parti tal-ġisem tal-bniedem li mhix mgħottija.

sense_translations.en_definition: exposed part of the human body
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于描述人体裸露、没有遮盖的部位。

collocations.en: an exposed part of the body
the exposed part of the arm

formal.mt: Il-kmiem qosra jħallu parti ġurda tad-driegħ.
formal.en: Short sleeves leave part of the arm exposed.
formal.zh: 短袖会让手臂的一部分露在外面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tiġbed il-kmiem 'l isfel? Nina: Biex ngħatti l-parti ġurda tad-driegħ; qed inħoss il-bard.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you pulling your sleeves down? Nina: To cover the exposed part of my arm; I'm feeling cold.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么把袖子往下拉？Nina：为了遮住手臂露出来的部分，我觉得冷。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把袖子往下拉？
messages.en: Why are you pulling your sleeves down?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ngħatti l-parti ġurda tad-driegħ; qed inħoss il-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ngħatti l-parti ġurda tad-driegħ; qed inħoss il-bard.
messages.zh: 为了遮住手臂露出来的部分，我觉得冷。
messages.en: To cover the exposed part of my arm; I'm feeling cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用卷起袖子后露出的手臂记ġurda，并连同parti一起记成“裸露的部位”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Grey in colour, between black and white.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 灰色的，即颜色介于黑色和白色之间的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' kulur bejn l-iswed u l-abjad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灰色的。

formal.mt: Għall-purtieri tal-uffiċċju ntgħażel drapp ġurdni.
formal.en: Grey fabric was chosen for the office curtains.
formal.zh: 办公室的窗帘选用了灰色布料。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Liema drapp tippreferi, l-abjad jew il-ġurdni? Ben: Nippreferi d-drapp ġurdni għall-purtieri.
colloquial.en: Anna: Which fabric do you prefer, the white or the grey? Ben: I prefer the grey fabric for the curtains.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你更喜欢哪种布料，白色的还是灰色的？Ben：做窗帘的话，我更喜欢灰色布料。

messages.speaker: Anna (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema drapp tippreferi, l-abjad jew il-ġurdni?
messages.mt_standard: Liema drapp tippreferi, l-abjad jew il-ġurdni?
messages.zh: 你更喜欢哪种布料，白色的还是灰色的？
messages.en: Which fabric do you prefer, the white or the grey?

messages.speaker: Ben (顾客)
messages.zh: 做窗帘的话，我更喜欢灰色布料。
messages.en: I prefer the grey fabric for the curtains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给ġurdni配一块灰色色卡，再默念drapp ġurdni“灰色布料”，用实物颜色巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A panel of fabric used as a section of a garment or another textile item.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为衣物或其他织物制品某一部分的一块布片或布幅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp li tifforma parti minn libsa jew minn oġġett ieħor tad-drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布片；构成衣物等制品某一部分的布幅。

formal.mt: Il-ħajjata qatgħet ġurun tad-drapp skont il-qisien tal-libsa.
formal.en: The dressmaker cut a fabric panel according to the measurements of the dress.
formal.zh: 裁缝按照连衣裙的尺寸裁出了一块布片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ġurun hu għall-libsa tiegħi? Rita: Iva, se nħitu mal-parti ta' quddiem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this panel for my dress? Rita: Yes, I'll sew it onto the front section.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这块布片是给我的连衣裙用的吗？Rita：是的，我会把它缝到前面的部分。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这块布片是给我的连衣裙用的吗？
messages.en: Is this panel for my dress?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nħitu mal-parti ta' quddiem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nħitu mal-parti ta' quddiem.
messages.zh: 是的，我会把它缝到前面的部分。
messages.en: Yes, I'll sew it onto the front section.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象裁缝把一块布片缝进裙子，将ġurun与“整件衣物中的一幅布”这一画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fair and in accordance with justice, treating people as they deserve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 符合公正原则、给予人们应有待遇的；公平合理的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jimxi skont il-ġustizzja u jittratta lin-nies kif jixirqilhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公正的；符合正义原则的；公平的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għandu jiżgura trattament ġust għal kull applikant.
formal.en: The committee should ensure fair treatment for every applicant.
formal.zh: 委员会应确保每位申请人都得到公平对待。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li dan il-ħlas hu ġust? Mark: Iva, għax iqis is-sigħat kollha li ħdimna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think this pay is fair? Mark: Yes, because it takes into account all the hours we worked.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你觉得这份报酬公平吗？Mark：公平，因为它把我们工作的所有时数都算进去了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dan il-ħlas hu ġust?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dan il-ħlas hu ġust?
messages.zh: 你觉得这份报酬公平吗？
messages.en: Do you think this pay is fair?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax iqis is-sigħat kollha li ħdimna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax iqis is-sigħat kollha li ħdimna.
messages.zh: 公平，因为它把我们工作的所有时数都算进去了。
messages.en: Yes, because it takes into account all the hours we worked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一架两边平衡的天平记ġust，再搭配ħlas ġust“公平报酬”，把公正落实到具体情境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small sweet treats eaten for enjoyment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为零食享用的小块甜食，即糖果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċiet żgħar ta' ħelu li jittieklu għall-gost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 糖果；供零食享用的甜食。

formal.mt: Għall-festa, l-organizzaturi poġġew borża ġuġù fuq kull mejda.
formal.en: For the party, the organisers placed a bag of sweets on each table.
formal.zh: 为准备聚会，组织者在每张桌上放了一袋糖果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit ġuġù? Ben: Iva, grazzi! Ħa nieħu ftit biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some sweets? Ben: Yes, thanks! I'll only take a few.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想吃点糖果吗？Ben：想，谢谢！我只拿几颗。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃点糖果吗？
messages.en: Would you like some sweets?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi! Ħa nieħu ftit biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi! Ħa nieħu ftit biss.
messages.zh: 想，谢谢！我只拿几颗。
messages.en: Yes, thanks! I'll only take a few.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġuġù 的两个音节想象成两颗并排的糖果，配着“一袋糖果”的画面反复朗读。

gloss_zh: Ġwann，马耳他语男性名字，对应英语 John

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male given name corresponding to English John.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男性名字，在英语中对应 John，中文可译作“约翰”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raġel li jikkorrispondi għall-isem John bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.en_definition: a male given name from Sicilian [in turn from Latin, in turn from Ancient Greek, in turn from Hebrew], equivalent to English John
sense_translations.zh_definition: 男性名字，来自西西里语；其来源依次可追溯至拉丁语、古希腊语及希伯来语，对应英语 John。

formal.mt: Ġwann se jippreżenta r-rapport waqt il-laqgħa ta' għada.
formal.en: Ġwann will present the report during tomorrow's meeting.
formal.zh: Ġwann将在明天的会议上介绍报告。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif jismu l-ħabib tiegħek? Pawlu: Jismu Ġwann. Se niltaqgħu miegħu aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Marija: What's your friend's name? Pawlu: His name is Ġwann. We're meeting him later.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你的朋友叫什么名字？Pawlu：他叫Ġwann。我们待会儿要和他见面。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的朋友叫什么名字？
messages.en: What's your friend's name?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jismu Ġwann. Se niltaqgħu miegħu aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Jismu Ġwann. Se niltaqgħu miegħu aktar tard.
messages.zh: 他叫Ġwann。我们待会儿要和他见面。
messages.en: His name is Ġwann. We're meeting him later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张双语姓名牌：正面写Ġwann，背面写John；想象两面都指向同一位名叫约翰的男子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Modest in manner, without boasting about personal qualities or achievements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人态度谦逊，不夸耀自己的优点或成就。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jiftaħarx bil-kwalitajiet jew bis-suċċessi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谦逊的；谦虚的；不自夸的。

formal.mt: Minkejja s-suċċess tiegħu, l-awtur baqa' ġwejdi u rringrazzja lil kull min għenu.
formal.en: Despite his success, the author remained modest and thanked everyone who had helped him.
formal.zh: 尽管取得了成功，这位作者仍然保持谦逊，并感谢所有帮助过他的人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Mark rebaħ premju u lanqas semmieh! Rita: Iva, hu ġwejdi ħafna. Ma jħobbx jiftaħar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Mark won an award and didn't even mention it! Rita: Yes, he's very modest. He doesn't like to boast.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Mark得了奖，居然都没提起！Rita：是啊，他很谦逊，不喜欢自夸。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark rebaħ premju u lanqas semmieh!
messages.mt_standard: Mark rebaħ premju u lanqas semmieh!
messages.zh: Mark得了奖，居然都没提起！
messages.en: Mark won an award and didn't even mention it!

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu ġwejdi ħafna. Ma jħobbx jiftaħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu ġwejdi ħafna. Ma jħobbx jiftaħar.
messages.zh: 是啊，他很谦逊，不喜欢自夸。
messages.en: Yes, he's very modest. He doesn't like to boast.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位获奖者把奖杯放在身后，先感谢伙伴；给这个谦逊的人贴上ġwejdi标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cowardice: a lack of courage when facing fear, difficulty, or danger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 怯懦，指面对恐惧、困难或危险时缺乏勇气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' kuraġġ quddiem il-biża', id-diffikultajiet jew il-periklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怯懦；缺乏勇气。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, id-deċiżjoni tal-karattru li jabbanduna lil sħabu hija ppreżentata bħala att ta' ġwejferija.
formal.en: In the story, the character's decision to abandon his companions is presented as an act of cowardice.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物抛弃同伴的决定被描写为一种怯懦的行为。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li kien att ta' ġwejferija meta ħarab u ħalla lil sħabu? Toni: F'dik ix-xena, iva. Kien jaf li kellhom bżonn l-għajnuna tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think it was an act of cowardice when he ran away and left his companions? Toni: In that scene, yes. He knew they needed his help.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你觉得他逃走、丢下同伴，是怯懦的行为吗？Toni：在那个场景里，是的。他知道同伴需要他的帮助。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li kien att ta' ġwejferija meta ħarab u ħalla lil sħabu?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li kien att ta' ġwejferija meta ħarab u ħalla lil sħabu?
messages.zh: 你觉得他逃走、丢下同伴，是怯懦的行为吗？
messages.en: Do you think it was an act of cowardice when he ran away and left his companions?

messages.speaker: Toni (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dik ix-xena, iva. Kien jaf li kellhom bżonn l-għajnuna tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: F'dik ix-xena, iva. Kien jaf li kellhom bżonn l-għajnuna tiegħu.
messages.zh: 在那个场景里，是的。他知道同伴需要他的帮助。
messages.en: In that scene, yes. He knew they needed his help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事画面记忆：人物因害怕而丢下同伴逃走，把这份缺乏勇气的表现标为ġwejferija。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be collected together, or to be repaired after damage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物品被收集到一起，也可指损坏的东西被修复。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal affarijiet li jinġabru flimkien jew għal oġġett bil-ħsara li jissewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被收集；被集中起来。
被修理；损坏后被修复。

formal.mt: Il-materjal għall-wirja ġġabbar minn diversi skejjel.
formal.en: The material for the exhibition was collected from several schools.
formal.zh: 展览所需的材料从几所学校收集而来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-bieb għadu miksur? Mark: Le, ġġabbar ilbieraħ u issa jagħlaq sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the door still broken? Mark: No, it was repaired yesterday and now it closes properly.
colloquial.zh: 马娅：门还坏着吗？马克：没有，昨天修好了，现在能关严了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 门还坏着吗？
messages.en: Is the door still broken?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ġġabbar ilbieraħ u issa jagħlaq sew.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ġġabbar ilbieraħ u issa jagħlaq sew.
messages.zh: 没有，昨天修好了，现在能关严了。
messages.en: No, it was repaired yesterday and now it closes properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面分别记义：散落的材料被集中，损坏的门被修好；看主语和语境判断是哪一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop pockmarks or pustules on the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指皮肤出现痘疤、痘坑或脓疱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad meta fuq il-ġilda jitfaċċaw ħofor żgħar jew bżieżaq bil-materja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出现痘疤或痘坑；长出脓疱。

collocations.en: His face developed pockmarks or pustules.
collocations.zh: 他的脸上出现了痘疤或脓疱。

collocations.en: His body developed pockmarks or pustules.
collocations.zh: 他的身上出现了痘疤或脓疱。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, wiċċ ir-raġel ġġaddar u baqa' mmarkat.
formal.en: In the story, the man's face developed pockmarks and remained marked.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个男人的脸上出现了痘疤，并留下了痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lil wiċċ il-karattru? Mark: Wiċċu ġġaddar; ara l-ħofor żgħar fit-tpinġija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the character's face? Mark: His face developed pockmarks; look at the little pits in the drawing.
colloquial.zh: 马娅：这个人物的脸怎么了？马克：他脸上长了痘坑；看看画里的那些小凹坑。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个人物的脸怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the character's face?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Wiċċu ġġaddar; ara l-ħofor żgħar fit-tpinġija.
messages.mt_standard: Wiċċu ġġaddar; ara l-ħofor żgħar fit-tpinġija.
messages.zh: 他脸上长了痘坑；看看画里的那些小凹坑。
messages.en: His face developed pockmarks; look at the little pits in the drawing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义配成皮肤特写：一种是留下的小凹坑，一种是鼓起的脓疱，两种画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mislead someone by making them believe something false.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人相信不真实的事情，从而欺骗或蒙骗对方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqarraq b'xi ħadd billi jġiegħlu jemmen xi ħaġa li mhijiex vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗；使人信以为真而受到蒙骗。

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ ġġakbina lill-klijent billi tah informazzjoni falza dwar il-prodott.
formal.en: The seller deceived the customer by giving him false information about the product.
formal.zh: 卖家向顾客提供了有关产品的虚假信息，欺骗了顾客。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ? Mark: Għax ġġakbina lil ħija dwar il-prezz.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you trust that seller? Mark: Because he deceived my brother about the price.
colloquial.zh: 马娅：你为什么不信任那个卖家？马克：因为他在价格上骗过我哥哥。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.zh: 你为什么不信任那个卖家？
messages.en: Why don't you trust that seller?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ġġakbina lil ħija dwar il-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ġġakbina lil ħija dwar il-prezz.
messages.zh: 因为他在价格上骗过我哥哥。
messages.en: Because he deceived my brother about the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象卖家说出假价格，顾客却信以为真；把“说假话使人上当”的完整情景与此词相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lift a vehicle or another heavy object using a jack.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用千斤顶把车辆或其他重物顶起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerfa' vettura jew oġġett tqil ieħor permezz ta' ġakk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用千斤顶顶起；用起重装置抬升。

collocations.zh: 用千斤顶顶起了厢式车

formal.mt: Il-mekkanik ġġakkja l-karozza biex jibdel ir-rota.
formal.en: The mechanic jacked up the car to change the wheel.
formal.zh: 机修工用千斤顶顶起汽车，以便更换车轮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-mekkanik diġà ġġakkja l-karozza? Mark: Iva, issa qed jibdel ir-rota.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the mechanic already jacked up the car? Mark: Yes, he's changing the wheel now.
colloquial.zh: 马娅：机修工已经把车顶起来了吗？马克：是的，他现在正在换车轮。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 机修工已经把车顶起来了吗？
messages.en: Has the mechanic already jacked up the car?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修接待员)
messages.zh: 是的，他现在正在换车轮。
messages.en: Yes, he's changing the wheel now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 jack up 作跨语言提示，再想象千斤顶把车轮抬离地面，记住“顶起”这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be gathered or collected together in one place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被收集或集中到一处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal xi ħaġa li tinġabar jew titqiegħed flimkien f'post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被收集；被聚集到一起。

formal.mt: L-ikel għall-familji fil-bżonn ġġamma' fiċ-ċentru tal-komunità.
formal.en: The food for families in need was collected at the community centre.
formal.zh: 为困难家庭募集的食品被集中到了社区中心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-materjal għall-attività? Mark: Ġġamma' kollu fil-klassi; tista' ssibu hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the material for the activity? Mark: It was all collected in the classroom; you can find it there.
colloquial.zh: 马娅：活动用的材料在哪儿？马克：全都集中到教室里了，你可以去那里找。

messages.speaker: Maja (教师)
messages.zh: 活动用的材料在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the material for the activity?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġġamma' kollu fil-klassi; tista' ssibu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Ġġamma' kollu fil-klassi; tista' ssibu hemm.
messages.zh: 全都集中到教室里了，你可以去那里找。
messages.en: It was all collected in the classroom; you can find it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象分散在各处的材料最后放到同一张桌上；从材料的角度记“被收集、被集中”。

gloss_zh: 燃烧发热；烧成焦烬；眼睛闪亮

teaching_sense.en_definition: To burn or glow with heat, especially of coal or similar fuel; also to burn to a cinder, especially of a lamp wick, or to glow or flash, of someone's eyes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常指煤炭等燃料燃烧或发出热光；也指灯芯等烧成焦烬，或指人的眼睛发亮、闪光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għall-faħam jew fjuwil simili li jaqbad jew jiddi bis-sħana; ukoll għal ftila li tinħaraq għalkollox, jew għal għajnejn li jleqqu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to burn or glow with heat (usually used of coal or similar fuel)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 燃烧或因高温而发光，通常用于煤炭或类似燃料。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be burnt to a cinder (used especially of the wick of a lamp)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被烧成焦烬，尤指灯的灯芯。

sense_translations.en_definition: to glow or flash (used of one's eyes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发亮；闪光，用于形容人的眼睛。

collocations.en: glowed with heat in the brazier

formal.mt: Il-faħam ġġammar fil-kenur u dawwal il-kamra b'dawl ħamrani.
formal.en: The coal glowed in the brazier and lit the room with a reddish light.
formal.zh: 煤炭在炭炉中烧得发亮，红色的微光照亮了房间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-faħam jidher aħmar? Mark: Għax ġġammar; għadu jaħraq ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the coal look red? Mark: Because it has begun to glow; it's still very hot.
colloquial.zh: 马娅：煤炭为什么看起来红红的？马克：因为它烧得发亮了，还很烫。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 煤炭为什么看起来红红的？
messages.en: Why does the coal look red?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为它烧得发亮了，还很烫。
messages.en: Because it has begun to glow; it's still very hot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张图串联三个义项：炭火发红、灯芯焦化、双眼闪亮；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 把东西卡住；干扰广播信号

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get something stuck in a confined space, or to interfere with a broadcast signal so that it is blocked or confused.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西卡在狭窄空间里；也指干扰广播信号，使其受阻或混乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwaħħal xi ħaġa fi spazju dejjaq, jew jinterferixxi ma' sinjal tax-xandir biex jimblokkah jew ifixklu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to jam (to get something stuck in a confined space)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物卡在狭窄空间里，使其无法顺畅移动。

sense_translations.en_definition: to jam (to block or confuse a broadcast signal)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 干扰广播信号，使其被阻断或变得混乱。

collocations.en: jammed the paper in the machine

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, apparat mhux magħruf ġġammja s-sinjal tar-radju u waqqaf ix-xandir.
formal.en: In the story, an unidentified device jammed the radio signal and stopped the broadcast.
formal.zh: 故事中，一台不明设备干扰了无线电信号，导致广播中断。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqfet il-magna? Mark: Xi ħadd ġġammja l-karta fiha u issa l-karta ma tiċċaqlaqx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the machine stop? Mark: Someone jammed the paper in it, and now the paper won't move.
colloquial.zh: 马娅：机器怎么停了？马克：有人把纸卡在里面了，现在纸动不了了。

messages.speaker: Maja (办公室职员)
messages.zh: 机器怎么停了？
messages.en: Why did the machine stop?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd ġġammja l-karta fiha u issa l-karta ma tiċċaqlaqx.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd ġġammja l-karta fiha u issa l-karta ma tiċċaqlaqx.
messages.zh: 有人把纸卡在里面了，现在纸动不了了。
messages.en: Someone jammed the paper in it, and now the paper won't move.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借英语 jam 记两种受阻画面：纸张卡住无法移动，广播信号受干扰无法正常传送。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be joined together with other parts, or to be assembled into a whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与其他部分连接在一起，或由各个部件组装成整体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħaqad ma' partijiet oħra jew jiġi mmuntat biex jifforma ħaġa sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被连接在一起；彼此接合。
被组装；由零部件装配成整体。

collocations.zh: 与其余部分连接在一起

formal.mt: Il-qafas tal-mudell ġġannat fil-ħanut tax-xogħol qabel ma ġie miżbugħ.
formal.en: The model's frame was assembled in the workshop before it was painted.
formal.zh: 模型的框架先在工坊里组装完成，随后才上漆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qafas għadu f'biċċiet? Mark: Le, ġġannat dalgħodu; issa nistgħu niżbgħuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the frame still in pieces? Mark: No, it was assembled this morning; now we can paint it.
colloquial.zh: 马娅：框架还是散件吗？马克：不是了，今天早上已经组装好，现在可以上漆了。

messages.speaker: Maja (手工课学生)
messages.zh: 框架还是散件吗？
messages.en: Is the frame still in pieces?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ġġannat dalgħodu; issa nistgħu niżbgħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ġġannat dalgħodu; issa nistgħu niżbgħuh.
messages.zh: 不是了，今天早上已经组装好，现在可以上漆了。
messages.en: No, it was assembled this morning; now we can paint it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上的散件先彼此接合，最后成为完整框架；分别对应“被连接”和“被组装”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For an experience to be undergone, or for clothing to be tried on to check its fit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某种经历被人亲身体验，或衣物被试穿以检查是否合身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għal esperjenza li wieħed jgħaddi minnha, jew għal ilbies li jintlibes biex jitkejjel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被亲身经历；被体验

sense_translations.en_definition: to be tried on for fitting (used of clothes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被试穿以检查是否合身，用于衣物

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-uġigħ li ġġarrab wara l-inċident.
formal.en: The report describes the pain that was experienced after the accident.
formal.zh: 报告描述了事故后所经历的疼痛。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan il-kowt ġġarrab diġà? Pawlu: Iva, iżda kien kbir wisq.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has this coat been tried on already? Pawlu: Yes, but it was too big.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这件外套已经试穿过了吗？保罗：是的，不过太大了。

messages.speaker: Marta (店员)
messages.zh: 这件外套已经试穿过了吗？
messages.en: Has this coat been tried on already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (顾客)
messages.zh: 是的，不过太大了。
messages.en: Yes, but it was too big.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个场景并排记：疼痛被经历，外套被试穿；根据主语判断是哪一种意思。

gloss_zh: 被拆毁；被推翻；被击败；屈服

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be demolished or toppled, to be defeated, or to give way under pressure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指建筑等被拆毁或推倒，也可指被击败，或在压力下屈服、支撑不住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitwaqqa' jew jinqered, jingħeleb, jew iċedi quddiem pressjoni jew diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拆毁；被拆除
被推倒；被推翻
被击败；被征服
屈服；因无力抵抗而倒下或支撑不住

formal.mt: Il-bini l-antik ġġarraf waqt ix-xogħol tat-twaqqigħ.
formal.en: The old building was demolished during the demolition work.
formal.zh: 那座旧建筑在拆除作业中被拆毁了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'sar mill-ħajt ta' wara? Mark: Ġġarraf ilbieraħ; issa hemm spazju għall-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to the back wall? Mark: It was knocked down yesterday; now there is room for the garden.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：后面的墙怎么样了？马克：昨天被推倒了，现在有地方做花园了。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 后面的墙怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened to the back wall?

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġġarraf ilbieraħ; issa hemm spazju għall-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Ġġarraf ilbieraħ; issa hemm spazju għall-ġnien.
messages.zh: 昨天被推倒了，现在有地方做花园了。
messages.en: It was knocked down yesterday; now there is room for the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅倒下的画面串联：建筑被拆倒、政权被推翻、对手被击败、人终于屈服。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become stony or take on the character of stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得具有石头的性质或呈现石质状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir bħall-ġebel jew jieħu natura ta' ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得石质；变得像石头

formal.mt: L-eżami tal-kampjun wera li s-saff ta' barra ġġebbel.
formal.en: Examination of the sample showed that the outer layer had become stony.
formal.zh: 对样本的检查显示，外层已经变得石质。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif inbidel dan il-materjal? Toni: Ġġebbel; issa qisu ġebla.
colloquial.en: Nina: How has this material changed? Toni: It has become stony; now it is like a stone.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这种材料发生了什么变化？托尼：变得像石头了，现在就像一块石头。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这种材料发生了什么变化？
messages.en: How has this material changed?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.zh: 变得像石头了，现在就像一块石头。
messages.en: It has become stony; now it is like a stone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象样本外层逐渐变成石头般的状态，把这个词与“变得石质”的画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become chalky, taking on a texture or appearance like chalk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质地或外观变得像粉笔，呈现粉笔质的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir bħall-ġibs fid-dehra jew fin-nisġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得像粉笔；呈现粉笔质地或外观

collocations.zh: 这一层呈现出粉笔质地

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-wiċċ tal-kampjun ġġebbes.
formal.en: The report describes how the surface of the sample became chalky.
formal.zh: 报告描述了样本表面如何变得具有粉笔质地。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-wiċċ għadu lixx? David: Le, ġġebbes; issa qisu ġibs.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the surface still smooth? David: No, it has become chalky; now it is like chalk.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：表面还光滑吗？戴维：不，已经变得像粉笔了，现在有粉笔般的质地。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 表面还光滑吗？
messages.en: Is the surface still smooth?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.zh: 不，已经变得像粉笔了，现在有粉笔般的质地。
messages.en: No, it has become chalky; now it is like chalk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用粉笔表面的触感来记忆；与表示变得石质的ġġebbel分开，重点记住粉笔质地。

gloss_zh: 被更新；被修复；恢复清新

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be renewed, restored to good condition, or made fresh again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被更新或续期，被恢复到良好状态，或重新变得清新。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir ġdid mill-ġdid, jerġa' jitqiegħed f'kundizzjoni tajba, jew jerġa' jikseb il-freskezza tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被更新；被续期
被修复；被恢复到原有或良好的状态
恢复清新；重新焕发精神或活力

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ġġedded għal sena oħra bi qbil bejn iż-żewġ partijiet.
formal.en: The contract was renewed for another year by agreement between the two parties.
formal.zh: 经双方同意，合同续期一年。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Il-bini tal-librerija ġġedded? Mario: Iva, u issa jidħol ħafna aktar dawl.
colloquial.en: Elena: Has the library building been restored? Mario: Yes, and much more light comes in now.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：图书馆的楼修复了吗？马里奥：是的，现在采光好多了。

messages.speaker: Elena (读者)
messages.zh: 图书馆的楼修复了吗？
messages.en: Has the library building been restored?

messages.speaker: Mario (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u issa jidħol ħafna aktar dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u issa jidħol ħafna aktar dawl.
messages.zh: 是的，现在采光好多了。
messages.en: Yes, and much more light comes in now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住“重新变好”的共同画面：合同续期、建筑修复、精神恢复清新，再按对象选择译法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become cowardly and lose the courage to face a difficult or frightening situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得怯懦，失去面对困难或可怕处境的勇气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir beżżiegħ u jitlef il-kuraġġ li jiffaċċja sitwazzjoni diffiċli jew tal-biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得怯懦；变得缺乏勇气

collocations.en: he became cowardly in the face of danger
collocations.zh: 他面对危险时变得怯懦

collocations.en: he lost his nerve at the last moment

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-protagonist ġġejjef quddiem il-periklu u ħalla lil sħabu waħedhom.
formal.en: In the story, the protagonist became cowardly in the face of danger and left his companions alone.
formal.zh: 在故事中，主人公面对危险变得怯懦，丢下同伴独自离开。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Pawlu ma daħalx magħkom? Ben: Ġġejjef fl-aħħar mument u baqa' barra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why didn't Pawlu go in with you? Ben: He lost his nerve at the last moment and stayed outside.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗为什么没和你们一起进去？本：他在最后一刻胆怯了，留在外面。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么没和你们一起进去？
messages.en: Why didn't Pawlu go in with you?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġġejjef fl-aħħar mument u baqa' barra.
messages.mt_standard: Ġġejjef fl-aħħar mument u baqa' barra.
messages.zh: 他在最后一刻胆怯了，留在外面。
messages.en: He lost his nerve at the last moment and stayed outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象已经走到门口，却因胆怯退缩的情景；重点记住这是“变得怯懦”的变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover something with icing, or to freeze and become solid from cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给食物覆盖糖霜，或因寒冷而冻结、凝固。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi xi ħaġa b'kisja taz-zokkor, jew jagħqad bil-kesħa u jsir silġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给……覆盖糖霜；给……裹上糖衣
冻结；结冰

collocations.en: he covered the cake with icing

formal.mt: Il-furnar ġġela l-kejk b'kisja rqiqa taz-zokkor qabel ma żejnu.
formal.en: The baker covered the cake with a thin layer of icing before decorating it.
formal.zh: 烘焙师先给蛋糕裹上一层薄糖霜，然后再进行装饰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-ilma fil-flixkun ġġela? Leo: Iva, ħallejtu fil-friża għal żmien twil wisq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the water in the bottle freeze? Leo: Yes, I left it in the freezer for too long.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：瓶子里的水结冰了吗？利奥：是的，我把它放在冷冻室里太久了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 瓶子里的水结冰了吗？
messages.en: Did the water in the bottle freeze?

messages.speaker: Leo (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħallejtu fil-friża għal żmien twil wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħallejtu fil-friża għal żmien twil wisq.
messages.zh: 是的，我把它放在冷冻室里太久了。
messages.en: Yes, I left it in the freezer for too long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用厨房里的两幅画面记忆：蛋糕裹上糖霜，瓶里的水冻成冰；看对象区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 被使或任其滴流而下；变强；发芽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made or allowed to trickle down, to become stronger, or to germinate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指液体被引导或任其缓缓滴流而下，也可指变得更强健，或种子开始发芽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħalla jew jitwassal biex iqattar 'l isfel, isir aktar b'saħħtu, jew jibda jinbet.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made or allowed to trickle down
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被引导或任其缓缓滴流而下
变得更强；变得更强健
发芽；开始萌发

collocations.en: the liquid was allowed to trickle down
collocations.zh: 液体被任其缓缓滴流而下

formal.mt: Matul id-dimostrazzjoni, il-likwidu ġġelben bil-mod 'l isfel tul il-ħġieġ.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the liquid was allowed to trickle slowly down the glass.
formal.zh: 演示过程中，液体被任其沿着玻璃缓缓滴流而下。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-qamħ ġġelben diġà? Samwel: Iva, ara r-rimjiet ħodor fit-trej.
colloquial.en: Rita: Has the wheat germinated already? Samwel: Yes, look at the green shoots in the tray.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：小麦已经发芽了吗？萨姆韦尔：是的，看看托盘里的绿色嫩芽。

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 小麦已经发芽了吗？
messages.en: Has the wheat germinated already?

messages.speaker: Samwel (园艺教师)
messages.zh: 是的，看看托盘里的绿色嫩芽。
messages.en: Yes, look at the green shoots in the tray.

cognitive_memory_aid: 编一段学习小故事：水缓缓滴下，小麦开始发芽，茎逐渐强健；三个画面分别对应三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop a tough texture resembling leather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质地变得像皮革一样坚韧，常用于描述表面或食物的变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu konsistenza iebsa u tenċi li tixbah il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 质地变得像皮革一样坚韧。

collocations.en: cheese that has developed a leathery texture
collocations.zh: 质地变得像皮革一样坚韧的奶酪

collocations.en: a surface that has become leathery in the sun
collocations.zh: 在阳光下变得像皮革一样坚韧的表面
