formal.mt: Wara li tħalla mikxuf għal diversi jiem, il-ġobon ġġelled u sar diffiċli biex tomogħdu.
formal.en: After being left uncovered for several days, the cheese developed a leathery texture and became difficult to chew.
formal.zh: 奶酪敞放了几天后，质地变得像皮革一样坚韧，难以咀嚼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ġobon ġġelled! | Pawlu: Iva, ħallejnieh mikxuf għal wisq żmien.
colloquial.en: Maja: This cheese has gone leathery! | Pawlu: Yes, we left it uncovered for too long.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这奶酪变得像皮革一样难嚼了！ | 保罗：是啊，我们让它敞着放太久了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这奶酪变得像皮革一样难嚼了！
messages.en: This cheese has gone leathery!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħallejnieh mikxuf għal wisq żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħallejnieh mikxuf għal wisq żmien.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们让它敞着放太久了。
messages.en: Yes, we left it uncovered for too long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象奶酪久放后嚼起来像皮革，用这幅质地变化的画面记住词义。

gloss_zh: 使辅音重叠；发成长辅音

teaching_sense.en_definition: To double a consonant or pronounce it with the extended duration of a geminate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使辅音重叠，或在发音时延长辅音的持续时间，形成长辅音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirdoppja konsonanti jew jippronunzjaha b'tul akbar bħala konsonanti doppja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使辅音重叠或延长，形成长辅音。

collocations.en: geminated the consonant in the middle of the word
collocations.zh: 将词中间的辅音发成长辅音
将 /m/ 音延长为长辅音

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-pronunzja, l-istudent ġġemina l-konsonanti fin-nofs tal-kelma u żammha għal aktar ħin.
formal.en: In the pronunciation exercise, the student geminated the consonant in the middle of the word, holding it for longer.
formal.zh: 在发音练习中，学生将词中间的辅音发成长辅音，使其持续更长时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-ħoss dam aktar? | Mark: Għax Pawlu ġġemina l-konsonanti meta qara l-kelma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did that sound last longer? | Mark: Because Pawlu geminated the consonant when he read the word.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么那个音持续得更久？ | 马克：因为保罗读这个词时，把那个辅音发成了长辅音。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么那个音持续得更久？
messages.en: Why did that sound last longer?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Pawlu ġġemina l-konsonanti meta qara l-kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Pawlu ġġemina l-konsonanti meta qara l-kelma.
messages.zh: 因为保罗读这个词时，把那个辅音发成了长辅音。
messages.en: Because Pawlu geminated the consonant when he read the word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把辅音想成一根可以拉长的橡皮筋，发音时多保持一会儿，帮助记住长辅音化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered or stained with soot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面沾上烟灰，或因烟灰附着而变黑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkesa jew jitħammeġ bin-nugrufun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沾上烟灰，变得黑乎乎的。

collocations.en: the bottom of the pot became sooty
the ceiling became sooty from the smoke

formal.mt: Wara diversi sigħat fuq in-nar tal-injam, il-qiegħ tal-borma ġġemmed u kellu jitnaddaf bir-reqqa.
formal.en: After several hours over the wood fire, the bottom of the pot became sooty and had to be cleaned carefully.
formal.zh: 在柴火上烧了几个小时后，锅底积满了烟灰，必须仔细清洗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm ġġemmed il-qiegħ tal-borma! | Pawlu: Iva, in-nar tal-injam ħalla ħafna nugrufun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how sooty the bottom of the pot has become! | Pawlu: Yes, the wood fire left a lot of soot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，锅底都熏得这么黑了！ | 保罗：是啊，柴火留下了很多烟灰。

messages.speaker: Maja (露营同伴)
messages.zh: 看，锅底都熏得这么黑了！
messages.en: Look how sooty the bottom of the pot has become!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (露营同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, in-nar tal-injam ħalla ħafna nugrufun.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, in-nar tal-injam ħalla ħafna nugrufun.
messages.zh: 是啊，柴火留下了很多烟灰。
messages.en: Yes, the wood fire left a lot of soot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象露营煮饭后锅底一层黑烟灰，把这个词和手指一摸就黑的画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made more beautiful, including through added decoration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被变得更加美观，也可指通过增添装饰而得到美化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar sabiħ, ukoll permezz ta' tiżjin miżjud.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被美化，变得美丽。
被增添装饰或点缀。

collocations.en: the garden was beautified with flowers
collocations.zh: 花园因花卉的点缀而变得美丽

collocations.en: the book was embellished with illustrations
collocations.zh: 这本书增添了插图装饰

formal.mt: Il-ġnien tal-iskola ġġemmel b'fjuri ġodda u sar post aktar pjaċevoli għall-istudenti.
formal.en: The school garden was beautified with new flowers and became a more pleasant place for students.
formal.zh: 学校花园增添了新的花卉，变得更加美观，也成为学生更乐于停留的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm ġġemmel il-ġnien bil-fjuri! | Pawlu: Iva, issa nieħu gost noqgħod hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: How lovely the flowers have made the garden! | Pawlu: Yes, I enjoy spending time there now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：有了这些花，花园变得真漂亮！ | 保罗：是啊，我现在很喜欢待在那里。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 有了这些花，花园变得真漂亮！
messages.en: How lovely the flowers have made the garden!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nieħu gost noqgħod hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nieħu gost noqgħod hemm.
messages.zh: 是啊，我现在很喜欢待在那里。
messages.en: Yes, I enjoy spending time there now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个相连的画面：花园变漂亮，书页添插图；共同点都是事物得到美化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flow abundantly, especially when describing tears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大量地流淌，尤其用于描述泪水不断涌流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżel jew joħroġ bil-kotra, speċjalment meta jkun qiegħed jissemma d-dmugħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to flow copiously (used especially of tears)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量流淌，尤用于形容眼泪涌流。

collocations.zh: 泪水从他眼中不断涌出
泪水沿着他的脸颊不断流下

formal.mt: Meta sema' l-aħbar, id-dmugħ ġġemġem minn għajnejh u għal xi ħin ma setax jitkellem.
formal.en: When he heard the news, tears streamed from his eyes, and for a while he could not speak.
formal.zh: 听到消息后，他泪流不止，一时间说不出话来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħassu meta ra lil bintu? | Pawlu: Id-dmugħ ġġemġem minn għajnejh; tant feraħ biha!
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he feel when he saw his daughter? | Pawlu: Tears streamed from his eyes; he was so happy to see her!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他见到女儿时是什么感受？ | 保罗：他泪流不止，见到她实在太高兴了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassu meta ra lil bintu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassu meta ra lil bintu?
messages.zh: 他见到女儿时是什么感受？
messages.en: How did he feel when he saw his daughter?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dmugħ ġġemġem minn għajnejh; tant feraħ biha!
messages.mt_standard: Id-dmugħ ġġemġem minn għajnejh; tant feraħ biha!
messages.zh: 他泪流不止，见到她实在太高兴了！
messages.en: Tears streamed from his eyes; he was so happy to see her!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把重复出现的字母组合当作记忆节奏，联想眼泪一股接一股地涌流。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce or bring something into existence, such as electricity, information, or interest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生或生成某种事物，例如电力、信息或兴趣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipproduċi jew joħloq xi ħaġa, bħall-elettriku, l-informazzjoni jew l-interess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产生、生成或创造出某种事物。

formal.mt: Matul il-jum, il-pannell solari ġġenera biżżejjed elettriku biex iħaddem id-dwal tal-bini.
formal.en: During the day, the solar panel generated enough electricity to power the building's lights.
formal.zh: 白天，太阳能板产生了足够的电力，可以供大楼照明使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-filmat il-ġdid ġġenera ħafna interess! | Pawlu: Iva, diġà staqsewna ħafna nies dwar il-proġett.
colloquial.en: Maja: The new video has generated a lot of interest! | Pawlu: Yes, lots of people have already asked us about the project.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新视频引起了很多人的兴趣！ | 保罗：是啊，已经有很多人来问我们这个项目了。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目同事)
messages.zh: 新视频引起了很多人的兴趣！
messages.en: The new video has generated a lot of interest!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà staqsewna ħafna nies dwar il-proġett.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà staqsewna ħafna nies dwar il-proġett.
messages.zh: 是啊，已经有很多人来问我们这个项目了。
messages.en: Yes, lots of people have already asked us about the project.

cognitive_memory_aid: 可以借英语 generate 辅助记形，再用太阳能板产生电力的画面记住核心意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a broad statement or draw a general conclusion from particular cases.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据个别事例作出概括或一般性结论；语境中也可表示以偏概全。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel stqarrija ġenerali jew jasal għal konklużjoni ġenerali minn każijiet partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 概括；从具体事例推及一般情况。

collocations.zh: 从单个事例作出一般化推断
对整个群体作出笼统判断

formal.mt: L-awtur ġġeneralizza minn ftit eżempji biss, għalhekk il-konklużjoni teħtieġ aktar evidenza.
formal.en: The author generalized from only a few examples, so the conclusion requires more evidence.
formal.zh: 作者仅凭少数几个例子便作出了一般性结论，因此该结论还需要更多证据支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark qal li l-karozzi tal-linja dejjem jaslu tard. | Pawlu: Ġġeneralizza minn vjaġġ wieħed; ilbieraħ tiegħi waslet fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark said the buses always arrive late. | Pawlu: He generalized from one journey; mine arrived on time yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克说公交车总是晚点。 | 保罗：他只坐了一次就以偏概全了；我昨天坐的那班就准时到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark qal li l-karozzi tal-linja dejjem jaslu tard.
messages.mt_standard: Mark qal li l-karozzi tal-linja dejjem jaslu tard.
messages.zh: 马克说公交车总是晚点。
messages.en: Mark said the buses always arrive late.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġġeneralizza minn vjaġġ wieħed; ilbieraħ tiegħi waslet fil-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Ġġeneralizza minn vjaġġ wieħed; ilbieraħ tiegħi waslet fil-ħin.
messages.zh: 他只坐了一次就以偏概全了；我昨天坐的那班就准时到了。
messages.en: He generalized from one journey; mine arrived on time yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个由单个例子指向整个群体的箭头，记住从具体情况推向一般结论的过程。

gloss_zh: 移到一旁；被移到一旁；倾向某种观点

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move oneself aside, be shifted aside, or lean towards a particular ideology or viewpoint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自己移到一旁，被移到一旁，或在思想上倾向某种意识形态或观点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi lejn il-ġenb, jitmexxa lejn il-ġenb, jew ixaqleb lejn ideoloġija jew fehma partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自己移到一旁；侧身让开。
被移到一旁；被挪开。

sense_translations.en_definition: to tend towards a particular ideology or viewpoint
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向某种特定的意识形态或观点。

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskussjoni, ir-rappreżentant ġġenneb lejn il-fehma tal-maġġoranza, iżda sema' wkoll l-argumenti tal-oħrajn.
formal.en: During the discussion, the representative leaned towards the majority's viewpoint but also listened to the others' arguments.
formal.zh: 讨论中，这位代表倾向多数人的观点，但也听取了其他人的论据。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Pawlu ġġenneb? Luka: Ġġenneb biex jgħaddi r-raġel bil-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did Pawlu move aside? Luka: He moved aside to let the man carrying the box pass.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗为什么移到一旁？卢卡：他让到一旁，好让那个搬箱子的男人过去。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么移到一旁？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu move aside?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.zh: 他让到一旁，好让那个搬箱子的男人过去。
messages.en: He moved aside to let the man carrying the box pass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“身体站到一边、观点偏向一边”串联记忆；再区分主动让开与被人挪开两种情况。

gloss_zh: 发疯；慌乱困惑；疯狂爱上某人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go mad, become flustered or confused, or fall madly in love with someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发疯，变得慌乱或困惑，或疯狂地爱上某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef moħħu, jitħawwad ħafna, jew jinħabb b'mod qawwi ħafna ma' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发疯；失去理智。
变得慌乱、不知所措或困惑。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fall madly in love with sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 疯狂地爱上某人；对某人痴迷。

collocations.en: became flustered by all the instructions
collocations.zh: 被一大堆指示弄得慌乱

collocations.en: fell madly in love with Marija

formal.mt: Meta rċieva diversi istruzzjonijiet kontradittorji, l-istudent ġġennen u talab spjegazzjoni aktar ċara.
formal.en: When he received several contradictory instructions, the student became flustered and asked for a clearer explanation.
formal.zh: 收到几条相互矛盾的指示后，这名学生慌了神，要求得到更清楚的解释。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu qed jitbissem il-ħin kollu? Nina: Ġġennen għal Marija; ma jitkellem fuq xejn aktar!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is Pawlu smiling all the time? Nina: He has fallen madly in love with Marija; he talks about nothing else!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗怎么一直在笑？妮娜：他疯狂地爱上玛丽亚了，开口闭口都是她！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu qed jitbissem il-ħin kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu qed jitbissem il-ħin kollu?
messages.zh: 保罗怎么一直在笑？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu smiling all the time?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġġennen għal Marija; ma jitkellem fuq xejn aktar!
messages.mt_standard: Ġġennen għal Marija; ma jitkellem fuq xejn aktar!
messages.zh: 他疯狂地爱上玛丽亚了，开口闭口都是她！
messages.en: He has fallen madly in love with Marija; he talks about nothing else!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项画成三格漫画：失去理智、忙乱发懵、为爱痴迷；具体含义要靠上下文判断。

gloss_zh: 开裂；破损；身体状况很差或筋疲力尽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become cracked or broken, or to be in poor physical condition through illness or exhaustion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出现裂纹或破损；也可形容人因疾病或劳累而身体状况很差、筋疲力尽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixxaqqaq jew jinkiser; għal persuna, ikun fi stat fiżiku ħażin minħabba mard jew għeja kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出现裂纹；处于开裂状态。
破损；处于损坏状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be in a bad state (e.g. due to ill health or strenuous exercise causing exhaustion)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体状况很差，例如因生病而虚弱，或因剧烈运动而筋疲力尽。

collocations.en: the vase was broken in the fall

formal.mt: Il-ħġieġ tat-tieqa ġġenġel wara d-daqqa u kellu jinbidel.
formal.en: The window glass became cracked after the impact and had to be replaced.
formal.zh: 窗玻璃受到撞击后出现裂纹，必须更换。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien Mark wara t-taħriġ? | Pawlu: Ġġenġel wara dawk l-eżerċizzji kollha; kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was Mark after training? | Pawlu: He was exhausted after all those exercises; he needed to rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克训练后怎么样？ | 保罗：做完那么多练习，他累得够呛，需要休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (队友)
messages.zh: 马克训练后怎么样？
messages.en: How was Mark after training?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġġenġel wara dawk l-eżerċizzji kollha; kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ġġenġel wara dawk l-eżerċizzji kollha; kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 做完那么多练习，他累得够呛，需要休息。
messages.en: He was exhausted after all those exercises; he needed to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记三幅画面：玻璃开裂、花瓶破损、运动后累瘫；用具体场景区分三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To investigate or make observations about rocks and the geological features of an area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究或观察某个地区的岩石及其他地质特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jistudja jew josserva l-blat u l-karatteristiċi ġeoloġiċi ta' żona.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行地质研究、地质考察或地质观察。

collocations.en: made geological observations along the coast
conducted geological research by examining rock layers
collocations.zh: 通过考察岩层进行地质研究

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur ġġeoloġizza tul il-kosta, fejn eżamina l-blat u ħa noti dwar is-saffi differenti.
formal.en: The researcher made geological observations along the coast, examining the rocks and taking notes on the different layers.
formal.zh: 研究人员沿海岸开展地质观察，考察岩石，并记录不同岩层的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel David waqt il-mixja mal-kosta? Mark: Ġġeoloġizza ftit; waqaf iħares lejn il-blat u jieħu n-noti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did David do during the coastal walk? Mark: He did a little geological observation; he stopped to look at the rocks and take notes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：戴维沿海散步时做了什么？马克：他做了点地质观察，停下来看看岩石、记记笔记。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 戴维沿海散步时做了什么？
messages.en: What did David do during the coastal walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġġeoloġizza ftit; waqaf iħares lejn il-blat u jieħu n-noti.
messages.mt_standard: Ġġeoloġizza ftit; waqaf iħares lejn il-blat u jieħu n-noti.
messages.zh: 他做了点地质观察，停下来看看岩石、记记笔记。
messages.en: He did a little geological observation; he stopped to look at the rocks and take notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人拿着笔记本沿海岸观察岩层，把这个词与“看岩石、记地质”整组动作绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 使几何化；用几何形式表现

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something a geometric form or represent it using geometric shapes or concepts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 赋予事物几何形式，或用几何图形、几何概念来表现它。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti forma ġeometrika lil xi ħaġa jew jirrappreżentaha permezz ta' forom jew kunċetti ġeometriċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使几何化；用几何形式或几何方法表现、处理。

collocations.en: gave the design a geometric form
represented natural forms as geometric shapes
collocations.zh: 用几何图形表现自然形态

formal.mt: L-artist ġġeometrizza l-pajsaġġ billi rrappreżenta l-għoljiet bi trijangoli u x-xemx b'ċirku.
formal.en: The artist geometrized the landscape by representing the hills with triangles and the sun with a circle.
formal.zh: 艺术家用三角形表现山丘，用圆形表现太阳，把风景作了几何化处理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex is-siġar fit-tpinġija jidhru qishom trijangoli? Toni: L-artist ġġeometrizza l-forom biex jagħmel id-disinn aktar sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do the trees in the drawing look like triangles? Toni: The artist geometrized the shapes to make the design simpler.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：画里的树为什么看起来像三角形？托尼：艺术家把形状几何化了，让设计更简洁。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex is-siġar fit-tpinġija jidhru qishom trijangoli?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex is-siġar fit-tpinġija jidhru qishom trijangoli?
messages.zh: 画里的树为什么看起来像三角形？
messages.en: Why do the trees in the drawing look like triangles?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-artist ġġeometrizza l-forom biex jagħmel id-disinn aktar sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: L-artist ġġeometrizza l-forom biex jagħmel id-disinn aktar sempliċi.
messages.zh: 艺术家把形状几何化了，让设计更简洁。
messages.en: The artist geometrized the shapes to make the design simpler.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中把一幅风景画改成圆形、三角形和方形；从具体画面记住“使几何化”这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be put up with or tolerated, or, of food, to be digested.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某事被忍受或容忍；用于食物时，指被消化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi ssapportat jew ittollerat; meta jingħad għall-ikel, jiġi diġerit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被忍受；被勉强承受。
被容忍；被允许存在或继续。
被消化，指食物经过消化过程。

collocations.en: the noise was put up with for a short time

formal.mt: L-istorbju ġġerragħ għal ftit minuti, iżda mbagħad il-parteċipanti talbu l-kwiet biex ikomplu jaħdmu.
formal.en: The noise was tolerated for a few minutes, but then the participants asked for quiet so they could continue working.
formal.zh: 大家忍受了几分钟噪声，随后参与者要求保持安静，以便继续工作。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif kien l-ikel tal-bieraħ? Pawlu: Kien ħafif u ġġerragħ faċilment; ma ħassejt l-ebda toqol fl-istonku.
colloquial.en: Anna: How was yesterday's food? Pawlu: It was light and easily digested; I felt no heaviness in my stomach.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：昨天的饭吃着怎么样？保罗：挺清淡，也容易消化；我一点也没觉得胃里发沉。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的饭吃着怎么样？
messages.en: How was yesterday's food?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien ħafif u ġġerragħ faċilment; ma ħassejt l-ebda toqol fl-istonku.
messages.mt_standard: Kien ħafif u ġġerragħ faċilment; ma ħassejt l-ebda toqol fl-istonku.
messages.zh: 挺清淡，也容易消化；我一点也没觉得胃里发沉。
messages.en: It was light and easily digested; I felt no heaviness in my stomach.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记两幅画：噪声被人忍受，食物被胃消化；先看主语是什么，再选择对应的中文义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suffer a bruise or wound, for example through a fall or an accident.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到挫伤或创伤，例如因跌倒或事故而受伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isofri tbenġila jew ferita, pereżempju minħabba waqgħa jew inċident.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受挫伤或创伤；被弄伤。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ġġerraħ f'dirgħu waqt li kien qed iġorr kaxxa, u ngħata l-ewwel għajnuna.
formal.en: The worker injured his arm while carrying a box and was given first aid.
formal.zh: 这名工人在搬箱子时手臂受伤，随后接受了急救处理。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex Pawlu għandu faxxa fuq idu? Karl: Ġġerraħ meta waqa' lbieraħ, iżda issa jinsab aħjar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why does Pawlu have a bandage on his hand? Karl: He was injured when he fell yesterday, but he is better now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：保罗手上为什么缠着绷带？卡尔：他昨天跌倒受伤了，不过现在好些了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu għandu faxxa fuq idu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu għandu faxxa fuq idu?
messages.zh: 保罗手上为什么缠着绷带？
messages.en: Why does Pawlu have a bandage on his hand?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġġerraħ meta waqa' lbieraħ, iżda issa jinsab aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Ġġerraħ meta waqa' lbieraħ, iżda issa jinsab aħjar.
messages.zh: 他昨天跌倒受伤了，不过现在好些了。
messages.en: He was injured when he fell yesterday, but he is better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象跌倒后手臂出现淤青、手上缠着绷带，用同一个受伤场景同时记住“挫伤”和“创伤”。

gloss_zh: 做手势；用动作辅助表达

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make expressive movements with the hands or arms, especially while speaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做有表达作用的手部或手臂动作，尤其指说话时用手势辅助表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel movimenti espressivi b'idejh jew b'dirgħajh, speċjalment waqt li jkun qed jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做手势；用手或手臂的动作辅助表达。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem ġġestikola b'idejh biex juri d-daqs tal-oġġett li kien qed jiddeskrivi.
formal.en: The speaker gesticulated with his hands to show the size of the object he was describing.
formal.zh: 发言者用双手比画，展示他所描述物体的大小。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex Mark ġġestikola hekk? Toni: Kien qed jurini kemm kienet kbira l-ħuta li qabad!
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did Mark gesticulate like that? Toni: He was showing me how big the fish he caught was!
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：马克为什么那样比画？托尼：他在给我比画他钓到的鱼有多大！

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么那样比画？
messages.en: Why did Mark gesticulate like that?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien qed jurini kemm kienet kbira l-ħuta li qabad!
messages.mt_standard: Kien qed jurini kemm kienet kbira l-ħuta li qabad!
messages.zh: 他在给我比画他钓到的鱼有多大！
messages.en: He was showing me how big the fish he caught was!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友讲钓鱼故事，双手越张越大；把“嘴里说、手上比画”的画面作为这个动词的记忆提示。

gloss_zh: 变得非常饥饿；生活在饥饿状态中

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become very hungry or live in conditions of starvation because of a lack of food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得非常饥饿，或因食物匮乏而生活在严重饥饿的状态中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss ġuħ qawwi ħafna jew jgħix f'kundizzjonijiet ta' ġuħ kbir minħabba nuqqas ta' ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得非常饥饿；饿得厉害。

sense_translations.en_definition: to live in conditions of starvation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 生活在缺乏食物、遭受严重饥饿的环境中。

collocations.en: became very hungry after a long walk
collocations.zh: 长时间步行后饿得厉害

collocations.en: suffered starvation because of a lack of food
collocations.zh: 因食物短缺而遭受严重饥饿

formal.mt: Matul il-kriżi, il-poplu ġġewwaħ minħabba nuqqas qawwi ta' ikel, u kien hemm bżonn ta' għajnuna urġenti.
formal.en: During the crisis, the population suffered starvation because of a severe food shortage, and urgent aid was needed.
formal.zh: 危机期间，民众因食物严重短缺而遭受饥饿，急需援助。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Ben kiel żewġ platti għaġin? Luka: Ħareġ mingħajr kolazzjon u ġġewwaħ wara l-mixja twila!
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did Ben eat two plates of pasta? Luka: He went out without breakfast and got very hungry after the long walk!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：本为什么吃了两盘意面？卢卡：他没吃早饭就出门了，走了很长一段路后饿坏了！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Ben kiel żewġ platti għaġin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Ben kiel żewġ platti għaġin?
messages.zh: 本为什么吃了两盘意面？
messages.en: Why did Ben eat two plates of pasta?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħareġ mingħajr kolazzjon u ġġewwaħ wara l-mixja twila!
messages.mt_standard: Ħareġ mingħajr kolazzjon u ġġewwaħ wara l-mixja twila!
messages.zh: 他没吃早饭就出门了，走了很长一段路后饿坏了！
messages.en: He went out without breakfast and got very hungry after the long walk!

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象走远路后肚子饿得咕咕叫，再联想长期缺粮的处境；用情境区分一时很饿与持续挨饿。

gloss_zh: 被少量分次食用；被节省着使用

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be eaten a little at a time, or used sparingly so that a supply lasts longer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物被一点一点地吃，或某种供应品被节省着使用，使其能维持更久。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittiekel ftit ftit, jew jintuża bil-qies biex iservi għal żmien itwal.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be eaten in small quantities
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被少量地、分次地食用。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be drawn out or economised on
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被节省着使用，以延长可供使用的时间。

collocations.en: the cheese was eaten a little at a time
the bread was rationed to make it last longer
collocations.zh: 面包被节省着吃，以维持更久

formal.mt: Matul il-vjaġġ, il-ħobż ġġewweż f'porzjonijiet żgħar biex iservi għal diversi ikliet.
formal.en: During the journey, the bread was eaten in small portions so that it would last for several meals.
formal.zh: 旅途中，面包被分成小份食用，以供几顿饭使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif dam daqshekk il-ġobon? Toni: Ġġewweż ftit ftit; kuljum ħadna biss biċċa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the cheese last so long? Toni: It was eaten a little at a time; we only took a small piece each day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：奶酪怎么能吃这么久？托尼：我们一点一点地吃，每天只取一小块。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 奶酪怎么能吃这么久？
messages.en: How did the cheese last so long?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġġewweż ftit ftit; kuljum ħadna biss biċċa żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Ġġewweż ftit ftit; kuljum ħadna biss biċċa żgħira.
messages.zh: 我们一点一点地吃，每天只取一小块。
messages.en: It was eaten a little at a time; we only took a small piece each day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块奶酪每天只切一小片：少量分次吃，便能把供应时间拉长，串起两个义项。

gloss_zh: 变得很脏；染上麻风病或相关皮肤病

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become very dirty; in another sense, to become infected with leprosy or a related skin disease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指变得非常脏；另一个义项指染上麻风病或相关皮肤病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir maħmuġ ħafna; f'tifsira oħra, jimrad bil-lebbra jew b'marda tal-ġilda relatata magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得非常脏。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be infected with a leprosy or related skin disease
sense_translations.zh_definition: 感染麻风病或与之相关的皮肤病。

collocations.en: the coat became very dirty with mud
the shirt became very dirty during work
collocations.zh: 衬衫在工作时弄得很脏

formal.mt: Il-kowt tal-ħaddiem ġġiddem wara ġurnata xogħol f'għalqa mimlija tajn.
formal.en: The worker's coat became very dirty after a day's work in a muddy field.
formal.zh: 工人在泥泞的田里干了一天活后，外套变得非常脏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ħallejt il-kowt barra? Ben: Ġġiddem bit-tajn waqt li kont naħdem fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you leave the coat outside? Ben: It got very dirty with mud while I was working in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把外套留在外面？本：我在花园干活时，外套沾满了泥，弄得很脏。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把外套留在外面？
messages.en: Why did you leave the coat outside?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġġiddem bit-tajn waqt li kont naħdem fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Ġġiddem bit-tajn waqt li kont naħdem fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 我在花园干活时，外套沾满了泥，弄得很脏。
messages.en: It got very dirty with mud while I was working in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用沾满泥的外套记住“变得很脏”；另把疾病义单独记卡，避免把脏污与患病混为一谈。

gloss_zh: 变卷曲；起褶皱；呈波浪状

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become curly, creased, or wavy, depending on the material or surface being described.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指头发、布料等变得卷曲、起褶皱或呈波浪状，具体含义取决于所描述的对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir innukklat, imkemmex jew immewġin, skont il-materjal jew il-wiċċ li jkun qed jiġi deskritt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得卷曲。
起褶皱；变得有折痕。
变得呈波浪状。

collocations.en: the fabric became creased in the suitcase
collocations.zh: 布料在行李箱里起了褶皱

formal.mt: Id-drapp ġġiegħed wara li baqa' magħfus fil-bagalja matul il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The fabric became creased after being compressed in the suitcase throughout the journey.
formal.zh: 布料在整个旅途中一直挤压在行李箱里，结果起了褶皱。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara lid-drapp li xtrajna? Mark: Ġġiegħed fil-bagalja; irridu ngħadduh bil-ħadida.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happened to the fabric we bought? Mark: It got creased in the suitcase; we need to iron it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们买的布料怎么了？马克：在行李箱里压皱了，得熨一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们买的布料怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the fabric we bought?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在行李箱里压皱了，得熨一下。
messages.en: It got creased in the suitcase; we need to iron it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把直线变弯作为画面提示：头发可变卷，布料可起皱，表面可呈波浪；根据主语选择中文义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be forced or compelled to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指受到强迫或强制而不得不做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun imġiegħel jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被迫；受到强制而不得不行动。

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, ix-xhud ġġiegħel iwieġeb mistoqsija li ma riedx jiddiskuti.
formal.en: In the story, the witness was compelled to answer a question he did not want to discuss.
formal.zh: 故事中，证人被迫回答了一个他不愿讨论的问题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark għaliex telaq daqshekk kmieni? Pawlu: Ġġiegħel jitlaq; ma kellux għażla.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark leave so early? Pawlu: He was forced to leave; he had no choice.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么那么早就走了？保罗：他是被迫离开的，没有选择。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么那么早就走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave so early?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是被迫离开的，没有选择。
messages.en: He was forced to leave; he had no choice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人被要求离场、没有选择：先记“被迫”，再接具体动作，如离开或回答。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be provided with a bridal trousseau, such as clothes and household linen prepared for marriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被配备新娘嫁妆，例如为结婚准备的衣物和家用布品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata ħwejjeġ u bjankerija bħala parti mill-korred tal-għarusa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be provided with a bridal trousseau
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被配备新娘嫁妆，包括为婚后生活准备的衣物、布品等。

collocations.en: was provided with bridal clothes as part of a trousseau
collocations.zh: 获配作为嫁妆的新娘衣物

collocations.en: was provided with linen for the wedding trousseau
collocations.zh: 获配作为结婚嫁妆的布品

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru tal-għarusa ġġieheż bi ħwejjeġ u bjankerija qabel it-tieġ.
formal.en: In the story, the bride character was provided with clothes and linen for her trousseau before the wedding.
formal.zh: 故事中的新娘角色在婚礼前获配了衣物和布品，作为嫁妆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'ġġieheż' f'dan ir-rakkont? Toni: Ifisser li l-karattru ngħata korred tal-għarusa, bħal ħwejjeġ u bjankerija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ġġieheż' mean in this story? Toni: It means the character was provided with a bridal trousseau, such as clothes and linen.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇故事里的“ġġieheż”是什么意思？托尼：意思是这个角色获配了新娘嫁妆，例如衣物和布品。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇故事里的“ġġieheż”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ġġieheż' mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-karattru ngħata korred tal-għarusa, bħal ħwejjeġ u bjankerija.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-karattru ngħata korred tal-għarusa, bħal ħwejjeġ u bjankerija.
messages.zh: 意思是这个角色获配了新娘嫁妆，例如衣物和布品。
messages.en: It means the character was provided with a bridal trousseau, such as clothes and linen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象婚前装好衣物与床单的嫁妆箱：记忆重点是“获配嫁妆”这一具体准备过程。

gloss_zh: 自行退到一旁；让到一边

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move or place oneself to one side, for example to let someone pass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指自己移到或站到一旁，例如为了让别人通过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwarrab lejn naħa, pereżempju biex iħalli lil xi ħadd jgħaddi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自行退到一旁；把自己移到一边。

collocations.mt: ġġieneb biex iħalli lil xi ħadd jgħaddi
collocations.en: stepped aside to let someone pass
moved aside next to the wall

formal.mt: Il-viżitatur ġġieneb ħdejn il-ħajt biex il-ħaddiema jkunu jistgħu jgħaddu bil-kaxxi.
formal.en: The visitor moved aside next to the wall so that the workers could pass with the boxes.
formal.zh: 访客让到墙边，好让搬着箱子的工人通过。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu waqaf ħdejn il-ħajt? Ben: Ġġieneb biex iħalli lit-tfal jgħaddu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu stop next to the wall? Ben: He stepped aside to let the children pass.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗为什么停在墙边？本：他让到一旁，好让孩子们通过。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么停在墙边？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop next to the wall?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 他让到一旁，好让孩子们通过。
messages.en: He stepped aside to let the children pass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象狭窄走廊里自己往墙边挪一步：动作由自己完成，结果是让出中间的通道。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wander or roam from place to place; in a separate sense, to be promiscuous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指四处游荡或漫游；另一个独立义项指性关系随便，与不同对象发生性关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idur minn post għal ieħor mingħajr destinazzjoni fissa; f'tifsira oħra, ikollu relazzjonijiet sesswali ma' diversi persuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 游荡；没有固定目的地地走动。
漫游；在某个区域内四处走动。
性关系随便；与不同对象发生性关系，常带评价意味。

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġatur ġġiera fil-kampanja għal diversi sigħat mingħajr destinazzjoni fissa.
formal.en: The traveller roamed through the countryside for several hours without a fixed destination.
formal.zh: 旅人在乡间漫游了几个小时，没有固定的目的地。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn mar Mark wara l-ikla? Pawlu: Ġġiera ftit fit-toroq u mbagħad reġa' lura.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did Mark go after lunch? Pawlu: He wandered around the streets for a while and then came back.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克午饭后去哪里了？保罗：他在街上逛了一会儿，然后就回来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克午饭后去哪里了？
messages.en: Where did Mark go after lunch?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġġiera ftit fit-toroq u mbagħad reġa' lura.
messages.mt_standard: Ġġiera ftit fit-toroq u mbagħad reġa' lura.
messages.zh: 他在街上逛了一会儿，然后就回来了。
messages.en: He wandered around the streets for a while and then came back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用地图上没有固定终点的路线记“游荡、漫游”；涉及性关系的义项另记，不能仅凭外出闲逛推断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gain weight or grow bigger in bodily size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指体重增加，或身体长大、体形变大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżdied fil-piż jew jikber fid-daqs tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体重增加；长胖。
长大；体形或体积变大。

collocations.en: the puppy grew bigger over time

formal.mt: Matul l-ewwel sena tiegħu, il-ġeru ġġissem u sar ferm akbar milli kien meta wasal.
formal.en: During its first year, the puppy grew bigger and became much larger than it had been when it arrived.
formal.zh: 在第一年里，小狗逐渐长大，比刚来时大了很多。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan l-istess ġeru li rajt ix-xahar li għadda? Mark: Iva, ġġissem ħafna minn dakinhar!
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this the same puppy I saw last month? Mark: Yes, he's grown a lot bigger since then!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这是我上个月见过的那只小狗吗？马克：是啊，它从那以后长大了好多！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-istess ġeru li rajt ix-xahar li għadda?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-istess ġeru li rajt ix-xahar li għadda?
messages.zh: 这是我上个月见过的那只小狗吗？
messages.en: Is this the same puppy I saw last month?

messages.speaker: Mark (宠物主人)
messages.zh: 是啊，它从那以后长大了好多！
messages.en: Yes, he's grown a lot bigger since then!

cognitive_memory_aid: 对比小狗前后两张照片：秤上数字增加对应“增重”，身体轮廓变大对应“长大”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To run slowly and steadily, especially for exercise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以较慢而稳定的速度跑步，通常为了锻炼身体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġri bil-mod u b'ritmu regolari, speċjalment bħala eżerċizzju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慢跑；以较慢的速度跑步锻炼。

formal.mt: Bħala parti mill-programm ta' eżerċizzju tiegħu, Mark iġġoggja għal għoxrin minuta fil-park.
formal.en: As part of his exercise programme, Mark jogged for twenty minutes in the park.
formal.zh: 作为锻炼计划的一部分，马克在公园慢跑了二十分钟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġġoggja miegħi fil-park? Mark: Iva, imma ejja nibdew bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to jog with me in the park? Mark: Yes, but let's start slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想和我一起去公园慢跑吗？马克：想，不过我们先慢一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想和我一起去公园慢跑吗？
messages.en: Do you want to jog with me in the park?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，不过我们先慢一点吧。
messages.en: Yes, but let's start slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġġoggja和公园里匀速小跑的画面连起来记：能够边跑边说话的轻松节奏，就是慢跑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become joined to another part, including by being glued together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一部分连接起来，也可指通过胶水粘合在一起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tingħaqad ma' parti oħra, ukoll permezz tal-kolla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连接起来；与另一部分接合在一起。
被胶水粘合在一起；粘接起来。

collocations.en: become joined to the other piece

formal.mt: Wara li nixfet il-kolla, iż-żewġ biċċiet tal-kartun iġġonġaw sew.
formal.en: After the glue dried, the two pieces of cardboard were firmly joined together.
formal.zh: 胶水干燥后，两块硬纸板便牢牢地粘合在一起。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-biċċiet iġġonġaw sew? Pawlu: Iva, il-kolla nixfet u issa ma jinqalgħux.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the pieces join together properly? Pawlu: Yes, the glue has dried and they don't come apart now.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这几块粘牢了吗？保罗：粘牢了，胶水已经干了，现在不会分开了。

messages.speaker: Lara (手工课学生)
messages.zh: 这几块粘牢了吗？
messages.en: Did the pieces join together properly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kolla nixfet u issa ma jinqalgħux.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kolla nixfet u issa ma jinqalgħux.
messages.zh: 粘牢了，胶水已经干了，现在不会分开了。
messages.en: Yes, the glue has dried and they don't come apart now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两块拼图终于接在一起，再想象接口涂上胶水：用这两个连续画面记住连接与粘合两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To form an opinion or make a decision about someone or something after considering the available information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据已有信息，对人或事形成看法、作出判断或进行评判。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifforma opinjoni jew tieħu deċiżjoni dwar persuna jew ħaġa wara li tqis l-informazzjoni disponibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 判断；评判；对人或事作出评价或裁断。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iġġudika kull proposta skont l-istess kriterji u spjega d-deċiżjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The committee judged each proposal according to the same criteria and explained its decision.
formal.zh: 委员会按照相同标准评判了每份提案，并解释了自己的决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek taħseb li l-idea tiegħi mhix tajba? Mark: Ma rridx niġġudika qabel nisma' l-pjan kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still think my idea isn't good? Mark: I don't want to judge before hearing the whole plan.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还是觉得我的主意不好吗？马克：我想听完整个计划再作判断。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek taħseb li l-idea tiegħi mhix tajba?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek taħseb li l-idea tiegħi mhix tajba?
messages.zh: 你还是觉得我的主意不好吗？
messages.en: Do you still think my idea isn't good?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma rridx niġġudika qabel nisma' l-pjan kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Ma rridx niġġudika qabel nisma' l-pjan kollu.
messages.zh: 我想听完整个计划再作判断。
messages.en: I don't want to judge before hearing the whole plan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġġudika放进评委打分的画面：先看材料，再按标准给出判断，帮助记住评判这一核心动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a solemn promise or declaration under oath.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 郑重地宣誓或起誓，承诺所说属实或将履行某项责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel wegħda jew dikjarazzjoni solenni b'ġurament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣誓；起誓；郑重作出誓言。

collocations.en: swear an oath before the court

formal.mt: Qabel ta x-xhieda tiegħu, ix-xhud iġġuramenta li jgħid il-verità.
formal.en: Before giving his testimony, the witness swore to tell the truth.
formal.zh: 证人在作证之前宣誓会说实话。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ix-xhud iġġuramenta qabel tkellem? Pawlu: Iva, wiegħed li jgħid il-verità.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the witness swear an oath before speaking? Pawlu: Yes, he promised to tell the truth.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：证人开口前宣誓了吗？保罗：宣誓了，他承诺会说实话。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 证人开口前宣誓了吗？
messages.en: Did the witness swear an oath before speaking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 宣誓了，他承诺会说实话。
messages.en: Yes, he promised to tell the truth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象证人郑重说出“我保证说实话”，把ġġuramenta和正式宣誓的声音、姿态一起记住。

gloss_zh: 说明……有理；为……提供正当理由

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give reasons or evidence showing that an action, decision, or claim is reasonable or acceptable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供理由或证据，说明某个行为、决定或主张是合理或可以接受的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti raġunijiet jew provi biex turi li azzjoni, deċiżjoni jew stqarrija hija raġonevoli jew aċċettabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为……提供正当理由；说明……合理；论证……有理。

collocations.zh: 说明一项决定的合理性
说明这笔开支的必要性或合理性

formal.mt: Id-direttur iġġustifika l-ispiża billi spjega kif it-tagħmir il-ġdid kien se jtejjeb is-servizz.
formal.en: The director justified the expense by explaining how the new equipment would improve the service.
formal.zh: 主管解释了新设备将如何改善服务，以此说明这笔开支的合理性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se tiġġustifika dan ix-xiri? Mark: Se nispjega li għandna bżonnu għax-xogħol ta' kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: How will you justify this purchase? Mark: I'll explain that we need it for our everyday work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你打算怎样说明这次购买有必要？马克：我会解释，我们的日常工作需要它。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你打算怎样说明这次购买有必要？
messages.en: How will you justify this purchase?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nispjega li għandna bżonnu għax-xogħol ta' kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Se nispjega li għandna bżonnu għax-xogħol ta' kuljum.
messages.zh: 我会解释，我们的日常工作需要它。
messages.en: I'll explain that we need it for our everyday work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“决定旁边要附理由”的画面：ġġustifika就是拿出解释和证据，让别人明白为什么这样做合理。
